	public class ChildrenEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private IElementFilter _Filter;

		private bool _IsInStart;

		private LanguageElement _StartNode;

		private LanguageElement _CurrentNode;

		public object Current => _CurrentNode;

		public ChildrenEnumerator(LanguageElement start)
			: this(start, null)
		{
		}

		public ChildrenEnumerator(LanguageElement start, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			if (start == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("start");
			}
			_Filter = filter;
			_IsInStart = true;
			_StartNode = start;
			_CurrentNode = null;
		}

		private bool ApplyFilter(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_Filter != null)
			{
				return _Filter.Apply(node);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetNextNode(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement nextSibling = node.NextSibling;
			if (nextSibling != null)
			{
				return nextSibling;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = node.Parent;
			if (parent != null && node.IsDetailNode)
			{
				nextSibling = parent.FirstChild;
				if (nextSibling != null)
				{
					return nextSibling;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetFirstChild(LanguageElement node)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = node.FirstDetail;
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = node.FirstChild;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetStartNode(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetFirstChild(node);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			while (languageElement != null)
			{
				if (ApplyFilter(languageElement))
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
				languageElement = GetNextNode(languageElement);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool GetNextFilteredNode(ref LanguageElement node)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = node;
			do
			{
				languageElement = GetNextNode(languageElement);
				if (languageElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			while (!ApplyFilter(languageElement));
			node = languageElement;
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_IsInStart = true;
			_CurrentNode = null;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (_IsInStart)
			{
				_CurrentNode = GetStartNode(_StartNode);
				_IsInStart = false;
				return _CurrentNode != null;
			}
			return GetNextFilteredNode(ref _CurrentNode);
		}
	}
	public enum BracesOnNewLineOptions
	{
		LeaveOnPrevious,
		PlaceOnNewLine
	}
	public enum BraceHolder
	{
		Unknown,
		Type,
		ArrayInitializer,
		AnonymousMethod,
		Method,
		ControlFlow
	}
	public interface IBraceSettings
	{
		BracesOnNewLineOptions this[LanguageElement element] { get; }
	}
	public class DefaultBraceSettings : IBraceSettings
	{
		private Hashtable _BraceSettings;

		public BracesOnNewLineOptions this[LanguageElement element] => GetSettingForLanguageElement(element);

		public DefaultBraceSettings()
		{
			_BraceSettings = new Hashtable();
			try
			{
				LoadDefaultSettings();
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException("Exception while loading brace settings", value);
				LoadDefaultSettings();
			}
		}

		private void LoadDefaultSettings()
		{
			AddBraceSetting(BracesOnNewLineOptions.PlaceOnNewLine, BraceHolder.ControlFlow);
			AddBraceSetting(BracesOnNewLineOptions.PlaceOnNewLine, BraceHolder.AnonymousMethod);
			AddBraceSetting(BracesOnNewLineOptions.PlaceOnNewLine, BraceHolder.Type);
			AddBraceSetting(BracesOnNewLineOptions.PlaceOnNewLine, BraceHolder.Method);
			AddBraceSetting(BracesOnNewLineOptions.LeaveOnPrevious, BraceHolder.ArrayInitializer);
		}

		private void AddBraceSetting(BracesOnNewLineOptions setting, BraceHolder holder)
		{
			if (_BraceSettings != null)
			{
				_BraceSettings[holder] = setting;
			}
		}

		private BraceHolder TranslateLanguageElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return BraceHolder.Unknown;
			}
			if (element is TypeDeclaration)
			{
				return BraceHolder.Type;
			}
			if (element is Method)
			{
				return BraceHolder.Method;
			}
			if (element is AnonymousMethodExpression)
			{
				return BraceHolder.AnonymousMethod;
			}
			if (element is DelimiterCapableBlock)
			{
				return BraceHolder.ControlFlow;
			}
			return BraceHolder.Unknown;
		}

		private BracesOnNewLineOptions GetSettingForLanguageElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (_BraceSettings == null)
			{
				_BraceSettings = new Hashtable();
			}
			BraceHolder braceHolder = TranslateLanguageElement(element);
			if (_BraceSettings.Contains(braceHolder))
			{
				return (BracesOnNewLineOptions)_BraceSettings[braceHolder];
			}
			return BracesOnNewLineOptions.PlaceOnNewLine;
		}

		protected void SetBraceOptionForElement(BraceHolder holder, BracesOnNewLineOptions option)
		{
			if (_BraceSettings == null)
			{
				_BraceSettings = new Hashtable();
			}
			if (_BraceSettings.Contains(holder))
			{
				_BraceSettings[holder] = option;
			}
			else
			{
				_BraceSettings.Add(holder, option);
			}
		}
	}
	public class GeneratingElements : List<LanguageElement>
	{
		public void Push(LanguageElement element)
		{
			Add(element);
		}

		public LanguageElement Peek()
		{
			return base[base.Count - 1];
		}

		public LanguageElement Pop()
		{
			LanguageElement result = Peek();
			RemoveAt(base.Count - 1);
			return result;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LanguageElementCodeGenBase : CodeGenObject
	{
		internal abstract class DisposableOption : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly bool _NeedApplyOption;

			private readonly CodeGen _CodeGen;

			public DisposableOption(bool needApply, CodeGen codeGen)
			{
				_NeedApplyOption = needApply;
				_CodeGen = codeGen;
				if (_NeedApplyOption && _CodeGen != null)
				{
					SetOption(_CodeGen);
				}
			}

			protected abstract void SetOption(CodeGen codeGen);

			protected abstract void ClearOption(CodeGen codeGen);

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (_CodeGen != null && _NeedApplyOption)
				{
					ClearOption(_CodeGen);
				}
			}
		}

		internal class Indention : DisposableOption
		{
			public Indention(bool needApply, CodeGen codeGen)
				: base(needApply, codeGen)
			{
			}

			protected override void SetOption(CodeGen codeGen)
			{
				codeGen.AddIncreaseIndent();
			}

			protected override void ClearOption(CodeGen codeGen)
			{
				codeGen.AddDecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		internal class ClearIndention : DisposableOption
		{
			public ClearIndention(bool needApply, CodeGen codeGen)
				: base(needApply, codeGen)
			{
			}

			protected override void SetOption(CodeGen codeGen)
			{
				codeGen.AddClearIndent();
			}

			protected override void ClearOption(CodeGen codeGen)
			{
				codeGen.AddRestoreIndent();
			}
		}

		private CodeGen _CodeGen;

		protected override CodeGen CodeGen => _CodeGen;

		protected FormattingTokenGen TokenGen => CodeGen.TokenGen;

		public override CodeGenOptions Options => _CodeGen.Options;

		public LanguageElement Context => _CodeGen.Context;

		public LanguageElementCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			if (codeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("codeGen");
			}
			_CodeGen = codeGen;
		}

		private bool FindElement(LanguageElementType[] list, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (list == null || element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = list.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (list[i] == element.ElementType)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool WillSkipOtherElements(ICollection parameters, LanguageElementType[] excludeElements, int paramIndex)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = 0;
			bool result = false;
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				if (num++ > paramIndex)
				{
					if (!SkipElement(parameter) && !FindElement(excludeElements, parameter))
					{
						return false;
					}
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void WriteDelimiter(FormattingTokenType[] delimiters, ref int delimiterIndex)
		{
			int num = CodeGen.Contexts.Count - 1;
			int count = CodeGen.Contexts.Count;
			if (count > 1 && CodeGen.Contexts[count - 2] is GenericModifier)
			{
				num -= 2;
			}
			foreach (FormattingTokenType formattingTokenType in delimiters)
			{
				if (formattingTokenType != FormattingTokenType.None)
				{
					Write(formattingTokenType, num, delimiterIndex, null);
					delimiterIndex++;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddLineBreakAfterDelimiterIfNeeded(bool needLineBreak, LanguageElement generated)
		{
			if (needLineBreak && !(generated is SnippetCodeElement) && !(generated is Variable { NextVariable: not null }))
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		protected string GetLineContinuation()
		{
			string lineContinuation = LineContinuation;
			string lastLine = base.Code.LastLine;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastLine) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineContinuation))
			{
				return lineContinuation;
			}
			if (lineContinuation.StartsWith(lastLine[lastLine.Length - 1].ToString()))
			{
				return lineContinuation.Remove(0, 1);
			}
			return lineContinuation;
		}

		protected bool SkipElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CodeGen.IsSkipped(element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (element is Comment { ElementType: not LanguageElementType.XmlDocComment } comment)
			{
				if (comment.TargetNode != null && comment.TargetNode.Parent != null)
				{
					return comment.Position != SupportElementPosition.Inside;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (element is AttributeSection { TargetNode: not null } attributeSection && !(attributeSection.TargetNode is SourceFile) && !(attributeSection.Parent is ElementList))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ContextMatch(LanguageElementType type)
		{
			return Context.ElementType == type;
		}

		protected virtual void Write(string text)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident, text);
		}

		protected virtual void Write(string text, bool split)
		{
			TokenGen.WriteCode(new GenTextArgs(CodeGen, text, split));
		}

		protected virtual void IncreaseIndent()
		{
			CodeGen.AddIncreaseIndent();
		}

		protected virtual void DecreaseIndent()
		{
			CodeGen.AddDecreaseIndent();
		}

		protected IDisposable GetIndent(bool needIndent)
		{
			return new Indention(needIndent, CodeGen);
		}

		protected IDisposable GetIndent()
		{
			return GetIndent(Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents);
		}

		protected IDisposable GetClearIndent(bool needClear)
		{
			return new ClearIndention(needClear, CodeGen);
		}

		internal bool ElementWasGenerated(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return CodeGen.ElementWasGenerated(element);
		}

		internal void AddGeneratedElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			CodeGen.AddGeneratedElement(element);
		}

		internal void RemoveGeneratedElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			CodeGen.RemoveGeneratedElement(element);
		}

		public virtual bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			return CodeGen.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
		}

		public virtual FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			return CodeGen.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
		}

		public virtual void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, FormattingTokenType delimiter, bool lineBreakAfterDelimiter, params LanguageElementType[] excludeElements)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, new FormattingTokenType[1] { delimiter }, lineBreakAfterDelimiter, excludeElements);
		}

		public virtual void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, FormattingTokenType[] delimiters, bool lineBreakAfterDelimiter, params LanguageElementType[] excludeElements)
		{
			int count = parameters.Count;
			if (count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int delimiterIndex = 0;
			int num = -1;
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				num++;
				if (!SkipElement(parameter) && !FindElement(excludeElements, parameter))
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(parameter);
					if (num < count - 1 && !WillSkipOtherElements(parameters, excludeElements, num))
					{
						WriteDelimiter(delimiters, ref delimiterIndex);
					}
					AddLineBreakAfterDelimiterIfNeeded(lineBreakAfterDelimiter, parameter);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void GenerateParameters(ICollection parameters)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		public override bool IsSkipped(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return _CodeGen.IsSkipped(element);
		}

		public override void AddSkipped(LanguageElement element)
		{
			_CodeGen.AddSkipped(element);
		}

		public override void ClearSkippedElements()
		{
			_CodeGen.ClearSkippedElements();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public CodeGen GetCodeGen()
		{
			return CodeGen;
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, FormattingTokenType.None);
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, FormattingTokenType delimiter)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, new FormattingTokenType[1] { delimiter }, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: false, null);
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, FormattingTokenType[] delimiters)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, delimiters, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: false, null);
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, FormattingTokenType delimiter, params LanguageElementType[] excludeElements)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, delimiter, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: false, excludeElements);
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, FormattingTokenType delimiter, bool lineBreakAfterDelimiter)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, delimiter, lineBreakAfterDelimiter, null);
		}

		public void Write(TokenList types)
		{
			if (types == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FormattingTokenType type in types)
			{
				Write(type, 0);
			}
		}

		public void Write(params FormattingTokenType[] types)
		{
			if (types != null)
			{
				foreach (FormattingTokenType type in types)
				{
					Write(type, 0);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Write(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			Write(type, 0);
		}

		public void Write(FormattingTokenType type, int index)
		{
			TokenGen.WriteCode(new GenTextArgs(CodeGen, type, index));
		}

		public void Write(FormattingTokenType type, string tokenText)
		{
			Write(new GenTextArgs(CodeGen, type, 0, tokenText));
		}

		public void Write(FormattingTokenType type, int index, string tokenText)
		{
			TokenGen.WriteCode(new GenTextArgs(CodeGen, type, index, tokenText));
		}

		public void Write(FormattingTokenType type, int contextsIndex, int index, string tokenText)
		{
			TokenGen.WriteCode(new GenTextArgs(CodeGen, contextsIndex, type, index, tokenText));
		}

		public void Write(GenTextArgs args)
		{
			TokenGen.WriteCode(args);
		}

		public void CodeWritePrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			TokenGen.WritePrevFormattingElements(type, 0);
		}

		public void CodeWriteNextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			TokenGen.WriteNextFormattingElements(type, 0);
		}

		private bool SkipElementOld(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (CodeGen.IsSkipped(element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (element is AttributeSection { TargetNode: not null } attributeSection && !(attributeSection.TargetNode is SourceFile))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void GenerateParameters(ICollection parameters, string delimiter)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, delimiter, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: false, null);
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, string delimiter)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, delimiter, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: false, null);
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, string delimiter, params LanguageElementType[] excludeElements)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, delimiter, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: false, excludeElements);
		}

		public void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, string delimiter, bool lineBreakAfterDelimiter)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, delimiter, lineBreakAfterDelimiter, null);
		}

		public virtual void GenerateElementCollection(ICollection parameters, string delimiter, bool lineBreakAfterDelimiter, params LanguageElementType[] excludeElements)
		{
			int count = parameters.Count;
			if (count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				if (SkipElementOld(parameter) || FindElement(excludeElements, parameter))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					base.Code.Write(delimiter);
					if (lineBreakAfterDelimiter && !flag2)
					{
						if (flag3)
						{
							CodeGen.TokenGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
						}
						else
						{
							base.Code.WriteLine();
						}
					}
				}
				CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, parameter);
				flag = false;
				flag2 = parameter is SnippetCodeElement || parameter is SnippetCodeStatementBlock;
				if (!flag2)
				{
					flag2 = parameter.LastChild is SnippetCodeStatementBlock snippetCodeStatementBlock && snippetCodeStatementBlock.AddNewLineAfter;
				}
				flag3 = parameter is AttributeSection;
			}
		}

		protected void WriteOpenBrace(bool onNewLine, bool spaceBefore, bool spaceAfter, bool increaseIndent)
		{
			bool openAndCloseBraces = Options.Indention.OpenAndCloseBraces;
			if (openAndCloseBraces)
			{
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
			}
			if (onNewLine)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			else if (spaceBefore)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("{");
			if (spaceAfter)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			if (openAndCloseBraces)
			{
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			}
			if (increaseIndent)
			{
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		protected void WriteCloseBrace(bool onNewLine, bool spaceBefore, bool decreaseIndent)
		{
			bool openAndCloseBraces = Options.Indention.OpenAndCloseBraces;
			if (openAndCloseBraces)
			{
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
			}
			if (decreaseIndent)
			{
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			}
			if (onNewLine)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			else if (spaceBefore)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("}");
			if (openAndCloseBraces)
			{
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		protected string GetCommaDelimeter()
		{
			return GetCommaDelimeter(string.Empty);
		}

		protected string GetCommaDelimeter(string endOfLineChar)
		{
			string text = ",";
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeComma)
			{
				text = " " + text;
			}
			if (Options.Spacing.AfterComma)
			{
				text = ((!endOfLineChar.StartsWith(" ")) ? (text + " ") : (text + endOfLineChar));
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(endOfLineChar))
			{
				text += endOfLineChar;
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected void WriteOpenParen(bool spaceBefore, bool spaceAfter)
		{
			if (spaceBefore)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("(");
			if (spaceAfter)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
		}

		protected void WriteCloseParen(bool spaceBefore)
		{
			if (spaceBefore)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(")");
		}

		protected void WriteLineTerminator<T>(bool needWrite, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (needWrite && element != null)
			{
				LanguageElement nextCodeSibling = element.NextCodeSibling;
				if (nextCodeSibling != null && !(nextCodeSibling is T) && !(nextCodeSibling is SourceFile))
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void WriteDot()
		{
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeDot)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(".");
			if (Options.Spacing.AfterDot)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
		}

		protected void WriteOperator(string op)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(op))
			{
				bool flag = ((op.Length == 1) ? Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators : Options.Spacing.AroundTwoCharOperators);
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write(op);
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
			}
		}

		protected void WriteSemicolon()
		{
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: true);
		}

		protected void WriteSemicolon(bool spacingAfter)
		{
			WriteWhithing(Options.Spacing.BeforeSemicolon, ";", spacingAfter);
		}

		protected void WriteWhithing(bool before, string text, bool after)
		{
			if (before)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(text);
			if (after)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
		}

		public void GenerateElementsByRules(NodeList parameters, ElementsGenerationRules rules)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = parameters.Count;
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (rules.WrapFirst)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine(LineContinuation);
			}
			bool flag2 = rules.Indenting && rules.WrapFirst;
			bool flag3 = rules.Indenting && rules.WrapParams;
			string lastLineInSpacesWithoutIndent = base.Code.LastLineInSpacesWithoutIndent;
			if (flag2)
			{
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					PrepareNextElementSpaces(lastLineInSpacesWithoutIndent, rules);
				}
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(parameter);
				if (flag && !flag2 && flag3)
				{
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag2 || flag3)
			{
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		private void PrepareNextElementSpaces(string firstSpaces, ElementsGenerationRules rules)
		{
			if (rules.HasStringDelimiter)
			{
				base.Code.Write(rules.StringDelimiter);
			}
			if (rules.WrapParams)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine(LineContinuation);
				if (rules.AlignIfWrap)
				{
					base.Code.Write(firstSpaces);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TokenSourceFileCodeGenBase : SourceFileCodeGenBase
	{
		public TokenSourceFileCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		private bool HasFileStartToken(SourceFile file)
		{
			if (file == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return file.Tokens?.HasElement(FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart) ?? false;
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement is SourceFile sourceFile)
			{
				if (HasFileStartToken(sourceFile))
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart);
				}
				else
				{
					CodeGen.DirectiveGen.GenerateTopDirectives(sourceFile);
				}
				CodeGen.ExpressionGen.GenerateElementCollection(sourceFile.Nodes);
				if (!base.SaveFormat && Options.OtherLanguageSpecific.AddLineFeedAtEndOfFile)
				{
					CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.EndsEOLNecessary = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TokenCSnippetCodeGen : SnippetCodeGenBase
	{
		public TokenCSnippetCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeElement(SnippetCodeElement snippet)
		{
			Write(snippet.Code);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeMember(SnippetCodeMember snippet)
		{
			Write(snippet.Code);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeStatement(SnippetCodeStatement snippet)
		{
			if (snippet.AddBlock)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			}
			Write(snippet.Code);
			if (snippet.AddStatementTerminator)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
			if (snippet.AddBlock)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeStatementBlock(SnippetCodeStatementBlock snippet)
		{
			Write(snippet.Code);
			if (snippet.AddNewLineAfter)
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetExpression(SnippetExpression snippet)
		{
			Write(snippet.Code);
		}
	}
	public class CSnippetCodeGen : SnippetCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSnippetCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeElement(SnippetCodeElement snippet)
		{
			base.Code.Write(snippet.Code);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeMember(SnippetCodeMember snippet)
		{
			base.Code.Write(snippet.Code);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeStatement(SnippetCodeStatement snippet)
		{
			if (snippet.AddBlock)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine("{");
			}
			Write(snippet.Code);
			if (snippet.AddStatementTerminator)
			{
				base.Code.Write(";");
			}
			if (snippet.AddBlock)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Code.LastLine))
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
				base.Code.Write("}");
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeStatementBlock(SnippetCodeStatementBlock snippet)
		{
			base.Code.Write(snippet.Code);
			if (snippet.AddNewLineAfter)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetExpression(SnippetExpression snippet)
		{
			base.Code.Write(snippet.Code);
		}
	}
	public abstract class TokenCStatementCodeGenBase : StatementCodeGenBase
	{
		public TokenCStatementCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		private bool HasChildVariables(Statement statement)
		{
			if (statement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int nodeCount = statement.NodeCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				object obj = statement.Nodes[i];
				if (obj is BaseVariable)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool HasAtLeastOneSnipppet(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NodeList nodes = element.Nodes;
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement item in nodes)
			{
				if (item is SnippetCodeElement element2 && !IsSystemSnippet(element2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsSystemSnippet(SnippetCodeElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string name = element.Name;
			if (!(name == "«Caret»"))
			{
				return name == "«BlockAnchor»";
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected static bool IsIfStatementWithElseAndNestedIf(Statement statement)
		{
			if (!(statement is If obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj.ElseStatement is Else))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj.FindChildByElementType(LanguageElementType.If) is If obj3 && obj3.Parent == statement)
			{
				return obj3.ElseStatement == null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void GenerateBlockStatementContents(Statement statement)
		{
			if (NeedToAddBraces(statement, Options, out var alwaysHasBlock))
			{
				if (alwaysHasBlock)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
					GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
					return;
				}
				TokenGenArgs args = null;
				bool flag = statement.Tokens != null && statement.Tokens.HasElement(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				if (!flag)
				{
					args = CodeGen.GetArgs().LogicForProcessComment();
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				if (!flag)
				{
					CodeGen.RestoreSavedArgs(args);
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes);
				bool flag2 = statement.Tokens != null && statement.Tokens.HasElement(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
				if (!flag2)
				{
					args = CodeGen.GetArgs().LogicForProcessComment();
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
				if (!flag2)
				{
					CodeGen.RestoreSavedArgs(args);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes);
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateParentingStatement(ParentingStatement statement, FormattingTokenType keyword, FormattingTokenType delimiter)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, statement.DetailNodes, keyword, delimiter);
		}

		protected void GenerateParentingStatement(ParentingStatement statement, NodeList collection, FormattingTokenType keyword, FormattingTokenType delimiter)
		{
			Write(keyword);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(collection, delimiter);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
			CodeGen.GenerateContextBackComment();
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateLabelStatement(Label statement)
		{
			using (GetClearIndent(!Options.Indention.IndentLabels))
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateUnsafeStatement(UnsafeStatement statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Unsafe);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateOptionStatement(OptionStatement statement)
		{
		}

		protected override bool GenerateStatement(Statement statement)
		{
			bool flag = base.GenerateStatement(statement);
			if (flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			if (statement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Label)
			{
				return false;
			}
			GenerateLabelStatement(statement as Label);
			return true;
		}

		protected override void GenerateAbortStatement(Abort statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateGotoStatement(Goto statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.GoTo);
			if (statement.IsGotoCaseLabel)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Case);
			}
			if (statement.IsGotoCaseDefault)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Default);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(statement.Label);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateBreakStatement(Break statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Break);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateContinueStatement(Continue statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Continue);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateStatementStatement(Statement statement)
		{
			if (statement.SourceExpression != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.SourceExpression);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
			if (!statement.IsDetailNode)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethodCallStatement(MethodCall statement)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Qualifier);
			GenerateParameters(statement.Arguments);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateAssignmentStatement(Assignment statement)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.LeftSide);
			TokenCExpressionCodeGenBase.GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(this);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSwitchStatement(Switch statement)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.Switch, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
		}

		protected override void GenerateCaseStatement(Case statement)
		{
			if (statement.IsDefault)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Default);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Case);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Expression);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTryStatement(Try statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Try);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateCatchStatement(Catch statement)
		{
			if (statement.DetailNodeCount > 0)
			{
				GenerateParentingStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.Catch, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				return;
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Catch);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateFinallyStatement(Finally statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Finally);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateUsingStatement(UsingStatement statement)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, statement.Initializers, FormattingTokenType.Using, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
		}

		protected override void GenerateDoStatement(Do statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Do);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.While);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Condition);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateForStatement(For statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.For);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.Initializers, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Condition);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.Incrementors, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateForEachStatement(ForEach statement)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.Foreach, FormattingTokenType.In);
		}

		protected override void GenerateWhileStatement(While statement)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.While, FormattingTokenType.None);
		}

		protected override void GenerateIfStatement(If statement)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.If, FormattingTokenType.None);
		}

		protected override void GenerateElseIfStatement(ElseIf statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Else);
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.If, FormattingTokenType.WhiteSpace);
		}

		protected override void GenerateElseStatement(Else statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Else);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEmptyStatement(EmptyStatement statement)
		{
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateBlockStatement(Block statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateReturnStatement(Return statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Return);
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		internal static bool NeedToAddBraces(Statement statement, CodeGenOptions options)
		{
			bool alwaysHasBlock;
			return NeedToAddBraces(statement, options, out alwaysHasBlock);
		}

		internal static bool NeedToAddBraces(Statement statement, CodeGenOptions options, out bool alwaysHasBlock)
		{
			alwaysHasBlock = false;
			if (statement == null || options == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HasAtLeastOneSnipppet(statement))
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (statement.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Block:
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
			case LanguageElementType.Switch:
			case LanguageElementType.Try:
			case LanguageElementType.Catch:
			case LanguageElementType.Finally:
			case LanguageElementType.Checked:
			case LanguageElementType.Unchecked:
			case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
			case LanguageElementType.UnsafeStatement:
				alwaysHasBlock = true;
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Do:
			case LanguageElementType.Fixed:
			case LanguageElementType.If:
			case LanguageElementType.Else:
			case LanguageElementType.For:
			case LanguageElementType.ForEach:
			case LanguageElementType.While:
			case LanguageElementType.Lock:
			case LanguageElementType.UsingStatement:
				if (statement is ParentingStatement { HasBlock: not false })
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (IsIfStatementWithElseAndNestedIf(statement))
			{
				return true;
			}
			int nodeCount = statement.NodeCount;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (statement.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement && !IsSystemSnippet(languageElement as SnippetCodeElement) && languageElement is CodeElement && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Catch && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Finally && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Else && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ElseIf)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num != 1;
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			CSharpCodeGen cSharpCodeGen = null;
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				switch (base.Context.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.For:
				case LanguageElementType.ForEach:
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeForForeachParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Lock:
				case LanguageElementType.UsingStatement:
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeUsingLockParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Fixed:
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeFixedParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.While:
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeWhileParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.If:
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeIfParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Switch:
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeSwitchParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Catch:
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeCatchParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				switch (base.Context.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.For:
				case LanguageElementType.ForEach:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinForForeachParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Lock:
				case LanguageElementType.UsingStatement:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinUsingLockParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Fixed:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinFixedParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.While:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinWhileParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.If:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinIfParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Catch:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinCatchParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Switch:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinSwitchParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Semicolon:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.For && Options.Spacing.BeforeSemicolonInForStatement)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ForEach)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Label && Options.Spacing.BeforeColonInLabels)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Case && Options.Spacing.BeforeColonInCaseStatement)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ConstructorInitializer) && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceConstructorInitializerOnSameLine)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Else:
				if (!(CodeGen is CSharpCodeGen { ContextIsFirstElement: not false }))
				{
					If obj = base.Context.PreviousCodeSibling as If;
					bool flag = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceElseStatementOnNewLine && !(base.Context.PreviousSibling is SupportElement);
					bool flag2 = obj != null && !obj.HasBlock;
					bool flag3 = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && obj != null && obj.NodeCount == 1 && base.Context.NodeCount == 1;
					if ((flag || flag2) && !flag3)
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
					else
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Finally:
				if (!(CodeGen is CSharpCodeGen { ContextIsFirstElement: not false }) && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceFinallyStatementOnNewLine)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Catch:
				if (!(CodeGen is CSharpCodeGen { ContextIsFirstElement: not false }) && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceCatchStatementOnNewLine)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.While:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Do) && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceWhileStatementOnNewLine)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					if (!NeedToAddBraces(base.Context as Statement, Options, out var _) && Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents)
					{
						formattingElements.AddDecreaseIndent();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Add:
			case FormattingTokenType.Remove:
				if ((ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.EventAdd) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.EventRemove)) && base.Context is IHasAttributes hasAttributes && hasAttributes.Attributes.Count > 0)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				switch (base.Context.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.For:
				case LanguageElementType.ForEach:
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapForStatementHeader)
					{
						formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
					}
					else if (Options.Spacing.WithinForForeachParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Lock:
				case LanguageElementType.UsingStatement:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinUsingLockParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Fixed:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinFixedParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.While:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinWhileParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.If:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinIfParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Catch:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinCatchParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Switch:
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinSwitchParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				if (base.Context is Statement statement && !NeedToAddBraces(statement, Options) && base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MethodCall && base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression && base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Do)
				{
					if (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && statement.NodeCount == 1)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					else
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
					if (statement.ElementType == LanguageElementType.UsingStatement && statement.NodeCount > 0)
					{
						bool flag = false;
						foreach (LanguageElement node in statement.Nodes)
						{
							if (node.ElementType == LanguageElementType.UsingStatement)
							{
								if (Options.Indention.IndentNestedUsingStatements)
								{
									formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
								}
								flag = true;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					if (Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents)
					{
						formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
					}
				}
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.For) && Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapForStatementHeader)
				{
					formattingElements.AddDecreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Else:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ElseIf)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (NeedToAddBraces((Statement)base.Context, Options))
				{
					break;
				}
				if ((Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && base.Context.NodeCount == 1) || (base.Context.NextNode is If && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceIfStatementFollowedByElseOnNewLine))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					break;
				}
				formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				if (Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents)
				{
					formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Semicolon:
				switch (base.Context.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.For:
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapForStatementHeader)
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
					else if (Options.Spacing.AfterSemicolonInForStatement)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
				case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
				case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
				case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
				case LanguageElementType.EventRaise:
					if (base.Context.NextSibling == null || !(base.Context.Parent is AccessSpecifiedElement accessSpecifiedElement))
					{
						break;
					}
					if (accessSpecifiedElement is Property { IsAutoImplemented: not false })
					{
						if (!Options.LineBreaks.PlaceAutoImplementedPropertyOnSingleLine)
						{
							formattingElements.AddNewLine();
						}
					}
					else if (!Options.LineBreaks.PlaceAbstractInterfaceMemberOnSingleLine)
					{
						if (accessSpecifiedElement.IsAbstract)
						{
							formattingElements.AddNewLine();
						}
						else if (accessSpecifiedElement.Parent is Interface)
						{
							formattingElements.AddNewLine();
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
			{
				LanguageElementType elementType = base.Context.ElementType;
				if (elementType == LanguageElementType.Case)
				{
					if (Options.Indention.CaseStatementContents)
					{
						formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
					}
					if (base.Context.NodeCount > 0 && !(base.Context.Nodes[0] is Block))
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case FormattingTokenType.GoTo:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Case:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Return:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Return))
				{
					if (((Return)base.Context).Expression != null)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.YieldReturn) && ((YieldReturn)base.Context).Expression != null)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Do:
				if (!NeedToAddBraces(base.Context as Statement, Options))
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					if (Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents)
					{
						formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.While:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Do) && Options.Spacing.BeforeWhileParentheses)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}
	public abstract class CodeGen : CodeGenObject
	{
		private LanguageElement _FirstElement;

		private CodeGenOptions _Options;

		private DirectiveCodeGenBase _DirectiveGen;

		private ExpressionCodeGenBase _ExpressionGen;

		private MemberCodeGenBase _MemberGen;

		private StatementCodeGenBase _StatementGen;

		private SupportElementCodeGenBase _SupportElementGen;

		private TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase _TypeDeclarationGen;

		private XmlCodeGenBase _XmlGen;

		private NamespaceReferenceGenBase _NamespaceReferenceGen;

		private NamespaceGenBase _NamespaceGen;

		private SnippetCodeGenBase _SnippetGen;

		private TemplateCodeGenBase _TemplateGen;

		private TemplateParameterCodeGenBase _TemplateParameterGen;

		private SourceFileCodeGenBase _SourceFileGen;

		private HtmlXmlCodeGenBase _HtmlXmlCodeGen;

		private GeneratingElements _Contexts = new GeneratingElements();

		private FormattingTokenGen _TokenGen;

		private bool _GenCommentsFromToken;

		private List<LanguageElement> _GeneratedElements;

		internal FormattingTokenGen TokenGen
		{
			get
			{
				if (_TokenGen == null)
				{
					_TokenGen = new FormattingTokenGen(this);
				}
				return _TokenGen;
			}
		}

		internal virtual FormattingTable FormattingTable => null;

		internal GeneratingElements Contexts => _Contexts;

		public LanguageElement Context
		{
			get
			{
				if (Contexts == null || Contexts.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Contexts.Peek();
			}
		}

		public TemplateParameterCodeGenBase TemplateParameterGen => _TemplateParameterGen;

		public SourceFileCodeGenBase SourceFileGen => _SourceFileGen;

		public TemplateCodeGenBase TemplateGen => _TemplateGen;

		public DirectiveCodeGenBase DirectiveGen => _DirectiveGen;

		public ExpressionCodeGenBase ExpressionGen => _ExpressionGen;

		public MemberCodeGenBase MemberGen => _MemberGen;

		public SupportElementCodeGenBase SupportElementGen => _SupportElementGen;

		public StatementCodeGenBase StatementGen => _StatementGen;

		public TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase TypeDeclarationGen => _TypeDeclarationGen;

		public XmlCodeGenBase XmlGen => _XmlGen;

		public NamespaceReferenceGenBase NamespaceReferenceGen => _NamespaceReferenceGen;

		public NamespaceGenBase NamespaceGen => _NamespaceGen;

		public SnippetCodeGenBase SnippetGen => _SnippetGen;

		public override CodeGenOptions Options
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SaveFormat)
				{
					_Options.SaveFormat = true;
				}
				else
				{
					_Options.SaveFormat = false;
				}
				return _Options;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool GenCommentsFromToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _GenCommentsFromToken;
			}
			set
			{
				_GenCommentsFromToken = value;
			}
		}

		public HtmlXmlCodeGenBase HtmlXmlCodeGen => _HtmlXmlCodeGen;

		public bool GeneratingInSupportElement
		{
			get
			{
				return TokenGen.GeneratingInSupportElement;
			}
			set
			{
				TokenGen.GeneratingInSupportElement = value;
			}
		}

		public CodeGen()
			: this(CodeGenOptions.Default)
		{
		}

		public CodeGen(CodeGenOptions options)
		{
			if (options == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("options");
			}
			_Options = options;
			InitializeCodeGenObjects();
		}

		private bool PrevContextHasAttributeSection(AttributeSection section)
		{
			if (section == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(GetPrevContext() is CodeElement codeElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return codeElement.AttributeSections.Contains(section);
		}

		private bool IsSecondaryAncestorTypeReference(LanguageElement context, TypeDeclaration type)
		{
			if (type.SecondaryAncestorTypes != null && type.SecondaryAncestorTypes.Contains(context))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAncestorTypeReference(LanguageElement context, TypeDeclaration type)
		{
			if (context == null || type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (type.PrimaryAncestorType == context)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return IsSecondaryAncestorTypeReference(context, type);
		}

		private bool IsHandlesExpression(LanguageElement context, Member parent)
		{
			if (context == null || parent == null || parent.HandlesExpressions == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(context is Expression expression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return parent.HandlesExpressions.Contains(expression);
		}

		private bool IsImplementsExpression(LanguageElement context, Member member)
		{
			if (context == null || member == null || member.ImplementsExpressions == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(context is Expression expression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return member.ImplementsExpressions.Contains(expression);
		}

		private bool IsFirst(Variable var)
		{
			if (var == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = var.NextVariable != null;
			bool flag2 = var.PreviousVariable != null;
			if (!flag2 && flag)
			{
				return !var.IsDetailNode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsLast(Variable var)
		{
			if (var == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = var.NextVariable != null;
			if (var.PreviousVariable != null && !flag)
			{
				return !var.IsDetailNode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsNotFirst(Variable var)
		{
			if (var == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (var.PreviousVariable != null)
			{
				return !var.IsDetailNode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetTokenText(FormattingTokenType type, LanguageElement fromElement)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart:
				return string.Empty;
			case FormattingTokenType.Ident:
				if (fromElement != null)
				{
					return fromElement.Name;
				}
				break;
			}
			return FormattingTable.Get(type);
		}

		protected Expression[] GetBinaryList(BinaryOperatorExpression oper)
		{
			List<Expression> list = new List<Expression>();
			if (oper == null)
			{
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			if (oper.LeftSide != null)
			{
				if (oper.LeftSide is BinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					list.AddRange(GetBinaryList(oper.LeftSide as BinaryOperatorExpression));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(oper.LeftSide);
				}
			}
			if (oper.RightSide != null)
			{
				if (oper.RightSide is BinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					list.AddRange(GetBinaryList(oper.RightSide as BinaryOperatorExpression));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(oper.RightSide);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedIndenting(LanguageElement element, bool pushed)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = element.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (parent.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation:
				if (!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapLogicalOperatorExpression)
				{
					return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOperatorInLogicalExpression;
				}
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.BinaryOperatorExpression:
				if (!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOperatorInBinaryExpression;
				}
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.GenericModifier:
				if (!(element is TypeParameter))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (pushed)
				{
					if (ElementWasGenerated(element))
					{
						if ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameterConstraints && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint) || Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint)
						{
							return false;
						}
						return !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint;
					}
					if ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameters && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameter) || Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameter)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameter;
				}
				if (!ElementWasGenerated(element))
				{
					if ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameterConstraints && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint) || Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint;
				}
				if ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameters && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameter) || Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameter)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameter;
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
				return Options.Indention.ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents;
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression:
			{
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument || (!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments))
				{
					return false;
				}
				ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = (ObjectCreationExpression)parent;
				if (objectCreationExpression.Arguments != null)
				{
					return objectCreationExpression.Arguments.Contains(element);
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCall:
			{
				if ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments) || Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MethodCall methodCall = (MethodCall)parent;
				if (methodCall.Arguments != null)
				{
					return methodCall.Arguments.Contains(element);
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression:
			{
				if ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments) || Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)parent;
				if (methodCallExpression.Arguments != null)
				{
					return methodCallExpression.Arguments.Contains(element);
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression:
			{
				if ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments) || Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IndexerExpression indexerExpression = (IndexerExpression)parent;
				if (indexerExpression.Arguments != null)
				{
					return indexerExpression.Arguments.Contains(element);
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Method:
				if ((Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstFormalParameter || Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFormalParameters) && !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstFormalParameter)
				{
					Method method = (Method)parent;
					if (method.Parameters != null && method.Parameters.Contains(element))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.QueryExpression:
				if (parent.Parent != null && !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstQueryExpressionItem)
				{
					return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapQueryExpression;
				}
				return false;
			}
			TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = parent as TypeDeclaration;
			if ((Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstAncestorsListItem || (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapAncestorsListInTypeDeclaration && !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstAncestorsListItem)) && typeDeclaration != null)
			{
				if (typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes != null && typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count > 0 && typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes.IndexOf(element) == typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count - 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (typeDeclaration.PrimaryAncestorType == element)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if ((Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstImplementsHandlesSectionItem || Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapImplementsHandlesSectionItems) && !Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstImplementsHandlesSectionItem)
			{
				if (parent is Member member && (IsHandlesExpression(element, member) || IsImplementsExpression(element, member)))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (typeDeclaration != null && IsAncestorTypeReference(element, typeDeclaration))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Expression[] GetBinaryList(LanguageElement element)
		{
			BinaryOperatorExpression binaryOperatorExpression = element.Parent as BinaryOperatorExpression;
			if (element == null || binaryOperatorExpression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			while (binaryOperatorExpression.Parent is BinaryOperatorExpression)
			{
				binaryOperatorExpression = (BinaryOperatorExpression)binaryOperatorExpression.Parent;
			}
			return GetBinaryList(binaryOperatorExpression);
		}

		protected void Alignment(LanguageElement context, bool pushed)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (pushed)
			{
				if (IsFirst(context))
				{
					if (NeedWrapFirst(context))
					{
						AddWrappingNewLine();
					}
					if (NeedAlignment(context, pushed))
					{
						AddIncreaseAlignment();
					}
					else if (NeedIndenting(context, pushed))
					{
						AddIncreaseIndent();
					}
				}
				else if (IsNotFirst(context) && NeedWrapWithoutFirst(context))
				{
					AddWrappingNewLine();
				}
			}
			else if (IsLast(context))
			{
				if (NeedAlignment(context, pushed))
				{
					AddDecreaseAlignment();
				}
				else if (NeedIndenting(context, pushed))
				{
					AddDecreaseIndent();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void AddDecreaseAlignment()
		{
			TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.FormattingElements.AddDecreaseAlignment();
		}

		protected bool IsFirst(NodeList coll, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (coll == null || element == null || coll.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return coll[0] == element;
		}

		protected bool IsLast(NodeList coll, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (coll == null || element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (coll.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return coll[coll.Count - 1] == element;
		}

		protected bool IsNotFirst(NodeList coll, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (coll == null || element == null || coll.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (coll.Contains(element))
			{
				return coll[0] != element;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsFirst(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (context is Variable var)
			{
				return IsFirst(var);
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.AttributeVariableInitializer)
			{
				Expression[] binaryList = GetBinaryList(context);
				if (binaryList != null && binaryList.Length != 0)
				{
					return binaryList[0] == context;
				}
			}
			switch (parent.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.GenericModifier:
			{
				TypeParameterCollection typeParameters = ((GenericModifier)parent).TypeParameters;
				if (typeParameters != null)
				{
					return typeParameters.IndexOf(context) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
			{
				ArrayInitializerExpression arrayInitializerExpression = (ArrayInitializerExpression)parent;
				if (arrayInitializerExpression.Initializers != null)
				{
					return arrayInitializerExpression.Initializers.IndexOf(context) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
			{
				ObjectInitializerExpression objectInitializerExpression = (ObjectInitializerExpression)parent;
				if (objectInitializerExpression.Initializers != null)
				{
					return objectInitializerExpression.Initializers.IndexOf(context) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression:
			{
				ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = (ObjectCreationExpression)parent;
				if (objectCreationExpression.Parent is Throw)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (objectCreationExpression.Arguments != null)
				{
					return objectCreationExpression.Arguments.IndexOf(context) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCall:
			{
				MethodCall methodCall = (MethodCall)parent;
				if (methodCall.Arguments != null)
				{
					return methodCall.Arguments.IndexOf(context) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression:
			{
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)parent;
				if (methodCallExpression.Arguments != null)
				{
					return methodCallExpression.Arguments.IndexOf(context) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Method:
			{
				Method method = (Method)parent;
				if (method.Parameters != null && method.Parameters.IndexOf(context) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.QueryExpression:
				if (parent.DetailNodes != null)
				{
					return parent.DetailNodes.IndexOf(context) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (parent is TypeDeclaration type && IsFirstTypeAncestor(context, type))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parent is Member member && (IsFirst(member.HandlesExpressions, context) || IsFirst(member.ImplementsExpressions, context)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsLast(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.AttributeVariableInitializer)
			{
				Expression[] binaryList = GetBinaryList(context);
				if (binaryList != null && binaryList.Length != 0)
				{
					return binaryList[binaryList.Length - 1] == context;
				}
			}
			if (context is Variable var)
			{
				return IsLast(var);
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent is TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration)
			{
				if (typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes == null || typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count == 0)
				{
					if (typeDeclaration.PrimaryAncestorType == context)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (IsLast(typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes, context))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			switch (parent.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.BinaryOperatorExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation:
				if (parent.Parent is BinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((BinaryOperatorExpression)parent).RightSide == context;
			case LanguageElementType.GenericModifier:
			{
				TypeParameterCollection typeParameters = ((GenericModifier)parent).TypeParameters;
				return IsLast(typeParameters, context);
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
				return IsLast(((ArrayInitializerExpression)parent).Initializers, context);
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
				return IsLast(((ObjectInitializerExpression)parent).Initializers, context);
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression:
				if (((ObjectCreationExpression)parent).Parent is Throw)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return IsLast(((ObjectCreationExpression)parent).Arguments, context);
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCall:
				return IsLast(((MethodCall)parent).Arguments, context);
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression:
				return IsLast(((MethodCallExpression)parent).Arguments, context);
			case LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.QueryExpression:
				return IsLast(parent.DetailNodes, context);
			default:
				if (parent is Method method && IsLast(method.Parameters, context))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (parent is Member member && (IsLast(member.ImplementsExpressions, context) || IsLast(member.HandlesExpressions, context)))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsNotFirst(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is Variable var)
			{
				return IsNotFirst(var);
			}
			LanguageElement parent = element.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.AttributeVariableInitializer)
			{
				if (element is BinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Expression[] binaryList = GetBinaryList(element);
				if (binaryList != null && binaryList.Length != 0)
				{
					return binaryList[0] != element;
				}
			}
			switch (parent.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.GenericModifier:
			{
				TypeParameterCollection typeParameters = ((GenericModifier)parent).TypeParameters;
				if (typeParameters != null)
				{
					return typeParameters.IndexOf(element) > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
			{
				ArrayInitializerExpression arrayInitializerExpression = (ArrayInitializerExpression)parent;
				if (arrayInitializerExpression.Initializers != null)
				{
					return arrayInitializerExpression.Initializers.IndexOf(element) > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
			{
				ObjectInitializerExpression objectInitializerExpression = (ObjectInitializerExpression)parent;
				if (objectInitializerExpression.Initializers != null)
				{
					return objectInitializerExpression.Initializers.IndexOf(element) > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression:
			{
				ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = (ObjectCreationExpression)parent;
				if (objectCreationExpression.Parent is Throw)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (objectCreationExpression.Arguments != null)
				{
					return objectCreationExpression.Arguments.IndexOf(element) > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCall:
			{
				MethodCall methodCall = (MethodCall)parent;
				if (methodCall.Arguments != null)
				{
					return methodCall.Arguments.IndexOf(element) > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression:
			{
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)parent;
				if (methodCallExpression.Arguments != null)
				{
					return methodCallExpression.Arguments.IndexOf(element) > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Method:
			{
				Method method = (Method)parent;
				if (method.Parameters != null && method.Parameters.IndexOf(element) > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.QueryExpression:
				if (parent.DetailNodes != null)
				{
					return parent.DetailNodes.IndexOf(element) > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (parent is TypeDeclaration type && IsAncestorTypeReference(element, type) && !IsFirstTypeAncestor(element, type))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parent is Member member && (IsNotFirst(member.ImplementsExpressions, element) || IsNotFirst(member.HandlesExpressions, element)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedWrapWithoutFirst(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Context is Variable)
			{
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapMultiVariableDeclaration;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (parent.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapLogicalOperatorExpression;
			case LanguageElementType.BinaryOperatorExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBinaryOperatorExpression;
			case LanguageElementType.GenericModifier:
				if (ElementWasGenerated(context))
				{
					return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameterConstraints;
				}
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameters;
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializers;
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression:
			{
				ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = (ObjectCreationExpression)parent;
				if (objectCreationExpression.Parent is Throw)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (objectCreationExpression.Arguments == null || objectCreationExpression.Arguments.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments;
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
			{
				LanguageElement parent2 = parent.Parent;
				if (parent2 != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent2.Name))
				{
					return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapMembersInAnonymousType;
				}
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializers;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCall:
			case LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments;
			case LanguageElementType.QueryExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapQueryExpression;
			default:
			{
				TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = parent as TypeDeclaration;
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapAncestorsListInTypeDeclaration && typeDeclaration != null && IsSecondaryAncestorTypeReference(context, typeDeclaration))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapImplementsHandlesSectionItems)
				{
					if (parent is Member member && (IsNotFirst(member.HandlesExpressions, context) || IsNotFirst(member.ImplementsExpressions, context)))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (typeDeclaration != null && IsNotFirst(typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes, context))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFormalParameters && parent is Method method && IsNotFirst(method.Parameters, context))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedWrapFirst(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (context is Variable)
			{
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstMultiVariableDeclaration;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (parent.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.GenericModifier:
				if (!ElementWasGenerated(context))
				{
					return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameter;
				}
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint;
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializer;
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression:
			{
				ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = (ObjectCreationExpression)parent;
				if (objectCreationExpression.Parent is Throw)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (objectCreationExpression.Arguments == null || objectCreationExpression.Arguments.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument;
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
			{
				LanguageElement parent2 = parent.Parent;
				if (parent2 != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent2.Name))
				{
					return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstMemberInAnonymousType;
				}
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializer;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCall:
			case LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument;
			default:
			{
				TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = parent as TypeDeclaration;
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstAncestorsListItem && typeDeclaration != null)
				{
					return typeDeclaration.PrimaryAncestorType == context;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstFormalParameter && parent is Method method && IsFirst(method.Parameters, context))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstImplementsHandlesSectionItem)
				{
					if (parent is Member member && (IsFirst(member.HandlesExpressions, context) || IsFirst(member.ImplementsExpressions, context)))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (typeDeclaration != null)
					{
						return IsFirst(typeDeclaration.SecondaryAncestorTypes, context);
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedAlignment(LanguageElement context, bool pushed)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (context is Variable)
			{
				if (!pushed && Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstMultiVariableDeclarationItem)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstMultiVariableDeclaration;
				}
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (parent.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstLogicalExpressionItem;
			case LanguageElementType.BinaryOperatorExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstBinaryExpressionItem;
			case LanguageElementType.GenericModifier:
				if (!(context is TypeParameter))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (pushed)
				{
					if (ElementWasGenerated(context))
					{
						if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint)
						{
							return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint;
						}
						return false;
					}
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameter)
					{
						return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameter;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (!ElementWasGenerated(context))
				{
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint)
					{
						return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameter)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameter;
				}
				return false;
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
			{
				ExpressionCollection initializers = ((ArrayInitializerExpression)parent).Initializers;
				if (initializers == null || initializers.Count < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstArrayObjectOrCollectionInitializerItem)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializer;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression:
			{
				ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = (ObjectCreationExpression)parent;
				if (objectCreationExpression.Parent is Throw)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (objectCreationExpression.Arguments == null || objectCreationExpression.Arguments.Count < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression:
				if (((MethodCallExpression)parent).ArgumentsCount < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
