				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument;
				}
				return false;
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
			{
				LanguageElement parent3 = parent.Parent;
				ExpressionCollection initializers = ((ObjectInitializerExpression)parent).Initializers;
				if (initializers == null || initializers.Count < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (parent3 != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(parent3.Name))
				{
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstMemberInAnonymousType)
					{
						return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstMemberInAnonymousType;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstArrayObjectOrCollectionInitializerItem)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializer;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression:
			{
				ExpressionCollection arguments = ((IndexerExpression)parent).Arguments;
				if (arguments == null || arguments.Count < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.MethodCall:
				if (((MethodCall)parent).ArgumentsCount < 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument;
				}
				return false;
			case LanguageElementType.QueryExpression:
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstQueryExpressionItem;
			default:
			{
				TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = parent as TypeDeclaration;
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstAncestorsListItem && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstAncestorsListItem && typeDeclaration != null && IsAncestorTypeReference(context, typeDeclaration))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstFormalParameter && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstFormalParameter && parent is Method { ParameterCount: >=2 } method && method.Parameters.Contains(context))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstImplementsHandlesSectionItem && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstImplementsHandlesSectionItem)
				{
					if (parent is Member parent2 && (IsHandlesExpression(context, parent2) || IsImplementsExpression(context, parent as Member)))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (typeDeclaration != null && IsAncestorTypeReference(context, typeDeclaration))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsFirstTypeAncestor(LanguageElement context, TypeDeclaration type)
		{
			return type.PrimaryAncestorType == context;
		}

		protected virtual void AddWrappingNewLine()
		{
			AddNewLineIfNeeded();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeCodeGenObjects()
		{
			_DirectiveGen = CreateDirectiveGen();
			_ExpressionGen = CreateExpressionGen();
			_MemberGen = CreateMemberGen();
			_StatementGen = CreateStatementGen();
			_SupportElementGen = CreateSupportElementGen();
			_TypeDeclarationGen = CreateTypeDeclarationGen();
			_XmlGen = CreateXmlGen();
			_NamespaceReferenceGen = CreateNamespaceReferenceGen();
			_NamespaceGen = CreateNamespaceGen();
			_SnippetGen = CreateSnippetGen();
			_TemplateGen = CreateTemplateGen();
			_TemplateParameterGen = CreateTemplateParameterGen();
			_SourceFileGen = CreateSourceFileGen();
			_HtmlXmlCodeGen = CreateHtmlXmlGen();
		}

		protected virtual void ContextPushed()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ContextPoped(LanguageElement oldContext)
		{
		}

		protected virtual SourceFileCodeGenBase CreateSourceFileGen()
		{
			return new SourceFileCodeGenBase(this);
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedGenerateSideComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || GenCommentsFromToken)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is Expression))
			{
				return !base.SaveFormat;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateElementList(LanguageElement element)
		{
			ExpressionGen.GenerateElementCollection(element.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSpecificElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateSpecificElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
		}

		protected abstract DirectiveCodeGenBase CreateDirectiveGen();

		protected abstract ExpressionCodeGenBase CreateExpressionGen();

		protected abstract MemberCodeGenBase CreateMemberGen();

		protected abstract StatementCodeGenBase CreateStatementGen();

		protected abstract SupportElementCodeGenBase CreateSupportElementGen();

		protected abstract TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase CreateTypeDeclarationGen();

		protected abstract XmlCodeGenBase CreateXmlGen();

		protected abstract NamespaceReferenceGenBase CreateNamespaceReferenceGen();

		protected abstract NamespaceGenBase CreateNamespaceGen();

		protected abstract SnippetCodeGenBase CreateSnippetGen();

		protected abstract TemplateCodeGenBase CreateTemplateGen();

		protected abstract TemplateParameterCodeGenBase CreateTemplateParameterGen();

		protected abstract HtmlXmlCodeGenBase CreateHtmlXmlGen();

		internal void AddIncreaseAlignment()
		{
			TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.FormattingElements.AddIncreaseAlignment();
		}

		internal bool ElementWasGenerated(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || _GeneratedElements == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _GeneratedElements.Contains(element);
		}

		internal void AddGeneratedElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (_GeneratedElements == null)
				{
					_GeneratedElements = new List<LanguageElement>();
				}
				_GeneratedElements.Add(element);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveGeneratedElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && _GeneratedElements != null)
			{
				_GeneratedElements.Remove(element);
			}
		}

		internal LanguageElement GetPrevContext()
		{
			int count = Contexts.Count;
			if (count < 2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement element = Contexts.Pop();
			LanguageElement result = null;
			if (Contexts.Count > 0)
			{
				result = Contexts.Peek();
			}
			Contexts.Push(element);
			return result;
		}

		internal void GenerateElementInternal(LanguageElementCodeGenBase codeGen, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (codeGen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElementCodeGenBase elementCodeGen = TokenGen.ElementCodeGen;
			try
			{
				TokenGen.ElementCodeGen = codeGen;
				if (element != null)
				{
					codeGen.GenerateElement(element);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				TokenGen.ElementCodeGen = elementCodeGen;
			}
		}

		internal bool TokenArgsContainsElement(object element)
		{
			return TokenGen.TokenArgsContainsElement(element);
		}

		internal TokenGenArgs GetArgs()
		{
			return TokenGen.TokenGenArgs;
		}

		internal void RestoreSavedArgs(TokenGenArgs args)
		{
			if (args != null && args.FormattingElements != null)
			{
				if (TokenGen.FormattingElements != null)
				{
					args.FormattingElements.InsertRange(0, TokenGen.FormattingElements);
				}
				TokenGen.TokenGenArgs = args;
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_FirstElement == null)
			{
				_FirstElement = element;
			}
			PushContext(element);
			if (NeedGenerateSideComment(element))
			{
				GenerateElementForeComment(element);
			}
			SupportElementGen.GenerateAttributes(element);
			if (element is ISnippetCodeElement)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(SnippetGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is Expression)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(ExpressionGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is Statement)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(StatementGen, element);
			}
			else if (MemberGen.IsMemberGenElement(element))
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(MemberGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is TypeDeclaration)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(TypeDeclarationGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is ConstructorInitializer)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(StatementGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is NamespaceReference)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(NamespaceReferenceGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is ExternAlias)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(NamespaceReferenceGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is Namespace)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(NamespaceGen, element);
			}
			else if (XmlGen.IsXmlGenElement(element))
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(XmlGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is XmlElement)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(XmlGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is PreprocessorDirective)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(DirectiveGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is TemplateModifier)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(TemplateGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is TemplateParameter)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(TemplateParameterGen, element);
			}
			else if (element is SourceFile)
			{
				GenerateElementInternal(SourceFileGen, element);
			}
			else if (IsSpecificElement(element))
			{
				GenerateSpecificElement(element);
			}
			else if (element is ElementList)
			{
				GenerateElementList(element);
			}
			else if (element is MemberVisibilitySpecifier)
			{
				GenerateMemberVisibilitySpecifier((MemberVisibilitySpecifier)element);
			}
			else if (element is GenericModifier)
			{
				MemberGen.GenerateGenericModifier((GenericModifier)element);
			}
			else if (element is SupportElement)
			{
				if (base.SaveFormat)
				{
					if (GeneratingInSupportElement)
					{
						GenerateElementInternal(SupportElementGen, element);
					}
				}
				else if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.AttributeSection || ((SupportElement)element).TargetNode == null)
				{
					if (!IsSkipped(element) && _FirstElement != element)
					{
						GenerateElementInternal(SupportElementGen, element);
						AddSkipped(element);
					}
					else if (_FirstElement == element || ((SupportElement)element).TargetNode == null)
					{
						GenerateElementInternal(SupportElementGen, element);
					}
				}
				else if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.AttributeSection && !IsSkipped(element))
				{
					if (element.Parent is ElementList)
					{
						GenerateElementInternal(SupportElementGen, element);
						AddSkipped(element);
					}
					else if ((this is CSharpCodeGen || this is VBCodeGen) && PrevContextHasAttributeSection(element as AttributeSection))
					{
						GenerateElementInternal(SupportElementGen, element);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ExpressionGen.GenerateElementCollection(element.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
			}
			GenerateContextBackComment();
			PopContext();
		}

		public override bool IsSkipped(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (base.IsSkipped(element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return TokenArgsContainsElement(element);
		}

		public string GetTokenText(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			return GetTokenText(type, Context);
		}

		public string GetTokenText(FormattingTokenType type, int contextIndex)
		{
			LanguageElement fromElement = null;
			if (Contexts != null && contextIndex >= 0 && contextIndex < Contexts.Count)
			{
				fromElement = Contexts[contextIndex];
			}
			return GetTokenText(type, fromElement);
		}

		public void GenerateContextBackComment()
		{
			LanguageElement context = Context;
			if (context != null)
			{
				if (NeedGenerateSideComment(context))
				{
					GenerateElementBackComment(context);
				}
				if (context != null && _FirstElement != null && context == _FirstElement)
				{
					_FirstElement = null;
					ClearSkippedElements();
				}
			}
		}

		public void GenerateElementForeComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (SupportElementGen != null && element != null)
			{
				SupportElementGen.GenerateElementForeComment(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateElementBackComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (SupportElementGen != null && element != null)
			{
				SupportElementGen.GenerateElementBackComment(element);
			}
		}

		public void Write(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			Write(type, 0);
		}

		public void Write(FormattingTokenType type, int index)
		{
			TokenGen.WriteCode(new GenTextArgs(this, type, index));
		}

		public void IncreaseIndent()
		{
			base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
		}

		public void DecreaseIndent()
		{
			base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
		}

		public void AddIncreaseIndent()
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				TokenGen.AddIncreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		public void AddDecreaseIndent()
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				TokenGen.AddDecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		public void AddClearIndent()
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				TokenGen.AddClearIndent();
			}
		}

		public void AddRestoreIndent()
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				TokenGen.AddRestoreIndent();
			}
		}

		public void AddNewLineIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				TokenGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		public void AddNewLine(int countConsecutive)
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				TokenGen.AddNewLine(countConsecutive);
			}
		}

		public void AddWSIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				TokenGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void PushContext(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				Contexts.Push(element);
				if (!base.SaveFormat)
				{
					ContextPushed();
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement PopContext()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = Contexts.Pop();
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				ContextPoped(languageElement);
			}
			if ((languageElement is PreprocessorDirective || languageElement is Comment) && TokenGen.GeneratingInSupportElement)
			{
				return languageElement;
			}
			if (Contexts.Count == 0)
			{
				bool flag = languageElement is Expression || languageElement is Param;
				if (!flag && languageElement is ElementList)
				{
					ElementList elementList = (ElementList)languageElement;
					if (elementList.NodeCount == 1)
					{
						LanguageElement languageElement2 = (LanguageElement)elementList.Nodes[0];
						flag = languageElement2 is Expression || languageElement2 is Param || languageElement2 is XmlDocComment;
					}
				}
				if (!base.SaveFormat && !(languageElement is SourceFile) && !flag)
				{
					if (this is CSharpCodeGen)
					{
						if (!(languageElement is ElementList { NodeCount: <=0 }))
						{
							AddNewLineIfNeeded();
						}
					}
					else if (this is JavaScriptCodegen)
					{
						if (!(languageElement is ElementList { NodeCount: <=0 }))
						{
							AddNewLineIfNeeded();
						}
					}
					else if (this is VBCodeGen && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Code.LastLine))
					{
						AddNewLineIfNeeded();
					}
				}
				TokenGen.WriteResiduaryFormattingElements();
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public virtual FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			return new FormattingElements();
		}

		public virtual FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			return new FormattingElements();
		}

		public virtual void WriteWS()
		{
			base.Code.Write(" ");
		}

		public virtual void WriteTab()
		{
			base.Code.Write("\t");
		}

		public virtual void WriteEOL()
		{
			base.Code.WriteLine();
		}

		public virtual void WriteText(GenTextArgs args)
		{
			base.Code.Write(args.Text, args.SplitLines);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public string GenerateStatements(ICollection elements)
		{
			if (elements == null || StatementGen == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StatementGen.GenerateElementCollection(elements);
			return base.Code.Code;
		}

		public abstract void GenerateMemberVisibilitySpecifier(MemberVisibilitySpecifier specifier);
	}
	public static class CodeGenFactory
	{
		public static CodeGen CreateCodeGenForFileExtension(string extension)
		{
			return CreateCodeGen(ParserLanguage.FromFileExtension(extension));
		}

		public static CodeGen CreateCodeGen(string language)
		{
			return CreateCodeGen(ParserLanguage.FromString(language));
		}

		public static CodeGen CreateCodeGen(ParserLanguageID languageID)
		{
			CodeGen codeGen = FindCodeGenerator(languageID);
			if (codeGen != null)
			{
				codeGen.Code = new CodeWriter(new StringWriter(), new CodeGenOptions(languageID));
			}
			return codeGen;
		}

		private static CodeGen FindCodeGenerator(ParserLanguageID languageID)
		{
			return languageID switch
			{
				ParserLanguageID.None => null, 
				ParserLanguageID.CSharp => new CSharpCodeGen(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Basic => new VBCodeGen(), 
				ParserLanguageID.JavaScript => new JavaScriptCodegen(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class CStatementCodeGenBase : StatementCodeGenBase
	{
		public CStatementCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		private bool HasChildVariables(Statement statement)
		{
			if (statement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int nodeCount = statement.NodeCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				object obj = statement.Nodes[i];
				if (obj is BaseVariable)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void GenerateInitializers(LanguageElementList initializers)
		{
			if (initializers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < initializers.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = initializers[i];
				if (!IsSkipped(languageElement))
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
					if (i > 0 && !(languageElement is BaseVariable))
					{
						CodeGen.Code.Write(GetCommaDelimeter());
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool IsIfStatementWithElseAndNestedIf(Statement statement)
		{
			if (!(statement is If obj))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj.ElseStatement is Else))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj.FindChildByElementType(LanguageElementType.If) is If obj3)
			{
				return obj3.Parent == statement;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool NeedToAddBraces(Statement statement, CurlyBraceOption option)
		{
			if (statement is Block { ForceDelimiters: not false })
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsIfStatementWithElseAndNestedIf(statement))
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = ParserUtils.CountChildStatements(statement);
			if (num == 1 && HasChildVariables(statement))
			{
				return true;
			}
			switch (option)
			{
			case CurlyBraceOption.None:
				return false;
			case CurlyBraceOption.Always:
				return true;
			case CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode:
				if (num <= 1)
				{
					return num == 0;
				}
				return true;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateBlockStatementContents(Statement statement)
		{
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode);
		}

		protected void GenerateBlockStatementContents(Statement statement, CurlyBraceOption option)
		{
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, option, increaseIndent: true);
		}

		protected void GenerateBlockStatementContents(Statement statement, CurlyBraceOption option, bool increaseIndent)
		{
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, option, increaseIndent, needWriteLine: false);
		}

		protected void GenerateBlockStatementContents(Statement statement, CurlyBraceOption option, bool increaseIndent, bool needWriteLine)
		{
			bool flag = NeedToAddBraces(statement, option);
			if (flag)
			{
				bool flag2 = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForCodeBlocks && statement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Block;
				bool spaceBefore = Options.Spacing.BeforeOpenCurlyBraceOnTheSameLine && !flag2 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Code.LastLineInSpacesWithoutIndent);
				WriteOpenBrace(flag2, spaceBefore, spaceAfter: false, increaseIndent: false);
			}
			base.Code.WriteLine();
			bool flag3 = statement.NodeCount > 0;
			if (flag3)
			{
				if (increaseIndent)
				{
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes, "", lineBreakAfterDelimiter: true);
				if (increaseIndent)
				{
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				WriteCloseBrace(Options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForCodeBlocks && flag3, spaceBefore: false, decreaseIndent: false);
			}
			if (needWriteLine)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateParentingStatement(ParentingStatement statement, string keyword, string delimiter)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, keyword, delimiter, CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode);
		}

		protected void GenerateParentingStatement(ParentingStatement statement, string keyword, string delimiter, CurlyBraceOption option, bool increaseIndent)
		{
			base.Code.Write(keyword + " (");
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, delimiter);
			base.Code.Write(")");
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, option, increaseIndent);
		}

		protected void GenerateParentingStatement(ParentingStatement statement, string keyword, string delimiter, CurlyBraceOption option)
		{
			base.Code.Write(keyword + " (");
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, delimiter);
			base.Code.Write(")");
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, option);
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateLabelStatement(Label statement)
		{
			bool indentLabels = Options.Indention.IndentLabels;
			int indentLevel = base.Code.IndentLevel;
			if (!indentLabels)
			{
				base.Code.IndentLevel = 0;
			}
			base.Code.Write(statement.Name);
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeColonInLabels)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(":");
			if (!indentLabels)
			{
				base.Code.IndentLevel = indentLevel;
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateOptionStatement(OptionStatement statement)
		{
		}

		protected override bool GenerateStatement(Statement statement)
		{
			bool flag = base.GenerateStatement(statement);
			if (flag)
			{
				return flag;
			}
			if (statement.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Label)
			{
				GenerateLabelStatement(statement as Label);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void GenerateAbortStatement(Abort statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateGotoStatement(Goto statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("goto ");
			if (statement.IsGotoCaseLabel)
			{
				base.Code.Write("case ");
			}
			if (statement.IsGotoCaseDefault)
			{
				base.Code.Write("default");
			}
			base.Code.Write(statement.Label);
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
		}

		protected override void GenerateBreakStatement(Break statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("break");
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
		}

		protected override void GenerateContinueStatement(Continue statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("continue");
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
		}

		protected override void GenerateStatementStatement(Statement statement)
		{
			if (statement.SourceExpression != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.SourceExpression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Code.Write(statement.Name);
			}
			if (!statement.IsDetailNode)
			{
				WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethodCallStatement(MethodCall statement)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.Qualifier);
			base.Code.Write("(");
			GenerateParameters(statement.Arguments, GetCommaDelimeter());
			base.Code.Write(")");
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
		}

		protected override void GenerateAssignmentStatement(Assignment statement)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.LeftSide);
			CExpressionCodeGenBase.GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(base.Code, statement.AssignmentOperator);
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.Expression);
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSwitchStatement(Switch statement)
		{
			bool caseStatementFromSwitchStatement = Options.Indention.CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement;
			base.Code.Write("switch");
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeSwitchParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("(");
			bool withinSwitchParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinSwitchParentheses;
			if (withinSwitchParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, GetCommaDelimeter());
			if (withinSwitchParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(")");
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, CurlyBraceOption.Always, caseStatementFromSwitchStatement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateCaseStatement(Case statement)
		{
			if (statement.IsDefault)
			{
				base.Code.Write("default");
			}
			else
			{
				base.Code.Write("case ");
				CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.Expression);
			}
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeColonInCaseStatement)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(":");
			bool caseStatementContents = Options.Indention.CaseStatementContents;
			if (caseStatementContents)
			{
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
			}
			int nodeCount = statement.NodeCount;
			LanguageElement languageElement = ((nodeCount > 0) ? (statement.Nodes[0] as LanguageElement) : null);
			if (!Options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForBlocksUnderCaseStatement && nodeCount == 1 && languageElement is Block)
			{
				bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
				WriteOpenBrace(Options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForBlocksUnderCaseStatement, spaceBefore: false, spaceAfter: false, codeBlockContents);
				if (languageElement.NodeCount > 0)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(languageElement.Nodes, Environment.NewLine);
				WriteCloseBrace(Options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForBlocksUnderCaseStatement, spaceBefore: false, codeBlockContents);
			}
			else
			{
				if (nodeCount > 0)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes, Environment.NewLine);
			}
			if (caseStatementContents)
			{
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateTryStatement(Try statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("try");
			bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, CurlyBraceOption.Always, codeBlockContents, needWriteLine: false);
			LanguageElement nextCodeSibling = statement.NextCodeSibling;
			while (nextCodeSibling != null && (nextCodeSibling.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Catch || nextCodeSibling.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Finally))
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, nextCodeSibling);
				CodeGen.AddSkipped(nextCodeSibling);
				nextCodeSibling = nextCodeSibling.NextCodeSibling;
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateCatchStatement(Catch statement)
		{
			if (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceCatchStatementOnNewLine)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			else
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("catch");
			if (statement.DetailNodeCount > 0)
			{
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeCatchParentheses)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write("(");
				bool withinCatchParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinCatchParentheses;
				if (withinCatchParentheses)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, GetCommaDelimeter());
				if (withinCatchParentheses)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write(")");
			}
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, CurlyBraceOption.Always, Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents);
		}

		protected override void GenerateFinallyStatement(Finally statement)
		{
			if (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceFinallyStatementOnNewLine)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			else
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("finally");
			bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, CurlyBraceOption.Always, codeBlockContents);
		}

		protected override void GenerateUsingStatement(UsingStatement statement)
		{
			bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			CurlyBraceOption option = CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode;
			if (!statement.BlockStart.IsEmpty)
			{
				option = CurlyBraceOption.Always;
			}
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, "using", GetCommaDelimeter(), option, codeBlockContents);
		}

		protected override void GenerateDoStatement(Do statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("do");
			bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			CurlyBraceOption curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode;
			if (!statement.BlockStart.IsEmpty)
			{
				curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.Always;
			}
			bool needWriteLine = (curlyBraceOption != CurlyBraceOption.Always && statement.NodeCount == 1) || Options.LineBreaks.PlaceWhileStatementOnNewLine;
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, curlyBraceOption, codeBlockContents, needWriteLine);
			base.Code.Write("while");
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeWhileParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("(");
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.Condition);
			base.Code.Write(")");
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
		}

		protected override void GenerateForStatement(For statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("for");
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeForForeachParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("(");
			bool withinForForeachParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinForForeachParentheses;
			if (withinForForeachParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			GenerateInitializers(statement.Initializers);
			bool beforeSemicolonInForStatement = Options.Spacing.BeforeSemicolonInForStatement;
			bool afterSemicolonInForStatement = Options.Spacing.AfterSemicolonInForStatement;
			WriteWhithing(beforeSemicolonInForStatement, ";", afterSemicolonInForStatement);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Condition);
			WriteWhithing(beforeSemicolonInForStatement, ";", afterSemicolonInForStatement);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.Incrementors, GetCommaDelimeter());
			if (withinForForeachParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(")");
			CurlyBraceOption option = CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode;
			if (!statement.BlockStart.IsEmpty)
			{
				option = CurlyBraceOption.Always;
			}
			bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, option, codeBlockContents);
		}

		protected override void GenerateForEachStatement(ForEach statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("foreach");
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeForForeachParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("(");
			bool withinForForeachParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinForForeachParentheses;
			if (withinForForeachParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, (LanguageElement)statement.DetailNodes[0]);
			base.Code.Write(" in ");
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, (LanguageElement)statement.DetailNodes[1]);
			if (withinForForeachParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(")");
			CurlyBraceOption option = CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode;
			if (!statement.BlockStart.IsEmpty)
			{
				option = CurlyBraceOption.Always;
			}
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, option, Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents);
		}

		protected override void GenerateWhileStatement(While statement)
		{
			bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			base.Code.Write("while");
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeWhileParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("(");
			bool withinWhileParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinWhileParentheses;
			if (withinWhileParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, string.Empty);
			if (withinWhileParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(")");
			CurlyBraceOption curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode;
			if (!statement.BlockStart.IsEmpty)
			{
				curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.Always;
			}
			if (curlyBraceOption != CurlyBraceOption.Always && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && statement.NodeCount == 1)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement((LanguageElement)statement.Nodes[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, curlyBraceOption, codeBlockContents);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateIfStatement(If statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("if");
			bool withinIfParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinIfParentheses;
			WriteOpenParen(Options.Spacing.BeforeIfParentheses, withinIfParentheses);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, string.Empty);
			WriteCloseParen(withinIfParentheses);
			CurlyBraceOption curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode;
			if (!statement.BlockStart.IsEmpty)
			{
				curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.Always;
			}
			Else obj = statement.NextCodeSibling as Else;
			bool needWriteLine = obj != null && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceElseStatementOnNewLine;
			if (curlyBraceOption != CurlyBraceOption.Always && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && statement.NodeCount == 1)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement((LanguageElement)statement.Nodes[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, curlyBraceOption, Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents, needWriteLine);
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(obj);
				CodeGen.AddSkipped(obj);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateElseIfStatement(ElseIf statement)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, "else if", " ");
		}

		protected override void GenerateElseStatement(Else statement)
		{
			if (!Options.LineBreaks.PlaceElseStatementOnNewLine && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Code.LastLineInSpacesWithoutIndent))
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("else");
			CurlyBraceOption curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.MoreThanOneNode;
			if (!statement.BlockStart.IsEmpty)
			{
				curlyBraceOption = CurlyBraceOption.Always;
			}
			if (curlyBraceOption != CurlyBraceOption.Always && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && statement.NodeCount == 1)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
				CodeGen.GenerateElement((LanguageElement)statement.Nodes[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, curlyBraceOption, Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateEmptyStatement(EmptyStatement statement)
		{
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, CurlyBraceOption.None);
		}

		protected override void GenerateBlockStatement(Block statement)
		{
			bool codeBlockContents = Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement, CurlyBraceOption.Always, codeBlockContents);
		}

		protected override void GenerateReturnStatement(Return statement)
		{
			base.Code.Write("return");
			if (statement.Expression != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, statement.Expression);
			WriteSemicolon(spacingAfter: false);
		}
	}
	public enum CurlyBraceOption : byte
	{
		None,
		Always,
		MoreThanOneNode
	}
	internal class FormattingElementsWriter
	{
		public static void WriteSupportElement(CodeGen codeGen, IFormattingElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool generatingInSupportElement = codeGen.GeneratingInSupportElement;
			codeGen.GeneratingInSupportElement = true;
			try
			{
				if (!WriteFormattingElement(codeGen, element as FormattingElement) && !WriteComment(codeGen, element as Comment) && !WritePpDirective(codeGen, element as PreprocessorDirective))
				{
					WriteFormattingText(codeGen, element as FormattingText);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				codeGen.GeneratingInSupportElement = generatingInSupportElement;
			}
		}

		public static void WriteEOL(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			codeGen.WriteEOL();
		}

		private static bool WriteComment(CodeGen codeGen, Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			codeGen.GenerateElement(comment);
			codeGen.AddSkipped(comment);
			return true;
		}

		private static bool WriteFormattingText(CodeGen codeGen, FormattingText formattingText)
		{
			if (formattingText == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = formattingText.Text;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return true;
			}
			codeGen.Code.WriteClearFormat(text);
			return true;
		}

		private static bool WritePpDirective(CodeGen codeGen, PreprocessorDirective element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int indentLevel = codeGen.Code.IndentLevel;
			if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Region && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective)
			{
				codeGen.Code.IndentLevel = 0;
			}
			codeGen.GenerateElement(element);
			codeGen.Code.IndentLevel = indentLevel;
			return true;
		}

		private static void WriteIndent(CodeGen codeGen, CheckedIndent indent)
		{
			string text = new string('\t', indent.CountConsecutive) + new string(' ', indent.SpaceCount);
			string indentString = codeGen.Code.IndentString;
			if (indentString.Length < text.Length)
			{
				text = text.Substring(indentString.Length);
				codeGen.Code.Write(text);
			}
		}

		private static bool WriteFormattingElement(CodeGen codeGen, FormattingElement formatingElement)
		{
			if (formatingElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (formatingElement is CheckedIndent indent)
			{
				WriteIndent(codeGen, indent);
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < formatingElement.CountConsecutive; i++)
			{
				switch (formatingElement.Type)
				{
				case FormattingElementType.WS:
					WriteWS(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.Tab:
					WriteTab(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.CR:
					WriteCR(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.EOL:
					WriteEOL(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.IncreaseIndent:
					IncreaseIndent(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.DecreaseIndent:
					DecreaseIndent(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.IncreaseAlignment:
					IncreaseAlignment(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.DecreaseAlignment:
					DecreaseAlignment(codeGen);
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.ClearIndent:
					codeGen.Code.ClearIndent();
					break;
				case FormattingElementType.RestoreIndent:
					codeGen.Code.RestoreIndent();
					break;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void WriteWS(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			codeGen.WriteWS();
		}

		private static void WriteTab(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			codeGen.WriteTab();
		}

		private static void WriteCR(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
		}

		private static void IncreaseIndent(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			codeGen.IncreaseIndent();
		}

		private static void DecreaseIndent(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			codeGen.DecreaseIndent();
		}

		private static void IncreaseAlignment(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			codeGen.Code.IncreaseAlignment();
		}

		private static void DecreaseAlignment(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			codeGen.Code.DecreaseAlignment();
		}
	}
	internal class FormattingHelper
	{
		public static bool IsFormattingChar(char ch)
		{
			if (ch != '\n' && ch != '\r' && ch != ' ')
			{
				return ch == '\t';
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void AddTokenElement(FormattingElements list, char ch)
		{
			if (ch == '\n')
			{
				list.AddNewLine();
			}
			if (ch == ' ')
			{
				list.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
		}

		public static bool CanProcessTextToken(GenTextArgs args)
		{
			FormattingTokenType type = args.Type;
			if (args.Context is ISnippetCodeElement && type != FormattingTokenType.NewLine && type != FormattingTokenType.WhiteSpace)
			{
				return type != FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void ProcessTokenText(GenTextArgs args, out FormattingElements prevElementsInText, out FormattingElements nextElementsInText)
		{
			prevElementsInText = null;
			nextElementsInText = null;
			string text = args.Text;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			prevElementsInText = new FormattingElements();
			nextElementsInText = new FormattingElements();
			char[] array = text.ToCharArray();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (char ch in array)
			{
				if (!IsFormattingChar(ch))
				{
					break;
				}
				AddTokenElement(prevElementsInText, ch);
				num++;
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				text = text.Remove(0, num);
			}
			if (num >= array.Length)
			{
				args.Text = text;
				return;
			}
			array = text.ToCharArray();
			num = 0;
			for (int num2 = array.Length - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				char ch2 = array[num2];
				if (!IsFormattingChar(ch2))
				{
					break;
				}
				AddTokenElement(nextElementsInText, ch2);
				num++;
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				text = text.Remove(text.Length - num);
				if (nextElementsInText.Count != 0)
				{
					nextElementsInText.Reverse();
				}
			}
			args.Text = text;
		}

		private static void Sort(FormattingElements elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			while (!flag)
			{
				flag = true;
				int count = elements.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count - 1; i++)
				{
					if (elements[i] is FormattingElement formattingElement && elements[i + 1] is FormattingElement { Type: var type } formattingElement2 && (uint)(type - 4) <= 5u && (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL || formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.WS || formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.Tab))
					{
						flag = false;
						elements[i] = formattingElement2;
						elements[i + 1] = formattingElement;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static FormattingElements MergeIndents(CodeGen codeGen, List<FormattingElement> indents)
		{
			if (codeGen == null || indents == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormattingElements formattingElements = new FormattingElements();
			int num = 0;
			int tabSize = codeGen.Options.TabSize;
			foreach (FormattingElement indent in indents)
			{
				num = ((indent.Type != FormattingElementType.WS) ? (num + indent.CountConsecutive * tabSize) : (num + indent.CountConsecutive));
			}
			if (codeGen.Options.InsertSpaces)
			{
				formattingElements.Add(new CheckedIndent(0, num));
			}
			else
			{
				int tabCount = num / tabSize;
				int spaceCount = num % tabSize;
				formattingElements.Add(new CheckedIndent(tabCount, spaceCount));
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public static void MergeIndents(CodeGen codeGen, FormattingElements elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(elements[i] is FormattingElement formattingElement) || !formattingElement.IsEol() || i >= elements.Count - 1)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = i + 1;
				int j = num;
				List<FormattingElement> list = new List<FormattingElement>();
				for (; j < elements.Count; j++)
				{
					FormattingElement formattingElement2 = elements[j] as FormattingElement;
					if (formattingElement2 is CheckedIndent || formattingElement2 == null || !formattingElement2.IsWsOrTab())
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Add(formattingElement2);
				}
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					FormattingElements formattingElements = MergeIndents(codeGen, list);
					elements.RemoveRange(num, list.Count);
					for (int num2 = formattingElements.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						elements.Insert(num, formattingElements[num2]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool KeepExpressionIndent(CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			if (codeGen == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!codeGen.Options.General.KeepExpressionsIndent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(codeGen.Context is Expression expression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = expression.GetParentStatementOrVariable();
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				if (expression.GetParent(LanguageElementType.Parameter) != null)
				{
					return !codeGen.Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstFormalParameter;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (languageElement is IHasArguments hasArguments && hasArguments.Arguments.Contains(expression))
			{
				return !codeGen.Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstInvocationArgument;
			}
			if ((languageElement is Variable || languageElement is Assignment) && languageElement.IsDetailNode)
			{
				languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return languageElement.Range.Start != expression.NameRange.Start;
		}

		public static void CleanupElements(CodeGen codeGen, FormattingElements result)
		{
			if (result == null || codeGen.SaveFormat)
			{
				return;
			}
			Sort(result);
			int num = result.Count - 1;
			for (int num2 = num; num2 > 0; num2--)
			{
				if (!(result[num2] is FormattingElement formattingElement) || formattingElement.IsIndent() || !(result[num2 - 1] is FormattingElement formattingElement2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (formattingElement2.Type == FormattingElementType.IncreaseAlignment && formattingElement.IsWsOrTab())
				{
					result[num2 - 1] = formattingElement;
					result[num2] = formattingElement2;
					num2++;
					continue;
				}
				int index = num2 - 1;
				if (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL)
				{
					if (formattingElement2.Type == FormattingElementType.WS || formattingElement2.Type == FormattingElementType.Tab)
					{
						result.RemoveAt(index);
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if (formattingElement2.IsEol() && !KeepExpressionIndent(codeGen) && (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.WS || formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.Tab))
				{
					result.RemoveAt(num2);
					if (num2 + 1 < result.Count)
					{
						num2++;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (formattingElement.Type == formattingElement2.Type)
				{
					if (formattingElement2.CountConsecutive < formattingElement.CountConsecutive && !(formattingElement2 is CheckedIndent))
					{
						result.RemoveAt(index);
					}
					else
					{
						result.RemoveAt(num2);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TokenList : List<FormattingTokenType>
	{
		public TokenList()
		{
		}

		public TokenList(params FormattingTokenType[] types)
		{
			if (types != null)
			{
				foreach (FormattingTokenType item in types)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public TokenList Clone()
		{
			TokenList tokenList = new TokenList();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				FormattingTokenType current = enumerator.Current;
				tokenList.Add(current);
			}
			return tokenList;
		}

		public void AddUnique(TokenList tokenList)
		{
			if (tokenList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FormattingTokenType token in tokenList)
			{
				if (!Contains(token))
				{
					Add(token);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddUnique(params FormattingTokenType[] tokens)
		{
			if (tokens == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (FormattingTokenType item in tokens)
			{
				if (!Contains(item))
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ContainsAtLeastOne(TokenList tokens)
		{
			if (tokens == null || tokens.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (FormattingTokenType token in tokens)
			{
				if (Contains(token))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public TokenList And(TokenList tokens)
		{
			TokenList tokenList = Clone();
			if (tokens == null || tokens.Count == 0)
			{
				return tokenList;
			}
			foreach (FormattingTokenType token in tokens)
			{
				if (!tokenList.Contains(token))
				{
					tokenList.Add(token);
				}
			}
			return tokenList;
		}

		public static TokenList Merge(TokenList fTokens, TokenList sTokens)
		{
			if (fTokens == null || fTokens.Count == 0 || sTokens == null || sTokens.Count == 0)
			{
				return new TokenList();
			}
			TokenList tokenList = new TokenList();
			foreach (FormattingTokenType fToken in fTokens)
			{
				if (sTokens.Contains(fToken))
				{
					tokenList.Add(fToken);
				}
			}
			return tokenList;
		}

		public static TokenList Load(System.Xml.XmlNode ruleNode)
		{
			if (ruleNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TokenList tokenList = new TokenList();
			foreach (System.Xml.XmlNode item2 in ruleNode.SelectNodes("Token"))
			{
				System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = item2.Attributes["Name"];
				if (xmlAttribute != null)
				{
					try
					{
						FormattingTokenType item = (FormattingTokenType)Enum.Parse(typeof(FormattingTokenType), xmlAttribute.Value);
						tokenList.Add(item);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return tokenList;
		}

		public void Save(System.Xml.XmlNode ruleNode)
		{
			if (ruleNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				FormattingTokenType current = enumerator.Current;
				XmlDocument ownerDocument = ruleNode.OwnerDocument;
				if (ownerDocument == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode = ownerDocument.CreateNode(System.Xml.XmlNodeType.Element, "Token", string.Empty);
				ruleNode.AppendChild(xmlNode);
				System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = ownerDocument.CreateAttribute("Name");
				xmlAttribute.Value = current.ToString();
				xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class CodeGenObject
	{
		private CodeWriter _Code;

		private Stack<CodeWriter> _CodeStack;

		private Hashtable _SkipElements = new Hashtable();

		private bool _SaveFormat;

		protected virtual CodeGen CodeGen => null;

		public abstract CodeGenOptions Options { get; }

		protected virtual string LineContinuation
		{
			get
			{
				if (CodeGen == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return CodeGen.LineContinuation;
			}
		}

		public CodeWriter Code
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Code == null && CodeGen != null)
				{
					return CodeGen.Code;
				}
				return _Code;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					_Code = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool SaveFormat
		{
			get
			{
				if (CodeGen == null)
				{
					return _SaveFormat;
				}
				return CodeGen.SaveFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				if (CodeGen != null)
				{
					CodeGen.SaveFormat = value;
				}
				else
				{
					_SaveFormat = value;
				}
			}
		}

		protected CodeGenObject()
		{
			_CodeStack = new Stack<CodeWriter>();
		}

		protected void PushCodeWriter()
		{
			if (_Code != null)
			{
				_CodeStack.Push(_Code);
			}
		}

		protected void PopCodeWriter()
		{
			if (_CodeStack.Count != 0)
			{
				_Code = _CodeStack.Pop();
			}
		}

		protected void SetCodeWriter(CodeWriter code)
		{
			_Code = code;
			CodeGen?.SetCodeWriter(code);
		}

		public virtual void ClearSkippedElements()
		{
			_SkipElements.Clear();
		}

		public virtual void AddSkipped(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && !IsSkipped(element))
			{
				_SkipElements.Add(element, element);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsSkipped(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (SaveFormat && element is CompilerDirective)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return _SkipElements.ContainsKey(element);
		}

		protected internal virtual void CalculateIndent(LanguageElement element)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResetIndent()
		{
		}

		public abstract void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement);

		public virtual void GenerateCode(TextWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			GenerateCode(writer, languageElement, 0);
		}

		public virtual void GenerateCode(TextWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, int precedingWhiteSpaceCount)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				CodeWriter codeWriter = new CodeWriter(writer, Options, LineContinuation);
				codeWriter.PrecedingWhiteSpaceCount = precedingWhiteSpaceCount;
				GenerateCode(codeWriter, languageElement);
			}
		}

		public virtual string GenerateCode(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			return GenerateCode(languageElement, 0);
		}

		public virtual string GenerateCode(LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			return GenerateCode(languageElement, 0, calculateIndent);
		}

		public virtual string GenerateCode(LanguageElement languageElement, int precedingWhiteSpaceCount)
		{
			return GenerateCode(languageElement, precedingWhiteSpaceCount, calculateIndent: false);
		}

		public virtual string GenerateCode(LanguageElement languageElement, int precedingWhiteSpaceCount, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			StringWriter writer = new StringWriter(stringBuilder);
			CodeWriter codeWriter = new CodeWriter(writer, Options, LineContinuation);
			codeWriter.PrecedingWhiteSpaceCount = precedingWhiteSpaceCount;
			GenerateCode(codeWriter, languageElement, calculateIndent);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public virtual void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			GenerateCode(writer, languageElement, calculateIndent: false);
		}

		public virtual void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}
	}
	public class CodeGenOptions
	{
		private string _IndentString;

		private IBraceSettings _BraceSettings;

		private IndentionFormattingOptions _Indention;

		private BlankLinesFormattingOptions _BlankLines;

		private GeneralFormattingOptions _General;

		private LineBreaksFormattingOptions _LineBreaks;

		private OtherLanguageSpecificFormattingOptions _OtherLanguageSpecific;

		private SortingOrderingFormattingOptions _SortingOrdering;

		private SpacingFormattingOptions _Spacing;

		private WrappingAlignmentFormattingOptions _WrappingAlignment;

		private ParserLanguageID _Language;

		private bool _SaveFormat;

		private bool _InsertSpaces;

		private int _TabSize;

		public static CodeGenOptions Default => new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.None);

		public string IndentString
		{
			get
			{
				return _IndentString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(_IndentString == value))
				{
					_IndentString = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public IBraceSettings BraceSettings => _BraceSettings;

		public IndentionFormattingOptions Indention => _Indention;

		public BlankLinesFormattingOptions BlankLines => _BlankLines;

		public GeneralFormattingOptions General => _General;

		public LineBreaksFormattingOptions LineBreaks => _LineBreaks;

		public OtherLanguageSpecificFormattingOptions OtherLanguageSpecific => _OtherLanguageSpecific;

		public SortingOrderingFormattingOptions SortingOrdering => _SortingOrdering;

		public SpacingFormattingOptions Spacing => _Spacing;

		public WrappingAlignmentFormattingOptions WrappingAlignment => _WrappingAlignment;

		public bool SaveFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return _SaveFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				_SaveFormat = value;
			}
		}

		public bool InsertSpaces
		{
			get
			{
				return _InsertSpaces;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_InsertSpaces = value;
			}
		}

		public int TabSize => _TabSize;

		public CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID language)
		{
			_IndentString = "\t\t";
			InitializeLanguageOptions(language);
		}

		public CodeGenOptions(IBraceSettings settings, ParserLanguageID language)
			: this(language)
		{
			_BraceSettings = settings;
		}

		private void InitializeLanguageOptions(ParserLanguageID language)
		{
			_Language = language;
			_BraceSettings = StructuralParserServicesHolder.LoadBraceSettings();
			if (_BraceSettings == null)
			{
				_BraceSettings = new DefaultBraceSettings();
			}
			_Indention = new IndentionFormattingOptions();
			_BlankLines = new BlankLinesFormattingOptions();
			_General = new GeneralFormattingOptions();
			_LineBreaks = new LineBreaksFormattingOptions();
			_OtherLanguageSpecific = new OtherLanguageSpecificFormattingOptions();
			_SortingOrdering = new SortingOrderingFormattingOptions();
			_Spacing = new SpacingFormattingOptions();
			_WrappingAlignment = new WrappingAlignmentFormattingOptions();
			IFormattingService formattingService = StructuralParserServicesHolder.StructuralParserServices.FormattingService;
			if (formattingService == null)
			{
				LoadDefaultFormattingSettings(language);
				return;
			}
			FormattingRuleCollection rules = formattingService.GetRules(language);
			LoadFormattingSettings(rules);
			SetIndentString(StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetTabSettings(language));
		}

		private void SetIndentString(ITabSettings settings)
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				_IndentString = new string(settings.InsertSpaces ? ' ' : '\t', settings.TabSize);
				_TabSize = settings.TabSize;
				_InsertSpaces = settings.InsertSpaces;
			}
		}

		private void LoadDefaultFormattingSettings(ParserLanguageID language)
		{
			_Indention.LoadDefault(language);
			_BlankLines.LoadDefault(language);
			_General.LoadDefault(language);
			_LineBreaks.LoadDefault(language);
			_OtherLanguageSpecific.LoadDefault(language);
			_SortingOrdering.LoadDefault(language);
			_Spacing.LoadDefault(language);
			_WrappingAlignment.LoadDefault(language);
			SetIndentString(new DefaultTabSettings());
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void LoadFormattingSettings(FormattingRuleCollection rules)
		{
			if (rules == null || rules.Count == 0)
			{
				LoadDefaultFormattingSettings(_Language);
				return;
			}
			_Indention.Load(rules);
			_BlankLines.Load(rules);
			_General.Load(rules);
			_LineBreaks.Load(rules);
			_OtherLanguageSpecific.Load(rules);
			_SortingOrdering.Load(rules);
			_Spacing.Load(rules);
			_WrappingAlignment.Load(rules);
		}
	}
	public class CodeWriter
	{
		private CodeGenOptions _Options;

		private TextWriter _Writer;

		private int _IndentLevel;

		private int _PrecedingWhiteSpaceCount;

		private string _IndentString;

		private string _LastLine = string.Empty;

		private readonly string _LineContinuation;

		public bool WriteWithoutIndentStringOneTime;

		private int _LineTerminatorCount;

		private Stack<string> _Alignment = new Stack<string>();

		private Stack<int> _IndentLevelStack = new Stack<int>();

		private string Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Alignment.Count == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return _Alignment.Peek();
			}
		}

		protected internal string IndentString
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Options != null && _Options.SaveFormat)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (WriteWithoutIndentStringOneTime)
				{
					WriteWithoutIndentStringOneTime = false;
					return string.Empty;
				}
				string precedingString = GetPrecedingString();
				return precedingString + _IndentString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(_IndentString == value))
				{
					_IndentString = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int IndentLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return _IndentLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_IndentLevel != value)
				{
					_IndentLevel = value;
					IndentString = GetIndentString(_IndentLevel);
				}
			}
		}

		public string Code => _Writer.ToString();

		public CodeGenOptions Options => _Options;

		public bool IsAtWhitespace
		{
			get
			{
				string code = Code;
				if (code == null || code.Length == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return char.IsWhiteSpace(code[code.Length - 1]);
			}
		}

		public int PrecedingWhiteSpaceCount
		{
			get
			{
				return _PrecedingWhiteSpaceCount;
			}
			set
			{
				_PrecedingWhiteSpaceCount = value;
			}
		}

		public int LineTerminatorCount
		{
			get
			{
				return _LineTerminatorCount;
			}
			set
			{
				_LineTerminatorCount = value;
			}
		}

		public string LastLine => _LastLine;

		public string LastLineInSpaces => new string(' ', LastLine.Length);

		public string LastLineInSpacesWithoutIndent
		{
			get
			{
				string lastLineInSpaces = LastLineInSpaces;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(lastLineInSpaces))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return lastLineInSpaces.Remove(0, IndentLevel * Options.IndentString.Length);
			}
		}

		public void IncreaseAlignment()
		{
			string text = LastLineInSpacesWithoutIndent;
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			_Alignment.Push(text);
		}

		public void DecreaseAlignment()
		{
			if (_Alignment.Count != 0)
			{
				_Alignment.Pop();
			}
		}

		public CodeWriter(TextWriter writer, CodeGenOptions options, string lineContinuation)
		{
			_LineContinuation = lineContinuation;
			_Writer = writer;
			_Options = options;
		}

		public CodeWriter(TextWriter writer, CodeGenOptions options)
			: this(writer, options, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public CodeWriter()
			: this(new StringWriter(new StringBuilder()), CodeGenOptions.Default)
		{
		}

		private string GetIndentString(int level)
		{
			if (level == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < level; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Options.IndentString);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private string GetPrecedingString()
		{
			return new string(' ', _PrecedingWhiteSpaceCount);
		}

		private string[] SplitLines(string s)
		{
			return StringHelper.SplitLines(s, removeLastIfEmpty: false);
		}

		private string[] SplitLines(string s, bool split)
		{
			if (!split)
			{
				return new string[1] { s };
			}
			return SplitLines(s);
		}

		private void WriteInternal(string s)
		{
			_Writer.Write(s);
			_LastLine += s;
		}

		public void Indent()
		{
			_Writer.Write(IndentString);
		}

		public void IncreaseIndent()
		{
			IndentLevel++;
		}

		public void DecreaseIndent()
		{
			if (IndentLevel > 0)
			{
				IndentLevel--;
			}
		}

		public void WriteLines(string[] lines, bool finishWithCR)
		{
			int num = lines.Length;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = ((!(LastLine == string.Empty)) ? lines[0] : (IndentString + Alignment + lines[0]));
			if (num == 1 && !finishWithCR)
			{
				WriteInternal(text);
			}
			else
			{
				_Writer.WriteLine(text);
				_LineTerminatorCount++;
				_LastLine = string.Empty;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < num; i++)
			{
				text = ((lines[i] == string.Empty) ? string.Empty : (IndentString + Alignment + lines[i]));
				if (i + 1 == num)
				{
					if (finishWithCR)
					{
						_Writer.WriteLine(text);
						_LineTerminatorCount++;
						_LastLine = string.Empty;
					}
					else
					{
						WriteInternal(text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_Writer.WriteLine(text);
					_LineTerminatorCount++;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Write(string s)
		{
			Write(s, split: true);
		}

		public void Write(string s, bool split)
		{
			WriteLines(SplitLines(s, split), finishWithCR: false);
		}

		public void Write(string format, params object[] arg)
		{
			string s = string.Format(format, arg);
			WriteLines(SplitLines(s), finishWithCR: false);
		}

		public void WriteClearFormat(string s)
		{
			string indentString = IndentString;
			IndentString = string.Empty;
			Write(s);
			IndentString = indentString;
		}

		public void WriteLine(string s)
		{
			WriteLine(s, split: true);
		}

		public void WriteLine(string s, bool split)
		{
			if (s == string.Empty)
			{
				WriteLine();
			}
			else
			{
				WriteLines(SplitLines(s, split), finishWithCR: true);
			}
		}

		public void WriteLine(string format, params object[] arg)
		{
			string s = string.Format(format, arg);
			WriteLines(SplitLines(s, split: false), finishWithCR: true);
		}

		public void WriteLine()
		{
			_Writer.WriteLine();
			_LineTerminatorCount++;
			_LastLine = string.Empty;
		}

		public void WriteOpenBrace(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (_Options == null && _Options.BraceSettings == null)
			{
				WriteLine(" {");
			}
			switch (_Options.BraceSettings[element])
			{
			case BracesOnNewLineOptions.LeaveOnPrevious:
				WriteLine(" {");
				break;
			case BracesOnNewLineOptions.PlaceOnNewLine:
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(LastLine))
				{
					WriteLine();
				}
				WriteLine("{");
				break;
			}
		}

		public void ClearIndent()
		{
			_IndentLevelStack.Push(IndentLevel);
			IndentLevel = 0;
		}

		public void RestoreIndent()
		{
			if (_IndentLevelStack.Count != 0)
			{
				IndentLevel = _IndentLevelStack.Pop();
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DirectiveCodeGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public DirectiveCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				GenerateDirective(languageElement as PreprocessorDirective);
			}
		}

		private bool GenerateDirective(PreprocessorDirective directive)
		{
			if (directive == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (directive.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Region && directive.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective)
			{
				base.Code.WriteWithoutIndentStringOneTime = true;
			}
			switch (directive.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Region:
				GenerateRegion(directive as RegionDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective:
				GenerateEndRegion(directive as EndRegionDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.DefineDirective:
				GenerateDefineDirective(directive as DefineDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.IfDirective:
				GenerateIfDirective(directive as IfDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ElifDirective:
				GenerateElifDirective(directive as ElifDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ElseDirective:
				GenerateElseDirective(directive as ElseDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.EndifDirective:
				GenerateEndIfDirective(directive as EndIfDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.UndefineDirective:
				GenerateUndefDirective(directive as UndefDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ErrorDirective:
				GenerateErrorDirective(directive as ErrorDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.WarningDirective:
				GenerateWarningDirective(directive as WarningDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.LineDirective:
				GenerateLineDirective(directive as LineDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.IfDefDirective:
				GenerateIfDefDirective(directive as IfDefDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.IfnDefDirective:
				GenerateIfnDefDirective(directive as IfnDefDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.IncludeDirective:
				GenerateIncludeDirective(directive as IncludeDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.PragmaDirective:
				GeneratePragmaDirective(directive as PragmaDirective);
				return true;
			default:
				if (directive.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Region && directive.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective)
				{
					base.Code.WriteWithoutIndentStringOneTime = false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void GenerateDefineDirective(DefineDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateIfDirective(IfDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateElifDirective(ElifDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateElseDirective(ElseDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateEndIfDirective(EndIfDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateUndefDirective(UndefDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateErrorDirective(ErrorDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateWarningDirective(WarningDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateLineDirective(LineDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateRegion(RegionDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateEndRegion(EndRegionDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateIfDefDirective(IfDefDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateIfnDefDirective(IfnDefDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateIncludeDirective(IncludeDirective directive);

		protected abstract void GenerateImportDirective(ImportDirective directive);

		protected virtual void GeneratePragmaDirective(PragmaDirective directive)
		{
		}

		internal void GenerateTopDirectives(SourceFile sourceFile)
		{
			if (sourceFile == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CompilerDirective compilerDirectiveRootNode = sourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode;
			NodeList nodes = compilerDirectiveRootNode.Nodes;
			if (nodes != null && nodes.Count != 0)
			{
				NodeList nodes2 = sourceFile.Nodes;
				SourceRange? stopRange = null;
				if (nodes2 != null && nodes2.Count != 0)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = nodes2[0] as LanguageElement;
					stopRange = languageElement.Range;
				}
				GenerateDirectives(nodes, stopRange);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateDirectives(NodeList directives, SourceRange? stopRange)
		{
			if (directives == null || directives.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = directives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (directives[i] is DefineDirective { Range: var range } defineDirective)
				{
					FormattingElements userFormattingElements = new FormattingElements
					{
						new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL)
					};
					if (!stopRange.HasValue || defineDirective.StartsBefore(stopRange.Value.Start))
					{
						CodeGen.GenerateElement(defineDirective);
						base.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.SetUserFormattingElements(userFormattingElements);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class CExpressionCodeGenBase : ExpressionCodeGenBase
	{
		public CExpressionCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetBinaryOperatorText(BinaryOperatorType operatorType)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (operatorType)
			{
			case BinaryOperatorType.None:
				return " ";
			case BinaryOperatorType.Add:
				text = "+";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Assign:
				text = "=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseAnd:
				text = "&";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseOr:
				text = "|";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BooleanAnd:
				text = "&&";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BooleanOr:
				text = "||";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ExclusiveOr:
				text = "^";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Divide:
				text = "/";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThan:
				text = ">";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				text = ">=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.IdentityEquality:
				text = "==";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.IdentityInequality:
				text = "!=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.LessThan:
				text = "<";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
				text = "<=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Modulus:
			case BinaryOperatorType.IntegerDivision:
				text = "%";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Multiply:
				text = "*";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Subtract:
				text = "-";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ValueEquality:
				text = "==";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.StrictEquality:
				text = "===";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.StrictInequality:
				text = "!==";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.In:
				return " in ";
			case BinaryOperatorType.UnsignedShiftRight:
				text = ">>>";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ShiftRight:
				text = ">>";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ShiftLeft:
				text = "<<";
				break;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return " ";
			}
			if (Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators && text.Length == 1)
			{
				return $" {text} ";
			}
			if (Options.Spacing.AroundTwoCharOperators && text.Length > 1)
			{
				return $" {text} ";
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected override bool GenerateMacroExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			string macroCall = expression.MacroCall;
			if (macroCall == null || macroCall == string.Empty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.Code.Write(macroCall);
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateTypeReferenceExpressionName(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				string text = expression.Name;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && expression.IsDynamic)
				{
					text = "dynamic";
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					base.Code.Write(text);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateDateTimeMinValue()
		{
			base.Code.Write("DateTime.MinValue");
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateUnaryOperator(UnaryOperatorExpression expression, string op)
		{
			if (!expression.IsPostOperator)
			{
				base.Code.Write(op);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			if (expression.IsPostOperator)
			{
				base.Code.Write(op);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypedElementReferenceExpression(TypedElementReferenceExpression expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateExpressionTypeArgument(ExpressionTypeArgument expression)
		{
			GenerateElement(expression.SourceExpression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeOfIsExpression(TypeOfIsExpression expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateAttributeVariableInitializer(AttributeVariableInitializer expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateIsNot(IsNot expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateConditionalExpression(ConditionalExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Condition);
			bool wrapTernaryExpression = Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTernaryExpression;
			bool aroundTernaryQuestionOperator = Options.Spacing.AroundTernaryQuestionOperator;
			if (aroundTernaryQuestionOperator)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("?");
			if (wrapTernaryExpression)
			{
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			else if (aroundTernaryQuestionOperator)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TrueExpression);
			bool aroundTernaryColonOperator = Options.Spacing.AroundTernaryColonOperator;
			if (aroundTernaryColonOperator)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(":");
			if (wrapTernaryExpression)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			else if (aroundTernaryColonOperator)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.FalseExpression);
			if (wrapTernaryExpression)
			{
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateThisReferenceExpression(ThisReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			base.Code.Write("this");
		}

		protected override void GenerateMyClassExpression(MyClassExpression expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeReferenceExpression(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.BaseType != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.BaseType);
			}
			else if (expression.Qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Qualifier);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(expression.Name) && (expression.BaseType != null || (expression.Qualifier != null && expression.Qualifier.ElementType != LanguageElementType.QualifiedAliasExpression)))
			{
				WriteDot();
			}
			GenerateTypeReferenceExpressionName(expression);
			if (expression.IsGeneric)
			{
				GenerateGenericTypeArguments(expression.TypeArguments);
			}
			else if (expression.IsArrayType)
			{
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeArrayRankBrackets)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write("[");
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankEmptyBrackets && expression.Rank < 2)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				bool flag = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankBrackets && expression.Rank > 1;
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < expression.Rank; i++)
				{
					base.Code.Write(GetCommaDelimeter());
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write("]");
			}
			else if (expression.IsPointerType)
			{
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeUnsafePointerDeclarationOperator)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write("*");
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateIndexerExpression(IndexerExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Qualifier);
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpenSquareBracket)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("[");
			bool withinSquareBrackets = Options.Spacing.WithinSquareBrackets;
			if (withinSquareBrackets)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			GenerateExpressionList(expression.Arguments);
			if (withinSquareBrackets)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("]");
		}

		protected override void GenerateLogicalInversion(LogicalInversion expression)
		{
			base.Code.Write("!");
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateAddressOfExpression(AddressOfExpression expression)
		{
			base.Code.Write("&");
			if (Options.Spacing.AroundUnsafeOperators)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateAssignmentExpression(AssignmentExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(base.Code, expression.AssignmentOperator);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeCastExpression(TypeCastExpression expression)
		{
			base.Code.Write("(");
			bool withinTypeCastParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinTypeCastParentheses;
			if (withinTypeCastParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TypeReference);
			if (withinTypeCastParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(")");
			if (Options.Spacing.AfterTypeCastParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			Expression target = expression.Target;
			if (target != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(target);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateArrayInitializerExpression(ArrayInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			base.Code.Write("{");
			bool withinArrayInitializerBraces = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayInitializerBraces;
			if (withinArrayInitializerBraces)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			ElementsGenerationRules elementsGenerationRules = new ElementsGenerationRules();
			elementsGenerationRules.AlignIfWrap = Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstArrayObjectOrCollectionInitializerItem;
			elementsGenerationRules.WrapFirst = Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializer;
			elementsGenerationRules.WrapParams = Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializers;
			elementsGenerationRules.Indenting = Options.Indention.ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents;
			elementsGenerationRules.StringDelimiter = GetCommaDelimeter();
			GenerateElementsByRules(expression.Initializers, elementsGenerationRules);
			if (withinArrayInitializerBraces)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("}");
		}

		protected override void GenerateUnaryIncrement(UnaryIncrement expression)
		{
			GenerateUnaryOperator(expression, "++");
		}

		protected override void GenerateUnaryDecrement(UnaryDecrement expression)
		{
			GenerateUnaryOperator(expression, "--");
		}

		protected override void GenerateArrayCreateExpression(ArrayCreateExpression expression)
		{
			if (!expression.IsStackAlloc)
			{
				base.Code.Write("new ");
			}
			else
			{
				base.Code.Write("stackalloc ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.BaseType);
			bool flag = expression.BaseType != null && expression.BaseType.IsArrayType;
			bool flag2 = expression.Dimensions != null && expression.Dimensions.Count > 0;
