			bool flag3 = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankEmptyBrackets && !flag2;
			bool withinArrayRankBrackets = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankBrackets;
			if (!flag)
			{
				base.Code.Write("[");
				if (flag3)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Code.Write("[");
				}
				if (withinArrayRankBrackets)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Dimensions, GetCommaDelimeter());
				if (withinArrayRankBrackets)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Code.Write("]");
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				base.Code.Write("]");
			}
			if (expression.Initializer != null && base.Code.Options.Indention.ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Initializer);
		}

		protected override void GenerateObjectCreationExpression(ObjectCreationExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Code.Write("new");
			Expression objectType = expression.ObjectType;
			if (objectType != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(objectType);
			}
			ExpressionCollection arguments = expression.Arguments;
			if (arguments != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write("(");
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Arguments, GetCommaDelimeter());
				base.Code.Write(")");
			}
			ObjectInitializerExpression objectInitializer = expression.ObjectInitializer;
			if (objectInitializer != null)
			{
				if (base.Code.Options.Indention.ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
				else
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(objectInitializer);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateAnonymousMethodExpression(AnonymousMethodExpression expression)
		{
			base.Code.Write("delegate");
			if (expression.Parameters != null && expression.Parameters.Count > 0)
			{
				GenerateParameters(expression.Parameters);
			}
			int nodeCount = expression.NodeCount;
			bool flag = Options.Spacing.WithinSingleLineAnonymousMethod && nodeCount < 2;
			bool flag2 = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine && nodeCount < 2;
			bool flag3 = !flag2 && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousMethods;
			bool anonymousMethodContents = Options.Indention.AnonymousMethodContents;
			WriteOpenBrace(flag3, !flag3 && Options.Spacing.BeforeOpenCurlyBraceOnTheSameLine, flag2 && flag, anonymousMethodContents);
			if (!flag2 && nodeCount > 0)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
			if (nodeCount > 0)
			{
				if (nodeCount == 1)
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateCode(base.Code, (LanguageElement)expression.Nodes[0]);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.Nodes, string.Empty);
				}
			}
			WriteCloseBrace(!flag2 && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousMethods, flag2 && flag, anonymousMethodContents);
		}

		protected override void GenerateDateTime(object value)
		{
			if ((DateTime)value == DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				GenerateDateTimeMinValue();
				return;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
			if (dateTime.Second > 0 || dateTime.Minute > 0 || dateTime.Hour > 0)
			{
				if (dateTime.Millisecond > 0)
				{
					base.Code.Write("new DateTime({0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {6})", dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second, dateTime.Millisecond);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Code.Write("new DateTime({0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5})", dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day, dateTime.Hour, dateTime.Minute, dateTime.Second);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.Code.Write("new DateTime({0}, {1}, {2})", dateTime.Year, dateTime.Month, dateTime.Day);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateSizeOfExpression(SizeOfExpression expression)
		{
			base.Code.Write("sizeof");
			if (Options.Spacing.BeforeTypeofSizeofParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("(");
			bool withinTypeofSizeofParentheses = Options.Spacing.WithinTypeofSizeofParentheses;
			if (withinTypeofSizeofParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TypeReference);
			if (withinTypeofSizeofParentheses)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write(")");
		}

		protected override void GenerateFunctionPointerTypeReference(FunctionPointerTypeReference expression)
		{
		}

		public static void GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(CodeWriter codeWriter, AssignmentOperatorType op)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (op)
			{
			case AssignmentOperatorType.Assignment:
				text = "=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.BackSlashEquals:
				text = "/=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.BitAndEquals:
				text = "&=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.BitOrEquals:
				text = "|=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.MinusEquals:
				text = "-=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.PercentEquals:
				text = "%=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.PlusEquals:
				text = "+=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.ShiftLeftEquals:
				text = "<<=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.ShiftRightEquals:
				text = ">>=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.SlashEquals:
				text = "/=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.StarEquals:
				text = "*=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.XorEquals:
				text = "^=";
				break;
			case AssignmentOperatorType.UnsignedShiftRightEquals:
				text = ">>>=";
				break;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (codeWriter.Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators && text.Length == 1)
			{
				codeWriter.Write(" " + text + " ");
				return;
			}
			if (codeWriter.Options.Spacing.AroundTwoCharOperators && text.Length > 1)
			{
				text = " " + text + " ";
			}
			codeWriter.Write(text);
		}
	}
	public abstract class TokenCExpressionCodeGenBase : TokenExpressionCodeGenBase
	{
		public TokenCExpressionCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		private static FormattingTokenType GetTokenType(AssignmentOperatorType opType)
		{
			return opType switch
			{
				AssignmentOperatorType.Assignment => FormattingTokenType.Equal, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.BackSlashEquals => FormattingTokenType.BackSlashEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.BitAndEquals => FormattingTokenType.AmpersandEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.BitOrEquals => FormattingTokenType.VerticalBarEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.MinusEquals => FormattingTokenType.MinusEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.PercentEquals => FormattingTokenType.PercentEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.PlusEquals => FormattingTokenType.PlusEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.ShiftLeftEquals => FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThanEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.ShiftRightEquals => FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.SlashEquals => FormattingTokenType.SlashEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.StarEquals => FormattingTokenType.AsteriskEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.XorEquals => FormattingTokenType.CaretEqual, 
				AssignmentOperatorType.UnsignedShiftRightEquals => FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanGreatThanEqual, 
				_ => FormattingTokenType.None, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateDateTimeMinValue()
		{
			Write("DateTime.MinValue");
		}

		protected override string GetBinaryOperatorText(BinaryOperatorType operatorType)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (operatorType)
			{
			case BinaryOperatorType.None:
				return " ";
			case BinaryOperatorType.Add:
				text = "+";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Assign:
				text = "=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseAnd:
				text = "&";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseOr:
				text = "|";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BooleanAnd:
				text = "&&";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.BooleanOr:
				text = "||";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ExclusiveOr:
				text = "^";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Divide:
				text = "/";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThan:
				text = ">";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				text = ">=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.IdentityEquality:
				text = "==";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.IdentityInequality:
				text = "!=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.LessThan:
				text = "<";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
				text = "<=";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Modulus:
			case BinaryOperatorType.IntegerDivision:
				text = "%";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Multiply:
				text = "*";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.Subtract:
				text = "-";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ValueEquality:
				text = "==";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.StrictEquality:
				text = "===";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.StrictInequality:
				text = "!==";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.In:
				return " in ";
			case BinaryOperatorType.UnsignedShiftRight:
				text = ">>>";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ShiftRight:
				text = ">>";
				break;
			case BinaryOperatorType.ShiftLeft:
				text = "<<";
				break;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return " ";
			}
			if (Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators && text.Length == 1)
			{
				return $" {text} ";
			}
			if (Options.Spacing.AroundTwoCharOperators && text.Length > 1)
			{
				return $" {text} ";
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypedElementReferenceExpression(TypedElementReferenceExpression expression)
		{
		}

		protected override bool GenerateExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			return base.GenerateExpressionCore(expression);
		}

		protected override bool GenerateMacroExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			string macroCall = expression.MacroCall;
			if (macroCall == null || macroCall == string.Empty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.Code.Write(macroCall);
			return true;
		}

		protected override void GeneratePrimitiveExpression(PrimitiveExpression expression)
		{
			object primitiveValue = expression.PrimitiveValue;
			string name = expression.Name;
			bool flag = IsEscapedString(name);
			PrimitiveType primitiveType = expression.PrimitiveType;
			if (primitiveType == PrimitiveType.Path && primitiveValue != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write(primitiveValue.ToString());
			}
			else if (primitiveValue is bool)
			{
				GenerateBooleanLiteral((bool)primitiveValue);
			}
			else if ((primitiveValue == null && (name == null || name.Length == 0)) || primitiveType == PrimitiveType.Void)
			{
				GenerateNullLiteral();
			}
			else if (expression.Literal != null)
			{
				Write(expression.Literal);
			}
			else if (primitiveValue is char)
			{
				GenerateCharLiteral((char)primitiveValue);
			}
			else if (primitiveType == PrimitiveType.Char)
			{
				Write(name);
			}
			else if (primitiveValue is string || primitiveType == PrimitiveType.String)
			{
				if (name != null && name != string.Empty && flag)
				{
					Write(name, split: false);
				}
				else if (expression.CanHasEscapeSequence)
				{
					GenerateStringLiteralWithEscapeSequence((string)primitiveValue);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateStringLiteral((string)primitiveValue);
				}
			}
			else if (expression.IsNumberLiteral)
			{
				GenerateNumberLiteral(name, primitiveValue, expression.PrimitiveType);
			}
			else if (expression.IsDateTime && (name == null || name.Length == 0))
			{
				GenerateDateTime(primitiveValue);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(name);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateExpressionTypeArgument(ExpressionTypeArgument expression)
		{
			GenerateElement(expression.SourceExpression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateLogicalOperation(LogicalOperation expression)
		{
			GenerateBinaryOperatorExpression(expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateBinaryOperator(BinaryOperatorExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				FormattingTokenType binaryOperatorToken = GetBinaryOperatorToken(expression.BinaryOperator);
				if (binaryOperatorToken == FormattingTokenType.None && expression.OperatorText != null)
				{
					string text = $" {expression.OperatorText} ";
					Write(text);
				}
				else
				{
					Write(binaryOperatorToken);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateBinaryOperator(BinaryOperatorType op)
		{
			Write(GetBinaryOperatorToken(op));
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeOfIsExpression(TypeOfIsExpression expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateAttributeVariableInitializer(AttributeVariableInitializer expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateIsNot(IsNot expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateConditionalExpression(ConditionalExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Condition);
			using (GetIndent(Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTernaryExpression))
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Question);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TrueExpression);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.FalseExpression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateThisReferenceExpression(ThisReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.This);
		}

		protected override void GenerateMyClassExpression(MyClassExpression expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeReferenceExpression(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.BaseType != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.BaseType);
			}
			else if (expression.Qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Qualifier);
			}
			if (HasName(expression))
			{
				if (expression.BaseType != null || (expression.Qualifier != null && expression.Qualifier.ElementType != LanguageElementType.QualifiedAliasExpression))
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Dot);
				}
				GenerateName(expression);
			}
			if (expression.IsGeneric)
			{
				GenerateGenericTypeArguments(expression.TypeArguments);
			}
			else if (expression.IsArrayType)
			{
				bool flag = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankBrackets && expression.Rank > 1;
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
				for (int i = 1; i < expression.Rank; i++)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma, i - 1);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
			}
			else if (expression.IsPointerType)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Asterisk);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateIndexerExpression(IndexerExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Qualifier);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
			GenerateExpressionList(expression.Arguments);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateLogicalInversion(LogicalInversion expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Exclamation);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateAddressOfExpression(AddressOfExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ampersand);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateAssignmentExpression(AssignmentExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(this);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeCastExpression(TypeCastExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TypeReference);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			Expression target = expression.Target;
			if (target != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(target);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateArrayInitializerExpression(ArrayInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(expression.Initializers, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateUnaryIncrement(UnaryIncrement expression)
		{
			GenerateUnaryOperator(expression, FormattingTokenType.PlusPlus);
		}

		protected override void GenerateUnaryDecrement(UnaryDecrement expression)
		{
			GenerateUnaryOperator(expression, FormattingTokenType.MinusMinus);
		}

		protected override void GenerateArrayCreateExpression(ArrayCreateExpression expression)
		{
			if (!expression.IsStackAlloc)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.New);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Stackalloc);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.BaseType);
			bool flag = expression.BaseType != null && expression.BaseType.IsArrayType;
			bool flag2 = expression.Dimensions != null && expression.Dimensions.Count > 0;
			if (!flag)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Dimensions, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Initializer);
		}

		protected override void GenerateObjectCreationExpression(ObjectCreationExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.New);
				Expression objectType = expression.ObjectType;
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(objectType);
				ExpressionCollection arguments = expression.Arguments;
				if (arguments != null)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.Arguments, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
				}
				GenerateObjectInitializerExpression(expression.ObjectInitializer);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateAnonymousMethodExpression(AnonymousMethodExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.IsAsynchronous)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Async);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Delegate);
			if (!expression.ParameterListOmitted)
			{
				GenerateParameters(expression.Parameters);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(expression.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateDateTime(object value)
		{
			if ((DateTime)value == DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				GenerateDateTimeMinValue();
				return;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty = ((dateTime.Second <= 0 && dateTime.Minute <= 0 && dateTime.Hour <= 0) ? $"new DateTime({dateTime.Year}, {dateTime.Month}, {dateTime.Day})" : ((dateTime.Millisecond <= 0) ? $"new DateTime({dateTime.Year}, {dateTime.Month}, {dateTime.Day}, {dateTime.Hour}, {dateTime.Minute}, {dateTime.Second})" : $"new DateTime({dateTime.Year}, {dateTime.Month}, {dateTime.Day}, {dateTime.Hour}, {dateTime.Minute}, {dateTime.Second}, {dateTime.Millisecond})"));
			Write(empty);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSizeOfExpression(SizeOfExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Sizeof);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TypeReference);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateFunctionPointerTypeReference(FunctionPointerTypeReference expression)
		{
		}

		public virtual bool HasName(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(expression.Name))
			{
				return expression.IsDynamic;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void GenerateName(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (expression.IsDynamic && string.IsNullOrEmpty(expression.Name))
				{
					Write("dynamic");
				}
				else
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				}
			}
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Ampersand:
			case FormattingTokenType.Equal:
			case FormattingTokenType.EqualEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThenEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.Minus:
			case FormattingTokenType.ExclamationEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Plus:
			case FormattingTokenType.PlusEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Asterisk:
			case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBarVerticalBar:
			case FormattingTokenType.AmpersandAmpersand:
			case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBar:
			case FormattingTokenType.Caret:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Slash:
			case FormattingTokenType.Percent:
			case FormattingTokenType.EqualEqualEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.ExclamationEqualEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanGreatThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThan:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation) && Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOperatorInLogicalExpression)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.BinaryOperatorExpression) && Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOperatorInBinaryExpression)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				else if (tokenType == FormattingTokenType.Asterisk && base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression { IsGeneric: false, IsArrayType: false, IsPointerType: not false } && Options.Spacing.BeforeUnsafePointerDeclarationOperator)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeCheckedUncheckedParentheses && (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.CheckedExpression) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.UncheckedExpression)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.BeforeTypeofSizeofParentheses && (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.TypeOfExpression) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.SizeOfExpression)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.BeforeDefaultParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.DefaultValueExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ParenthesizedExpression) && Options.Spacing.WithinExpressionParentheses)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.TypeCastExpression) && Options.Spacing.WithinTypeCastParentheses)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.WithinCheckedUncheckedParentheses && (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.CheckedExpression) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.UncheckedExpression)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeofSizeofParentheses && (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.TypeOfExpression) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.SizeOfExpression)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.WithinDefaultParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.DefaultValueExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen:
				if (base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression { IsGeneric: false, IsArrayType: not false } && Options.Spacing.BeforeArrayRankBrackets)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression) && Options.Spacing.BeforeOpenSquareBracket)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketClose:
				if (base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression { IsGeneric: false, IsArrayType: not false } typeReferenceExpression3 && Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankBrackets && typeReferenceExpression3.Rank > 1)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression) && Options.Spacing.WithinSquareBrackets)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else
				{
					if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ArrayCreateExpression) || !(base.Context is ArrayCreateExpression { BaseType: var baseType } arrayCreateExpression))
					{
						break;
					}
					bool flag = baseType?.IsArrayType ?? false;
					int num = -1;
					if (arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions != null)
					{
						num = arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions.Count;
					}
					bool flag2 = arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions != null && arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions.Count > 0;
					bool flag3 = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankBrackets && flag2;
					if (num > 0 && flag)
					{
						if (flag3)
						{
							formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
						}
						break;
					}
					if (flag2 && flag && flag3)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					if (!flag && flag3)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Question:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundTernaryQuestionOperator && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ConditionalExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundTernaryColonOperator && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ConditionalExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Async:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ParenthesizedExpression) && Options.Spacing.WithinExpressionParentheses)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.TypeCastExpression) && Options.Spacing.WithinTypeCastParentheses)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeofSizeofParentheses && (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.TypeOfExpression) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.SizeOfExpression)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.TypeCastExpression) && Options.Spacing.AfterTypeCastParentheses)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen:
				if (base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression)
				{
					bool flag = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankBrackets && typeReferenceExpression.Rank > 1;
					if (!typeReferenceExpression.IsGeneric && typeReferenceExpression.IsArrayType && (flag || (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankEmptyBrackets && typeReferenceExpression.Rank < 2)))
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ArrayCreateExpression) || !(base.Context is ArrayCreateExpression { BaseType: var baseType } arrayCreateExpression))
					{
						break;
					}
					bool flag2 = baseType?.IsArrayType ?? false;
					int num = -1;
					if (arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions != null)
					{
						num = arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions.Count;
					}
					bool flag3 = arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions != null && arrayCreateExpression.Dimensions.Count > 0;
					bool flag4 = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankEmptyBrackets && !flag3;
					bool flag5 = Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankBrackets && flag3;
					if (num > 0 && flag2)
					{
						if (flag5)
						{
							formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
						}
					}
					else if (!flag2 && (flag4 || flag5))
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					else if (flag3 && flag2 && flag5)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.New:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ArrayCreateExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else
				{
					if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression) || !(base.Context is ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression))
					{
						break;
					}
					Expression objectType = objectCreationExpression.ObjectType;
					if (objectType == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (objectType == null)
					{
						if (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousTypes)
						{
							formattingElements.AddNewLine();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Question:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ConditionalExpression))
				{
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTernaryExpression)
					{
						IncreaseIndent();
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
					else if (Options.Spacing.AroundTernaryQuestionOperator)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ConditionalExpression))
				{
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTernaryExpression)
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
					else if (Options.Spacing.AroundTernaryColonOperator)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Ampersand:
			case FormattingTokenType.Equal:
			case FormattingTokenType.EqualEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThenEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.Minus:
			case FormattingTokenType.ExclamationEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Plus:
			case FormattingTokenType.PlusEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Asterisk:
			case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBarVerticalBar:
			case FormattingTokenType.AmpersandAmpersand:
			case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBar:
			case FormattingTokenType.Caret:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Slash:
			case FormattingTokenType.Percent:
			case FormattingTokenType.EqualEqualEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.ExclamationEqualEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanGreatThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThan:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation) && Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapLogicalOperatorExpression)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				else if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.BinaryOperatorExpression) && Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public static void GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(LanguageElementCodeGenBase codeGen)
		{
			if (codeGen != null)
			{
				Assignment assignment = codeGen.Context as Assignment;
				AssignmentOperatorType assignmentOperatorType = AssignmentOperatorType.None;
				if (assignment != null)
				{
					assignmentOperatorType = assignment.AssignmentOperator;
				}
				else
				{
					AssignmentExpression assignmentExpression = codeGen.Context as AssignmentExpression;
					assignmentOperatorType = assignmentExpression.AssignmentOperator;
				}
				codeGen.Write(GetTokenType(assignmentOperatorType));
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class ExpressionCodeGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		private class ExpressionInfo
		{
			private Expression _Expression;

			private BinaryOperatorType _Operator;

			public BinaryOperatorType Operator
			{
				get
				{
					return _Operator;
				}
				set
				{
					_Operator = value;
				}
			}

			public Expression Expression => _Expression;

			public ExpressionInfo(Expression expression, BinaryOperatorType op)
			{
				_Expression = expression;
				_Operator = op;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		private List<ExpressionInfo> GetExpressionListFromBinaryExpression(BinaryOperatorExpression expression, LanguageElementType elementType)
		{
			List<ExpressionInfo> list = new List<ExpressionInfo>();
			GetExpressionListFromBinaryExpression(expression, list, elementType, BinaryOperatorType.None);
			return list;
		}

		private void GetExpressionListFromBinaryExpression(BinaryOperatorExpression expression, List<ExpressionInfo> list, LanguageElementType elementType, BinaryOperatorType op)
		{
			Expression leftSide = expression.LeftSide;
			if (leftSide.ElementType == elementType)
			{
				GetExpressionListFromBinaryExpression(leftSide as BinaryOperatorExpression, list, elementType, expression.BinaryOperator);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new ExpressionInfo(leftSide, expression.BinaryOperator));
			}
			Expression rightSide = expression.RightSide;
			if (rightSide.ElementType == elementType)
			{
				GetExpressionListFromBinaryExpression(rightSide as BinaryOperatorExpression, list, elementType, op);
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(new ExpressionInfo(rightSide, op));
			}
		}

		private string GetBinaryOperatorText(BinaryOperatorExpression expression)
		{
			string text = expression.OperatorText;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				text = $" {text} ";
			}
			if (expression.BinaryOperator != BinaryOperatorType.None)
			{
				text = GetBinaryOperatorText(expression.BinaryOperator);
			}
			return text;
		}

		private void GenerateElementForeComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && CodeGen != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElementForeComment(element);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateElementBackComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && CodeGen != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElementBackComment(element);
			}
		}

		protected string GetStringValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return Convert.ToString(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}

		protected abstract bool IsEscapedString(string value);
