	public abstract class CSupportElementCodeGen : SupportElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSupportElementCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateAttributeTargetType(CodeWriter code, AttributeTargetType target)
		{
			switch (target)
			{
			case AttributeTargetType.Assembly:
				code.Write("assembly");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Class:
				code.Write("class");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Constructor:
				code.Write("constructor");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Delegate:
				code.Write("delegate");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Enum:
				code.Write("enum");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Event:
				code.Write("event");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Field:
				code.Write("field");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Interface:
				code.Write("interface");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Method:
				code.Write("method");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Param:
				code.Write("parameter");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Property:
				code.Write("property");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Return:
				code.Write("returnvalue");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Struct:
				code.Write("struct");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Module:
				code.Write("module");
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.None:
				return;
			}
			if (code.Options.Spacing.BeforeAttributeTargetColon)
			{
				code.Write(" ");
			}
			code.Write(":");
			if (code.Options.Spacing.AfterAttributeTargetColon)
			{
				code.Write(" ");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateAttributeQualifier(Attribute attr, string delimiter)
		{
			if (attr.Qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(attr.Qualifier);
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeDot)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write(".");
				if (Options.Spacing.AfterDot)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateAttribute(Attribute attr)
		{
			GenerateAttributeTargetType(base.Code, attr.TargetType);
			GenerateAttributeQualifier(attr, ".");
			base.Code.Write(attr.Name);
			if (attr.ArgumentCount > 0)
			{
				base.Code.Write("(");
				GenerateParameters(attr.Arguments, GetCommaDelimeter());
				base.Code.Write(")");
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateAttribute(AttributeSection section)
		{
			base.Code.Write("[");
			bool withinAttributeBrackets = Options.Spacing.WithinAttributeBrackets;
			if (withinAttributeBrackets)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			GenerateElementCollection(section.AttributeCollection, GetCommaDelimeter());
			if (withinAttributeBrackets)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("]");
			LanguageElement targetNode = section.TargetNode;
			bool flag = targetNode == null || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceTypeAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is TypeDeclaration) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceMethodAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Method) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlacePropertyAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Property) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceFieldConstantAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Variable) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceEventAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Event) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceEnumElementAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is EnumElement);
			if (targetNode is Param || !flag)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			else if (section.NextSibling != null && targetNode != null)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateComment(Comment comment)
		{
			bool indentComment = base.Code.Options.Indention.IndentComment;
			int indentLevel = 0;
			if (!indentComment)
			{
				indentLevel = base.Code.IndentLevel;
				base.Code.IndentLevel = 0;
			}
			if (comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine)
			{
				base.Code.Write("//");
				base.Code.Write(comment.Name);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!base.Code.IsAtWhitespace)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write("/*");
				int num = comment.TextStartOffset - 2;
				string s = string.Empty;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					s = " ".PadRight(num);
				}
				base.Code.Write(s);
				base.Code.Write(comment.Name);
				base.Code.Write("*/");
			}
			if (!indentComment)
			{
				base.Code.IndentLevel = indentLevel;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class NamespaceGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public NamespaceGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void GenerateNamespace(Namespace element);

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				GenerateNamespace(languageElement as Namespace);
			}
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is Namespace))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement nextSibling = element.NextSibling;
			if (nextSibling == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Options.BlankLines.AfterNamespaces)
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLine(2);
			}
			else
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class NamespaceReferenceGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public NamespaceReferenceGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void GenerateExternAlias(ExternAlias element);

		protected abstract void GenerateNamespaceReference(NamespaceReference element);

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlNamespaceReference(XmlNamespaceReference element)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				switch (languageElement.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.NamespaceReference:
					GenerateNamespaceReference(languageElement as NamespaceReference);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.ExternAlias:
					GenerateExternAlias(languageElement as ExternAlias);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.XmlNamespaceReference:
					GenerateXmlNamespaceReference(languageElement as XmlNamespaceReference);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ExternAlias && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.NamespaceReference && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.XmlNamespaceReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement nextSibling = element.NextSibling;
			if (nextSibling == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class TokenSupportElementCodeGenBase : SupportElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public TokenSupportElementCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateAttributeTargetType(AttributeTargetType target)
		{
			switch (target)
			{
			case AttributeTargetType.Assembly:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Assembly);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Class:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Class);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Constructor:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Constructor);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Delegate:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Delegate);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Enum:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Enum);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Event:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Event);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Field:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Field);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Interface:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Interface);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Method:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Method);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Param:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Param);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Property:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Property);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Return:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Return);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Struct:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Struct);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.Module:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Module);
				break;
			case AttributeTargetType.None:
				return;
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateAttributeQualifier(Attribute attr, FormattingTokenType delimiter)
		{
			if (attr.Qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(attr.Qualifier);
				Write(delimiter);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateAttribute(Attribute attr)
		{
			GenerateAttributeTargetType(attr.TargetType);
			GenerateAttributeQualifier(attr, FormattingTokenType.Dot);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (attr.ArgumentCount > 0)
			{
				GenerateParameters(attr.Arguments);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateAttribute(AttributeSection section)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(section.AttributeCollection, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateComment(Comment comment)
		{
			if (CodeGen.TokenArgsContainsElement(comment))
			{
				return;
			}
			using (GetClearIndent(!base.Code.Options.Indention.IndentComment))
			{
				if (comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine)
				{
					Write("//" + comment.Name);
					return;
				}
				if (!base.Code.IsAtWhitespace)
				{
					CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
				}
				int num = comment.TextStartOffset - 2;
				string text = string.Empty;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					text = " ".PadRight(num);
				}
				Write("/*" + text + comment.Name + "*/", split: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateElementComment(CodeElement codeElement, SupportElementPosition position)
		{
			if (codeElement == null || codeElement.Comments == null || codeElement.CommentCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Comment comment = null;
			CommentCollection comments = codeElement.Comments;
			int commentCount = codeElement.CommentCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < commentCount; i++)
			{
				comment = comments[i];
				if (comment.Position == position && comment.TargetNode == codeElement && !CodeGen.IsSkipped(comment))
				{
					if (HasSameLineRange(comment))
					{
						CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
					}
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(comment);
					if (comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine && position == SupportElementPosition.Before)
					{
						CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
					}
					CodeGen.AddSkipped(comment);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateAttributes(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is CodeElement codeElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			CodeGen codeGen = CodeGen;
			AttributeSection attributeSection = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < codeElement.AttributeSections.Count; i++)
			{
				if (codeElement.AttributeSections[i] is AttributeSection attributeSection2 && attributeSection2.TargetNode == codeElement && !codeGen.IsSkipped(attributeSection2))
				{
					bool generatingInSupportElement = CodeGen.GeneratingInSupportElement;
					CodeGen.GeneratingInSupportElement = true;
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(attributeSection2);
					CodeGen.GeneratingInSupportElement = generatingInSupportElement;
				}
			}
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Attribute && Options.Spacing.BeforeAttributeTargetColon)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketClose:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.AttributeSection && Options.Spacing.WithinAttributeBrackets)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		private bool GenerateCodeBlock(PropertyAccessor target)
		{
			return target?.GenerateCodeBlock ?? false;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Attribute && Options.Spacing.AfterAttributeTargetColon)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.AttributeSection && Options.Spacing.WithinAttributeBrackets)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketClose:
				if (base.Context is AttributeSection { TargetNode: var targetNode } attributeSection)
				{
					bool flag = targetNode == null || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceTypeAttributeOnSeparateLine && (targetNode is TypeDeclaration || targetNode is DelegateDefinition)) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceMethodAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Method) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceMethodAttributeOnSeparateLine && GenerateCodeBlock(targetNode as PropertyAccessor)) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlacePropertyAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Property) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceFieldConstantAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Variable) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceEventAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is Event) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceEnumElementAttributeOnSeparateLine && targetNode is EnumElement);
					if (targetNode is Param || !flag)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					else if ((attributeSection.NextSibling != null || attributeSection.Parent == null) && targetNode != null)
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.AttributeSection) && Options.LineBreaks.PlaceMultipleAttributesOnTheirOwnLine)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SupportElementCodeGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public SupportElementCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool GenerateSupportElement(SupportElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (element.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Attribute:
				GenerateAttribute(element as Attribute);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AttributeSection:
				GenerateAttribute(element as AttributeSection);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CppAttributeSection:
				GenerateCppAttribute(element as CppAttributeSection);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Comment:
				GenerateComment(element as Comment);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void GenerateAttribute(Attribute element);

		protected abstract void GenerateAttribute(AttributeSection element);

		protected abstract void GenerateComment(Comment element);

		protected abstract void GenerateCppAttribute(CppAttributeSection element);

		protected virtual void GenerateElementComment(CodeElement codeElement, SupportElementPosition position)
		{
			if (codeElement == null || codeElement.Comments == null || codeElement.CommentCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Comment comment = null;
			CommentCollection comments = codeElement.Comments;
			int commentCount = codeElement.CommentCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < commentCount; i++)
			{
				comment = comments[i];
				if (comment.Position == position && comment.TargetNode == codeElement && !CodeGen.IsSkipped(comment))
				{
					if (HasSameLineRange(comment))
					{
						base.Code.Write(" ");
					}
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(comment);
					if (comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine && position == SupportElementPosition.Before)
					{
						base.Code.WriteLine();
					}
					CodeGen.AddSkipped(comment);
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool HasSameLineRange(Comment com)
		{
			return HasSameLineRange(com, SupportElementPosition.After);
		}

		protected virtual bool HasSameLineRange(Comment com, SupportElementPosition possiblePosition)
		{
			if (com == null || com.Position != possiblePosition)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(com.TargetNode is CodeElement target))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return HasSameLineRange(target, com);
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				GenerateSupportElement(languageElement as SupportElement);
			}
		}

		public virtual void GenerateAttributes(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is CodeElement codeElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			CodeGen codeGen = CodeGen;
			AttributeSection attributeSection = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < codeElement.AttributeSections.Count; i++)
			{
				attributeSection = codeElement.AttributeSections[i] as AttributeSection;
				if (attributeSection.TargetNode == codeElement && !codeGen.IsSkipped(attributeSection))
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(attributeSection);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void GenerateElementForeComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && element is CodeElement)
			{
				CodeElement codeElement = element as CodeElement;
				GenerateElementComment(codeElement, SupportElementPosition.Before);
			}
		}

		public virtual void GenerateElementBackComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && element is CodeElement)
			{
				CodeElement codeElement = element as CodeElement;
				GenerateElementComment(codeElement, SupportElementPosition.After);
			}
		}

		public static bool HasAfterComment(CodeElement target)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CommentCollection comments = target.Comments;
			if (comments == null || comments.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = comments.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[i];
				if (comment != null && comment.Position == SupportElementPosition.After && HasSameLineRange(target, comment))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool HasSameLineRange(CodeElement target, Comment comment)
		{
			SourceRange range = target.Range;
			SourceRange range2 = comment.Range;
			if (range.IsEmpty || range2.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int line = range.End.Line;
			int line2 = range2.Start.Line;
			return line == line2;
		}
	}

	public class GenTextArgs
	{
		private FormattingTokenType _Type;

		private int _Index;

		private string _Text;

		private bool _SplitLines = true;

		private CodeGen _CodeGen;

		private int _ContextsIndex = -1;

		public bool SplitLines
		{
			get
			{
				return _SplitLines;
			}
			set
			{
				_SplitLines = value;
			}
		}

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				return _Index;
			}
			set
			{
				_Index = value;
			}
		}

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return _Text;
			}
			set
			{
				_Text = value;
			}
		}

		public FormattingTokenType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return _Type;
			}
			set
			{
				_Type = value;
				SetTokenText(value);
			}
		}

		public int ContextsIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return _ContextsIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				_ContextsIndex = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Type == FormattingTokenType.None)
				{
					return Text == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement Context
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CodeGen == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _CodeGen.Context;
			}
		}

		public GenTextArgs(CodeGen codeGen, string tokenText, bool split)
			: this(codeGen, FormattingTokenType.None, 0, tokenText)
		{
			_SplitLines = split;
		}

		public GenTextArgs(CodeGen codeGen, FormattingTokenType tokenType, int index)
			: this(codeGen, tokenType, index, null)
		{
		}

		public GenTextArgs(CodeGen codeGen, FormattingTokenType tokenType, int index, string tokenText)
			: this(codeGen, codeGen.Contexts.Count - 1, tokenType, index, tokenText)
		{
		}

		public GenTextArgs(CodeGen codeGen, int contextsIndex, FormattingTokenType tokenType, int index, string tokenText)
		{
			_CodeGen = codeGen;
			_ContextsIndex = contextsIndex;
			_Text = tokenText;
			Type = tokenType;
			_Index = index;
		}

		private void SetTokenText(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			if (_CodeGen != null && _Text == null)
			{
				if (type == FormattingTokenType.None)
				{
					_Text = string.Empty;
				}
				else
				{
					_Text = _CodeGen.GetTokenText(type, _ContextsIndex);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class TokenGenArgs
	{
		private FormattingElements _FormattingElements;

		private FormattingElements _UserFormattingElements;

		private bool _EndsEOLNecessary;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (FormattingElements.Count <= 0 && UserFormattingElements.Count <= 0)
				{
					return !_EndsEOLNecessary;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public FormattingElements FormattingElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_FormattingElements == null)
				{
					_FormattingElements = new FormattingElements();
				}
				return _FormattingElements;
			}
		}

		public FormattingElements UserFormattingElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_UserFormattingElements == null)
				{
					_UserFormattingElements = new FormattingElements();
				}
				return _UserFormattingElements;
			}
		}

		public bool EndsEOLNecessary
		{
			get
			{
				return _EndsEOLNecessary;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndsEOLNecessary = value;
			}
		}

		public TokenGenArgs()
		{
		}

		public TokenGenArgs(FormattingElements formattingElements)
		{
			_FormattingElements = formattingElements;
		}

		public void AddWhiteSpace()
		{
			FormattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
		}

		public void AddDecreaseIndent()
		{
			FormattingElements.AddDecreaseIndent();
		}

		public void AddIncreaseIndent()
		{
			FormattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
		}

		public void AddClearIndent()
		{
			FormattingElements.AddClearIndent();
		}

		public void AddRestoreIndent()
		{
			FormattingElements.AddRestoreIndent();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_FormattingElements = null;
			_UserFormattingElements = null;
			_EndsEOLNecessary = false;
		}

		public bool Contains(object element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_FormattingElements != null)
			{
				foreach (IFormattingElement formattingElement in _FormattingElements)
				{
					if (formattingElement == element)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (_UserFormattingElements != null)
			{
				foreach (IFormattingElement userFormattingElement in _UserFormattingElements)
				{
					if (userFormattingElement == element)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void AddNewLine(int countConsecutive)
		{
			if (_FormattingElements == null)
			{
				_FormattingElements = new FormattingElements();
			}
			_FormattingElements.AddNewLine(countConsecutive);
		}

		public void AddNewLine()
		{
			if (_FormattingElements == null)
			{
				_FormattingElements = new FormattingElements();
			}
			_FormattingElements.AddNewLine();
		}

		public void SetFormattingElements(FormattingElements nextElements)
		{
			_FormattingElements = nextElements;
		}

		public void SetUserFormattingElements(FormattingElements userTokens)
		{
			_UserFormattingElements = userTokens;
		}

		public void ClearFormattingElements()
		{
			_FormattingElements = null;
			_UserFormattingElements = null;
			_EndsEOLNecessary = false;
		}

		internal bool IsLastElementNewLine()
		{
			if (_FormattingElements == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _FormattingElements.IsLastElementNewLine();
		}

		internal bool IsLastElementWhiteSpace()
		{
			if (_FormattingElements == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _FormattingElements.IsLastElementWhiteSpace();
		}

		internal bool IsLastElementIndent()
		{
			if (_FormattingElements == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _FormattingElements.IsLastElementIndent();
		}

		public TokenGenArgs SaveAndReset()
		{
			TokenGenArgs tokenGenArgs = new TokenGenArgs();
			tokenGenArgs._FormattingElements = _FormattingElements;
			tokenGenArgs._UserFormattingElements = _UserFormattingElements;
			tokenGenArgs._EndsEOLNecessary = _EndsEOLNecessary;
			Reset();
			return tokenGenArgs;
		}

		public TokenGenArgs LogicForProcessComment()
		{
			if (_UserFormattingElements == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TokenGenArgs tokenGenArgs = new TokenGenArgs();
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < _UserFormattingElements.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_UserFormattingElements[i] is PreprocessorDirective)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					tokenGenArgs.UserFormattingElements.AddRange(_UserFormattingElements.GetElements(i, _UserFormattingElements.Count - i));
					_UserFormattingElements.RemoveRange(i, _UserFormattingElements.Count - i);
					break;
				}
				if (_UserFormattingElements[i] is FormattingElement formattingElement && formattingElement.IsEol())
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (_UserFormattingElements[i] is Comment { CommentType: CommentType.SingleLine })
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			return tokenGenArgs;
		}
	}

		}

			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				GenerateTemplate(languageElement as TemplateModifier);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool GenerateTemplate(TemplateModifier modifier)
		{
			if (modifier == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class TemplateParameterCodeGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public TemplateParameterCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void GenerateClassTemplateParameter(ClassTemplateParameter parameter);

		protected abstract void GenerateNamedTemplateParameter(NamedTemplateParameter parameter);

		protected abstract void GenerateNestedTemplateParameter(NestedTemplateParameter parameter);

		public virtual bool GenerateTemplateParameter(TemplateParameter parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (parameter.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.ClassTemplateParameter:
				GenerateClassTemplateParameter(parameter as ClassTemplateParameter);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.NamedTemplateParameter:
				GenerateNamedTemplateParameter(parameter as NamedTemplateParameter);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.NestedTemplateParameter:
				GenerateNestedTemplateParameter(parameter as NestedTemplateParameter);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				GenerateTemplateParameter(languageElement as TemplateParameter);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool GenerateTypeDeclaration(TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration)
		{
			if (typeDeclaration == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (typeDeclaration.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Module:
				GenerateModuleDeclaration(typeDeclaration as Module);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Class:
				GenerateClassDeclaration(typeDeclaration as Class);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Struct:
				GenerateStructDeclaration(typeDeclaration as Struct);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ManagedClass:
				GenerateManagedClassDeclaration(typeDeclaration as ManagedClass);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ManagedStruct:
				GenerateManagedStructDeclaration(typeDeclaration as ManagedStruct);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ValueClass:
				GenerateValueClassDeclaration(typeDeclaration as ValueClass);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ValueStruct:
				GenerateValueStructDeclaration(typeDeclaration as ValueStruct);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Interface:
				GenerateInterfaceDeclaration(typeDeclaration as Interface);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.InterfaceClass:
				GenerateInterfaceClassDeclaration(typeDeclaration as InterfaceClass);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.InterfaceStruct:
				GenerateInterfaceStructDeclaration(typeDeclaration as InterfaceStruct);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Enum:
				GenerateEnumDeclaration(typeDeclaration as Enumeration);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Union:
				GenerateUnionDeclaration(typeDeclaration as Union);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateMembers(NodeList nodeList)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(nodeList, string.Empty, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: true);
		}

		protected abstract void GenerateModuleDeclaration(Module type);

		protected abstract void GenerateClassDeclaration(Class type);

		protected abstract void GenerateStructDeclaration(Struct type);

		protected abstract void GenerateManagedClassDeclaration(ManagedClass type);

		protected abstract void GenerateManagedStructDeclaration(ManagedStruct type);

		protected abstract void GenerateInterfaceClassDeclaration(InterfaceClass type);

		protected abstract void GenerateInterfaceStructDeclaration(InterfaceStruct type);

		protected abstract void GenerateValueClassDeclaration(ValueClass type);

		protected abstract void GenerateValueStructDeclaration(ValueStruct type);

		protected abstract void GenerateInterfaceDeclaration(Interface type);

		protected abstract void GenerateEnumDeclaration(Enumeration type);

		protected abstract void GenerateUnionDeclaration(Union type);

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				GenerateTypeDeclaration(languageElement as TypeDeclaration);
			}
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is TypeDeclaration))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement nextSibling = element.NextSibling;
			if (nextSibling == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Options.BlankLines.AfterTypeDeclarations)
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLine(2);
			}
			else
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public abstract class XmlCodeGenBase : LanguageElementCodeGenBase
	{
		private XmlNode _LastGeneratedNode;

		public XmlCodeGenBase(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
			_LastGeneratedNode = null;
		}

		private void GenerateReference(XmlReference xmlReference)
		{
			if (xmlReference != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write("&{0};", xmlReference.Name);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateBaseXmlNode(BaseXmlNode baseXmlNode)
		{
			if (baseXmlNode != null)
			{
				XmlNodeType xmlNodeType = baseXmlNode.XmlNodeType;
				if (xmlNodeType == XmlNodeType.Reference)
				{
					GenerateReference(baseXmlNode as XmlReference);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateQuote()
		{
			base.Code.Write("\"");
		}

		protected abstract void GenerateXmlPrefix();

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlDocComment(XmlDocComment xmlComment)
		{
			_LastGeneratedNode = null;
			if (xmlComment != null)
			{
				if (xmlComment.NodeCount == 0)
				{
					GenerateEmptyComment(xmlComment);
					return;
				}
				StartXmlCommentLine(xmlComment);
				GenerateXmlNodes(xmlComment.Nodes);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void StartXmlCommentLine(XmlDocComment xmlComment)
		{
			if (xmlComment != null)
			{
				base.Code.Indent();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateEmptyComment(XmlDocComment xmlComment)
		{
			if (xmlComment != null && xmlComment.Name != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write(xmlComment.Name);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlNodes(NodeList xmlNodes)
		{
			if (xmlNodes == null || xmlNodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < xmlNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (xmlNodes[i] is XmlNode xmlNode)
				{
					GenerateXmlNode(xmlNode);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlNode(XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (xmlNode.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.XmlDocElement:
				if (xmlNode is BaseXmlNode)
				{
					GenerateBaseXmlNode(xmlNode as BaseXmlNode);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateXmlDocElement(xmlNode as XmlElement);
				}
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.XmlDocText:
				GenerateXmlDocText(xmlNode as XmlText);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlDocElement(XmlElement xmlDocElement)
		{
			if (xmlDocElement != null)
			{
				GenerateXmlElementOpenTag(xmlDocElement);
				GenerateXmlNodes(xmlDocElement.Nodes);
				GenerateXmlElementCloseTag(xmlDocElement);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlDocText(XmlText xmlDocText)
		{
			if (xmlDocText == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = xmlDocText.Text;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && xmlDocText.Parent is XmlDocComment)
			{
				text = text.TrimStart(' ', '\r', '\n');
			}
			string[] array = StringHelper.SplitLines(text);
			bool flag = StringHelper.EndsWithLineTerminator(text);
			string empty = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i == 0 && !(xmlDocText.Parent is XmlDocComment))
				{
					base.Code.Write(array[i]);
					continue;
				}
				empty = " " + array[i].TrimStart();
				base.Code.WriteLine();
				GenerateXmlPrefix();
				base.Code.Write(empty);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
				GenerateXmlPrefix();
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			_LastGeneratedNode = xmlDocText;
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlElementOpenTag(XmlElement xmlDocElement)
		{
			if (xmlDocElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_LastGeneratedNode == null || _LastGeneratedNode.ElementType != LanguageElementType.XmlDocText)
			{
				if (_LastGeneratedNode != null)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
				GenerateXmlPrefix();
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			base.Code.Write("<");
			base.Code.Write(xmlDocElement.Name);
			if (xmlDocElement.XmlAttributes != null && xmlDocElement.XmlAttributes.Count > 0)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
			}
			GenerateXmlAttributesList(xmlDocElement.XmlAttributes);
			base.Code.Write(">");
			_LastGeneratedNode = xmlDocElement;
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlElementCloseTag(XmlElement xmlDocElement)
		{
			if (xmlDocElement != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write("<");
				base.Code.Write("/");
				base.Code.Write(xmlDocElement.Name);
				base.Code.Write(">");
				_LastGeneratedNode = xmlDocElement;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlAttributesList(NodeList xmlAttributes)
		{
			if (xmlAttributes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < xmlAttributes.Count; i++)
			{
				GenerateXmlAttribute(xmlAttributes[i] as XmlAttribute);
				if (i < xmlAttributes.Count - 1)
				{
					base.Code.Write(", ");
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlAttribute(XmlAttribute xmlAttribute)
		{
			if (xmlAttribute != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write(xmlAttribute.Name);
				base.Code.Write("=");
				GenerateQuote();
				base.Code.Write(xmlAttribute.Value);
				GenerateQuote();
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsXmlGenElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return element is XmlDocComment;
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (element is XmlDocComment)
				{
					GenerateXmlDocComment(element as XmlDocComment);
				}
				else if (element is XmlElement && element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.XmlDocElement)
				{
					GenerateXmlDocElement(element as XmlElement);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class FriendAssemblies
	{
		private const string STR_NameSeparator = ",";

		private ArrayList _FriendAssebliesNames;

		private IElementCollection _UnresolvedExpressions;

		public int Count
		{
			get
			{
				int count = _FriendAssebliesNames.Count;
				int count2 = _UnresolvedExpressions.Count;
				return Math.Max(count, count2);
			}
		}

		public string[] FriendAssembliesNames => (string[])_FriendAssebliesNames.ToArray(typeof(string));

		public IElementCollection UnresolvedExpressions => _UnresolvedExpressions;

		public FriendAssemblies()
		{
			_FriendAssebliesNames = new ArrayList();
			_UnresolvedExpressions = new IElementCollection();
		}

		private void CorrectAssemblyName(ref string friendAssembly)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(friendAssembly) && friendAssembly.Contains(","))
			{
				string[] array = friendAssembly.Split(new string[1] { "," }, StringSplitOptions.None);
				friendAssembly = array[0];
			}
		}

		public void Add(string friendAssembly)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(friendAssembly))
			{
				CorrectAssemblyName(ref friendAssembly);
				if (!_FriendAssebliesNames.Contains(friendAssembly))
				{
					_FriendAssebliesNames.Add(friendAssembly);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddUnresolved(IExpression friendAssemblyExpression)
		{
			if (!_UnresolvedExpressions.Contains(friendAssemblyExpression))
			{
				_UnresolvedExpressions.Add(friendAssemblyExpression);
			}
		}
	}
	public class HybridObjectStorage
	{
		private const int INT_MaxItemsCount = 10000;

		private Hashtable _CaseSensitiveHash;

		private Hashtable _CaseInsensitiveHash;

		private bool _LimitSize;

		private Hashtable CaseSensitiveHash
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CaseSensitiveHash == null)
				{
					_CaseSensitiveHash = new Hashtable();
				}
				return _CaseSensitiveHash;
			}
		}

		private Hashtable CaseInsensitiveHash
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CaseInsensitiveHash == null)
				{
					_CaseInsensitiveHash = HashtableUtils.CreateHashtable(caseSensitive: false);
				}
				return _CaseInsensitiveHash;
			}
		}

		internal bool LimitSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _LimitSize;
			}
			set
			{
				_LimitSize = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual ICollection Keys => CaseSensitiveHash.Keys;

		public virtual ICollection Values => CaseSensitiveHash.Values;

		public virtual int Count => CaseSensitiveHash.Count;

		public virtual object this[object key]
		{
			get
			{
				return Get(key);
			}
			set
			{
				CaseSensitiveHash[key] = value;
				CaseInsensitiveHash[key] = value;
			}
		}

		private void AddItemInternal(Hashtable table, object key, object value)
		{
			if (table != null)
			{
				if (_LimitSize && table.Count > 10000)
				{
					table.Clear();
				}
				table.Add(key, value);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<object> GetValues()
		{
			ICollection values = CaseSensitiveHash.Values;
			foreach (object item in values)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Add(object key, object value)
		{
			AddItemInternal(CaseSensitiveHash, key, value);
			object obj = CaseInsensitiveHash[key];
			if (obj == null)
			{
				AddItemInternal(CaseInsensitiveHash, key, value);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Remove(object key)
		{
			CaseSensitiveHash.Remove(key);
			CaseInsensitiveHash.Remove(key);
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			CaseSensitiveHash.Clear();
			CaseInsensitiveHash.Clear();
		}

		public object Get(object key)
		{
			return Get(key, ignoreCase: false);
		}

		public object Get(object key, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			if (ignoreCase)
			{
				return CaseInsensitiveHash[key];
			}
			return CaseSensitiveHash[key];
		}

		public virtual bool Contains(object key)
		{
			return Contains(key, ignoreCase: false);
		}

		public bool Contains(object key, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			if (ignoreCase)
			{
				return CaseInsensitiveHash.ContainsKey(key);
			}
			return CaseSensitiveHash.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		public virtual bool ContainsKey(object key)
		{
			return Contains(key);
		}

		public virtual bool ContainsValue(object value)
		{
			return CaseSensitiveHash.ContainsValue(value);
		}

		public virtual IDictionaryEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return CaseSensitiveHash.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public string[] GetAllNames(bool caseSensitive)
		{
			ICollection collection = null;
			collection = ((!caseSensitive) ? CaseInsensitiveHash.Keys : CaseSensitiveHash.Keys);
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = collection.Count;
			string[] array = new string[count];
			int num = 0;
			IEnumerator enumerator = collection.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (enumerator.Current is string text)
				{
					array[num] = text;
					num++;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public Hashtable GetCaseSensitiveHash()
		{
			return CaseSensitiveHash;
		}

		public Hashtable GetCaseInsensitiveHash()
		{
			return CaseInsensitiveHash;
		}

		public Hashtable GetHashTable(bool isCaseSensitive)
		{
			if (isCaseSensitive)
			{
				return GetCaseSensitiveHash();
			}
			return GetCaseInsensitiveHash();
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	public class IElementCollection : NodeList, IEnumerable<IElement>, IEnumerable, ISerializableCollection, IList, ICollection
	{
		private class IElementCollectionEnumerator : IEnumerator<IElement>, IDisposable, IEnumerator
		{
			private IEnumerator _Enumerator;

			object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

			public IElement Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (_Enumerator == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return _Enumerator.Current as IElement;
				}
			}

			public IElementCollectionEnumerator(IEnumerator enumerator)
			{
				_Enumerator = enumerator;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				_Enumerator = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (_Enumerator == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return _Enumerator.MoveNext();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				if (_Enumerator != null)
				{
					_Enumerator.Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		public new static readonly IElementCollection Empty = new EmptyIElementCollection();

		public new IElement this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base[index] as IElement;
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public CollectionType CollectionType => CollectionType.IElementCollection;

		public IElementCollection()
			: this(1)
		{
		}

		public IElementCollection(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		IEnumerator<IElement> IEnumerable<IElement>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			return new IElementCollectionEnumerator(enumerator);
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new IElementCollection();
		}

		public virtual int Add(IElement element)
		{
			return base.Add(element);
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<IElement> elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IElement element in elements)
			{
				Add(element);
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(IElement element)
		{
			return IndexOf((object)element);
		}

		public virtual void Insert(int index, IElement element)
		{
			base.Insert(index, element);
		}

		public virtual void Remove(IElement element)
		{
			base.Remove(element);
		}

		public IElement Find(IElement element)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(element);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return this[num];
		}

		public bool Contains(IElement element)
		{
			return Find(element) != null;
		}

		public IElement FindElementByFullName(string fullName, bool caseSensitive)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.FindElementByFullName(this, fullName, caseSensitive);
		}

		public new IElementCollection DeepClone()
		{
			return base.DeepClone(ElementCloneOptions.Default) as IElementCollection;
		}

		public new IElementCollection DeepClone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			return base.DeepClone(options) as IElementCollection;
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection ToLanguageElementCollection()
		{
			return LanguageElementRestorer.ConvertToLanguageElements(this);
		}

		public static int IndexOf(IElement[] elements, IElement element)
		{
			int num = elements.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				IElement element2 = elements[i];
				if (element2 == element)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public IEnumerable<IElement> GetEnumerable()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return (IElement)enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public SourceRange GetRange()
		{
			return GetRange(this);
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange result = element.FirstRange;
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = element.FirstNameRange;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(IEnumerable<IElement> elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			foreach (IElement element in elements)
			{
				sourceRange = SourceRange.Union(sourceRange, GetRange(element));
			}
			return sourceRange;
		}
	}

	internal class LinkedList : IEnumerable, ICollection, IList
	{
		private class Node
		{
			public Node Next;

			public Node Prior;

			public object Data;
		}

		private class NodeCache
		{
			private Node[] m_Stack;

			private int m_StackIndex = -1;

			public NodeCache()
			{
				m_Stack = new Node[16];
			}

			private void GrowStack()
			{
				int num = m_Stack.Length;
				Node[] array = new Node[num * 2];
				Array.Copy(m_Stack, 0, array, 0, num);
				m_Stack = array;
			}

			public Node Alloc()
			{
				Node result;
				if (m_StackIndex >= 0)
				{
					result = m_Stack[m_StackIndex];
					m_StackIndex--;
				}
				else
				{
					result = new Node();
				}
				return result;
			}

			public void Free(Node node)
			{
				node.Data = null;
				node.Next = null;
				node.Prior = null;
				m_StackIndex++;
				if (m_StackIndex == m_Stack.Length)
				{
					GrowStack();
				}
				m_Stack[m_StackIndex] = node;
			}
		}

		private class LinkedListEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private LinkedList m_LinkedList;

			public object Current => m_LinkedList.Current;

			public LinkedListEnumerator(LinkedList linkedList)
			{
				if (linkedList == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("linkedList");
				}
				m_LinkedList = linkedList;
				Reset();
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				m_LinkedList.MoveNext();
				return !m_LinkedList.IsAfterLast;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				m_LinkedList.MoveBeforeFirst();
			}
		}

		private int m_Count;

		private Node m_Cursor;

		private int m_CursorIndex;

		private Node m_Head;

		private Node m_Tail;

		private NodeCache m_NodeCache;

		private object m_SyncRoot;

		public int Count => m_Count;

		public object Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (m_Cursor == m_Head)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot get current item because the cursor is positioned before the first item.");
				}
				if (m_Cursor == m_Tail)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot get current item because the cursor is positioned after the last item.");
				}
				return m_Cursor.Data;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAfterLast => m_Cursor == m_Tail;

		public bool IsBeforeFirst => m_Cursor == m_Head;

		public object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				PositionAtIndex(index);
				return m_Cursor.Data;
			}
			set
			{
				PositionAtIndex(index);
				m_Cursor.Data = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSynchronized => false;

		public object SyncRoot
		{
			get
			{
				if (m_SyncRoot == null)
				{
					Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref m_SyncRoot, new object(), null);
				}
				return m_SyncRoot;
			}
		}

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public LinkedList()
		{
			m_Head = AllocNode();
			m_Tail = AllocNode();
			m_Head.Next = m_Tail;
			m_Tail.Prior = m_Head;
			MoveBeforeFirst();
		}

		private Node AllocNode()
		{
			if (m_NodeCache == null)
			{
				m_NodeCache = new NodeCache();
			}
			return m_NodeCache.Alloc();
		}

		private Node AllocNode(object value)
		{
			Node node = AllocNode();
			node.Data = value;
			return node;
		}

		private void FreeNode(Node node)
		{
			if (m_NodeCache == null)
			{
				m_NodeCache = new NodeCache();
			}
			m_NodeCache.Free(node);
		}

		private void PositionAtIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > m_Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, "Index is out of range.");
			}
			Node node = m_Cursor;
			int i = m_CursorIndex;
			if (index == i)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (index < i)
			{
				if (index < i - index)
				{
					node = m_Head;
					i = -1;
				}
			}
			else if (index - i > m_Count - index)
			{
				node = m_Tail;
				i = m_Count;
			}
			for (; i < index; i++)
			{
				node = node.Next;
			}
			while (i > index)
			{
				node = node.Prior;
				i--;
			}
			m_Cursor = node;
			m_CursorIndex = i;
		}

		public int Add(object value)
		{
			MoveAfterLast();
			int count = m_Count;
			InsertAtCursor(value);
			return count;
		}

		public void AddRange(ICollection range)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("range");
			}
			foreach (object item in range)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (Node next = m_Head.Next; next != m_Tail; next = m_Head.Next)
			{
				m_Head.Next = next.Next;
				FreeNode(next);
			}
			m_Tail.Prior = m_Head;
			m_Count = 0;
			m_Cursor = m_Head;
			m_CursorIndex = -1;
		}

		public bool Contains(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf(value) != -1;
		}

		public void DeleteAtCursor()
		{
			Node cursor = m_Cursor;
			if (cursor == m_Head)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot delete at cursor because it is positioned before the first item.");
			}
			if (cursor == m_Tail)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot delete at cursor because it is positioned after the last item.");
			}
			cursor.Prior.Next = cursor.Next;
			cursor.Next.Prior = cursor.Prior;
			m_Cursor = cursor.Next;
			m_Count--;
			FreeNode(cursor);
		}

		public object First()
		{
			PositionAtIndex(0);
			return m_Cursor.Data;
		}

		public int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			Node next = m_Head.Next;
			int num = 0;
			while (next != m_Tail)
			{
				if (next.Data == value)
				{
					m_Cursor = next;
					m_CursorIndex = num;
					return num;
				}
				next = next.Next;
				num++;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			PositionAtIndex(index);
			InsertAtCursor(value);
		}

		public void InsertAtCursor(object value)
		{
			if (m_Cursor == m_Head)
			{
				MoveNext();
			}
			if (m_Cursor == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Node node = AllocNode(value);
			if (node != null)
			{
				node.Next = m_Cursor;
				node.Prior = m_Cursor.Prior;
				if (node.Prior != null)
				{
					node.Prior.Next = node;
				}
				m_Cursor.Prior = node;
				m_Cursor = node;
				m_Count++;
			}
		}

		public object Last()
		{
			PositionAtIndex(m_Count - 1);
			return m_Cursor.Data;
		}

		public void MoveAfterLast()
		{
			m_Cursor = m_Tail;
			m_CursorIndex = m_Count;
		}

		public void MoveBeforeFirst()
		{
			m_Cursor = m_Head;
			m_CursorIndex = -1;
		}

		public void MoveNext()
		{
			if (m_Cursor != m_Tail)
			{
				m_Cursor = m_Cursor.Next;
				m_CursorIndex++;
			}
		}

		public void MovePrior()
		{
			if (m_Cursor != m_Head)
			{
				m_Cursor = m_Cursor.Prior;
				m_CursorIndex--;
			}
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			if (IndexOf(value) != -1)
			{
				DeleteAtCursor();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			PositionAtIndex(index);
			DeleteAtCursor();
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new LinkedListEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("array");
			}
			if (array.Rank != 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Array is multi-dimensional.", "array");
			}
			if (index < 0 || index >= array.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, "Index is out of range.");
			}
			if (m_Count > array.Length - index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The number of items in this list is greater than the available space in the destination array.");
			}
			MoveBeforeFirst();
			for (int i = 0; i < m_Count; i++)
			{
				MoveNext();
				array.SetValue(m_Cursor.Data, index + i);
			}
		}
	}

	public interface IMemberElementCollection : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		IMemberElement this[int index] { get; }

		int IndexOf(IMemberElement m);

		IEnumerable<IElement> GetEnumerable();
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class LiteMemberElementCollection : NodeList, IMemberElementCollection, ICollection, IEnumerable, ISerializableCollection, IList
	{
		public CollectionType CollectionType => CollectionType.MemberElementCollection;

		IMemberElement IMemberElementCollection.this[int index] => this[index] as IMemberElement;

		public LiteMemberElementCollection()
			: this(1)
		{
		}

		public LiteMemberElementCollection(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LiteMemberElementCollection();
		}

		IEnumerable<IElement> IMemberElementCollection.GetEnumerable()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return (IElement)enumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		int IMemberElementCollection.IndexOf(IMemberElement m)
		{
			return IndexOf(m);
		}
	}

	public interface ISourceFileCollection : ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		ISourceFile this[int index] { get; }

		int IndexOf(ISourceFile f);

		int IndexOf(string fileName);
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class LiteSourceFileCollection : NodeList, ISourceFileCollection, ICollection, IEnumerable, ISerializableCollection, IList
	{
		public CollectionType CollectionType => CollectionType.SourceFileCollection;

		ISourceFile ISourceFileCollection.this[int index] => this[index] as ISourceFile;

		public LiteSourceFileCollection()
			: this(1)
		{
		}

		public LiteSourceFileCollection(int capacity)
			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LiteSourceFileCollection();
		}

		int ISourceFileCollection.IndexOf(ISourceFile f)
		{
			return IndexOf(f);
		}

		int ISourceFileCollection.IndexOf(string fileName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(this[i] is ISourceFile sourceFile))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (string.Compare(sourceFile.Name, fileName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

			: this(1)
		{
		}

			: base(capacity)
		{
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LiteXmlAttributeDeclarationCollection();
		}

		int IXmlAttributeDeclarationCollection.IndexOf(IXmlAttributeDeclaration e)
		{
			return IndexOf(e);
		}

	[Serializable]
	[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)]
	public class NodeList : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class NodeListEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private NodeList _List;

			private int _Index;

			public object Current => _List[_Index];

			public NodeListEnumerator(NodeList list)
			{
				_List = list;
				_Index = -1;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_Index = -1;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				_Index++;
				if (_Index >= _List._Size)
				{
					_Index = _List._Size;
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[FieldOffset(0)]
		private int _Size;

		[FieldOffset(8)]
		private object _Object;

		[FieldOffset(8)]
		[NonSerialized]
		private object[] _Items;

		public static readonly NodeList Empty = new EmptyNodeList();

		private bool IsSingleValue => _Size == 1;

		public virtual bool IsReadOnly => false;

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public bool IsSynchronized => false;

		public int Count => _Size;

		public virtual object this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= _Size)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
				}
				if (_Size == 1 && index == 0)
				{
					return _Object;
				}
				return _Items[index];
			}
			set
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= _Size)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
				}
				if (_Size == 1 && index == 0)
				{
					_Object = value;
				}
				else
				{
					_Items[index] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public object SyncRoot => this;

		public NodeList()
			: this(1)
		{
		}

		public NodeList(int capacity)
		{
			if (capacity > 1)
			{
				_Items = new object[capacity];
			}
		}

		private void EnsureCapacity(int capacity)
		{
			object[] array = new object[capacity * 2];
			Array.Copy(_Items, 0, array, 0, _Size);
			_Items = array;
		}

		private void EnsureCapacity(int capacity, int count)
		{
			capacity = ((capacity * 2 > capacity + count) ? (capacity * 2) : (capacity * 2 + count));
			EnsureCapacity(capacity);
		}

		protected virtual NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new NodeList();
		}

		protected virtual void CloneElements(NodeList targetList, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (targetList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(this[i] is ICloneable cloneable))
				{
					throw new Exception("Object must implement ICloneable.");
				}
				if (cloneable is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					BaseElement baseElement = languageElement.Clone(options);
					if (baseElement != null)
					{
						targetList.Add(baseElement);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					object obj = cloneable.Clone();
					if (obj != null)
					{
						targetList.Add(obj);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual int Add(object value)
		{
			Insert(_Size, value);
			return _Size;
		}

		public virtual void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= _Size)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (index == 0 && IsSingleValue)
			{
				_Object = null;
				_Size--;
				return;
			}
			_Size--;
			if (_Size == 1)
			{
				_Object = _Items[(index == 0) ? 1u : 0u];
				return;
			}
			if (index < _Size)
			{
				Array.Copy(_Items, index + 1, _Items, index, _Size - index);
			}
			_Items[_Size] = null;
		}

		public virtual void RemoveFrom(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= _Size)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (index == 0 && IsSingleValue)
			{
				_Object = null;
				_Size--;
			}
			else if (index == 1)
			{
				_Object = _Items[0];
				_Size = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Clear(_Items, index, _Size - index);
				_Size = index;
			}
		}

		public virtual void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (index < 0 || index > _Size)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (_Size == 0)
			{
				_Size++;
				_Object = value;
				return;
			}
			if (_Size == 1)
			{
				object obj = _Object;
				_Items = new object[2];
				_Items[(index == 0) ? 1u : 0u] = obj;
				_Items[index] = value;
			}
			else
			{
				if (_Size == _Items.Length)
				{
					EnsureCapacity(_Size + 1);
				}
				if (index < _Size)
				{
					Array.Copy(_Items, index, _Items, index + 1, _Size - index);
				}
				_Items[index] = value;
			}
			_Size++;
		}

		public virtual void InsertRange(int index, IList value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			if (index < 0 || index > _Size)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			int count = value.Count;
			if (value.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (count == 1)
			{
				Insert(index, value[0]);
				return;
			}
			if (_Size == 0)
			{
				_Items = new object[count + 1];
			}
			else
			{
				if (_Size == 1)
				{
					object obj = _Object;
					_Items = new object[1];
					_Items[0] = obj;
				}
				if (_Items != null || _Size < _Items.Length + count)
				{
					EnsureCapacity(_Size + 1, count);
				}
				if (index < _Size)
				{
					Array.Copy(_Items, index, _Items, index + count, _Size - index);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				_Items[index + i] = value[i];
			}
			_Size += count;
		}

		public virtual void Remove(object value)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(value);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(object value)
		{
			return IndexOf(value) >= 0;
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			try
			{
				if (_Size != 0)
				{
					if (_Size == 1)
					{
						_Object = null;
					}
					else
					{
						Array.Clear(_Items, 0, _Size);
					}
					_Size = 0;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				OnClear();
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_Size == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_Size == 1)
			{
				if (!value.Equals(_Object))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return Array.IndexOf(_Items, value);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			if (array == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("array");
			}
			if (array.Rank != 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("array rank is not equal to 1");
			}
			if (_Size != 0)
			{
				if (_Size == 1)
				{
					array.SetValue(_Object, index);
				}
				else
				{
					Array.Copy(_Items, 0, array, index, _Size);
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new NodeListEnumerator(this);
		}

		public static void VisitNodeList(NodeList list, IElementVisitor visitor)
		{
			list?.VisitNodeList(visitor);
		}

		public void VisitNodeList(IElementVisitor visitor)
		{
			if (visitor != null)
			{
				int count = Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					visitor.Visit(this[i] as IElement);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void AddRange(ICollection range)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in range)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void Sort(IComparer comparer)
		{
			Sort(0, _Size, comparer);
		}

		public void Sort(int index, int length, IComparer comparer)
		{
			if (_Size > 1)
			{
				Array.Sort(_Items, index, length, comparer);
			}
		}

		public object[] ToArray()
		{
			object[] array = new object[_Size];
			if (_Size == 1)
			{
				array[0] = _Object;
			}
			else if (_Size > 1)
			{
				Array.Copy(_Items, array, _Size);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public Array ToArray(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("type");
			}
			Array array = Array.CreateInstance(type, _Size);
			if (_Size == 1)
			{
				array.SetValue(_Object, 0);
			}
			else if (_Size > 1)
			{
				Array.Copy(_Items, array, _Size);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public void IncreaseNodesIndices(int startFrom)
		{
			if (_Size < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			if (_Size == 1)
			{
				if (startFrom <= 0 && _Object is LanguageElement languageElement2)
				{
					languageElement2.SetIndex(languageElement2.Index + 1);
				}
				return;
			}
			object[] items = _Items;
			int size = _Size;
			for (int i = startFrom; i < size; i++)
			{
				languageElement = items[i] as LanguageElement;
				languageElement.SetIndex(languageElement.Index + 1);
			}
		}

		public int BinarySearch(int index, object value, IComparer comparer)
		{
			return BinarySearch(index, Count - index, value, comparer);
		}

		public int BinarySearch(int index, int length, object value, IComparer comparer)
		{
			if (_Size == 0)
			{
				return ~index;
			}
			if (_Size > 1)
			{
				return Array.BinarySearch(_Items, index, length, value, comparer);
			}
			int num = comparer.Compare(_Object, value);
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return -2;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public static ArrayList ToArrayList(NodeList list)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			arrayList.AddRange(list);
			return arrayList;
		}

		public ArrayList ToArrayList()
		{
			return ToArrayList(this);
		}

		public virtual void Replace(object oldObject, object newObject)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(oldObject);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
				if (newObject != null)
				{
					Insert(num, newObject);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual NodeList DeepClone()
		{
			return DeepClone(ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		public virtual NodeList DeepClone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			NodeList nodeList = CreateInstance();
			CloneElements(nodeList, options);
			return nodeList;
		}

		protected virtual void OnClear()
		{
		}
	}
