	internal class TextPointWrapper
	{
		public TextPoint Point;
	}
	public class DocumentHistorySlice
	{
		private ArrayList _RangeTransforms;

		private TextPointWrapper pointWrapper = new TextPointWrapper();

		public DocumentHistorySlice()
		{
			_RangeTransforms = new ArrayList();
			TextRange range = new TextRange(1, 1, 1073741823, 16383);
			RangeTransform transform = new RangeTransform(range, 0, 0);
			AddTransform(transform);
		}

		private int Find(RangeTransform transform)
		{
			return _RangeTransforms.BinarySearch(transform, RangeTransform.RangeComparer);
		}

		private int FindTransformed(TextPoint point)
		{
			pointWrapper.Point = point;
			return _RangeTransforms.BinarySearch(pointWrapper, RangeTransform.TransformedPointComparer);
		}

		private int FindOriginal(TextPoint point)
		{
			pointWrapper.Point = point;
			return _RangeTransforms.BinarySearch(pointWrapper, RangeTransform.OriginalPointComparer);
		}

		private void AddTransform(RangeTransform transform)
		{
			int num = Find(transform);
			_RangeTransforms.Insert(~num, transform);
		}

		private void RemoveTransform(int i)
		{
			_RangeTransforms.RemoveAt(i);
		}

		private void GetLineOffset(ref int line, ref int offset)
		{
			if (line != 0 || offset != 0)
			{
				int num = FindOriginal(new TextPoint(line, offset));
				if (num < 0)
				{
					line = -1;
					offset = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					RangeTransform rangeTransform = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[num];
					rangeTransform.Apply(ref line, ref offset);
				}
			}
		}

		private RangeTransform FindContainingTransform(TextPoint point)
		{
			int num = FindTransformed(point);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RangeTransform rangeTransform = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[num];
			if (rangeTransform.IsStart(point))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rangeTransform;
		}

		private void RemoveTransforms(TextRange range)
		{
			int num = FindTransformed(range.Start);
			num = ((num >= 0) ? (num + 1) : (~num));
			int num2 = FindTransformed(range.End);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = ~num2;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num;
			if (num3 > 0)
			{
				_RangeTransforms.RemoveRange(num, num3);
			}
		}

		private void ShiftTrailingTransforms(TextRange range, bool shiftUp)
		{
			int count = _RangeTransforms.Count;
			int num = FindTransformed(range.Start);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			int line = (shiftUp ? range.Start.Line : range.End.Line);
			int lineTransform = (shiftUp ? (-range.LineCountMinusOne) : range.LineCountMinusOne);
			int offsetTransform = (shiftUp ? (range.Start.Offset - range.End.Offset) : (range.End.Offset - range.Start.Offset));
			for (int i = num; i < count; i++)
			{
				RangeTransform rangeTransform = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[i];
				rangeTransform.Shift(line, lineTransform, offsetTransform);
			}
		}

		private void TransformDeletedPoint(ref int line, ref int offset)
		{
			TextPoint point = new TextPoint(line, offset);
			int num = FindOriginal(point);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				num--;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				line = 0;
				offset = 0;
				return;
			}
			RangeTransform rangeTransform = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[num];
			line = rangeTransform.EndLine;
			offset = rangeTransform.EndOffset;
			rangeTransform.Apply(ref line, ref offset);
		}

		private bool WasDeleted(TextPoint point)
		{
			if (point.Line == -1)
			{
				return point.Offset == -1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private TextRange TransformRangeWithRecover(TextPoint start, TextPoint end)
		{
			TextPoint textPoint = TransformStart(start);
			if (start == end)
			{
				return new TextRange(textPoint, textPoint);
			}
			TextPoint textPoint2 = TransformStart(start);
			TextPoint textPoint3 = TransformEnd(end);
			if (WasDeleted(textPoint2) && WasDeleted(textPoint3))
			{
				return TextRange.Empty;
			}
			if (WasDeleted(textPoint2))
			{
				int line = start.Line;
				int offset = start.Offset;
				TransformDeletedPoint(ref line, ref offset);
				textPoint2 = new TextPoint(line, offset++);
			}
			if (WasDeleted(textPoint3))
			{
				int line = end.Line;
				int offset = end.Offset - 1;
				TransformDeletedPoint(ref line, ref offset);
				textPoint3 = new TextPoint(line, offset);
			}
			if (WasDeleted(textPoint2))
			{
				textPoint2 = TextPoint.Empty;
			}
			if (WasDeleted(textPoint3))
			{
				textPoint3 = TextPoint.Empty;
			}
			return new TextRange(textPoint2, textPoint3);
		}

		public void Insert(TextRange range)
		{
			if (range.IsEmpty || range.IsPoint)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				RangeTransform rangeTransform = FindContainingTransform(range.Start);
				if (rangeTransform != null)
				{
					AddTransform(rangeTransform.Insert(range));
				}
				ShiftTrailingTransforms(range, shiftUp: false);
			}
		}

		public void Delete(TextRange range)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				if (!range.IsEmpty && !range.IsPoint)
				{
					RangeTransform rangeTransform = FindContainingTransform(range.Start);
					RangeTransform rangeTransform2 = FindContainingTransform(range.End);
					if (rangeTransform != null && rangeTransform == rangeTransform2)
					{
						AddTransform(rangeTransform.Delete(range));
					}
					else
					{
						rangeTransform?.TrimEnd(range.Start);
						rangeTransform2?.TrimStart(range.End);
						RemoveTransforms(range);
					}
					ShiftTrailingTransforms(range, shiftUp: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public TextPoint TransformStart(TextPoint point)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				int line = point.Line;
				int offset = point.Offset;
				GetPoint(ref line, ref offset);
				return new TextPoint(line, offset);
			}
		}

		public TextPoint TransformEnd(TextPoint point)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				int line = point.Line;
				int offset = point.Offset;
				bool flag = false;
				if (offset != 1)
				{
					offset--;
					flag = true;
				}
				GetPoint(ref line, ref offset);
				if (offset != -1 && flag)
				{
					offset++;
				}
				return new TextPoint(line, offset);
			}
		}

		public TextRange Transform(TextRange range)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				TextPoint textPoint = TransformStart(range.Start);
				if (range.IsPoint)
				{
					return new TextRange(textPoint, textPoint);
				}
				return new TextRange(textPoint, TransformEnd(range.End));
			}
		}

		public TextRange TransformWithRecover(TextRange range)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				return TransformRangeWithRecover(range.Start, range.End);
			}
		}

		public void GetPoint(ref int line, ref int offset)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				GetLineOffset(ref line, ref offset);
			}
		}

		public int GetLine(int line, int offset)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				GetLineOffset(ref line, ref offset);
				return line;
			}
		}

		public int GetOffset(int line, int offset)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				GetLineOffset(ref line, ref offset);
				return offset;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDeletion(RangeTransform start, RangeTransform end)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				int num = start?.EndLine ?? 1;
				int num2 = start?.EndOffset ?? 1;
				return num != end.StartLine || num2 != end.StartOffset;
			}
		}

		private bool IsInsertion(RangeTransform start, RangeTransform end)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				return !IsDeletion(start, end);
			}
		}

		private static TextRange GetEditOperationRange(RangeTransform prev, RangeTransform next)
		{
			int line = 1;
			int offset = 1;
			if (prev == null && next.StartLine == 1 && next.StartOffset == 1 && !next.HasTransformValue)
			{
				return TextRange.Empty;
			}
			if (prev != null)
			{
				line = prev.EndLine;
				offset = prev.EndOffset;
				prev.Apply(ref line, ref offset);
			}
			int line2 = next.StartLine;
			int offset2 = next.StartOffset;
			next.Apply(ref line2, ref offset2);
			return new TextRange(line, offset, line2, offset2);
		}

		private TextRange GetInsertionRange(RangeTransform prev, RangeTransform next)
		{
			TextRange editOperationRange = GetEditOperationRange(prev, next);
			if (editOperationRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				return editOperationRange;
			}
			if (IsInsertion(prev, next) || !editOperationRange.IsPoint)
			{
				return editOperationRange;
			}
			return TextRange.Empty;
		}

		private TextRange GetDeletionRange(RangeTransform prev, RangeTransform next)
		{
			if (!IsDeletion(prev, next))
			{
				return TextRange.Empty;
			}
			TextRange editOperationRange = GetEditOperationRange(prev, next);
			if (editOperationRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				return TextRange.Empty;
			}
			if (!editOperationRange.IsPoint)
			{
				editOperationRange.SetEnd(editOperationRange.Start);
			}
			return editOperationRange;
		}

		public TextRange[] GetDeletions()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				List<TextRange> list = new List<TextRange>();
				RangeTransform rangeTransform = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[0];
				TextRange deletionRange = GetDeletionRange(null, rangeTransform);
				if (!deletionRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					list.Add(deletionRange);
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < _RangeTransforms.Count; i++)
				{
					RangeTransform rangeTransform2 = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[i];
					deletionRange = GetDeletionRange(rangeTransform, rangeTransform2);
					if (!deletionRange.IsEmpty)
					{
						list.Add(deletionRange);
					}
					rangeTransform = rangeTransform2;
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		public TextRange[] GetInsertions()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				List<TextRange> list = new List<TextRange>();
				RangeTransform rangeTransform = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[0];
				TextRange insertionRange = GetInsertionRange(null, rangeTransform);
				if (!insertionRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					list.Add(insertionRange);
				}
				for (int i = 1; i < _RangeTransforms.Count; i++)
				{
					RangeTransform rangeTransform2 = (RangeTransform)_RangeTransforms[i];
					insertionRange = GetInsertionRange(rangeTransform, rangeTransform2);
					if (!insertionRange.IsEmpty)
					{
						list.Add(insertionRange);
					}
					rangeTransform = rangeTransform2;
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DocumentHistory
	{
		private class SourceRangeContainer
		{
			public int Index;

			public SourceRange Range;

			public SourceRange NewRange;

			public SourceRangeContainer(int index, SourceRange range, SourceRange newRange)
			{
				Index = index;
				Range = range;
				NewRange = newRange;
			}
		}

		private class SourceRangeContainerComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				SourceRangeContainer sourceRangeContainer = x as SourceRangeContainer;
				SourceRangeContainer sourceRangeContainer2 = y as SourceRangeContainer;
				if (sourceRangeContainer == null && sourceRangeContainer2 == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (sourceRangeContainer == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (sourceRangeContainer2 == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (sourceRangeContainer.Range.Start == sourceRangeContainer2.Range.Start)
				{
					if (sourceRangeContainer.Range.End == sourceRangeContainer2.Range.End)
					{
						int index = sourceRangeContainer.Index;
						int index2 = sourceRangeContainer2.Index;
						if (index == index2)
						{
							return 0;
						}
						if (index < index2)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						return 1;
					}
					if (!(sourceRangeContainer.Range.End < sourceRangeContainer2.Range.End))
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (sourceRangeContainer.Range.Start < sourceRangeContainer2.Range.Start)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		private ArrayList _Slices;

		private int Count => _Slices.Count;

		private DocumentHistorySlice this[int i] => (DocumentHistorySlice)_Slices[i];

		public DocumentHistorySlice Current
		{
			get
			{
				lock (this)
				{
					return this[Count - 1];
				}
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler BeforeClear;

		public event EventHandler AfterClear;

		public DocumentHistory()
		{
			_Slices = new ArrayList();
			CreateCurrent();
		}

		private void CreateCurrent()
		{
			_Slices.Add(new DocumentHistorySlice());
		}

		protected virtual void OnBeforeClear()
		{
			if (this.BeforeClear != null)
			{
				this.BeforeClear(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAfterClear()
		{
			if (this.AfterClear != null)
			{
				this.AfterClear(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public void Insert(TextRange range)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				int count = Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					this[i].Insert(range);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Delete(TextRange range)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				int count = Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					this[i].Delete(range);
				}
			}
		}

		public DocumentHistorySlice Branch()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				DocumentHistorySlice documentHistorySlice = new DocumentHistorySlice();
				_Slices.Add(documentHistorySlice);
				return documentHistorySlice;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				OnBeforeClear();
				_Slices.Clear();
				CreateCurrent();
				OnAfterClear();
			}
		}

		public SourceRange[] UpdateRanges(SourceRange[] ranges, int newLength)
		{
			if (ranges == null || ranges.Length == 0)
			{
				return ranges;
			}
			int[] array = new int[ranges.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = newLength;
			}
			return UpdateRanges(ranges, newLength);
		}

		public SourceRange[] UpdateRanges(SourceRange[] ranges, int[] newLengths)
		{
			if (ranges == null || ranges.Length == 0)
			{
				return ranges;
			}
			SourceRange[] array = new SourceRange[ranges.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < newLengths.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new SourceRange(ranges[i].Start, ranges[i].Start.OffsetPoint(0, newLengths[i]));
			}
			return UpdateRanges(ranges, array);
		}

		public SourceRange[] UpdateRanges(SourceRange[] ranges, SourceRange[] newRanges)
		{
			if (ranges == null || ranges.Length == 0)
			{
				return new SourceRange[0];
			}
			if (newRanges == null || newRanges.Length == 0)
			{
				return ranges;
			}
			if (ranges.Length != newRanges.Length)
			{
				return ranges;
			}
			SourceRange[] array = new SourceRange[ranges.Length];
			ranges.CopyTo(array, 0);
			SourceRangeContainer[] array2 = new SourceRangeContainer[ranges.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = new SourceRangeContainer(i, ranges[i], newRanges[i]);
			}
			Array.Sort(array2, new SourceRangeContainerComparer());
			foreach (SourceRangeContainer sourceRangeContainer in array2)
			{
				SourceRange range = sourceRangeContainer.Range;
				SourceRange newRange = sourceRangeContainer.NewRange;
				DocumentHistorySlice current = Current;
				range = current.Transform(range);
				Delete(range);
				newRange = newRange.ExtractFromDocument(newRange.Start).RestoreToDocument(range.Start);
				Insert(newRange);
				array[sourceRangeContainer.Index] = newRange;
			}
			return array;
		}
	}
	public class FileSourceRange
	{
		private SourceFile _File;

		private SourceRange _Range;

		private object _Data;

		public SourceFile File => _File;

		public SourceRange Range
		{
			get
			{
				return _Range;
			}
			set
			{
				_Range = value;
			}
		}

		public object Data
		{
			get
			{
				return _Data;
			}
			set
			{
				_Data = value;
			}
		}

		public FileSourceRange(SourceFile file, SourceRange range)
		{
			_File = file;
			_Range = range;
			_Data = null;
		}

		public FileSourceRange(IElement element, SourceRange range)
			: this(GetSourceFile(element), range)
		{
		}

		private static SourceFile GetSourceFile(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element is SourceFile result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return element.FirstFile as SourceFile;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is FileSourceRange fileSourceRange))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (fileSourceRange.File == _File)
			{
				return fileSourceRange.Range == _Range;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			string text = _File.Name + " " + _Range.ToString();
			return text.GetHashCode();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool BindToCode()
		{
			if (_File == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_Range.BindToCode(_File.Document);
			return _Range.IsBoundToCode;
		}
	}
	public class FileSourceRangeCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		public SourceRange[] Ranges => GetRanges();

		public object[] Data => GetData();

		public FileSourceRange this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (FileSourceRange)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		private SourceRange[] GetRanges()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				arrayList.Add(this[i].Range);
			}
			return (SourceRange[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(SourceRange));
		}

		private object[] GetData()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				arrayList.Add(this[i].Data);
			}
			return (object[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(object));
		}

		private static FileSourceRangeCollection GetFileRanges(SourceFile file, SourceRange[] ranges)
		{
			if (file == null || ranges == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FileSourceRangeCollection fileSourceRangeCollection = new FileSourceRangeCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < ranges.Length; i++)
			{
				fileSourceRangeCollection.Add(new FileSourceRange(file, ranges[i]));
			}
			return fileSourceRangeCollection;
		}

		public int Add(FileSourceRange range)
		{
			return base.List.Add(range);
		}

		public void AddRange(FileSourceRangeCollection ranges)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ranges.Count; i++)
			{
				Add(ranges[i]);
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(ICollection ranges)
		{
			base.InnerList.AddRange(ranges);
		}

		public int IndexOf(FileSourceRange range)
		{
			return base.List.IndexOf(range);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, FileSourceRange range)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, range);
		}

		public void Remove(FileSourceRange range)
		{
			base.List.Remove(range);
		}

		public Hashtable GroupByFile()
		{
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					FileSourceRange fileSourceRange = (FileSourceRange)enumerator.Current;
					SourceFile sourceFile = fileSourceRange.File;
					IProjectElement project = sourceFile.Project;
					if (project != null)
					{
						sourceFile = project.FindDiskFile(sourceFile) as SourceFile;
					}
					FileSourceRangeCollection fileSourceRangeCollection = null;
					object obj = hashtable[sourceFile];
					if (obj == null)
					{
						fileSourceRangeCollection = new FileSourceRangeCollection();
						hashtable.Add(sourceFile, fileSourceRangeCollection);
					}
					else
					{
						fileSourceRangeCollection = (FileSourceRangeCollection)obj;
					}
					fileSourceRangeCollection?.Add(fileSourceRange);
				}
				return hashtable;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		public FileSourceRangeCollection GetRangesFromData()
		{
			FileSourceRangeCollection fileSourceRangeCollection = new FileSourceRangeCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				object data = this[i].Data;
				if (data != null && data is SourceRange[])
				{
					SourceRange[] ranges = (SourceRange[])data;
					FileSourceRangeCollection fileRanges = GetFileRanges(this[i].File, ranges);
					if (fileRanges != null)
					{
						fileSourceRangeCollection.AddRange(fileRanges);
					}
				}
			}
			return fileSourceRangeCollection;
		}

		public static FileSourceRangeCollection CreateInstance(SourceFile fileNode, SourceRange[] ranges)
		{
			return GetFileRanges(fileNode, ranges);
		}
	}
	public struct LineRange : IEquatable<LineRange>

			return lineRange._NumLines;

		public static implicit operator LineRange(int numLines)
		{

		}

		{
			if ((object)left == null)
			{
				return (object)right == null;
			}
			return left.Equals(right);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(LineRange left, int right)
		{
			return !(left == right);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(int left, LineRange right)
		{
			if ((object)left == null)
			{
				return (object)right == null;
			}
			return right.Equals(left);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(int left, LineRange right)
		{
			return !(left == right);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{

		}

				return Equals((LineRange)obj);

	public class RangeTransform : IComparable
	{
		private class RangeTransformComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return ((RangeTransform)x).CompareTo((RangeTransform)y);
			}
		}

		private class TransformedTextPointComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return ((RangeTransform)x).CompareToTransformed(((TextPointWrapper)y).Point);
			}
		}

		private class OriginalTextPointComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return ((RangeTransform)x).CompareToOriginal(((TextPointWrapper)y).Point);
			}
		}

		private static IComparer _RangeComparer;

		private static IComparer _OriginalPointComparer;

		private static IComparer _TransformedPointComparer;

		private int _StartLine;

		private int _EndLine;

		private int _StartOffset;

		private int _EndOffset;

		private int _LineTransform;

		private int _OffsetTransform;

		public static IComparer RangeComparer
		{
			get
			{
				if (_RangeComparer == null)
				{
					_RangeComparer = new RangeTransformComparer();
				}
				return _RangeComparer;
			}
		}

		public static IComparer OriginalPointComparer
		{
			get
			{
				if (_OriginalPointComparer == null)
				{
					_OriginalPointComparer = new OriginalTextPointComparer();
				}
				return _OriginalPointComparer;
			}
		}

		public static IComparer TransformedPointComparer
		{
			get
			{
				if (_TransformedPointComparer == null)
				{
					_TransformedPointComparer = new TransformedTextPointComparer();
				}
				return _TransformedPointComparer;
			}
		}

		public int StartLine
		{
			get
			{
				return _StartLine;
			}
			set
			{
				_StartLine = value;
			}
		}

		public int EndLine
		{
			get
			{
				return _EndLine;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndLine = value;
			}
		}

		public int StartOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return _StartOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				_StartOffset = value;
			}
		}

		public int EndOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return _EndOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndOffset = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasTransformValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (_LineTransform == 0)
				{
					return _OffsetTransform != 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public RangeTransform(RangeTransform source)
		{
			_StartLine = source._StartLine;
			_EndLine = source._EndLine;
			_StartOffset = source._StartOffset;
			_EndOffset = source._EndOffset;
			_LineTransform = source._LineTransform;
			_OffsetTransform = source._OffsetTransform;
		}

		public RangeTransform(TextRange range, int lineTransform, int offsetTransform)
		{
			_StartLine = range.Start.Line;
			_EndLine = range.End.Line;
			_StartOffset = range.Start.Offset;
			_EndOffset = range.End.Offset;
			_LineTransform = lineTransform;
			_OffsetTransform = offsetTransform;
		}

		private void Move(int line, int offset)
		{
			int line2 = _StartLine;
			int offset2 = _StartOffset;
			Apply(ref line2, ref offset2);
			if (line2 == line)
			{
				_OffsetTransform += offset;
			}
		}

		int IComparable.CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			return CompareTo((RangeTransform)obj);
		}

		public int CompareTo(RangeTransform transform)
		{
			if (transform == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (_StartLine < transform._StartLine)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_StartLine == transform._StartLine)
			{
				if (_StartOffset == transform._StartOffset)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (_StartOffset < transform._StartOffset)
				{
					return -1;
				}
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public int CompareToTransformed(TextPoint point)
		{
			if (ContainsTransformed(point.Line, point.Offset))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int line = point.Line;
			int offset = point.Offset;
			Restore(ref line, ref offset);
			if (_StartLine < line)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_StartLine == line && _StartOffset < offset)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public int CompareToOriginal(TextPoint point)
		{
			if (ContainsOriginal(point.Line, point.Offset))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int line = point.Line;
			int offset = point.Offset;
			if (_StartLine < line)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_StartLine == line && _StartOffset < offset)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public bool IsStart(TextPoint point)
		{
			int line = _StartLine;
			int offset = _StartOffset;
			Apply(ref line, ref offset);
			if (line == point.Line)
			{
				return offset == point.Offset;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsContainedInTransformed(TextRange range)
		{
			int line = _StartLine;
			int line2 = _EndLine;
			int offset = _StartOffset;
			int offset2 = _EndOffset;
			Apply(ref line, ref offset);
			Apply(ref line2, ref offset2);
			if (range.Contains(line, offset))
			{
				return range.Contains(line2, offset2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ContainsOriginal(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (line < _StartLine || line > _EndLine)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_StartLine == _EndLine)
			{
				if (offset >= _StartOffset)
				{
					return offset < _EndOffset;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (line == _StartLine)
			{
				return offset >= _StartOffset;
			}
			if (line == _EndLine)
			{
				return offset < _EndOffset;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool ContainsTransformed(int line, int offset)
		{
			Restore(ref line, ref offset);
			return ContainsOriginal(line, offset);
		}

		public bool StartsAfter(TextPoint point)
		{
			int line = _StartLine;
			int offset = _StartOffset;
			Apply(ref line, ref offset);
			if (line == point.Line)
			{
				return offset >= point.Offset;
			}
			return line > point.Line;
		}

		public void Shift(int line, int lineTransform, int offsetTransform)
		{
			_LineTransform += lineTransform;
			Move(line, offsetTransform);
		}

		public void Apply(ref int line, ref int offset)
		{
			if (line == _StartLine)
			{
				offset += _OffsetTransform;
			}
			line += _LineTransform;
		}

		public void Restore(ref int line, ref int offset)
		{
			line -= _LineTransform;
			if (line == _StartLine)
			{
				offset -= _OffsetTransform;
			}
		}

		public void TrimStart(TextPoint point)
		{
			int line = point.Line;
			_StartOffset = point.Offset;
			Restore(ref line, ref _StartOffset);
			if (line != _StartLine)
			{
				_OffsetTransform = 0;
				_StartLine = line;
			}
		}

		public void TrimEnd(TextPoint point)
		{
			_EndLine = point.Line;
			_EndOffset = point.Offset;
			Restore(ref _EndLine, ref _EndOffset);
		}

		public RangeTransform Insert(TextRange range)
		{
			RangeTransform rangeTransform = new RangeTransform(this);
			TrimEnd(range.Start);
			rangeTransform.TrimStart(range.Start);
			return rangeTransform;
		}

		public RangeTransform Delete(TextRange range)
		{
			RangeTransform rangeTransform = new RangeTransform(this);
			TrimEnd(range.Start);
			rangeTransform.TrimStart(range.End);
			return rangeTransform;
		}
	}
	public enum SourcePointBinding : byte
	{
		None,
		EditPoint,
		Anchor
	}
	[Serializable]
	[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit, Size = 8)]
	public struct TextPoint : IEquatable<TextPoint>
	{
		public static readonly TextPoint Empty;

		[FieldOffset(0)]
		private int _Line;

		[FieldOffset(4)]
		private int _Offset;

		public int Offset => _Offset;

		public int Line => _Line;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Line == 0)
				{
					return _Offset == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TextPoint(int line, int offset)
		{
			_Line = line;
			_Offset = offset;
		}

		public void Set(int line, int offset)
		{
			_Line = line;
			_Offset = offset;
		}

		public void Set(SourcePoint point)
		{
			Set(point.Line, point.Offset);
		}

		public void Set(Token token)
		{
			Set(token.Line, token.Column);
		}

		public void SetOffset(int offset)
		{
			_Offset = offset;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TextPoint)
			{
				return Equals((TextPoint)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(TextPoint point)
		{
			if (_Offset == point._Offset)
			{
				return Line == point.Line;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			string text = ToString();
			return text.GetHashCode();
		}

		public int CompareTo(SourcePoint point)
		{
			return SourcePoint.CompareTo(Line, Offset, point.Line, point.Offset);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{_Line},{_Offset}";
		}

		public static implicit operator SourcePoint(TextPoint point)
		{
			return new SourcePoint(point.Line, point.Offset);
		}

		public static implicit operator TextPoint(SourcePoint point)
		{
			return new TextPoint(point.Line, point.Offset);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(TextPoint first, TextPoint second)
		{
			return first.Equals(second);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TextPoint first, TextPoint second)
		{
			return !first.Equals(second);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public struct SourcePoint : IComparable, ICloneable, IEquatable<SourcePoint>, IComparable<SourcePoint>
	{
		private int _Line;

		private int _Offset;

		private SourcePointBinding _Binding;

		private byte _IsAnchorPushable;

		internal IDisposableEditPoint _BindingPoint;

		public static readonly SourcePoint Empty = new SourcePoint(0, 0);

		public bool IsBoundToCode
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Binding == SourcePointBinding.EditPoint)
				{
					return HasBindingPoint;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAnchored
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Binding == SourcePointBinding.Anchor)
				{
					return HasBindingPoint;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Line == 0 && _Offset == 0)
				{
					return _BindingPoint == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int Line
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsBoundToCode)
				{
					return _BindingPoint.Line;
				}
				if (IsAnchored)
				{
					return _BindingPoint.Line + _Line;
				}
				return _Line;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsAnchored)
				{
					_Line = value - _BindingPoint.Line;
				}
				else
				{
					_Line = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Offset
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsBoundToCode)
				{
					return _BindingPoint.Offset;
				}
				if (_Line == 0 && IsAnchored)
				{
					return _BindingPoint.Offset + _Offset;
				}
				return _Offset;
			}
			set
			{
				_Offset = value;
				if (_Line == 0 && IsAnchored)
				{
					_Offset -= _BindingPoint.Offset;
				}
			}
		}

		public SourcePointBinding Binding => _Binding;

		public IDisposableEditPoint BindingPoint => _BindingPoint;

		public bool HasBindingPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (_BindingPoint != null)
				{
					return !_BindingPoint.IsDisposed;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAnchorPushable
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsAnchorPushable == 1;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsAnchorPushable = (byte)(value ? 1u : 0u);
			}
		}

		public SourcePoint(int line, int offset)
		{
			_Line = line;
			_Offset = offset;
			_IsAnchorPushable = 0;
			_BindingPoint = null;
			_Binding = SourcePointBinding.None;
		}

		public SourcePoint(SourcePoint point)
			: this(point.Line, point.Offset)
		{
		}

		private static bool NeedToAdjustForInsertion(int line, int offset, int topLine, int topOffset, bool pushable)
		{
			int num = CompareTo(line, offset, topLine, topOffset);
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				if (pushable)
				{
					return num == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (obj is SourcePoint)
			{
				return Equals((SourcePoint)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (Offset == point.Offset)
			{
				return Line == point.Line;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (Offset == offset)
			{
				return Line == line;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			string text = ToString();
			return text.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{_Line},{_Offset}";
		}

		public void AdjustForInsertion(SourceRange insertion)
		{
			if (IsBoundToCode)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourcePoint top = insertion.Top;
			int line = top.Line;
			int offset = top.Offset;
			SourcePoint bottom = insertion.Bottom;
			int line2 = bottom.Line;
			int offset2 = bottom.Offset;
			if (IsAnchored)
			{
				int line3 = _BindingPoint.Line;
				int offset3 = _BindingPoint.Offset;
				if (CompareTo(line3, offset3, line2, offset2) >= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			int line4 = Line;
			int offset4 = Offset;
			if (NeedToAdjustForInsertion(line4, offset4, line, offset, IsAnchorPushable))
			{
				if (line == line4)
				{
					int offset5 = offset4 + offset2 - offset;
					Line = line2;
					Offset = offset5;
				}
				else
				{
					int num = line2 - line;
					Line = line4 + num;
				}
			}
		}

		public void AdjustForDeletion(SourceRange deletion)
		{
			if (IsBoundToCode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsAnchored)
			{
				int line = _BindingPoint.Line;
				int offset = _BindingPoint.Offset;
				if (CompareTo(line, offset, deletion.Top.Line, deletion.Top.Offset) >= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (deletion.Contains(this))
			{
				Line = deletion.Top.Line;
				Offset = deletion.Top.Offset;
			}
			else if (this > deletion.Bottom)
			{
				if (deletion.Bottom.Line == Line)
				{
					int offset2 = Offset - deletion.Bottom.Offset + deletion.Top.Offset;
					Line = deletion.Top.Line;
					Offset = offset2;
				}
				else
				{
					int num = deletion.Bottom.Line - deletion.Top.Line;
					Line -= num;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetFast(int line, int offset)
		{
			_Line = line;
			_Offset = offset;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("SetPoint is obsolete -- use Set method instead.")]
		public void SetPoint(int line, int offset)
		{
			Set(line, offset);
		}

		public void Set(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (IsBoundToCode)
			{
				RemoveBinding();
			}
			Line = line;
			Offset = offset;
		}

		public void Set(SourcePoint sourcePoint)
		{
			Set(sourcePoint.Line, sourcePoint.Offset);
		}

		public void Set(Token token)
		{
			Set(token.Line, token.Column);
		}

		public void SetOffset(int offset)
		{
			RemoveAllBindings();
			_Offset = offset;
		}

		public void BindToCode(IDisposableEditPointFactory editPointFactory)
		{
			BindToCode(editPointFactory, pushable: false);
		}

		public void BindToCode(IDisposableEditPointFactory editPointFactory, bool pushable)
		{
			if (_Line >= 1 && _Offset >= 1)
			{
				RemoveAllBindings();
				string name = "SourcePoint binding" + (pushable ? " (pushable)" : string.Empty);
				_BindingPoint = editPointFactory.CreateDisposableEditPoint(_Line, _Offset, name);
				_BindingPoint.IsPushable = pushable;
				_BindingPoint.IsAnchorable = true;
				SetBinding(SourcePointBinding.EditPoint);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveBinding()
		{
			if (IsBoundToCode)
			{
				_Line = _BindingPoint.Line;
				_Offset = _BindingPoint.Offset;
				if (!_BindingPoint.IsDisposed)
				{
					_BindingPoint.Dispose();
				}
				_BindingPoint = null;
				SetBinding(SourcePointBinding.None);
			}
		}

		public void AnchorToSourcePoint(SourcePoint sourcePoint)
		{
			AnchorToSourcePoint(sourcePoint, pushable: false);
		}

		public void AnchorToSourcePoint(SourcePoint sourcePoint, bool pushable)
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				RemoveAllBindings();
				if (!sourcePoint.IsBoundToCode)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("sourcePoint must be bound to code before calling AnchorToSourcePoint.");
				}
				IsAnchorPushable = pushable;
				_BindingPoint = sourcePoint._BindingPoint;
				_Line -= _BindingPoint.Line;
				if (_Line == 0)
				{
					_Offset -= _BindingPoint.Offset;
				}
				SetBinding(SourcePointBinding.Anchor);
			}
		}

		public void HoistAnchor()
		{
			if (IsAnchored)
			{
				if (_Line == 0)
				{
					_Offset = _BindingPoint.Offset + _Offset;
				}
				_Line = _BindingPoint.Line + _Line;
				_BindingPoint = null;
				_IsAnchorPushable = 0;
				SetBinding(SourcePointBinding.None);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAllBindings()
		{
			if (IsBoundToCode)
			{
				RemoveBinding();
			}
			if (IsAnchored)
			{
				HoistAnchor();
			}
		}

		public SourcePoint OffsetPoint(int lines, int columns)
		{
			int line = Line + lines;
			int offset = Offset + columns;
			return new SourcePoint(line, offset);
		}

		public SourcePoint ExtractFromDocument(SourcePoint newOrigin)
		{
			int line = Line - (newOrigin.Line - 1);
			int num = 0;
			if (Line == newOrigin.Line)
			{
				num = newOrigin.Offset - 1;
			}
			int offset = Offset - num;
			return new SourcePoint(line, offset);
		}

		public SourcePoint RestoreToDocument(SourcePoint customOrigin)
		{
			int line = Line + (customOrigin.Line - 1);
			int num = 0;
			if (Line == 1)
			{
				num = customOrigin.Offset - 1;
			}
			int offset = Offset + num;
			return new SourcePoint(line, offset);
		}

		private void SetBinding(SourcePointBinding binding)
		{
			_Binding = binding;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(SourcePoint point1, SourcePoint point2)
		{
			return point1.Equals(point2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(SourcePoint point1, SourcePoint point2)
		{
			return !(point1 == point2);
		}

		public static bool operator >(SourcePoint point1, SourcePoint point2)
		{
			return point1.CompareTo(point2) > 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <(SourcePoint point1, SourcePoint point2)
		{
			return point1.CompareTo(point2) < 0;
		}

		public static bool operator >=(SourcePoint point1, SourcePoint point2)
		{
			return point1.CompareTo(point2) >= 0;
		}

		public static bool operator <=(SourcePoint point1, SourcePoint point2)
		{
			return point1.CompareTo(point2) <= 0;
		}

		public int CompareTo(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("obj");
			}
			if (!(obj is SourcePoint))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"obj must be of type {typeof(SourcePoint).FullName}");
			}
			return CompareTo((SourcePoint)obj);
		}

		public int CompareTo(SourcePoint point)
		{
			int line = Line;
			int offset = Offset;
			int line2 = point.Line;
			int offset2 = point.Offset;
			return CompareTo(line, offset, line2, offset2);
		}

		public int UnboundCompareTo(SourcePoint point)
		{
			return CompareTo(_Line, _Offset, point._Line, point._Offset);
		}

		public static int CompareTo(int firstLine, int firstOffset, int secondLine, int secondOffset)
		{
			if (firstLine > secondLine)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (firstLine < secondLine)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (firstOffset > secondOffset)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (firstOffset < secondOffset)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public SourcePoint Clone()
		{
			return new SourcePoint(this);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public struct SourceRange : ICloneable, IEquatable<SourceRange>
	{
		public SourcePoint Start;

		public SourcePoint End;

		public static readonly SourceRange Empty = new SourceRange(SourcePoint.Empty, SourcePoint.Empty);

		public bool IsBoundToCode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Start.IsBoundToCode)
				{
					return End.IsBoundToCode;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAnchored
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Start.IsAnchored)
				{
					return End.IsAnchored;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public SourcePoint Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				if (StartPrecedesEnd)
				{
					return End;
				}
				return Start;
			}
		}

		public int CharsIncludedOnLastLine
		{
			get
			{
				if (Bottom.Line == Top.Line)
				{
					return Bottom.Offset - Top.Offset;
				}
				return Bottom.Offset;
			}
		}

		public int Height => Bottom.Line - Top.Line + 1;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Start.IsEmpty)
				{
					return End.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsPoint => Start == End;

		public LineRange LineCount => new LineRange(Bottom.Line - Top.Line + 1);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LineRange LineCountMinusOne => new LineRange(Bottom.Line - Top.Line);

		public SourceRange LogicalRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (StartPrecedesEnd)
				{
					return new SourceRange(Start, End);
				}
				return new SourceRange(End, Start);
			}
		}

		public bool StartPrecedesEnd => Start.CompareTo(End) <= 0;

		public SourcePoint Top
		{
			get
			{
				if (StartPrecedesEnd)
				{
					return Start;
				}
				return End;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange(int line, int offset)
		{
			Start = new SourcePoint(line, offset);
			End = new SourcePoint(line, offset);
		}

		public SourceRange(SourcePoint sourcePoint)
		{
			Start = new SourcePoint(sourcePoint.Line, sourcePoint.Offset);
			End = Start;
		}

		public SourceRange(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset)
		{
			Start = new SourcePoint(startLine, startOffset);
			End = new SourcePoint(endLine, endOffset);
		}

		public SourceRange(SourcePoint start, SourcePoint end)
		{
			Start = new SourcePoint(start.Line, start.Offset);
			End = new SourcePoint(end.Line, end.Offset);
		}

		public SourceRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			Start = new SourcePoint(range.Start.Line, range.Start.Offset);
			End = new SourcePoint(range.End.Line, range.End.Offset);
		}

		public SourceRange(TextPoint start, TextPoint end)
		{
			Start = start;
			End = end;
		}

		private void GetTopAndBottom(out SourcePoint top, out SourcePoint bottom)
		{
			top = Start;
			bottom = End;
			if (!StartPrecedesEnd)
			{
				SourcePoint sourcePoint = top;
				top = bottom;
				bottom = sourcePoint;
			}
		}

		public void AdjustForInsertion(SourceRange insertion)
		{
			Start.AdjustForInsertion(insertion);
			End.AdjustForInsertion(insertion);
		}

		public void AdjustForDeletion(SourceRange deletion)
		{
			Start.AdjustForDeletion(deletion);
			End.AdjustForDeletion(deletion);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("SetRange is Obsolete. Use the Set method instead.")]
		public void SetRange(Token token)
		{
			Set(token);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Set(Token token)
		{
			Set(token.Line, token.Column, token.Line, token.EndColumn);
		}

		public void Set(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset)
		{
			Start = new SourcePoint(startLine, startOffset);
			End = new SourcePoint(endLine, endOffset);
		}

		public void Set(SourcePoint startPoint, SourcePoint endPoint)
		{
			Set(startPoint.Line, startPoint.Offset, endPoint.Line, endPoint.Offset);
		}

		public void Set(SourceRange range)
		{
			Set(range.Start.Line, range.Start.Offset, range.End.Line, range.End.Offset);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetFast(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset)
		{
			Start.SetFast(startLine, startOffset);
			End.SetFast(endLine, endOffset);
		}

		public static void AnchorToSourcePoint(ref object range, SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (range != null)
			{
				SourceRange sourceRange = (SourceRange)range;
				sourceRange.AnchorToSourcePoint(point);
				range = sourceRange;
			}
		}

		public static void HoistAnchor(ref object range)
		{
			if (range != null)
			{
				SourceRange sourceRange = (SourceRange)range;
				sourceRange.RemoveAllBindings();
				range = sourceRange;
			}
		}

		public static void AdjustForDeletion(ref object range, SourceRange deletion)
		{
			if (range != null)
			{
				SourceRange sourceRange = (SourceRange)range;
				sourceRange.AdjustForDeletion(deletion);
				range = sourceRange;
			}
		}

		public static void AdjustForInsertion(ref object range, SourceRange insertion)
		{
			if (range != null)
			{
				SourceRange sourceRange = (SourceRange)range;
				sourceRange.AdjustForInsertion(insertion);
				range = sourceRange;
			}
		}

		public static void Set(ref object range, Token token)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				range = Empty;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange = (SourceRange)range;
			sourceRange.Set(token);
			range = sourceRange;
		}

		public static void Set(ref object range, SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				range = Empty;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange2 = (SourceRange)range;
			sourceRange2.Set(sourceRange);
			range = sourceRange2;
		}

		public static void SetEnd(ref object range, SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				range = Empty;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange = (SourceRange)range;
			sourceRange.End.Set(point);
			range = sourceRange;
		}

		public static void SetEnd(ref object range, Token token)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				range = Empty;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange = (SourceRange)range;
			sourceRange.End.Set(token.Line, token.EndColumn);
			range = sourceRange;
		}

		public static SourceRange Get(object range)
		{
			if (range != null)
			{
				return (SourceRange)range;
			}
			return Empty;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object aObj)
		{
			if (aObj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (aObj is SourceRange)
			{
				return Equals((SourceRange)aObj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (!Start.Equals(range.Start))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!End.Equals(range.End))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Equals(SourcePoint start, SourcePoint end)
		{
			if (Start.Equals(start))
			{
				return End.Equals(end);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset)
		{
			if (Start.Equals(startLine, startOffset))
			{
				return End.Equals(endLine, endOffset);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			string text = ToString();
			return text.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{Start} -> {End}";
		}

		public bool Contains(int line, int offset)
		{
			return Contains(new SourcePoint(line, offset));
		}

		public bool Contains(SourcePoint sourcePoint)
		{
			GetTopAndBottom(out var top, out var bottom);
			if (sourcePoint >= top)
			{
				return sourcePoint <= bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool FastContains(SourceRange range)
		{
			SourcePoint start = range.Start;
			SourcePoint end = range.End;
			if (Start <= start && End >= start && Start <= end)
			{
				return End >= end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(SourceRange range)
		{
			GetTopAndBottom(out var top, out var bottom);
			SourcePoint start = range.Start;
			SourcePoint end = range.End;
			if (start >= top && start <= bottom && end >= top)
			{
				return end <= bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (!Contains(range.Start) && !Contains(range.End))
			{
				return range.Contains(this);
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool Intersects(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (!Contains(range.Start))
			{
				return Contains(range.End);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Surrounds(SourcePoint sourcePoint)
		{
			if (Top < sourcePoint)
			{
				return Bottom > sourcePoint;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool EndsBefore(SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			return Bottom < sourceRange.Top;
		}

		public bool EndsBefore(int lineNumber, int columnOffset)
		{
			if (End.Line >= lineNumber)
			{
				if (End.Line == lineNumber)
				{
					return End.Offset < columnOffset;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool StartsAfter(int lineNumber, int columnOffset)
		{
			if (Start.Line <= lineNumber)
			{
				if (Start.Line == lineNumber)
				{
					return Start.Offset > columnOffset;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool StartsAfter(SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			return Top > sourceRange.Bottom;
		}

		public bool StartsBefore(int lineNumber, int columnOffset)
		{
			if (Start.Line >= lineNumber)
			{
				if (Start.Line == lineNumber)
				{
					return Start.Offset < columnOffset;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool EndsAfter(int lineNumber, int columnOffset)
		{
			if (End.Line <= lineNumber)
			{
				if (End.Line == lineNumber)
				{
					return End.Offset > columnOffset;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Overlaps(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (Holds(range.Top) || Holds(range.Bottom) || range.Holds(Top))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Holds(SourcePoint testPoint)
		{
			if (testPoint > Top)
			{
				return testPoint < Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void BindToCode(IDisposableEditPointFactory editPointFactory)
		{
			Start.BindToCode(editPointFactory, pushable: true);
			End.BindToCode(editPointFactory, pushable: true);
		}

		public void RemoveBinding()
		{
			Start.RemoveBinding();
			End.RemoveBinding();
		}

		public void RemoveAllBindings()
		{
			Start.RemoveAllBindings();
			End.RemoveAllBindings();
		}

		public void AnchorToSourcePoint(SourcePoint sourcePoint)
		{
			Start.AnchorToSourcePoint(sourcePoint, pushable: true);
			End.AnchorToSourcePoint(sourcePoint);
		}

		public void HoistAnchor()
		{
			Start.HoistAnchor();
			End.HoistAnchor();
		}

		public SourceRange OffsetRange(int lines, int columns)
		{
			return new SourceRange(Start.OffsetPoint(lines, columns), End.OffsetPoint(lines, columns));
		}

		public SourceRange ExtractFromDocument(SourcePoint newOrigin)
		{
			return new SourceRange(Start.ExtractFromDocument(newOrigin), End.ExtractFromDocument(newOrigin));
		}

		public SourceRange RestoreToDocument(SourcePoint customOrigin)
		{
			return new SourceRange(Start.RestoreToDocument(customOrigin), End.RestoreToDocument(customOrigin));
		}

		private static SourcePoint GetMax(SourcePoint a, SourcePoint b)
		{
			if (!(a <= b))
			{
				return a;
			}
			return b;
		}

		private static SourcePoint GetMin(SourcePoint a, SourcePoint b)
		{
			if (!(a >= b))
			{
				return a;
			}
			return b;
		}

		public static SourceRange Union(SourceRange a, SourceRange b)
		{
			SourceRange empty = Empty;
			if (a == Empty)
			{
				return b;
			}
			if (b == Empty)
			{
				return a;
			}
			empty.Start = GetMin(a.Top, b.Top);
			empty.End = GetMax(a.Bottom, b.Bottom);
			return empty;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(SourceRange range1, SourceRange range2)
		{
			return range1.Equals(range2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(SourceRange range1, SourceRange range2)
		{
			return !(range1 == range2);
		}

		public static SourceRange operator -(SourceRange sourceRange, LineRange lineRange)
		{
			return new SourceRange(sourceRange.Start.Line - (int)lineRange, sourceRange.Start.Offset, sourceRange.End.Line - (int)lineRange, sourceRange.End.Offset);
		}

		public static SourceRange operator +(SourceRange sourceRange, LineRange lineRange)
		{
			return new SourceRange(sourceRange.Start.Line + (int)lineRange, sourceRange.Start.Offset, sourceRange.End.Line + (int)lineRange, sourceRange.End.Offset);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public SourceRange Clone()
		{
			return new SourceRange(this);
		}
	}
	public class SourceRangeComparer : IComparer<SourceRange>
	{
		public int Compare(SourceRange x, SourceRange y)
		{
			if (x.IsEmpty && y.IsEmpty)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (x.IsEmpty)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (y.IsEmpty)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x.Start < y.Start)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (x.Start > y.Start)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}

				return range.Range;

	public class SourceTextRange
	{
		private SourceRange _Range;

		private string _Text;

		public SourceRange Range
		{
			get
			{
				return _Range;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(_Range == value))
				{
					_Range = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return _Text;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(_Text == value))
				{
					_Text = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public SourceTextRange()
			: this(string.Empty, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public SourceTextRange(string text, SourceRange range)
		{
			_Text = text;
			_Range = range;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit, Size = 16)]
	public struct TextRange : ICloneable, IEquatable<TextRange>
	{
		public static readonly TextRange Empty;

		[FieldOffset(0)]
		public TextPoint Start;

		[FieldOffset(8)]
		public TextPoint End;

		public bool IsPoint => Start == End;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Start == TextPoint.Empty)
				{
					return End == TextPoint.Empty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int LineCount => LineCountMinusOne + 1;

		public int LineCountMinusOne => Math.Abs(End.Line - Start.Line);

		public TextRange(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset)
			: this(new TextPoint(startLine, startOffset), new TextPoint(endLine, endOffset))
		{
		}

		public TextRange(TextPoint start, TextPoint end)
		{
			Start = start;
			End = end;
		}

		public void Set(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset)
		{
			Start.Set(startLine, startOffset);
			End.Set(endLine, endOffset);
		}

		public void Set(SourcePoint start, SourcePoint end)
		{
			Start.Set(start);
			End.Set(end);
		}

		public void Set(SourceRange range)
		{
			Start.Set(range.Start);
			End.Set(range.End);
		}

		public void SetStart(TextPoint point)
		{
			Start.Set(point);
		}

		public void SetEnd(TextPoint point)
		{
			End.Set(point);
		}

		public bool Contains(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (line < Start.Line || line > End.Line)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (line == Start.Line)
			{
				flag = offset >= Start.Offset;
			}
			if (line == End.Line)
			{
				flag &= offset <= End.Offset;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool Contains(TextPoint point)
		{
			return Contains(point.Line, point.Offset);
		}

		public bool Contains(TextRange range)
		{
			if (Contains(range.Start))
			{
				return Contains(range.End);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is TextRange)
			{
				return Equals((TextRange)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Equals(TextRange range)
		{
			if (Start.Equals(range.Start))
			{
				return End.Equals(range.End);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			string text = ToString();
			return text.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{Start} -> {End}";
		}

		public SourceRange ToSourceRange()
		{
			SourceRange empty = SourceRange.Empty;
			empty.SetFast(Start.Line, Start.Offset, End.Line, End.Offset);
			return empty;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(TextRange range1, TextRange range2)
		{
			return range1.Equals(range2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(TextRange range1, TextRange range2)
		{
			return !(range1 == range2);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public TextRange Clone()
		{
			return new TextRange(Start, End);
		}

		public static implicit operator SourceRange(TextRange range)
		{
			return new SourceRange(range.Start, range.End);
		}

		public static implicit operator TextRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			return new TextRange(range.Start, range.End);
		}
	}

	public class CommentBuilder
	{
		public string Language { get; private set; }

		public CommentBuilder(string language)
		{
			Language = language;
		}

		public string GetComment(string label)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			return GetComment(label, empty);
		}

		public string GetComment(string label, string value)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetComment(label + value, Language);
		}
	}
	public class ElementBuilder
	{
		private const string STR_SystemInt32 = "System.Int32";

		private LanguageElementCollection _TopLevelElements = new LanguageElementCollection();

		private ElementList _RootElement = new ElementList();

		public NodeList TopLevelElements => _RootElement.Nodes;

		protected void AddTopElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				_RootElement.AddNode(element);
			}
		}

		protected void InsertTopElement(int index, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				_RootElement.InsertNode(index, element);
			}
		}

		protected int GetIndexOfTopElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || _RootElement.Nodes == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _RootElement.Nodes.IndexOf(element);
		}

		protected string GetSimpleTypeName(string typeName)
		{
			if (StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsBuiltInType(typeName))
			{
				return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetSimpleTypeName(typeName);
			}
			return typeName;
		}

		protected string GenerateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return GenerateElement(element, 0);
		}

		protected string GenerateElement(LanguageElement element, string languageID)
		{
			return GenerateElement(element, languageID, 0);
		}

		protected string GenerateElement(LanguageElement element, int precedingWhiteSpaceCount)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GenerateElement(element, precedingWhiteSpaceCount);
		}

		protected string GenerateElement(LanguageElement element, string languageID, int precedingWhiteSpaceCount)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GenerateElement(element, languageID, precedingWhiteSpaceCount);
		}

		protected void SetMethodType(Method method, string type)
		{
			if (method != null)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(type))
				{
					method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Void;
				}
				else
				{
					method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Function;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual Param AddParam(MemberWithParameters parent, Param param)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				AddTopElement(param);
			}
			else
			{
				parent.AddDetailNode(param);
				parent.Parameters.Add(param);
			}
			return param;
		}

		protected virtual Expression AddMethodArgument(MethodCall parent, Expression argument)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				AddTopElement(argument);
			}
			else
			{
				parent.AddDetailNode(argument);
				parent.Arguments.Add(argument);
			}
			return argument;
		}

		protected virtual Expression AddSource(IHasQualifier parent, object source)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Expression expression = GetExpression(source);
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			parent.Qualifier = expression;
			return expression;
		}

		protected virtual AttributeSection AddAttributeSection(CodeElement target, AttributeSection section)
		{
			if (target == null)
			{
				return (AttributeSection)AddNode(null, section);
			}
			target.AddAttributeSection(section);
			if (target.Parent == null)
			{
				int indexOfTopElement = GetIndexOfTopElement(target);
				if (indexOfTopElement < 0)
				{
					AddTopElement(section);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertTopElement(indexOfTopElement, section);
				}
			}
			return section;
		}

		protected virtual Attribute AddAttribute(AttributeSection parent, Attribute attr)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return (Attribute)AddNode(null, attr);
			}
			parent.AttributeCollection.Add(attr);
			parent.AddNode(attr);
			attr.SetTarget(parent.TargetNode);
			return attr;
		}

		public virtual ConstructorInitializer AddConstructorInitializer(Method parent, ConstructorInitializer initializer)
		{
			if (initializer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return (ConstructorInitializer)AddNode(null, initializer);
			}
			if (parent.HasInitializer)
			{
				parent.RemoveNode(parent.Initializer);
			}
			parent.InsertNode(0, initializer);
			return initializer;
		}

		protected virtual Comment AddComment(CodeElement parent, Comment comment)
		{
			if (parent == null || comment == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			parent.AddCommentNode(comment);
			return comment;
		}

		public virtual Throw AddThrow(LanguageElement parent, Throw @throw)
		{
			if (parent == null || @throw == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			parent.AddNode(@throw);
			return @throw;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsAnIdentifier(string text)
		{
			if (text == null || text == "")
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (char.IsNumber(text[0]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (char c in text)
			{
				if (!char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual TypeReferenceExpression GetTypeReferenceExpression(object expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (expression is TypeReferenceExpression)
			{
				return (TypeReferenceExpression)expression;
			}
			if (expression is string && IsAnIdentifier((string)expression))
			{
				return BuildTypeReference((string)expression);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElementCollectionBase AddDetailNodes(LanguageElement parent, LanguageElementCollectionBase children)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Count; i++)
			{
				AddDetailNode(parent, children[i] as LanguageElement);
			}
			return children;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement AddDetailNode(LanguageElement parent, LanguageElement child)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			parent.AddDetailNode(child);
			return child;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElementCollectionBase AddNodes(LanguageElement parent, LanguageElementCollectionBase children)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < children.Count; i++)
			{
				AddNode(parent, children[i] as LanguageElement);
			}
			return children;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement AddNode(LanguageElement parent, LanguageElement child)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				AddTopElement(child);
			}
			else
			{
				parent.AddNode(child);
			}
			return child;
		}

		public virtual Expression GetExpression(object expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (expression is Expression)
			{
				return (Expression)expression;
			}
			if (expression is string && IsAnIdentifier((string)expression))
			{
				return BuildElementReference((string)expression);
			}
			return BuildPrimitive(expression.ToString());
		}

		public virtual ExpressionCollection GetSnippetExpressions(string[] values)
		{
			ExpressionCollection expressionCollection = new ExpressionCollection();
			if (values != null)
			{
				int num = values.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					expressionCollection.Add(BuildSnippetExpression(values[i]));
				}
			}
			return expressionCollection;
		}

		public virtual ExpressionCollection GetSnippetExpressions(LanguageElementCollection elements)
		{
			ExpressionCollection expressionCollection = new ExpressionCollection();
			if (elements != null)
			{
				int count = elements.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					expressionCollection.Add(BuildSnippetExpression(elements[i].Name));
				}
			}
			return expressionCollection;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetInitializer(object initializer)
		{
			if (initializer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (initializer is LanguageElement)
			{
				return (LanguageElement)initializer;
			}
			return BuildPrimitive(initializer.ToString());
		}

		public void ClearTopLevelElements()
		{
			_TopLevelElements.Clear();
			_RootElement.Nodes.Clear();
		}

		public string GenerateCode(string languageID, int precedingWhiteSpaceCount)
		{
			if (languageID == string.Empty)
			{
				return GenerateElement(_RootElement, precedingWhiteSpaceCount);
			}
			return GenerateElement(_RootElement, languageID, precedingWhiteSpaceCount);
		}

		public string GenerateCode(string languageID)
		{
			if (languageID == string.Empty)
			{
				return GenerateElement(_RootElement);
			}
			return GenerateElement(_RootElement, languageID);
		}

		public string GenerateCode()
		{
			return GenerateCode(string.Empty);
		}

		public virtual DefineDirective AddDefineDirective(LanguageElement parent)
		{
			return (DefineDirective)AddNode(parent, BuildDefineDirective());
		}

		public virtual DefineDirective BuildDefineDirective()
		{
			return new DefineDirective();
		}

		public virtual UnaryOperatorExpression OpPointerDereference(object identifier)
		{
			return new UnaryOperatorExpression(UnaryOperatorType.PointerDereference, GetExpression(identifier), isPostOperator: false);
		}

		public virtual UnaryIncrement OpPlusPlus(object identifier)
		{
			return OpPlusPlus(identifier, isPostIncrement: true);
		}

		public virtual UnaryIncrement OpPlusPlus(object identifier, bool isPostIncrement)
		{
			return new UnaryIncrement(GetExpression(identifier), isPostIncrement);
		}

		public virtual UnaryDecrement OpMinusMinus(object identifier)
		{
			return OpMinusMinus(identifier, isPostDecrement: true);
		}

		public virtual UnaryDecrement OpMinusMinus(object identifier, bool isPostDecrement)
		{
			return new UnaryDecrement(GetExpression(identifier), isPostDecrement);
		}

		public virtual BinaryOperatorExpression Op(object leftSide, string operatorText, object rightSide)
		{
			BinaryOperatorExpression binaryOperatorExpression = new BinaryOperatorExpression();
			binaryOperatorExpression.LeftSide = GetExpression(leftSide);
			binaryOperatorExpression.RightSide = GetExpression(rightSide);
			binaryOperatorExpression.OperatorText = operatorText;
			return binaryOperatorExpression;
		}

		public virtual BinaryOperatorExpression Op(object leftSide, BinaryOperatorType op, object rightSide)
		{
			BinaryOperatorExpression binaryOperatorExpression = new BinaryOperatorExpression();
			binaryOperatorExpression.LeftSide = GetExpression(leftSide);
			binaryOperatorExpression.RightSide = GetExpression(rightSide);
			binaryOperatorExpression.OperatorText = string.Empty;
			binaryOperatorExpression.BinaryOperator = op;
			return binaryOperatorExpression;
		}

		public virtual RelationalOperation Op(object leftSide, RelationalOperator operatorType, object rightSide)
		{
			return new RelationalOperation(GetExpression(leftSide), operatorType, GetExpression(rightSide));
		}

		public virtual BinaryOperatorExpression OpMinus(object leftSide, object rightSide)
		{
			return Op(leftSide, BinaryOperatorType.Subtract, rightSide);
		}

		public virtual BinaryOperatorExpression OpPlus(object leftSide, object rightSide)
		{

		}

		public virtual BinaryOperatorExpression OpTimes(object leftSide, object rightSide)
		{

		public virtual BinaryOperatorExpression OpDivide(object leftSide, object rightSide)

		}

		public virtual RelationalOperation OpEquals(object leftSide, object rightSide)

		public virtual RelationalOperation OpNotEquals(object leftSide, object rightSide)

		public virtual RelationalOperation OpGreaterOrEqual(object leftSide, object rightSide)

		public virtual DelegateDefinition BuildDelegateDefinition(string delegateName, string delegateType)
		{
			DelegateDefinition delegateDefinition = BuildDelegateDefinition(delegateName);
			delegateDefinition.MemberType = delegateType;
			if (delegateType != null)
			{
				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = BuildTypeReference(delegateType);
				if (typeReferenceExpression != null)
				{
					delegateDefinition.MemberTypeReference = typeReferenceExpression;
					delegateDefinition.AddDetailNode(typeReferenceExpression);
				}
			}
			delegateDefinition.MemberType = delegateType;
			delegateDefinition.MemberTypeReference = BuildTypeReference(delegateType);
			return delegateDefinition;
		}

		public virtual DelegateDefinition BuildDelegateDefinition(string delegateName, string delegateType, LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			DelegateDefinition delegateDefinition = BuildDelegateDefinition(delegateName, parameters);
			delegateDefinition.MemberType = delegateType;
			if (delegateType != null)
			{
				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = BuildTypeReference(delegateType);
				if (typeReferenceExpression != null)
				{
					delegateDefinition.MemberTypeReference = typeReferenceExpression;
					delegateDefinition.AddDetailNode(typeReferenceExpression);
				}
			}
			return delegateDefinition;
		}

		public virtual DelegateDefinition BuildDelegateDefinition(string delegateName, TypeReferenceExpression delegateType)
		{
			DelegateDefinition delegateDefinition = BuildDelegateDefinition(delegateName);
			delegateDefinition.MemberType = delegateType.ToString();
			delegateDefinition.MemberTypeReference = delegateType;
			delegateDefinition.AddDetailNode(delegateType);
			return delegateDefinition;
		}

		public virtual void AddBaseMethodCall(LanguageElement parent, string name, ExpressionCollection arguments, string codeBefore, string codeAfter)
		{
			if (parent != null)
			{
				if (codeBefore != null && codeBefore.Length > 0)
				{
					AddNode(parent, BuildStatement(codeBefore));
				}
				AddBaseMethodCall(parent, name, arguments);
				if (codeAfter != null && codeAfter.Length > 0)
				{
					AddNode(parent, BuildStatement(codeAfter));
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual CaseClause AddCaseClause(Case parent, CaseClause caseClause)
		{
			if (parent == null)
			{
				AddTopElement(caseClause);
			}
			else
			{
				parent.AddCaseClause(caseClause);
			}
			return caseClause;
		}

		public virtual CaseClause AddCaseClause(Case parent)
		{
			return AddCaseClause(parent, BuildCaseClause());
		}

		public virtual CaseClause AddCaseClause(Case parent, object startExpression)
		{
			return AddCaseClause(parent, BuildCaseClause(startExpression));
		}

		public virtual CaseClause AddCaseClause(Case parent, object startExpression, object endExpression)
		{
			return AddCaseClause(parent, BuildCaseClause(startExpression, endExpression));
		}

		public virtual CaseClause BuildCaseClause()
		{
			return new CaseClause();
		}

		public virtual CaseClause BuildCaseClause(object startExpression)
		{
			CaseClause caseClause = BuildCaseClause();
			caseClause.StartExpression = GetExpression(startExpression);
			return caseClause;
		}

		public virtual CaseClause BuildCaseClause(object startExpression, object endExpression)
		{
			CaseClause caseClause = BuildCaseClause();
			caseClause.StartExpression = GetExpression(startExpression);
			Expression expression = GetExpression(endExpression);
			if (expression != null)
			{
				caseClause.EndExpression = expression;
				caseClause.IsRangeCheckClause = true;
			}
			return caseClause;
		}

		public virtual Event BuildEvent(string eventName, string eventType)
		{

			obj.MemberType = eventType;

				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = BuildTypeReference(eventType);
				if (typeReferenceExpression != null)
				{
					obj.MemberTypeReference = typeReferenceExpression;
					obj.AddDetailNode(typeReferenceExpression);
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public virtual XmlDocComment AddXmlDocComment(CodeElement parent, string text)
		{
			XmlDocComment xmlDocComment = BuildXmlDocComment(text);
			if (xmlDocComment == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (parent == null)
			{
				AddTopElement(xmlDocComment);
			}
			else
			{
				parent.AddCommentNode(xmlDocComment);
			}
			return xmlDocComment;
		}

		public virtual XmlDocComment BuildXmlDocComment(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			XmlDocComment xmlDocComment = new XmlDocComment();
			xmlDocComment.Name = text;
			xmlDocComment.ParseXmlNodes();
			return xmlDocComment;
		}

		public virtual ElementReferenceExpression BuildQualifiedElementReference(object source, string name)

			return new QualifiedElementReference(expression, name, SourceRange.Empty);
		}

		public virtual MethodCall BuildMethodCall(string name, ExpressionCollection arguments, object qualifier)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MethodCall methodCall = BuildMethodCall(new MethodReferenceExpression(name, SourceRange.Empty));
			if (arguments != null)
			{
				methodCall.Arguments.AddRange(arguments);
			}
			if (qualifier == null)
			{
				return methodCall;
			}
			if (!(methodCall.Qualifier is IHasQualifier parent))
			{
				return methodCall;
			}
			AddSource(parent, GetExpression(qualifier));
			return methodCall;
		}

		public virtual Variable BuildVariable(string variableType, string variableName)
		{
			Variable variable = new Variable();
			variable.Name = variableName;
			string text = (variable.MemberType = GetSimpleTypeName(variableType));
			if (text != null)
			{
				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = BuildTypeReference(text);
				if (typeReferenceExpression != null)
				{
					variable.MemberTypeReference = typeReferenceExpression;
					variable.AddDetailNode(typeReferenceExpression);
				}
			}
			return variable;
		}

		public virtual InitializedVariable BuildInitializedVariable(TypeReferenceExpression variableType, string variableName, Expression value)
		{
			InitializedVariable initializedVariable = new InitializedVariable();
			initializedVariable.Name = variableName;
			if (variableType != null)
			{
				initializedVariable.MemberType = variableType.ToString();
				initializedVariable.MemberTypeReference = variableType;
				initializedVariable.AddDetailNode(variableType);
			}
			initializedVariable.Expression = value;
			initializedVariable.AddDetailNode(value);
			return initializedVariable;
		}

		public virtual While BuildWhile(object condition)
		{
			While obj = new While();
			obj.SetCondition(GetExpression(condition));
			return obj;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement BuildStatement(object statement)
		{
			LanguageElement result = null;
			if (statement is Statement)
			{
				result = (Statement)statement;
			}
			else if (statement is string)
			{
				result = new SnippetCodeStatement((string)statement);
			}
			else if (statement is LanguageElement)
			{
				result = (LanguageElement)statement;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public static class ElementBuilderFactory
	{
		private static ParserLanguageID FromString(string language)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(language))
			{
				return ParserLanguageID.None;
			}
			try
			{
				return (ParserLanguageID)Enum.Parse(typeof(ParserLanguageID), language, ignoreCase: true);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return ParserLanguageID.None;
		}

		public static ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder(ParserLanguageID languageID)
		{
			switch (languageID)
			{
			default:
				return new ElementBuilder();
			case ParserLanguageID.Basic:
				return new VBElementBuilder();
			case ParserLanguageID.Html:
			case ParserLanguageID.Xaml:
			case ParserLanguageID.Xml:
			case ParserLanguageID.Css:
				return new AspElementBuilder();
			}
		}

		public static ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder(string language)
		{
			return CreateElementBuilder(FromString(language));
		}

		public static ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder()
		{
			return CreateElementBuilder(ParserLanguageID.None);
		}
	}
	public class VBElementBuilder : ElementBuilder
	{
		private const string VBSTR_SystemInt32 = "System.Int32";

		public override Method BuildMethod(string memberType, string name)
		{
			Method method = new VBMethod(memberType, name);
			SetMethodType(method, memberType);
			return method;
		}

		public override Event BuildEvent()
		{
			return new VBEvent();
		}

		public override Event BuildEvent(string name)
		{
			return new VBEvent(name);
		}

		public VBFor BuildFor(string iteratorVar, string toExpr, string stepExp)
		{
			VBFor vBFor = new VBFor();
			InitializedVariable element = BuildInitializedVariable("System.Int32", iteratorVar, "0");
			vBFor.AddInitializer(element);
			if (toExpr != null && toExpr != string.Empty)
			{
				Expression toExpression = new PrimitiveExpression(toExpr);
				vBFor.ToExpression = toExpression;
			}
			if (stepExp != null && stepExp != string.Empty)
			{
				Expression stepExpression = new PrimitiveExpression(stepExp);
				vBFor.StepExpression = stepExpression;
			}
			return vBFor;
		}

		public override For BuildFor(string iteratorVar, Expression endCondition)
		{
			return BuildFor(iteratorVar, ((BinaryOperatorExpression)endCondition).RightSide.Name, "1");
		}

		public override For BuildFor(Expression endCondition)
		{
			return BuildFor("i", endCondition);
		}

		public For AddFor(LanguageElement parent, string iteratorVar, string toExpr, string stepExp)
		{
			return (VBFor)AddNode(parent, BuildFor(iteratorVar, toExpr, stepExp));
		}

		public override Method BuildDestructor(string className)
		{
			Method method = base.BuildDestructor(className);
			method.Visibility = MemberVisibility.Protected;
			method.SetAccessSpecifiers(new AccessSpecifiers
			{
				IsOverride = true
			});
			return method;
		}
	}

	public interface IExpressionInverter
	{
		Expression Invert(Expression expression);
	}
	public abstract class ExpressionInverterBase : IExpressionInverter
	{
		protected virtual Expression InvertIsExpression(Is expression)
		{
			return DefaultInvert(expression);
		}

		protected virtual Expression InvertIsNotExpression(IsNot expression)
		{
			return DefaultInvert(expression);
		}

		protected virtual Expression InvertRelationalOperation(RelationalOperation expression)
		{
			RelationalOperator relationalOperator = RelationalOperation.InvertRelationalOperator(expression.RelationalOperator);
			if (relationalOperator == RelationalOperator.None)
			{
				return new LogicalInversion(expression);
			}
			return new RelationalOperation(expression.LeftSide, relationalOperator, expression.RightSide);
		}

		protected virtual Expression InvertExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression is Is)
			{
				return InvertIsExpression((Is)expression);
			}
			if (expression is IsNot)
			{
				return InvertIsNotExpression((IsNot)expression);
			}
			if (expression is RelationalOperation)
			{
				return InvertRelationalOperation((RelationalOperation)expression);
			}
			return DefaultInvert(expression);
		}

		public virtual Expression Invert(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return expression;
			}
			return InvertExpression(expression);
		}

		public static Expression DefaultInvert(Expression expression)
		{
			Expression expression2 = expression;
			if (expression2 is LogicalInversion)
			{
				Expression expression3 = ((LogicalInversion)expression2).Expression;
				if (expression3 is ParenthesizedExpression && !expression3.NeedsInvertParens)
				{
					expression3 = ((ParenthesizedExpression)expression3).Expression;
				}
				return expression3;
			}
			if (expression2.NeedsInvertParens)
			{
				expression2 = new ParenthesizedExpression(expression2);
			}
			return new LogicalInversion(expression2);
		}
	}
