	public class ComplexAndFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private IElementFilter[] _Filters;

		public ComplexAndFilter(IElementFilter[] filters)
		{
			if (filters == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("filters");
			}
			_Filters = filters;
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IElementFilter elementFilter = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < _Filters.Length; i++)
			{
				elementFilter = _Filters[i];
				if (elementFilter != null && !elementFilter.Apply(element))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IElementFilter elementFilter = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < _Filters.Length; i++)
			{
				elementFilter = _Filters[i];
				if (elementFilter != null && !elementFilter.SkipChildren(element))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class ComplexOrFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private IElementFilter[] _Filters;

		public ComplexOrFilter(IElementFilter[] filters)
		{
			if (filters == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("filters");
			}
			_Filters = filters;
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IElementFilter elementFilter = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < _Filters.Length; i++)
			{
				elementFilter = _Filters[i];
				if (elementFilter != null && elementFilter.Apply(element))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IElementFilter elementFilter = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < _Filters.Length; i++)
			{
				elementFilter = _Filters[i];
				if (elementFilter != null && elementFilter.SkipChildren(element))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ConstructorFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is IMethodElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DeclarationTester.IsConstructor(element);
		}
	}
	public class ConstStaticMembersOrTypesFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private bool _NonPrivate;

		private NonPrivateMemberFilter _NonPrivateFilter;

		public bool NonPrivate
		{
			set
			{
				_NonPrivate = value;
			}
		}

		public ConstStaticMembersOrTypesFilter()
			: this(nonPrivate: false)
		{
		}

		public ConstStaticMembersOrTypesFilter(bool nonPrivate)
		{
			_NonPrivate = nonPrivate;
			_NonPrivateFilter = new NonPrivateMemberFilter();
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			IMemberElement memberElement = element as IMemberElement;
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TypeDeclarationFilter.IsTypeDeclaration(element) || element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Const || memberElement.IsStatic)
			{
				if (_NonPrivate)
				{
					return _NonPrivateFilter.Apply(element);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		public static NonPrivateMemberFilter NonPrivateMember => ElementFilters.NonPrivateMember;

		public static MemberFilter Member => ElementFilters.Member;

		public static MethodFilter Method => ElementFilters.Method;

		public static PropertyFilter Property => ElementFilters.Property;

		public static EventFilter Event => ElementFilters.Event;

		public static ConstructorFilter Constructor => ElementFilters.Constructor;

		public static bool IsType(IElement element)

			return Type.Apply(element);

	public class DestructorFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is IMethodElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DeclarationTester.IsDestructor(element);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ElementFilterBase : IElementFilter, IElementCollectionFilter
	{
		public abstract bool Apply(IElement element);

		public virtual IElementCollection Apply(IElementCollection elements)
		{
			return ElementCollector.CollectElements(elements, this);
		}

		public virtual bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public sealed class ElementFilters
	{
		public static readonly TypeDeclarationFilter Type;

		public static readonly NamespaceFilter Namespace;

		public static readonly TypeOrNamespaceFilter TypeOrNamespace;

		public static readonly NonPrivateMemberFilter NonPrivateMember;

		public static readonly MemberFilter Member;

		public static readonly MethodFilter Method;

		public static readonly PropertyFilter Property;

		public static readonly EventFilter Event;

		public static readonly ConstructorFilter Constructor;

		public static readonly DestructorFilter Destructor;

		public static readonly FieldFilter Field;

		public static readonly LocalFilter Local;

		public static readonly PublicParameterLessMethodFilter PublicParameterLessMethod;

		private ElementFilters()
		{
		}

		static ElementFilters()
		{
			Type = new TypeDeclarationFilter();
			Namespace = new NamespaceFilter();
			TypeOrNamespace = new TypeOrNamespaceFilter();
			Member = new MemberFilter();
			NonPrivateMember = new NonPrivateMemberFilter();
			Method = new MethodFilter();
			Property = new PropertyFilter();
			Event = new EventFilter();
			Constructor = new ConstructorFilter();
			Destructor = new DestructorFilter();
			Field = new FieldFilter();
			Local = new LocalFilter();
			PublicParameterLessMethod = new PublicParameterLessMethodFilter();
		}

		public static bool IsVoidTypeRef(ITypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				if (!(type.Name == "void"))
				{
					return type.Name == "System.Void";
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsVoidType(ITypeElement type)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				return type.FullName == "System.Void";
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsType(IElement element)
		{
			return Type.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsNamespace(IElement element)
		{
			return Namespace.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsTypeOrNamespace(IElement element)
		{
			return TypeOrNamespace.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsNonPrivateMember(IElement element)
		{
			return NonPrivateMember.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsMember(IElement element)
		{
			return Member.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsExternMember(IElement element)
		{
			if (element is IMemberElement memberElement)
			{
				return memberElement.IsExtern;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsMethod(IElement element)
		{
			return Method.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsProperty(IElement element)
		{
			return Property.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsEvent(IElement element)
		{
			return Event.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsConstructor(IElement element)
		{
			return Constructor.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsField(IElement element)
		{
			return Field.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsLocal(IElement element)
		{
			return Local.Apply(element);
		}

		public static bool IsPublicParameterLessMethod(IElement element)
		{
			return PublicParameterLessMethod.Apply(element);
		}

	public class ElementRangeFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private SourceRange _Range;

		public ElementRangeFilter(SourceRange range)
		{
			_Range = range;
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			SourceRange range = SourceRange.Empty;
			if (element.Ranges != null && element.Ranges.Count > 0)
			{
				range = element.Ranges[0];
			}
			if (range.IsEmpty && element.NameRanges != null && element.NameRanges.Count > 0)
			{
				range = element.NameRanges[0];
			}
			return _Range.Contains(range);
		}
	}
	public class ReferenceFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private ElementRangeFilter _RangeFilter;

		private bool _HasThisOrBaseReferences;

		public bool HasThisOrBaseReferences => _HasThisOrBaseReferences;

		public ReferenceFilter(SourceRange range)
		{
			_RangeFilter = new ElementRangeFilter(range);
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (_RangeFilter != null && !_RangeFilter.Apply(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is IThisReferenceExpression)
			{
				_HasThisOrBaseReferences = true;
			}
			if (element is IBaseReferenceExpression)
			{
				_HasThisOrBaseReferences = true;
			}
			return DeclarationTester.IsReference(element);
		}
	}
	public class ElementTypeFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private LanguageElementType[] _Types;

		private Type[] _ObjectTypes;

		public ElementTypeFilter(LanguageElementType type)
		{
			_Types = new LanguageElementType[1];
			_Types[0] = type;
		}

		public ElementTypeFilter(LanguageElementType[] types)
		{
			_Types = types;
		}

		public ElementTypeFilter(Type type)
		{
			_ObjectTypes = new Type[1];
			_ObjectTypes[0] = type;
		}

		public ElementTypeFilter(Type[] types)
		{
			_ObjectTypes = types;
		}

		private bool FilterByElementType(IElement element)
		{
			if (_Types == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = element.ElementType;
			int num = _Types.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (elementType == _Types[i])
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool FilterByObjectType(IElement element)
		{
			if (_ObjectTypes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = _ObjectTypes.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (_ObjectTypes[i].IsInstanceOfType(element))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!FilterByElementType(element))
			{
				return FilterByObjectType(element);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public class FirstLevelReferenceFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is IWithSource))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IWithSource withSource = (IWithSource)element;
			return withSource.Source == null;
		}

	public class InversionFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private IElementFilter _Filter;

		public InversionFilter(IElementFilter filter)
		{
			if (filter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("filter");
			}
			_Filter = filter;
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !_Filter.Apply(element);
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !_Filter.SkipChildren(element);
		}
	}
	public class MemberFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			return IsMember(element);
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			return IsMember(element);
		}

		public static bool IsMember(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is ElaboratedTypeReference)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!TypeDeclarationFilter.IsTypeDeclaration(element) && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Method && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Property && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Event && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EnumElement && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Variable && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.InitializedVariable && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Const)
			{
				return element is IMemberElement;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class MemberVisibilityFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private IEnumerable<MemberVisibility> _Visibilities;

		public MemberVisibilityFilter(MemberVisibility visibility)
			: this(new MemberVisibility[1] { visibility })
		{
		}

		public MemberVisibilityFilter(IEnumerable<MemberVisibility> visibilities)
		{
			if (visibilities == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("visibilities");
			}
			_Visibilities = visibilities;
		}

		private bool VisibilityMatches(IElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is IMemberElement memberElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (MemberVisibility visibility in _Visibilities)
			{
				if (memberElement.Visibility == visibility)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MemberFilter.IsMember(element))
			{
				return VisibilityMatches(element);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		public override IElementCollection Apply(IElementCollection elements)

	public class ParameterLessMethodFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		public override bool Apply(IElement element)

			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;

			if (!(element is IMethodElement methodElement))
			{
				return false;

			{
				return methodElement.Parameters.Count == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override IElementCollection Apply(IElementCollection elements)
		{
			return ElementCollector.CollectElements(elements, this);
		}
	}
	public class PublicParameterLessMethodFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private ComplexAndFilter _Filter;

		public PublicParameterLessMethodFilter()
		{
			_Filter = BuildFilter();
		}

		private ComplexAndFilter BuildFilter()
		{
			MemberVisibilityFilter memberVisibilityFilter = new MemberVisibilityFilter(MemberVisibility.Public);
			ParameterLessMethodFilter parameterLessMethodFilter = new ParameterLessMethodFilter();
			return new ComplexAndFilter(new IElementFilter[2] { memberVisibilityFilter, parameterLessMethodFilter });
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _Filter.Apply(element);
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override IElementCollection Apply(IElementCollection elements)
		{
			return ElementCollector.CollectElements(elements, this);
		}
	}

	public class TypeElementsFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private TypeDeclaration _Scope;

		private bool _SearchBaseClasses;

		public TypeDeclaration Scope => _Scope;

		public TypeElementsFilter(TypeDeclaration scope)
			: this(scope, searchBaseClasses: false)
		{
		}

		public TypeElementsFilter(TypeDeclaration scope, bool searchBaseClasses)
		{
			_Scope = scope;
			_SearchBaseClasses = searchBaseClasses;
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (_Scope == null || element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _Scope.Declares(element, _SearchBaseClasses);
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override IElementCollection Apply(IElementCollection elements)
		{
			return ElementCollector.CollectElements(elements, this);
		}
	}
	public class TypeOrNamespaceFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		private TypeDeclarationFilter _TypeFilter;

		private NamespaceFilter _NamespaceFilter;

		public TypeOrNamespaceFilter()
		{
			_TypeFilter = new TypeDeclarationFilter();
			_NamespaceFilter = new NamespaceFilter();
		}

		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_TypeFilter.Apply(element))
			{
				return _NamespaceFilter.Apply(element);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			if (!_TypeFilter.SkipChildren(element))
			{
				return _NamespaceFilter.SkipChildren(element);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class UsingDeclarationFilter : ElementFilterBase
	{
		public override bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is INamespaceReference)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(element is IUsingDeclarationStatement usingDeclarationStatement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (usingDeclarationStatement.NamespaceReference == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

			{
				return element is IBaseVariable;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override IElementCollection Apply(IElementCollection elements)
		{
			return ElementCollector.CollectElements(elements, this);
		}
	}
	public class LocalNameFilter : IElementFilter
	{
		private SourceRange _Range;

		public LocalNameFilter(SourceRange range)
		{
			_Range = range;
		}

		public bool Apply(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_Range.Contains(element.FirstRange))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is BaseVariable)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ElementReferenceExpression && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MethodReferenceExpression && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.TypedElementReferenceExpression)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IReferenceExpression referenceExpression = (IReferenceExpression)element;
			return referenceExpression.Source == null;
		}

		public bool SkipChildren(IElement element)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public enum SymbolType
	{
		Letter,
		Digit,
		WhiteSpace,
		Others,
		Unknown
	}
	public sealed class CharUtils
	{
		private CharUtils()
		{
		}

		private static SymbolType ResolveSymbol(char ch)
		{
			if ((ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z'))
			{
				return SymbolType.Letter;
			}
			if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9')
			{
				return SymbolType.Digit;
			}
			if (ch == ';' || ch == '.' || ch == '{' || ch == '}')
			{
				return SymbolType.Others;
			}
			if (ch == '\t' || (uint)(ch - 11) <= 1u || ch == ' ')
			{
				return SymbolType.WhiteSpace;
			}
			return SymbolType.Unknown;
		}

		public static char Translate(char c)
		{
			if (c == '“' || c == '”')
			{
				c = '"';
			}
			switch (c)
			{
			case '\b':
			case '\t':
			case '\n':
			case '\r':
				return c;
			case ' ':
			case '!':
			case '"':
			case '#':
			case '$':
			case '%':
			case '&':
			case '\'':
			case '(':
			case ')':
			case '*':
			case '+':
			case ',':
			case '-':
			case '.':
			case '/':
			case '0':
			case '1':
			case '2':
			case '3':
			case '4':
			case '5':
			case '6':
			case '7':
			case '8':
			case '9':
			case ':':
			case ';':
			case '<':
			case '=':
			case '>':
			case '?':
			case '@':
			case 'A':
			case 'B':
			case 'C':
			case 'D':
			case 'E':
			case 'F':
			case 'G':
			case 'H':
			case 'I':
			case 'J':
			case 'K':
			case 'L':
			case 'M':
			case 'N':
			case 'O':
			case 'P':
			case 'Q':
			case 'R':
			case 'S':
			case 'T':
			case 'U':
			case 'V':
			case 'W':
			case 'X':
			case 'Y':
			case 'Z':
			case '[':
			case '\\':
			case ']':
			case '^':
			case '_':
			case '`':
			case 'a':
			case 'b':
			case 'c':
			case 'd':
			case 'e':
			case 'f':
			case 'g':
			case 'h':
			case 'i':
			case 'j':
			case 'k':
			case 'l':
			case 'm':
			case 'n':
			case 'o':
			case 'p':
			case 'q':
			case 'r':
			case 's':
			case 't':
			case 'u':
			case 'v':
			case 'w':
			case 'x':
			case 'y':
			case 'z':
			case '{':
			case '|':
			case '}':
			case '~':
				return c;
			default:
				switch (char.GetUnicodeCategory(c))
				{
				case UnicodeCategory.UppercaseLetter:
				case UnicodeCategory.LowercaseLetter:
				case UnicodeCategory.TitlecaseLetter:
				case UnicodeCategory.ModifierLetter:
				case UnicodeCategory.OtherLetter:
				case UnicodeCategory.LetterNumber:
					return 'w';
				case UnicodeCategory.NonSpacingMark:
				case UnicodeCategory.SpacingCombiningMark:
				case UnicodeCategory.DecimalDigitNumber:
				case UnicodeCategory.Format:
				case UnicodeCategory.ConnectorPunctuation:
					return '$';
				default:
					return '~';
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool IsNewLine(char ch)
		{
			if (ch == '\n' || ch == '\r' || (uint)(ch - 8232) <= 1u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsNewLine(string s)
		{
			switch (s)
			{
			case "\r":
			case "\n":
			case "\r\n":
			case "\u2028":
			case "\u2029":
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWhiteSpace(char ch)
		{
			switch (ResolveSymbol(ch))
			{
			case SymbolType.WhiteSpace:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			case SymbolType.Unknown:
			{
				UnicodeCategory unicodeCategory = char.GetUnicodeCategory(ch);
				if (unicodeCategory == UnicodeCategory.SpaceSeparator)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		public static bool IsLetter(char ch)
		{
			return ResolveSymbol(ch) switch
			{
				SymbolType.Letter => true, 
				SymbolType.Unknown => char.IsLetter(ch), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public static bool IsDigit(char ch)
		{
			return ResolveSymbol(ch) switch
			{
				SymbolType.Digit => true, 
				SymbolType.Unknown => char.IsDigit(ch), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public static bool IsLetterOrDigit(char ch)
		{
			switch (ResolveSymbol(ch))
			{
			case SymbolType.Letter:
			case SymbolType.Digit:
				return true;
			case SymbolType.Unknown:
				return char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}

	{
		Class,
		Struct,
		Enum,
		Interface
	}

		}

		{

			{

				{
					Log.SendWarning("CodeDomServices.get_CodeGenerator: CodeProvider is null!");
					return null;
				}
				return CodeProvider.CreateGenerator() as CodeGenerator;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (CodeProvider == null)
				{
					Log.SendWarning("CodeDomServices.CodeGeneratorAsObject: CodeProvider is null!");
					return null;
				}
				return CodeProvider.CreateGenerator();
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (CodeProvider == null)
				{
					Log.SendWarning("CodeDomServices.get_ICodeGenerator: CodeProvider is null!");
					return null;
				}
				return CodeProvider.CreateGenerator();
			}
		}

		{
			_CodeProvider = provider;
			_Options = options;
		}

		private object[] GetCodeGenMethodParameters(CodeGenParameterUsage usage, CodeObject target, CodeTypeDeclaration wrapper, object[] parameters)
		{
			return usage switch
			{
				CodeGenParameterUsage.Target => new object[1] { target }, 
				CodeGenParameterUsage.TargetWrapper => new object[2] { target, wrapper }, 
				CodeGenParameterUsage.ParameterList => parameters, 
				_ => new object[2] { target, wrapper }, 
			};
		}

		private void SetCodeGenContext(CodeTypeDeclaration type, CodeGenerationContext context)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				switch (context)
				{
				case CodeGenerationContext.Class:
					type.IsClass = true;
					break;
				case CodeGenerationContext.Interface:
					type.IsInterface = true;
					break;
				case CodeGenerationContext.Enum:
					type.IsEnum = true;
					break;
				case CodeGenerationContext.Struct:
					type.IsStruct = true;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private CodeTypeDeclaration GetCodeTypeWrapper(CodeObject target, CodeGenerationContext context)
		{
			string name = "WrapperType";
			if (target is CodeConstructor)
			{
				name = ((CodeConstructor)target).Name;
			}
			if (target is CodeTypeConstructor)
			{
				name = ((CodeTypeConstructor)target).Name;
			}
			CodeTypeDeclaration codeTypeDeclaration = new CodeTypeDeclaration(name);
			SetCodeGenContext(codeTypeDeclaration, context);
			return codeTypeDeclaration;
		}

		private void GetGeneratorTypeAndObject(out Type type, out object generator)
		{
			generator = CodeGenerator;
			type = null;
			if (generator != null)
			{
				type = typeof(CodeGenerator);
				return;
			}
			generator = CodeGeneratorAsObject;
			type = generator.GetType();
		}

		private void InvokeMethod(Type type, object target, string method, params object[] args)
		{
			MethodInfo method2 = type.GetMethod(method, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			method2.Invoke(target, args);
		}

		private void SetFieldValue(Type type, object target, string field, object value)
		{
			FieldInfo field2 = type.GetField(field, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			field2.SetValue(target, value);
		}

		private void PrepareGenerator(Type type, object generator, CodeTypeDeclaration wrapper, TextWriter output)
		{
			SetFieldValue(type, generator, "currentClass", wrapper);
			SetFieldValue(type, generator, "output", new IndentedTextWriter(output));
			SetFieldValue(type, generator, "options", _Options);
		}

		private void GenerateField(CodeObject target, TextWriter output, bool isEnum)
		{
			CodeGenerationContext context = CodeGenerationContext.Class;
			if (isEnum)
			{
				context = CodeGenerationContext.Enum;
			}
			GenerateCode("GenerateField", target, output, context, CodeGenParameterUsage.Target, null);
		}

		private void GenerateCode(string methodName, TextWriter output, object[] parameters)
		{
			GenerateCode(methodName, null, output, CodeGenerationContext.Class, CodeGenParameterUsage.ParameterList, parameters);
		}

		private void GenerateCode(string methodName, CodeObject target, TextWriter output)
		{
			GenerateCode(methodName, target, CodeGenerationContext.Class, output);
		}

		private void GenerateCode(string methodName, CodeObject target, CodeGenerationContext context, TextWriter output)
		{
			GenerateCode(methodName, target, output, context, CodeGenParameterUsage.TargetWrapper, null);
		}

		private void GenerateCode(string methodName, CodeObject target, TextWriter output, CodeGenerationContext context, CodeGenParameterUsage usage, object[] parameters)
		{
			try
			{
				if (CodeProvider != null)
				{
					GetGeneratorTypeAndObject(out var type, out var generator);
					CodeTypeDeclaration codeTypeWrapper = GetCodeTypeWrapper(target, context);
					object[] codeGenMethodParameters = GetCodeGenMethodParameters(usage, target, codeTypeWrapper, parameters);
					PrepareGenerator(type, generator, codeTypeWrapper, output);
					InvokeMethod(type, generator, methodName, codeGenMethodParameters);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException(value);
			}
		}

	public class DeclarationTester
	{
		private DeclarationTester()
		{
		}

		private static bool IsMethodReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MethodReferenceExpression && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.PointerMethodReference)
			{
				return element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.QualifiedMethodReference;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsElementReference(ILocalDeclaration declaration, IElement element)
		{
			if (!IsElementReference(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (declaration.IsImplicit && declaration.IsReturnedValue)
			{
				IExpression expression = (IExpression)element;
				if (expression.IsStatement || IsMethodReference(element))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsSizeOfExpresion(IElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && element.Parent != null)
			{
				return element.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.SizeOfExpression;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsHtmlReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				return element is HtmlAttribute;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsKeywordReference(IElement declaration, IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (declaration != null && string.Compare(declaration.Name, element.Name) == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is IReferenceExpression referenceExpression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (referenceExpression.Source != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsKeyword(referenceExpression.Name))
			{
				return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsKeywordElement(referenceExpression);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsSuitableForLocalReference(ILocalDeclaration declaration, IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || !IsElementReference(declaration, element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsKeywordReference(declaration, element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsArgumentNameSpecifier(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is IWithSource withSource))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (withSource.Source != null)
			{
				if (withSource is IReferenceExpression { IsMulOperator: not false })
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (declaration is IQueryIdent)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsArgumentNameSpecifier(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element.Parent is IAttributeVariableInitializer { LeftSide: var leftSide }))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return leftSide?.Equals(element) ?? false;
		}

		public static bool IsSuitableForFieldReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsElementReference(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsKeywordReference(null, element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsSuitableForTypeDefReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsTypeReference(element))
			{
				return IsElementReference(element);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsElementReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = element.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.ElementReferenceExpression && elementType != LanguageElementType.PointerElementReference && elementType != LanguageElementType.QualifiedNestedReference && elementType != LanguageElementType.CppQualifiedElementReference && elementType != LanguageElementType.MemberInitializerExpression && elementType != LanguageElementType.TypedElementReferenceExpression && !IsMethodReference(element))
			{
				return IsSizeOfExpresion(element);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsTypeReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = element.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.TypeReferenceExpression && elementType != LanguageElementType.ElementReferenceExpression && elementType != LanguageElementType.PointerElementReference && elementType != LanguageElementType.QualifiedNestedReference && elementType != LanguageElementType.CppQualifiedElementReference && elementType != LanguageElementType.QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression && elementType != LanguageElementType.QualifiedNestedTypeReference && elementType != LanguageElementType.Attribute)
			{
				return elementType == LanguageElementType.TypedElementReferenceExpression;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsTypeReference(element) && !IsElementReference(element))
			{
				return IsHtmlReference(element);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsConstructor(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is IMethodElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IMethodElement methodElement = (IMethodElement)element;
			return methodElement.IsConstructor;
		}

		public static bool IsDestructor(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is IMethodElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IMethodElement methodElement = (IMethodElement)element;
			return methodElement.IsDestructor;
		}

		public static bool DeclarationIsValid(IElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Variable && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Volatile && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.InitializedVariable && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.InitializedVolatile && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ImplicitVariable && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.LambdaImplicitlyTypedParam && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.QueryIdent && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Const && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ConstVolatile && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Parameter && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Method && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MethodPrototype && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Property && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Event && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Class && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ManagedClass && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ManagedStruct && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ValueClass && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ValueStruct && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Union && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Struct && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Interface && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.InterfaceClass && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.InterfaceStruct && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Module && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Enum && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EnumElement && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Delegate && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.TypeParameter && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.TypenameTypeParameter && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Namespace && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.BitFieldConst && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.BitFieldVariable)
				{
					return element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.BitFieldVolatile;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum ElementCollectorFlags
	{
		Recursive = 1,
		CheckRootNode = 2,
		IterateChildren = 4
	}
	public sealed class ElementCollector
	{
		private static ElementCollectorFlags DirectChildren => ElementCollectorFlags.IterateChildren;

		private static ElementCollectorFlags AllChildren => DirectChildren | ElementCollectorFlags.Recursive;

		private static ElementCollectorFlags AllChildrenWithScopeCheck => AllChildren | ElementCollectorFlags.CheckRootNode;

		private ElementCollector()
		{
		}

		private static bool IsDefined(ElementCollectorFlags flags, ElementCollectorFlags value)
		{
			return (flags & value) == value;
		}

		private static void Collect(IElementCollection collector, IElement scope, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			if (collector == null || scope == null || filter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (filter.Apply(scope))
			{
				collector.Add(scope);
			}
			IElementCollection children = scope.Children;
			if (children != null)
			{
				int count = children.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					Collect(collector, children[i], filter);
				}
			}
		}

		public static IElementCollection Collect(IElement scope, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
			if (scope == null)
			{
				return elementCollection;
			}
			Collect(elementCollection, scope, filter);
			return elementCollection;
		}

		public static IElementCollection CollectDirectChildren(IElement scope, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
			CollectElements(elementCollection, scope, filter, DirectChildren);
			return elementCollection;
		}

		public static IElementCollection CollectDirectChildren(IElementCollection scopeList, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
			if (scopeList == null)
			{
				return elementCollection;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < scopeList.Count; i++)
			{
				IElement scope = scopeList[i];
				CollectElements(elementCollection, scope, filter, DirectChildren);
			}
			return elementCollection;
		}

		public static IElementCollection CollectAllChildren(IElement scope, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
			CollectElements(elementCollection, scope, filter, AllChildren);
			return elementCollection;
		}

		public static IElementCollection CollectElements(IElementCollection list, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			return Filter(list, filter);
		}

		public static void CollectElements(IElementCollection list, IElementCollection nodes, IElementFilter filter, ElementCollectorFlags flags)
		{
			if (list == null || nodes == null || filter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				IElement element = nodes[i];
				if (element != null && filter.Apply(element))
				{
					list.Add(element);
					if (IsDefined(flags, ElementCollectorFlags.Recursive))
					{
						CollectElements(list, element, filter, flags & ~ElementCollectorFlags.CheckRootNode);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void CollectElements(IElementCollection list, IElement scope, IElementFilter filter, ElementCollectorFlags flags)
		{
			if (list != null && scope != null && filter != null)
			{
				if (IsDefined(flags, ElementCollectorFlags.CheckRootNode) && filter.Apply(scope))
				{
					list.Add(scope);
				}
				if (IsDefined(flags, ElementCollectorFlags.IterateChildren))
				{
					CollectElements(list, scope.Children, filter, flags);
				}
			}
		}

		public static IElementCollection Filter(ICollection list, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
			foreach (object item in list)
			{
				if (item is IElement element && filter.Apply(element))
				{
					elementCollection.Add(element);
				}
			}
			return elementCollection;
		}
	}
	internal class PathPart
	{
		private string _Name;

		private LanguageElement _Element;

		public string Name => _Name;

		public LanguageElement Element => _Element;

		public PathPart(string name, LanguageElement element)
		{
			_Name = name;
			_Element = element;
		}
	}
	internal class ElementLocation
	{
		protected ElementLocation()
		{
		}

		private static bool IsEmptyDocText(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is XmlText xmlText))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string value = xmlText.Text.Trim();
			return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value);
		}

		private static int GetClearElementIndex(LanguageElement element)
		{
			LanguageElement parent = element.Parent;
			if (!(parent is XmlNode))
			{
				return element.Index;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int nodeCount = parent.NodeCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = parent.Nodes[i] as LanguageElement;
				if (languageElement == element)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (IsEmptyDocText(languageElement))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return element.Index - num;
		}

		private static System.Xml.XmlNode CreateXmlNode(XmlDocument doc, string name, bool isDetailNode, int index, string signature)
		{
			System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode = doc.CreateNode(System.Xml.XmlNodeType.Element, name, string.Empty);
			System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = doc.CreateAttribute("isDetail");
			xmlAttribute.Value = isDetailNode.ToString();
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
			xmlAttribute = doc.CreateAttribute("index");
			xmlAttribute.Value = index.ToString();
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
			xmlAttribute = doc.CreateAttribute("signature");
			xmlAttribute.Value = signature;
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
			return xmlNode;
		}

		private static System.Xml.XmlNode CreateXmlNodeForFile(XmlDocument doc, SourceFile file)
		{
			if (file == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode = doc.CreateNode(System.Xml.XmlNodeType.Element, "file", string.Empty);
			System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = doc.CreateAttribute("path");
			xmlAttribute.Value = file.FilePath;
			xmlNode.Attributes.Append(xmlAttribute);
			return xmlNode;
		}

		private static bool CanBeMoved(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element is IMethodElement || element is IPropertyElement || element is IDelegateElement)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static System.Xml.XmlNode GetXmlNodeForElement(XmlDocument doc, string nodeName, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nodeName) || element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool isDetailNode = element.IsDetailNode;
			int index = -1;
			if (!CanBeMoved(element))
			{
				index = GetClearElementIndex(element);
			}
			string signature = SignatureBuilder.GetSignature(element);
			return CreateXmlNode(doc, nodeName, isDetailNode, index, signature);
		}

		private static System.Xml.XmlNode CreateXmlNodeForCurrent(XmlDocument doc, PathPart part)
		{
			if (part.Name == "file")
			{
				return CreateXmlNodeForFile(doc, part.Element as SourceFile);
			}
			return GetXmlNodeForElement(doc, part.Name, part.Element);
		}

		private static void CollectParents(ArrayList parents, LanguageElement element)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = element;
			while (languageElement != null)
			{
				string name = "scope";
				if (languageElement == element)
				{
					name = "element";
				}
				else if (languageElement is SourceFile)
				{
					name = "file";
				}
				parents.Add(new PathPart(name, languageElement));
				if (languageElement is SupportElement)
				{
					SupportElement supportElement = (SupportElement)languageElement;
					LanguageElement targetNode = supportElement.TargetNode;
					if (targetNode != null && CanBeMoved(targetNode))
					{
						parents.Add(new PathPart("target", targetNode));
						languageElement = targetNode;
					}
				}
				if (!(languageElement is SourceFile))
				{
					languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void BuildLocation(XmlDocument doc, LanguageElement element)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			CollectParents(arrayList, element);
			if (arrayList == null || arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode = null;
			int count = arrayList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode2 = CreateXmlNodeForCurrent(doc, arrayList[i] as PathPart);
				if (xmlNode2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (xmlNode != null)
				{
					xmlNode2.AppendChild(xmlNode);
				}
				xmlNode = xmlNode2;
			}
			if (xmlNode != null)
			{
				doc.AppendChild(xmlNode);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsTarget(System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode != null)
			{
				return string.Compare(xmlNode.Name, "target", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsFile(System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode != null)
			{
				return string.Compare(xmlNode.Name, "file", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static SourceFile LocateFile(IProjectElement proj, System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode == null || !IsFile(xmlNode))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string value = xmlNode.Attributes["path"].Value;
			if (proj != null)
			{
				return proj.FindDiskFile(value) as SourceFile;
			}
			ISolutionElement activeSolution = StructuralParserServicesHolder.ActiveSolution;
			if (activeSolution == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (IProjectElement project in activeSolution.Projects)
			{
				ISourceFile sourceFile = project.FindDiskFile(value);
				if (sourceFile != null)
				{
					return sourceFile as SourceFile;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static LanguageElement FindElementByClearIndex(NodeList nodes, int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = -1;
			int count = nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = nodes[i] as LanguageElement;
				if (!IsEmptyDocText(languageElement))
				{
					num++;
					if (num >= index)
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool CompareSignature(LanguageElement element, string signature)
		{
			if (element == null || signature == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string signature2 = SignatureBuilder.GetSignature(element);
			if (signature2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return string.Compare(signature2, signature, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0;
		}

		private static LanguageElement LocateElementBySignature(NodeList nodes, string signature)
		{
			if (nodes == null || signature == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement && CompareSignature(languageElement, signature))
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static LanguageElement LocateElement(NodeList nodes, System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = xmlNode.Attributes["index"];
			if (xmlAttribute != null)
			{
				int num = int.Parse(xmlAttribute.Value);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					languageElement = FindElementByClearIndex(nodes, num);
				}
			}
			System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute2 = xmlNode.Attributes["signature"];
			if (xmlAttribute2 != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(xmlAttribute2.Value))
			{
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					if (CompareSignature(languageElement, xmlAttribute2.Value))
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return LocateElementBySignature(nodes, xmlAttribute2.Value);
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private static bool IsElementNode(System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode != null)
			{
				if (string.Compare(xmlNode.Name, "scope", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) != 0 && string.Compare(xmlNode.Name, "element", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) != 0)
				{
					return string.Compare(xmlNode.Name, "target", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static LanguageElement LocateElement(LanguageElement context, System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (context == null || !IsElementNode(xmlNode))
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = xmlNode.Attributes["isDetail"];
			if (xmlAttribute != null)
			{
				if (bool.Parse(xmlAttribute.Value))
				{
					return LocateElement(context.DetailNodes, xmlNode);
				}
				return LocateElement(context.Nodes, xmlNode);
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = LocateElement(context.Nodes, xmlNode);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = LocateElement(context.DetailNodes, xmlNode);
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private static LanguageElement LocateElementForTarget(LanguageElement context, System.Xml.XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (!(context is CodeElement codeElement) || xmlNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Xml.XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = xmlNode.Attributes["signature"];
			if (xmlAttribute == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string value = xmlAttribute.Value;
			if (CompareSignature(codeElement.DocComment, value))
			{
				return codeElement.DocComment;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < codeElement.CommentCount; i++)
			{
				if (CompareSignature(codeElement.Comments[i], value))
				{
					return codeElement.Comments[i];
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < codeElement.AttributeCount; j++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = codeElement.Attributes[j] as LanguageElement;
				if (CompareSignature(languageElement, value))
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static LanguageElement RestoreElementRecursively(LanguageElement context, System.Xml.XmlNode xmlContext)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = context;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = null;
			while (xmlContext != null)
			{
				if (languageElement2 != null)
				{
					languageElement = LocateElementForTarget(languageElement, xmlContext);
					languageElement2 = null;
				}
				else
				{
					languageElement = LocateElement(languageElement, xmlContext);
				}
				if (IsTarget(xmlContext))
				{
					languageElement2 = languageElement;
				}
				if (languageElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				xmlContext = ((xmlContext.ChildNodes.Count > 0) ? xmlContext.ChildNodes[0] : null);
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private static LanguageElement RestoreElement(IProjectElement proj, System.Xml.XmlNode xmlContext)
		{
			if (xmlContext == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement context = LocateFile(proj, xmlContext);
			xmlContext = ((xmlContext.ChildNodes.Count > 0) ? xmlContext.ChildNodes[0] : null);
			return RestoreElementRecursively(context, xmlContext);
		}

		private static LanguageElement RestoreElement(SourceFile file, System.Xml.XmlNode xmlContext)
		{
			if (file == null || xmlContext == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (IsFile(xmlContext))
			{
				xmlContext = ((xmlContext.ChildNodes.Count > 0) ? xmlContext.ChildNodes[0] : null);
			}
			return RestoreElementRecursively(file, xmlContext);
		}

		public static string GetFileLocation(LanguageElement element)
		{
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			BuildLocation(xmlDocument, element);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			StringWriter stringWriter = new StringWriter(stringBuilder);
			XmlTextWriter xmlTextWriter = new XmlTextWriter(stringWriter);
			try
			{
				xmlDocument.WriteTo(xmlTextWriter);
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			finally
			{
				stringWriter.Close();
				xmlTextWriter.Close();
			}
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum BlockElements
	{
		None = 0,
		Attributes = 1,
		XmlDocComments = 2,
		SupportComments = 4,
		Region = 8,
		LeadingWhiteSpace = 0x10,
		TrailingWhiteSpace = 0x20,
		LeadingEmptyLines = 0x40,
		TrailingEmptyLines = 0x80,
		WithoutUnsuitableRegions = 0x100,
		AllSupportElements = 7,
		AllLeadingWhiteSpaces = 0x50,
		AllTrailingWhiteSpaces = 0xA0,
		AllWhiteSpaces = 0xF0,
		All = 0xFF
	}
	public sealed class ElementRangeHelper
	{
		private class ParentRegionCache
		{
			public RegionDirective CurrentRegion;

			public SourceRange CurrentRegionRange;

			public RegionDirective NodeRegion;

			public SourceRange NodeRegionRange;

			public static ParentRegionCache Create(LanguageElement current, LanguageElement node)
			{
				RegionDirective regionDirective = null;
				SourceRange currentRegionRange = SourceRange.Empty;
				if (current != null)
				{
					regionDirective = current.ParentRegion;
					currentRegionRange = regionDirective?.Range ?? SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				RegionDirective regionDirective2 = null;
				SourceRange nodeRegionRange = SourceRange.Empty;
				if (node != null)
				{
					regionDirective2 = node.ParentRegion;
					nodeRegionRange = regionDirective2?.Range ?? SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				ParentRegionCache parentRegionCache = new ParentRegionCache();
				parentRegionCache.CurrentRegion = regionDirective;
				parentRegionCache.CurrentRegionRange = currentRegionRange;
				parentRegionCache.NodeRegion = regionDirective2;
				parentRegionCache.NodeRegionRange = nodeRegionRange;
				return parentRegionCache;
			}

			public void Update(LanguageElement current, LanguageElement node)
			{
				if (current != null && !CurrentRegionRange.Contains(current.Range))
				{
					CurrentRegion = current.ParentRegion;
					CurrentRegionRange = ((CurrentRegion == null) ? SourceRange.Empty : CurrentRegion.Range);
				}
				if (node != null && !NodeRegionRange.Contains(node.Range))
				{
					NodeRegion = node.ParentRegion;
					NodeRegionRange = ((NodeRegion == null) ? SourceRange.Empty : NodeRegion.Range);
				}
			}
		}

		public const BlockElements DefaultBlockElements = BlockElements.Attributes | BlockElements.XmlDocComments | BlockElements.Region;

		private ElementRangeHelper()
		{
		}

		private static bool IsOptionSet(BlockElements target, BlockElements option)
		{
			return (target & option) == option;
		}

		private static bool CanIncludeNode(LanguageElement node, BlockElements blockElements)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BlockElements blockElements2 = ToBlockElements(node);
			if (blockElements2 == BlockElements.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (blockElements & blockElements2) == blockElements2;
		}

		private static bool ContainsOtherCode(LanguageElement element, RegionDirective directive)
		{
			if (element == null || directive == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceRange range = directive.Range;
			LanguageElement parent = element.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement childAfter = parent.GetChildAfter(range.Start);
			if (childAfter == null || !range.Contains(childAfter.Range))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = childAfter;
			if (languageElement is SupportElement)
			{
				languageElement = childAfter.NextCodeSibling;
			}
			if (languageElement == null || !range.Contains(languageElement.Range))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (languageElement.Range != element.Range)
			{
				return true;
			}
			languageElement = languageElement.NextCodeSibling;
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				return range.Contains(languageElement.Range);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckOtherCodeInRegions(RegionDirective nodeRegion, RegionDirective region, LanguageElement current)
		{
			if (!RegionDirective.Equals(nodeRegion, region))
			{
				return ContainsOtherCode(current, region);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool BreaksRegions(LanguageElement node, LanguageElement current, BlockElements blockElements)
		{
			if (node == null || current == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RegionDirective parentRegion = current.ParentRegion;
			RegionDirective parentRegion2 = node.ParentRegion;
			return BreaksRegions(node, current, blockElements, parentRegion, parentRegion2);
		}

		private static bool BreaksRegions(LanguageElement node, LanguageElement current, BlockElements blockElements, RegionDirective currentRegion, RegionDirective nodeRegion)
		{
			if (node == null || current == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentRegion == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsOptionSet(blockElements, BlockElements.Region))
			{
				return CheckOtherCodeInRegions(nodeRegion, currentRegion, current);
			}
			if (currentRegion.Contains(node.Range))
			{
				return CheckOtherCodeInRegions(nodeRegion, currentRegion, current);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static LanguageElement ExpandToDeclarationListStart(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return node;
			}
			if (!(node is Variable))
			{
				return node;
			}
			Variable variable = (Variable)node;
			if (!variable.IsInDeclarationList)
			{
				return node;
			}
			return variable.FirstVariable;
		}

		private static LanguageElement ExpandToDeclarationListEnd(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return node;
			}
			if (!(node is Variable))
			{
				return node;
			}
			Variable variable = (Variable)node;
			if (!variable.IsInDeclarationList)
			{
				return node;
			}
			return variable.LastVariable;
		}

		private static bool HasDirectivesBetweenNodes(LanguageElement start, LanguageElement end)
		{
			if (start == null || end == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceFile fileNode = start.FileNode;
			if (fileNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CompilerDirectiveCollection compilerDirectives = fileNode.CompilerDirectives;
			if (compilerDirectives == null || compilerDirectives.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceRange logicalRange = new SourceRange(start.Range.End, end.Range.Start).LogicalRange;
			int count = compilerDirectives.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				CompilerDirective compilerDirective = compilerDirectives[i];
				if (compilerDirective != null && logicalRange.Contains(compilerDirective.Range.Start))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static LanguageElement ExpandStartNode(LanguageElement node, BlockElements blockElements, bool includeComplitingElements, out LanguageElement target)
		{
			node = ExpandToDeclarationListStart(node);
			LanguageElement result = node;
			target = node;
			LanguageElement languageElement = node;
			ParentRegionCache parentRegionCache = ParentRegionCache.Create(languageElement, node);
			while (languageElement != null)
			{
				if (languageElement.CompletesPrevious && includeComplitingElements)
				{
					languageElement = languageElement.PreviousSibling;
					node = languageElement;
					target = languageElement;
					result = languageElement;
					continue;
				}
				LanguageElement previousSibling = languageElement.PreviousSibling;
				if (!IsAttachedToTarget(previousSibling, node) || HasDirectivesBetweenNodes(previousSibling, languageElement))
				{
					break;
				}
				languageElement = previousSibling;
				parentRegionCache.Update(languageElement, node);
				if (CanIncludeNode(languageElement, blockElements) && !BreaksRegions(node, languageElement, blockElements, parentRegionCache.CurrentRegion, parentRegionCache.NodeRegion))
				{
					result = languageElement;
				}
				if (HasBadRegionBetweenNodes(languageElement, blockElements))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static bool HasBadRegionBetweenNodes(LanguageElement currentElement, BlockElements blockElements)
		{
			if (currentElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RegionDirective parentRegion = currentElement.ParentRegion;
			if (parentRegion == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsValidRegion(currentElement, parentRegion, blockElements))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static LanguageElement ExpandEndNode(LanguageElement node, BlockElements blockElements, bool includeComplitingElements, out LanguageElement target)
		{
			node = ExpandToDeclarationListEnd(node);
			LanguageElement result = node;
			target = node;
			LanguageElement languageElement = node;
			ParentRegionCache parentRegionCache = ParentRegionCache.Create(languageElement, node);
			while (languageElement != null)
			{
				if (languageElement.NextSibling != null && languageElement.NextSibling.CompletesPrevious && includeComplitingElements)
				{
					languageElement = languageElement.NextSibling;
					node = languageElement;
					target = languageElement;
					result = languageElement;
					continue;
				}
				languageElement = languageElement.NextSibling;
				if (!IsAttachedToTarget(languageElement, node))
				{
					break;
				}
				parentRegionCache.Update(languageElement, node);
				if (CanIncludeNode(languageElement, blockElements) && !BreaksRegions(node, languageElement, blockElements, parentRegionCache.CurrentRegion, parentRegionCache.NodeRegion))
				{
					result = languageElement;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static SourceRange GetFullBlockRange(IDocument document, LanguageElement startNode, LanguageElement endNode, BlockElements blockElements)
		{
			int startLine = startNode.StartLine;
			int startOffset = startNode.StartOffset;
			int endLine = endNode.EndLine;
			int endOffset = endNode.EndOffset;
			SourceRange sourceRange = new SourceRange(startLine, startOffset, endLine, endOffset);
			if (document == null)
			{
				return sourceRange;
			}
			if (IsOptionSet(blockElements, BlockElements.LeadingWhiteSpace))
			{
				sourceRange = document.IncludeLeadingWhiteSpace(sourceRange);
			}
			if (IsOptionSet(blockElements, BlockElements.TrailingWhiteSpace))
			{
				sourceRange = document.IncludeTrailingWhiteSpace(sourceRange);
			}
			if (IsOptionSet(blockElements, BlockElements.LeadingEmptyLines))
			{
				sourceRange = document.IncludePrecedingEmptyLines(sourceRange);
			}
			if (IsOptionSet(blockElements, BlockElements.TrailingEmptyLines))
			{
				sourceRange = document.IncludeTrailingEmptyLines(sourceRange);
			}
			return sourceRange;
		}

		private static LanguageElement GetNext(LanguageElement startNode, LanguageElement target)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = startNode.NextSibling;
			while (languageElement != null && IsAttachedToTarget(languageElement, target))
			{
				languageElement = languageElement.NextSibling;
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = startNode.Parent;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private static LanguageElement GetPrevious(LanguageElement startNode, LanguageElement target)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = startNode.PreviousSibling;
			while (languageElement != null && IsAttachedToTarget(languageElement, target))
			{
				languageElement = languageElement.PreviousSibling;
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = startNode.Parent;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private static void IncludeRegion(BlockElements blockElements, LanguageElement region, LanguageElement previous, LanguageElement next, ref LanguageElement node)
		{
			while (CanIncludeNode(region, blockElements) && !region.Range.IsEmpty && (previous is SourceFile || next is SourceFile || (!region.Contains(previous.Range.Start) && !region.Contains(previous.Range.End) && !region.Contains(next.Range.Start) && !region.Contains(next.Range.End))))
			{
				node = region;
				region = region.Parent as RegionDirective;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsAttachedToTarget(LanguageElement node, LanguageElement target)
		{
			if (node == null || target == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node is SupportElement supportElement)
			{
				return supportElement.TargetNode == target;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static BlockElements ToBlockElements(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node is Attribute || node is AttributeSection)
			{
				return BlockElements.Attributes;
			}
			if (node is XmlDocComment)
			{
				return BlockElements.XmlDocComments;
			}
			if (node is Comment)
			{
				return BlockElements.SupportComments;
			}
			if (node is RegionDirective)
			{
				return BlockElements.Region;
			}
			return BlockElements.None;
		}

		public static void GetFullBlockNodes(LanguageElement element, out LanguageElement startNode, out LanguageElement endNode)
		{
			GetFullBlockNodes(element, BlockElements.Attributes | BlockElements.XmlDocComments | BlockElements.Region, out startNode, out endNode);
		}

		public static void GetFullBlockNodes(LanguageElement element, BlockElements blockElements, out LanguageElement startNode, out LanguageElement endNode)
		{
			GetFullBlockNodes(element, blockElements, includeComplitingElements: true, out startNode, out endNode);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void GetFullBlockNodes(LanguageElement element, BlockElements blockElements, bool includeComplitingElements, out LanguageElement startNode, out LanguageElement endNode)
		{
			startNode = ExpandStartNode(element, blockElements, includeComplitingElements, out var target);
			endNode = ExpandEndNode(element, blockElements, includeComplitingElements, out var target2);
			LanguageElement previous = GetPrevious(startNode, target);
			LanguageElement next = GetNext(endNode, target2);
			RegionDirective parentRegion = startNode.ParentRegion;
			if (IsValidRegion(element, parentRegion, blockElements))
			{
				RegionDirective parentRegion2 = endNode.ParentRegion;
				IncludeRegion(blockElements, parentRegion, previous, next, ref startNode);
				IncludeRegion(blockElements, parentRegion2, previous, next, ref endNode);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsValidRegion(LanguageElement element, RegionDirective startRegion, BlockElements blockElements)
		{
			if (!IsOptionSet(blockElements, BlockElements.WithoutUnsuitableRegions))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (startRegion == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string name = element.Name;
			string name2 = startRegion.Name;
			if (MatchName(name, name2))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool MatchName(string elementName, string startRegionName)
		{
			if (elementName == null || startRegionName == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = elementName.Trim();
			string text2 = startRegionName.Trim();
			if (elementName == string.Empty || startRegionName == string.Empty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			text = text.ToLower();
			text2 = text2.ToLower();
			if (text == text2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetFullBlockRange(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return GetFullBlockRange(element, BlockElements.Attributes | BlockElements.XmlDocComments | BlockElements.Region);
		}

		public static SourceRange GetFullBlockRange(LanguageElement element, BlockElements blockElements)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			GetFullBlockNodes(element, blockElements, out var startNode, out var endNode);
			return GetFullBlockRange(element.Document, startNode, endNode, blockElements);
		}
	}

	public abstract class FullDirective
	{
		public enum FullDirectiveType
		{
			FullRegion,
			FullIf
		}

		private List<FullDirective> _NestedFull;

		private FullDirective _ParentFull;

		private SourceRange _Range;

		public abstract List<PreprocessorDirective> SimpleDirectives { get; }

		public abstract PreprocessorDirective FirstSimple { get; }

		public abstract PreprocessorDirective LastSimple { get; }

		public List<FullDirective> NestedFull => _NestedFull;

		public FullDirective ParentFull
		{
			get
			{
				return _ParentFull;
			}
			set
			{
				_ParentFull = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange Range
		{
			get
			{
				return _Range;
			}
			set
			{
				_Range = value;
			}
		}

		public int StartLine => _Range.Start.Line;

		public int EndLine => _Range.End.Line;

		public abstract FullDirectiveType FullType { get; }

		public FullDirective()
		{
			_NestedFull = new List<FullDirective>();
		}

		public FullDirective GoToNextFull()
		{
			FullDirective fullDirective = this;
			bool flag = false;
			FullDirective parentFull;
			int num;
			while (true)
			{
				if (!flag && fullDirective.NestedFull.Count > 0)
				{
					return fullDirective.NestedFull[0];
				}
				parentFull = fullDirective.ParentFull;
				if (parentFull == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = parentFull.NestedFull.IndexOf(fullDirective);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (num < parentFull.NestedFull.Count - 1)
				{
					break;
				}
				fullDirective = parentFull;
				flag = true;
			}
			return parentFull.NestedFull[++num];
		}
	}
	public class FullIfDirective : FullDirective
	{
		private IfDirective _IfDirective;

		private List<ElifDirective> _ElifDirectives;

		private ElseDirective _ElseDirective;

		private EndIfDirective _EndifDirective;

		public override List<PreprocessorDirective> SimpleDirectives
		{
			get
			{
				List<PreprocessorDirective> list = new List<PreprocessorDirective> { IfDirective };
				foreach (ElifDirective elifDirective in ElifDirectives)
				{
					list.Add(elifDirective);
				}
				if (ElseDirective != null)
				{
					list.Add(ElseDirective);
				}
				list.Add(EndifDirective);
				return list;
			}
		}

		public override PreprocessorDirective FirstSimple => IfDirective;

		public override PreprocessorDirective LastSimple => EndifDirective;

		public IfDirective IfDirective
		{
			get
			{
				return _IfDirective;
			}
			set
			{
				_IfDirective = value;
			}
		}

		public List<ElifDirective> ElifDirectives => _ElifDirectives;

		public ElseDirective ElseDirective
		{
			get
			{
				return _ElseDirective;
			}
			set
			{
				_ElseDirective = value;
			}
		}

		public EndIfDirective EndifDirective
		{
			get
			{
				return _EndifDirective;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndifDirective = value;
			}
		}

		public PreprocessorDirective SimpleIsSatisfied
		{
			get
			{
				if (IfDirective != null && IfDirective.ExpressionValue)
				{
					return IfDirective;
				}
				foreach (ElifDirective elifDirective in ElifDirectives)
				{
					if (elifDirective.ExpressionValue)
					{
						return elifDirective;
					}
				}
				if (ElseDirective != null)
				{
					return ElseDirective;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public PreprocessorDirective SimpleAfterSimpleIsSatisfied
		{
			get
			{
				List<PreprocessorDirective> simpleDirectives = SimpleDirectives;
				return simpleDirectives[simpleDirectives.IndexOf(SimpleIsSatisfied) + 1];
			}
		}

		public override FullDirectiveType FullType => FullDirectiveType.FullIf;

		public FullIfDirective()
		{
			_ElifDirectives = new List<ElifDirective>();
		}
	}

	}

	internal class MemoryHelper
	{
		private const int INT_ObjectHeaderSize = 8;

		private const int INT_ReferenceSize = 4;

		private const int INT_Byte = 1;

		private const int INT_SByte = 1;

		private const int INT_Int16 = 2;

		private const int INT_UInt16 = 2;

		private const int INT_Int32 = 4;

		private const int INT_UInt32 = 4;

		private const int INT_Int64 = 8;

		private const int INT_UInt64 = 8;

		private const int INT_Char = 2;

		private const int INT_Single = 4;

		private const int INT_Double = 8;

		private const int INT_Decimal = 16;

		private const int INT_Boolean = 1;

		private const int INT_SourcePoint = 17;

		private const int INT_SourceRange = 34;

		private const string STR_Byte = "System.Byte";

		private const string STR_SByte = "System.SByte";

		private const string STR_Int16 = "System.Int16";

		private const string STR_UInt16 = "System.UInt16";

		private const string STR_Int32 = "System.Int32";

		private const string STR_UInt32 = "System.UInt32";

		private const string STR_Int64 = "System.Int64";

		private const string STR_UInt64 = "System.UInt64";

		private const string STR_Char = "System.Char";

		private const string STR_Single = "System.Single";

		private const string STR_Double = "System.Double";

		private const string STR_Decimal = "System.Decimal";

		private const string STR_String = "System.String";

		private const string STR_Boolean = "System.Boolean";

		private const string STR_SourcePoint = "DevExpress.CodeRush.StructuralParser.SourcePoint";

		private const string STR_SourceRange = "DevExpress.CodeRush.StructuralParser.SourceRange";

		private MemoryHelper()
		{
		}

		private static long GetFieldSize(object instance, FieldInfo field)
		{
			if (field == null)
			{
				return 0L;
			}
			Type fieldType = field.FieldType;
			switch (fieldType.FullName)
			{
			case "System.Byte":
				return 1L;
			case "System.SByte":
				return 1L;
			case "System.Int16":
				return 2L;
			case "System.UInt16":
				return 2L;
			case "System.Int32":
				return 4L;
			case "System.UInt32":
				return 4L;
			case "System.Int64":
				return 8L;
			case "System.UInt64":
				return 8L;
			case "System.Char":
				return 2L;
			case "System.Single":
				return 4L;
			case "System.Double":
				return 8L;
			case "System.Decimal":
				return 16L;
			case "System.Boolean":
				return 1L;
			case "DevExpress.CodeRush.StructuralParser.SourcePoint":
				return 17L;
			case "DevExpress.CodeRush.StructuralParser.SourceRange":
				return 34L;
			case "System.String":
			{
				object value = field.GetValue(instance);
				if (value == null)
				{
					return 4L;
				}
				return 4 + ((string)value).Length * 2 + 8;
			}
			default:
				if (!fieldType.IsValueType)
				{
					return 4L;
				}
				return 0L;
			}
		}

		public static long SizeOf(object instance)
		{
			if (instance == null)
			{
				return 0L;
			}
			Type type = instance.GetType();
			FieldInfo[] fields = type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			long num = 0L;
			for (int i = 0; i < fields.Length; i++)
			{
				num += GetFieldSize(instance, fields[i]);
			}
			if (!type.IsValueType)
			{
				num += 8;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		public static bool IsSByte(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= -128m)
			{
				return value <= 127m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsByte(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= 0m)
			{
				return value <= 255m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsShort(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= -32768m)
			{
				return value <= 32767m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsUShort(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= 0m)
			{
				return value <= 65535m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsInt(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= -2147483648m)
			{
				return value <= 2147483647m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsUInt(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= 0m)
			{
				return value <= 4294967295m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsLong(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= -9223372036854775808m)
			{
				return value <= 9223372036854775807m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsULong(decimal value)
		{
			if (value >= 0m)
			{
				return value <= 18446744073709551615m;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetAllPossibleTypes()
		{
			if (_AllPossibleTypes == null)
			{
				_AllPossibleTypes = new List<PrimitiveType>();
				_AllPossibleTypes.Add(PrimitiveType.Int32);
				_AllPossibleTypes.Add(PrimitiveType.UInt32);
				_AllPossibleTypes.Add(PrimitiveType.Int64);
				_AllPossibleTypes.Add(PrimitiveType.UInt64);
				_AllPossibleTypes.Add(PrimitiveType.Single);
				_AllPossibleTypes.Add(PrimitiveType.Double);
				_AllPossibleTypes.Add(PrimitiveType.Decimal);
			}
			return _AllPossibleTypes;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetPossibleTypesForInt32()
		{
			List<PrimitiveType> list = new List<PrimitiveType>(GetAllPossibleTypes());
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.UInt32);
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetPossibleTypesForUInt32()
		{
			List<PrimitiveType> list = new List<PrimitiveType>(GetAllPossibleTypes());
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.Int32);
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetPossibleTypesForInt64()
		{
			List<PrimitiveType> list = new List<PrimitiveType>(GetAllPossibleTypes());
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.Int32);
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.UInt32);
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.UInt64);
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetPossibleTypesForUInt64()
		{
			List<PrimitiveType> list = new List<PrimitiveType>(GetAllPossibleTypes());
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.Int32);
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.UInt32);
			list.Remove(PrimitiveType.Int64);
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetPossibleTypesForSingle()
		{
			List<PrimitiveType> list = new List<PrimitiveType>();
			list.Add(PrimitiveType.Single);
			list.Add(PrimitiveType.Double);
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetPossibleTypesForDecimal()
		{
			List<PrimitiveType> list = new List<PrimitiveType>();
			list.Add(PrimitiveType.Decimal);
			return list;
		}

		private static List<PrimitiveType> GetPossibleTypesForDouble()
		{
			List<PrimitiveType> list = new List<PrimitiveType>();
			list.Add(PrimitiveType.Double);
			return list;
		}

		private static Dictionary<PrimitiveType, List<PrimitiveType>> GetPossibleTypesTable()
		{
			if (_PossibleTypesTable == null)
			{
				_PossibleTypesTable = new Dictionary<PrimitiveType, List<PrimitiveType>>();
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.Byte, GetAllPossibleTypes());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.SByte, GetAllPossibleTypes());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.Int16, GetAllPossibleTypes());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.UInt16, GetAllPossibleTypes());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.Int32, GetPossibleTypesForInt32());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.UInt32, GetPossibleTypesForUInt32());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.Int64, GetPossibleTypesForInt64());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.UInt64, GetPossibleTypesForUInt64());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.Single, GetPossibleTypesForSingle());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.Double, GetPossibleTypesForDouble());
				_PossibleTypesTable.Add(PrimitiveType.Decimal, GetPossibleTypesForDecimal());
			}
			return _PossibleTypesTable;
		}

		public static List<PrimitiveType> GetBinaryOperatorPossibleTypes(PrimitiveType type)
		{
			Dictionary<PrimitiveType, List<PrimitiveType>> possibleTypesTable = GetPossibleTypesTable();
			if (possibleTypesTable.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return possibleTypesTable[type];
			}
			return new List<PrimitiveType>();
		}

		public static List<PrimitiveType> GetBinaryOperatorPossibleTypes(object value)
		{
			return GetBinaryOperatorPossibleTypes(value, PrimitiveType.Int32);
		}

				list.Add(PrimitiveType.Single);

				list.Add(PrimitiveType.Double);
			}

		}

		public static void GetMinAndMaxValues(PrimitiveType type, out decimal minValue, out decimal maxValue)
		{
			minValue = default(decimal);
			maxValue = default(decimal);
			switch (type)
			{
			case PrimitiveType.SByte:
				minValue = -128m;
				maxValue = 127m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Byte:
				minValue = default(decimal);
				maxValue = 255m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Int16:
				minValue = -32768m;
				maxValue = 32767m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Int32:
				minValue = -2147483648m;
				maxValue = 2147483647m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Int64:
				minValue = -9223372036854775808m;
				maxValue = 9223372036854775807m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.UInt16:
				minValue = default(decimal);
				maxValue = 65535m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.UInt32:
				minValue = default(decimal);
				maxValue = 4294967295m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.UInt64:
				minValue = default(decimal);
				maxValue = 18446744073709551615m;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Single:
				minValue = decimal.MinValue;
				maxValue = decimal.MaxValue;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Double:
				minValue = decimal.MinValue;
				maxValue = decimal.MaxValue;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Decimal:
				minValue = decimal.MinValue;
				maxValue = decimal.MaxValue;
				break;
			case PrimitiveType.Char:
			case PrimitiveType.DBNull:
				break;
			}
		}

		public static object GetDefaultValue(PrimitiveType type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case PrimitiveType.SByte:
				return (sbyte)0;
			case PrimitiveType.Byte:
				return (byte)0;
			case PrimitiveType.Int16:
				return (short)0;
			case PrimitiveType.Int32:
				return 0;
			case PrimitiveType.Int64:
				return 0L;
			case PrimitiveType.UInt16:
				return (ushort)0;
			case PrimitiveType.UInt32:
				return 0u;
			case PrimitiveType.UInt64:
				return 0uL;
			case PrimitiveType.Single:
				return 0f;
			case PrimitiveType.Double:
				return 0.0;
			case PrimitiveType.Decimal:
				return 0m;
			case PrimitiveType.String:
				return string.Empty;
			case PrimitiveType.DateTime:
				return DateTime.MinValue;
			case PrimitiveType.Boolean:
				return false;
			case PrimitiveType.Char:
				return '\0';
			case PrimitiveType.Object:
			case PrimitiveType.Void:
				return null;
			case PrimitiveType.DBNull:
				return DBNull.Value;
			default:
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public static PrimitiveType PromoteType(IElement type)
