		}

		public static PrimitiveType PromoteType(PrimitiveType type)
		{
			return PromoteType(type, UnaryOperatorType.None);
		}

		public static PrimitiveType PromoteType(PrimitiveType type, UnaryOperatorType unaryOperator)
		{
			if ((unaryOperator == UnaryOperatorType.UnaryNegation || unaryOperator == UnaryOperatorType.UnaryPlus || unaryOperator == UnaryOperatorType.OnesComplement) && (type == PrimitiveType.SByte || type == PrimitiveType.Byte || type == PrimitiveType.Int16 || type == PrimitiveType.UInt16 || type == PrimitiveType.Char))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			if (unaryOperator == UnaryOperatorType.UnaryNegation && type == PrimitiveType.UInt32)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int64;
			}
			return type;
		}

		public static PrimitiveType PromoteTypes(IElement firstType, IElement secondType)
		{
			return PromoteTypes(ToPrimitiveType(firstType), ToPrimitiveType(secondType));
		}

		public static PrimitiveType PromoteTypes(PrimitiveType first, PrimitiveType second)
		{
			if (first == PrimitiveType.String)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.String;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.String)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.String;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.Char)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Char;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.Char)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Char;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.Decimal)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Decimal;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.Decimal)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Decimal;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.Double)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Double;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.Double)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Double;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.Single)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Single;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.Single)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Single;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.UInt64)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.UInt64;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.UInt64)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.UInt64;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.Int64)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int64;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.Int64)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int64;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.UInt32 && (second == PrimitiveType.SByte || second == PrimitiveType.Int16 || second == PrimitiveType.Int32))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.UInt32;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.UInt32 && (first == PrimitiveType.SByte || first == PrimitiveType.Int16 || first == PrimitiveType.Int32))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.UInt32;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.UInt32)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.UInt32;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.UInt32)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.UInt32;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.Int32)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			if (second == PrimitiveType.Int32)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			if (first == PrimitiveType.Boolean && second == first)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Boolean;
			}
			return PrimitiveType.Int32;
		}

		public static bool IsIntegerType(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is sbyte) && !(value is byte) && !(value is ushort) && !(value is short) && !(value is uint) && !(value is int) && !(value is ulong))
			{
				return value is long;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsIntegerType(PrimitiveType type)
		{
			if (type - 2 <= PrimitiveType.Boolean || type - 6 <= PrimitiveType.DBNull)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

	public class QualifiedExpressionHelper
	{
		private static bool IsSimpleReference(IElement element)
		{
			if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ElementReferenceExpression || element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.QualifiedNestedReference)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeReferenceExpression || element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression || element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.QualifiedNestedTypeReference)
			{
				if (element is ITypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression)
				{
					if (!typeReferenceExpression.IsArrayType && !typeReferenceExpression.IsPointerType)
					{
						return !typeReferenceExpression.IsGeneric;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static int GetLevel(IHasQualifier element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (element.Qualifier == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return element.Qualifier.Level + 1;
		}

		public static LanguageElement GetByLevel(LanguageElement element, int level)
		{
			if (element == null || level < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(element is IHasQualifier))
			{
				if (level == 1)
				{
					return element;
				}
				return null;
			}
			IHasQualifier hasQualifier = element as IHasQualifier;
			int level2 = GetLevel(hasQualifier);
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			if (level > level2 || level < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (level2 == level)
			{
				return element;
			}
			return GetByLevel(hasQualifier.Qualifier, level);
		}

		public static LanguageElement GetStartElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return GetByLevel(element, 1);
		}

		public static LanguageElement GetEndElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return GetEndElement(element, expressionOnly: false);
		}

		private static LanguageElement GetEndElement(LanguageElement element, bool expressionOnly)
		{
			if (element == null && element is IHasQualifier)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = element;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = null;
			bool flag = false;
			while (!flag && languageElement != null)
			{
				if (languageElement.Parent is IHasQualifier)
				{
					languageElement2 = languageElement.Parent;
					if (expressionOnly && !(languageElement2 is Expression))
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
					if (((IHasQualifier)languageElement2).Qualifier == languageElement)
					{
						languageElement = languageElement2;
						continue;
					}
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public static LanguageElement GetEndExpression(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return GetEndElement(element, expressionOnly: true);
		}

		public static bool HasCleanReferences(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || !(element is IWithSource))
			{
				return false;
			}
			IWithSource withSource = (IWithSource)element;
			if (withSource.Source == null)
			{
				return IsSimpleReference(element);
			}
			if (IsSimpleReference(element))
			{
				return HasCleanReferences(withSource.Source);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class QuailifiedExpressionHelper : QualifiedExpressionHelper
	{
	}
	public class SiblingHelper
	{
		private IElement _Start;

		private Dictionary<IElement, List<IElement>> _ElementsCache;

		private Dictionary<IElement, int> _ElementsIndexCache;

		public SiblingHelper(IElement start)
		{
			if (start == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("start");
			}
			SetStart(start);
		}

		private void SetStart(IElement start)
		{
			if (_Start != start && start != null)
			{
				start = GetParentMember(start);
				if (start != null && (_Start == null || _Start != start))
				{
					_Start = start;
					_ElementsCache = null;
					_ElementsIndexCache = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void BuildElements()
		{
			if (_Start != null)
			{
				_ElementsCache = new Dictionary<IElement, List<IElement>>();
				_ElementsIndexCache = new Dictionary<IElement, int>();
				BuildElements(_Start, _Start.AllChildren, _ElementsCache);
			}
		}

		private void BuildElements(IElement parent, IEnumerable<IElement> children, Dictionary<IElement, List<IElement>> elements)
		{
			if (children == null || elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<IElement> list = new List<IElement>();
			list.Add(parent);
			foreach (IElement child in children)
			{
				try
				{
					if (_ElementsIndexCache.ContainsKey(child))
					{
						continue;
					}
					_ElementsIndexCache.Add(child, list.Count);
					elements.Add(child, list);
					list.Add(child);
					goto IL_005e;
				}
				catch (ArgumentException)
				{
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				continue;
				IL_005e:
				BuildElements(child, child.AllChildren, elements);
			}
		}

		private IElement GetPrevious(IElement element, ref bool isSibling)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!_ElementsCache.ContainsKey(element))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<IElement> list = _ElementsCache[element];
			int num = _ElementsIndexCache[element];
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num == 1)
			{
				isSibling = false;
			}
			return list[num - 1];
		}

		public IElement GetPreviousElement(IElement element, out bool isSibling)
		{
			isSibling = true;
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_ElementsCache == null)
			{
				BuildElements();
			}
			if (_ElementsCache == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetPrevious(element, ref isSibling);
		}

		public static IElement GetParentMember(IElement start)
		{
			while (start != null && !(start is IMemberElement) && !(start is IBaseVariable))
			{
				start = start.Parent;
			}
			if (start == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return start;
		}
	}
	public static class ParserUtils
	{
		public enum Position
		{
			BeforeStart,
			Inside,
			AfterEnd,
			Error
		}

		public static object GetCloneFromNodeList(NodeList target, NodeList source, object obj)
		{
			if (target == null || source == null || obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = source.IndexOf(obj);
			if (num >= 0 && num < target.Count)
			{
				return target[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static object GetCloneFromNodes(BaseElement target, BaseElement source, object obj)
		{
			if (target == null || source == null || obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object cloneFromNodeList = GetCloneFromNodeList(target.DetailNodes, source.DetailNodes, obj);
			if (cloneFromNodeList != null)
			{
				return cloneFromNodeList;
			}
			cloneFromNodeList = GetCloneFromNodeList(target.Nodes, source.Nodes, obj);
			if (cloneFromNodeList != null)
			{
				return cloneFromNodeList;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void GetClonesFromNodes(NodeList targetNodes, NodeList sourceNodes, NodeList targetCollection, NodeList sourceCollection)
		{
			if (targetNodes == null || sourceNodes == null || targetCollection == null || sourceCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sourceCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sourceCollection[i] is LanguageElement value)
				{
					int num = sourceNodes.IndexOf(value);
					if (num >= 0 && num < targetNodes.Count && targetNodes[num] is LanguageElement value2)
					{
						targetCollection.Add(value2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static LanguageElementCollection GetSelectedNodes(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			if (scope == null || range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			SourceTreeEnumerator sourceTreeEnumerator = new SourceTreeEnumerator(scope);
			while (sourceTreeEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (sourceTreeEnumerator.Current is LanguageElement languageElement && range.Contains(languageElement.Range))
				{
					languageElementCollection.Add(languageElement);
				}
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		private static bool IsBadPoint(SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (point.Line > 0)
			{
				return point.Offset <= 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ContainsPoint(IList list, int startIndex, int endIndex, SourcePoint point)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = list[startIndex] as LanguageElement;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = list[endIndex] as LanguageElement;
			if (languageElement == null || languageElement2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceRange range = new SourceRange(languageElement.Range.Start, languageElement2.Range.End);
			if (!RangeIsCorrupted(range))
			{
				if (!range.IsEmpty)
				{
					return range.Contains(point);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool RangeIsCorrupted(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (!IsBadPoint(range.Start))
			{
				return IsBadPoint(range.End);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static Position GetPosition(IList list, int startIndex, int endIndex, SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0 || point.IsEmpty || IsBadPoint(point) || startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				return Position.Error;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!(list[startIndex] is LanguageElement { Range: { IsEmpty: false } } languageElement) || RangeIsCorrupted(languageElement.Range))
				{
					return Position.Error;
				}
				if (!(list[endIndex] is LanguageElement { Range: { IsEmpty: false } } languageElement2) || RangeIsCorrupted(languageElement2.Range))
				{
					return Position.Error;
				}
				if (point < languageElement.Range.Start)
				{
					return Position.BeforeStart;
				}
				if (point >= languageElement2.Range.End)
				{
					return Position.AfterEnd;
				}
				return Position.Inside;
			}
			catch
			{
				return Position.Error;
			}
		}

		public static int GetIndexAt(IList list, SourcePoint point)
		{
			return GetIndexAt(list, 0, list.Count - 1, point);
		}

		public static int GetIndexAt(IList list, SourcePoint point, out Position position)
		{
			return GetIndexAt(list, 0, list.Count - 1, point, out position);
		}

		public static int GetIndexAt(IList list, int startIndex, int endIndex, SourcePoint point)
		{
			Position position;
			return GetIndexAt(list, startIndex, endIndex, point, out position);
		}

		public static int GetIndexAt(IList list, int startIndex, int endIndex, SourcePoint point, out Position position)
		{
			if ((position = GetPosition(list, startIndex, endIndex, point)) != Position.Inside)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				int num = (endIndex + startIndex) / 2;
				if (num == startIndex)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (ContainsPoint(list, num, endIndex, point))
				{
					startIndex = num;
				}
				else
				{
					endIndex = num;
				}
			}
			return startIndex;
		}

		public static bool GetBounds(IList list, SourceRange range, out int left, out int right)
		{
			return GetBounds(list, 0, list.Count - 1, range, out left, out right);
		}

		public static bool GetBounds(IList list, int startIndex, int endIndex, SourceRange range, out int left, out int right)
		{
			left = GetIndexAt(list, startIndex, endIndex, range.Start, out var position);
			switch (position)
			{
			case Position.BeforeStart:
				left = startIndex;
				break;
			case Position.Inside:
				left++;
				break;
			}
			right = GetIndexAt(list, startIndex, endIndex, range.End, out var position2);
			if (position2 == Position.AfterEnd)
			{
				right = endIndex;
			}
			if (left != -1 && right != -1)
			{
				return left <= right;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static IList<LanguageElement> GetNodesInRange(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range)
		{
			return GetNodesInRange(scope, range, useBinarySerach: false);
		}

		public static IList<LanguageElement> GetNodesInRange(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range, bool useBinarySerach)
		{
			List<LanguageElement> result = new List<LanguageElement>();
			if (scope == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return GetNodesInRange(scope.Nodes, range, useBinarySerach);
		}

		public static IList<LanguageElement> GetNodesInRange(NodeList nodes, SourceRange range)
		{
			return GetNodesInRange(nodes, range, useBinarySerach: false);
		}

		public static IList<LanguageElement> GetNodesInRange(NodeList nodes, SourceRange range, bool useBinarySerach)
		{
			List<LanguageElement> list = new List<LanguageElement>();
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0 || range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return list;
			}
			int count = nodes.Count;
			int num = (useBinarySerach ? GetIndexAt(nodes, 0, count - 1, range.Start) : 0);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			for (int i = num; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement { Range: var range2 } languageElement)
				{
					if (range.Contains(range2))
					{
						list.Add(languageElement);
					}
					if (useBinarySerach && range2.Start > range.End)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static void RemoveNodesInRange(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range)
		{
			if (scope != null)
			{
				RemoveNodesInRange(scope.Nodes, range);
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveNodesInRange(NodeList nodes, SourceRange range, bool useBinarySerach, bool recursive)
		{
			RemoveNodesInRange(nodes, range, useBinarySerach);
			if (!recursive)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement node in nodes)
			{
				RemoveNodesInRange(node.Nodes, range, useBinarySerach, recursive);
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveNodesInRange(NodeList nodes, SourceRange range)
		{
			RemoveNodesInRange(nodes, range, useBinarySerach: false);
		}

		public static void RemoveNodesInRange(NodeList nodes, SourceRange range, bool useBinarySerach)
		{
			if (nodes == null || range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<LanguageElement> nodesInRange = GetNodesInRange(nodes, range, useBinarySerach);
			if (nodesInRange != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < nodesInRange.Count; i++)
				{
					nodes.Remove(nodesInRange[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public static int CountChildStatements(Statement statement)
		{
			if (statement == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return CountStatements(statement.Nodes);
		}

		public static bool IsStatement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is Statement) && !(element is Variable))
			{
				return element is InitializedVariable;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static int CountStatements(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int count = nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement { CompletesPrevious: false } languageElement && IsStatement(languageElement))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static string GetElementTypeName(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (element is BaseVariable)
			{
				return ((BaseVariable)element).MemberType;
			}
			if (element is Param)
			{
				return ((Param)element).ParamType;
			}
			if (element is Member)
			{
				return ((Member)element).MemberType;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public static TypeReferenceExpression GetElementType(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = null;
			if (element is BaseVariable)
			{
				typeReferenceExpression = ((BaseVariable)element).MemberTypeReference;
			}
			if (element is Member)
			{
				typeReferenceExpression = ((Member)element).MemberTypeReference;
			}
			if (typeReferenceExpression != null && typeReferenceExpression.Parent == null)
			{
				typeReferenceExpression.SetParent(element);
			}
			return typeReferenceExpression;
		}
	}
	public sealed class SourceRangeUtils
	{
		private SourceRangeUtils()
		{
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(object a, object b)
		{
			return new SourceRange(GetRange(a).Start, GetRange(b).End);
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(object a)
		{
			if (a is LanguageElement)
			{
				return ((LanguageElement)a).InternalRange;
			}
			if (a is Token)
			{
				return ((Token)a).Range;
			}
			if (a is SourceRange)
			{
				return (SourceRange)a;
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(params object[] objs)
		{
			int num = 0;
			object obj;
			do
			{
				obj = objs[num];
				num++;
			}
			while (obj == null);
			num = objs.Length - 1;
			object obj2;
			do
			{
				obj2 = objs[num];
				num--;
			}
			while (obj2 == null);
			return GetRange(obj, obj2);
		}
	}
	public enum LineTerminatorChar
	{
		Unknown,
		CarriageReturn,
		LineFeed,
		LineSeparator,
		ParagraphSeparator
	}
	public enum LineTerminator
	{
		None,
		MSDOS,
		Mac,
		Unix,
		LineSeparator,
		ParagraphSeparator
	}
	public static class StringHelper
	{
		private static LineTerminatorChar GetLineTerminatorChar(char character)
		{
			return character switch
			{
				'\r' => LineTerminatorChar.CarriageReturn, 
				'\n' => LineTerminatorChar.LineFeed, 
				'\u2028' => LineTerminatorChar.LineSeparator, 
				'\u2029' => LineTerminatorChar.ParagraphSeparator, 
				_ => LineTerminatorChar.Unknown, 
			};
		}

		public static StringCollection CloneStringCollection(StringCollection source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			string[] array = new string[source.Count];
			source.CopyTo(array, 0);
			stringCollection.AddRange(array);
			return stringCollection;
		}

		public static string[] SplitLines(string text)
		{
			return SplitLines(text, removeLastIfEmpty: true);
		}

		public static string[] SplitLines(string text, bool removeLastIfEmpty)
		{
			if (text == null || text == string.Empty)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int length = text.Length;
			while (num < length)
			{
				if (GetLineTerminatorChar(text[num]) != LineTerminatorChar.Unknown)
				{
					arrayList.Add(text.Substring(num2, num - num2));
					num += GetLineTerminatorLength(GetLineTerminator(text, num));
					num2 = num;
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			arrayList.Add(text.Substring(num2));
			if (removeLastIfEmpty && (string)arrayList[arrayList.Count - 1] == string.Empty)
			{
				arrayList.RemoveAt(arrayList.Count - 1);
			}
			string[] array = new string[arrayList.Count];
			arrayList.CopyTo(array);
			return array;
		}

		public static LineTerminator GetLineTerminator(string text)
		{
			return GetLineTerminator(text, 0);
		}

		public static LineTerminator GetLineTerminator(string text, int index)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			if (text == string.Empty)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Cannot check empty string", "text");
			}
			if (text.Length <= index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", index, "index is out of range.");
			}
			switch (GetLineTerminatorChar(text[index]))
			{
			case LineTerminatorChar.CarriageReturn:
				if (index < text.Length - 1 && GetLineTerminatorChar(text[index + 1]) == LineTerminatorChar.LineFeed)
				{
					return LineTerminator.MSDOS;
				}
				return LineTerminator.Mac;
			case LineTerminatorChar.LineFeed:
				return LineTerminator.Unix;
			case LineTerminatorChar.LineSeparator:
				return LineTerminator.LineSeparator;
			case LineTerminatorChar.ParagraphSeparator:
				return LineTerminator.ParagraphSeparator;
			default:
				return LineTerminator.None;
			}
		}

		public static int GetLineTerminatorLength(LineTerminator lineTerm)
		{
			switch (lineTerm)
			{
			case LineTerminator.MSDOS:
				return 2;
			case LineTerminator.Mac:
			case LineTerminator.Unix:
			case LineTerminator.LineSeparator:
			case LineTerminator.ParagraphSeparator:
				return 1;
			default:
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public static bool EndsWithLineTerminator(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = text[text.Length - 1];
			if (c != '\n' && c != '\r' && c != '\u2028')
			{
				return c == '\u2029';
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public sealed class LanguageElementRestorer
	{
		private LanguageElementRestorer()
		{
		}

		private static string GetText(SourceFile file)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (file == null)
			{
				return empty;
			}
			if (file.Document != null)
			{
				return file.Document.Text;
			}
			string name = file.Name;
			if (name == null || !File.Exists(name))
			{
				return empty;
			}
			using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(name, Encoding.Default);
			return streamReader.ReadToEnd();
		}

		private static LanguageElement GetStartForExpression(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = node.GetParentStatementOrVariable();
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = node.GetParent(LanguageElementType.NamespaceReference);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = node.GetParentMethodOrAccessor();
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = node.GetParentClassInterfaceStructOrModule();
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = node.Parent;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private static LanguageElement GetAppropriateStart(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range)
		{
			if (scope == null || range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement childAt = scope.GetChildAt(range.Start);
			if (childAt == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (childAt is Expression || childAt is MethodCall)
			{
				return GetStartForExpression(childAt);
			}
			return childAt;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static LanguageElement FindElement(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range, bool checkNameRangeOnly)
		{
			return FindElement(scope, range, LanguageElementType.Unknown, checkNameRangeOnly);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static LanguageElement FindElement(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range, LanguageElementType type)
		{
			return FindElement(scope, range, type, checkNameRangeOnly: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static LanguageElement FindElement(LanguageElement scope, SourceRange range, LanguageElementType type, bool checkNameRangeOnly)
		{
			if (scope == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement appropriateStart = GetAppropriateStart(scope, range);
			if (appropriateStart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SourceTreeEnumerator sourceTreeEnumerator = new SourceTreeEnumerator(scope, appropriateStart, null);
			while (sourceTreeEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (sourceTreeEnumerator.Current is LanguageElement { NameRange: var sourceRange } languageElement)
				{
					if (sourceRange.IsEmpty)
					{
						sourceRange = languageElement.Range;
					}
					if ((!(sourceRange != range) || (!checkNameRangeOnly && !(languageElement.Range != range))) && (type == LanguageElementType.Unknown || IsValidType(type, languageElement.ElementType)))
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool IsValidType(LanguageElementType first, LanguageElementType second)
		{
			if (IsValidQualifiedTypeReference(first, second))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsValidVariable(first, second))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return first == second;
		}

		private static bool IsValidVariable(LanguageElementType first, LanguageElementType second)
		{
			if (first == LanguageElementType.Variable)
			{
				return second == LanguageElementType.InitializedVariable;
			}
			if (second == LanguageElementType.Variable)
			{
				return first == LanguageElementType.InitializedVariable;
			}
			if (first == LanguageElementType.ImplicitVariable)
			{
				return second == LanguageElementType.InitializedVariable;
			}
			if (second == LanguageElementType.ImplicitVariable)
			{
				return first == LanguageElementType.InitializedVariable;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsValidQualifiedTypeReference(LanguageElementType first, LanguageElementType second)
		{
			if (first == LanguageElementType.QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression)
			{
				if (second != LanguageElementType.TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					return second == LanguageElementType.QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (second == LanguageElementType.QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression)
			{
				if (first != LanguageElementType.TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					return first == LanguageElementType.QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool TryConvertAspxFieldTag(LanguageElementCollection result, IFieldElement field, IElement element)
		{
			if (!field.IsAspxTag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IProjectElement project = element.Project;
			if (project == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(project.SourceModel is ICanRestoreFromGeneratedSymbols canRestoreFromGeneratedSymbols))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(canRestoreFromGeneratedSymbols.RestoreFromGeneratedSymbols(element) is LanguageElement value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			result.Add(value);
			return true;
		}

		public static LanguageElementCollection ConvertToLanguageElements(IElement element)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			if (element == null)
			{
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			if (element is LanguageElement)
			{
				languageElementCollection.Add((LanguageElement)element);
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			if (element is IFieldElement)
			{
				IFieldElement fieldElement = (IFieldElement)element;
				if (fieldElement.HasNodeLink && fieldElement.NodeLink is LanguageElement)
				{
					languageElementCollection.Add((LanguageElement)fieldElement.NodeLink);
					return languageElementCollection;
				}
				if (TryConvertAspxFieldTag(languageElementCollection, fieldElement, element))
				{
					return languageElementCollection;
				}
			}
			if (element.Files == null || element.Files.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IProjectElement project = element.Project;
			if (project == null)
			{
				project = element.FirstFile.Project;
			}
			if (project == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = element.Files.Count;
			int count2 = element.NameRanges.Count;
			if (count != count2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElementType languageElementType = element.ElementType;
			if (languageElementType == LanguageElementType.Method && element.Parent is IPropertyElement)
			{
				languageElementType = ((!element.Name.StartsWith("get_")) ? LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet : LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (project.FindDiskFile(element.Files[i].Name) is SourceFile sourceFile)
				{
					LanguageElement scope = sourceFile;
					IAspSourceFile aspSourceFile = sourceFile;
					if (aspSourceFile.Code != null)
					{
						scope = aspSourceFile.Code;
					}
					bool checkNameRangeOnly = NeedsToCheckNameRangeOnly(languageElementType);
					LanguageElement languageElement = FindElement(scope, element.NameRanges[i], languageElementType, checkNameRangeOnly);
					if (languageElement != null)
					{
						languageElementCollection.Add(languageElement);
					}
				}
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		private static bool NeedsToCheckNameRangeOnly(LanguageElementType type)
		{
			return type != LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation;
		}

		public static LanguageElement ConvertToLanguageElement(IElement element)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = ConvertToLanguageElements(element);
			if (languageElementCollection == null || languageElementCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return languageElementCollection[0];
		}

		public static LanguageElementCollection ConvertToLanguageElements(IElementCollection elements)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			if (elements == null || elements.Count == 0)
			{
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			int count = elements.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = ConvertToLanguageElement(elements[i]);
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					languageElementCollection.Add(languageElement);
				}
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}
	}
	public abstract class LanguageUtils
	{
		private const ParserVersion ENUM_LastParsertVersion = ParserVersion.VS2014;

		internal LanguageUtils()
		{
		}

		public static ParserLanguageID GetLanguageId(string fileNameOrFileExtension)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileNameOrFileExtension))
			{
				return ParserLanguageID.None;
			}
			int num = fileNameOrFileExtension.LastIndexOf('.');
			string text = ((num >= 0) ? fileNameOrFileExtension.Remove(0, num + 1) : fileNameOrFileExtension);
			switch (text.ToLower())
			{
			case "css":
				return ParserLanguageID.Css;
			case "cs":
			case "csproj":
				return ParserLanguageID.CSharp;
			case "vb":
			case "vbproj":
				return ParserLanguageID.Basic;
			case "h":
			case "hh":
			case "cpp":
			case "vcproj":
				return ParserLanguageID.Cpp;
			case "js":
				return ParserLanguageID.JavaScript;
			case "xml":
				return ParserLanguageID.Xml;
			case "htm":
			case "html":
			case "cshtml":
			case "vbhtml":
			case "asax":
			case "aspx":
			case "ascx":
			case "ashx":
			case "asmx":
			case "master":
				return ParserLanguageID.Html;
			case "xaml":
				return ParserLanguageID.Xaml;
			default:
				return ParserLanguageID.None;
			}
		}

		public static LanguageUtils Create(ParserLanguageID languageId)
		{
			return languageId switch
			{
				ParserLanguageID.Basic => new VBLanguageUtils(), 
				ParserLanguageID.CSharp => new CSharpLanguageUtils(), 
				ParserLanguageID.JavaScript => new JavaScriptLanguageUtils(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Html => new HtmlLanguageUtils(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Xaml => new XamlLanguageUtils(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Xml => new XmlLanguageUtils(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Css => new CssLanguageUtils(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public static LanguageUtils Create(string fileNameOrFileExtension)
		{
			ParserLanguageID languageId = GetLanguageId(fileNameOrFileExtension);
			return Create(languageId);
		}

		public static Tokenizer GetTokenizer(ParserLanguageID languageId)
		{
			return Create(languageId)?.CreateTokenizer();
		}

		public static Tokenizer GetTokenizer(string fileExtension)
		{
			ParserLanguageID languageId = GetLanguageId(fileExtension);
			return GetTokenizer(languageId);
		}

		public ParserBase CreateParser()
		{
			return CreateParser(ParserVersion.VS2014, EmbededLanguageKind.Asp, DotNetLanguageType.CSharp);
		}

		public abstract Tokenizer CreateTokenizer();

		public abstract ParserBase CreateParser(ParserVersion version, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embededLanguage);

		public abstract CodeGen CreateCodeGen();

		public abstract ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder();
	}

	public class AtgParserRule : NamedAtgElement
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _Parameters;

		public LanguageElementCollection Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					_Parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _Parameters;
			}
		}

		public int ParametersCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Parameters.Count;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AtgParserRule;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AtgParserRule))
			{
				return;
			}
			AtgParserRule atgParserRule = (AtgParserRule)source;
			if (atgParserRule._Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, atgParserRule.DetailNodes, _Parameters, atgParserRule._Parameters);
				if (_Parameters.Count == 0 && atgParserRule._Parameters.Count > 0)
				{
					_Parameters = atgParserRule._Parameters.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AtgParserRule atgParserRule = new AtgParserRule();
			atgParserRule.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return atgParserRule;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(Name);
			if (ParametersCount > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("<{0}>", Parameters.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void AddParameter(LanguageElement parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Add(parameter);
				AddDetailNode(parameter);
			}
		}
	}

				arg = Condition.ToString();

			return $"IF({arg})";
		}

	{
		private bool _IsWeak;

		public bool IsSync
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsSync;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsSync = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AtgFactor;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AtgFactor))
			{
				return;
			}
			AtgFactor atgFactor = (AtgFactor)source;
			if (atgFactor._Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, atgFactor.DetailNodes, _Parameters, atgFactor._Parameters);
				if (_Parameters.Count == 0 && atgFactor._Parameters.Count > 0)
				{

				AddDetailNode(parameter);

		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (IsWeak)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" WEAK ");
			}
			if (IsSync)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" SYNC ");

			stringBuilder.Append(Name);
			if (ParametersCount > 0)

				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("<{0}>", Parameters.ToString());

			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

	public class AtgComplexFactor : AtgFactor
	{
		private ComplexFactorType _ComplexType;

		private AtgExpression _NestedExpression;

		private SourceRange _BlockStart;

		private SourceRange _BlockEnd;

		public SourceRange BlockStart
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_BlockStart);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_BlockStart = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange BlockEnd
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_BlockEnd);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_BlockEnd = value;
			}
		}

		public ComplexFactorType ComplexType
		{
			get
			{
				return _ComplexType;
			}
			set
			{
				_ComplexType = value;
			}
		}

		public AtgExpression NestedExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _NestedExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_NestedExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AtgComplexFactor;

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string arg = string.Empty;
			if (NestedExpression != null)
			{
				arg = NestedExpression.ToString();
			}
			return ComplexType switch
			{
				ComplexFactorType.Braces => $"lbr {arg} rbr", 
				ComplexFactorType.Parens => $"({arg})", 
				ComplexFactorType.Brackets => $"[{arg}]", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AtgComplexFactor))
			{
				return;
			}
			AtgComplexFactor atgComplexFactor = (AtgComplexFactor)source;
			_BlockStart = atgComplexFactor.BlockStart;
			_BlockEnd = atgComplexFactor.BlockEnd;
			_ComplexType = atgComplexFactor._ComplexType;
			if (atgComplexFactor._NestedExpression != null)
			{
				_NestedExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, atgComplexFactor, atgComplexFactor._NestedExpression) as AtgExpression;
				if (_NestedExpression == null)
				{
					_NestedExpression = atgComplexFactor._NestedExpression.Clone(options) as AtgExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AtgComplexFactor atgComplexFactor = new AtgComplexFactor();
			atgComplexFactor.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return atgComplexFactor;
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_BlockStart = BlockStart;
			_BlockEnd = BlockEnd;
		}
	}
	public class AtgFactorCollection : NodeList
	{
		public new AtgFactor this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (AtgFactor)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		protected int Add(AtgFactor element)
		{
			return base.Add(element);
		}

		protected void AddRange(AtgFactorCollection collection)
		{
			base.AddRange(collection);
		}

		protected int IndexOf(AtgFactor element)
		{
			return IndexOf((object)element);
		}

		protected void Insert(int index, AtgFactor element)
		{
			base.Insert(index, element);
		}

		protected void Remove(AtgFactor element)
		{
			base.Remove(element);
		}

		protected AtgFactor Find(AtgFactor element)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(element);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return this[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool Contains(AtgFactor element)
		{
			return Find(element) != null;
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new AtgFactorCollection();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(string.Empty);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0} ", this[i]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class AtgTerminal : BaseAtgElement
	{
		private AtgResolver _Resolver;

		private AtgFactorCollection _Factors;

		public AtgResolver Resolver
		{
			get
			{
				return _Resolver;
			}
			set
			{
				_Resolver = value;
			}
		}

		public AtgFactorCollection Factors
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Factors == null)
				{
					_Factors = new AtgFactorCollection();
				}
				return _Factors;
			}
		}

		public int FactorsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Factors == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Factors.Count;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AtgTerminal;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AtgTerminal))
			{
				return;
			}
			AtgTerminal atgTerminal = (AtgTerminal)source;
			if (atgTerminal._Factors != null)
			{
				_Factors = new AtgFactorCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(Nodes, atgTerminal.Nodes, _Factors, atgTerminal._Factors);
				if (_Factors.Count == 0 && atgTerminal._Factors.Count > 0)
				{
					_Factors = atgTerminal._Factors.DeepClone(options) as AtgFactorCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AtgTerminal atgTerminal = new AtgTerminal();
			atgTerminal.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return atgTerminal;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Resolver != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0} ", Resolver.ToString());
			}
			if (FactorsCount > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(Factors.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void AddFactor(AtgFactor factor)
		{
			if (factor != null && Factors.IndexOf(factor) == -1)
			{
				Factors.Add(factor);
				AddNode(factor);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AtgTerminalCollection : NodeList
	{
		public new AtgTerminal this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (AtgTerminal)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		protected int Add(AtgTerminal element)
		{
			return base.Add(element);
		}

		protected void AddRange(AtgTerminalCollection collection)
		{
			base.AddRange(collection);
		}

		protected int IndexOf(AtgTerminal element)
		{
			return IndexOf((object)element);
		}

		protected void Insert(int index, AtgTerminal element)
		{
			base.Insert(index, element);
		}

		protected void Remove(AtgTerminal element)
		{
			base.Remove(element);
		}

		protected AtgTerminal Find(AtgTerminal element)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(element);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return this[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool Contains(AtgTerminal element)
		{
			return Find(element) != null;
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new AtgTerminalCollection();
		}
	}
	public class AtgExpression : BaseAtgElement
	{
		private AtgTerminalCollection _Terminals;

		public AtgTerminalCollection Terminals
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Terminals == null)
				{
					_Terminals = new AtgTerminalCollection();
				}
				return _Terminals;
			}
		}

		public int TerminalsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Terminals == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Terminals.Count;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AtgExpression;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AtgExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			AtgExpression atgExpression = (AtgExpression)source;
			if (atgExpression._Terminals != null)
			{
				_Terminals = new AtgTerminalCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(Nodes, atgExpression.Nodes, _Terminals, atgExpression._Terminals);
				if (_Terminals.Count == 0 && atgExpression._Terminals.Count > 0)
				{
					_Terminals = atgExpression._Terminals.DeepClone(options) as AtgTerminalCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AtgExpression atgExpression = new AtgExpression();
			atgExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return atgExpression;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (TerminalsCount > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Terminals[0].ToString());
				if (TerminalsCount > 1)
				{
					for (int i = 1; i < TerminalsCount; i++)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("\r\n | {0}", Terminals[i].ToString());
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void AddTerminal(AtgTerminal terminal)
		{
			if (terminal != null)
			{
				Terminals.Add(terminal);
				AddNode(terminal);
			}
		}
	}
