	public abstract class BaseElement : ICloneable
	{
		protected internal abstract NodeList InnerNodes { get; }

		protected internal int InnerNodeCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (InnerNodes != null)
				{
					return InnerNodes.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected internal abstract NodeList InnerDetailNodes { get; }

		protected internal int InnerDetailNodeCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (InnerDetailNodes != null)
				{
					return InnerDetailNodes.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Description("The language elements parented by this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public abstract NodeList Nodes { get; }

		[Description("The number of child language elements parented by this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public int NodeCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (Nodes != null)
				{
					return Nodes.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Description("The detail language elements associated with this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public abstract NodeList DetailNodes { get; }

		[Description("The number of detail language elements parented by this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public int DetailNodeCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (DetailNodes != null)
				{
					return DetailNodes.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Description("The name of this language element.")]
		[Category("Description")]
		public abstract string Name { get; set; }

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		private SourceRange GetRangeFromNodes(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement { Range: { IsEmpty: false } } languageElement)
				{
					sourceRange = ((!sourceRange.IsEmpty) ? SourceRange.Union(sourceRange, languageElement.Range) : languageElement.Range);
				}
			}
			return sourceRange;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected void CleanUpOwnedReferencesForNodes(NodeList nodeList)
		{
			if (nodeList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodeList[i] is BaseElement baseElement)
				{
					baseElement.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected virtual NodeList CreateNodeList()
		{
			return new NodeList();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected virtual void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public SourceRange GetDetailNodeRange()
		{
			return GetRangeFromNodes(DetailNodes);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public SourceRange GetNodeRange()
		{
			return GetRangeFromNodes(Nodes);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
		}

		public virtual BaseElement Clone()
		{
			return Clone(ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		public virtual BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class CodeElement : LanguageElement
	{
		private SupportElements _SupportElements;

		private SupportElements SupportElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SupportElements == null)
				{
					_SupportElements = new SupportElements();
				}
				return _SupportElements;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable AllExpressions => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Expression), useRecursion: true);

		[Description("Gets an ArrayList of Attributes for this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public NodeList Attributes => SupportElements.Attributes;

		[Description("The number of Attributes associated with this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public int AttributeCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SupportElements == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _SupportElements.AttributeCount;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets an ArrayList of AttributeSections for this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public NodeList AttributeSections => SupportElements.AttributeSections;

		[Description("The number of AttributeSections associated with this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public int AttributeSectionsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SupportElements == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _SupportElements.AttributeSectionsCount;
			}
		}

		[Description("A create-on-demand collection of comments bound to this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public CommentCollection Comments
		{
			get
			{
				ParseOnDemandIfNeeded();
				return SupportElements.InnerComments;
			}
		}

		[Description("The number of comments bound to this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public int CommentCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SupportElements != null)
				{
					return _SupportElements.CommentCount;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets xml doc comment associated with this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public XmlDocComment DocComment
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SupportElements == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _SupportElements.DocComment;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement FirstNode
		{
			get
			{
				GetSupportNodes(out var topSupportElement, out var _);
				LanguageElement firstChild = FirstChild;
				if (topSupportElement == null)
				{
					return firstChild;
				}
				if (firstChild == null || topSupportElement.Range.Start < firstChild.Range.Start)
				{
					return topSupportElement;
				}
				return firstChild;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement LastNode
		{
			get
			{
				GetSupportNodes(out var _, out var bottomSupportElement);
				LanguageElement lastChild = LastChild;
				if (bottomSupportElement == null)
				{
					return lastChild;
				}
				if (lastChild == null || bottomSupportElement.Range.End > lastChild.Range.End)
				{
					return bottomSupportElement;
				}
				return lastChild;
			}
		}

		public CodeElement()
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_SupportElements != null)
			{
				_SupportElements.CleanUp();
				_SupportElements = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void TransferCommentsTo(CodeElement element)
		{
			if (_SupportElements != null)
			{
				_SupportElements.TransferCommentsTo(element);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void TransferXmlDocCommentTo(CodeElement element)
		{
			if (_SupportElements != null)
			{
				_SupportElements.TransferXmlDocCommentTo(element);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetDocComment(XmlDocComment value)
		{
			SupportElements.DocComment = value;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int SkipStartSupportElement(LanguageElement start, SupportElement support)
		{
			if (start == null || support == null || start.OwningList == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num;
			for (num = start.OwningList.IndexOf(start) - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)start.OwningList[num];
				if (!(languageElement is SupportElement) || languageElement.Range.Start <= support.Range.End)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return num + 1;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int SkipEndSupportElement(LanguageElement start, SupportElement support)
		{
			if (start == null || support == null || start.OwningList == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = start.OwningList.IndexOf(start) + 1; i < start.OwningList.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)start.OwningList[i];
				if (!(languageElement is SupportElement) || languageElement.Range.Start >= support.Range.Start)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetAttributes(LanguageElementCollection attributes)
		{
			SetAttributes((NodeList)attributes);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void SetAttributes(NodeList attributes)
		{
			SetAttributeSections(attributes);
			AddAttributeSections(attributes);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void InsertSupportElement(SupportElement element, out NodeList nodeList, out int index)
		{
			GetSupportElementNodeListAndIndex(element, out nodeList, out index);
			if (nodeList != null && index >= 0)
			{
				element.SetTarget(this);
				InsertNodeToNodeListWithoutReIndex(nodeList, index, element);
			}
		}

		public void AddAttributeSection(AttributeSection section)
		{
			if (section != null)
			{
				NodeList nodeList = new NodeList();
				nodeList.Add(section);
				AddAttributeSections(nodeList);
				SupportElements.AddAttributeSection(section);
				CollectAttributes(nodeList);
			}
		}

		private void GetSupportElementNodeListAndIndex(SupportElement element, out NodeList nodeList, out int index)
		{
			AddSupportElemetIfOwningListIsNull(element);
			switch (element.Position)
			{
			case SupportElementPosition.Before:
				nodeList = base.OwningList;
				index = SkipStartSupportElement(this, element);
				break;
			case SupportElementPosition.After:
				nodeList = base.OwningList;
				index = SkipEndSupportElement(this, element);
				break;
			case SupportElementPosition.Inside:
			{
				LanguageElement elementToInsertBefore = GetElementToInsertBefore(DetailNodes, element);
				if (elementToInsertBefore == null)
				{
					PrepareNodeList();
					nodeList = Nodes;
					elementToInsertBefore = GetElementToInsertBefore(nodeList, element);
				}
				else
				{
					PrepareDetailNodeList();
					nodeList = DetailNodes;
				}
				if (elementToInsertBefore == null)
				{
					index = nodeList.Count;
				}
				else
				{
					index = nodeList.IndexOf(elementToInsertBefore);
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
				nodeList = null;
				index = -1;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddSupportElemetIfOwningListIsNull(SupportElement element)
		{
			if (base.OwningList == null && element.Position != SupportElementPosition.Inside)
			{
				element.SetTarget(this);
			}
		}

		private void CollectAttributes(NodeList sections)
		{
			if (sections == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sections[i] is AttributeSection section)
				{
					AddAttributes(section);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddAttributes(AttributeSection section)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < section.AttributeCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				Attribute attribute = (Attribute)section.AttributeCollection[i];
				attribute.SetTarget(this);
				SupportElements.AddAttribute(attribute);
			}
		}

		private void AddAttributeSections(NodeList sections)
		{
			if (sections == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sections[i] is AttributeSection element)
				{
					AddSupportElement(element);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetAttributeSections(NodeList sections)
		{
			if (sections != null && sections.Count != 0)
			{
				SupportElements.AttributeSections = sections;
				CollectAttributes(sections);
			}
		}

		private LanguageElement GetElementToInsertBefore(NodeList nodes, SupportElement support)
		{
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0 || support == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement documentElement = (LanguageElement)nodes[nodes.Count - 1];
			if (!support.StartsBefore(documentElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Do obj = this as Do;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)nodes[i];
				if ((obj == null || obj.Condition != languageElement) && support.StartsBefore(languageElement))
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RestoreSupportElementLinks(NodeList nodeList, NodeList sourceNodeList)
		{
			if (sourceNodeList == null || nodeList.Count != sourceNodeList.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < sourceNodeList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(nodeList[i] is SupportElement supportElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				SupportElement supportElement2 = (SupportElement)sourceNodeList[i];
				if (!(supportElement2.TargetNode is CodeElement codeElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (codeElement == supportElement2.Parent)
				{
					supportElement.SetTarget(this);
					continue;
				}
				int num = sourceNodeList.IndexOf(codeElement);
				if (num < 0 || num > sourceNodeList.Count)
				{
					break;
				}
				CodeElement codeElement2 = (CodeElement)nodeList[num];
				supportElement.SetTarget(codeElement2);
				if (supportElement is XmlDocComment)
				{
					codeElement2.SetDocComment((XmlDocComment)supportElement);
				}
				else if (supportElement is Comment)
				{
					codeElement2.AddComment((Comment)supportElement);
				}
				else if (supportElement is AttributeSection)
				{
					AttributeSection section = (AttributeSection)supportElement;
					codeElement2.SupportElements.AddAttributeSection(section);
					codeElement2.AddAttributes(section);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RestoreSupportElementLinks(CodeElement source)
		{
			RestoreSupportElementLinks(DetailNodes, source.DetailNodes);
			RestoreSupportElementLinks(Nodes, source.Nodes);
		}

		private void GetSupportNodes(out LanguageElement topSupportElement, out LanguageElement bottomSupportElement)
		{
			ElementRangeHelper.GetFullBlockNodes(this, BlockElements.AllSupportElements, includeComplitingElements: false, out topSupportElement, out bottomSupportElement);
			if (topSupportElement == this)
			{
				topSupportElement = null;
			}
			if (bottomSupportElement == this)
			{
				bottomSupportElement = null;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected LanguageElement GetLanguageElementLink(LanguageElement source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (source.IsDetailNode)
			{
				return DetailNodes[source.Index] as LanguageElement;
			}
			return Nodes[source.Index] as LanguageElement;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected SupportElement GetSupportElementLink(SupportElement source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			source.SetTarget(this);
			return GetLanguageElementLink(source) as SupportElement;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is CodeElement)
				{
					CodeElement source2 = (CodeElement)source;
					RestoreSupportElementLinks(source2);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_SupportElements != null && _SupportElements.ContainsElement(oldElement))
			{
				_SupportElements.ReplaceElement(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void AddSupportElement(SupportElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				element.Parent?.RemoveNode(this);
				GetSupportElementNodeListAndIndex(element, out var nodeList, out var index);
				if (nodeList != null && index >= 0)
				{
					element.SetTarget(this);
					InsertNodeToNodeList(nodeList, index, element);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddComment(Comment comment)
		{
			AddComment(comment, useSorting: false);
		}

		public void AddComment(Comment comment, bool useSorting)
		{
			if (comment == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!useSorting)
			{
				SupportElements.AddComment(comment);
				return;
			}
			SourcePoint start = comment.Range.Start;
			int nodeIndexAfter = GetNodeIndexAfter(SupportElements.InnerComments, start.Line, start.Offset);
			if (nodeIndexAfter < 0)
			{
				SupportElements.AddComment(comment);
			}
			else
			{
				SupportElements.InsertComment(nodeIndexAfter, comment);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveComment(Comment element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				SupportElements.RemoveComment(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddCommentNode(Comment comment)
		{
			AddSupportElement(comment);
			Comments.Add(comment);
		}

		public Attribute FindAttribute(string name)
		{
			if (AttributeCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			NodeList attributes = Attributes;
			foreach (LanguageElement item in attributes)
			{
				if (string.Compare(item.Name, name, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0)
				{
					return item as Attribute;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class CompilerDirectiveCollection : NodeList
	{
		public new CompilerDirective this[int aIndex] => (CompilerDirective)base[aIndex];

		public void Add(CompilerDirective directive)
		{
			base.Add(directive);
		}

		public void Remove(CompilerDirective directive)
		{
			base.Remove(directive);
		}

		public CompilerDirective Find(string directive)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					CompilerDirective compilerDirective = (CompilerDirective)enumerator.Current;
					if (compilerDirective.Name == directive)
					{
						return compilerDirective;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new CompilerDirectiveCollection();
		}
	}
	public class ConditionalParentingStatement : ParentingStatement
	{
		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return 1 + GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ConditionalParentingStatement conditionalParentingStatement = new ConditionalParentingStatement();
			conditionalParentingStatement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return conditionalParentingStatement;
		}
	}
	public class ConditionalParentToSingleStatement : ParentToSingleStatement
	{
		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return 1 + GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ConditionalParentToSingleStatement conditionalParentToSingleStatement = new ConditionalParentToSingleStatement();
			conditionalParentToSingleStatement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return conditionalParentToSingleStatement;
		}
	}
	public interface IHasBlock
	{
		SourceRange BlockStart { get; }

		SourceRange BlockEnd { get; }

		void SetBlockStart(SourceRange blockStart);

		void SetBlockEnd(SourceRange blockEnd);
	}
	public interface ICapableBlock : IHasBlock
	{
		DelimiterBlockType BlockType { get; }

		bool HasDelimitedBlock { get; }
	}
	public enum DelimiterBlockType : byte
	{
		None,
		Brace,
		Token,
		Middle
	}
	public abstract class DelimiterCapableBlock : CodeElement, ICapableBlock, IHasBlock
	{
		private TextRangeWrapper _BlockStart;

		private TextRangeWrapper _BlockEnd;

		private DelimiterBlockType _BlockType;

		[Description("Returns true if this node owns a delimited block of code. For example, in C#, a Method body is delimited by \"{\" and \"}\" characters.")]
		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public bool HasDelimitedBlock
		{
			get
			{
				if (BlockStart != SourceRange.Empty)
				{
					return BlockEnd != SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("The position of the start delimiter of a blocked pair. In C#, this will mark the position of the \"{\" for a node which owns such a block.")]
		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public SourceRange BlockStart => GetTransformedRange(_BlockStart);

		[Description("The position of the end delimiter of a blocked pair. In C#, this will mark the position of the \"}\" for a node which owns such a block.")]
		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public SourceRange BlockEnd => GetTransformedRange(_BlockEnd);

		[Description("Gets the range of code inside this element.")]
		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public SourceRange BlockCodeRange => GetBlockCodeRange(checkRegions: false);

		[Description("Gets the range of code iside this element, including region and compiler directives")]
		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public SourceRange ExtendedBlockCodeRange => GetBlockCodeRange(checkRegions: true, checkDirectives: true);

		[Description("Gets block range including block delimiters.")]
		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public SourceRange BlockRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (BlockType != DelimiterBlockType.Brace)
				{
					return BlockCodeRange;
				}
				SourcePoint start = BlockStart.Start.Clone();
				SourcePoint end = BlockEnd.End.Clone();
				return new SourceRange(start, end);
			}
		}

		[Description("The type of this delimited block.")]
		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public DelimiterBlockType BlockType => _BlockType;

		SourceRange IHasBlock.BlockStart => BlockStart;

		SourceRange IHasBlock.BlockEnd => BlockEnd;

		public DelimiterCapableBlock()
		{
			_BlockType = DelimiterBlockType.None;
		}

		private SourceRange GetBlockCodeRangeFromChildren()
		{
			SourceRange result = SourceRange.Empty;
			LanguageElement languageElement = FirstChild;
			LanguageElement lastChild = LastChild;
			if (HasDelimitedBlock)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				while (languageElement != null && !languageElement.StartsAfter(BlockStart.End))
				{
					object obj = hashtable[languageElement];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						break;
					}
					hashtable.Add(languageElement, languageElement);
					languageElement = languageElement.NextSibling;
				}
				hashtable.Clear();
				while (lastChild != null && !lastChild.EndsBefore(BlockEnd.Start))
				{
					object obj2 = hashtable[lastChild];
					if (obj2 != null)
					{
						break;
					}
					hashtable.Add(lastChild, lastChild);
					lastChild = lastChild.LastChild;
				}
				if (BlockType != DelimiterBlockType.Brace && lastChild == null && languageElement != null)
				{
					return new SourceRange(languageElement.Range.Start, BlockEnd.Start);
				}
			}
			if (languageElement != null && lastChild != null)
			{
				result = new SourceRange(languageElement.Range.Start, lastChild.Range.End);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SourceRange GetBlockCodeRangeForEmptyBlock()
		{
			if (!HasDelimitedBlock)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange range = SourceRange.Empty;
			if (BlockType == DelimiterBlockType.Brace)
			{
				return new SourceRange(BlockStart.End, BlockEnd.Start);
			}
			if (BlockType == DelimiterBlockType.Token)
			{
				range = new SourceRange(BlockStart.Start.Line + 1, 1, BlockEnd.Start.Line, BlockEnd.Start.Offset);
				SourceRange range2 = AdjustBlockCodeRangeToDetailNodes(range);
				return AdjustRangeToParens(range2);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		private SourceRange AdjustRangeToParens(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (!(this is Method { ParamCloseRange: { IsEmpty: false } } method))
			{
				return range;
			}
			if (range.StartsAfter(method.ParamCloseRange))
			{
				return range;
			}
			return new SourceRange(method.ParamCloseRange.End.Line + 1, 1, range.End.Line, range.End.Offset);
		}

		private SourceRange AdjustBlockCodeRangeToDetailNodes(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (base.DetailNodeCount == 0)
			{
				return range;
			}
			NodeList detailNodes = DetailNodes;
			SourceRange result = range;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DetailNodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (!(detailNodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (result.IsEmpty)
				{
					result = languageElement.Range;
				}
				if (!languageElement.StartsBefore(BlockStart.End) && !languageElement.EndsAfter(BlockEnd.Start))
				{
					SourceRange range2 = languageElement.Range;
					if (result.Contains(range2))
					{
						result.Start = new SourcePoint(range2.End.Line + 1, 1);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SourceRange AdjustBlockCodeRangeToNodes(SourceRange range, IList nodes)
		{
			SourceRange result = range;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (result.IsEmpty)
				{
					result = languageElement.Range;
				}
				if (!languageElement.StartsBefore(BlockStart.End) && !languageElement.EndsAfter(BlockEnd.Start))
				{
					SourceRange range2 = languageElement.Range;
					if (result.Start > range2.Start)
					{
						result.Start = range2.Start;
					}
					if (result.End < range2.End)
					{
						result.End = range2.End;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SourceRange AdjustBlockCodeRangeToRegions(SourceRange range)
		{
			LanguageElement regionRootNode = base.FileNode.RegionRootNode;
			if (regionRootNode == null)
			{
				return range;
			}
			LanguageElementCollection selectedNodes = ParserUtils.GetSelectedNodes(regionRootNode, base.Range);
			return AdjustBlockCodeRangeToNodes(range, selectedNodes);
		}

		private SourceRange AdjustBlockCodeRangeToComplilerDirectives(SourceRange range)
		{
			LanguageElement compilerDirectiveRootNode = base.FileNode.CompilerDirectiveRootNode;
			if (compilerDirectiveRootNode == null)
			{
				return range;
			}
			LanguageElementCollection selectedNodes = ParserUtils.GetSelectedNodes(compilerDirectiveRootNode, base.Range);
			return AdjustBlockCodeRangeToNodes(range, selectedNodes);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is DelimiterCapableBlock)
				{
					DelimiterCapableBlock delimiterCapableBlock = (DelimiterCapableBlock)source;
					_BlockStart = delimiterCapableBlock.BlockStart;
					_BlockEnd = delimiterCapableBlock.BlockEnd;
					_BlockType = delimiterCapableBlock.BlockType;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ParsePostponedTokens()
		{
			if (PostponedData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ParserBase parser = PostponedData.Parser;
			if (parser == null || !base.HasUnparsedCode)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceFile sourceFile = GetSourceFile();
			RegionDirective regionContext = PostponedData.RegionContext;
			CompilerDirective compilerDirective = null;
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			ParserContext parserContext = new ParserContext();
			parserContext.Context = this;
			parserContext.Document = Document;
			parserContext.ParseRange = base.InternalRange;
			parserContext.AutoSetValues();
			if (regionContext != null)
			{
				parserContext.RegionContext = regionContext;
			}
			if (sourceFile != null && sourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode != null && sourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode.GetChildAt(base.InternalRange.Start) is CompilerDirective compilerDirectiveContext)
			{
				parserContext.CompilerDirectiveContext = compilerDirectiveContext;
			}
			ISourceReader unparsedCode = PostponedData.UnparsedCode;
			unparsedCode.OffsetSubStream(base.InternalRange.Start.Line + PostponedData.LineOffset, base.InternalRange.Start.Offset + PostponedData.ColumnOffset);
			DocumentHistorySlice history = History;
			languageElement = parser.Parse(parserContext, unparsedCode);
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				while (languageElement is ParentToSingleStatement && !((ParentToSingleStatement)languageElement).HasBlock)
				{
					object obj = hashtable[languageElement];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						break;
					}
					hashtable.Add(languageElement, languageElement);
					LanguageElement lastChild = languageElement.LastChild;
					if (lastChild != null)
					{
						languageElement.SetEnd(lastChild.EndLine, lastChild.EndOffset);
					}
					languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
				}
				SetHistory(history);
				if (parserContext.CompilerDirectiveContext != null)
				{
					parserContext.CompilerDirectiveContext.SetHistory(history);
				}
				if (parserContext.RegionContext != null)
				{
					parserContext.RegionContext.SetHistory(history);
				}
			}
			if (base.HasPostponedComments)
			{
				CommentCollection commentCollection = new CommentCollection();
				commentCollection.AddRange(base.PostponedComments);
				foreach (Comment item in commentCollection)
				{
					item.SetHistory(History);
				}
				base.PostponedComments.Clear();
				parser.IntroduceComments(this, commentCollection);
			}
			CleanUpPostponedData();
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_BlockStart = BlockStart;
			_BlockEnd = BlockEnd;
		}

		public virtual void PatchIt(SourceRange sRange, SourceRange eRange)
		{
			SetBlockEnd(eRange);
			SetBlockStart(sRange);
			SetBlockType(DelimiterBlockType.Token);
		}

		public override void ParseOnDemandIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!UsePostponedParsing || !base.HasUnparsedCode)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				if (!base.ParsingPostponedTokens)
				{
					base.ParsingPostponedTokens = true;
					ParsePostponedTokens();
					base.ParsingPostponedTokens = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public SourceRange GetBlockCodeRange(bool checkRegions)
		{
			return GetBlockCodeRange(checkRegions, checkDirectives: false);
		}

		public SourceRange GetBlockCodeRange(bool checkRegions, bool checkDirectives)
		{
			SourceRange sourceRange = GetBlockCodeRangeFromChildren();
			if (checkRegions)
			{
				sourceRange = AdjustBlockCodeRangeToRegions(sourceRange);
			}
			if (checkDirectives)
			{
				sourceRange = AdjustBlockCodeRangeToComplilerDirectives(sourceRange);
			}
			if (sourceRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				sourceRange = GetBlockCodeRangeForEmptyBlock();
			}
			return sourceRange;
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetBlockType(DelimiterBlockType type)
		{
			_BlockType = type;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetBlockStart(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_BlockStart = range;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetBlockEnd(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_BlockEnd = range;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DocumentElement : BaseElement
	{
		private TextRange _InternalRange = TextRange.Empty;

		private DocumentHistorySlice _History;

		private NodeList _Nodes = NodeList.Empty;

		private NodeList _DetailNodes = NodeList.Empty;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected internal string InternalName = string.Empty;

		protected internal override NodeList InnerNodes => _Nodes;

		protected internal override NodeList InnerDetailNodes => _DetailNodes;

		[Description("The line number where this language element starts.")]
		[Category("Position")]
		public int StartLine => InternalRange.Start.Line;

		[Description("The line number where this language element ends.")]
		[Category("Position")]
		public virtual int EndLine => InternalRange.End.Line;

		[Description("The column offset where this language element starts.")]
		[Category("Position")]
		public int StartOffset => InternalRange.Start.Offset;

		[Description("The column offset where this language element ends.")]
		[Category("Position")]
		public virtual int EndOffset => InternalRange.End.Offset;

		[Description("The name of this language element class.")]
		[Category("Description")]
		public string ClassName
		{
			get
			{
				Type type = GetType();
				return type.FullName;
			}
		}

		[Description("The name of this language element.")]
		[Category("Description")]
		public override string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return InternalName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(InternalName == value))
				{
					InternalName = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("The language elements parented by this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public override NodeList Nodes => InnerNodes;

		[Description("The detail language elements associated with this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public override NodeList DetailNodes => InnerDetailNodes;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual DocumentHistorySlice History => _History;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public SourceRange InternalRange => GetTransformedRange(_InternalRange);

		public SourceRange RecoveredRange => GetRecoveredRange(_InternalRange);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool IsNewContext => false;

		public virtual SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		private SourceRange GetRecoveredRange(TextRange original)
		{
			if (History == null || original.IsEmpty)
			{
				return original.ToSourceRange();
			}
			return History.TransformWithRecover(original);
		}

		private void CloneChildren(DocumentElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (options != null && options.NeedToCloneNodes(this))
			{
				if (source._Nodes == null || source._Nodes == NodeList.Empty)
				{
					_Nodes = NodeList.Empty;
				}
				else
				{
					_Nodes = source._Nodes.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
			if (source._DetailNodes == null || source._DetailNodes == NodeList.Empty)
			{
				_DetailNodes = NodeList.Empty;
			}
			else
			{
				_DetailNodes = source._DetailNodes.DeepClone(options);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void CloneRegions(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected static void SetHistory(NodeList list, DocumentHistorySlice history)
		{
			SetHistory(list, 0, history);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected static void SetHistory(NodeList list, int index, DocumentHistorySlice history)
		{
			if (list != null)
			{
				int count = list.Count;
				for (int i = index; i < count; i++)
				{
					DocumentElement documentElement = (DocumentElement)list[i];
					documentElement.SetHistory(history, isRecursive: true);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual SourceRange GetTransformedRange(TextRange original)
		{
			if (History == null || original.IsEmpty)
			{
				return original.ToSourceRange();
			}
			return History.Transform(original);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRanges()
		{
			_InternalRange = InternalRange;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void ClearHistory()
		{
			if (_History != null)
			{
				UpdateRanges();
				_History = null;
			}
		}

		protected void SelectCode(IDXCoreTextView textView, int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset, bool ensureVisible)
		{
			textView?.Select(startLine, startOffset, endLine, endOffset, ensureVisible);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void SetInnerDetailNodes(NodeList value)
		{
			if (_DetailNodes != value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = NodeList.Empty;
				}
				_DetailNodes = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void SetInnerNodes(NodeList value)
		{
			if (_Nodes != value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = NodeList.Empty;
				}
				_Nodes = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected internal void PrepareDetailNodeList()
		{
			if (_DetailNodes == NodeList.Empty)
			{
				_DetailNodes = CreateNodeList();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected internal void PrepareNodeList()
		{
			if (_Nodes == NodeList.Empty)
			{
				_Nodes = CreateNodeList();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected long GetTotalMemoryForNodeList(NodeList nodeList)
		{
			if (nodeList == null || nodeList.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0L;
			}
			long num = 0L;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeList.Count; i++)
			{
				num += ((DocumentElement)nodeList[i]).GetTotalMemory();
			}
			return num;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected long GetTotalMemoryForDetailNodes()
		{
			return GetTotalMemoryForNodeList(_DetailNodes);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected long GetTotalMemoryForNodes()
		{
			return GetTotalMemoryForNodeList(_Nodes);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is DocumentElement documentElement)
			{
				InternalName = documentElement.InternalName;
				options.BeginChildrenCloning();
				try
				{
					CloneChildren(documentElement, options);
				}
				finally
				{
					options.EndChildrenCloning();
				}
				SetRange(documentElement.InternalRange);
				CloneRegions(documentElement, options);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public long GetTotalMemory()
		{
			return GetTotalMemory(forceFullCollection: false);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public long GetTotalMemory(bool forceFullCollection)
		{
			if (forceFullCollection)
			{
				GC.Collect();
				GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();
			}
			long totalMemoryForDetailNodes = GetTotalMemoryForDetailNodes();
			long totalMemoryForNodes = GetTotalMemoryForNodes();
			long num = MemoryHelper.SizeOf(this);
			return num + totalMemoryForDetailNodes + totalMemoryForNodes;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool DetailNodesFollowChildNodes()
		{
			if (_DetailNodes == null || _DetailNodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_Nodes == null || _Nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DocumentElement documentElement = (DocumentElement)_DetailNodes[0];
			DocumentElement documentElement2 = (DocumentElement)_Nodes[0];
			return documentElement.InternalRange.Start > documentElement2.InternalRange.Start;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetHistory(DocumentHistorySlice history)
		{
			SetHistory(history, isRecursive: true);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetHistory(DocumentHistorySlice history, bool isRecursive)
		{
			SetHistory(0, history, isRecursive);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void SetHistory(int nodeIndex, DocumentHistorySlice history, bool isRecursive)
		{
			if (_History == null)
			{
				_History = history;
			}
			if (isRecursive)
			{
				SetHistory(_DetailNodes, history);
				SetHistory(_Nodes, nodeIndex, history);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			if (_Nodes != NodeList.Empty)
			{
				_Nodes.Clear();
				_Nodes = NodeList.Empty;
			}
			if (_DetailNodes != NodeList.Empty)
			{
				_DetailNodes.Clear();
				_DetailNodes = NodeList.Empty;
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			try
			{
				CleanUpOwnedReferencesForNodes(_Nodes);
				CleanUpOwnedReferencesForNodes(_DetailNodes);
				_Nodes = NodeList.Empty;
				_DetailNodes = NodeList.Empty;
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException($"Exception has been thrown while cleaning up {GetType().FullName} element references.", value);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void PrepareToParentNodes()
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public virtual int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 57;
		}

		public void SelectCode(IDXCoreTextView textView)
		{
			SelectCode(textView, aEnsureVisible: false);
		}

		{
			SelectCode(textView, InternalRange.Start.Line, InternalRange.Start.Offset, EndLine, EndOffset, aEnsureVisible);
		}

		public virtual bool Contains(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (line < InternalRange.Start.Line || line > EndLine)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (line == InternalRange.Start.Line && offset < InternalRange.Start.Offset)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (line == EndLine && offset > EndOffset)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Contains(SourcePoint point)
		{
			return Contains(point.Line, point.Offset);
		}

		public bool Contains(DocumentElement aElement)
		{
			if (aElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Contains(aElement.StartLine, aElement.StartOffset))
			{
				return Contains(aElement.EndLine, aElement.EndOffset);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(SourceRange aRange)
		{
			if (Contains(aRange.Top.Line, aRange.Top.Offset))
			{
				return Contains(aRange.Bottom.Line, aRange.Bottom.Offset);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ContainedIn(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset)
		{
			if (InternalRange.Start.Line < startLine || EndLine > endLine)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (InternalRange.Start.Line == startLine && InternalRange.Start.Offset < startOffset)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (EndLine == endLine && EndOffset > endOffset)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool ContainedIn(SourcePoint start, SourcePoint end)
		{
			return ContainedIn(start.Line, start.Offset, end.Line, end.Offset);
		}

		public bool ContainedIn(SourceRange aRange)
		{
			return ContainedIn(aRange.Top.Line, aRange.Top.Offset, aRange.Bottom.Line, aRange.Bottom.Offset);
		}

		public virtual string GetDetailNodeDescription(int index)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public bool StartsAfter(int lineNumber, int columnOffset)

		}

	public class ElementCloneOptions
	{
		private bool _CloneUpToMembers;

		private bool _KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate;

		private bool _PerformParseBeforeClone;

		private bool _CloneNodes;

		private bool _CloneRegions;

		private SourceFile _SourceFile;

		private int _CloneChildrenCount;

		private Dictionary<LanguageElement, LanguageElement> _ClonedElements;

		private ITypeReferenceExpression _TypeReferencePrototype;

		internal bool CloningChildren => _CloneChildrenCount > 0;

		public static ElementCloneOptions Default => new ElementCloneOptions();

		public bool CloneNodes
		{
			get
			{
				return _CloneNodes;
			}
			set
			{
				_CloneNodes = value;
			}
		}

		public bool CloneRegions
		{
			get
			{
				return _CloneRegions;
			}
			set
			{
				_CloneRegions = value;
			}
		}

		public bool CloneUpToMembers
		{
			get
			{
				return _CloneUpToMembers;
			}
			set
			{
				_CloneUpToMembers = value;
			}
		}

		public bool KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return _KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				_KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("Use KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate")]
		public bool KeepAsseccSpecifierTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate;
			}
			set
			{
				KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate = value;
			}
		}

		public bool PerformParseBeforeClone
		{
			get
			{
				return _PerformParseBeforeClone;
			}
			set
			{
				_PerformParseBeforeClone = value;
			}
		}

		public ITypeReferenceExpression TypeReferencePrototype
		{
			get
			{
				return _TypeReferencePrototype;
			}
			set
			{
				_TypeReferencePrototype = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceFile SourceFile
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceFile;
			}
			set
			{
				_SourceFile = value;
			}
		}

		public ElementCloneOptions()
		{
			ResetToDefaults();
		}

		internal void AddClonedElement(LanguageElement sourceElement, LanguageElement clonedElement)
		{
			if (sourceElement != null && clonedElement != null && _ClonedElements != null)
			{
				_ClonedElements[sourceElement] = clonedElement;
			}
		}

		internal LanguageElement GetClonedElement(LanguageElement sourceElement)
		{
			LanguageElement value = null;
			if (_ClonedElements != null && _ClonedElements.TryGetValue(sourceElement, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool BeginChildrenCloning()
		{
			_CloneChildrenCount++;
			return _CloneChildrenCount == 1;
		}

		internal bool EndChildrenCloning()
		{
			_CloneChildrenCount--;
			return _CloneChildrenCount == 0;
		}

		public virtual bool NeedToCloneNodes(BaseElement element)
		{
			if (!_CloneNodes)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is LanguageElement languageElement && CloneUpToMembers)
			{
				if (languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EventAdd && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EventRemove)
				{
					return languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Method;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetToDefaults()
		{
			_CloneUpToMembers = false;
			_PerformParseBeforeClone = false;
			_CloneNodes = true;
			_CloneRegions = false;
			_ClonedElements = new Dictionary<LanguageElement, LanguageElement>();
		}
	}
	public class ElementEnumerable : IEnumerable
	{
		private LanguageElement _Scope;

		private IElementFilter _Filter;

		private bool _UseRecursion;

		private bool _SkipScope;

		public IElementFilter Filter => _Filter;

		public bool UseRecursion => _UseRecursion;

		public bool SkipScope
		{
			get
			{
				return _SkipScope;
			}
			set
			{
				_SkipScope = value;
			}
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope)
			: this(scope, useRecursion: false)
		{
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, bool useRecursion)
			: this(scope, (IElementFilter)null, useRecursion)
		{
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, IElementFilter filter)
			: this(scope, filter, useRecursion: false)
		{
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, IElementFilter filter, bool useRecursion)
		{
			if (scope == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("scope");
			}
			_Scope = scope;
			_Filter = filter;
			_UseRecursion = useRecursion;
			_SkipScope = true;
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, LanguageElementType filterType)
			: this(scope, filterType, useRecursion: false)
		{
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, LanguageElementType filterType, bool useRecursion)
			: this(scope, useRecursion)
		{
			_Filter = GetFilter(filterType);
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, LanguageElementType[] filterTypes)
			: this(scope, filterTypes, useRecursion: false)
		{
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, LanguageElementType[] filterTypes, bool useRecursion)
			: this(scope, useRecursion)
		{
			_Filter = GetFilter(filterTypes);
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, Type filterType)
			: this(scope, filterType, useRecursion: false)
		{
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, Type filterType, bool useRecursion)
			: this(scope, useRecursion)
		{
			_Filter = GetFilter(filterType);
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, Type[] filterTypes)
			: this(scope, filterTypes, useRecursion: false)
		{
		}

		public ElementEnumerable(LanguageElement scope, Type[] filterTypes, bool useRecursion)
			: this(scope, useRecursion)
		{
			_Filter = GetFilter(filterTypes);
		}

		private IElementFilter GetFilter(LanguageElementType filterType)
		{
			return new ElementTypeFilter(filterType);
		}

		private IElementFilter GetFilter(LanguageElementType[] filterTypes)
		{
			if (filterTypes == null || filterTypes.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ElementTypeFilter(filterTypes);
		}

		private IElementFilter GetFilter(Type filterType)
		{
			if (filterType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ElementTypeFilter(filterType);
		}

		private IElementFilter GetFilter(Type[] filterTypes)
		{
			if (filterTypes == null || filterTypes.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ElementTypeFilter(filterTypes);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			if (_UseRecursion)
			{
				SourceTreeEnumerator sourceTreeEnumerator = new SourceTreeEnumerator(_Scope, _Filter);
				sourceTreeEnumerator.SkipScope = _SkipScope;
				return sourceTreeEnumerator;
			}
			return new ChildrenEnumerator(_Scope, _Filter);
		}
	}
	public class ElementList : LanguageElement
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ElementList;

		public ElementList()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public ElementList(LanguageElementCollection list)
			: this((NodeList)list)
		{
		}

		public ElementList(NodeList list)
			: this(list, setParent: true)
		{
		}

		public ElementList(NodeList list, bool setParent)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(list[i] is LanguageElement languageElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (setParent)
				{
					AddNode(languageElement);
					continue;
				}
				if (i == 0)
				{
					PrepareNodeList();
				}
				Nodes.Add(languageElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ElementList elementList = new ElementList();
			elementList.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return elementList;
		}
	}

	public abstract class LanguageElement : DocumentElement, IElement, IElementModifier, IEnumerable
	{
		private class LanguageElementStartComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return ((LanguageElement)x).InternalRange.Start.CompareTo(y);
			}
		}

		private class LanguageElementEndComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return ((LanguageElement)x).InternalRange.End.CompareTo(y);
			}
		}

		private class LanguageElementRangeComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)x;
				SourceRange internalRange = languageElement.InternalRange;
				if (internalRange.End.IsEmpty || internalRange.Start.IsEmpty)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				int num = internalRange.End.CompareTo(y);
				int num2 = internalRange.Start.CompareTo(y);
				if (num == num2)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private bool _IsFakeNode;

		private bool _HasErrors;

		private LanguageElementTokens _Tokens;

		private bool _IsRemoved;

		private const int INT_LoopPreventCount = 10000;

		private short _SiblingCounter;

		private LanguageElement _Parent;

		private int _Index = -1;

		private bool _IsDetailNode;

		protected virtual int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 0;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual PostponedParsingData PostponedData
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected internal NodeList OwningList
		{
			get
			{
				if (Parent == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!IsDetailNode)
				{
					return Parent.InnerNodes;
				}
				return Parent.InnerDetailNodes;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected CommentCollection PostponedComments
		{
			get
			{
				if (PostponedData == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return PostponedData.Comments;
			}
			set
			{
				if (PostponedData != null)
				{
					PostponedData.Comments = value;
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

					PostponedData.IsParsing = value;
				}
			}

		[Category("Position")]
		public SourceRange Range => base.InternalRange;

		[Category("Family")]

		public virtual bool DeclaresIdentifier => false;

		[Category("Description")]
		public abstract LanguageElementType ElementType { get; }

		[Description("Whether this language element is inside a Method.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideMethod => Inside(LanguageElementType.Method);

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is inside an Event.")]
		[Category("Location")]

		public bool InsideEvent => GetParentEvent() != null;

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is inside an Event accessor.")]
		[Category("Location")]

		public bool InsideEventAccessor => GetParentEventAccessor() != null;

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is inside left side of an assignment.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideAssignment
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetParent(LanguageElementType.Assignment) is Assignment assignment))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return assignment.LeftSide == this;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is used inside out argument direction expression.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideOutArgumentDirection
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetParent(LanguageElementType.ArgumentDirectionExpression) is ArgumentDirectionExpression argumentDirectionExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return argumentDirectionExpression.Direction == ArgumentDirection.Out;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is used inside ref argument direction expression.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideRefArgumentDirection
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetParent(LanguageElementType.ArgumentDirectionExpression) is ArgumentDirectionExpression argumentDirectionExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return argumentDirectionExpression.Direction == ArgumentDirection.Ref;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is used inside increment expression.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideIncrement
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetParent(LanguageElementType.UnaryIncrement) is UnaryIncrement unaryIncrement))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return unaryIncrement.Expression == this;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is used inside decrement expression.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideDecrement
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(GetParent(LanguageElementType.UnaryDecrement) is UnaryDecrement unaryDecrement))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return unaryDecrement.Expression == this;
			}
		}

		[Description("Whether this language element is inside a Property.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideProperty => Inside(LanguageElementType.Property);

		[Description("Whether this language element is inside a Class.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideClass => Inside(LanguageElementType.Class, LanguageElementType.ManagedClass, LanguageElementType.ValueClass);

		[Description("Whether this language element is inside a Struct.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideStruct => Inside(LanguageElementType.Struct, LanguageElementType.ManagedStruct, LanguageElementType.ValueStruct);

		[Description("Whether this language element is inside an Interface declaration.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool InsideInterface => Inside(LanguageElementType.Interface);

		[Description("Whether this language element is inside a Namespace.")]
		[Category("Location")]

		public bool InsideNamespace => Inside(LanguageElementType.Namespace);

		[Description("Whether this language element is a detail node.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsDetailNode
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsDetailNode;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsDetailNode = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this language element was parsed from a source file.")]
		public bool HasDocument => Document != null;

		[Description("Gets the number of parent nodes between this node and the topmost node, inclusive of the topmost node.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		public int LevelsDeep
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				LanguageElement languageElement = this;
				while (languageElement.Parent != null)
				{
					languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		[Description("The parent of this language element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public LanguageElement Parent => _Parent;

		[Description("The parent of this language element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public SourceFile FileNode => GetParent(LanguageElementType.SourceFile) as SourceFile;

		[Description("The region that parents this node.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public RegionDirective ParentRegion
		{
			get
			{
				SourceFile sourceFile = GetSourceFile();
				if (sourceFile == null || sourceFile.RegionRootNode == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return sourceFile.RegionRootNode.GetChildAt(base.InternalRange.Start) as RegionDirective;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this language element is loop statement.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public bool IsLoop
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is ParentingStatement)
				{
					ParentingStatement parentingStatement = (ParentingStatement)this;
					if (parentingStatement.IsBreakable)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("The parenting loop, switch statement, or other code block that can be broken by a \"break;\" statement.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public ParentingStatement ParentLoop
		{
			get
			{
				LanguageElement parent = _Parent;
				while (parent != null && parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression && parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression)
				{
					if (parent.IsLoop)
					{
						return parent as ParentingStatement;
					}
					parent = parent._Parent;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("The parenting try block that contains this language element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public Try ParentTryBlock
		{
			get
			{
				for (LanguageElement parent = _Parent; parent != null; parent = parent._Parent)
				{
					if (parent is Try)
					{
						return (Try)parent;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets parent with statement for this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public LanguageElement ParentWith => GetParent(LanguageElementType.With);

		[Category("Location")]
		public virtual string ParentPath
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parent != null)
				{

				return string.Empty;

		public virtual ISolutionElement Solution
		{

				IProjectElement project = Project;

		public virtual IProjectElement Project => GetParentDocument()?.Project;

		[Description("The location of this node as a string.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		public string Location
		{
			get
			{
				string text = GetFullPath();
				if (PathSegment == string.Empty)
				{
					string text2 = ToString();
					if (text2 != string.Empty)
					{
						text = text + " - " + text2;
					}
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the location of this node as a string starting with root namespace.")]
		[Category("Location")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public string RootNamespaceLocation
		{
			get
			{
				string result = Location;
				IProjectElement project = Project;
				if (project != null && project.HasRootNamespace)
				{
					result = project.RootNamespace + "." + Location;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		[Description("The previous node in the code following the start of this node.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public LanguageElement PreviousNode
		{
			get
			{
				LanguageElement previousSibling = PreviousSibling;
				if (previousSibling != null)
				{
					if (previousSibling.LastChild != null)
					{
						return previousSibling.LastChild;
					}
					if (previousSibling.LastDetail != null)
					{
						return previousSibling.LastDetail;
					}
					return previousSibling;
				}
				if (!IsDetailNode && Parent != null && Parent.LastDetail != null)
				{
					return Parent.LastDetail;
				}
				return Parent;
			}
		}

		[Description("The next node in the code following the start of this node.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public LanguageElement NextNode
		{
			get
			{
				LanguageElement firstDetail = FirstDetail;
				if (firstDetail != null)
				{
					return firstDetail;
				}
				firstDetail = FirstChild;
				if (firstDetail != null)
				{
					return firstDetail;
				}
				firstDetail = NextSibling;
				if (firstDetail != null)
				{
					return firstDetail;
				}
				if (IsDetailNode && Parent != null)
				{
					firstDetail = Parent.FirstChild;
					if (firstDetail != null)
					{
						return firstDetail;
					}
				}
				LanguageElement languageElement = this;
				do
				{
					languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
					if (languageElement == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					firstDetail = languageElement.NextSibling;
					if (firstDetail == null && languageElement.IsDetailNode && languageElement.Parent != null)
					{
						firstDetail = languageElement.Parent.FirstChild;
					}
				}
				while (firstDetail == null);
				return firstDetail;
			}
		}

		[Description("The next sibling to this element, or null if no siblings follow this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public virtual LanguageElement NextSibling
		{
			get
			{
				if (OwningList == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ValidateIndices();
				int num = _Index + 1;
				if (num >= OwningList.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (LanguageElement)OwningList[num];
			}
		}

		[Description("The previous sibling to this element, or null if no siblings precede this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public virtual LanguageElement PreviousSibling
		{
			get
			{
				if (OwningList == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ValidateIndices();
				int num = _Index - 1;
				if (num >= OwningList.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (LanguageElement)OwningList[num];
			}
		}

		[Description("The next non-comment sibling to this element, or null if no siblings containing code follow this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public virtual LanguageElement NextCodeSibling
		{
			get
			{
				if (OwningList == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ValidateIndices();
				int i = _Index + 1;
				if (i < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (; i < OwningList.Count; i++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)OwningList[i];
					if (languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Comment && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.FictiveAspComment)
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		[Description("The previous non-comment sibling to this element, or null if no siblings containing code precede this element.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public virtual LanguageElement PreviousCodeSibling
		{
			get
			{
				if (OwningList == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ValidateIndices();
				int num = _Index - 1;
				if (num >= OwningList.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				while (num >= 0)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)OwningList[num];
					if (!(languageElement is Comment))
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
					num--;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public bool IsRemoved
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsRemoved;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_IsRemoved == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				_IsRemoved = value;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.DetailNodeCount; i++)
				{
					if (DetailNodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement)
					{
						languageElement.IsRemoved = value;
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < base.NodeCount; j++)
				{
					if (Nodes[j] is LanguageElement languageElement2)
					{
						languageElement2.IsRemoved = value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement()

		}

		private void SetSelection(int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset, bool ensureVisible)
		{
			IDocument document = Document;
			if (document != null)
			{
				SetSelection(document.ActiveView, startLine, startOffset, endLine, endOffset, ensureVisible);
			}
		}

		private void SetSelection(IDXCoreTextView textView, int startLine, int startOffset, int endLine, int endOffset, bool ensureVisible)
		{
			textView?.Select(startLine, startOffset, endLine, endOffset, ensureVisible);
		}

		private void AdjustStartToElement(LanguageElement element, ref int startLine, ref int startOffset)
		{
			if (element.StartLine < startLine)
			{
				startLine = element.StartLine;
				startOffset = element.StartOffset;
			}
			else if (element.StartLine == startLine)
			{
				startOffset = Math.Min(startOffset, element.StartOffset);
			}
		}

		private void ParseAllPostponedElementsInNodes(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)nodes[i];
					languageElement.ParseAllPostponedElements();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CheckNodeListIndexes(NodeList nodeList)
		{
			if (nodeList == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodeList[i] is LanguageElement)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)nodeList[i];
					if (languageElement._Index != i)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CheckIndexes(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (!CheckNodeListIndexes(element.DetailNodes))
				{
					throw new Exception($"Detail node indexes are not valid inside {element.Name}.");
				}
				if (!CheckNodeListIndexes(element.Nodes))
				{
					throw new Exception($"Node indexes are not valid inside {element.Name}.");
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateIndices()
		{
			_SiblingCounter++;
			if (_SiblingCounter > 10000)
			{
				CheckIndexes(Parent);
				_SiblingCounter = 0;
			}
		}

		private bool FindInList(NodeList list, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0 || element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement scope = list[i] as LanguageElement;
				if (FindInScope(scope, element))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool FindInScope(LanguageElement scope, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (scope == null || element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (scope == element)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (FindInList(scope.Nodes, element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (FindInList(scope.DetailNodes, element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsTrailingComment(LanguageElement target, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(element is Comment))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Comment comment = (Comment)element;
			if (comment.TargetNode != target)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetNodeLinks(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					languageElement._Parent = this;
					languageElement._Index = i;
				}
			}
		}

		private LanguageElement GetOuterRangeChild(int line, int column, NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (!HasOuterRangeChildren)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = nodes[i] as LanguageElement;
				LanguageElement languageElement2 = null;
				if (languageElement.Contains(line, column))
				{
					languageElement2 = languageElement.GetChildAt(line, column);
					if (languageElement2 == null)
					{
						languageElement2 = languageElement;
					}
					return languageElement2;
				}
				if (languageElement.HasOuterRangeChildren)
				{
					languageElement2 = languageElement.GetChildAt(line, column);
					if (languageElement2 != null)
					{
						return languageElement2;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetChildAtInternal(int line, int column, NodeList lChildList)
		{
			int num = lChildList.BinarySearch(0, new SourcePoint(line, column), new LanguageElementRangeComparer());
			if (num < 0)
			{
				LanguageElement outerRangeChild = GetOuterRangeChild(line, column, lChildList);
				if (outerRangeChild != null)
				{
					return outerRangeChild;
				}
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)lChildList[num];
			SourceRange internalRange = languageElement.InternalRange;
			if (internalRange.Start.IsEmpty || internalRange.End.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = languageElement.GetChildAt(line, column);
			if (languageElement2 == null)
			{
				languageElement2 = languageElement;
			}
			return languageElement2;
		}

		private int GetNodeIndexBeforeInternal(NodeList list, int line, int offset)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = list.BinarySearch(0, new SourcePoint(line, offset), new LanguageElementEndComparer());
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				num--;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetNodeIndexAfterInternal(NodeList list, int line, int offset)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = list.BinarySearch(0, new SourcePoint(line, offset), new LanguageElementStartComparer());
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static bool IsInsideNodeList(NodeList list, SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0 || point == SourcePoint.Empty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = list.Count;
			LanguageElement languageElement = list[0] as LanguageElement;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = list[count - 1] as LanguageElement;
			return new SourceRange(languageElement.Range.Start, languageElement2.Range.End).Contains(point);
		}

		private bool CanInjectInside(SourceRange targetRange, SourceRange elementRange)
		{
			if (targetRange.IsEmpty || elementRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return targetRange.Contains(elementRange);
		}

		private bool CanInjectBetween(SourceRange prev, SourceRange next, SourceRange elementRange)
		{
			if (next.IsEmpty || elementRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (prev.IsEmpty)
			{
				return elementRange.Start <= next.Start;
			}
			if (elementRange.Start > prev.Start)
			{
				return elementRange.Start < next.Start;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InjectElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceRange range = element.Range;
			SourceRange prev = SourceRange.Empty;
			int nodeCount = base.NodeCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (Nodes[i] is LanguageElement { Range: var range2 } languageElement)
				{
					if (CanInjectInside(range2, range))
					{
						languageElement.InjectElement(element);
						return;
					}
					if (CanInjectBetween(prev, range2, range))
					{
						InsertNode(i, element);
						return;
					}
					prev = range2;
				}
			}
			AddNode(element);
		}

		private ICollection CollectRegions(LanguageElement regionRootNode)
		{
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			foreach (RegionDirective item in new ElementEnumerable(regionRootNode, typeof(RegionDirective), useRecursion: true))
			{
				SourceRange range = item.Range;
				if (!hashtable.Contains(range))
				{
					hashtable.Add(range, item);
				}
			}
			return hashtable.Values;
		}

		private void InjectRegions(LanguageElement regionRootNode)
		{
			if (regionRootNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ICollection collection = CollectRegions(regionRootNode);
			foreach (RegionDirective item in collection)
			{
				SourceRange range = item.Range;
				if (Range.Contains(range))
				{
					RegionDirective regionDirective2 = item.Clone() as RegionDirective;
					regionDirective2.SetRange(new SourceRange(range.Start.Line, 1, range.Start.Line, 1));
					EndRegionDirective endRegionDirective = new EndRegionDirective();
					endRegionDirective.SetRange(new SourceRange(range.End.Line, 1, range.End.Line, 1));
					InjectElement(regionDirective2);
					InjectElement(endRegionDirective);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NodeIsAlreadyAdded(LanguageElement parent, NodeList nodeList, LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node.Index < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node.OwningList == nodeList)
			{
				return node.Parent == parent;
			}
			return false;
		}

				PostponedData = null;
			}
