		{
			return GetCollapsibleRegion(null);
		}

		protected ICollapsibleRegion GetCollapsibleRegion(IDXCoreTextView textView)
		{
			if (!IsCollapsible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Document == null)
			{
				Log.SendWarning("LanguageElement.GetCollapsibleRegion() found a null Document property.");
				return null;
			}
			return Document.GetCollapsibleRegion(CollapsibleRange, textView);
		}

		protected bool InsertNodeToNodeListWithoutReIndex(NodeList list, int index, LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (index < 0 || index > list.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = null;
			bool isDetailNode = list == InnerDetailNodes;
			if (list == OwningList)
			{
				isDetailNode = IsDetailNode;
			}
			node._IsDetailNode = isDetailNode;
			if (list == OwningList)
			{
				parent = Parent;
			}
			else if (list == InnerNodes || list == InnerDetailNodes)
			{
				parent = this;
			}
			if (NodeIsAlreadyAdded(parent, list, node))
			{
				return false;
			}
			node.SetParent(parent);
			list.Insert(index, node);
			node._Index = index;
			return true;
		}

		protected void IncreaseNodesIndices(NodeList list, int startFrom)
		{
			list.IncreaseNodesIndices(startFrom);
		}

		protected void DecreaseNodesIndices(NodeList list, int startFrom)
		{
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = startFrom; i < count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)list[i];
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					languageElement._Index--;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetCanBeDocumented()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement GetPreviousChildIdentifier(LanguageElement startingChildNode, LanguageElement aReferenceNode)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			NodeList owningList = startingChildNode.OwningList;
			int index = startingChildNode._Index;
			if (owningList != null && index > 0 && index < owningList.Count)
			{
				int num = index - 1;
				for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement2 = (LanguageElement)owningList[num2];
					if (languageElement2._Index != num2)
					{
						string text = $"Parse tree is corrupted at: {languageElement2.Range}";
						LanguageElement languageElement3 = startingChildNode;
						if (num2 != num)
						{
							languageElement3 = (LanguageElement)owningList[num2 + 1];
						}
						text += $"Next node range: {languageElement3.Range}";
						Log.SendErrorWithStackTrace(text);
						return null;
					}
					if (languageElement2 != null && languageElement2 != startingChildNode && languageElement2.DeclaresIdentifier)
					{
						languageElement = languageElement2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (languageElement == null && owningList != DetailNodes && aReferenceNode.IsParentedBy(this))
			{
				languageElement = GetLastDetailIdentifier();
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetLastSiblingInScope(aReferenceNode);
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement GetLastSiblingInScope(LanguageElement referenceNode)
		{
			LanguageElement parent = _Parent;
			LanguageElement languageElement = this;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = null;
			bool flag = false;
			while (parent != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					LanguageElement lastDetailIdentifier = languageElement.GetLastDetailIdentifier();
					if (lastDetailIdentifier != null)
					{
						languageElement2 = lastDetailIdentifier;
						break;
					}
				}
				languageElement2 = ((!parent.AllChildrenAccessibleByGrandchildren()) ? languageElement : parent.LastChild);
				if (!languageElement2.DeclaresIdentifier)
				{
					languageElement2 = ((languageElement2._Index != 0) ? parent.GetPreviousChildIdentifier(languageElement2, referenceNode) : ((!flag || !referenceNode.IsParentedBy(languageElement2)) ? null : languageElement2.GetLastDetailIdentifier()));
				}
				if (languageElement2 != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				languageElement = parent;
				parent = parent._Parent;
				flag = true;
			}
			return languageElement2;
		}

		protected virtual bool AllChildrenAccessibleByGrandchildren()
		{
			if (ElementType != LanguageElementType.Class && ElementType != LanguageElementType.ManagedClass && ElementType != LanguageElementType.ValueClass && ElementType != LanguageElementType.Struct && ElementType != LanguageElementType.ManagedStruct && ElementType != LanguageElementType.ValueStruct && ElementType != LanguageElementType.Union)
			{
				return ElementType == LanguageElementType.Namespace;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement GetLastIdentifierInList(NodeList list)
		{
			if (list != null)
			{
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)list[num];
					if (languageElement != null && languageElement.DeclaresIdentifier)
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement GetLastDetailIdentifier()
		{
			return GetLastIdentifierInList(DetailNodes);
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement GetLastIdentifier()
		{
			return GetLastIdentifierInList(Nodes);
		}

		protected virtual void AddNodeToNodeList(NodeList aList, LanguageElement aLanguageElement)
		{
			if (aList != null && aLanguageElement != null && !NodeIsAlreadyAdded(this, aList, aLanguageElement))
			{
				aLanguageElement._Index = aList.Count;
				aList.Add(aLanguageElement);
				aLanguageElement._IsDetailNode = aList == InnerDetailNodes;
				aLanguageElement.SetParent(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddNodesToNodeList(NodeList aList, LanguageElementCollectionBase nodes)
		{
			if (aList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object node in nodes)
			{
				if (node is LanguageElement)
				{
					AddNodeToNodeList(aList, (LanguageElement)node);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveNodeFromNodeList(NodeList list, LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (list == null || element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int index = element._Index;
			if (index >= 0 && index < list.Count)
			{
				element._Index = -1;
				element.SetParent(null);
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Remove(element);
				}
				DecreaseNodesIndices(list, index);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InsertNodeToNodeList(NodeList list, int index, LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (list != null && index >= 0 && index <= list.Count && InsertNodeToNodeListWithoutReIndex(list, index, node))
			{
				IncreaseNodesIndices(list, index + 1);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InsertNodesToNodeList(NodeList list, int index, LanguageElementCollectionBase nodes)
		{
			if (list == null || index < 0 || index > list.Count || nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement node && InsertNodeToNodeListWithoutReIndex(list, index, node))
				{
					IncreaseNodesIndices(list, index + 1);
					index++;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement FindDeclarationInList(NodeList list, string firstIdentifier, string remainingIdentifiers, LanguageElement viewer)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			if (list != null)
			{
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement2 = (LanguageElement)list[num];
					languageElement = languageElement2.FindDeclaration(firstIdentifier, remainingIdentifiers, viewer);
					if (languageElement != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

			for (int i = 0; i < parser.Context.NodeCount; i++)

		protected override void CloneRegions(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null && options.CloneRegions && !options.CloningChildren && source is LanguageElement { FileNode: not null } languageElement)
			{
				InjectRegions(languageElement.FileNode.RegionRootNode);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null && source is LanguageElement)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)source;
				if (options.PerformParseBeforeClone && languageElement != null && languageElement.HasUnparsedCode)
				{
					languageElement.ParseOnDemandIfNeeded();
				}
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				_Parent = null;
				_Index = -1;
				_IsDetailNode = languageElement._IsDetailNode;
				MacroCall = languageElement.MacroCall;
				_HasErrors = languageElement._HasErrors;
				SetNodeLinks(DetailNodes);
				SetNodeLinks(Nodes);
				_IsRemoved = languageElement._IsRemoved;
				_IsFakeNode = languageElement.IsFakeNode;
				if (languageElement._Tokens == null)
				{
					_Tokens = null;
				}
				else
				{
					_Tokens = languageElement._Tokens.Clone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

			}
		}

		}

		public LanguageElement ClosestParent(LanguageElement element1, LanguageElement element2)
		{
			if (element1 == null)
			{
				if (element2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (element2.Parents(this))
				{
					return element2;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (element2 == null)
			{
				if (element1.Parents(this))
				{
					return element1;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (element1.Parents(this))
			{
				if (element2.Parents(this))
				{
					if (element2.Parents(element1))
					{
						return element1;
					}
					return element2;
				}
				return element1;
			}
			if (element2.Parents(this))
			{
				return element2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Parent = null;
			CleanUpPostponedData();
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public bool ContainsSelection()
		{
			IDocument document = Document;
			if (document == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			document.GetSelectionBounds(out var startLine, out var startOffset, out var endLine, out var endOffset);
			if (Contains(startLine, startOffset))
			{
				return Contains(endLine, endOffset);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual int GetChildCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (Nodes != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Nodes.Count; i++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)Nodes[i];
					if (languageElement != null)
					{
						num += languageElement.GetCyclomaticComplexity();
					}
				}
			}
			if (DetailNodes != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < DetailNodes.Count; j++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement2 = (LanguageElement)DetailNodes[j];
					if (languageElement2 != null)
					{
						num += languageElement2.GetCyclomaticComplexity();
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public Class GetDeclaringType()
		{
			Class obj = GetClass();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = GetStruct();
				if (obj == null)
				{
					obj = GetInterface();
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetParent(LanguageElementType aType)
		{
			for (LanguageElement parent = _Parent; parent != null; parent = parent._Parent)
			{
				if (parent.ElementType == aType)
				{
					return parent;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetParent(LanguageElementType type, params LanguageElementType[] types)
		{
			for (LanguageElement parent = _Parent; parent != null; parent = parent._Parent)
			{
				if (parent.ElementType == type)
				{
					return parent;
				}
				foreach (LanguageElementType languageElementType in types)
				{
					if (parent.ElementType == languageElementType)
					{
						return parent;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetParentingStatementParent()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = this;
			if (languageElement is ParentingStatement || languageElement is Method || languageElement is Property || languageElement is Event || languageElement is Accessor)
			{
				return languageElement;
			}
			do
			{
				languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
				if (languageElement == null || languageElement is SourceFile)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			while (!(languageElement is ParentingStatement) && !(languageElement is Method) && !(languageElement is Property) && !(languageElement is Event) && !(languageElement is Accessor));
			return languageElement;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void GetSourceFileSupportLists(out RegionDirective regionDirectives, out TextStringCollection strings, out CompilerDirective compilerDirectives, out SourceFile sourceFile)
		{
			regionDirectives = null;
			strings = null;
			compilerDirectives = null;
			sourceFile = null;
			if (this is SourceFile)
			{
				sourceFile = (SourceFile)this;
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStudioDocument parentDocument = GetParentDocument();
				if (parentDocument is SourceFile)
				{
					sourceFile = (SourceFile)parentDocument;
				}
			}
			if (sourceFile != null)
			{
				regionDirectives = sourceFile.RegionRootNode;
				strings = sourceFile.TextStrings;
				compilerDirectives = sourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement GetPreviousIdentifier(LanguageElement referenceNode)

		public LanguageElement GetPreviousIdentifier(LanguageElement referenceNode, int refLine, int refColumn)
		{
			if (Contains(refLine, refColumn))
			{
				LanguageElement lastDetailIdentifier = GetLastDetailIdentifier();
				if (lastDetailIdentifier != null)
				{
					return lastDetailIdentifier;
				}
				if (AllChildrenAccessibleByGrandchildren())
				{
					lastDetailIdentifier = GetLastIdentifier();
					if (lastDetailIdentifier != null)
					{
						return lastDetailIdentifier;
					}
				}
			}
			if (DeclaresIdentifier)
			{
				if (_Parent == null)
				{
					return this;
				}
				if (_Parent.AllChildrenAccessibleByGrandchildren())
				{
					return GetLastSiblingInScope(referenceNode);
				}
				return this;
			}
			return GetPreviousIdentifier(referenceNode);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement GetCodeNodeFromList(NodeList list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)list[i];
				if (languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Comment && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.XmlDocComment && !(languageElement is PreprocessorDirective))
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

			{
				languageElement = GetCodeNodeFromList(DetailNodes);
			}
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				return languageElement;
			}
			return GetCodeNodeFromList(Nodes);
		}

		public CodeElement GetNextCodeElementSibling()
		{
			LanguageElement nextSibling = NextSibling;
			while (nextSibling != null && !(nextSibling is CodeElement))
			{
				nextSibling = nextSibling.NextSibling;
			}
			return nextSibling as CodeElement;
		}

		public CodeElement GetPreviousCodeElementSibling()
		{
			LanguageElement previousSibling = PreviousSibling;
			while (previousSibling != null && !(previousSibling is CodeElement))
			{
				previousSibling = previousSibling.PreviousSibling;
			}
			return previousSibling as CodeElement;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetParentLoopOrFinallyTarget()
		{
			LanguageElement parentLoop = ParentLoop;
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			Try parentTryBlock = ParentTryBlock;
			if (parentTryBlock != null && ClosestParent(parentLoop, parentTryBlock) == parentTryBlock)
			{
				languageElement = parentTryBlock.GetFinallyTarget();
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = parentLoop;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetParentMethodOrAccessor()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParentMethodOrEventAccessor();
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetParentMethodOrAccessor(bool checkAnonymousMethod)
		{
			LanguageElement parentMethodOrAccessor = GetParentMethodOrAccessor();
			if (!checkAnonymousMethod)
			{
				return parentMethodOrAccessor;
			}
			LanguageElement anonymousMethodOrLambda = GetAnonymousMethodOrLambda();
			if (anonymousMethodOrLambda == null)
			{
				return parentMethodOrAccessor;
			}
			if (parentMethodOrAccessor == null || anonymousMethodOrLambda.IsParentedBy(parentMethodOrAccessor))
			{
				return anonymousMethodOrLambda;
			}
			return parentMethodOrAccessor;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetAnonymousMethodOrLambda()
		{
			if (ElementType == LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression || ElementType == LanguageElementType.AnonymousConstructorExpression || ElementType == LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return GetParent(LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression, LanguageElementType.AnonymousConstructorExpression, LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression);
		}

		public LanguageElement GetParentMethodOrEventAccessor()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetMethod();
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetEventAccessor();
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetParentCodeBlock()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParentEventAccessor();
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParent(LanguageElementType.Delegate);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParent(LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParent(LanguageElementType.AnonymousConstructorExpression);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParent(LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParent(LanguageElementType.LambdaFunctionExpression);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParentProperty();
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetParentStatementOrVariable()
		{
			if (this is Statement || this is Variable)
			{
				return this;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = this;
			while (languageElement != null && !(languageElement is Statement) && !(languageElement is Variable))
			{
				languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		{
			if (Document == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return Document.GetText(base.StartLine, 1, base.StartLine, base.StartOffset);
		}

			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.FindElementInSnapshotStructure(this);
		}

		public bool InsideSelection()
		{
			IDocument document = Document;
			if (document == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			document.GetSelectionBounds(out var startLine, out var startOffset, out var endLine, out var endOffset);
			if (StartsAfter(startLine, startOffset - 1))
			{
				return EndsBefore(endLine, endOffset + 1);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsSibling(LanguageElement aLanguageElement)
		{
			if (aLanguageElement != null && OwningList != null)
			{
				return aLanguageElement.OwningList == OwningList;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsDeeperThan(LanguageElement aLanguageElement)
		{
			if (aLanguageElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return LevelsDeep > aLanguageElement.LevelsDeep;
		}

		public bool SameEndPoint(LanguageElement aLanguageElement)
		{
			if (aLanguageElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (EndLine == aLanguageElement.EndLine)
			{
				return EndOffset == aLanguageElement.EndOffset;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool SameStartPoint(LanguageElement aLanguageElement)
		{
			if (aLanguageElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.StartLine == aLanguageElement.StartLine)
			{
				return base.StartOffset == aLanguageElement.StartOffset;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		internal void RemoveNodesBetweenIndexes(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (InnerNodes == null || startIndex < 0 || endIndex < 0 || startIndex >= InnerNodes.Count || endIndex >= InnerNodes.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = InnerNodes[startIndex] as LanguageElement;
				languageElement._Index = -1;
				languageElement.SetParent(null);
				InnerNodes.RemoveAt(startIndex);
				ReplaceOwnedReference(languageElement, null);
			}
			int num = endIndex - startIndex + 1;
			for (int j = startIndex + 1; j <= base.InnerNodeCount; j++)
			{
				if (InnerNodes[j] is LanguageElement languageElement2)
				{
					languageElement2._Index -= num;
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveFromParent()
		{
			LanguageElement parent = Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				if (IsDetailNode)
				{
					parent.RemoveDetailNode(this);
				}
				else
				{
					parent.RemoveNode(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void RemoveNodesFromIndex(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < InnerNodes.Count)
			{
				for (int i = index; i < InnerNodes.Count; i++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = InnerNodes[i] as LanguageElement;
					ReplaceOwnedReference(languageElement, null);
					languageElement._Index = -1;
					languageElement.SetParent(null);
				}
				InnerNodes.RemoveFrom(index);
			}
		}

		public virtual void RemoveNodes(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes != null && nodes.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int num = nodes.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					RemoveNode(nodes[num] as LanguageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public virtual void RemoveAllNodes()
		{
			if (Nodes != null)
			{
				object[] array = InnerNodes.ToArray();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					RemoveNode(array[i] as LanguageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public virtual void ReplaceNode(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (oldElement == null && newElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (oldElement == null)
			{
				AddNode(newElement);
			}
			else if (newElement == null)
			{
				if (InnerNodes.Contains(oldElement))
				{
					RemoveNode(oldElement);
				}
			}
			else if (InnerNodes.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				int index = oldElement._Index;
				RemoveNodeFromNodeList(InnerNodes, oldElement);
				InsertNodeToNodeList(InnerNodes, index, newElement);
				ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ReplaceNodes(LanguageElementCollectionBase oldNodes, LanguageElementCollectionBase newNodes)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (oldNodes != null && oldNodes.Count > 0)
			{
				num = Nodes.IndexOf(oldNodes[0]);
			}
			RemoveNodes(oldNodes);
			if (newNodes != null && newNodes.Count != 0)
			{
				if (num < 0)
				{
					AddNodes(newNodes);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertNodes(num, newNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			if (oldElement == null && newElement == null)
			{
				return;

			if (oldElement == null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(newElement);

			else if (newElement == null)

				if (InnerDetailNodes.Contains(oldElement))

					RemoveDetailNode(oldElement);

			else if (InnerDetailNodes.Contains(oldElement))

		public virtual void ReplaceDetailNode(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElementCollectionBase newElements)
		{
			if (oldElement == null && newElements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (oldElement == null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(newElements);
			}
			else if (newElements == null || newElements.Count == 0)
			{
				if (InnerDetailNodes.Contains(oldElement))
				{
					RemoveDetailNode(oldElement);
				}
			}
			else if (InnerDetailNodes.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				int index = oldElement._Index;
				RemoveDetailNode(oldElement);
				InsertDetailNodes(index, newElements);
			}
		}

		public virtual void ReplaceNode(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElementCollectionBase newElements)
		{
			if (oldElement == null && newElements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (oldElement == null)
			{
				AddNodes(newElements);
			}
			else if (newElements == null || newElements.Count == 0)
			{
				if (InnerNodes.Contains(oldElement))
				{
					RemoveNode(oldElement);
				}
			}
			else if (InnerNodes.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				int index = oldElement._Index;
				RemoveNode(oldElement);
				InsertNodes(index, newElements);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ReplaceDetailNodes(LanguageElementCollectionBase oldNodes, LanguageElementCollectionBase newNodes)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (oldNodes != null && oldNodes.Count > 0)
			{
				num = DetailNodes.IndexOf(oldNodes[0]);
			}
			RemoveDetailNodes(oldNodes);
			if (newNodes != null && newNodes.Count != 0)
			{
				if (num < 0)
				{
					AddDetailNodes(newNodes);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertDetailNodes(num, newNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void RemoveChildElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			ReplaceChildElement(element, null);
		}

		public static void ReplaceChildElement(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (oldElement == null || oldElement == newElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = oldElement.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (oldElement.IsDetailNode)
			{
				if (newElement is ElementList)
				{
					parent.ReplaceDetailNode(oldElement, LanguageElementCollection.FromNodeList(newElement.Nodes));
				}
				else
				{
					parent.ReplaceDetailNode(oldElement, newElement);
				}
			}
			else if (newElement is ElementList)
			{
				parent.ReplaceNode(oldElement, LanguageElementCollection.FromNodeList(newElement.Nodes));
			}
			else
			{
				parent.ReplaceNode(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public static void MoveChildElementBefore(LanguageElement child, LanguageElement targetElement)
		{
			if (child != null && targetElement != null && targetElement.Index >= 0)
			{
				LanguageElement parent = targetElement.Parent;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					RemoveChildElement(child);
					parent.InsertNode(targetElement.Index, child);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement FindDeclaration(string firstIdentifier, string remainingIdentifiers, LanguageElement viewer)
		{
			if (!IsIdentifier(firstIdentifier, viewer))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (remainingIdentifiers == string.Empty)
			{
				return this;
			}
			firstIdentifier = ExtractFirstIdentifier(ref remainingIdentifiers);
			LanguageElement languageElement = FindDetailDeclaration(firstIdentifier, remainingIdentifiers, viewer);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = FindChildDeclaration(firstIdentifier, remainingIdentifiers, viewer);
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public LanguageElement FindDeclaration(string identifier, LanguageElement viewer)
		{
			string firstIdentifier = ExtractFirstIdentifier(ref identifier);
			return FindDeclaration(firstIdentifier, identifier, viewer);
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement FindChildByName(string aName, bool lookInDetail)
		{
			if (lookInDetail)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < DetailNodes.Count; i++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)DetailNodes[i];
					if (languageElement.Name == aName)
					{
						return languageElement;
					}
					LanguageElement languageElement2 = languageElement.FindChildByName(aName, lookInDetail: true);
					if (languageElement2 != null)
					{
						return languageElement2;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Nodes.Count; j++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)Nodes[j];
				if (languageElement.Name == aName)
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
				LanguageElement languageElement2 = languageElement.FindChildByName(aName, lookInDetail);
				if (languageElement2 != null)
				{
					return languageElement2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetSiblingBefore(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (OwningList == null || _Index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = GetNodeIndexBeforeInternal(OwningList, line, offset);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
				num--;
			}
			if (num == _Index)
			{
				num--;
			}
			if (num < 0 || num >= OwningList.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (LanguageElement)OwningList[num];
		}

		public LanguageElement GetSiblingAfter(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (OwningList == null || _Index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = GetNodeIndexAfterInternal(OwningList, line, offset);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num == _Index)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (num < 0 || num >= OwningList.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (LanguageElement)OwningList[num];
		}

		private LanguageElement GetNearestChildInMacro(int line, int column)
		{
			SourceRange range = Range;
			if (range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable enumerable = new ElementEnumerable(this, useRecursion: true);
			foreach (LanguageElement item in enumerable)
			{
				if (item != null && !(item.Range == range) && item.Range.Contains(line, column))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetChildAt(int line, int column)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			if (StructuralParserServicesHolder.InMacroCall(this))
			{
				LanguageElement nearestChildInMacro = GetNearestChildInMacro(line, column);
				if (nearestChildInMacro != null)
				{
					languageElement = nearestChildInMacro.GetChildAt(line, column);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				languageElement = GetChildAtInternal(line, column, Nodes);
				if (languageElement == null)
				{
					languageElement = GetChildAtInternal(line, column, DetailNodes);
				}
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		}

		public virtual int GetMaintenanceComplexity()
		{
			int num = ThisMaintenanceComplexity;
			if (Nodes != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Nodes.Count; i++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)Nodes[i];
					if (languageElement != null)
					{
						num += languageElement.GetMaintenanceComplexity();
					}
				}
			}
			if (DetailNodes != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < DetailNodes.Count; j++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement2 = (LanguageElement)DetailNodes[j];
					if (languageElement2 != null)
					{
						num += languageElement2.GetMaintenanceComplexity();
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetNodeAt(SourcePoint sourcePoint)
		{
			return GetNodeAt(sourcePoint.Line, sourcePoint.Offset);
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetNodeAt(int line, int column)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			if (Parent != null)
			{
				languageElement = Parent.GetChildAt(line, column);
				if (languageElement == null && Parent.Contains(line, column))
				{
					return Parent;
				}
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
				return Parent.GetNodeAt(line, column);
			}
			languageElement = GetChildAt(line, column);
			if (languageElement == null && Contains(line, column))
			{
				languageElement = this;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ParentingStatement GetNearestParentingStatement(SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (point == SourcePoint.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement childAt = GetChildAt(point);
			if (childAt == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (childAt is ParentingStatement)
			{
				return childAt as ParentingStatement;
			}
			return childAt.GetParentParentingStatement();
		}

		public bool IsParentedBy(LanguageElement aParentElement)
		{
			for (LanguageElement parent = _Parent; parent != null; parent = parent._Parent)
			{
				if (parent == aParentElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool MatchesSelection()
		{
			IDocument document = Document;
			if (document == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			document.GetSelectionBounds(out var startLine, out var startOffset, out var endLine, out var endOffset);
			if (startLine == base.StartLine && startOffset == base.StartOffset && endLine == EndLine)
			{
				return endOffset == EndOffset;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Parents(LanguageElement aChildElement)
		{
			return aChildElement?.IsParentedBy(this) ?? false;
		}

		public virtual string GetFullPath()
		{
			string parentPath = ParentPath;
			string pathSegment = PathSegment;
			if (pathSegment != string.Empty)
			{
				if (parentPath != string.Empty)
				{
					return parentPath + "." + pathSegment;
				}
				return pathSegment;
			}
			return parentPath;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool HasInDetails(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || base.DetailNodeCount == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return FindInList(DetailNodes, element);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool HasInNodes(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || base.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return FindInList(Nodes, element);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool IsDetailOfParentStatement()
		{
			return GetParentStatementOrVariable()?.HasInDetails(this) ?? false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public ParentingStatement GetParentParentingStatement()
		{
			if (this is Method || Parent == null || Parent is Method)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Parent is ParentingStatement)
			{
				return Parent as ParentingStatement;
			}
			return Parent.GetParentParentingStatement();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement GetFirstLevelParentInCustomElement(LanguageElementType elementType)
		{
			LanguageElement parent = GetParent(elementType);
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (LanguageElement languageElement = this; languageElement != null; languageElement = languageElement.Parent)
			{
				if (languageElement.CompletesPrevious)
				{
					languageElement = languageElement.PreviousSibling;
				}
				if (languageElement.Parent == null || languageElement.Parent.ElementType == elementType)
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement GetFirstLevelParentInParentMethod()
		{
			return GetFirstLevelParentInCustomElement(LanguageElementType.Method);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement GetFirstLevelParentInParentProperty()
		{
			LanguageElement firstLevelParentInCustomElement = GetFirstLevelParentInCustomElement(LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet);
			if (firstLevelParentInCustomElement != null)
			{
				return firstLevelParentInCustomElement;
			}
			LanguageElement firstLevelParentInCustomElement2 = GetFirstLevelParentInCustomElement(LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet);
			if (firstLevelParentInCustomElement2 != null)
			{
				return firstLevelParentInCustomElement2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement GetFirstLevelParentInParentMethodOrProperty()
		{
			LanguageElement firstLevelParentInParentMethod = GetFirstLevelParentInParentMethod();
			if (firstLevelParentInParentMethod != null)
			{
				return firstLevelParentInParentMethod;
			}
			LanguageElement firstLevelParentInParentProperty = GetFirstLevelParentInParentProperty();
			if (firstLevelParentInParentProperty != null)
			{
				return firstLevelParentInParentProperty;
			}
			return null;
		}

		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)MemberwiseClone();
			languageElement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);

		public LanguageElement NextStandaloneCodeSibling(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = element;
			do
			{
				languageElement = languageElement.NextCodeSibling;
			}
			while (languageElement != null && languageElement.CompletesPrevious && languageElement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Finally);
			if (languageElement != null && languageElement.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Finally)
			{
				LanguageElement firstCodeChild = languageElement.GetFirstCodeChild();
				if (firstCodeChild != null)
				{
					languageElement = firstCodeChild;
				}
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public LanguageElement NextStandaloneCodeSibling()
		{
			return NextStandaloneCodeSibling(this);
		}

	internal class Sorter : IComparer
	{
		protected int InnerCompare(object x, object y)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)x;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = (LanguageElement)y;
			SourceRange range = languageElement.Range;
			SourceRange range2 = languageElement2.Range;
			if (languageElement is QueuedEdit && languageElement2 is QueuedEdit && languageElement.StartLine == languageElement2.StartLine)
			{
				if (languageElement == languageElement2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (languageElement is QueuedDelete)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (range.Top > range2.Top)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (range.Top < range2.Top)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (range.Bottom > range2.Bottom)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (range.Bottom < range2.Bottom)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			return InnerCompare(x, y);
		}
	}
	internal class ReverseSorter : Sorter, IComparer
	{
		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			return -InnerCompare(x, y);
		}
	}
	public class LanguageElementCollection : LanguageElementCollectionBase
	{
		public new static readonly LanguageElementCollection Empty = new LanguageElementCollection();

		public new LanguageElement this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public new int Add(LanguageElement value)
		{
			return base.Add(value);
		}

		public void Add(LanguageElementCollection collection)
		{
			AddRange(collection);
		}

		public void AddRange(LanguageElementCollection collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
			{
				if (collection[i] != null)
				{
					Add(collection[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public new bool Contains(LanguageElement value)
		{
			return base.Contains(value);
		}

		public void CopyTo(LanguageElement[] array, int index)
		{
			CopyTo((Array)array, index);
		}

		public new int IndexOf(LanguageElement value)
		{
			return base.IndexOf(value);
		}

		public new void Insert(int index, LanguageElement value)
		{
			base.Insert(index, value);
		}

		public new void Remove(LanguageElement value)
		{
			base.Remove(value);
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			Sort(new Sorter());
		}

		public void SortReverse()
		{
			Sort(new ReverseSorter());
		}

		public static LanguageElementCollection FromNodeList(NodeList nodes)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			languageElementCollection.AddRange(nodes);
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		public static LanguageElementCollection FromArray(LanguageElement[] elements)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			languageElementCollection.AddRange(elements);
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		public void RemoveElementsInRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (range.Contains(this[num].Range))
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveRange(int startIndex, int count)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				RemoveAt(startIndex);
			}
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LanguageElementCollection();
		}

		public new LanguageElementCollection DeepClone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = CreateInstance() as LanguageElementCollection;
			languageElementCollection.AddRange(base.DeepClone(options));
			return languageElementCollection;
		}
	}
	public class LanguageElementCollectionBase : NodeList, IEnumerable<LanguageElement>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected new LanguageElement this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (LanguageElement)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		IEnumerator<LanguageElement> IEnumerable<LanguageElement>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (enumerator.Current is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					yield return languageElement;
				}
			}
		}

		protected int Add(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return base.Add(element);
		}

		protected void AddRange(LanguageElementCollectionBase collection)
		{
			base.AddRange(collection);
		}

		protected int IndexOf(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return IndexOf((object)element);
		}

		protected void Insert(int index, LanguageElement element)
		{
			base.Insert(index, element);
		}

		protected void Remove(LanguageElement element)
		{
			base.Remove(element);
		}

		protected LanguageElement Find(LanguageElement element)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(element);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return this[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool Contains(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return Find(element) != null;
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LanguageElementCollectionBase();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(string.Empty);
			string arg = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", arg, this[i]);
				arg = ", ";
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public SourceRange GetRange()
		{
			SourceRange sourceRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			int count = base.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				sourceRange = SourceRange.Union(sourceRange, this[i].Range);
			}
			return sourceRange;
		}
	}

		{

				return (LanguageElement)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new LanguageElementList();
		}
	}

		RazorInlineHtmlExpression,
		RazorSectionElement,
		MarkupExtensionExpression,
		DependencyProperty
	}

	public class ParentingStatement : Statement, IHasParens
	{
		private TextRangeWrapper _ParensRange;

		private bool _IsBreakable;

		private bool _HasBlock;

		[Description("True if this language element contains a block of code.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public bool HasBlock
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasBlock;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasBlock = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsBreakable
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsBreakable;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsBreakable = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		public IEnumerable AllStatements => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Statement), useRecursion: true);

		public IEnumerable AllVariables => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Variable), useRecursion: true);

		public IEnumerable AllFlowBreaks => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(FlowBreak), useRecursion: true);

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParensRange == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParensRange);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is ParentingStatement)
			{
				ParentingStatement parentingStatement = (ParentingStatement)source;
				_IsBreakable = parentingStatement._IsBreakable;
				_HasBlock = parentingStatement._HasBlock;
				if (parentingStatement._ParensRange != null)
				{
					_ParensRange = parentingStatement._ParensRange.Range;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ElementType.ToString() + "()";
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ParentingStatement parentingStatement = new ParentingStatement();
			parentingStatement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return parentingStatement;
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection GetUnusedDeclarations()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetUnusedDeclarations(AllVariables);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(Token parenOpen, Token parenClose)
		{
			SetParensRange(new SourceRange(parenOpen.Range.Start, parenClose.Range.End));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			if (range.IsEmpty)
			{
				_ParensRange = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_ParensRange = range;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ParentToSingleStatement : ParentingStatement

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{

			parentToSingleStatement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return parentToSingleStatement;
		}
	}

	public class ReadOnlyLanguageElementCollection : ReadOnlyCollectionBase
	{
		public LanguageElement this[int index] => (LanguageElement)base.InnerList[index];

		public ReadOnlyLanguageElementCollection(IList source)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.InnerList.AddRange(source);
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return base.InnerList.IndexOf(element);
		}

		public LanguageElement FindByName(string name)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].Name == name)
				{
					return this[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Contains(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return base.InnerList.Contains(element);
		}
	}
	public class RegionDirectiveCollection : NodeList
	{
		public new RegionDirective this[int aIndex] => (RegionDirective)base[aIndex];

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new RegionDirectiveCollection();
		}

		public void Add(RegionDirective aRegionDirective)
		{
			base.Add(aRegionDirective);
		}

		public void Remove(RegionDirective aRegionDirective)
		{
			base.Remove(aRegionDirective);
		}

		public RegionDirective Find(string aRegionDirective)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RegionDirective regionDirective = (RegionDirective)enumerator.Current;
					if (regionDirective.Name == aRegionDirective)
					{
						return regionDirective;
					}
					LanguageElement languageElement = regionDirective.FindChildByName(aRegionDirective);
					if (languageElement is RegionDirective)
					{
						return (RegionDirective)languageElement;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public RegionDirective Find(RegionDirective region)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RegionDirective regionDirective = (RegionDirective)enumerator.Current;
					if (regionDirective == region)
					{
						return regionDirective;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Contains(string aRegionDirective)
		{
			return Find(aRegionDirective) != null;
		}

		public bool Contains(RegionDirective region)
		{
			return Find(region) != null;
		}
	}
	public enum SupportElementPosition : byte
	{
		Before,
		Inside,
		After
	}
	public abstract class SupportElement : LanguageElement
	{
		private LanguageElement _TargetNode;

		private SupportElementPosition _Position;

		public LanguageElement TargetNode => _TargetNode;

		public SupportElementPosition Position
		{
			get
			{
				return _Position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Position != value)
				{
					_Position = value;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is SupportElement)
				{
					SupportElement supportElement = (SupportElement)source;
					_TargetNode = null;
					_Position = supportElement._Position;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void SetTarget(LanguageElement targetNode)
		{
			if (_TargetNode != targetNode)
			{
				_TargetNode = targetNode;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SupportElements
	{
		private NodeList _Attributes;

		private NodeList _AttributeSections;

		private CommentCollection _Comments;

		private XmlDocComment _DocComment;

		public NodeList Attributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Attributes == null)
				{
					_Attributes = new NodeList();
				}
				return _Attributes;
			}
			set
			{
				_Attributes = value;
			}
		}

		public int AttributeCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Attributes != null)
				{
					return _Attributes.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public NodeList AttributeSections
		{
			get
			{
				if (_AttributeSections == null)
				{
					_AttributeSections = new NodeList();
				}
				return _AttributeSections;
			}
			set
			{
				_AttributeSections = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("The number of AttributeSections associated with this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public int AttributeSectionsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_AttributeSections != null)
				{
					return _AttributeSections.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Description("A create-on-demand collection of comments bound to this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public CommentCollection InnerComments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Comments == null)
				{
					_Comments = new CommentCollection();
				}
				return _Comments;
			}
			set
			{
				_Comments = value;
			}
		}

		public NodeList InnerAttributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Attributes == null)
				{
					_Attributes = new NodeList();
				}
				return _Attributes;
			}
			set
			{
				_Attributes = value;
			}
		}

		public NodeList InnerAttributeSections
		{
			get
			{
				if (_AttributeSections == null)
				{
					_AttributeSections = new NodeList();
				}
				return _AttributeSections;
			}
			set
			{
				_AttributeSections = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("The number of comments bound to this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public int CommentCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (InnerComments != null)
				{
					return InnerComments.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets xml doc comment associated with this element.")]
		[Category("SupportElements")]
		public XmlDocComment DocComment
		{
			get
			{
				return _DocComment;
			}
			set
			{
				_DocComment = value;
			}
		}

		public void CleanUp()
		{
			if (_DocComment != null)
			{
				_DocComment = null;
			}
			if (_Comments != null)
			{
				_Comments.Clear();
				_Comments = null;
			}
			if (_AttributeSections != null)
			{
				_AttributeSections.Clear();
				_AttributeSections = null;
			}
		}

		public void TransferCommentsTo(CodeElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || _Comments == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Comment comment in _Comments)
			{
				_Comments.Remove(comment);
				element.Comments.Add(comment);
			}
		}

		public void TransferXmlDocCommentTo(CodeElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && _DocComment != null)
			{
				element.SetDocComment(_DocComment);
				_DocComment = null;
			}
		}

		public void AddComment(Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment != null)
			{
				InnerComments.Add(comment);
			}
		}

		public void InsertComment(int index, Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment != null)
			{
				InnerComments.Insert(index, comment);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveComment(Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment != null)
			{
				InnerComments.Remove(comment);
			}
		}

		public void AddAttribute(Attribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				InnerAttributes.Add(attribute);
			}
		}

		public void AddAttributeSection(AttributeSection section)
		{
			if (section != null)
			{
				InnerAttributeSections.Add(section);
			}
		}

		public bool ContainsElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (_Attributes != null && _Attributes.Contains(element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_AttributeSections != null && _AttributeSections.Contains(element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_Comments != null && _Comments.Contains(element))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (_DocComment == element)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ReplaceElement(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Attributes != null && _Attributes.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Attributes.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			if (_AttributeSections != null && _AttributeSections.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_AttributeSections.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			if (_Comments != null && _Comments.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Comments.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			if (_DocComment == oldElement)
			{
				_DocComment = newElement as XmlDocComment;
			}
		}
	}
	public class TextString : LanguageElement
	{
		private string _EscapedValue;

		private bool _IsVerbatim;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Obsolete("Use TextString.IsVerbatim")]
		public bool IsLiteralString => _IsVerbatim;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override DocumentHistorySlice History
		{
			get
			{
				SourceFile fileNode = base.FileNode;
				if (fileNode == null)
				{
					return base.History;
				}
				return fileNode.History;
			}
		}

		public string EscapedValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (_EscapedValue == null)
				{
					_EscapedValue = GetEscapedString(InternalName, _IsVerbatim);
				}
				return _EscapedValue;
			}
		}

		public bool IsVerbatim => _IsVerbatim;

		public PrimitiveExpression PrimitiveExpression => GetPrimitiveExpression();

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.TextString;

		public TextString()
			: this(string.Empty, isVerbatim: false)
		{
		}

		public TextString(bool isVerbatim)
			: this(string.Empty, isVerbatim)
		{
		}

		public TextString(string text, bool isVerbatim)
		{
			InternalName = text;
			_IsVerbatim = isVerbatim;
		}

		private string GetEscapedString(string name, bool isVerbatim)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return name;
			}
			if (Project == null)
			{
				return name;
			}
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetEscapedString(Project.Language, name, isVerbatim);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is TextString)
				{
					TextString textString = (TextString)source;
					_EscapedValue = textString._EscapedValue;
					_IsVerbatim = textString._IsVerbatim;
				}
			}
		}

		protected PrimitiveExpression GetPrimitiveExpression()
		{
			SourceFile fileNode = base.FileNode;
			if (fileNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return fileNode.GetNodeAt(base.Range.Start) as PrimitiveExpression;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 39;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TextString textString = new TextString();
			textString.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return textString;
		}
	}
	public class TextStringCollection : LanguageElementCollection
	{
		private Hashtable _RangesHash;

		public new TextString this[int index] => (TextString)base[index];

		public TextStringCollection()
		{
			_RangesHash = new Hashtable();
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new TextStringCollection();
		}

		public void Add(TextString s)
		{
			if (s != null)
			{
				if (!_RangesHash.ContainsKey(s.Range))
				{
					_RangesHash.Add(s.Range, s);
				}
				Add((LanguageElement)s);
			}
		}

		public void AddUnique(TextString s)
		{
			if (s != null && !_RangesHash.ContainsKey(s.Range))
			{
				_RangesHash.Add(s.Range, s);
				Add((LanguageElement)s);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(TextString s)
		{
			if (s != null)
			{
				if (_RangesHash.ContainsKey(s.Range))
				{
					_RangesHash.Remove(s.Range);
				}
				Remove((LanguageElement)s);
			}
		}

		public TextString Find(string s)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					TextString textString = (TextString)enumerator.Current;
					if (textString.Name == s)
					{
						return textString;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public TextString Find(TextString s)
		{
			return (TextString)Find((LanguageElement)s);
		}

		public bool Contains(TextString s)
		{
			return Contains((LanguageElement)s);
		}
	}
	public enum CommentType : byte
	{
		SingleLine,
		MultiLine
	}
	public class Comment : SupportElement, IFormattingElement, ICloneable
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private int _TextStartOffset;

		private CommentType _CommentType;

		private bool _IsUnfinished;

		private int _StartPos;

		private int _EndPos;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public int StartPos
		{
			get
			{
				return _StartPos;
			}
			set
			{
				_StartPos = value;
			}
		}

		public int EndPos
		{
			get
			{
				return _EndPos;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndPos = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsUnfinished
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsUnfinished;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsUnfinished = value;
			}
		}

		public int TextStartOffset => _TextStartOffset;

		public CommentType CommentType
		{
			get
			{
				return _CommentType;
			}
			set
			{
				_CommentType = value;
			}
		}

		public Comment NextConnectedComment
		{
			get
			{
				LanguageElement nextSibling = NextSibling;
				if (nextSibling == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (nextSibling.ElementType == ElementType)
				{
					Comment comment = (Comment)nextSibling;
					if (comment.InternalRange.Start.Line == base.InternalRange.End.Line + 1)
					{
						return comment;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public Comment PreviousConnectedComment
		{
			get
			{
				LanguageElement previousSibling = PreviousSibling;
				if (previousSibling == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (previousSibling.ElementType == ElementType)
				{
					Comment comment = (Comment)previousSibling;
					if (comment.InternalRange.End.Line == base.InternalRange.Start.Line - 1)
					{
						return comment;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Comment;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Comment comment)
				{
					_TextStartOffset = comment._TextStartOffset;
					_CommentType = comment._CommentType;
					_IsUnfinished = comment._IsUnfinished;
				}
			}
		}

		public void GetFirstAndLastConnectedComments(out Comment first, out Comment last)
		{
			first = this;
			last = this;
			for (Comment previousConnectedComment = PreviousConnectedComment; previousConnectedComment != null; previousConnectedComment = previousConnectedComment.PreviousConnectedComment)
			{
				first = previousConnectedComment;
			}
			for (Comment nextConnectedComment = NextConnectedComment; nextConnectedComment != null; nextConnectedComment = nextConnectedComment.NextConnectedComment)
			{
				last = nextConnectedComment;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetCommentType(CommentType aCommentType)
		{
			_CommentType = aCommentType;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetTextStartOffset(int aTextStartOffset)
		{
			_TextStartOffset = aTextStartOffset;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 110;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Comment comment = options.GetClonedElement(this) as Comment;
			if (comment == null)
			{
				comment = new Comment();
				comment.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
				options?.AddClonedElement(this, comment);
			}
			if (options != null && options.SourceFile != null)
			{
				options.SourceFile.AddComment(comment, useSorting: true);
			}
			return comment;
		}
	}

				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		{
			for (int num = base.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)

			}
			return null;

		}

	public class XmlDocComment : Comment, IFormattingElement, ICloneable
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.XmlDocComment;

		public bool MultiLine
		{
			get
			{
				return base.CommentType == CommentType.MultiLine;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value)
				{
					base.CommentType = CommentType.MultiLine;
				}
				else
				{
					base.CommentType = CommentType.SingleLine;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 111;
		}

		public virtual SourceLineCollection SplitDocComment()
		{
			SourceLineCollection sourceLineCollection = new SourceLineCollection();
			string[] array = StringHelper.SplitLines(InternalName);
			if (array == null)
			{
				return sourceLineCollection;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = array[i];
				if (text == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text2 = text.Trim();
				if (text2.Length == 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text3 = text + "\r\n";
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 1;
				if (text2.StartsWith("/") || text2.StartsWith("*"))
				{
					int num3 = text3.IndexOf("/");
					int num4 = text3.IndexOf("*");
					if (num3 < 0 && num4 < 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					num = ((num3 < 0) ? num4 : ((num4 >= 0) ? Math.Min(num3, num4) : num3));
					if (num3 == num)
					{
						num2 = 3;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				int line = base.StartLine + i;
				int num5 = num + num2;
				int num6 = num5;
				num6 = ((i != 0) ? (num6 + 1) : (num6 + base.StartOffset));
				SourceLine aSourceLine = new SourceLine(line, num6, text3.Substring(num5));
				sourceLineCollection.Add(aSourceLine);
			}
			return sourceLineCollection;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			XmlDocComment xmlDocComment = options.GetClonedElement(this) as XmlDocComment;
			if (xmlDocComment == null)
			{
				xmlDocComment = new XmlDocComment();
				xmlDocComment.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
				options?.AddClonedElement(this, xmlDocComment);
			}
			if (options != null && options.SourceFile != null)
			{
				options.SourceFile.AddXmlDocComment(xmlDocComment);
			}
			return xmlDocComment;
		}

		private void ParseXmlDocComment()
		{
			if (!Name.Contains("<") || !Name.Contains(">"))
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceLineCollection lines = SplitDocComment();
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceLinesReader(lines);
			IXmlDocParser xmlDocParser = new NewXmlParser();
			ArrayList arrayList = xmlDocParser.ParseXmlDocNodes(reader);
			if (arrayList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement item in arrayList)
			{
				AddNode(item);
			}
		}

		public virtual XmlDocComment ParseXmlNodes()
		{
			ParseXmlDocComment();
			return this;
		}
	}

		private StringCollection _SupportedMediaTypes;

		private CssMediaQueryCollection _Queries;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CssImportDirective;

		{
			get

				return _Source;
			}
			set
			{
				_Source = value;

		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (_SupportedMediaTypes == null)
				{
					_SupportedMediaTypes = new StringCollection();
				}
				return _SupportedMediaTypes;
			}
		}

		public int SupportedMediaTypesCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SupportedMediaTypes == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}

			}

				if (_Queries == null)
				{
					_Queries = new CssMediaQueryCollection();
				}
				_Queries.Add(query);
				AddDetailNode(query);
				SupportedMediaTypes.Add(query.Name);
			}

			if (queries == null)

				return;
			}
			foreach (CssMediaQuery query in queries)

				AddQuery(query);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is CssImportDirective cssImportDirective)
			{
				SupportedMediaTypes.Clear();
				for (int i = 0; i < cssImportDirective.SupportedMediaTypes.Count; i++)
				{
					SupportedMediaTypes.Add(cssImportDirective.SupportedMediaTypes[i]);
				}
				_Source = cssImportDirective._Source;
			}
		}
	}

	public class CssMediaQuery : BaseCssElement
	{
		private CssMediaExpressionCollection _Expressions;

		public string MediaType { get; set; }

		public CssMediaQueryPrefix Prefix { get; set; }

		public CssMediaExpressionCollection Expressions => _Expressions;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CssMediaQuery;

		public void AddExpression(CssMediaExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(expression);
				if (_Expressions == null)
				{
					_Expressions = new CssMediaExpressionCollection();
				}
				_Expressions.Add(expression);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CssMediaQuery cssMediaQuery = new CssMediaQuery();
			cssMediaQuery.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return cssMediaQuery;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source is CssMediaQuery cssMediaQuery)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				Prefix = cssMediaQuery.Prefix;
				_Expressions = new CssMediaExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, cssMediaQuery.DetailNodes, _Expressions, cssMediaQuery._Expressions);
			}
		}
	}

	public class CssNumberLiteral : CssTerm, ICssNumberLiteral, ICssTerm, ICssElement, IElement
	{
		private object _Value;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CssNumberLiteral;

		public virtual object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _Value;
			}
			set
			{
				_Value = value;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is CssNumberLiteral cssNumberLiteral)
				{
					Value = cssNumberLiteral.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone()
		{
			return Clone(ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CssNumberLiteral cssNumberLiteral = new CssNumberLiteral();
			cssNumberLiteral.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return cssNumberLiteral;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Value == null)
			{
				return base.ToString();
			}
			if (Value is string)
			{
				return (Value as string).Trim();
			}
			if (Value is decimal)
			{
				return Value.ToString();
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}
	}

	public class CssPropertyDeclaration : BaseCssElement, ICssPropertyDeclaration, ICssElement, IElement
	{
		private bool _IsEqual;

		private bool _IsImportant;

		private CssTermCollection _Values;

		public bool IsEqual
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsEqual;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsEqual = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CssPropertyDeclaration;

		public CssTermCollection Values
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Values == null)
				{
					_Values = new CssTermCollection();
				}
				return _Values;
			}
		}

		public int ValuesCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Values == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Values.Count;
			}
		}

		public bool IsImportant
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsImportant;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsImportant = value;
			}
		}

		ICssTermCollection ICssPropertyDeclaration.Values => Values;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is CssPropertyDeclaration cssPropertyDeclaration))
			{
				return;
			}
			IsEqual = cssPropertyDeclaration.IsEqual;
			IsImportant = cssPropertyDeclaration.IsImportant;
			if (cssPropertyDeclaration._Values == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement value in cssPropertyDeclaration._Values)
			{
				AddValue(value.Clone(options) as CssTerm);
			}
		}

		public void AddValue(CssTerm cssTerm)
		{
			if (cssTerm != null)
			{
				Values.Add(cssTerm);
				cssTerm.SetParent(this);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone()
		{
			return Clone(ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CssPropertyDeclaration cssPropertyDeclaration = new CssPropertyDeclaration();
			cssPropertyDeclaration.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return cssPropertyDeclaration;
		}
	}

	public class CssSelector : BaseCssElement, ICssSelector, ICssElement, IElement
	{
		private CssSelector _ChildSelector;

		private CssSelectorType _SelectorType;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CssSelector;

		public virtual CssSelectorType SelectorType
		{
			get
			{
				return _SelectorType;
			}
			set
			{
				_SelectorType = value;
			}
		}

		public CssSelector Ancestor => base.Parent as CssSelector;

		public CssSelector ChildSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return _ChildSelector;
			}
			set
			{
				_ChildSelector = value;
			}
		}

		ICssSelector ICssSelector.Ancestor => Ancestor;

		ICssSelector ICssSelector.ChildSelector => ChildSelector;

		public CssSelector()
		{
			_SelectorType = CssSelectorType.Name;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone()
		{
			return Clone(ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CssSelector cssSelector = new CssSelector();
			cssSelector.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return cssSelector;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is CssSelector cssSelector))
			{
				return;
			}
			_SelectorType = cssSelector._SelectorType;
			if (cssSelector.ChildSelector != null)
			{
				ChildSelector = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, cssSelector, cssSelector.ChildSelector) as CssSelector;
				if (ChildSelector == null)
				{
					ChildSelector = cssSelector.ChildSelector.Clone() as CssSelector;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ChildSelector = null;
			}
			if (ChildSelector != null)
			{
				ChildSelector.SetParent(this);
			}
		}
	}
	public class CssSelectorCollection : NodeList, ICssSelectorCollection, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		public new CssSelector this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (CssSelector)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		ICssSelector ICssSelectorCollection.this[int index] => this[index];

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new CssSelectorCollection();
		}

		int ICssSelectorCollection.IndexOf(ICssSelector e)
		{
			return IndexOf(e);
		}
	}

	public class RegionDirective : PreprocessorDirective
	{
		private int _EndTokenLength;

		private int _StartTokenLength;

		private SourceRange _NameRange;

		public override bool CompletesPrevious => false;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Region;

		public int EndTokenLength => _EndTokenLength;

		public int StartTokenLength => _StartTokenLength;

		[Obsolete("Use Range instead.")]
		public SourceRange FullRange => base.Range;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null && source is RegionDirective)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				RegionDirective regionDirective = (RegionDirective)source;
				_StartTokenLength = regionDirective._StartTokenLength;
				_EndTokenLength = regionDirective._EndTokenLength;
				_NameRange = regionDirective.NameRange;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override bool Contains(int line, int offset)
		{
			return base.Range.Contains(line, offset);
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 38;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetStartTokenLength(Token token)
		{
			if (token != null)
			{
				string escapedValue = token.EscapedValue;
				if (escapedValue != null)
				{
					SetStartTokenLength(escapedValue.Length);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetStartTokenLength(int value)
		{
			if (_StartTokenLength != value)
			{
				_StartTokenLength = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetEndTokenLength(Token token)
		{
			if (token != null)
			{
				string escapedValue = token.EscapedValue;
				if (escapedValue != null)
				{
					SetEndTokenLength(escapedValue.Length);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetEndTokenLength(int value)
		{
			if (_EndTokenLength != value)
			{
				_EndTokenLength = value;
			}
		}

		public void ToggleCollapsedState()
		{
			ICollapsibleRegion collapsibleRegion = GetCollapsibleRegion();
			if (collapsibleRegion != null)
			{
				collapsibleRegion.Collapsed = !collapsibleRegion.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			RegionDirective regionDirective = new RegionDirective();
			regionDirective.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return regionDirective;
		}

		public static bool Equals(RegionDirective region1, RegionDirective region2)
		{
			if (region1 == null || region2 == null)
			{
				if (region1 == null)
				{
					return region2 == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (string.Compare(region1.Name, region2.Name, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0 && region1.Range.Equals(region2.Range))
			{
				return region1.NameRange.Equals(region2.NameRange);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public RegionDirectiveCollection GetSubRegions()
		{
			RegionDirectiveCollection regionDirectiveCollection = new RegionDirectiveCollection();
			foreach (LanguageElement node in Nodes)
			{
				if (node is RegionDirective aRegionDirective)
				{
					regionDirectiveCollection.Add(aRegionDirective);
				}
			}
			return regionDirectiveCollection;
		}
	}

	public class AddressOfExpression : Expression, IAddressOfExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 2;

		private Expression _Exp;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 2;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AddressOfExpression;

		public string Operator => InternalName;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Exp;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IAddressOfExpression.Expression => Expression;

		public AddressOfExpression()
		{
		}

		public AddressOfExpression(Expression expression)
			: this(null, expression)
		{
		}

		public AddressOfExpression(Token token, Expression expression)
		{
			SetOperator(token);
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		private void SetOperator(Token token)
		{
			if (token != null)
			{
				InternalName = token.EscapedValue;
				SetStart(token.Range);
			}
		}

		private void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Exp);
			}
			_Exp = expression;
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Exp);
				SetEnd(_Exp.InternalRange);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AddressOfExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			AddressOfExpression addressOfExpression = (AddressOfExpression)source;
			if (addressOfExpression._Exp != null)
			{
				_Exp = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, addressOfExpression, addressOfExpression._Exp) as Expression;
				if (_Exp == null)
				{
					_Exp = addressOfExpression._Exp.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (InternalName != null)
			{
				text = text + InternalName + " ";
			}
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				text += _Exp.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 102;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is AddressOfExpression)
			{
				AddressOfExpression addressOfExpression = expression as AddressOfExpression;
				if (Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Expression.IsIdenticalTo(addressOfExpression.Expression);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Exp = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Exp == oldElement)
			{
				_Exp = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AddressOfExpression addressOfExpression = new AddressOfExpression();
			addressOfExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return addressOfExpression;
		}
	}
	public class AggregateElementReferenceExpression : ElementReferenceExpression
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AggregateElementReferenceExpression;

		public AggregateElementReferenceExpression()
		{
		}
