	public class AnonymousMethodExpression : Expression, IHasParameters, IAnonymousMethodExpression, IExpression, IElement, IWithParameters, IHasBlock, IWithParametersModifier
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _Parameters;

		private SourceRange _NameRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private SourceRange _ParamOpenRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private SourceRange _ParamCloseRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private SourceRange _BlockStart;

		private SourceRange _BlockEnd;

		private bool _IsAsynchronous;

		private bool _ParameterListOmitted;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression;

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		public override bool CanContainCode => true;

		public LanguageElementCollection Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					_Parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _Parameters;
			}
		}

		public int ParameterCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Parameters.Count;
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange ParamOpenRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParamOpenRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_ParamOpenRange = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange ParamCloseRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParamCloseRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_ParamCloseRange = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange BlockStart
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_BlockStart);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_BlockStart = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange BlockEnd
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_BlockEnd);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_BlockEnd = value;
			}
		}

		IParameterElementCollection IWithParameters.Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIParameterElementCollection;
				}
				LiteParameterElementCollection liteParameterElementCollection = new LiteParameterElementCollection();
				liteParameterElementCollection.AddRange(_Parameters);
				return liteParameterElementCollection;
			}
		}

		SourceRange IHasBlock.BlockStart => _BlockStart;

		SourceRange IHasBlock.BlockEnd => _BlockEnd;

		[Description("True if this anonimous method expression has async modifier.")]
		[Category("Access")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsAsynchronous
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsAsynchronous;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsAsynchronous = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool ParameterListOmitted
		{
			get
			{
				return _ParameterListOmitted;
			}
			set
			{
				_ParameterListOmitted = value;
			}
		}

		void IWithParametersModifier.AddParameter(IParameterElement parameter)
		{
			AddParameter(parameter as Param);
		}

		void IWithParametersModifier.RemoveParameter(IParameterElement parameter)
		{
			RemoveParameter(parameter as Param);
		}

		void IWithParametersModifier.InsertParameter(int index, IParameterElement parameter)
		{
			InsertParameter(index, parameter as Param);
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			int num = Parameters.IndexOf(oldElement);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				Parameters.RemoveAt(num);
				if (newElement != null)
				{
					Parameters.Insert(num, newElement);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AnonymousMethodExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			AnonymousMethodExpression anonymousMethodExpression = (AnonymousMethodExpression)source;
			if (anonymousMethodExpression._Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, anonymousMethodExpression.DetailNodes, _Parameters, anonymousMethodExpression._Parameters);
				if (_Parameters.Count == 0 && anonymousMethodExpression._Parameters.Count > 0)
				{
					_Parameters = anonymousMethodExpression._Parameters.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
			_NameRange = anonymousMethodExpression.NameRange;
			_ParamOpenRange = anonymousMethodExpression.ParamOpenRange;
			_ParamCloseRange = anonymousMethodExpression.ParamCloseRange;
			_BlockStart = anonymousMethodExpression.BlockStart;
			_BlockEnd = anonymousMethodExpression.BlockEnd;
			_IsAsynchronous = anonymousMethodExpression._IsAsynchronous;
			_ParameterListOmitted = anonymousMethodExpression._ParameterListOmitted;
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
			_ParamOpenRange = ParamOpenRange;
			_ParamCloseRange = ParamCloseRange;
			_BlockStart = BlockStart;
			_BlockEnd = BlockEnd;
		}

		public void SetBlockStart(SourceRange blockStart)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_BlockStart = blockStart;
		}

		public void SetBlockEnd(SourceRange blockEnd)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_BlockEnd = blockEnd;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver.Resolve(this);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "delegate";
		}

		public void AddParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Count; i++)
				{
					AddParameter(parameters[i] as Param);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddParameter(Param param)
		{
			if (param != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(param);
				Parameters.Add(param);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveParameter(Param param)
		{
			if (param != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(param);
				Parameters.Remove(param);
			}
		}

		public void InsertParameter(int index, Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Insert(index, parameter);
				InsertDetailNode(index, parameter);
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Parameters = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AnonymousMethodExpression anonymousMethodExpression = new AnonymousMethodExpression();
			anonymousMethodExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return anonymousMethodExpression;
		}

		private TypeReferenceExpression GetMethodType()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetMethodType(this);
		}

		public Method CreateMethod(string methodName)
		{
			return CreateMethod(methodName, GetMethodType(), Parameters);
		}

		public Method CreateMethod(string methodName, TypeReferenceExpression methodType, LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (methodName == null || methodName.Length == 0 || methodType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string type = StructuralParserServicesHolder.GenerateElement(methodType);
			Method method = new Method(type, methodName);
			if (methodType.Name != "void")
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Function;
			}
			else
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Void;
			}
			method.MemberTypeReference = methodType;
			if (parameters != null && parameters.Count > 0)
			{
				method.SetParameters(parameters.DeepClone() as LanguageElementCollection);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.NodeCount; i++)
			{
				method.AddNode((Nodes[i] as LanguageElement).Clone() as LanguageElement);
			}
			return method;
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return 1 + GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}
	}
	public enum ArgumentDirection : byte
	{
		In,
		Out,
		Ref,
		ParamArray,
		ArgList
	}
	public class ArgumentDirectionExpression : Expression, IArgumentDirectionExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Exp;

		private ArgumentDirection _Direction;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ArgumentDirectionExpression;

		public override SourceRange NameRange => GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);

		public ArgumentDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return _Direction;
			}
			set
			{
				SetDirection(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Exp;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		ArgumentDirection IArgumentDirectionExpression.Direction => Direction;

		IExpression IArgumentDirectionExpression.Expression => Expression;

		public ArgumentDirectionExpression()
		{
		}

		public ArgumentDirectionExpression(Token token, Expression expression)
		{
			SetDirectionToken(token);
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		public ArgumentDirectionExpression(ArgumentDirection direction, Expression expression)
		{
			SetDirection(direction);
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		private void SetDirectionToken(Token token)
		{
			if (token != null)
			{
				InternalName = token.EscapedValue;
				SetNameRange(token.Range);
				SetStart(token.Range);
			}
		}

		private void SetDirection(ArgumentDirection direction)
		{
			_Direction = direction;
		}

		private void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Exp);
			}
			_Exp = expression;
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Exp);
				SetEnd(_Exp.InternalRange);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Exp == oldElement)
			{
				_Exp = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ArgumentDirectionExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ArgumentDirectionExpression argumentDirectionExpression = (ArgumentDirectionExpression)source;
			_Direction = argumentDirectionExpression._Direction;
			_NameRange = argumentDirectionExpression.NameRange;
			if (argumentDirectionExpression._Exp != null)
			{
				_Exp = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, argumentDirectionExpression, argumentDirectionExpression._Exp) as Expression;
				if (_Exp == null)
				{
					_Exp = argumentDirectionExpression._Exp.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		protected void SetNameRange(SourceRange value)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_NameRange = value;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 98;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = Name + " ";
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				text += _Exp.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ArgumentDirectionExpression)
			{
				ArgumentDirectionExpression argumentDirectionExpression = expression as ArgumentDirectionExpression;
				if (Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Expression.IsIdenticalTo(argumentDirectionExpression.Expression))
				{
					return Direction == argumentDirectionExpression.Direction;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Exp = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ArgumentDirectionExpression argumentDirectionExpression = new ArgumentDirectionExpression();
			argumentDirectionExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return argumentDirectionExpression;
		}
	}
	public enum ArrayKindModifier
	{
		None,
		GC,
		NoGC
	}
	public class ArrayCreateExpression : Expression, IArrayCreateExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 6;

		private TypeReferenceExpression _BaseType;

		private ExpressionCollection _Dimensions;

		private ArrayInitializerExpression _Initializer;

		private bool _HasNOGCModifier;

		private bool _IsStackAlloc;

		private ArrayKindModifier _ArrayKind;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 6;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ArrayCreateExpression;

		public TypeReferenceExpression BaseType
		{
			get
			{
				return _BaseType;
			}
			set
			{
				SetBaseType(value);
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection Dimensions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Dimensions == null)
				{
					_Dimensions = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Dimensions;
			}
			set
			{
				SetDimensions(value);
			}
		}

		public ArrayInitializerExpression Initializer
		{
			get
			{
				return _Initializer;
			}
			set
			{
				SetInitializer(value);
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_BaseType != null)
				{
					return _BaseType.InternalRange;
				}
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
		}

		public bool HasNOGCModifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasNOGCModifier;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasNOGCModifier = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayKindModifier ArrayKind
		{
			get
			{
				return _ArrayKind;
			}
			set
			{
				_ArrayKind = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsStackAlloc
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsStackAlloc;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsStackAlloc = value;
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpression IArrayCreateExpression.BaseType => BaseType;

		IExpressionCollection IArrayCreateExpression.Dimensions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Dimensions == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return _Dimensions;
			}
		}

		IArrayInitializerExpression IArrayCreateExpression.Initializer => Initializer;

		public ArrayCreateExpression()
		{
		}

		public ArrayCreateExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type)
			: this(type, null, null)
		{
		}

		public ArrayCreateExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, ExpressionCollection dimensions)
			: this(type, dimensions, null)
		{
		}

		public ArrayCreateExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, ExpressionCollection dimensions, ArrayInitializerExpression initializer)
		{
			SetBaseType(type);
			if (dimensions != null)
			{
				AddDimensions(dimensions);
			}
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				SetInitializer(initializer);
			}
		}

		private bool CompareDimensions(ArrayCreateExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Dimensions == null && expression.Dimensions == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Dimensions == null || expression.Dimensions == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Dimensions.IsIdenticalTo(expression.Dimensions);
		}

		private bool CompareInitializer(ArrayCreateExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Initializer == null && expression.Initializer == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Initializer == null || expression.Initializer == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Initializer.IsIdenticalTo(expression.Initializer);
		}

		private void SetBaseType(TypeReferenceExpression baseType)
		{
			if (_BaseType != null)
			{
				RemoveNode(_BaseType);
			}
			_BaseType = baseType;
			if (_BaseType != null)
			{
				AddNode(_BaseType);
			}
			if (_BaseType != null)
			{
				InternalName = _BaseType.ToString();
			}
		}

		private void SetInitializer(ArrayInitializerExpression initializer)
		{
			if (_Initializer != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Initializer);
			}
			_Initializer = initializer;
			if (_Initializer != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Initializer);
			}
		}

		private void SetDimensions(ExpressionCollection dimensions)
		{
			if (_Dimensions != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_Dimensions);
			}
			_Dimensions = dimensions;
			if (_Dimensions != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_Dimensions);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ArrayCreateExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayCreateExpression arrayCreateExpression = (ArrayCreateExpression)source;
			_IsStackAlloc = arrayCreateExpression._IsStackAlloc;
			if (arrayCreateExpression.BaseType != null)
			{
				_BaseType = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, arrayCreateExpression, arrayCreateExpression._BaseType) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_BaseType == null)
				{
					_BaseType = arrayCreateExpression._BaseType.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
			if (arrayCreateExpression._Dimensions != null)
			{
				_Dimensions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, arrayCreateExpression.DetailNodes, _Dimensions, arrayCreateExpression._Dimensions);
				if (_Dimensions.Count == 0 && arrayCreateExpression._Dimensions.Count > 0)
				{
					_Dimensions = arrayCreateExpression._Dimensions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (arrayCreateExpression._Initializer != null)
			{
				_Initializer = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, arrayCreateExpression, arrayCreateExpression._Initializer) as ArrayInitializerExpression;
				if (_Initializer == null)
				{
					_Initializer = arrayCreateExpression._Initializer.Clone(options) as ArrayInitializerExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = "new ";
			if (_BaseType != null)
			{
				text += _BaseType.ToString();
			}
			if (_Dimensions != null)
			{
				text += "[";
				text += _Dimensions.ToString();
				text += "]";
			}
			if (_Initializer != null)
			{
				text += _Initializer.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 103;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ArrayCreateExpression)
			{
				ArrayCreateExpression arrayCreateExpression = expression as ArrayCreateExpression;
				if (BaseType == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!BaseType.IsIdenticalTo((Expression)arrayCreateExpression.BaseType))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!CompareDimensions(arrayCreateExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!CompareInitializer(arrayCreateExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_BaseType = null;
			_Initializer = null;
			if (_Dimensions != null)
			{
				_Dimensions.Clear();
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_BaseType == oldElement)
			{
				_BaseType = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Initializer == oldElement)
			{
				_Initializer = (ArrayInitializerExpression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Dimensions != null)
			{
				_Dimensions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ArrayCreateExpression arrayCreateExpression = new ArrayCreateExpression();
			arrayCreateExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return arrayCreateExpression;
		}

		public void AddDimension(Expression dimension)
		{
			Dimensions.Add(dimension);
			AddDetailNode(dimension);
		}

		public void AddDimensions(IEnumerable<Expression> dimensions)
		{
			if (dimensions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Expression dimension in dimensions)
			{
				AddDimension(dimension);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ArrayInitializerExpression : Expression, IArrayInitializerExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 2;

		private ExpressionCollection _Initializers;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 2;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression;

		public ExpressionCollection Initializers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Initializers == null)
				{
					_Initializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Initializers;
			}
			set
			{
				SetInitializers(value);
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IArrayInitializerExpression.Initializers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Initializers == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return _Initializers;
			}
		}

		public ArrayInitializerExpression()
		{
		}

		public ArrayInitializerExpression(ExpressionCollection initializers)
		{
			AddInitializers(initializers);
		}

		private void SetInitializers(ExpressionCollection initializers)
		{
			if (_Initializers != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_Initializers);
			}
			_Initializers = initializers;
			if (_Initializers != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_Initializers);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ArrayInitializerExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayInitializerExpression arrayInitializerExpression = (ArrayInitializerExpression)source;
			if (arrayInitializerExpression._Initializers != null)
			{
				_Initializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, arrayInitializerExpression.DetailNodes, _Initializers, arrayInitializerExpression._Initializers);
				if (_Initializers.Count == 0 && arrayInitializerExpression._Initializers.Count > 0)
				{
					_Initializers = arrayInitializerExpression._Initializers.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (_Initializers != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("{");
				string arg = string.Empty;
				for (int i = 0; i < _Initializers.Count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", arg, _Initializers[i].ToString());
					arg = ", ";
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("}");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ArrayInitializerExpression)
			{
				ArrayInitializerExpression arrayInitializerExpression = expression as ArrayInitializerExpression;
				if (Initializers == null && arrayInitializerExpression.Initializers == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Initializers == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Initializers.IsIdenticalTo(arrayInitializerExpression.Initializers);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Initializers = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Initializers != null)
			{
				_Initializers.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ArrayInitializerExpression arrayInitializerExpression = new ArrayInitializerExpression();
			arrayInitializerExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return arrayInitializerExpression;
		}

		public void AddInitializer(Expression initializer)
		{
			Initializers.Add(initializer);
			AddDetailNode(initializer);
		}

		public void AddInitializers(IEnumerable<Expression> initializers)
		{
			if (initializers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Expression initializer in initializers)
			{
				AddInitializer(initializer);
			}
		}
	}

				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is AssignmentExpression)
				{
					AssignmentExpression assignmentExpression = (AssignmentExpression)source;
					_AssignmentOperatorType = assignmentExpression._AssignmentOperatorType;
				}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)

				if (base.LeftSide.IsIdenticalTo(assignmentExpression.LeftSide) && AssignmentOperator == assignmentExpression.AssignmentOperator)
				{
					return base.RightSide.IsIdenticalTo(assignmentExpression.RightSide);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)

		}

			return assignmentExpression;
		}

	public class AssociativeContainerExpression : Expression
	{
		private ExpressionCollection _Expressions;

		public ExpressionCollection Expressions => _Expressions;

		private AssociativeContainerExpression()
		{
		}

		public AssociativeContainerExpression(ExpressionCollection expressions)
		{
			if (expressions == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("expressions");
			}
			_Expressions = expressions;
			SetAssociativeRange();
		}

		private void SetAssociativeRange()
		{
			if (Expressions == null || Expressions.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourcePoint sourcePoint = SourcePoint.Empty;
			SourcePoint sourcePoint2 = SourcePoint.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < Expressions.Count; i++)
			{
				Expression expression = Expressions[i];
				SourceRange range = expression.Range;
				if (sourcePoint.IsEmpty)
				{
					sourcePoint = range.Top;
				}
				if (sourcePoint2.IsEmpty)
				{
					sourcePoint2 = range.Bottom;
				}
				if (range.Top < sourcePoint)
				{
					sourcePoint = range.Top;
				}
				if (range.Bottom > sourcePoint2)
				{
					sourcePoint2 = range.Bottom;
				}
			}
			SetRange(new SourceRange(sourcePoint, sourcePoint2));
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AssociativeContainerExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			AssociativeContainerExpression associativeContainerExpression = (AssociativeContainerExpression)source;
			if (associativeContainerExpression._Expressions != null)
			{
				_Expressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, associativeContainerExpression.DetailNodes, _Expressions, associativeContainerExpression._Expressions);
				if (_Expressions.Count == 0 && associativeContainerExpression._Expressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_Expressions = associativeContainerExpression._Expressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expressions != null && _Expressions.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Expressions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			if (resolver == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Expressions.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Expressions[0]?.Resolve(resolver);
		}

		public void AttachToSourceTree()
		{
			if (Expressions.Count != 0)
			{
				Expression expression = Expressions[0];
				SetParent(expression.Parent);
			}
		}

		public void DetachFromSourceTree()
		{
			SetParent(null);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AssociativeContainerExpression associativeContainerExpression = new AssociativeContainerExpression();
			associativeContainerExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return associativeContainerExpression;
		}
	}

	public class AwaitExpression : Expression, IAwaitExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private Expression _SourceExpression;

		public Expression SourceExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_SourceExpression, value);
				_SourceExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AwaitExpression;

		IExpression IAwaitExpression.SourceExpression => _SourceExpression;

		private AwaitExpression()
		{
		}

		public AwaitExpression(Expression source)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				SourceExpression = source;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is AwaitExpression { _SourceExpression: not null } awaitExpression)
			{
				_SourceExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, awaitExpression, awaitExpression._SourceExpression) as Expression;
				if (_SourceExpression == null)

					SourceExpression = awaitExpression._SourceExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}

		{

		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = "await";
			if (_SourceExpression == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return text + " " + _SourceExpression;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			SourceExpression = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}
	}

	public class BinaryOperatorExpression : OperatorExpression, IBinaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 5;

		private BinaryOperatorType _Operator;

		private Expression _LeftSide;

		private Expression _RightSide;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 5;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.BinaryOperatorExpression;

		public Expression LeftSide
		{
			get
			{
				return _LeftSide;
			}
			set
			{
				SetLeftSide(value);
			}
		}

		public BinaryOperatorType BinaryOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _Operator;
			}
			set
			{
				_Operator = value;
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use BinaryOperator instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public BinaryOperatorType Operator
		{
			get
			{
				return _Operator;
			}
			set
			{
				_Operator = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression RightSide
		{
			get
			{
				return _RightSide;
			}
			set
			{
				SetRightSide(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IBinaryOperatorExpression.LeftSide => LeftSide;

		IExpression IBinaryOperatorExpression.RightSide => RightSide;

		public BinaryOperatorExpression()
		{
		}

		public BinaryOperatorExpression(Expression left, Token token, Expression right)
			: base(token)
		{
			SetLeftSide(left);
			SetRightSide(right);
		}

		public BinaryOperatorExpression(Expression left, Expression right)
		{
			SetLeftSide(left);
			SetRightSide(right);
		}

		public BinaryOperatorExpression(Expression left, string operatorText, Expression right)
			: base(operatorText)
		{
			SetLeftSide(left);
			SetRightSide(right);
		}

		public BinaryOperatorExpression(Expression left, BinaryOperatorType operatorType, Expression right)
		{
			BinaryOperator = operatorType;
			SetLeftSide(left);
			SetRightSide(right);
		}

		protected void SetLeftSide(Expression left)
		{
			if (_LeftSide != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_LeftSide);
			}
			_LeftSide = left;
			if (_LeftSide != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_LeftSide);
			}
		}

		protected void SetRightSide(Expression right)
		{
			if (_RightSide != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_RightSide);
			}
			_RightSide = right;
			if (_RightSide != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_RightSide);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_LeftSide == oldElement)
			{
				_LeftSide = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else if (_RightSide == oldElement)
			{
				_RightSide = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is BinaryOperatorExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			BinaryOperatorExpression binaryOperatorExpression = (BinaryOperatorExpression)source;
			_Operator = binaryOperatorExpression._Operator;
			if (binaryOperatorExpression._LeftSide != null)
			{
				_LeftSide = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, binaryOperatorExpression, binaryOperatorExpression._LeftSide) as Expression;
				if (_LeftSide == null)
				{
					_LeftSide = binaryOperatorExpression._LeftSide.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (binaryOperatorExpression._RightSide != null)
			{
				_RightSide = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, binaryOperatorExpression, binaryOperatorExpression._RightSide) as Expression;
				if (_RightSide == null)
				{
					_RightSide = binaryOperatorExpression._RightSide.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (LeftSide != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0} ", LeftSide.ToString());
			}
			if (base.OperatorText != string.Empty)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0} ", base.OperatorText);
			}
			if (RightSide != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}", RightSide.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 92;
		}

		public override string GetDetailNodeDescription(int index)
		{
			return index switch
			{
				0 => "Left Side", 
				1 => "Right Side", 
				_ => base.GetDetailNodeDescription(index), 
			};
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is BinaryOperatorExpression)
			{
				BinaryOperatorExpression binaryOperatorExpression = expression as BinaryOperatorExpression;
				if (LeftSide == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (RightSide == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (LeftSide.IsIdenticalTo(binaryOperatorExpression.LeftSide) && base.OperatorText == binaryOperatorExpression.OperatorText)
				{
					return RightSide.IsIdenticalTo(binaryOperatorExpression.RightSide);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_LeftSide = null;
			_RightSide = null;
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_LeftSide = null;
			_RightSide = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			BinaryOperatorExpression binaryOperatorExpression = new BinaryOperatorExpression();
			binaryOperatorExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return binaryOperatorExpression;
		}

		public static OperatorType GetOverloadableOperatorType(BinaryOperatorType binary)
		{
			return binary switch
			{
				BinaryOperatorType.None => OperatorType.None, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Add => OperatorType.Addition, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Subtract => OperatorType.Subtraction, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Multiply => OperatorType.Multiply, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Divide => OperatorType.Division, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Modulus => OperatorType.Modulus, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseAnd => OperatorType.BitwiseAnd, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseOr => OperatorType.BitwiseOr, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Exponentiation => OperatorType.Exponent, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BooleanAnd => OperatorType.LogicalAnd, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BooleanOr => OperatorType.LogicalOr, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ExclusiveOr => OperatorType.ExclusiveOr, 
				BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThan => OperatorType.GreaterThan, 
				BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual => OperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual, 
				BinaryOperatorType.IdentityEquality => OperatorType.Equality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.IdentityInequality => OperatorType.Inequality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.LessThan => OperatorType.LessThan, 
				BinaryOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual => OperatorType.LessThanOrEqual, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ShiftLeft => OperatorType.LeftShift, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ShiftRight => OperatorType.SignedRightShift, 
				BinaryOperatorType.UnsignedShiftRight => OperatorType.RightShift, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ValueEquality => OperatorType.Equality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.IntegerDivision => OperatorType.IntegerDivision, 
				BinaryOperatorType.StrictEquality => OperatorType.Equality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.StrictInequality => OperatorType.Inequality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Like => OperatorType.Like, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Concatenation => OperatorType.Concatenate, 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class CastTargetExpression : TypeCastExpression
	{
		private Token _CastToken;

		private string _CastKeyword;

		private string _CastTypeName;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CastTargetExpression;

		public Token CastToken => _CastToken;

		public string CastTypeName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CastTypeName != null && _CastTypeName != string.Empty)
				{
					return _CastTypeName;
				}
				if (CastToken != null)
				{
					return GetTypeFromCastToken(CastToken);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				_CastTypeName = value;
			}
		}

		public string CastKeyword
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CastKeyword != null && _CastKeyword != string.Empty)
				{
					return _CastKeyword;
				}
				if (CastToken != null)
				{
					GetTypeCastKeyword(CastToken);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				_CastKeyword = value;
			}
		}

		protected CastTargetExpression()
		{
		}

		public CastTargetExpression(string castTypeName, string castKeyword, SourceRange castRange, Expression target)
		{
			SetTarget(target);
			_CastKeyword = castKeyword;
			_CastTypeName = castTypeName;
			SetStart(castRange);
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReference = new TypeReferenceExpression(castTypeName, castRange);
			SetTypeReference(typeReference);
		}

		public CastTargetExpression(Token castToken, Expression target)
		{
			SetTarget(target);
			_CastToken = castToken;
			SetStart(castToken.Range);
			SetTypeReference(GetTypeReference(castToken));
		}

		public CastTargetExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, Expression target)
			: base(type, target)
		{
		}

		protected string GetTypeFromCastToken(Token token)
		{
			return token.Type switch
			{
				163 => "Boolean", 
				164 => "Byte", 
				165 => "Char", 
				166 => "Date", 
				168 => "Decimal", 
				167 => "Double", 
				169 => "Integer", 
				170 => "Long", 
				171 => "Object", 
				172 => "Short", 
				173 => "Single", 
				174 => "String", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		protected string GetTypeCastKeyword(Token token)
		{
			return token.Type switch
			{
				163 => "CBool", 
				164 => "CByte", 
				165 => "CChar", 
				166 => "CDate", 
				168 => "CDec", 
				167 => "CDbl", 
				169 => "CInt", 
				170 => "CLng", 
				171 => "CObj", 
				172 => "CShort", 
				173 => "CSng", 
				174 => "CStr", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		protected TypeReferenceExpression GetTypeReference(Token token)
		{
			string typeFromCastToken = GetTypeFromCastToken(token);
			if (typeFromCastToken.Length > 0)
			{
				return new TypeReferenceExpression(typeFromCastToken, token.Range);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is CastTargetExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			CastTargetExpression castTargetExpression = (CastTargetExpression)source;
			if (castTargetExpression != null)
			{
				if (castTargetExpression._CastToken != null)
				{
					_CastToken = castTargetExpression._CastToken.Clone();
				}
				_CastKeyword = castTargetExpression.CastKeyword;
				_CastTypeName = castTargetExpression.CastTypeName;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = CastKeyword + "(";
			if (base.Target != null)
			{
				text += base.Target.ToString();
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CastTargetExpression castTargetExpression = new CastTargetExpression();
			castTargetExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return castTargetExpression;
		}
	}
	public class CheckedExpression : Expression, ICheckedExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Exp;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CheckedExpression;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Exp;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression ICheckedExpression.Expression => Expression;

		private CheckedExpression()
		{
		}

		public CheckedExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Exp == oldElement)
			{
				_Exp = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is CheckedExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			CheckedExpression checkedExpression = (CheckedExpression)source;
			if (checkedExpression._Exp != null)
			{
				_Exp = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, checkedExpression, checkedExpression._Exp) as Expression;
				if (_Exp == null)
				{
					_Exp = checkedExpression._Exp.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Exp);
			}
			_Exp = expression;
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Exp);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				return "checked(" + _Exp.ToString() + ")";
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 105;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is CheckedExpression)
			{
				CheckedExpression checkedExpression = (CheckedExpression)expression;
				if (Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Expression.IsIdenticalTo(checkedExpression.Expression);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Exp = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CheckedExpression checkedExpression = new CheckedExpression();
			checkedExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return checkedExpression;
		}
	}
	public class ComplexExpression : Expression, IComplexExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private ExpressionCollection _Expressions;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ComplexExpression;

		public ExpressionCollection Expressions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Expressions == null)
				{
					_Expressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Expressions;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpressions(value);
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IComplexExpression.Expressions => _Expressions;

		private void SetExpressions(ExpressionCollection expressions)
		{
			if (_Expressions != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_Expressions);
			}
			_Expressions = expressions;
			if (_Expressions != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_Expressions);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Expressions == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int count = Expressions.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat(",{0}", Expressions[i].ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Expressions[i].ToString());
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ComplexExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ComplexExpression complexExpression = (ComplexExpression)source;
			if (complexExpression._Expressions != null)
			{
				_Expressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, complexExpression.DetailNodes, _Expressions, complexExpression._Expressions);
				if (_Expressions.Count == 0 && complexExpression._Expressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_Expressions = complexExpression._Expressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expressions != null && _Expressions.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_Expressions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ComplexExpression complexExpression = new ComplexExpression();
			complexExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return complexExpression;
		}

		public void AddExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Expressions.Add(expression);
				AddDetailNode(expression);
			}
		}

		public void AddExpressions(IEnumerable<Expression> expressions)
		{
			if (expressions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Expression expression in expressions)
			{
				AddExpression(expression);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ConditionalExpression : Expression, IConditionalExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 6;

		private Expression _Condition;

		private Expression _TrueExpression;

		private Expression _FalseExpression;

		private bool _IsNeededResultsCasting;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 6;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ConditionalExpression;

		public Expression Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return _Condition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetCondition(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression TrueExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _TrueExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTrueExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression FalseExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _FalseExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetFalseExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IConditionalExpression.Condition => Condition;

		IExpression IConditionalExpression.TrueExpression => TrueExpression;

		IExpression IConditionalExpression.FalseExpression => FalseExpression;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsNeededResultsCasting
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsNeededResultsCasting;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsNeededResultsCasting = value;
			}
		}

		protected ConditionalExpression()
		{
		}

		public ConditionalExpression(Expression condition, Expression trueExpression, Expression falseExpression)
		{
			SetCondition(condition);
			SetTrueExpression(trueExpression);
			SetFalseExpression(falseExpression);
		}

		protected void SetCondition(Expression condition)
		{
			if (_Condition != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Condition);
			}
			_Condition = condition;
			if (_Condition != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Condition);
			}
		}

		protected void SetTrueExpression(Expression trueExpression)
		{
			if (_TrueExpression != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_TrueExpression);
			}
			_TrueExpression = trueExpression;
			if (_TrueExpression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_TrueExpression);
			}
		}

		protected void SetFalseExpression(Expression falseExpression)
		{
			if (_FalseExpression != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_FalseExpression);
			}
			_FalseExpression = falseExpression;
			if (_FalseExpression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_FalseExpression);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Condition == oldElement)
			{
				_Condition = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_TrueExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_TrueExpression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_FalseExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_FalseExpression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ConditionalExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ConditionalExpression conditionalExpression = (ConditionalExpression)source;
			if (conditionalExpression._Condition != null)
			{
				_Condition = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, conditionalExpression, conditionalExpression._Condition) as Expression;
				if (_Condition == null)
				{
					_Condition = conditionalExpression._Condition.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (conditionalExpression._TrueExpression != null)
			{
				_TrueExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, conditionalExpression, conditionalExpression._TrueExpression) as Expression;
				if (_TrueExpression == null)
				{
					_TrueExpression = conditionalExpression._TrueExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (conditionalExpression._FalseExpression != null)
			{
				_FalseExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, conditionalExpression, conditionalExpression._FalseExpression) as Expression;
				if (_FalseExpression == null)
				{
					_FalseExpression = conditionalExpression._FalseExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			_IsNeededResultsCasting = conditionalExpression._IsNeededResultsCasting;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (_Condition != null)
			{
				text = text + _Condition.ToString() + " ";
			}
			text += "? ";
			if (_TrueExpression != null)
			{
				text = text + _TrueExpression.ToString() + " ";
			}
			text += ": ";
			if (_FalseExpression != null)
			{
				text += _FalseExpression.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 107;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ConditionalExpression)
			{
				ConditionalExpression conditionalExpression = (ConditionalExpression)expression;
				if (Condition == null || !Condition.IsIdenticalTo(conditionalExpression.Condition))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (TrueExpression == null || !TrueExpression.IsIdenticalTo(conditionalExpression.TrueExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (FalseExpression == null || !FalseExpression.IsIdenticalTo(conditionalExpression.FalseExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return 1 + GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_Condition = null;
			_TrueExpression = null;
			_FalseExpression = null;
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Condition = null;
			_TrueExpression = null;
			_FalseExpression = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ConditionalExpression conditionalExpression = new ConditionalExpression();
			conditionalExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return conditionalExpression;
		}
	}
	public class ConditionalTypeCast : BinaryOperatorExpression, IConditionalTypeCast, IBinaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 4;

		private bool _IsIfOperator = true;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 4;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ConditionalTypeCast;

		public bool IsIfOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsIfOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsIfOperator = value;
			}
		}

		private ConditionalTypeCast()
		{
		}

		public ConditionalTypeCast(Expression left, Token token, Expression right)
			: base(left, token, right)
		{
		}

		public ConditionalTypeCast(Expression left, Expression right)
			: base(left, right)
		{
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ConditionalTypeCast conditionalTypeCast = new ConditionalTypeCast();
			conditionalTypeCast.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return conditionalTypeCast;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is ConditionalTypeCast conditionalTypeCast)
				{
					_IsIfOperator = conditionalTypeCast._IsIfOperator;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 128;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ConditionalTypeCast)
			{
				ConditionalTypeCast conditionalTypeCast = (ConditionalTypeCast)expression;
				if (base.LeftSide == null || !base.LeftSide.IsIdenticalTo(conditionalTypeCast.LeftSide))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.RightSide == null || !base.RightSide.IsIdenticalTo(conditionalTypeCast.RightSide))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class DefaultValueExpression : Expression, IDefaultValueExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private TypeReferenceExpression _TypeReference;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.DefaultValueExpression;

		public TypeReferenceExpression TypeReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _TypeReference;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTypeReference(value);
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpression IDefaultValueExpression.TypeReference => TypeReference;

		private DefaultValueExpression()
		{
		}

		public DefaultValueExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type)
			: this(type, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public DefaultValueExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, SourceRange range)
		{
			SetTypeReference(type);
			SetRange(range);
		}

		protected void SetTypeReference(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_TypeReference);
			}
			_TypeReference = type;
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_TypeReference);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_TypeReference == oldElement)
			{
				_TypeReference = newElement as TypeReferenceExpression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;

			if (source is DefaultValueExpression { _TypeReference: not null } defaultValueExpression)
			{
				_TypeReference = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, defaultValueExpression, defaultValueExpression._TypeReference) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_TypeReference == null)
				{
					_TypeReference = defaultValueExpression._TypeReference.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(TypeReference);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = ((_TypeReference == null) ? string.Empty : _TypeReference.ToString());
			return "default(" + text + ")";
		}

		{
			DefaultValueExpression defaultValueExpression = new DefaultValueExpression();
			defaultValueExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return defaultValueExpression;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_TypeReference = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}
	}
	public class DeleteExpression : Expression, IDeleteExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private Expression _Expression;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.DeleteExpression;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{

			}
		}

		IExpression IDeleteExpression.Expression => Expression;

		protected DeleteExpression()
		{
		}

		public DeleteExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			Name = "delete";
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		private void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is DeleteExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			DeleteExpression deleteExpression = (DeleteExpression)source;
			if (deleteExpression._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, deleteExpression, deleteExpression._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = deleteExpression._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			DeleteExpression deleteExpression = new DeleteExpression();
			deleteExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return deleteExpression;
		}
	}
	public class DirectCastExpression : TypeCastExpression
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.DirectCastExpression;

		protected DirectCastExpression()
		{
		}

		public DirectCastExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, Expression target)
			: base(type, target)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = "DirectCast(";
			if (base.Target != null)
			{
				text += base.Target.ToString();
			}
			if (base.TypeReference != null)
			{
				text = text + ", " + base.TypeReference.ToString();
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			DirectCastExpression directCastExpression = new DirectCastExpression();
			directCastExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return directCastExpression;
		}
	}

	public class ElementReferenceExpression : ReferenceExpressionBase, IElementReferenceExpression, IReferenceExpression, IExpression, IElement, IGenericExpression, IWithSource
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 1;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		private bool _IsModified;

		private bool _IsKey;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 1;

		public override bool NeedsInvertParens => false;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ElementReferenceExpression;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException("Can't set Qualifier property for ElementReferenceExpression. Qualifier property can be set on QualifiedElementReference");
			}
		}

		public virtual bool HasCleanReferences => true;

		public bool IsModified
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsModified;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsModified = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsKey
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsKey;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsKey = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsUsed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.InsideAssignment)
				{
					return !base.InsideOutArgumentDirection;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		bool IElementReferenceExpression.IsModified => IsModified;

		protected ElementReferenceExpression()
		{
		}

		public ElementReferenceExpression(string name)
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		public ElementReferenceExpression(string name, SourceRange range)
			: this(name)
		{
			SetRange(range);
			_NameRange = range;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is ElementReferenceExpression)
				{
					ElementReferenceExpression elementReferenceExpression = (ElementReferenceExpression)source;
					_IsModified = elementReferenceExpression._IsModified;
					_NameRange = elementReferenceExpression.NameRange;
					_IsKey = elementReferenceExpression.IsKey;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 96;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.IsIdenticalTo(expression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ElementReferenceExpression)
			{
				ElementReferenceExpression elementReferenceExpression = (ElementReferenceExpression)expression;
				if (Qualifier == null)
				{
					if (elementReferenceExpression.Qualifier == null)
					{
						return Name == elementReferenceExpression.Name;
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (Qualifier.IsIdenticalTo(elementReferenceExpression.Qualifier))
				{
					return Name == elementReferenceExpression.Name;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ElementReferenceExpression elementReferenceExpression = new ElementReferenceExpression();
			elementReferenceExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return elementReferenceExpression;
		}
	}

	public abstract class Expression : CodeElement, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private static object _NullValue = (byte)0;

		private object _TestValue = _NullValue;

		private bool _IsStatement;

		private string _MacroCall;

		public virtual bool NeedsInvertParens => true;

		public object TestValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasTestValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _TestValue;
			}
		}

		public bool TestValueAsBool
		{
			get
			{
				if (TestValue == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(TestValue is bool))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return (bool)TestValue;
			}
		}

		public bool HasTestValue => _TestValue != _NullValue;

		public virtual int Level
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is IHasQualifier)
				{
					return QualifiedExpressionHelper.GetLevel(this as IHasQualifier);
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool CanBeStatement => false;

		public bool IsStatement
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsStatement;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsStatement = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsIndirectlyModified
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Parent is Expression expression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (expression is IndexerExpression { Arguments: not null } indexerExpression && indexerExpression.Arguments.Contains(this))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (expression is MethodCallExpression { Arguments: not null } methodCallExpression && methodCallExpression.Arguments.Contains(this))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (expression.IsInsideModificationExpression)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (expression is ElementReferenceExpression { IsModified: not false })
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (expression.IsIndirectlyModified)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsInsideModificationExpression
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.InsideAssignment && !base.InsideOutArgumentDirection && !base.InsideRefArgumentDirection && !base.InsideIncrement)
				{
					return base.InsideDecrement;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public virtual string ExpressionTypeName => string.Empty;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Expression;

		public override string MacroCall
		{
			get
			{
				return _MacroCall;
			}
			set
			{
				_MacroCall = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression()
		{
		}

		private void TransferNodesTo(NodeList nodes, LanguageElement element, bool toDetail)
		{
			if (element == null || nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement element2)
				{
					if (toDetail)
					{
						element.AddDetailNode(element2);
					}
					else
					{
						element.AddNode(element2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearTestValues(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is Expression expression)
				{
					expression.ClearTestValue();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ConvertToBool(object value)
		{
			if (value is string || value is DateTime)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't convert expression to boolean type.");
			}
			return Convert.ToBoolean(value);
		}

		protected virtual object EvaluateExpression()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 18;
		}

		public Expression GetByLevel(int level)
		{
			return QualifiedExpressionHelper.GetByLevel(this, level) as Expression;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetStartElement()
		{
			return QualifiedExpressionHelper.GetStartElement(this);
		}

		public LanguageElement GetEndElement()
		{
			return QualifiedExpressionHelper.GetEndElement(this);
		}

		public virtual bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public Expression Invert()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.Invert(this);
		}

		public virtual Expression Simplify()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.Simplify(this);
		}

		public virtual Expression Simplify(bool considerMethodCalls)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.Simplify(this, considerMethodCalls);
		}

		public abstract IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver);

		public Expression RemoveRedundantParens()
		{
			if (!(this is ParenthesizedExpression))
			{
				return this;
			}
			ParenthesizedExpression parenthesizedExpression = (ParenthesizedExpression)this;
			Expression expression = parenthesizedExpression.Expression;
			if (!expression.NeedsInvertParens)
			{
				return expression;
			}
			return parenthesizedExpression;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public object Evaluate()
		{
			if (HasTestValue)
			{
				return TestValue;
			}
			return EvaluateExpression();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool EvaluateAsBool()
		{
			object obj = Evaluate();
			if (obj == null || !(obj is bool))
			{
				return ConvertToBool(obj);
			}
			return (bool)obj;
		}

		public virtual void TransferAllNodesTo(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				TransferNodesTo(DetailNodes, element, toDetail: true);
				TransferNodesTo(Nodes, element, toDetail: false);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetTestValue(object value)
		{
			_TestValue = value;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ClearTestValue()
		{
			_TestValue = _NullValue;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ClearTestValues()
		{
			ClearTestValue();
			ClearTestValues(DetailNodes);
			ClearTestValues(Nodes);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Expression)
				{
					Expression expression = (Expression)source;
					_TestValue = expression._TestValue;
					_IsStatement = expression._IsStatement;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual bool Is(string fullTypeName)
		{
			ISourceTreeResolver sourceTreeResolver = StructuralParserServicesHolder.SourceTreeResolver;
			return Is(sourceTreeResolver, fullTypeName);
		}

		public virtual bool Is(ITypeElement type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Is(type.FullName);
		}

		public virtual bool Is(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Is(type.FullName);
		}

		public virtual bool Is(ISourceTreeResolver resolver, string fullTypeName)
		{
			if (resolver == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(resolver.ResolveExpression(this) is ITypeElement typeElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return typeElement.Is(resolver, fullTypeName);
		}
	}
	public class ExpressionCollection : ExpressionCollectionBase, IExpressionCollection, ICollection, IEnumerable, IEnumerable<Expression>
	{
		public new Expression this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (Expression)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		IExpression IExpressionCollection.this[int index] => this[index];

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new ExpressionCollection();
		}

		public int Add(Expression expression)
		{
			return Add((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public void AddRange(ExpressionCollection collection)
		{
			AddRange((LanguageElementCollectionBase)collection);
		}

		public int IndexOf(Expression expression)
		{
			return IndexOf((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Expression expression)
		{
			Insert(index, (LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public void Remove(Expression expression)
		{
			Remove((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public Expression Find(Expression expression)
		{
			return (Expression)Find((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public bool Contains(Expression expression)
		{
			return Find(expression) != null;
		}

		int IExpressionCollection.IndexOf(IExpression e)
		{
			return IndexOf(e);
		}

		IEnumerator<Expression> IEnumerable<Expression>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (enumerator.Current is Expression expression)
				{
					yield return expression;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class ExpressionCollectionBase : LanguageElementCollectionBase
	{
		public bool IsIdenticalTo(ExpressionCollectionBase collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Count != collection.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				Expression expression = base[i] as Expression;
				Expression expression2 = collection[i] as Expression;
				if (expression == null && expression2 != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!expression.IsIdenticalTo(expression2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ReplaceExpression(Expression oldExpression, Expression newExpression)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(oldExpression);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(num);
				if (newExpression != null)
				{
					Insert(num, newExpression);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new ExpressionCollectionBase();
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class FunctionPointerTypeReference : TypeReferenceExpression, IFunctionPointerTypeReference, ITypeReferenceExpression, IReferenceExpression, IExpression, IElement, IGenericExpression, IWithSource
	{
		private AccessSpecifiers _AccessSpecifiers;

		private TypeReferenceExpression _ReturnType;

		private LanguageElementCollection _Parameters;

		private CallingConventionSpecifier _CallingConvention;

		public AccessSpecifiers AccessSpecifiers => _AccessSpecifiers;

		public CallingConventionSpecifier CallingConvention
		{
			get
			{
				return _CallingConvention;
			}
			set
			{
				_CallingConvention = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.FunctionPointerTypeReference;

		public LanguageElementCollection Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				return _Parameters;
			}
			set
			{
				SetParameters(value);
			}
		}

		public int ParametersCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters != null)
				{
					return _Parameters.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public TypeReferenceExpression ReturnType
		{
			get
			{
				return _ReturnType;
			}
			set
			{
				SetReturnType(value);
			}
		}

		IElementCollection IFunctionPointerTypeReference.Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					return IElementCollection.Empty;
				}
				IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
				elementCollection.AddRange(_Parameters);
				return elementCollection;
			}
		}

		int IFunctionPointerTypeReference.ParametersCount => ParametersCount;

		ITypeReferenceExpression IFunctionPointerTypeReference.ReturnType => ReturnType;

		protected FunctionPointerTypeReference()
		{
			_CallingConvention = CallingConventionSpecifier.Default;
			_AccessSpecifiers = new AccessSpecifiers();
		}

		public FunctionPointerTypeReference(TypeReferenceExpression returnType, LanguageElementCollection parameters, CallingConventionSpecifier callingConvention)
			: this()
		{
			SetReturnType(returnType);
			SetParameters(parameters);
			_CallingConvention = callingConvention;
		}

		private void SetReturnType(TypeReferenceExpression returnType)
		{
			if (_ReturnType != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_ReturnType);
			}
			_ReturnType = returnType;
			if (_ReturnType != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_ReturnType);
			}
			if (_ReturnType != null)
			{
				Name = _ReturnType.Name;
			}
		}

		private void SetParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (_Parameters != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_Parameters);
			}
			_Parameters = parameters;
			if (_Parameters != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_Parameters);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is FunctionPointerTypeReference))
			{
				return;
			}
			FunctionPointerTypeReference functionPointerTypeReference = (FunctionPointerTypeReference)source;
			if (functionPointerTypeReference._ReturnType != null)
			{
				_ReturnType = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, functionPointerTypeReference, functionPointerTypeReference._ReturnType) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_ReturnType == null)
				{
					_ReturnType = functionPointerTypeReference._ReturnType.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
			if (functionPointerTypeReference._Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, functionPointerTypeReference.DetailNodes, _Parameters, functionPointerTypeReference._Parameters);
				if (_Parameters.Count == 0 && functionPointerTypeReference._Parameters.Count > 0)
				{
					_Parameters = functionPointerTypeReference._Parameters.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
			_CallingConvention = functionPointerTypeReference.CallingConvention;
			_AccessSpecifiers = functionPointerTypeReference._AccessSpecifiers.Clone();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Parameters != null && _Parameters.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_Parameters.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else if (newElement is TypeReferenceExpression && oldElement is TypeReferenceExpression && _ReturnType == (TypeReferenceExpression)oldElement)
			{
				_ReturnType = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			FunctionPointerTypeReference functionPointerTypeReference = new FunctionPointerTypeReference();
			functionPointerTypeReference.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return functionPointerTypeReference;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (ReturnType != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0} ( * )( ", ReturnType.ToString());
			}
			if (Parameters != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Parameters.ToString());
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(")");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void AddParameter(Param parameter)
		{
			Parameters.Add(parameter);
			AddDetailNode(parameter);
		}

		public void AddParameters(IEnumerable<Param> parameters)
		{
			foreach (Param parameter in parameters)
			{
				AddParameter(parameter);
			}
		}
	}
