	public class IndexerExpression : Expression, IHasQualifier, IHasSource, IIndexerExpression, IExpression, IElement, IWithSource, IWithArguments
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Source;

		private ExpressionCollection _Arguments;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override bool NeedsInvertParens => false;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.IndexerExpression;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Source != null)
				{
					return _Source.InternalRange;
				}
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
		}

		public Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Source;
			}
			set
			{
				SetSource(value);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use Qualifier instead")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Expression Source
		{
			get
			{
				return Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Qualifier != value)
				{
					Qualifier = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
			set
			{
				SetArguments(value);
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IIndexerExpression.Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
		}

		IExpression IWithSource.Source => Qualifier;

		IExpressionCollection IWithArguments.Args => Arguments;

		private IndexerExpression()
		{
		}

		public IndexerExpression(Expression source)
		{
			SetSource(source);
		}

		private bool ComareIndexerArguments(IndexerExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Arguments == null && expression.Arguments == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Arguments == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Arguments.IsIdenticalTo(expression.Arguments);
		}

		private void SetArguments(ExpressionCollection args)
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(args);
			}
			_Arguments = args;
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(args);
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetSource(Expression source)
		{
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				RemoveNode(_Source);
			}
			InternalName = string.Empty;
			_Source = source;
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				InternalName = _Source.ToString();
				AddNode(_Source);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is IndexerExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			IndexerExpression indexerExpression = (IndexerExpression)source;
			if (indexerExpression._Source != null)
			{
				_Source = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, indexerExpression, indexerExpression._Source) as Expression;
				if (_Source == null)
				{
					_Source = indexerExpression._Source.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (indexerExpression._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, indexerExpression.DetailNodes, _Arguments, indexerExpression._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && indexerExpression._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = indexerExpression._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				text += _Source.ToString();
			}
			text += "[";
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				text += _Arguments.ToString();
			}
			return text + "]";
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 101;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is IndexerExpression)
			{
				IndexerExpression indexerExpression = (IndexerExpression)expression;
				if (Qualifier == null)
				{
					return ComareIndexerArguments(indexerExpression);
				}
				if (Qualifier.IsIdenticalTo(indexerExpression.Qualifier))
				{
					return ComareIndexerArguments(indexerExpression);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Source = null;
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.Clear();
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Source == oldElement)
			{
				_Source = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			IndexerExpression indexerExpression = new IndexerExpression();
			indexerExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return indexerExpression;
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			if (arg != null)
			{
				Arguments.Add(arg);
				AddDetailNode(arg);
			}
		}

		public void AddArguments(IEnumerable<Expression> arguments)
		{
			if (arguments == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Expression argument in arguments)
			{
				AddArgument(argument);
			}
		}
	}

	public class LogicalInversion : UnaryOperatorExpression, ILogicalInversionExpression, IUnaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement

		{
		}

		public LogicalInversion(Token token, Expression expression)
			: this(token, expression, isPost: false)

		}

		public LogicalInversion(Token token, Expression expression, bool isPost)
			: base(token, expression, isPost)
		{
		}

		public LogicalInversion(Expression expression)
			: this(expression, isPost: false)
		{
		}

		public LogicalInversion(Expression expression, bool isPost)
			: base(expression, isPost)
		{
		}

		protected override object EvaluateExpression()
		{
			if (base.Expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return !base.Expression.EvaluateAsBool();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 126;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.Expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is LogicalInversion)
			{
				LogicalInversion logicalInversion = expression as LogicalInversion;
				if (base.Expression.IsIdenticalTo(logicalInversion.Expression))
				{
					return base.IsPostOperator == logicalInversion.IsPostOperator;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{

		}

			logicalInversion.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return logicalInversion;
		}
	}
	public enum LogicalOperator : byte
	{
		None,
		And,
		Or,
		ShortCircuitAnd,
		ShortCircuitOr,
		ExclusiveOr
	}
	public class LogicalOperation : BinaryOperatorExpression, ILogicalOperationExpression, IBinaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 5;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 5;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.LogicalOperation;

		public LogicalOperator LogicalOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return GetLogicalOperatorType(base.BinaryOperator);
			}
			set
			{
				SetLogicalOperator(value);
			}
		}

		LogicalOperator ILogicalOperationExpression.LogicalOperator => LogicalOperator;

		protected LogicalOperation()
		{
		}

		public LogicalOperation(Expression left, Token token, Expression right)
			: base(left, token, right)
		{
		}

		public LogicalOperation(Expression left, Token token, Expression right, LogicalOperator op, SourceRange range)
			: this(left, token, right)
		{
			SetLogicalOperator(op);
			SetRange(range);
		}

		public LogicalOperation(Expression left, LogicalOperator op, Expression right)
		{
			SetLeftSide(left);
			SetLogicalOperator(op);
			SetRightSide(right);
		}

		protected override object EvaluateExpression()
		{
			if (base.LeftSide == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.RightSide == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = base.LeftSide.EvaluateAsBool();
			bool flag2 = base.RightSide.EvaluateAsBool();
			return LogicalOperator switch
			{
				LogicalOperator.And => flag && flag2, 
				LogicalOperator.Or => flag || flag2, 
				LogicalOperator.ExclusiveOr => flag ^ flag2, 
				LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitAnd => flag && flag2, 
				LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitOr => flag || flag2, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected virtual void SetLogicalOperator(LogicalOperator op)
		{
			base.BinaryOperator = GetBinaryOperatorType(op);
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 125;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is LogicalOperation)
			{
				LogicalOperation logicalOperation = expression as LogicalOperation;
				if (base.LeftSide == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.RightSide == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.LeftSide.IsIdenticalTo(logicalOperation.LeftSide) && LogicalOperator == logicalOperation.LogicalOperator)
				{
					return base.RightSide.IsIdenticalTo(logicalOperation.RightSide);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		private bool HasCondition(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.If && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.For && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ElseIf && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.While && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Do)
			{
				return element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Switch;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			int num = 0;
			LanguageElement parent = GetParent(LanguageElementType.Method, LanguageElementType.Property, LanguageElementType.Event);
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetParentStatementOrVariable();
			if (HasCondition(languageElement))
			{
				languageElement = null;
			}
			if (parent != null && languageElement == null)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			return num + GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			LogicalOperation logicalOperation = new LogicalOperation();
			logicalOperation.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return logicalOperation;
		}

		public static BinaryOperatorType GetBinaryOperatorType(LogicalOperator op)
		{
			return op switch
			{
				LogicalOperator.And => BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseAnd, 
				LogicalOperator.ExclusiveOr => BinaryOperatorType.ExclusiveOr, 
				LogicalOperator.Or => BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseOr, 
				LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitAnd => BinaryOperatorType.BooleanAnd, 
				LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitOr => BinaryOperatorType.BooleanOr, 
				_ => BinaryOperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		public static LogicalOperator GetLogicalOperatorType(BinaryOperatorType op)
		{
			return op switch
			{
				BinaryOperatorType.BooleanAnd => LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitAnd, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ExclusiveOr => LogicalOperator.ExclusiveOr, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BooleanOr => LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitOr, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseAnd => LogicalOperator.And, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseOr => LogicalOperator.Or, 
				_ => LogicalOperator.None, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class MethodCallExpression : Expression, IHasQualifier, IHasSource, IMethodCallExpression, IExpression, IElement, IGenericExpression, IWithSource, IWithArguments, IHasParens, IHasArguments, IWithArgumentsModifier
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Source;

		private ExpressionCollection _Arguments;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		private TextRangeWrapper _ParensRange;

		private bool _IsBaseConstructorCall;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		[Description("Returns true if this method is call to base construtor.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool IsBaseConstructorCall
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsBaseConstructorCall;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsBaseConstructorCall = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool NeedsInvertParens => false;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression;

		public Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Source;
			}
			set
			{
				SetSource(value);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use Qualifier instead")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Expression Source
		{
			get
			{
				return Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Qualifier != value)
				{
					Qualifier = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
			set
			{
				SetArguments(value);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanBeStatement => true;

		public override SourceRange NameRange => GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);

		public bool IsGeneric
		{
			get
			{
				if (Qualifier is ReferenceExpressionBase)
				{
					return ((ReferenceExpressionBase)Qualifier).IsGeneric;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TypeReferenceExpressionCollection TypeArguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (Qualifier is ReferenceExpressionBase)
				{
					return ((ReferenceExpressionBase)Qualifier).TypeArguments;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IMethodCallExpression.Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return Arguments;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IWithArguments.Args
		{
			get
			{
				if (Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return Arguments;
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection IGenericExpression.TypeArguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (TypeArguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyITypeReferenceExpressionCollection;
				}
				return TypeArguments;
			}
		}

		int IGenericExpression.TypeArity => 0;

		IExpression IWithSource.Source => Qualifier;

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParensRange == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return _ParensRange;
			}
		}

		ExpressionCollection IHasArguments.Arguments => Arguments;

		public int ArgumentsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Arguments.Count;
			}
		}

		protected MethodCallExpression()
		{
		}

		public MethodCallExpression(Expression source)
		{
			SetSource(source);
			string text = null;
			if (source != null && !(source is MethodCallExpression))
			{
				text = source.Name;
				_NameRange = source.NameRange;
			}
			else
			{
				_NameRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				InternalName = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(text);
			}
			else
			{
				InternalName = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private bool ComareArguments(MethodCallExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Arguments == null && expression.Arguments == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Arguments == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Arguments.IsIdenticalTo(expression.Arguments);
		}

		private void SetSource(Expression source)
		{
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				RemoveNode(_Source);
			}
			_Source = source;
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				AddNode(_Source);
			}
		}

		private void SetArguments(ExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_Arguments);
			}
			_Arguments = arguments;
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_Arguments);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Source == oldElement)
			{
				_Source = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is MethodCallExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)source;
			_NameRange = methodCallExpression.NameRange;
			_IsBaseConstructorCall = methodCallExpression.IsBaseConstructorCall;
			if (methodCallExpression._Source != null)
			{
				_Source = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, methodCallExpression, methodCallExpression._Source) as Expression;
				if (_Source == null)
				{
					_Source = methodCallExpression._Source.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (methodCallExpression._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, methodCallExpression.DetailNodes, _Arguments, methodCallExpression._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && methodCallExpression._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = methodCallExpression._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (methodCallExpression._ParensRange != null)
			{
				_ParensRange = methodCallExpression.ParensRange;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				text += _Source.ToString();
			}
			text += "(";
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				text += _Arguments.ToString();
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 93;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is MethodCallExpression)
			{
				MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = (MethodCallExpression)expression;
				if (Qualifier == null)
				{
					return ComareArguments(methodCallExpression);
				}
				if (Qualifier.IsIdenticalTo(methodCallExpression.Qualifier))
				{
					return ComareArguments(methodCallExpression);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_Source = null;
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.Clear();
				_Arguments = null;
			}
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _Arguments.Count; i++)
				{
					_Arguments[i].CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				}
				_Arguments.Clear();
				_Arguments = null;
			}
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				_Source.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_Source = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = new MethodCallExpression();
			methodCallExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return methodCallExpression;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(Token parenOpen, Token parenClose)
		{
			SetParensRange(new SourceRange(parenOpen.Range.Start, parenClose.Range.End));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			if (range.IsEmpty)
			{
				_ParensRange = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_ParensRange = range;
			}
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Add(arg);
			AddDetailNode(arg);
		}

		public void AddArguments(IEnumerable<Expression> arguments)
		{
			foreach (Expression argument in arguments)
			{
				AddArgument(argument);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Remove(arg);
			RemoveDetailNode(arg);
		}

		public void InsertArgument(int index, Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Insert(index, arg);
			InsertDetailNode(index, arg);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.AddArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			AddArgument(argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.InsertArgument(int index, IExpression argument)
		{
			InsertArgument(index, argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.RemoveArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			RemoveArgument(argument as Expression);
		}
	}
	public class MethodReferenceExpression : ReferenceExpressionBase, IMethodReferenceExpression, IReferenceExpression, IExpression, IElement, IGenericExpression, IWithSource
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Source;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.MethodReferenceExpression;

		public override Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Source;
			}
			set
			{
				SetSource(value);
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange => GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);

		protected MethodReferenceExpression()
		{
		}

		public MethodReferenceExpression(string name)
			: this(name, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public MethodReferenceExpression(string name, SourceRange namerange)
		{
			InternalName = name;
			_NameRange = namerange;
		}

		public MethodReferenceExpression(Expression source, string name)
			: this(source, name, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public MethodReferenceExpression(Expression source, string name, SourceRange namerange)
			: this(name, namerange)
		{
			SetSource(source);
		}

		private void SetSource(Expression source)
		{
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				RemoveNode(_Source);
			}
			_Source = source;
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				AddNode(_Source);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Source == oldElement)
			{
				_Source = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is MethodReferenceExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			MethodReferenceExpression methodReferenceExpression = (MethodReferenceExpression)source;
			_NameRange = methodReferenceExpression.NameRange;
			if (methodReferenceExpression._Source != null)
			{
				_Source = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, methodReferenceExpression, methodReferenceExpression._Source) as Expression;
				if (_Source == null)
				{
					_Source = methodReferenceExpression._Source.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 95;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.IsIdenticalTo(expression))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is MethodReferenceExpression)
			{
				MethodReferenceExpression methodReferenceExpression = (MethodReferenceExpression)expression;
				if (Qualifier == null)
				{
					return Name == methodReferenceExpression.Name;
				}
				if (Qualifier.IsIdenticalTo(methodReferenceExpression.Qualifier))
				{
					return Name == methodReferenceExpression.Name;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Source = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			MethodReferenceExpression methodReferenceExpression = new MethodReferenceExpression();
			methodReferenceExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return methodReferenceExpression;
		}
	}

		}

			: base(left, right)

		{

			if (base.RightSide != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(base.RightSide.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

			nullCoalescingExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return nullCoalescingExpression;
		}

		{

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParensRange == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return _ParensRange;
			}
		}

		public int ArgumentsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Arguments.Count;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IWithArguments.Args => _Arguments;

		protected ObjectCreationExpression()
		{
		}

		public ObjectCreationExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			SetObjectType(type);
			if (type != null)
			{
				InternalName = type.Name;
			}
		}

		public ObjectCreationExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, ExpressionCollection arguments)
			: this(type)
		{
			SetArguments(arguments);
		}

		private void SetObjectType(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (_ObjectType != null)
			{
				RemoveNode(_ObjectType);
			}
			_ObjectType = type;
			if (_ObjectType != null)
			{
				AddNode(_ObjectType);
			}
		}

		private void SetObjectInitializer(ObjectInitializerExpression initializer)
		{
			if (_ObjectInitializer != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_ObjectInitializer);
			}
			_ObjectInitializer = initializer;
			if (_ObjectInitializer != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_ObjectInitializer);
			}
		}

		private void SetArguments(ExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_Arguments);
			}
			_Arguments = arguments;
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_Arguments);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = "new ";
			if (_ObjectType != null)
			{
				text += _ObjectType.ToString();
			}
			text += "(";
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				text += _Arguments.ToString();
			}
			return text + ")";
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 91;
		}

		private bool ComareArguments(ObjectCreationExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Arguments == null && expression.Arguments == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Arguments == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Arguments.IsIdenticalTo(expression.Arguments);
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ObjectCreationExpression)
			{
				ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = expression as ObjectCreationExpression;
				if (ObjectType == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ObjectType.IsIdenticalTo(objectCreationExpression.ObjectType))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ComareArguments(objectCreationExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ObjectInitializer == null && objectCreationExpression.ObjectInitializer == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ObjectInitializer.IsIdenticalTo(objectCreationExpression.ObjectInitializer);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(Token parenOpen, Token parenClose)
		{
			SetParensRange(new SourceRange(parenOpen.Range.Start, parenClose.Range.End));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			if (range.IsEmpty)
			{
				_ParensRange = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_ParensRange = range;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_ObjectType = null;
			_ObjectInitializer = null;
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.Clear();
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_ObjectType == oldElement)
			{
				_ObjectType = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else if (_ObjectInitializer == oldElement)
			{
				_ObjectInitializer = newElement as ObjectInitializerExpression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ObjectCreationExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = (ObjectCreationExpression)source;
			_HasNOGCModifier = objectCreationExpression._HasNOGCModifier;
			if (objectCreationExpression._ParensRange != null)
			{
				_ParensRange = objectCreationExpression.ParensRange;
			}
			if (objectCreationExpression._ObjectType != null)
			{
				_ObjectType = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, objectCreationExpression, objectCreationExpression._ObjectType) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_ObjectType == null)
				{
					_ObjectType = objectCreationExpression._ObjectType.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
			if (objectCreationExpression._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, objectCreationExpression.DetailNodes, _Arguments, objectCreationExpression._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && objectCreationExpression._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = objectCreationExpression._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (objectCreationExpression._ObjectInitializer != null)
			{
				_ObjectInitializer = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, objectCreationExpression, objectCreationExpression._ObjectInitializer) as ObjectInitializerExpression;
				if (_ObjectInitializer == null)
				{
					_ObjectInitializer = objectCreationExpression._ObjectInitializer.Clone(options) as ObjectInitializerExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ObjectCreationExpression objectCreationExpression = new ObjectCreationExpression();
			objectCreationExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return objectCreationExpression;
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			if (arg != null)
			{
				Arguments.Add(arg);
				AddDetailNode(arg);
			}
		}

		public void AddArguments(IEnumerable<Expression> arguments)
		{
			if (arguments == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Expression argument in arguments)
			{
				AddArgument(argument);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			if (arg != null)
			{
				Arguments.Remove(arg);
				RemoveDetailNode(arg);
			}
		}

		public void InsertArgument(int index, Expression arg)
		{
			if (arg != null)
			{
				Arguments.Insert(index, arg);
				InsertDetailNode(index, arg);
			}
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.AddArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			AddArgument(argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.InsertArgument(int index, IExpression argument)
		{
			InsertArgument(index, argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.RemoveArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			RemoveArgument(argument as Expression);
		}
	}

		{
			if (_NewOperatorArguments != null)

				RemoveDetailNodes(_NewOperatorArguments);
			}
			_NewOperatorArguments = newArguments;
			if (_NewOperatorArguments != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_NewOperatorArguments);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;

			if (!(source is ParametrizedObjectCreationExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ParametrizedObjectCreationExpression parametrizedObjectCreationExpression = (ParametrizedObjectCreationExpression)source;
			if (parametrizedObjectCreationExpression._NewOperatorArguments != null)
			{
				_NewOperatorArguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, parametrizedObjectCreationExpression.DetailNodes, _NewOperatorArguments, parametrizedObjectCreationExpression._NewOperatorArguments);
				if (_NewOperatorArguments.Count == 0 && parametrizedObjectCreationExpression._NewOperatorArguments.Count > 0)

			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		}

			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ParenthesizedExpression)
			{
				ParenthesizedExpression parenthesizedExpression = expression as ParenthesizedExpression;
				return Expression.IsIdenticalTo(parenthesizedExpression.Expression);
			}
			return false;

			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()

			_Exp = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{

			parenthesizedExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);

	public class PrimitiveExpression : Expression, IPrimitiveExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private string _Literal;

		private bool _IsVerbatimStringLiteral;

		private PrimitiveType _PrimitiveType;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.PrimitiveExpression;

		public override bool NeedsInvertParens => false;

		public bool IsNumberLiteral
		{
			get
			{
				if (PrimitiveValue != null)
				{
					if (!(PrimitiveValue is sbyte) && !(PrimitiveValue is byte) && !(PrimitiveValue is ushort) && !(PrimitiveValue is short) && !(PrimitiveValue is uint) && !(PrimitiveValue is int) && !(PrimitiveValue is ulong) && !(PrimitiveValue is long) && !(PrimitiveValue is float) && !(PrimitiveValue is double))
					{
						return PrimitiveValue is decimal;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.SByte && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.Byte && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.UInt16 && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.Int16 && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.UInt32 && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.Int32 && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.UInt64 && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.Int64 && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.Single && PrimitiveType != PrimitiveType.Double)
				{
					return PrimitiveType == PrimitiveType.Decimal;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public string Literal
		{
			get
			{
				return _Literal;
			}
			set
			{
				_Literal = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool CanHasEscapeSequence => false;

		[Category("Expression Type")]
		[Description("Returns true if this primitive expression is boolean literal (true or false in C#).")]
		public bool IsBooleanLiteral => PrimitiveType == PrimitiveType.Boolean;

		[Category("Expression Type")]
		[Description("Returns true if this primitive expression is string literal.")]
		public bool IsStringLiteral => PrimitiveType == PrimitiveType.String;

		[Category("Expression Type")]
		[Description("Returns true if this primitive expression is char literal.")]
		public bool IsCharLiteral => PrimitiveType == PrimitiveType.Char;

		[Category("Expression Type")]
		[Description("Returns true if this primitive expression is DateTime literal.")]
		public bool IsDateTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (PrimitiveValue != null)
				{
					return PrimitiveValue is DateTime;
				}
				return PrimitiveType == PrimitiveType.DateTime;
			}
		}

		[Category("Expression Type")]
		[Description("Returns true if this primitive expression is null literal.")]
		public bool IsNullLiteral => PrimitiveType == PrimitiveType.Void;

		[Category("Expression Type")]
		[Description("Gets or sets primitive type of this expression.")]
		public PrimitiveType PrimitiveType
		{
			get
			{
				return _PrimitiveType;
			}
			set
			{
				_PrimitiveType = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets primitive value of this expression.")]
		public object PrimitiveValue
		{
			get
			{
				return base.TestValue;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTestValue(value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Expression Type")]
		[Description("Gets expression type name.")]
		public override string ExpressionTypeName => PrimitiveTypeUtils.GetFullTypeName(PrimitiveType);

		public override SourceRange NameRange => base.InternalRange;

		public bool IsVerbatimStringLiteral
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsVerbatimStringLiteral;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsVerbatimStringLiteral = value;
			}
		}

		object IPrimitiveExpression.Value => base.TestValue;

		PrimitiveType IPrimitiveExpression.PrimitiveType => PrimitiveType;

		bool IPrimitiveExpression.IsVerbatimString => IsVerbatimStringLiteral;

		protected PrimitiveExpression()
		{
		}

		public PrimitiveExpression(string value)
		{
			InternalName = value;
		}

		public PrimitiveExpression(string value, SourceRange range)
			: this(value)
		{
			SetRange(range);
		}

		private void InitializeValue(object value)
		{
			PrimitiveValue = value;
			PrimitiveType = PrimitiveTypeUtils.GetPrimitiveType(value);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is PrimitiveExpression)
				{
					PrimitiveExpression primitiveExpression = (PrimitiveExpression)source;
					_PrimitiveType = primitiveExpression._PrimitiveType;
					_Literal = primitiveExpression.Literal;
					_IsVerbatimStringLiteral = primitiveExpression._IsVerbatimStringLiteral;
				}
			}
		}

		public static PrimitiveExpression FromObject(object value)
		{
			string value2 = string.Empty;
			if (value != null)
			{
				value2 = value.ToString();
			}
			PrimitiveExpression primitiveExpression = new PrimitiveExpression(value2);
			primitiveExpression.InitializeValue(value);
			return primitiveExpression;
		}

		{
			return InternalName;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 97;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{

				return false;
			}
			if (expression is PrimitiveExpression)

				return primitiveExpression.Name == Name;

		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);

			primitiveExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);

		}

			return base.TestValue;
		}

				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is QualifiedAliasExpression)
				{
					QualifiedAliasExpression qualifiedAliasExpression = (QualifiedAliasExpression)source;
					_IsGlobal = qualifiedAliasExpression._IsGlobal;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			QualifiedAliasExpression qualifiedAliasExpression = new QualifiedAliasExpression();
			qualifiedAliasExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return qualifiedAliasExpression;
		}
	}
	public class QualifiedElementReference : ElementReferenceExpression, IQualifiedElementReferenceExpression, IElementReferenceExpression, IReferenceExpression, IExpression, IElement, IGenericExpression, IWithSource
	{
		private Expression _Source;

		public override Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Source;
			}
			set
			{
				SetSource(value);
			}
		}

		public override bool HasCleanReferences
		{
			get
			{
				if (Qualifier == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!(Qualifier is ElementReferenceExpression elementReferenceExpression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return elementReferenceExpression.HasCleanReferences;
			}
		}

		internal QualifiedElementReference()
		{
		}

		public QualifiedElementReference(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
		}

		public QualifiedElementReference(string name, SourceRange namerange)
			: this(name)
		{
			NameRange = namerange;
		}

		public QualifiedElementReference(Expression source, string name, SourceRange namerange)
			: this(name, namerange)
		{
			SetSource(source);
		}

		private void SetSource(Expression source)
		{
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				RemoveNode(_Source);
			}
			_Source = source;
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				AddNode(_Source);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Source = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Source == oldElement)
			{
				_Source = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is QualifiedElementReference))
			{
				return;
			}
			QualifiedElementReference qualifiedElementReference = (QualifiedElementReference)source;
			if (qualifiedElementReference.Qualifier != null)
			{
				_Source = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, qualifiedElementReference, qualifiedElementReference.Qualifier) as Expression;
				if (_Source == null)
				{
					_Source = qualifiedElementReference.Qualifier.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			QualifiedElementReference qualifiedElementReference = new QualifiedElementReference();
			qualifiedElementReference.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return qualifiedElementReference;
		}
	}
	public class QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression : TypeReferenceExpression
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression;

		public QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression(string type)
			: base(type)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Qualifier != null)
			{
				if (Qualifier is QualifiedAliasExpression)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}", Qualifier.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}::", Qualifier.ToString());
				}
				if (Name != null && Name.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Name);
				}
			}
			else if (Name != null && Name.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(Name);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression qualifiedTypeReferenceExpression = new QualifiedTypeReferenceExpression(Name);
			qualifiedTypeReferenceExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return qualifiedTypeReferenceExpression;
		}
	}
	public class RazorInlineHtmlExpression : Expression
	{

		public HtmlElement HtmlElement

			get
			{
				return _HtmlElement;
			}
			set

		public RazorInlineHtmlExpression(HtmlElement htmlElement)
		{
			SetHtmlElement(htmlElement);
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public void SetHtmlElement(HtmlElement htmlElement)
		{
			if (_HtmlElement != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_HtmlElement);
			}
			_HtmlElement = htmlElement;

	public class ReDimExpression : Expression, IReDimExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _Modifiers;

		private SourceRange _NameRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private Expression _Expression;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ReDimExpression;

		public LanguageElementCollection Modifiers => _Modifiers;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		IExpression IReDimExpression.Expression => _Expression;

		ICollection IReDimExpression.Modifiers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Modifiers == null)
				{
					_Modifiers = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _Modifiers;
			}
		}

		private void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ReDimExpression reDimExpression = new ReDimExpression();
			reDimExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return reDimExpression;
		}

		public void AddModifiers(IEnumerable<LanguageElement> modifiers)
		{
			if (modifiers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ArrayNameModifier modifier in modifiers)
			{
				AddModifier(modifier);
			}
		}

		public void AddModifiers(IEnumerable<ArrayNameModifier> modifiers)
		{
			if (modifiers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ArrayNameModifier modifier in modifiers)
			{
				AddModifier(modifier);
			}
		}

		public void AddModifier(ArrayNameModifier modifier)
		{
			if (modifier != null)
			{
				if (_Modifiers == null)
				{
					_Modifiers = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				_Modifiers.Add(modifier);
				AddDetailNode(modifier);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Modifiers != null && _Modifiers.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Modifiers.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ReDimExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ReDimExpression reDimExpression = (ReDimExpression)source;
			_NameRange = reDimExpression.NameRange;
			if (reDimExpression._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, reDimExpression, reDimExpression._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = reDimExpression._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (reDimExpression._Expression != null)
			{
				_Modifiers = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, reDimExpression.DetailNodes, _Modifiers, reDimExpression._Modifiers);
				if (_Modifiers.Count == 0 && reDimExpression._Modifiers.Count > 0)
				{
					_Modifiers = reDimExpression._Modifiers.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ReferenceExpressionBase : Expression, IHasQualifier, IHasSource, IReferenceExpression, IExpression, IElement, IGenericExpression, IWithSource
	{
		private TypeReferenceExpressionCollection _TypeArguments;

		private Expression _NameQualifier;

		private bool _IsMulOperator;

		public abstract Expression Qualifier { get; set; }

		[Obsolete("Use Qualifier instead")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Expression Source
		{
			get
			{
				return Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				Qualifier = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsGeneric
		{
			get
			{
				if (_TypeArguments != null)
				{
					return _TypeArguments.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual TypeReferenceExpressionCollection TypeArguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_TypeArguments == null)
				{
					_TypeArguments = new TypeReferenceExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _TypeArguments;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTypeArguments(value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsTypeArgument
		{
			get
			{
				ReferenceExpressionBase parentGenericReference = ParentGenericReference;
				if (parentGenericReference == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (parentGenericReference.TypeArguments != null)
				{
					return parentGenericReference.TypeArguments.Contains(this);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public ReferenceExpressionBase ParentGenericReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.Parent is ReferenceExpressionBase))
				{
					return null;
				}
				ReferenceExpressionBase referenceExpressionBase = (ReferenceExpressionBase)base.Parent;
				if (!referenceExpressionBase.IsGeneric)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return referenceExpressionBase;
			}
		}

		public virtual int TypeArity
		{
			get
			{
				return 0;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public Expression NameQualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _NameQualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				_NameQualifier = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsMulOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsMulOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsMulOperator = value;
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection IGenericExpression.TypeArguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_TypeArguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyITypeReferenceExpressionCollection;
				}
				return _TypeArguments;
			}
		}

		IExpression IWithSource.Source => Qualifier;

		IExpression IReferenceExpression.NameQualifier => _NameQualifier;

		public string FullSignature
		{
			get
			{
				string signaturePart = GetSignaturePart();
				if (Qualifier == null)
				{
					return signaturePart;
				}
				string text = string.Empty;
				if (Qualifier != null)
				{
					if (Qualifier is IReferenceExpression)
					{
						text = ((IReferenceExpression)Qualifier).FullSignature;
					}
					if (Qualifier is IBaseReferenceExpression || Qualifier is IThisReferenceExpression)
					{
						text = Qualifier.Name;
					}
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return signaturePart;
				}
				return $"{text}.{signaturePart}";
			}
		}

		public ReferenceExpressionBase()
		{
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ReferenceExpressionBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			ReferenceExpressionBase referenceExpressionBase = (ReferenceExpressionBase)source;
			_TypeArguments = new TypeReferenceExpressionCollection();
			_IsMulOperator = referenceExpressionBase._IsMulOperator;
			if (referenceExpressionBase._NameQualifier != null)
			{
				_NameQualifier = referenceExpressionBase._NameQualifier.Clone() as Expression;
			}
			if (referenceExpressionBase._TypeArguments != null)
			{
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, referenceExpressionBase.DetailNodes, _TypeArguments, referenceExpressionBase._TypeArguments);
				if (_TypeArguments.Count == 0 && referenceExpressionBase._TypeArguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_TypeArguments = referenceExpressionBase._TypeArguments.DeepClone(options) as TypeReferenceExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (TypeArguments.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				TypeArguments.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void SetTypeArguments(TypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeArguments)
		{
			if (_TypeArguments != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_TypeArguments);
			}
			_TypeArguments = typeArguments;
			if (_TypeArguments != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_TypeArguments);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_TypeArguments != null)
			{
				_TypeArguments.Clear();
				_TypeArguments = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Qualifier != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Qualifier.ToString());
				if (InternalName != null && InternalName.Length > 0)
				{
					if (Qualifier is MemberAccessExpression)
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}", InternalName);
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat(".{0}", InternalName);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (InternalName != null && InternalName.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(InternalName);
			}
			if (IsGeneric)
			{
				int count = TypeArguments.Count;
				stringBuilder.Append("<");
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(TypeArguments[i].ToString());
					if (i < count - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(">");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void GetDataFrom(BaseElement source)
		{
			CloneDataFrom(source, ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		public QualifiedElementReference CreateQualifiedElementReference()
		{
			QualifiedElementReference qualifiedElementReference = new QualifiedElementReference();
			qualifiedElementReference.GetDataFrom(this);
			return qualifiedElementReference;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ReferenceExpressionBase referenceExpressionBase)
			{
				TypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeArguments = TypeArguments;
				if (typeArguments == null || typeArguments.Count == 0)
				{
					if (referenceExpressionBase.TypeArguments != null)
					{
						return referenceExpressionBase.TypeArguments.Count == 0;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return typeArguments.IsIdenticalTo(referenceExpressionBase.TypeArguments);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void AddTypeArgument(TypeReferenceExpression typeArgument)
		{
			if (typeArgument != null)
			{
				TypeArguments.Add(typeArgument);
				AddDetailNode(typeArgument);
			}
		}

		public void AddTypeArguments(IEnumerable<TypeReferenceExpression> typeArguments)
		{
			if (typeArguments == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (TypeReferenceExpression typeArgument in typeArguments)
			{
				AddTypeArgument(typeArgument);
			}
		}
	}
	public enum RelationalOperator : byte
	{
		None,
		Equality,
		Inequality,
		LessThan,
		GreaterThan,
		LessOrEqual,
		GreaterOrEqual,
		Like,
		StrictEquality,
		StrictInequality
	}
	public class RelationalOperation : BinaryOperatorExpression, IRelationalOperationExpression, IBinaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 5;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity
		{
			get
			{
				if (RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.Inequality || RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.StrictInequality)
				{
					return 6;
				}
				return 5;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.RelationalOperation;

		public RelationalOperator RelationalOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return GetRelationalOperatorType(base.BinaryOperator);
			}
			set
			{
				SetRelationalOperator(value);
			}
		}

		RelationalOperator IRelationalOperationExpression.RelationalOperator => RelationalOperator;

		protected RelationalOperation()
		{
		}

		public RelationalOperation(Expression left, Token token, Expression right)
			: base(left, token, right)
		{
			SetRelationalOperator(RelationalOperator.None);
		}

		public RelationalOperation(Expression left, Token token, Expression right, RelationalOperator relationalOperator, SourceRange range)
			: base(left, token, right)
		{
			SetRange(range);
			SetRelationalOperator(relationalOperator);
		}

		public RelationalOperation(Expression left, RelationalOperator op, Expression right)
		{
			SetLeftSide(left);
			SetRelationalOperator(op);
			SetRightSide(right);
		}

		private bool CheckSymetric(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (base.LeftSide.IsIdenticalTo(op.LeftSide))
			{
				return base.RightSide.IsIdenticalTo(op.RightSide);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckAsymetric(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (base.LeftSide.IsIdenticalTo(op.RightSide))
			{
				return base.RightSide.IsIdenticalTo(op.LeftSide);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckEquality(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (op.RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.Equality)
			{
				if (!CheckSymetric(op))
				{
					return CheckAsymetric(op);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckInequality(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (op.RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.Inequality)
			{
				if (!CheckSymetric(op))
				{
					return CheckAsymetric(op);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckLessThan(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (op.RelationalOperator != RelationalOperator.LessThan || !CheckSymetric(op))
			{
				if (op.RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.GreaterThan)
				{
					return CheckAsymetric(op);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckGreaterThan(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (op.RelationalOperator != RelationalOperator.GreaterThan || !CheckSymetric(op))
			{
				if (op.RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.LessThan)
				{
					return CheckAsymetric(op);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckLessOrEqual(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (op.RelationalOperator != RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual || !CheckSymetric(op))
			{
				if (op.RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual)
				{
					return CheckAsymetric(op);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckGreaterOrEqual(RelationalOperation op)
		{
			if (op.RelationalOperator != RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual || !CheckSymetric(op))
			{
				if (op.RelationalOperator == RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual)
				{
					return CheckAsymetric(op);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void SetRelationalOperator(RelationalOperator op)
		{
			base.BinaryOperator = GetBinaryOperatorType(op);
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 128;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is RelationalOperation)
			{
				RelationalOperation op = expression as RelationalOperation;
				if (base.LeftSide == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.RightSide == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (RelationalOperator)
				{
				case RelationalOperator.Equality:
					return CheckEquality(op);
				case RelationalOperator.Inequality:
					return CheckInequality(op);
				case RelationalOperator.LessThan:
					return CheckLessThan(op);
				case RelationalOperator.GreaterThan:
					return CheckGreaterThan(op);
				case RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual:
					return CheckLessOrEqual(op);
				case RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual:
					return CheckGreaterOrEqual(op);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		public static RelationalOperator InvertRelationalOperator(RelationalOperator op)
		{
			return op switch
			{
				RelationalOperator.Inequality => RelationalOperator.Equality, 
				RelationalOperator.Equality => RelationalOperator.Inequality, 
				RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual => RelationalOperator.LessThan, 
				RelationalOperator.GreaterThan => RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual, 
				RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual => RelationalOperator.GreaterThan, 
				RelationalOperator.LessThan => RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual, 
				RelationalOperator.StrictEquality => RelationalOperator.StrictInequality, 
				RelationalOperator.StrictInequality => RelationalOperator.StrictEquality, 
				_ => RelationalOperator.None, 
			};
		}

		public static BinaryOperatorType GetBinaryOperatorType(RelationalOperator op)
		{
			return op switch
			{
				RelationalOperator.Equality => BinaryOperatorType.ValueEquality, 
				RelationalOperator.Inequality => BinaryOperatorType.IdentityInequality, 
				RelationalOperator.LessThan => BinaryOperatorType.LessThan, 
				RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual => BinaryOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual, 
				RelationalOperator.GreaterThan => BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThan, 
				RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual => BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual, 
				RelationalOperator.Like => BinaryOperatorType.Like, 
				RelationalOperator.StrictEquality => BinaryOperatorType.StrictEquality, 
				RelationalOperator.StrictInequality => BinaryOperatorType.StrictInequality, 
				_ => BinaryOperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		public static RelationalOperator GetRelationalOperatorType(BinaryOperatorType op)
		{
			return op switch
			{
				BinaryOperatorType.ValueEquality => RelationalOperator.Equality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.IdentityInequality => RelationalOperator.Inequality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.LessThan => RelationalOperator.LessThan, 
				BinaryOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual => RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual, 
				BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThan => RelationalOperator.GreaterThan, 
				BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual => RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Like => RelationalOperator.Like, 
				BinaryOperatorType.StrictEquality => RelationalOperator.StrictEquality, 
				BinaryOperatorType.StrictInequality => RelationalOperator.StrictInequality, 
				_ => RelationalOperator.None, 
			};
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			RelationalOperation relationalOperation = new RelationalOperation();
			relationalOperation.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return relationalOperation;
		}
	}
	public class ShortInitializeExpression : Expression, IHasArguments, IShortInitializeExpression, IExpression, IElement, IWithArguments, IHasParens, IWithArgumentsModifier
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private ExpressionCollection _Arguments;

		private TextRangeWrapper _ParensRange;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ShortInitializeExpression;

		public ExpressionCollection Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
			set
			{
				SetArguments(value);
			}
		}

		public override bool CanBeStatement => false;

		public bool IsGeneric => false;

		IExpressionCollection IShortInitializeExpression.Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParensRange == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParensRange);
			}
		}

		ExpressionCollection IHasArguments.Arguments => Arguments;

		public int ArgumentsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Arguments.Count;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IWithArguments.Args => Arguments;

		private void SetArguments(ExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNodes(_Arguments);
			}
			_Arguments = arguments;
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				AddDetailNodes(_Arguments);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ShortInitializeExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ShortInitializeExpression shortInitializeExpression = (ShortInitializeExpression)source;
			if (shortInitializeExpression._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, shortInitializeExpression.DetailNodes, _Arguments, shortInitializeExpression._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && shortInitializeExpression._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = shortInitializeExpression._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (shortInitializeExpression._ParensRange != null)
			{
				_ParensRange = shortInitializeExpression.ParensRange;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty += "(";
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				empty += _Arguments.ToString();
			}
			return empty + ")";
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 18;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.Clear();
				_Arguments = null;
			}
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _Arguments.Count; i++)
				{
					_Arguments[i].CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				}
				_Arguments.Clear();
				_Arguments = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ShortInitializeExpression shortInitializeExpression = new ShortInitializeExpression();
			shortInitializeExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return shortInitializeExpression;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(Token parenOpen, Token parenClose)
		{
			SetParensRange(new SourceRange(parenOpen.Range.Start, parenClose.Range.End));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_ParensRange = range;
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Add(arg);
			AddDetailNode(arg);
		}

		public void AddArguments(IEnumerable<Expression> arguments)
		{
			foreach (Expression argument in arguments)
			{
				AddArgument(argument);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Remove(arg);
			RemoveDetailNode(arg);
		}

		public void InsertArgument(int index, Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Insert(index, arg);
			InsertDetailNode(index, arg);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.AddArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			AddArgument(argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.InsertArgument(int index, IExpression argument)
		{
			InsertArgument(index, argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.RemoveArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			RemoveArgument(argument as Expression);
		}
	}
	public class SizeOfExpression : Expression, ISizeOfExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _TypeReference;

		private bool _IsParenthesizedExpression;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.SizeOfExpression;

		public bool IsParenthesizedExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsParenthesizedExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsParenthesizedExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression TypeReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _TypeReference;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTypeReference(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression ISizeOfExpression.TypeReference => TypeReference;

		protected SizeOfExpression()
		{
		}

		public SizeOfExpression(Expression type)
		{
			SetTypeReference(type);
		}

		public SizeOfExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			SetTypeReference(type);
		}

		private void SetTypeReference(Expression type)
		{
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_TypeReference);
			}
			_TypeReference = type;
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_TypeReference);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_TypeReference == oldElement)
			{
				_TypeReference = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is SizeOfExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			SizeOfExpression sizeOfExpression = (SizeOfExpression)source;
			_IsParenthesizedExpression = sizeOfExpression.IsParenthesizedExpression;
			if (sizeOfExpression._TypeReference != null)
			{
				_TypeReference = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, sizeOfExpression, sizeOfExpression._TypeReference) as Expression;
				if (_TypeReference == null)
				{
					_TypeReference = sizeOfExpression._TypeReference.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				return "sizeof(" + _TypeReference.ToString() + ")";
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is SizeOfExpression)
			{
				SizeOfExpression sizeOfExpression = (SizeOfExpression)expression;
				if (TypeReference == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return TypeReference.IsIdenticalTo(sizeOfExpression.TypeReference);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_TypeReference = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			SizeOfExpression sizeOfExpression = new SizeOfExpression();
			sizeOfExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return sizeOfExpression;
		}
	}

	public class TypeCastExpression : Expression, ITypeCastExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 4;

		private TypeReferenceExpression _TypeReference;

		private Expression _Target;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 4;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.TypeCastExpression;

		public TypeReferenceExpression TypeReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _TypeReference;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTypeReference(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression Target
		{
			get
			{
				return _Target;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTarget(value);
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpression ITypeCastExpression.TypeReference => TypeReference;

		IExpression ITypeCastExpression.Target => Target;

		public TypeCastExpression()
		{
		}

		public TypeCastExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, Expression target)
		{
			SetTypeReference(type);
			SetTarget(target);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				text = "(" + _TypeReference.ToString() + ")";
			}
			if (_Target != null)
			{
				text += _Target.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 89;
		}

		public void SetTypeReference(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_TypeReference);
			}
			_TypeReference = type;
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_TypeReference);
				SetStart(_TypeReference.Range);
			}
		}

		public void SetTarget(Expression target)
		{
			if (_Target != null)
			{
				RemoveNode(_Target);
			}
			_Target = target;
			if (_Target != null)
			{
				AddNode(_Target);
				SetEnd(_Target.Range);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is TypeCastExpression)
			{
				TypeCastExpression typeCastExpression = (TypeCastExpression)expression;
				if (TypeReference == null || !TypeReference.IsIdenticalTo(typeCastExpression.TypeReference))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Target == null || !Target.IsIdenticalTo(typeCastExpression.Target))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_TypeReference = null;
			_Target = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_TypeReference == oldElement)
			{
				_TypeReference = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Target == oldElement)
			{
				_Target = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is TypeCastExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			TypeCastExpression typeCastExpression = (TypeCastExpression)source;
			if (typeCastExpression.Target != null)
			{
				_Target = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeCastExpression, typeCastExpression.Target) as Expression;
				if (_Target == null)
				{
					_Target = typeCastExpression.Target.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (typeCastExpression.TypeReference != null)
			{
				_TypeReference = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeCastExpression, typeCastExpression.TypeReference) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_TypeReference == null)
				{
					_TypeReference = typeCastExpression.TypeReference.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TypeCastExpression typeCastExpression = new TypeCastExpression();
			typeCastExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return typeCastExpression;
		}
	}

			}
		}

		private void SetTypeReference(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_TypeReference);
			}
			_TypeReference = type;
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_TypeReference);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_TypeReference == oldElement)
			{
				_TypeReference = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Exp == oldElement)
			{
				_Exp = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is TypeOfIsExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			TypeOfIsExpression typeOfIsExpression = (TypeOfIsExpression)source;
			if (typeOfIsExpression._Exp != null)
			{
				_Exp = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeOfIsExpression, typeOfIsExpression._Exp) as Expression;
				if (_Exp == null)
				{
					_Exp = typeOfIsExpression._Exp.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (typeOfIsExpression._TypeReference != null)
			{
				_TypeReference = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeOfIsExpression, typeOfIsExpression._TypeReference) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_TypeReference == null)
				{
					_TypeReference = typeOfIsExpression._TypeReference.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_TypeReference != null)
			{
				return "typeof(" + _TypeReference.ToString() + ")";
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 108;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is TypeOfIsExpression)
			{
				TypeOfIsExpression typeOfIsExpression = (TypeOfIsExpression)expression;
				if (TypeReference == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!TypeReference.IsIdenticalTo(typeOfIsExpression.TypeReference))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Expression.IsIdenticalTo(typeOfIsExpression.Expression))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_TypeReference = null;
			_Exp = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TypeOfIsExpression typeOfIsExpression = new TypeOfIsExpression();
			typeOfIsExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return typeOfIsExpression;
		}
	}

	}

			_Type = TypeReferenceType.None;
			_IsNullable = isNullable;
