		{
			InternalName = name;
			_NameRange = nameRange;
			SetBaseType(type);
			_Type = TypeReferenceType.None;
		}

		public TypeReferenceExpression(string type, int typeArity, SourceRange range)
			: this(type)
		{
			SetRange(range);
			_TypeArity = typeArity;
		}

		protected void SetArrayBounds(ExpressionCollection bounds)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNodes(_ArrayBounds, bounds);
			_Type = TypeReferenceType.Array;
			_ArrayBounds = bounds;
		}

		protected void SetBaseType(TypeReferenceExpression baseType)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNode(BaseType, baseType);
			_BaseType = baseType;
			_Type = TypeReferenceType.Pointer;
		}

		protected void SetRank(int rank)
		{
			_Rank = rank;
			_Type = TypeReferenceType.Array;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_BaseType == oldElement)
			{
				_BaseType = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else if (ArrayBounds.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				ArrayBounds.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is TypeReferenceExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = (TypeReferenceExpression)source;
			_Rank = typeReferenceExpression.Rank;
			_TypeArity = typeReferenceExpression.TypeArity;
			_NameRange = typeReferenceExpression.NameRange;
			_IsNullable = typeReferenceExpression._IsNullable;
			_Type = typeReferenceExpression._Type;
			_GCType = typeReferenceExpression.GCType;
			_ArrayStorageClass = typeReferenceExpression.ArrayStorageClass;
			_IsConst = typeReferenceExpression.IsConst;
			_IsVolatile = typeReferenceExpression.IsVolatile;
			_IsManaged = typeReferenceExpression.IsManaged;
			_IsTypeCharacter = typeReferenceExpression._IsTypeCharacter;
			_IsUnbound = typeReferenceExpression._IsUnbound;
			_IsDynamic = typeReferenceExpression._IsDynamic;
			if (typeReferenceExpression.BaseType != null)
			{
				_BaseType = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeReferenceExpression, typeReferenceExpression.BaseType) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_BaseType == null)
				{
					_BaseType = typeReferenceExpression.BaseType.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
			else if (typeReferenceExpression.Qualifier != null)
			{
				_BaseType = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeReferenceExpression, typeReferenceExpression.Qualifier) as Expression;
				if (_BaseType == null)
				{
					_BaseType = typeReferenceExpression.Qualifier.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (typeReferenceExpression.BasedPointer != null)
			{
				_BasedPointer = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeReferenceExpression, typeReferenceExpression.BasedPointer) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_BasedPointer == null)
				{
					_BasedPointer = typeReferenceExpression.BasedPointer.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
			if (typeReferenceExpression._ArrayBounds != null)
			{
				_ArrayBounds = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, typeReferenceExpression.DetailNodes, _ArrayBounds, typeReferenceExpression._ArrayBounds);
				if (_ArrayBounds.Count == 0 && typeReferenceExpression._ArrayBounds.Count > 0)
				{
					_ArrayBounds = typeReferenceExpression._ArrayBounds.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetTypeProperties(ITypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				TypeReferenceType = type.TypeReferenceType;
				IsConst = type.IsConst;
				IsVolatile = type.IsVolatile;
				IsManaged = type.IsManaged;
				IsUnbound = type.IsUnbound;
				IsNullable = type.IsNullable;
				TypeArity = type.TypeArity;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetBaseTypeAfterCreation(TypeReferenceExpression baseType)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNode(BaseType, baseType);
			_BaseType = baseType;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(base.ToString());
			if (IsArrayType)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("[");
				for (int i = 0; i < _Rank - 1; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			if (IsConst)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" const");
			}
			if (IsVolatile)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" volatile");
			}
			bool isPointerType = IsPointerType;
			bool isReferenceType = IsReferenceType;
			if (isPointerType || isReferenceType)
			{
				if (isPointerType)
				{
					if (IsManaged)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("^");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("*");
					}
				}
				if (isReferenceType)
				{
					if (IsManaged)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("%");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("&");
					}
				}
			}
			else if (IsConst || IsVolatile)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" ");
			}
			if (IsNullable)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("?");
			}
			return GlobalStringStorage.Intern(stringBuilder.ToString());
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 94;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is TypeReferenceExpression)
			{
				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = (TypeReferenceExpression)expression;
				if (IsArrayType)
				{
					if (!typeReferenceExpression.IsArrayType || Rank != typeReferenceExpression.Rank)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (BaseType == null)
					{
						return typeReferenceExpression.BaseType == null;
					}
					return BaseType.IsIdenticalTo(typeReferenceExpression.BaseType);
				}
				if (IsPointerType)
				{
					if (BaseType == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (typeReferenceExpression.IsPointerType)
					{
						return BaseType.IsIdenticalTo(typeReferenceExpression.BaseType);
					}
					return false;
				}
				bool flag = Name == typeReferenceExpression.Name;
				if (IsGeneric != typeReferenceExpression.IsGeneric)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsGeneric)
				{
					if (typeReferenceExpression.IsGeneric && flag)
					{
						return TypeArguments.IsIdenticalTo(typeReferenceExpression.TypeArguments);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return flag;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_BaseType = null;
			if (_ArrayBounds != null)
			{
				_ArrayBounds.Clear();
				_ArrayBounds = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = new TypeReferenceExpression();
			typeReferenceExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return typeReferenceExpression;
		}

		public bool IsIdenticalTo(ITypeReferenceExpression typeRef)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsIdenticalTo(this, typeRef);
		}

		public ITypeReferenceExpression GetElementType()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetInnerType(this);
		}

		public bool UsesTypeParameters(IGenericElement generic)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.UsesTypeParameters(this, generic);
		}

		public bool IsTypeParameter(IGenericElement generic)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsTypeParameter(this, generic);
		}

		public ITypeReferenceExpression CreateArrayReference(int rank)
		{
			return new TypeReferenceExpression(this, rank);
		}

		public override bool Is(string fullTypeName)
		{
			ISourceTreeResolver sourceTreeResolver = StructuralParserServicesHolder.SourceTreeResolver;
			return Is(sourceTreeResolver, fullTypeName);
		}

		public override bool Is(ITypeElement type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Is(type.FullName);
		}

		public override bool Is(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Is(type.FullName);
		}

		public override bool Is(ISourceTreeResolver resolver, string fullTypeName)
		{
			if (resolver == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(resolver.ResolveType(this) is ITypeElement typeElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return typeElement.Is(resolver, fullTypeName);
		}

		public virtual ITypeReferenceExpression CreateResolvePoint()
		{
			return new TypeReferenceExpressionWrapper(this);
		}
	}
	public class TypeReferenceExpressionCollection : ExpressionCollectionBase, ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection, ICollection, IEnumerable, IEnumerable<TypeReferenceExpression>
	{
		public new TypeReferenceExpression this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (TypeReferenceExpression)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpression ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection.this[int index] => this[index];

		IEnumerator<TypeReferenceExpression> IEnumerable<TypeReferenceExpression>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (enumerator.Current is TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression)
				{
					yield return typeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Add(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			return Add((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public void AddRange(TypeReferenceExpressionCollection collection)
		{
			AddRange((LanguageElementCollectionBase)collection);
		}

		public int IndexOf(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			return IndexOf((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			Insert(index, (LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public void Remove(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			Remove((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public Expression Find(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			return (Expression)Find((LanguageElement)expression);
		}

		public bool Contains(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			return Find(expression) != null;
		}

		public StringCollection ToStringCollection()
		{
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				stringCollection.Add(this[i].ToString());
			}
			return stringCollection;
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new TypeReferenceExpressionCollection();
		}

		int ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection.IndexOf(ITypeReferenceExpression t)
		{
			return IndexOf(t);
		}

	public class UnaryDecrement : UnaryOperatorExpression, IUnaryDecrementExpression, IUnaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_PreMaintainanceComplexity = 4;

		private const int INT_PostMaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		public override bool CanBeStatement => true;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsPostOperator)
				{
					return 4;
				}
				return 3;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.UnaryDecrement;

		public UnaryDecrement()
		{
		}

		public UnaryDecrement(Token token, Expression expression, bool isPostDecrement)
			: base(token, expression, isPostDecrement)
		{
		}

		public UnaryDecrement(Expression expression, bool isPostDecrement)
			: base(expression, isPostDecrement)
		{
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 127;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is UnaryDecrement)
			{
				UnaryDecrement unaryDecrement = expression as UnaryDecrement;
				if (base.Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.Expression.IsIdenticalTo(unaryDecrement.Expression))
				{
					return base.IsPostOperator == unaryDecrement.IsPostOperator;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			UnaryDecrement unaryDecrement = new UnaryDecrement();
			unaryDecrement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return unaryDecrement;
		}
	}
	public class UnaryIncrement : UnaryOperatorExpression, IUnaryIncrementExpression, IUnaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_PreMaintainanceComplexity = 4;

		private const int INT_PostMaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.IsPostOperator)
				{
					return 4;
				}
				return 3;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.UnaryIncrement;

		public override bool CanBeStatement => true;

		public UnaryIncrement()
		{
		}

		public UnaryIncrement(Token token, Expression expression, bool isPostIncrement)
			: base(token, expression, isPostIncrement)
		{
		}

		public UnaryIncrement(Expression expression, bool isPostIncrement)
			: base(expression, isPostIncrement)
		{
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 100;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is UnaryIncrement)
			{
				UnaryIncrement unaryIncrement = expression as UnaryIncrement;
				if (base.Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.Expression.IsIdenticalTo(unaryIncrement.Expression))
				{
					return base.IsPostOperator == unaryIncrement.IsPostOperator;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			UnaryIncrement unaryIncrement = new UnaryIncrement();
			unaryIncrement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return unaryIncrement;
		}
	}
	public enum UnaryOperatorType : byte
	{
		None,
		Decrement,
		Increment,
		UnaryNegation,
		UnaryPlus,
		LogicalNot,
		AddressOf,
		OnesComplement,
		PointerDereference,
		TrackingReference
	}
	public class UnaryOperatorExpression : OperatorExpression, IUnaryOperatorExpression, IOperatorExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 2;

		private UnaryOperatorType _Operator;

		private Expression _Expression;

		private bool _IsPostOperator;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 2;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.UnaryOperatorExpression;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use Expression instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Expression UnaryExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				Expression = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsPostOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsPostOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_IsPostOperator != value)
				{
					_IsPostOperator = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public UnaryOperatorType UnaryOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _Operator;
			}
			set
			{
				_Operator = value;
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use UnaryOperator instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public UnaryOperatorType Operator
		{
			get
			{
				return _Operator;
			}
			set
			{
				_Operator = value;
			}
		}

		IExpression IUnaryOperatorExpression.UnaryExpression => Expression;

		IExpression IUnaryOperatorExpression.Expression => Expression;

		bool IUnaryOperatorExpression.IsPostOperator => IsPostOperator;

		UnaryOperatorType IUnaryOperatorExpression.UnaryOperator => UnaryOperator;

		public UnaryOperatorExpression()
		{
			_IsPostOperator = false;
			_Expression = null;
		}

		public UnaryOperatorExpression(Token token, Expression expression)
			: this(token, expression, isPostOperator: false)
		{
		}

		public UnaryOperatorExpression(Expression expression)
			: this(expression, isPostOperator: false)
		{
		}

		public UnaryOperatorExpression(Token token, Expression expression, bool isPostOperator)
			: base(token)
		{
			_IsPostOperator = isPostOperator;
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		public UnaryOperatorExpression(Expression expression, bool isPostOperator)
		{
			_IsPostOperator = isPostOperator;
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		public UnaryOperatorExpression(string op, Expression expression, bool isPostOperator)
			: base(op)
		{
			_IsPostOperator = isPostOperator;
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		public UnaryOperatorExpression(UnaryOperatorType op, Expression expression, bool isPostOperator)
			: this(expression, isPostOperator: false)
		{
			_IsPostOperator = isPostOperator;
			_Operator = op;
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use SetExpression instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected void SetUnaryExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is UnaryOperatorExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			UnaryOperatorExpression unaryOperatorExpression = (UnaryOperatorExpression)source;
			_IsPostOperator = unaryOperatorExpression._IsPostOperator;
			_Operator = unaryOperatorExpression._Operator;
			if (unaryOperatorExpression._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, unaryOperatorExpression, unaryOperatorExpression._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = unaryOperatorExpression._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (Expression != null)
			{
				text = Expression.ToString();
			}
			if (IsPostOperator)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", text, base.OperatorText);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", base.OperatorText, text);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 100;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is UnaryOperatorExpression)
			{
				UnaryOperatorExpression unaryOperatorExpression = expression as UnaryOperatorExpression;
				if (Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Expression.IsIdenticalTo(unaryOperatorExpression.Expression) && base.OperatorText == unaryOperatorExpression.OperatorText)
				{
					return IsPostOperator == unaryOperatorExpression.IsPostOperator;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_Expression = null;
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Expression = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			UnaryOperatorExpression unaryOperatorExpression = new UnaryOperatorExpression();
			unaryOperatorExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return unaryOperatorExpression;
		}

		public static OperatorType GetOverloadableOperatorType(UnaryOperatorType unary)
		{
			return unary switch
			{
				UnaryOperatorType.None => OperatorType.None, 
				UnaryOperatorType.UnaryPlus => OperatorType.UnaryPlus, 
				UnaryOperatorType.UnaryNegation => OperatorType.UnaryNegation, 
				UnaryOperatorType.LogicalNot => OperatorType.LogicalNot, 
				UnaryOperatorType.Increment => OperatorType.Increment, 
				UnaryOperatorType.Decrement => OperatorType.Decrement, 
				UnaryOperatorType.OnesComplement => OperatorType.OnesComplement, 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class UncheckedExpression : Expression, IUncheckedExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Exp;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.UncheckedExpression;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Exp;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IUncheckedExpression.Expression => Expression;

		protected UncheckedExpression()
		{
		}

		public UncheckedExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		private void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Exp);
			}
			_Exp = expression;
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Exp);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Exp == oldElement)
			{
				_Exp = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is UncheckedExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			UncheckedExpression uncheckedExpression = (UncheckedExpression)source;
			if (uncheckedExpression._Exp != null)
			{
				_Exp = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, uncheckedExpression, uncheckedExpression._Exp) as Expression;
				if (_Exp == null)
				{
					_Exp = uncheckedExpression._Exp.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_Exp != null)
			{
				return "unchecked(" + _Exp.ToString() + ")";
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 106;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is UncheckedExpression)
			{
				UncheckedExpression uncheckedExpression = (UncheckedExpression)expression;
				if (Expression == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return Expression.IsIdenticalTo(uncheckedExpression.Expression);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Exp = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			UncheckedExpression uncheckedExpression = new UncheckedExpression();
			uncheckedExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return uncheckedExpression;
		}
	}

	public class Namespace : DelimiterCapableBlock, INamespaceElement, IElement
	{
		private TextRange _NameRange;

		private string _FullName;

		private IDocument _ParentDocument;

		private bool _HasEndingSemicolon;

		public override string PathSegment => StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetSignaturePart(this);

		public virtual string FullName
		{
			get
			{
				if (_FullName != null && _FullName != string.Empty)
				{
					return _FullName;
				}
				_FullName = Name;
				for (Namespace parentNamespace = GetParentNamespace(); parentNamespace != null; parentNamespace = parentNamespace.GetParentNamespace())
				{
					_FullName = parentNamespace.Name + "." + _FullName;
				}
				IProjectElement project = Project;
				if (project != null && project.SupportsRootNamespace)
				{
					string rootNamespace = project.RootNamespace;
					if (rootNamespace != null && rootNamespace.Length > 0)
					{
						_FullName = $"{rootNamespace}.{_FullName}";
					}
				}
				return _FullName;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Namespace;

		public override bool DeclaresIdentifier => true;

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable AllNamespaces => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Namespace), useRecursion: true);

		public IEnumerable AllTypes => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(TypeDeclaration), useRecursion: true);

		public bool HasEndingSemicolon
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasEndingSemicolon;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasEndingSemicolon = value;
			}
		}

		INamespaceElementCollection INamespaceElement.Namespaces
		{
			get
			{
				LiteNamespaceElementCollection liteNamespaceElementCollection = new LiteNamespaceElementCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < Nodes.Count; i++)
				{
					if (Nodes[i] is Namespace)
					{
						liteNamespaceElementCollection.Add(Nodes[i]);
					}
				}
				return liteNamespaceElementCollection;
			}
		}

		ITypeElementCollection INamespaceElement.Types
		{
			get
			{
				LiteTypeElementCollection liteTypeElementCollection = new LiteTypeElementCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < Nodes.Count; i++)
				{
					if (Nodes[i] is TypeDeclaration || Nodes[i] is DelegateDefinition)
					{
						liteTypeElementCollection.Add(Nodes[i]);
					}
				}
				return liteTypeElementCollection;
			}
		}

		protected Namespace()
		{
			_ParentDocument = null;
		}

		public Namespace(string name)
		{
			_ParentDocument = null;
			InternalName = name;
		}

		public Namespace(IDocument document)
		{
			_ParentDocument = document;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Namespace)
				{
					Namespace obj = (Namespace)source;
					_NameRange = obj.NameRange;
					_FullName = obj._FullName;
					_ParentDocument = obj._ParentDocument;
					_HasEndingSemicolon = obj._HasEndingSemicolon;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 32;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Internal;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility[] GetValidVisibilities()
		{
			return new MemberVisibility[2]
			{
				MemberVisibility.Internal,
				MemberVisibility.Public
			};
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Namespace obj = new Namespace();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetNamespaceCollection(NamespaceCollection namespaceCollection)
		{
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}
	}
	public class NamespaceCollection : LanguageElementCollectionBase
	{
		private string _FullName;

		public new Namespace this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (Namespace)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public string FullName => _FullName;

		public NamespaceCollection(string fullName)
		{
			_FullName = fullName;
		}

		private void ClearMemberReferencesToThis()
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Namespace obj = (Namespace)enumerator.Current;
					obj.SetNamespaceCollection(null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			ClearMemberReferencesToThis();
			base.OnClear();
		}

		protected new NamespaceCollection CreateInstance()
		{
			return new NamespaceCollection(_FullName);
		}

		protected void CloneElements(NamespaceCollection target, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					Namespace aNamespace = this[i].Clone(options) as Namespace;
					target.Add(aNamespace);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Add(Namespace aNamespace)
		{
			if (aNamespace == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (aNamespace.FullName != _FullName)
			{
				throw new Exception($"Namespace name, \"{aNamespace.FullName}\", does not match name assigned to this collection (\"{_FullName}\"). Unable to add namespace.");
			}
			aNamespace.SetNamespaceCollection(this);
			return Add((LanguageElement)aNamespace);
		}

		public void Remove(Namespace aNamespace)
		{
			aNamespace?.SetNamespaceCollection(null);
			int num = IndexOf(aNamespace);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				base.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public int IndexOf(Namespace aNamespace)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] == aNamespace)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Namespace aNamespace)
		{
			Insert(index, (LanguageElement)aNamespace);
		}

		public Namespace Find(Namespace aNamespace)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Namespace obj = (Namespace)enumerator.Current;
					if (obj == aNamespace)
					{
						return obj;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Contains(Namespace aNamespace)
		{
			return Find(aNamespace) != null;
		}

		public new NamespaceCollection DeepClone()
		{
			return DeepClone(ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		public new NamespaceCollection DeepClone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			NamespaceCollection namespaceCollection = CreateInstance();
			CloneElements(namespaceCollection, options);
			return namespaceCollection;
		}
	}
	public class NamespaceReference : CodeElement, INamespaceReference, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		private TextRange _AliasNameRange;

		private bool _IsAlias;

		private string _AliasName;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.NamespaceReference;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("The name of the namespace (or potentially the class in the VB Imports statement) that this language element alias points to.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		public string AliasName
		{
			get
			{
				return _AliasName;
			}
			set
			{
				_AliasName = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets source range if the alias name.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public SourceRange AliasNameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_AliasNameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_AliasNameRange = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("True if this Using or Imports statement is an alias.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsAlias
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsAlias;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsAlias = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression AliasExpression
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DetailNodeCount == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				foreach (LanguageElement detailNode in DetailNodes)
				{
					if (!(detailNode is SupportElement))
					{
						return detailNode as Expression;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		IExpression INamespaceReference.NameExpression
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsAlias)
				{
					if (base.DetailNodeCount != 0)
					{
						return DetailNodes[0] as Expression;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		IExpression INamespaceReference.Expression
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsAlias)
				{
					if (base.DetailNodeCount >= 2)
					{
						return DetailNodes[1] as Expression;
					}
					return null;
				}
				if (base.DetailNodeCount != 0)
				{
					return DetailNodes[0] as Expression;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public NamespaceReference()
			: this(string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public NamespaceReference(string nameSpace)
		{
			InternalName = nameSpace;
		}

		public NamespaceReference(string aliasName, string nameSpace)
		{
			InternalName = nameSpace;
			_AliasName = aliasName;
			_IsAlias = true;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is NamespaceReference)
				{
					NamespaceReference namespaceReference = (NamespaceReference)source;
					_IsAlias = namespaceReference._IsAlias;
					_AliasName = namespaceReference._AliasName;
					_NameRange = namespaceReference.NameRange;
					_AliasNameRange = namespaceReference.AliasNameRange;
				}

	public class Abort : FlowBreak, IAbortStatement, IFlowBreakStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Abort;

		{

		{
			return "abort";
		}

		public override LanguageElement GetFlowParent()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = base.ParentTryBlock;
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParent(LanguageElementType.Catch);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public override LanguageElement FindTarget()
		{
			LanguageElement flowParent = GetFlowParent();
			if (flowParent == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement parentMethodOrPropertyAccessor = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			LanguageElement nextCodeSibling = flowParent.NextCodeSibling;
			if (nextCodeSibling == null)
			{
				return GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			}
			if (nextCodeSibling.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Catch)
			{
				return nextCodeSibling;
			}
			return parentMethodOrPropertyAccessor;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Abort abort = new Abort();
			abort.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return abort;
		}
	}

	public enum ExitKind
	{
		Do,
		For,
		While,
		Select,
		Sub,
		Function,
		Property,
		Try
	}
	public class Exit : Break
	{
		private ExitKind _ExitKind;

		public ExitKind ExitKind
		{
			get
			{
				return _ExitKind;
			}
			set
			{
				_ExitKind = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Exit;

		public Exit()
		{
		}

		public Exit(string exitKind, SourceRange range)
		{
			SetRange(range);
			_ExitKind = ResolveExitKind(exitKind);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Exit)
				{
					Exit exit = (Exit)source;
					_ExitKind = exit._ExitKind;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual ExitKind ResolveExitKind(string exitKind)
		{
			return ExitKind.Sub;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Exit " + _ExitKind;
		}

		public virtual bool MatchesExitKind(LanguageElement target)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override LanguageElement FindTarget()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = base.ParentLoop;
			LanguageElement languageElement3 = null;
			LanguageElement languageElement4 = null;
			if (languageElement2 != null)
			{
				languageElement4 = languageElement2.ParentTryBlock;
				languageElement3 = languageElement2.ParentLoop;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			while (languageElement == null && languageElement2 != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					languageElement = ((languageElement2 is Method) ? languageElement2 : ((languageElement2 is Property) ? languageElement2 : ((languageElement2 is PropertyAccessor) ? languageElement2 : ((languageElement2 == languageElement3 && !(languageElement2 is Try)) ? languageElement3 : ((languageElement2 != languageElement4) ? NextStandaloneCodeSibling(languageElement2) : NextStandaloneCodeSibling(languageElement4))))));
				}
				else if (MatchesExitKind(languageElement2))
				{
					flag = true;
					languageElement3 = languageElement2.ParentLoop;
					languageElement4 = languageElement2.ParentTryBlock;
					continue;
				}
				languageElement2 = languageElement2.Parent;
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Exit exit = new Exit();
			exit.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return exit;
		}
	}
	public class FlowBreak : Statement, IFlowBreakStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.FlowBreak;

		protected LanguageElement FindReturnTarget()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			Try parentTryBlock = base.ParentTryBlock;
			if (parentTryBlock != null)
			{
				languageElement = parentTryBlock.GetFinallyTarget();
			}
			if (languageElement == null && GetParent(LanguageElementType.Catch) is Catch obj)
			{
				languageElement = obj.GetFinallyTarget();
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParentAnonymousExpression();
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		protected LanguageElement FindBreakTarget()
		{
			return FindBreakTarget(canBreakOutOfMember: false);
		}

		protected LanguageElement FindBreakTarget(bool canBreakOutOfMember)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetParentLoopOrFinallyTarget();
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = base.ParentLoop;
			if (languageElement2 == null && canBreakOutOfMember)
			{
				languageElement2 = GetParentMethodOrAccessor();
			}
			if (languageElement2 != null && languageElement == languageElement2)
			{
				languageElement = NextStandaloneCodeSibling(languageElement2);
				if (languageElement == null)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement3 = languageElement2;
					LanguageElement parentLoop = languageElement2.ParentLoop;
					Try parentTryBlock = languageElement2.ParentTryBlock;
					if (languageElement3 != null)
					{
						while (languageElement == null)
						{
							languageElement3 = languageElement3.Parent;
							if (languageElement3 == null || languageElement3 is Method || languageElement3 is PropertyAccessor)
							{
								break;
							}
							languageElement = ((languageElement3 != parentLoop) ? ((languageElement3 != parentTryBlock) ? NextStandaloneCodeSibling(languageElement3) : NextStandaloneCodeSibling(parentTryBlock)) : parentLoop);
						}
					}
					if (languageElement == null)
					{
						languageElement = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
					}
				}
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 83;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement FindTarget()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetFlowParent()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			FlowBreak flowBreak = new FlowBreak();
			flowBreak.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return flowBreak;
		}
	}
	public class Goto : FlowBreak
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 10;

		private SourceRange _LabelRange;

		private bool _IsGotoCaseLabel;

		private bool _IsGotoCaseDefault;

		private string _Label;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 10;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Goto;

		public string Label
		{
			get
			{
				return _Label;
			}
			set
			{
				_Label = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsGotoCaseLabel
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsGotoCaseLabel;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsGotoCaseLabel = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsGotoCaseDefault
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsGotoCaseDefault;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsGotoCaseDefault = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange LabelRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_LabelRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_LabelRange = value;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Goto)
				{
					Goto obj = (Goto)source;
					_IsGotoCaseLabel = obj._IsGotoCaseLabel;
					_IsGotoCaseDefault = obj._IsGotoCaseDefault;
					_Label = obj._Label;
					_LabelRange = LabelRange;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_LabelRange = LabelRange;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Goto " + _Label;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 84;
		}

		private LanguageElement FindCaseTarget()
		{
			string text = Label;
			if (text != null)
			{
				text = text.Trim();
			}
			if ((IsGotoCaseLabel || IsGotoCaseDefault) && GetParent(LanguageElementType.Switch) is Switch obj)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < obj.NodeCount; i++)
				{
					if (!(obj.Nodes[i] is Case obj2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (IsGotoCaseDefault)
					{
						if (obj2.IsDefault)
						{
							return obj2;
						}
					}
					else if (IsGotoCaseLabel && obj2.Expression.ToString().Trim() == text)
					{
						return obj2;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override LanguageElement FindTarget()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			string text = Label;
			if (text != null)
			{
				text = text.Trim();
			}
			languageElement = FindCaseTarget();
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				return languageElement;
			}
			LanguageElement parentMethodOrPropertyAccessor = GetParentMethodOrPropertyAccessor();
			if (parentMethodOrPropertyAccessor != null)
			{
				LanguageElement nextNode = parentMethodOrPropertyAccessor.NextNode;
				while (nextNode != null && nextNode.IsParentedBy(parentMethodOrPropertyAccessor))
				{
					if (nextNode is Label)
					{
						Label label = (Label)nextNode;
						if (label.Name == text)
						{
							languageElement = label.NextCodeSibling;
							if (languageElement == null)
							{
								languageElement = label;
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					nextNode = nextNode.NextNode;
				}
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Goto obj = new Goto();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}

	public class Return : FlowBreak, IReturnStatement, IFlowBreakStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 1;

		private Expression _Expression;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 1;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Return;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Expression != value)
				{
					SetExpression(value);
				}
			}
		}

		IExpression IReturnStatement.Expression => Expression;

		public Return()
		{
		}

		public Return(Expression expression)
			: this()
		{
			SetExpression(expression);
		}

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_Expression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Return))
			{
				return;
			}
			Return obj = (Return)source;
			if (obj._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = obj._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "return";
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 81;
		}

		public override LanguageElement FindTarget()
		{
			return FindReturnTarget();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Return obj = new Return();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}

	public class Throw : Abort, IThrowStatement, IAbortStatement, IFlowBreakStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private Expression _Expression;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Throw;

		[Description("The expression thrown.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Expression != value)
				{
					SetExpression(value);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("The exception thrown.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public string Exception
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Expression != null)
				{
					return _Expression.ToString();
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		IExpression IThrowStatement.Expression => Expression;

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_Expression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Throw))
			{
				return;
			}
			Throw obj = (Throw)source;
			if (obj._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = obj._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 82;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "throw " + Exception;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Throw obj = new Throw();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}

	public class YieldReturn : Yield, IYieldReturnStatement, IYieldStatement, IFlowBreakStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 1;

		private Expression _Expression;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 1;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.YieldReturn;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetEpxression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IYieldReturnStatement.Expression => Expression;

		public YieldReturn()
		{
		}

		public YieldReturn(SourceRange range)
		{
			SetRange(range);
		}

		protected virtual void SetEpxression(Expression expression)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNode(_Expression, expression);
			_Expression = expression;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				SetEpxression(newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is YieldReturn))
			{
				return;
			}
			YieldReturn yieldReturn = (YieldReturn)source;
			if (yieldReturn._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, yieldReturn, yieldReturn._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = yieldReturn._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Expression = null;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 144;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_Expression == null)
			{
				return "yield return";
			}
			return "yield return" + _Expression.ToString();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			YieldReturn yieldReturn = new YieldReturn();
			yieldReturn.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return yieldReturn;
		}

		public override LanguageElement FindTarget()
		{
			return FindReturnTarget();
		}
	}

	public class GenericModifier : CodeElement
	{
		private TypeParameterCollection _TypeParameters;

		public TypeParameterCollection TypeParameters => _TypeParameters;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.GenericModifier;

		protected override bool HasOuterRangeChildren => true;

		public GenericModifier()
			: this(new TypeParameterCollection())
		{
		}

		public GenericModifier(TypeParameterCollection types)
			: this(types, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public GenericModifier(TypeParameterCollection types, SourceRange range)
		{
			_TypeParameters = types;
			AddDetailNodes(_TypeParameters);
			SetRange(range);
		}

		private void GetTypeParametersFromDetailNodes()
		{
			_TypeParameters = new TypeParameterCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DetailNodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (DetailNodes[i] is TypeParameter value)
				{
					_TypeParameters.Add(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is GenericModifier)
				{
					GetTypeParametersFromDetailNodes();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_TypeParameters = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_TypeParameters != null && _TypeParameters.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_TypeParameters.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			GenericModifier genericModifier = new GenericModifier();
			genericModifier.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return genericModifier;
		}

		public void AddTypeParameter(TypeParameter typeParameter)
		{
			if (typeParameter != null)
			{
				TypeParameters.Add(typeParameter);
				AddDetailNode(typeParameter);
			}
		}

		public void InsertTypeParameter(int index, TypeParameter typeParameter)
		{
			if (typeParameter != null)
			{
				TypeParameters.Insert(index, typeParameter);
				InsertDetailNode(index, typeParameter);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveTypeParameter(TypeParameter typeParameter)
		{
			if (typeParameter != null)
			{
				TypeParameters.Remove(typeParameter);
				RemoveDetailNode(typeParameter);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("<");
			if (_TypeParameters != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(_TypeParameters.ToString());
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(">");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class ComplexGenericModifier : GenericModifier
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _GenericModifiers;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ComplexGenericModifier;

		public LanguageElementCollection GenericModifiers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_GenericModifiers == null)
				{
					_GenericModifiers = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _GenericModifiers;
			}
		}

		public int GenericModifiersCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_GenericModifiers == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _GenericModifiers.Count;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is ComplexGenericModifier)
			{
				ComplexGenericModifier complexGenericModifier = source as ComplexGenericModifier;
				if (complexGenericModifier._GenericModifiers != null)
				{
					_GenericModifiers = complexGenericModifier._GenericModifiers.DeepClone() as LanguageElementCollection;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class NamedTypeParameterConstraint : TypeParameterConstraint, INamedTypeParameterConstraint
	{
		private TypeReferenceExpression _TypeReference;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.NamedTypeParameterConstraint;

		public TypeReferenceExpression TypeReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _TypeReference;
			}
			set
			{
				SetTypeReference(value);
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpression INamedTypeParameterConstraint.TypeReference => TypeReference;

		protected NamedTypeParameterConstraint()
		{
		}

		public NamedTypeParameterConstraint(TypeReferenceExpression typeReference)
			: base(string.Empty, typeReference.Range)
		{
			SetTypeReference(typeReference);
		}

		private void GetTypeReferenceFromDetailNodes()
		{
			if (base.DetailNodeCount != 0 && DetailNodes[0] is TypeReferenceExpression typeReference)
			{
				_TypeReference = typeReference;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetTypeReference(TypeReferenceExpression typeReference)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNode(_TypeReference, typeReference);
			_TypeReference = typeReference;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_TypeReference == oldElement && newElement is TypeReferenceExpression)
			{
				_TypeReference = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is NamedTypeParameterConstraint)
				{
					GetTypeReferenceFromDetailNodes();
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			NamedTypeParameterConstraint namedTypeParameterConstraint = new NamedTypeParameterConstraint();
			namedTypeParameterConstraint.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return namedTypeParameterConstraint;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_TypeReference = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}
	}

	public class TypeParameter : CodeElement, ITypeParameter, IElement, ITypeParameterModifier
	{
		private TypeParameterConstraintCollection _Constraints;

		private ITypeReferenceExpression _ActivatedType;

		private SourceRange _NameRange;

		private TypeParameterDirection _Direction = TypeParameterDirection.None;

		public TypeParameterDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return _Direction;
			}
			set
			{
				_Direction = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.TypeParameter;

		public TypeParameterConstraintCollection Constraints
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Constraints == null)
				{
					_Constraints = new TypeParameterConstraintCollection();
				}
				return _Constraints;
			}
			set
			{
				SetConstraints(value);
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool HasOuterRangeChildren => true;

		bool ITypeParameter.IsActivated => _ActivatedType != null;

		ITypeReferenceExpression ITypeParameter.ActivatedType => _ActivatedType;

		ITypeParameterConstraintCollection ITypeParameter.Constraints
		{
			get
			{
				if (Constraints == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyITypeParameterConstraintCollection;
				}
				return Constraints;
			}
		}

		TypeParameterDirection ITypeParameter.Direction => _Direction;

		protected TypeParameter()
		{
		}

		public TypeParameter(string name)
			: this(name, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public TypeParameter(string name, SourceRange range)
			: this(name, null, range)
		{
		}

		public TypeParameter(string name, TypeParameterConstraintCollection constraints, SourceRange range)
		{
			InternalName = name;
			SetRange(range);
			SetConstraints(constraints);
		}

		private void GetConstraintsFromDetailNodes()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DetailNodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (DetailNodes[i] is TypeParameterConstraint value)
				{
					Constraints.Add(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is TypeParameter typeParameter)
				{
					_NameRange = typeParameter.NameRange;
					_Direction = typeParameter.Direction;
					GetConstraintsFromDetailNodes();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TypeParameter typeParameter = new TypeParameter();
			typeParameter.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return typeParameter;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Constraints != null)
			{
				_Constraints.Clear();
				_Constraints = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			int num = ((_Constraints == null) ? (-1) : _Constraints.IndexOf(oldElement));
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				_Constraints.RemoveAt(num);
				if (newElement != null)
				{
					_Constraints.Insert(num, newElement);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetConstraints(TypeParameterConstraintCollection constraints)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNodes(_Constraints, constraints);
			_Constraints = constraints;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 129;
		}

		public void AddConstraint(TypeParameterConstraint constraint)
		{
			if (constraint != null)
			{
				Constraints.Add(constraint);
				AddDetailNode(constraint);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveConstraint(TypeParameterConstraint constraint)
		{
			if (constraint != null)
			{
				Constraints.Remove(constraint);
				RemoveDetailNode(constraint);
			}
		}

		void ITypeParameterModifier.SetActivatedType(ITypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			_ActivatedType = type;
		}

		void ITypeParameterModifier.AddConstraint(ITypeParameterConstraint constraint)
		{
			AddConstraint(constraint as TypeParameterConstraint);
		}

		void ITypeParameterModifier.RemoveConstraint(ITypeParameterConstraint constraint)
		{
			RemoveConstraint(constraint as TypeParameterConstraint);
		}

		void ITypeParameterModifier.SetDirection(TypeParameterDirection direction)
		{
			Direction = direction;
		}
	}

				}
			}

			typeReferenceExpressionWrapper.CloneDataFrom(this, options);

		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			ITypeReferenceExpression typeReference = GetTypeReference();
			if (typeReference == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return resolver.ResolveType(typeReference);
		}

		public override ITypeReferenceExpression CreateResolvePoint()
		{
			if (ResolvePoint == null)
			{
				return new TypeReferenceExpressionWrapper(this);
			}
			return ((ITypeReferenceExpressionModifier)ResolvePoint).CreateResolvePoint();
		}
	}

	public class HtmlAttribute : XmlAttribute, IHtmlAttribute, IXmlAttribute, IXmlNode, IElement, IMarkupElement
	{
		private bool _HasValue;

		private QuoteType _QuoteType;

		private Expression _InlineExpression;

		private CssPropertyDeclarationCollection _StyleProperties;

		private bool _ValueIsAspCodeEmbedding;

		private LanguageElementCollection _ScriptCode;

		private DotNetLanguageType _ScriptLanguage = DotNetLanguageType.Unknown;

		public QuoteType AttributeQuoteType
		{
			get
			{
				return _QuoteType;
			}
			set
			{
				_QuoteType = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ValueIsAspCodeEmbedding
		{
			get
			{
				return _ValueIsAspCodeEmbedding;
			}
			set
			{
				_ValueIsAspCodeEmbedding = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasValue;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasValue = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.HtmlAttribute;

		public Expression InlineExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _InlineExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_InlineExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public CssPropertyDeclarationCollection StyleProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return _StyleProperties;
			}
			set
			{
				_StyleProperties = value;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection ScriptCode
		{
			get
			{
				return _ScriptCode;
			}
			set
			{
				_ScriptCode = value;
			}
		}

		public DotNetLanguageType ScriptLanguage
		{
			get
			{
				return _ScriptLanguage;
			}
			set
			{
				_ScriptLanguage = value;
			}
		}

		IExpression IHtmlAttribute.InlineExpression => _InlineExpression;

		DotNetLanguageType IHtmlAttribute.ScriptLanguage => _ScriptLanguage;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is HtmlAttribute))
			{
				return;
			}
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = (HtmlAttribute)source;
			_HasValue = htmlAttribute._HasValue;
			_QuoteType = htmlAttribute._QuoteType;
			if (htmlAttribute._InlineExpression != null)
			{
				_InlineExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodeList(DetailNodes, htmlAttribute.DetailNodes, htmlAttribute.InlineExpression) as Expression;
				if (_InlineExpression == null)
				{
					_InlineExpression = htmlAttribute._InlineExpression.Clone() as Expression;
					_InlineExpression.SetParent(this);
				}
				else
				{
					_InlineExpression = null;
				}
			}
			if (htmlAttribute._StyleProperties != null)
			{
				_StyleProperties = htmlAttribute._StyleProperties.DeepClone(options) as CssPropertyDeclarationCollection;
			}
			else
			{
				_StyleProperties = null;
			}
			if (htmlAttribute._ScriptCode != null)
			{
				_ScriptCode = htmlAttribute._ScriptCode.DeepClone(options);
			}
			else
			{
				_ScriptCode = null;
			}
			_ScriptLanguage = htmlAttribute._ScriptLanguage;
			_ValueIsAspCodeEmbedding = htmlAttribute.ValueIsAspCodeEmbedding;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = new HtmlAttribute();
			htmlAttribute.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return htmlAttribute;
		}
	}
	public class HtmlAttributeCollection : NodeList, IHtmlAttributeCollection, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		public new HtmlAttribute this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (HtmlAttribute)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public HtmlAttribute this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				if (name == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					if (base[i] is HtmlAttribute && string.Compare((base[i] as HtmlAttribute).Name, name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
					{
						return base[i] as HtmlAttribute;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (name == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					if (base[i] is HtmlAttribute && string.Compare((base[i] as HtmlAttribute).Name, name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
					{
						base[i] = value;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		IHtmlAttribute IHtmlAttributeCollection.this[int index] => this[index];

		protected int Add(HtmlAttribute element)
		{
			return base.Add(element);
		}

		protected void AddRange(HtmlAttributeCollection collection)
		{
			base.AddRange(collection);
		}

		protected int IndexOf(HtmlAttribute element)
		{
			return IndexOf((object)element);
		}

		protected void Insert(int index, HtmlAttribute element)
		{
			base.Insert(index, element);
		}

		protected void Remove(HtmlAttribute element)
		{
			base.Remove(element);
		}

		protected HtmlAttribute Find(HtmlAttribute element)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(element);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return this[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected bool Contains(HtmlAttribute element)
		{
			return Find(element) != null;
		}

		protected override NodeList CreateInstance()
		{
			return new HtmlAttributeCollection();
		}

		int IHtmlAttributeCollection.IndexOf(IHtmlAttribute attribute)
		{
			return IndexOf(attribute);
		}
	}

	public class HtmlElement : XmlElement, IHtmlElement, IXmlElement, IXmlNode, IElement, IMarkupElement
	{
		private HtmlElementType _HtmlElementType;

		private bool _IsEmptyTag;

		private SourceRange _InnerRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private SourceRange _NameRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private SourceRange _CloseTagNameRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private HtmlAttributeCollection _Attributes;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.HtmlElement;

		public bool IsEmptyTag
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsEmptyTag;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsEmptyTag = value;
			}
		}

		public HtmlElementType HtmlElementType
		{
			get
			{
				return _HtmlElementType;
			}
			set
			{
				_HtmlElementType = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange InnerRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_InnerRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_InnerRange = value;
			}
		}

		public HtmlAttributeCollection Attributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Attributes == null)
				{
					_Attributes = new HtmlAttributeCollection();
				}
				return _Attributes;
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = (TextRange)value;
			}
		}

		public virtual SourceRange CloseTagNameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GetTransformedRange(_CloseTagNameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_CloseTagNameRange = (TextRange)value;
			}
		}

		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public override bool HasDelimitedBlock
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.HasDelimitedBlock && base.HasCloseTag)
				{
					return !IsEmptyTag;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		IHtmlAttributeCollection IHtmlElement.Attributes => _Attributes;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is HtmlElement)
				{
					HtmlElement htmlElement = (HtmlElement)source;
					_NameRange = htmlElement.NameRange;
					_HtmlElementType = htmlElement._HtmlElementType;
					_IsEmptyTag = htmlElement._IsEmptyTag;
					_InnerRange = htmlElement.InnerRange;
					_CloseTagNameRange = htmlElement.CloseTagNameRange;
					_Attributes = new HtmlAttributeCollection();
					ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, htmlElement.DetailNodes, _Attributes, htmlElement.Attributes);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
			_InnerRange = InnerRange;
			_CloseTagNameRange = CloseTagNameRange;
		}

		protected string GetAttributeValue(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = Attributes[name];
			if (htmlAttribute != null && htmlAttribute.Value != null)
			{
				return htmlAttribute.Value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected void SetAttributeValue(string name, string value, QuoteType quoteType)
		{
			if (name != null && value != null)
			{
				HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = Attributes[name];
				if (htmlAttribute == null)
				{
					htmlAttribute = new HtmlAttribute();
					htmlAttribute.Name = name;
					htmlAttribute.AttributeQuoteType = quoteType;
					AddDetailNode(htmlAttribute);
					Attributes.Add(htmlAttribute);
				}
				htmlAttribute.Value = value;
			}
		}

		protected void SetAttributeValue(string name, string value)
		{
			SetAttributeValue(name, value, QuoteType.DoubleQuote);
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 134;
		}

		public HtmlElement FindHtmlElementByType(HtmlElementType type)
		{
			if (base.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < base.NodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (Nodes[i] is HtmlElement)
				{
					HtmlElement htmlElement = Nodes[i] as HtmlElement;
					if (htmlElement.HtmlElementType == type)
					{
						return htmlElement;
					}
					HtmlElement htmlElement2 = htmlElement.FindHtmlElementByType(type);
					if (htmlElement2 != null)
					{
						return htmlElement2;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void AddAttribute(string name, string value)
		{
			SetAttributeValue(name, value);
		}

		public void AddAttribute(string name, string value, QuoteType quoteType)
		{
			SetAttributeValue(name, value, quoteType);
		}

					return PageLanguageType.VB;

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public enum ActiveHtmlTagPart
	{
		Property,
		Qualifier,
		None
	}
	public class ServerControlElement : HtmlElement, IMarkupElement
	{
		private ActiveHtmlTagPart _ActiveHtmlTagPart = ActiveHtmlTagPart.None;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ActiveHtmlTagPart ActiveHtmlTagPart => _ActiveHtmlTagPart;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ServerControlElement;

		public string TagPrefix
		{
			get
			{
				if (InternalName == null || InternalName.Length == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				int num = InternalName.IndexOf(":");
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return InternalName.Substring(0, num);
			}
		}

		public string TagName
		{
			get
			{
				if (InternalName == null || InternalName.Length == 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				int num = InternalName.IndexOf(":");
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return InternalName.Substring(num + 1);
			}
		}

		public SourceRange TagNameRange
		{
			get
			{
				string tagName = TagName;
				if (tagName == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				SourcePoint end = NameRange.End;
				SourcePoint start = new SourcePoint(end.Line, end.Offset - tagName.Length);
				return new SourceRange(start, end);
			}
		}

		public SourceRange TagPrefixRange
		{
			get
			{
				string tagPrefix = TagPrefix;
				if (tagPrefix == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				SourcePoint start = NameRange.Start;
				return new SourceRange(end: new SourcePoint(start.Line, start.Offset + tagPrefix.Length), start: start);
			}
		}

		public SourceRange CloseNameRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.HasCloseTag)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				SourceRange nameRange = NameRange;
				int num = nameRange.End.Offset - nameRange.Start.Offset;
				SourcePoint end = base.Range.End;
				int line = end.Line;
				int offset = end.Offset;
				return new SourceRange(line, offset - num - 1, line, offset - 1);
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange CloseTagNameRange
		{
			get
			{
				string tagName = TagName;
				if (!base.HasCloseTag || tagName == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				SourcePoint end = CloseNameRange.End;
				SourcePoint start = new SourcePoint(end.Line, end.Offset - tagName.Length);
				return new SourceRange(start, end);
			}
		}

		public SourceRange CloseTagPrefixRange
		{
			get
			{
				string tagPrefix = TagPrefix;
				if (!base.HasCloseTag || tagPrefix == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				SourcePoint start = CloseNameRange.Start;
				return new SourceRange(end: new SourcePoint(start.Line, start.Offset + tagPrefix.Length), start: start);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void EvaluateActivePart(SourcePoint activePoint)
		{
			SourceRange qualifierRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange propertyRange = GetPropertyRange(out qualifierRange);
			if (!SetActivePart(activePoint, propertyRange, qualifierRange))
			{
				qualifierRange = SourceRange.Empty;
				propertyRange = GetClosePropertyRange(out qualifierRange);
				SetActivePart(activePoint, propertyRange, qualifierRange);
			}
		}

		private bool SetActivePart(SourcePoint activePoint, SourceRange propertyRange, SourceRange qualifierRange)
		{
			if (propertyRange == SourceRange.Empty || qualifierRange == SourceRange.Empty)
			{
				_ActiveHtmlTagPart = ActiveHtmlTagPart.None;
				return true;
			}
			if (propertyRange.Contains(activePoint))
			{
				_ActiveHtmlTagPart = ActiveHtmlTagPart.Property;
				return true;
			}
			if (qualifierRange.Contains(activePoint))
			{
				_ActiveHtmlTagPart = ActiveHtmlTagPart.Qualifier;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 132;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ServerControlElement serverControlElement = new ServerControlElement();
			serverControlElement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return serverControlElement;
		}

		public SourceRange GetPropertyRange(out SourceRange qualifierRange)
		{
			qualifierRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourcePoint end = NameRange.End;
			return GetPropertyRangeCore(end, out qualifierRange);
		}

		public SourceRange GetClosePropertyRange(out SourceRange qualifierRange)
		{
			SourcePoint end = base.Range.End;
			int line = end.Line;
			int offset = end.Offset;
			return GetPropertyRangeCore(new SourcePoint(line, offset - 1), out qualifierRange);
		}

		private SourceRange GetPropertyRangeCore(SourcePoint end, out SourceRange qualifierRange)
		{
			qualifierRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			string qualifierName = null;
			string propertyName = GetPropertyName(out qualifierName);
			if (propertyName == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourcePoint start = new SourcePoint(end.Line, end.Offset - propertyName.Length);
			if (qualifierName != null)
			{
				SourcePoint end2 = new SourcePoint(start.Line, start.Offset - 1);
				SourcePoint start2 = new SourcePoint(end2.Line, end2.Offset - qualifierName.Length);
				qualifierRange = new SourceRange(start2, end2);
			}
			return new SourceRange(start, end);
		}

		public string GetPropertyName(out string qualifierName)
		{
			qualifierName = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(InternalName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<char> list = new List<char>();
			List<char> list2 = new List<char>();
			int num = InternalName.Length - 1;
			bool flag = false;
			char c = InternalName[num];
			while (c != ':' || char.IsLetter(c) || c == '.')
			{
				if (c == '.')
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						return null;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					list2.Add(c);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(c);
				}
				num--;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				c = InternalName[num];
			}
			if (list2.Count > 0)
			{
				list2.Reverse();
				qualifierName = new string(list2.ToArray());
			}
			else
			{
				qualifierName = null;
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				list.Reverse();
				return new string(list.ToArray());
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AccessSpecifiedElement : DelimiterCapableBlock, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IGenericElement, IMemberElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier, IGenericElementModifier
	{
		private bool _IsDefaultVisibility = true;

		public AccessSpecifiers AccessSpecifiers

			}

			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (Visibility != MemberVisibility.Public && Visibility != MemberVisibility.Protected)
				{
					return Visibility == MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (Visibility != MemberVisibility.Internal)
				{
					return Visibility == MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (Visibility != MemberVisibility.Protected)
				{
					return Visibility == MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				return _Visibility;
			}
			set
			{
				SetVisibility(value);
			}
		}

		private bool IsProtectedOrInternal(MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			if (visibility != MemberVisibility.Protected)
			{
				return visibility == MemberVisibility.Internal;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanSetProtectedInternalVisibility(MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			if (!IsProtectedOrInternal(_Visibility))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsProtectedOrInternal(visibility))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsDefaultVisibility)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void EnsureAccessSpecifiers()
		{
			if (_AccessSpecifiers == null)
			{
				_AccessSpecifiers = new AccessSpecifiers();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetVisibility(MemberVisibility visibility, Token token)
		{
			if (CanSetProtectedInternalVisibility(visibility))
			{
				_Visibility = MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal;
				EnsureAccessSpecifiers();
				_AccessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRangeEnd(token);
			}
			else
			{
				_Visibility = visibility;
				EnsureAccessSpecifiers();
				_AccessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(token);
			}
			_IsDefaultVisibility = false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetVisibility(MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			_Visibility = visibility;
			_IsDefaultVisibility = false;
