		public override void SetHistory(int index, DocumentHistorySlice history, bool isRecursive)
		{
			EnsureAccessSpecifiers();
			_AccessSpecifiers.SetHistory(history);
			base.SetHistory(index, history, isRecursive);
		}

		public override void ClearHistory()
		{
			if (History != null)
			{
				if (_AccessSpecifiers != null)
				{
					_AccessSpecifiers.ClearHistory();
				}
				base.ClearHistory();
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_GenericModifier = null;
			_GenericTemplate = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_GenericModifier == oldElement && newElement is GenericModifier)
			{
				_GenericModifier = (GenericModifier)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool GetCanBeDocumented()
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void SetParent(LanguageElement parent)
		{
			base.SetParent(parent);
			if (parent != null)
			{
				if (_Visibility == MemberVisibility.Illegal)
				{
					_Visibility = parent.GetDefaultVisibility();
					_IsDefaultVisibility = true;
				}
				_ValidVisiblities = parent.GetValidVisibilities();
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AccessSpecifiedElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			AccessSpecifiedElement accessSpecifiedElement = (AccessSpecifiedElement)source;
			if (options.KeepAccessSpecifierTemplate)
			{
				GenericTemplate = accessSpecifiedElement;
			}
			_NameRange = accessSpecifiedElement.NameRange;
			_IsDefaultVisibility = accessSpecifiedElement._IsDefaultVisibility;
			_StorageClassSpecifier = accessSpecifiedElement.StorageClassSpecifier;
			_Visibility = accessSpecifiedElement._Visibility;
			if (accessSpecifiedElement._ValidVisiblities != null)
			{
				_ValidVisiblities = new MemberVisibility[accessSpecifiedElement._ValidVisiblities.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < accessSpecifiedElement._ValidVisiblities.Length; i++)
				{
					_ValidVisiblities[i] = accessSpecifiedElement._ValidVisiblities[i];
				}
			}
			if (accessSpecifiedElement.HasAccessSpecifiers)
			{
				_AccessSpecifiers = accessSpecifiedElement._AccessSpecifiers.Clone();
			}
			if (accessSpecifiedElement.GenericModifier != null)
			{
				_GenericModifier = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, accessSpecifiedElement, accessSpecifiedElement.GenericModifier) as GenericModifier;
				if (_GenericModifier == null)
				{
					_GenericModifier = accessSpecifiedElement.GenericModifier.Clone(options) as GenericModifier;
				}
			}
			if (accessSpecifiedElement._NameQualifier != null)
			{
				_NameQualifier = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, accessSpecifiedElement, accessSpecifiedElement.NameQualifier) as Expression;
				if (_NameQualifier == null)
				{
					_NameQualifier = accessSpecifiedElement.NameQualifier.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		protected virtual IExpressionCollection GetImplementExpressions()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public void SetNameRange(SourceRange nameRange)
		{
			_NameRange = nameRange;
		}

		public virtual int GetVisibilityImageIndex()
		{
			return Visibility switch
			{
				MemberVisibility.Private => 33, 
				MemberVisibility.Protected => 35, 
				MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal => 36, 
				MemberVisibility.Internal => 28, 
				_ => 109, 
			};
		}

		public bool SupportsVisibility(MemberVisibility aMemberVisibility)
		{
			if (ValidVisibilities != null)
			{
				MemberVisibility[] validVisibilities = ValidVisibilities;
				foreach (MemberVisibility memberVisibility in validVisibilities)
				{
					if (memberVisibility == aMemberVisibility)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetGenericModifier(GenericModifier modifier)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNode(_GenericModifier, modifier);
			_GenericModifier = modifier;
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection GetUnusedDeclarations()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetUnusedDeclarations(AllVariables);
		}

		public override bool IsVisibleFrom(LanguageElement viewer)
		{
			if (base.IsVisibleFrom(viewer))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Visibility == MemberVisibility.Public)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (HasInternalAccess && InSameProject(viewer))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (HasProtectedAccess || Visibility == MemberVisibility.Private)
			{
				Class declaringType = viewer.GetDeclaringType();
				if (declaringType == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (declaringType.DeclaresMember(this))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Visibility == MemberVisibility.Private)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (declaringType.AncestorDeclaresMember(this))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetCVFlags()
		{
			if (_AccessSpecifiers != null)
			{
				_AccessSpecifiers.ResetCVFlags();
			}
		}

		public string GetOverrideCode()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetOverrideCode(this, callBase: false, string.Empty, string.Empty);
		}

		public string GetOverrideCode(bool callBase)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetOverrideCode(this, callBase, string.Empty, string.Empty);
		}

		public string GetOverrideCode(bool callBase, string codeBefore, string codeAfter)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetOverrideCode(this, callBase, codeBefore, codeAfter);
		}

		private AttributeSection CreateAttributeSection(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			AttributeSection attributeSection = new AttributeSection();
			attributeSection.AddAttribute(attribute as Attribute);
			return attributeSection;
		}

		void IHasAttributesModifier.AddAttribute(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			AddAttributeSection(CreateAttributeSection(attribute));
		}

		void IHasAttributesModifier.RemoveAttribute(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			if (base.AttributeSections == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AttributeSection attributeSection in base.AttributeSections)
			{
				if (attributeSection != null && attributeSection.AttributeCollection.Contains(attribute))
				{
					attributeSection.RemoveAttribute(attribute as Attribute);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateGenericModifierIfNeeded()
		{
			if (_GenericModifier == null)
			{
				SetGenericModifier(new GenericModifier());
			}
		}

		void IGenericElementModifier.AddTypeParameter(ITypeParameter typeParameter)
		{
			CreateGenericModifierIfNeeded();
			GenericModifier.AddTypeParameter(typeParameter as TypeParameter);
		}

		void IGenericElementModifier.InsertTypeParameter(int index, ITypeParameter typeParameter)
		{
			CreateGenericModifierIfNeeded();
			GenericModifier.InsertTypeParameter(index, typeParameter as TypeParameter);
		}

		void IGenericElementModifier.RemoveTypeParameter(ITypeParameter typeParameter)
		{
			CreateGenericModifierIfNeeded();
			GenericModifier.RemoveTypeParameter(typeParameter as TypeParameter);
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum AccessSpecifiersFlags
	{
		None = 0,
		Abstract = 1,
		Override = 2,
		ReadOnly = 4,
		Static = 8,
		Extern = 0x10,
		Virtual = 0x20,
		New = 0x40,
		Volatile = 0x80,
		Sealed = 0x100,
		Unsafe = 0x200,
		WithEvents = 0x400,
		WriteOnly = 0x800,
		Default = 0x1000,
		Overloads = 0x2000,
		Auto = 0x4000,
		Register = 0x8000,
		VTable = 0x10000,
		Inline = 0x20000,
		Explicit = 0x40000,
		Friend = 0x80000,
		TypeDef = 0x100000,
		Mutable = 0x200000,
		Const = 0x400000,
		ConstVolatile = 0x800000,
		Partial = 0x1000000,
		PureVirtual = 0x2000000,
		Async = 0x4000000,
		Iterator = 0x8000000
	}

		private void Set(ref TextRangeWrapper range, Token token)
		{
			range = token.Range;
		}

		private void Set(ref TextRangeWrapper range, SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			range = sourceRange;
		}

		private void SetEnd(ref TextRangeWrapper range, SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (range == null)
			{
				range = new TextRangeWrapper(new TextRange(default(TextPoint), point));
			}
			else
			{
				range.Range.SetEnd(point);
			}
		}

		private void SetEnd(ref TextRangeWrapper range, Token token)
		{
			TextPoint end = new TextPoint(token.Line, token.EndColumn);
			if (range == null)
			{
				range = new TextRangeWrapper(new TextRange(default(TextPoint), end));
			}
			else
			{
				range.Range.SetEnd(end);
			}
		}

		private SourceRange Get(TextRangeWrapper range)
		{
			SourceRange sourceRange = range;
			if (_History == null)
			{
				return sourceRange;
			}
			if (sourceRange == SourceRange.Empty)
			{
				return sourceRange;
			}
			return _History.Transform(sourceRange);
		}

		{
			if (_History == null)
			{
				_History = history;
			}
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public AccessSpecifiers Clone()
		{
			AccessSpecifiers accessSpecifiers = new AccessSpecifiers();
			accessSpecifiers.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(VirtualOverrideAbstractRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetVirtualRange(VirtualRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetOverrideRange(OverrideRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetAbstractRange(AbstractRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetStaticRange(StaticRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetUnsafeRange(UnsafeRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetNewRange(NewRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetSealedRange(SealedRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetReadOnlyRange(ReadOnlyRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetExternRange(ExternRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetVolatileRange(VolatileRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetWithEventsRange(WithEventsRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetWriteOnlyRange(WriteOnlyRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetDefaultRange(DefaultRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetOverloadsRange(OverloadsRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(VisibilityRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetPartialRange(PartialRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetAutoRange(AutoRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetRegisterRange(RegisterRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetMutableRange(MutableRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetInlineRange(InlineRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetExplicitRange(ExplicitRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetFriendRange(FriendRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetTypeDefRange(TypeDefRange);
			accessSpecifiers.SetAsynchronousRange(AsynchronousRange);
			accessSpecifiers._Specifiers = _Specifiers;
			return accessSpecifiers;
		}

		protected void UpdateRanges()
		{
			_VisibilityRange = VisibilityRange;
			_VirtualOverrideAbstractRange = VirtualOverrideAbstractRange;
			_VirtualRange = VirtualRange;
			_OverrideRange = OverrideRange;
			_AbstractRange = AbstractRange;
			_StaticRange = StaticRange;
			_UnsafeRange = UnsafeRange;
			_NewRange = NewRange;
			_SealedRange = SealedRange;
			_ReadOnlyRange = ReadOnlyRange;
			_ExternRange = ExternRange;
			_VolatileRange = VolatileRange;
			_WithEventsRange = WithEventsRange;
			_WriteOnlyRange = WriteOnlyRange;
			_DefaultRange = DefaultRange;
			_OverloadsRange = OverloadsRange;
			_PartialRange = PartialRange;
			_AsynchronousRange = AsynchronousRange;
			_IteratorRange = IteratorRange;
			_AutoRange = AutoRange;
			_RegisterRange = RegisterRange;
			_MutableRange = MutableRange;
			_InlineRange = InlineRange;
			_ExplicitRange = ExplicitRange;
			_FriendRange = FriendRange;
			_TypeDefRange = TypeDefRange;
		}

		public bool SpecifierIsSet(AccessSpecifiersFlags flag)
		{
			return (_Specifiers & flag) == flag;
		}

		public void SetSpecifierValue(AccessSpecifiersFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			_Specifiers = (value ? (_Specifiers | flag) : (_Specifiers & ~flag));
		}

		public void ResetCVFlags()
		{
			_Specifiers &= ~AccessSpecifiersFlags.Const;
			_Specifiers &= ~AccessSpecifiersFlags.ConstVolatile;
			_Specifiers &= ~AccessSpecifiersFlags.Volatile;
		}
	}
	public class Const : InitializedValue
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Const;

		public Expression Value
		{
			get
			{
				return base.Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Expression = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsConst => true;

		public Const()
		{
			IsConst = true;
		}

		public Const(string name)
			: this(string.Empty, name)
		{
		}

		public Const(string type, string name)
			: this(type, name, null)
		{
		}

		public Const(string type, string name, Expression expr)
			: base(type, name, expr)
		{
			IsConst = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return InternalName;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return 63;
			}
			return 62;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Const obj = new Const();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class ConstVolatile : Const
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ConstVolatile;

		public ConstVolatile()
		{
			IsConstVolatile = true;
		}

		public ConstVolatile(string name)
			: this(name, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public ConstVolatile(string type, string name)
			: this(type, name, null)
		{
		}

		public ConstVolatile(string type, string name, Expression expr)
			: base(type, name, expr)
		{
			IsConstVolatile = true;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ConstVolatile constVolatile = new ConstVolatile();
			constVolatile.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return constVolatile;
		}
	}
	public abstract class Member : AccessSpecifiedElement, IHasType
	{
		private string _Signature = string.Empty;

		private SourceRange _TypeRange;

		private string _MemberType;

		private TypeReferenceExpression _MemberTypeReference;

		private SourceRange _AsRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private PostponedParsingData _PostponedData;

		private StringCollection _Implements;

		private ExpressionCollection _ImplementsExpressions;

		private ExpressionCollection _HandlesExpressions;

		private bool _IsExplicitInterfaceMember;

		private SourceRange _ConstRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private bool _Unclosed;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool Unclosed
		{
			get
			{
				return _Unclosed;
			}
			set
			{
				_Unclosed = value;
			}
		}

		protected override PostponedParsingData PostponedData
		{
			get
			{
				return _PostponedData;
			}
			set
			{
				_PostponedData = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("The type of this member or method.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		public string MemberType
		{
			get
			{
				return _MemberType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(_MemberType == value))
				{
					_MemberType = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("The type of this member or method.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		public TypeReferenceExpression MemberTypeReference
		{
			get
			{
				return _MemberTypeReference;
			}
			set
			{
				_MemberTypeReference = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("The SourceRange of this member type.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public SourceRange TypeRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_TypeRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_TypeRange = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("The signature of this member.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public string Signature
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Signature == string.Empty)
				{
					_Signature = GetFullSignature();
				}
				return _Signature;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this member is explicitly declared interface member.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public override bool IsExplicitInterfaceMember
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsExplicitInterfaceMember;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsExplicitInterfaceMember = value;
			}
		}

		[Category("Details")]
		public StringCollection Implements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Implements == null)
				{
					_Implements = new StringCollection();
				}
				return _Implements;
			}
		}

		[Category("Details")]
		public int ImplementsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Implements == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Implements.Count;
			}
		}

		[Category("Details")]
		public ExpressionCollection ImplementsExpressions => _ImplementsExpressions;

		[Category("Details")]
		public ExpressionCollection HandlesExpressions => _HandlesExpressions;

		public SourceRange ConstRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_ConstRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_ConstRange = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange AsRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_AsRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_AsRange = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("True if the visibility of this member can not be changed (e.g., illegal, param, local, or if this is a static constructor).")]
		[Category("Access")]
		public override bool VisibilityIsFixed
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsExplicitInterfaceMember || base.InsideInterface)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.VisibilityIsFixed;
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpression IHasType.Type => MemberTypeReference;

		public Member()
		{
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_MemberTypeReference = null;
			_ImplementsExpressions = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_MemberTypeReference == oldElement)
			{
				_MemberTypeReference = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
				if (_MemberTypeReference == null)
				{
					_MemberType = string.Empty;
				}
				else
				{
					_MemberType = _MemberTypeReference.FullSignature;
				}
			}
			else if (_ImplementsExpressions != null && _ImplementsExpressions.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_ImplementsExpressions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else if (_HandlesExpressions != null && _HandlesExpressions.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_HandlesExpressions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected string GetFullSignature()
		{
			string parentPath = ParentPath;
			string signature = GetSignature();
			if (signature != string.Empty)
			{
				if (parentPath != string.Empty)
				{
					return parentPath + "/" + signature;
				}
				return signature;
			}
			return parentPath;
		}

		protected virtual string GetSignature()
		{
			return PathSegment;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Member))
			{
				return;
			}
			Member member = (Member)source;
			_Signature = member._Signature;
			_TypeRange = member.TypeRange;
			_AsRange = member.AsRange;
			_ConstRange = member.ConstRange;
			_Unclosed = member.Unclosed;
			_MemberType = member._MemberType;
			_MemberTypeReference = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, member, member._MemberTypeReference) as TypeReferenceExpression;
			if (_MemberTypeReference == null && member._MemberTypeReference != null)
			{
				_MemberTypeReference = member._MemberTypeReference.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
			}
			if (member._Implements != null)
			{
				_Implements = new StringCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < member._Implements.Count; i++)
				{
					_Implements.Add(member._Implements[i]);
				}
			}
			if (member._ImplementsExpressions != null)
			{
				_ImplementsExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, member.DetailNodes, _ImplementsExpressions, member._ImplementsExpressions);
				if (_ImplementsExpressions.Count == 0 && member._ImplementsExpressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_ImplementsExpressions = member._ImplementsExpressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (member._HandlesExpressions != null)
			{
				_HandlesExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, member.DetailNodes, _HandlesExpressions, member._HandlesExpressions);
				if (_HandlesExpressions.Count == 0 && member._HandlesExpressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_HandlesExpressions = member._HandlesExpressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			_IsExplicitInterfaceMember = member._IsExplicitInterfaceMember;
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_TypeRange = TypeRange;
			_AsRange = AsRange;
			_ConstRange = ConstRange;
		}

		protected override IExpressionCollection GetImplementExpressions()
		{
			return ImplementsExpressions;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return 44;
			}
			if (this is IVariableDeclarationStatement && ((IVariableDeclarationStatement)this).IsFixedSizeBuffer)
			{
				return 64;
			}
			return 19;
		}

		public override string GetTypeName()
		{
			return MemberType;
		}

		public void AddImplementsExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				string value = expression.ToString();
				if (_ImplementsExpressions == null)
				{
					_ImplementsExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				_ImplementsExpressions.Add(expression);
				Implements.Add(value);
				AddDetailNode(expression);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public string GetNameWithoutImplementsQualifier()
		{
			if (ImplementsCount <= 0)
			{
				return Name;
			}
			return ImplementsExpressions[0].Name;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveImplementsExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				string value = expression.ToString();
				if (_ImplementsExpressions != null)
				{
					_ImplementsExpressions.Remove(expression);
				}
				Implements.Remove(value);
				RemoveDetailNode(expression);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddHandlesExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (_HandlesExpressions == null)
				{
					_HandlesExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				_HandlesExpressions.Add(expression);
				AddDetailNode(expression);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveHandlesExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (_HandlesExpressions != null)
				{
					_HandlesExpressions.Remove(expression);
				}
				RemoveDetailNode(expression);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetMemberTypeReference(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (type != null)
			{
				MemberTypeReference = type;
				AddDetailNode(type);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool Is(string fullTypeName)
		{
			if (MemberTypeReference == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MemberTypeReference.Is(fullTypeName);
		}

		public virtual bool Is(ITypeElement type)
		{
			if (MemberTypeReference == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MemberTypeReference.Is(type);
		}

		public virtual bool Is(Type type)
		{
			if (MemberTypeReference == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MemberTypeReference.Is(type);
		}

		public virtual bool Is(ISourceTreeResolver resolver, string fullTypeName)
		{
			if (MemberTypeReference == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MemberTypeReference.Is(resolver, fullTypeName);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void SetAccessSpecifiers(AccessSpecifiers specifiers)
		{
			base.SetAccessSpecifiers(specifiers);
			if (base.AccessSpecifiers != null)
			{
				CheckVisibilities();
			}
		}

		private void CheckVisibilities()
		{
			if (!base.IsVirtual && !base.IsAbstract)
			{
				return;
			}
			MemberVisibility[] validVisibilities = ValidVisibilities;
			if (validVisibilities == null || validVisibilities.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			MemberVisibility[] array = validVisibilities;
			foreach (MemberVisibility memberVisibility in array)
			{
				if (memberVisibility != MemberVisibility.Private)
				{
					arrayList.Add(memberVisibility);
				}
			}
			ValidVisibilities = (MemberVisibility[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(MemberVisibility));
		}
	}
	public enum InitializerTarget : byte
	{
		Ancestor,
		ThisClass,
		Expression
	}
	public class ConstructorInitializer : CodeElement, IConstructorInitializerElement, IElement, IHasArguments, IHasParens
	{
		private InitializerTarget _Target;

		private ExpressionCollection _Arguments;

		private SourceRange _ParensRange;

		private SourceRange _NameRange;

		public bool IsBase => Target == InitializerTarget.Ancestor;

		public bool IsThis => Target == InitializerTarget.ThisClass;

		public ExpressionCollection Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
			set
			{
				SetArguments(value);
			}
		}

		public InitializerTarget Target
		{
			get
			{
				return _Target;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Target != value)
				{
					_Target = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ConstructorInitializer;

		InitializerTarget IConstructorInitializerElement.Target => Target;

		IExpressionCollection IConstructorInitializerElement.Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return Arguments;
			}
		}

		IExpression IConstructorInitializerElement.Expression
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.NodeCount == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Nodes[0] as IExpression;
			}
		}

		public int ArgumentsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Arguments.Count;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParensRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_ParensRange = value;
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		public ConstructorInitializer()
		{
			_Target = InitializerTarget.ThisClass;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 10;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.Clear();
				_Arguments = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Arguments != null && _Arguments.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Arguments.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected void SetIsBase(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				Target = InitializerTarget.Ancestor;
			}
			else
			{
				Target = InitializerTarget.ThisClass;
			}
		}

		protected void SetIsThis(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				Target = InitializerTarget.ThisClass;
			}
			else
			{
				Target = InitializerTarget.Ancestor;
			}
		}

		protected void SetArguments(ExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			_Arguments = arguments;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ConstructorInitializer))
			{
				return;
			}
			ConstructorInitializer constructorInitializer = (ConstructorInitializer)source;
			_Target = constructorInitializer._Target;
			_ParensRange = constructorInitializer.ParensRange;
			_NameRange = constructorInitializer.NameRange;
			if (constructorInitializer._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, constructorInitializer.DetailNodes, _Arguments, constructorInitializer._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && constructorInitializer._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = constructorInitializer._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ConstructorInitializer constructorInitializer = new ConstructorInitializer();
			constructorInitializer.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return constructorInitializer;
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Add(arg);
			AddDetailNode(arg);
		}
	}
	public abstract class MemberWithParameters : Member, IHasParens, IHasParameters, IWithParameters, IWithParametersModifier
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _Parameters;

		private TextRangeWrapper _ParensRange;

		[Description("The parameters to this element.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public LanguageElementCollection Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					_Parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _Parameters;
			}
		}

		[Description("The number of parameters declared by this element.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public int ParameterCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Parameters.Count;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable AllParameters => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Param));

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParensRange == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParensRange);
			}
		}

		IParameterElementCollection IWithParameters.Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIParameterElementCollection;
				}
				LiteParameterElementCollection liteParameterElementCollection = new LiteParameterElementCollection();
				liteParameterElementCollection.AddRange(_Parameters);
				return liteParameterElementCollection;
			}
		}

		public MemberWithParameters()
		{
		}

		private void AddAttributeSections()
		{
			if (_Parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = _Parameters.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (_Parameters[i] is Param { AttributeSections: var attributeSections } param)
				{
					AddAttributeSections(param, attributeSections);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddAttributeSections(Param param, NodeList nodeList)
		{
			if (param == null || nodeList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = nodeList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (nodeList[i] is AttributeSection element)
				{
					param.AddSupportElement(element);
				}
			}
		}

		void IWithParametersModifier.AddParameter(IParameterElement parameter)
		{
			AddParameter(parameter as Param);
		}

		void IWithParametersModifier.RemoveParameter(IParameterElement parameter)
		{
			RemoveParameter(parameter as Param);
		}

		void IWithParametersModifier.InsertParameter(int index, IParameterElement parameter)
		{
			InsertParameter(index, parameter as Param);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is MemberWithParameters))
			{
				return;
			}
			MemberWithParameters memberWithParameters = (MemberWithParameters)source;
			_Parameters = null;
			if (memberWithParameters._Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, memberWithParameters.DetailNodes, _Parameters, memberWithParameters._Parameters);
				if (_Parameters.Count == 0 && memberWithParameters._Parameters.Count > 0)
				{
					_Parameters = memberWithParameters._Parameters.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
			if (memberWithParameters._ParensRange != null)
			{
				SetParensRange(memberWithParameters.ParensRange);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters.Clear();
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (_Parameters != null)
			{
				num = _Parameters.IndexOf(oldElement);
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				_Parameters.RemoveAt(num);
				if (newElement != null)
				{
					_Parameters.Insert(num, newElement);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (_Parameters != parameters)
			{
				_Parameters = parameters;
			}
		}

		public Param GetParameter(string name)
		{
			if (_Parameters == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = _Parameters.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (_Parameters[i] is Param param && IdentifiersMatch(param.Name, name))
				{
					return param;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Param GetParameter(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_Parameters == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_Parameters.Count <= index)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _Parameters[index] as Param;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(Token parenOpen, Token parenClose)
		{
			SetParensRange(new SourceRange(parenOpen.Range.Start, parenClose.Range.End));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			if (range.IsEmpty)
			{
				_ParensRange = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_ParensRange = range;
			}
		}

		public void AddParameter(Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Add(parameter);
				AddDetailNode(parameter);
			}
		}

		public void AddParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				AddParameter(parameter as Param);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveParameter(Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Remove(parameter);
				RemoveDetailNode(parameter);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				RemoveParameter(parameter as Param);
			}
		}

		public void InsertParameter(int index, Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Insert(index, parameter);
				InsertDetailNode(index, parameter);
			}
		}
	}

		public override MemberVisibility[] ValidVisibilities
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsExplicitInterfaceMember || base.IsPartial)
				{
					return EmptyVisibilityArray.Value;
				}
				if (IsClassOperator)
				{
					return new MemberVisibility[1] { MemberVisibility.Public };
				}
				MemberVisibility[] validVisibilities = base.ValidVisibilities;
				if (base.IsOverride | base.IsVirtual)
				{
					validVisibilities = base.ValidVisibilities;
					if (validVisibilities == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					List<MemberVisibility> list = new List<MemberVisibility>();
					MemberVisibility[] array = validVisibilities;
					foreach (MemberVisibility memberVisibility in array)
					{
						if (memberVisibility != MemberVisibility.Private)
						{
							list.Add(memberVisibility);
						}
					}
					return list.ToArray();
				}
				return validVisibilities;
			}
		}

		[Description("True if the visibility of this member can not be changed (e.g., illegal, param, local, or if this is a static constructor).")]
		[Category("Access")]
		public override bool VisibilityIsFixed
		{
			get
			{
				if ((IsStatic && IsConstructor) || IsDestructor || IsClassOperator)
				{

				return base.VisibilityIsFixed;
			}

			: this()

		private bool NeedToBackOut(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Class && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Interface && element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Struct)
			{
				return element.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Module;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Local;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(base.MemberType + " " + InternalName + "(");
			if (base.Parameters != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Parameters.Count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0} {1}{2}", ((Param)base.Parameters[i]).ParamType, ((Param)base.Parameters[i]).InternalName, (i == base.Parameters.Count - 1) ? string.Empty : ",");
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(")");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (_MethodType == MethodTypeEnum.Constructor)
			{
				if (IsStatic)
				{
					return 43;
				}
				return 10;
			}
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return 46;
			}
			return 30;
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return 1 + GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		public override bool RangeIsClean(SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			if (sourceRange.Top > base.BlockStart.Bottom)
			{
				return sourceRange.Bottom < base.BlockEnd.Top;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Method method = new Method();
			method.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return method;
		}

		protected bool FlagIsSet(MethodFlags flag)
		{
			return (_MethodFlags & flag) == flag;
		}

		protected void SetFlagValue(MethodFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			_MethodFlags = (value ? (_MethodFlags | flag) : ((MethodFlags)((uint)_MethodFlags & (uint)(byte)(~(int)flag))));
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Method)
				{
					Method method = (Method)source;
					_MethodType = method._MethodType;
					_MethodFlags = method._MethodFlags;
					_Lib = method._Lib;
					_Alias = method._Alias;
					_IsConst = method._IsConst;
					_IsMemberFunctionConst = method.IsMemberFunctionConst;
					_CallingConvention = method._CallingConvention;
					_OverloadsOperator = method._OverloadsOperator;
					_CharsetModifier = method._CharsetModifier;
					_ParamOpenRange = method.ParamOpenRange;
					_ParamCloseRange = method.ParamCloseRange;
					_MethodKeyWordRange = method.MethodKeyWordRange;
					_GenerateCodeBlock = method._GenerateCodeBlock;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_ParamOpenRange = ParamOpenRange;
			_ParamCloseRange = ParamCloseRange;
			_MethodKeyWordRange = MethodKeyWordRange;
		}

		public Method CreateMethod()
		{
			Method method = new Method();
			method.CloneDataFrom(this, ElementCloneOptions.Default);
			method.RemoveAllNodes();
			return method;
		}

		public MethodPrototype CreateMethodPrototype()
		{
			MethodPrototype methodPrototype = new MethodPrototype(base.MemberType, Name);
			if (base.MemberTypeReference != null)
			{
				methodPrototype.MemberTypeReference = base.MemberTypeReference.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression;
			}
			methodPrototype.MemberType = base.MemberType;
			methodPrototype.MethodType = MethodType;
			methodPrototype.IsConst = IsConst;
			methodPrototype.IsMemberFunctionConst = IsMemberFunctionConst;
			if (base.AccessSpecifiers != null)
			{
				methodPrototype.AccessSpecifiers = base.AccessSpecifiers.Clone();
			}
			int parameterCount = base.ParameterCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < parameterCount; i++)
			{
				methodPrototype.Parameters.Add(base.Parameters[i].Clone() as Param);
			}
			return methodPrototype;
		}

		public AnonymousMethodExpression CreateAnonymousMethod()
		{
			AnonymousMethodExpression anonymousMethodExpression = new AnonymousMethodExpression();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ParameterCount; i++)
			{
				anonymousMethodExpression.AddParameter(base.Parameters[i].Clone() as Param);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < base.NodeCount; j++)
			{
				anonymousMethodExpression.AddNode((Nodes[j] as LanguageElement).Clone() as LanguageElement);
			}
			return anonymousMethodExpression;
		}

		public bool IsEventHandler()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsEventHandler(this);
		}

		public bool IsMainProcedure()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsMainProcedure(this);
		}

		public bool IsInitializeComponent()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsInitializeComponent(this);
		}

		private bool ContainsFlag(MethodCharacteristics options, MethodCharacteristics flag)
		{
			return (options & flag) == flag;
		}

		private bool CheckInteriorPtrPointer()
		{
			if (base.MemberTypeReference != null)
			{
				return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsInteriorPtrPointer(base.MemberTypeReference);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckPinPtrPointer()
		{
			if (base.MemberTypeReference != null)
			{
				return StructuralParserServicesHolder.IsInteriorPtrPointer(base.MemberTypeReference);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ContainsMethod(ITypeElement baseType, Method method)
		{
			IElementFilter memberSignatureFilter = StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetMemberSignatureFilter(this);
			IMemberElementCollection memberElementCollection = baseType.FindMembers(method.Name, memberSignatureFilter, searchInAncestors: false);
			if (memberElementCollection != null)
			{
				return memberElementCollection.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckInterfaceImplementor()
		{
			if (base.ImplementsCount > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Visibility != MemberVisibility.Public)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Class parentClass = GetParentClass();
			if (parentClass == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ITypeElement[] allBaseTypes = StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetAllBaseTypes(parentClass);
			if (allBaseTypes == null || allBaseTypes.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = allBaseTypes.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				ITypeElement typeElement = allBaseTypes[i] as IInterfaceElement;
				if (typeElement != null && ContainsMethod(typeElement, this))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckInClass()
		{
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = base.Parent.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.Class && elementType != LanguageElementType.ManagedClass)
			{
				return elementType == LanguageElementType.ValueClass;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckInStruct()
		{
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = base.Parent.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.Struct && elementType != LanguageElementType.ValueStruct)
			{
				return elementType == LanguageElementType.ManagedStruct;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckInModule()
		{
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Module;
		}

		private bool CheckInInterface()
		{
			if (base.Parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = base.Parent.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.Interface && elementType != LanguageElementType.InterfaceClass)
			{
				return elementType == LanguageElementType.InterfaceStruct;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool HasCharacteristics(MethodCharacteristics options)
		{
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.New) && IsNew)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.Abstract) && base.IsAbstract)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.Virtual) && base.IsVirtual)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.Override) && base.IsOverride)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.ClassOperator) && IsClassOperator)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.Extern) && base.IsExtern)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.MainProcedure) && IsMainProcedure())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.Generic) && base.IsGeneric)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.InClass) && CheckInClass())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.InStruct) && CheckInStruct())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.InModule) && CheckInModule())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.InInterface) && CheckInInterface())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.InteriorPtrPointer) && CheckInteriorPtrPointer())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.PinPtrPointer) && CheckPinPtrPointer())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.EventHandler) && IsEventHandler())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.InterfaceImplementer) && CheckInterfaceImplementor())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.IsExtensionMethod) && ((IMethodElement)this).IsExtensionMethod())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainsFlag(options, MethodCharacteristics.IsWebMethod) && IsWebMethod)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetAsRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			base.AsRange = range;
		}

		public void SetMethodKeyWordRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_MethodKeyWordRange = range;
		}

		public static bool CheckExtensionMethod(IMethodElement method)
		{
			return CheckExtensionMethod(null, method);
		}

		public static bool CheckExtensionMethod(ISourceTreeResolver resolver, IMethodElement method)
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.CheckExtensionMethod(resolver, method);
		}

		bool IMethodElement.IsExtensionMethod()
		{
			if (IsConstructor || IsDestructor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CheckExtensionMethod(this);
		}

		bool IMethodElement.IsExtensionMethod(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			if (IsConstructor || IsDestructor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CheckExtensionMethod(resolver, this);
		}

		void IMethodElementModifier.SetIsClassOperator(bool isClassOperator)
		{
			IsClassOperator = isClassOperator;
		}

		void IMethodElementModifier.SetIsExplicitCast(bool isExplicitCast)
		{
			IsExplicitCast = isExplicitCast;
		}

		void IMethodElementModifier.SetIsImplicitCast(bool isImplicitCast)
		{
			IsImplicitCast = isImplicitCast;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IMemberElement.get_Signature()
		{
			return base.Signature;
		}
	}
	public class MethodCall : Statement, IHasQualifier, IHasSource, IMethodCallStatement, IStatement, IElement, IGenericExpression, IWithSource, IWithArguments, IHasParens, IHasArguments, IWithArgumentsModifier
	{
		private Expression _Source;

		private ExpressionCollection _Arguments;

		private bool _IsBaseConstructorCall;

		private TextRangeWrapper _ParensRange;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.MethodCall;

		public Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Source;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Source != value)
				{
					SetQualifier(value);
				}
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use Qualifier instead")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Expression Source
		{
			get
			{
				return Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Qualifier != value)
				{
					Qualifier = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange => GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);

		public ExpressionCollection Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Arguments != value)
				{
					_Arguments = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this method is call to base construtor.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool IsBaseConstructorCall
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsBaseConstructorCall;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsBaseConstructorCall = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsGeneric
		{
			get
			{
				if (Qualifier is ReferenceExpressionBase)
				{
					return ((ReferenceExpressionBase)Qualifier).IsGeneric;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public TypeReferenceExpressionCollection TypeArguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (Qualifier is ReferenceExpressionBase)
				{
					return ((ReferenceExpressionBase)Qualifier).TypeArguments;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IMethodCallStatement.Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return Arguments;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IWithArguments.Args
		{
			get
			{
				if (Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return Arguments;
			}
		}

		ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection IGenericExpression.TypeArguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (TypeArguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyITypeReferenceExpressionCollection;
				}
				return TypeArguments;
			}
		}

		int IGenericExpression.TypeArity => 0;

		IExpression IWithSource.Source => Qualifier;

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParensRange == null)
				{
					return SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParensRange);
			}
		}

		ExpressionCollection IHasArguments.Arguments => Arguments;

		public int ArgumentsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Arguments.Count;
			}
		}

		public MethodCall()
		{
		}

		public MethodCall(Expression source)
		{
			SetQualifier(source);
		}

		protected void SetQualifier(Expression expression)
		{
			_Source?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Source = expression;
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				AddNode(_Source);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(_Source.ToString());
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Name);
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("(");
			string arg = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < Arguments.Count; i++)
			{
				Expression expression = Arguments[i];
				if (expression != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", arg, expression.ToString());
				}
				arg = ", ";
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(")");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 31;
		}

		public override string GetDetailNodeDescription(int index)
		{
			return "Argument";
		}

		public static MethodCall FromMethodCallExpression(MethodCallExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MethodCall methodCall = new MethodCall();
			methodCall.SourceExpression = expression;
			if (expression.Qualifier is MethodReferenceExpression)
			{
				methodCall.InternalName = expression.Name;
				methodCall._NameRange = expression.NameRange.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				methodCall.InternalName = string.Empty;
				methodCall._NameRange = TextRange.Empty;
			}
			methodCall._IsBaseConstructorCall = expression.IsBaseConstructorCall;
			expression.TransferCommentsTo(methodCall);
			if (expression.Qualifier != null)
			{
				methodCall._Source = expression.Qualifier;
			}
			methodCall.SetParensRange(expression.ParensRange);
			methodCall.SetRange(expression.Range);
			expression.TransferAllNodesTo(methodCall);
			for (int i = 0; i < expression.Arguments.Count; i++)
			{
				methodCall.Arguments.Add(expression.Arguments[i]);
			}
			methodCall.MacroCall = expression.MacroCall;
			return methodCall;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.Clear();
				_Arguments = null;
			}
			if (_Source != null)
			{
				_Source.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_Source = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Source == oldElement)
			{
				_Source = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected void SetArguments(ExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			_Arguments = arguments;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is MethodCall))
			{
				return;
			}
			MethodCall methodCall = (MethodCall)source;
			_IsBaseConstructorCall = methodCall._IsBaseConstructorCall;
			_NameRange = methodCall.NameRange;
			if (methodCall._Source != null)
			{
				_Source = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, methodCall, methodCall._Source) as Expression;
				if (_Source == null)
				{
					_Source = methodCall._Source.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (methodCall._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, methodCall.DetailNodes, _Arguments, methodCall._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && methodCall._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = methodCall._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (methodCall._ParensRange != null)
			{
				_ParensRange = methodCall.ParensRange;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			MethodCall methodCall = new MethodCall();
			methodCall.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return methodCall;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(Token parenOpen, Token parenClose)
		{
			SetParensRange(new SourceRange(parenOpen.Range.Start, parenClose.Range.End));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetParensRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			if (range.IsEmpty)
			{
				_ParensRange = null;
			}
			else
			{
				_ParensRange = range;
			}
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.AddArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			AddArgument(argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.InsertArgument(int index, IExpression argument)
		{
			InsertArgument(index, argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.RemoveArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			RemoveArgument(argument as Expression);
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Add(arg);
			AddDetailNode(arg);
		}

		public void RemoveArgument(Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Remove(arg);
			RemoveDetailNode(arg);
		}

		public void InsertArgument(int index, Expression arg)
		{
			Arguments.Insert(index, arg);
			InsertDetailNode(index, arg);
		}
	}
	public class MethodPrototype : Method, IMethodPrototypeElement, IMethodElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IGenericElement, IHasType, IWithParameters
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.MethodPrototype;

		protected MethodPrototype()
		{
		}

		public MethodPrototype(string type, string name)
			: base(type, name)
		{
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			MethodPrototype methodPrototype = new MethodPrototype();
			methodPrototype.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return methodPrototype;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IMemberElement.get_Signature()
		{
			return base.Signature;
		}
	}
	public class Param : BaseVariable, IParameterElement, IElement, IHasType, ILocalDeclaration, IBaseVariable, IParameterElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier
	{
		private const int INT_InParamMaintainanceComplexity = 1;

		private const int INT_RefOutParamMaintainanceComplexity = 2;

		private ArgumentDirection _Direction;

		private bool _IsOptional;

		private string _DefaultValue = string.Empty;

		private Expression _DefaultValueExpression;

		private SourceRange _DirectionRange;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsReferenceParam || IsOutParam)
				{
					return 2;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Parameter;

		public override bool DeclaresIdentifier => true;

		[Description("The type of this parameter.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public string ParamType
		{
			get
			{
				return base.MemberType;
			}
			set
			{
				base.MemberType = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("The default value for this parameter, if specified.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public string DefaultValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _DefaultValue;
			}
			set
			{
				_DefaultValue = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets parameter direction (in/out/ref).")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public ArgumentDirection Direction
		{
			get
			{
				return _Direction;
			}
			set
			{
				_Direction = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange DirectionRange
		{
			get
			{
				return _DirectionRange;
			}
			set
			{
				_DirectionRange = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("True if this parameter is optional.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool IsOptional
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsOptional;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsOptional = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("True if this parameter is passed by value.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool IsByVal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Direction != ArgumentDirection.In)
				{
					return Direction == ArgumentDirection.ParamArray;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("True if this parameter is passed by reference.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool IsReferenceParam => Direction == ArgumentDirection.Ref;

		[Description("True if this is an out parameter.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool IsOutParam => Direction == ArgumentDirection.Out;

		[Description("True if this parameter is an array of objects.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool IsParamArray => Direction == ArgumentDirection.ParamArray;

		bool IBaseVariable.IsParameter => true;

		IExpression IParameterElement.DefaultValue => DefaultValueExpression;

		public Expression DefaultValueExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _DefaultValueExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_DefaultValueExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsArgList => Direction == ArgumentDirection.ArgList;

		public Param()
		{
		}

		public Param(string name)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		public Param(string type, string name)
			: this(name)
		{
			base.MemberType = type;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is Param)
			{
				Param param = (Param)source;
				if (param.DefaultValueExpression != null)
				{
					_DefaultValueExpression = param.DefaultValueExpression.Clone() as Expression;
				}
				_IsOptional = param._IsOptional;
				_DefaultValue = param._DefaultValue;
				_Direction = param._Direction;
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (IsParamArray)
			{
				return 70;
			}
			if (IsOutParam)
			{
				return 68;
			}
			if (IsReferenceParam)
			{
				return 69;
			}
			return 67;
		}

		public override string GetTypeName()
		{
			return ParamType;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Param param = new Param();
			param.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return param;
		}

		public new void SetFullTypeName(string fullTypeName)
		{
			base.SetFullTypeName(fullTypeName);
		}

		void IParameterElementModifier.SetType(ITypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			TypeReferenceExpression element = (base.MemberTypeReference = type as TypeReferenceExpression);
			AddDetailNode(element);
		}

		void IParameterElementModifier.SetDirection(ArgumentDirection direction)
		{
			Direction = direction;
		}

	public class ExpressionTypeArgument : TypeReferenceExpression
	{
		private Expression _SourceExpression;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ExpressionTypeArgument;

		public Expression SourceExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_SourceExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionTypeArgument()
		{
		}

		public ExpressionTypeArgument(Expression sourceExpression)
		{
			if (sourceExpression != null)
			{
				_SourceExpression = sourceExpression;
				SetRange(sourceExpression.Range);
				AddNode(_SourceExpression);
				InternalName = _SourceExpression.Name;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is ExpressionTypeArgument)
				{
					ExpressionTypeArgument expressionTypeArgument = (ExpressionTypeArgument)source;
					_SourceExpression = expressionTypeArgument._SourceExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_SourceExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_SourceExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ExpressionTypeArgument expressionTypeArgument = new ExpressionTypeArgument();
			expressionTypeArgument.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return expressionTypeArgument;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_SourceExpression != null)
			{
				return _SourceExpression.ToString();
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression : ArrayCreateExpression
	{
		private ExpressionCollection _NewOperatorArguments;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression;

		public ExpressionCollection NewOperatorArguments
		{
			get
			{
				return _NewOperatorArguments;
			}
			set
			{
				_NewOperatorArguments = value;
			}
		}

		protected ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression()
		{
		}

		public ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, ExpressionCollection dimensions, ExpressionCollection newArguments)
			: base(type, dimensions)
		{
			_NewOperatorArguments = newArguments;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression parametrizedArrayCreateExpression = (ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression)source;
			if (parametrizedArrayCreateExpression._NewOperatorArguments != null)
			{
				_NewOperatorArguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, parametrizedArrayCreateExpression.DetailNodes, _NewOperatorArguments, parametrizedArrayCreateExpression._NewOperatorArguments);
				if (_NewOperatorArguments.Count == 0 && parametrizedArrayCreateExpression._NewOperatorArguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_NewOperatorArguments = parametrizedArrayCreateExpression._NewOperatorArguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_NewOperatorArguments != null && _NewOperatorArguments.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_NewOperatorArguments.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression parametrizedArrayCreateExpression = new ParametrizedArrayCreateExpression();
			parametrizedArrayCreateExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return parametrizedArrayCreateExpression;
		}
	}

	public class ManagedObjectCreationExpression : ObjectCreationExpression
	{
		private ExpressionCollection _Dimensions;

		private ArrayInitializerExpression _ArrayInitializers;

		private ArrayKindModifier _ArrayKind;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ManagedObjectCreationExpression;

		public ArrayInitializerExpression ArrayInitializers
		{
			get
			{
				return _ArrayInitializers;
			}
			set
			{
				_ArrayInitializers = value;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection Dimensions
		{
			get
			{
				return _Dimensions;
			}
			set
			{
				_Dimensions = value;
			}
		}

		public ArrayKindModifier ArrayKind
		{
			get
			{
				return _ArrayKind;
			}
			set
			{
				_ArrayKind = value;
			}
		}

		protected ManagedObjectCreationExpression()
		{
		}

		public ManagedObjectCreationExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type)
			: base(type)
		{
			Name = "gcnew";
		}

		public ManagedObjectCreationExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, ExpressionCollection ctorArguments)
			: base(type, ctorArguments)
		{
			Name = "gcnew";
		}

		public ManagedObjectCreationExpression(TypeReferenceExpression type, ExpressionCollection ctorArguments, ArrayInitializerExpression arrayinit)
			: this(type, ctorArguments)
		{
			_ArrayInitializers = arrayinit;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ManagedObjectCreationExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ManagedObjectCreationExpression managedObjectCreationExpression = (ManagedObjectCreationExpression)source;
			_ArrayKind = managedObjectCreationExpression._ArrayKind;
			if (managedObjectCreationExpression._ArrayInitializers != null)
			{
				_ArrayInitializers = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, managedObjectCreationExpression, managedObjectCreationExpression._ArrayInitializers) as ArrayInitializerExpression;
				if (_ArrayInitializers == null)
				{
					_ArrayInitializers = managedObjectCreationExpression._ArrayInitializers.Clone(options) as ArrayInitializerExpression;
				}
			}
			if (managedObjectCreationExpression._Dimensions != null)
			{
				_Dimensions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, managedObjectCreationExpression.DetailNodes, _Dimensions, managedObjectCreationExpression._Dimensions);
				if (_Dimensions.Count == 0 && managedObjectCreationExpression._Dimensions.Count > 0)
				{
					_Dimensions = managedObjectCreationExpression._Dimensions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_ArrayInitializers == oldElement)
			{
				_ArrayInitializers = newElement as ArrayInitializerExpression;
			}
			else if (_Dimensions != null && _Dimensions.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_Dimensions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ManagedObjectCreationExpression managedObjectCreationExpression = new ManagedObjectCreationExpression();
			managedObjectCreationExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return managedObjectCreationExpression;
		}
	}
	public class CppQualifiedElementReference : QualifiedElementReference
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CppQualifiedElementReference;

		protected CppQualifiedElementReference()
		{
		}

		public CppQualifiedElementReference(Expression source, string name, SourceRange namerange)
			: base(source, name, namerange)
		{
		}

		protected virtual string GetNameWithQualifier()
		{
			return $"{Qualifier.ToString()}::";
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Qualifier != null)
			{
				if (Qualifier is QualifiedAliasExpression)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Qualifier.ToString());
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat(GetNameWithQualifier());
				}
				if (Name != null && Name.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(Name);
				}
			}
			else if (Name != null && Name.Length > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Name);
			}
			if (IsGeneric)
			{
				int count = TypeArguments.Count;
				stringBuilder.Append("<");
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(TypeArguments[i].ToString());
					if (i < count - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(">");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CppQualifiedElementReference cppQualifiedElementReference = new CppQualifiedElementReference();
			cppQualifiedElementReference.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return cppQualifiedElementReference;
		}
	}

	public class TemplateExpression : ElementReferenceExpression
	{
		private Expression _Qualifier;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.TemplateExpression;

		public override Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				_Qualifier = value;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("template");
			if (Qualifier != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Qualifier.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is DeleteExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			TemplateExpression templateExpression = (TemplateExpression)source;
			if (templateExpression._Qualifier != null)
			{
				_Qualifier = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, templateExpression, templateExpression._Qualifier) as Expression;
				if (_Qualifier == null)
				{
					_Qualifier = templateExpression._Qualifier.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Qualifier == oldElement)
			{
				_Qualifier = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TemplateExpression templateExpression = new TemplateExpression();
			templateExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return templateExpression;
		}
	}

		{

			{
				return _AssemblerCode;

		{

				return _StatementType;

				_AssemblerCode = assemblerCode;

			{
				return _ExceptionExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_ExceptionExpression = value;
			}

		}

			: this()

			_ExceptionExpression = exceptionExpression;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Except)
				{
					Except except = (Except)source;
					ExceptionExpression = except.ExceptionExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_ExceptionExpression != null && _ExceptionExpression == oldElement as Expression)

				_ExceptionExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Except except = new Except();
			except.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return except;
		}

	public class TemplateModifier : CodeElement
	{
		private bool _IsExport;

		private LanguageElementCollection _Parameters;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.TemplateModifier;

		public bool IsExport
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsExport;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsExport = value;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				return _Parameters;
			}
			set
			{
				_Parameters = value;
			}
		}

		public int ParametersCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters != null)
				{
					return _Parameters.Count;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is TemplateModifier))
			{
				return;
			}
			TemplateModifier templateModifier = (TemplateModifier)source;
			_IsExport = templateModifier._IsExport;
			if (templateModifier._Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, templateModifier, templateModifier._Parameters) as LanguageElementCollection;
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					_Parameters = templateModifier._Parameters.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Parameters != null && _Parameters.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_Parameters.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TemplateModifier templateModifier = new TemplateModifier();
			templateModifier.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return templateModifier;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (IsExport)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("export ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("template ");
			if (_Parameters != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("<{0}>", _Parameters.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class TemplateParameter : CodeElement, ITemplateParameter, ITypeParameter, IElement

		ITypeParameterConstraintCollection ITypeParameter.Constraints => EmptyLiteElements.EmptyITypeParameterConstraintCollection;

		bool ITypeParameter.IsActivated => false;

		}

		public TemplateParameter(string name, Expression defaultValue)

			InternalName = name;
			_DefaultValue = defaultValue;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)

			{
				return;

			{
				return;

			TemplateParameter templateParameter = (TemplateParameter)source;
			if (templateParameter._DefaultValue != null)

		{
			get
			{
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIElementCollection;
				}
				IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
				elementCollection.AddRange(_Parameters);
				return elementCollection;
			}

			}
			stringBuilder.Append("class ");
			if (Name != string.Empty)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Name);
			}
			if (base.DefaultValue != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat(" = {0}", base.DefaultValue.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();

				return;

			{
				return;
			}
			NestedTemplateParameter nestedTemplateParameter = (NestedTemplateParameter)source;
			if (nestedTemplateParameter._Parameters != null)
			{
				_Parameters = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, nestedTemplateParameter, nestedTemplateParameter._Parameters) as LanguageElementCollection;
				if (_Parameters == null)
				{
					_Parameters = nestedTemplateParameter._Parameters.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			if (_Parameters != null && _Parameters.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_Parameters.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			NestedTemplateParameter nestedTemplateParameter = new NestedTemplateParameter();
			nestedTemplateParameter.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return nestedTemplateParameter;
		}

	public class ComplexConstructorInitializer : ConstructorInitializer
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ComplexConstructorInitializer;

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (DetailNodes != null && DetailNodes.Count != 0)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < DetailNodes.Count; i++)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(",");
					}
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}", DetailNodes[i].ToString());
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ComplexConstructorInitializer complexConstructorInitializer = new ComplexConstructorInitializer();
			complexConstructorInitializer.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return complexConstructorInitializer;

	public class FromExpression : QueryExpressionBase, IFromExpression, IQueryExpressionBase, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private ExpressionCollection _InExpressions;

		public ExpressionCollection InExpressions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_InExpressions == null)
				{
					_InExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _InExpressions;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.FromExpression;

		IExpressionCollection IFromExpression.InExpressions => InExpressions;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is FromExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			FromExpression fromExpression = source as FromExpression;
			if (fromExpression._InExpressions != null)
			{
				_InExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, fromExpression.DetailNodes, _InExpressions, fromExpression._InExpressions);
				if (_InExpressions.Count == 0 && fromExpression._InExpressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_InExpressions = fromExpression._InExpressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_InExpressions != null && _InExpressions.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_InExpressions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			FromExpression fromExpression = new FromExpression();
			fromExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return fromExpression;
		}

		public void AddInExpressions(IEnumerable<Expression> inExpressions)
		{
			if (inExpressions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Expression inExpression in inExpressions)
			{
				AddInExpression(inExpression as InExpression);
			}
		}

		public void AddInExpressions(IEnumerable<InExpression> inExpressions)
		{
			if (inExpressions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (InExpression inExpression in inExpressions)
			{
				AddInExpression(inExpression);
			}
		}

		public void AddInExpression(InExpression exp)
		{
			if (exp != null)
			{
				InExpressions.Add(exp);
				AddDetailNode(exp);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "FromExpression";
		}
	}
