				_ByList = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, groupByExpression.DetailNodes, _ByList, groupByExpression._ByList);
				if (_ByList.Count == 0 && groupByExpression._ByList.Count > 0)
				{
					_ByList = groupByExpression._ByList.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
			if (groupByExpression._GroupList != null)
			{
				_GroupList = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, groupByExpression.DetailNodes, _GroupList, groupByExpression._GroupList);
				if (_GroupList.Count == 0 && groupByExpression._GroupList.Count > 0)
				{
					_GroupList = groupByExpression._GroupList.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
			if (groupByExpression._IntoElements != null)
			{
				_IntoElements = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, groupByExpression.DetailNodes, _IntoElements, groupByExpression._IntoElements);
				if (_IntoElements.Count == 0 && groupByExpression._IntoElements.Count > 0)
				{
					_IntoElements = groupByExpression._IntoElements.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_GroupList != null && _GroupList.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_GroupList.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else if (_ByList != null && _ByList.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_ByList.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else if (_IntoElements != null && _IntoElements.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_IntoElements.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public void AddIntoElements(IEnumerable<LanguageElement> elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement element in elements)
			{
				AddIntoElement(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddIntoElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				IntoElements.Add(element);
				AddDetailNode(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddGroupElements(IEnumerable<LanguageElement> elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement element in elements)
			{
				AddGroupElement(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddGroupElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GroupList.Add(element);
				AddDetailNode(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddByElements(IEnumerable<LanguageElement> elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement element in elements)
			{
				AddByElement(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddByElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				ByList.Add(element);
				AddDetailNode(element);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			GroupByExpression groupByExpression = new GroupByExpression();
			groupByExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return groupByExpression;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "GroupByExpression";
		}
	}
	public class ImplicitVariable : InitializedVariable, IImplicitVariable, IVariableDeclarationStatement, IStatement, IElement, IHasType, ILocalDeclaration, IBaseVariable, IHasArrayNameModifier
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ImplicitVariable;

		protected ImplicitVariable()
		{
			base.HasType = false;
		}

		public ImplicitVariable(string name, Expression initializer)
			: base(string.Empty, name, initializer)
		{
			base.HasType = false;
		}

		public ImplicitVariable(string name)
			: this(name, null)
		{
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ImplicitVariable implicitVariable = new ImplicitVariable();
			implicitVariable.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return implicitVariable;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty = ((base.MemberType != null && !(base.MemberType == string.Empty)) ? (base.MemberType + " " + Name) : Name);
			if (base.Expression != null)
			{
				empty = $"{empty} = {base.Expression}";
			}
			return empty;
		}
	}
	public enum InExpressionType
	{
		InExpression,
		LetExpression
	}
	public class InExpression : QueryExpressionBase, IInExpression, IQueryExpressionBase, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private QueryIdent _QueryIdent;

		private Expression _Expression;

		private InExpressionType _InExpressionType;

		public QueryIdent QueryIdent
		{
			get
			{
				return _QueryIdent;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					ReplaceDetailNode(_QueryIdent, value);
					_QueryIdent = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					ReplaceDetailNode(_Expression, value);
					_Expression = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.InExpression;

		public InExpressionType InExpressionType
		{
			get
			{
				return _InExpressionType;
			}
			set
			{
				_InExpressionType = value;
			}
		}

		IExpression IInExpression.Expression => _Expression;

		IQueryIdent IInExpression.QueryIdent => _QueryIdent;

		public InExpression()
		{
		}

		public InExpression(QueryIdent queryIdent, Expression exp)
		{
			_QueryIdent = queryIdent;
			_Expression = exp;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is InExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			InExpression inExpression = source as InExpression;
			if (inExpression._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, inExpression, inExpression._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = inExpression._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (inExpression._QueryIdent != null)
			{
				_QueryIdent = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, inExpression, inExpression._QueryIdent) as QueryIdent;
				if (_QueryIdent == null)
				{
					_QueryIdent = inExpression._QueryIdent.Clone(options) as QueryIdent;
				}
			}
			_InExpressionType = inExpression.InExpressionType;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_QueryIdent == oldElement)
			{
				_QueryIdent = (QueryIdent)newElement;
			}
			else if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			InExpression inExpression = new InExpression();
			inExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return inExpression;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_InExpressionType == InExpressionType.LetExpression)
			{
				return "LetExpression";
			}
			return "InExpression";
		}
	}
	public class IntoExpression : QueryExpressionBase, IIntoExpression, IQueryExpressionBase, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private QueryIdent _IntoTarget;

		public QueryIdent IntoTarget => _IntoTarget;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.IntoExpression;

		IQueryIdent IIntoExpression.IntoTarget => IntoTarget;

		public IntoExpression()

		}

		public IntoExpression(QueryIdent intoTarget)
		{
			SetIntoTarget(intoTarget);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is IntoExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			IntoExpression intoExpression = (IntoExpression)source;
			if (intoExpression._IntoTarget != null)
			{
				_IntoTarget = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, intoExpression, intoExpression._IntoTarget) as QueryIdent;
				if (_IntoTarget == null)

					_IntoTarget = intoExpression._IntoTarget.Clone(options) as QueryIdent;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_IntoTarget == oldElement)
			{
				_IntoTarget = (QueryIdent)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public void SetIntoTarget(QueryIdent intoTarget)
		{
			if (intoTarget != null)

				_IntoTarget = intoTarget;
			}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)

			intoExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return intoExpression;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{

	public class JoinExpression : JoinExpressionBase, IJoinExpression, IQueryExpressionBase, IExpression, IElement
	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.JoinExpression;

		IInExpression IJoinExpression.InExpression => base.InExpression;

		IExpressionCollection IJoinExpression.EqualsExpressions => base.EqualsExpressions;

		IExpressionCollection IJoinExpression.JoinExpressions => base.JoinExpressions;

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "JoinExpression";
		}
	}
	public abstract class JoinExpressionBase : QueryExpressionBase
	{
		private InExpression _InExpression;

		private ExpressionCollection _EqualsExpressions;

		private ExpressionCollection _JoinExpressions;

		public ExpressionCollection EqualsExpressions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_EqualsExpressions == null)
				{
					_EqualsExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _EqualsExpressions;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection JoinExpressions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_JoinExpressions == null)
				{
					_JoinExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _JoinExpressions;
			}
		}

		public InExpression InExpression => _InExpression;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is JoinExpressionBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			JoinExpressionBase joinExpressionBase = (JoinExpressionBase)source;
			if (joinExpressionBase._EqualsExpressions != null)
			{
				_EqualsExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, joinExpressionBase.DetailNodes, _EqualsExpressions, joinExpressionBase._EqualsExpressions);
				if (_EqualsExpressions.Count == 0 && joinExpressionBase._EqualsExpressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_EqualsExpressions = joinExpressionBase._EqualsExpressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (joinExpressionBase._JoinExpressions != null)
			{
				_JoinExpressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, joinExpressionBase.DetailNodes, _JoinExpressions, joinExpressionBase._JoinExpressions);
				if (_JoinExpressions.Count == 0 && joinExpressionBase._JoinExpressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_EqualsExpressions = joinExpressionBase._JoinExpressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (joinExpressionBase._InExpression != null)
			{
				_InExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, joinExpressionBase, joinExpressionBase._InExpression) as InExpression;
				if (_InExpression == null)
				{
					_InExpression = joinExpressionBase._InExpression.Clone(options) as InExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_EqualsExpressions != null && _EqualsExpressions.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_EqualsExpressions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else if (_JoinExpressions != null && _JoinExpressions.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_JoinExpressions.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else if (_InExpression != null && _InExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_InExpression = newElement as InExpression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public void SetInExpression(InExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_InExpression, expression);
				_InExpression = expression;
			}
		}

		public void AddEqualsExpressions(IEnumerable<Expression> equalsExpressions)
		{
			if (equalsExpressions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (EqualsExpression equalsExpression in equalsExpressions)
			{
				AddEqualsExpression(equalsExpression);
			}
		}

		public void AddEqualsExpression(EqualsExpression exp)
		{
			if (exp != null)
			{
				EqualsExpressions.Add(exp);
				AddDetailNode(exp);
			}
		}

		public void AddJoinExpressions(IEnumerable<Expression> joinExpressions)
		{
			if (joinExpressions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (JoinExpressionBase joinExpression in joinExpressions)
			{
				AddJoinExpression(joinExpression);
			}
		}

		public void AddJoinExpression(JoinExpressionBase exp)
		{
			if (exp != null)
			{
				JoinExpressions.Add(exp);
				AddDetailNode(exp);
			}
		}
	}
	public class JoinIntoExpression : JoinExpression, IIntoContainingElement, IJoinIntoExpression, IJoinExpression, IQueryExpressionBase, IExpression, IElement

		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				IntoElements.Add(element);
				AddDetailNode(element);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "JoinIntoExpression";
		}

	public class LambdaExpression : AnonymousMethodExpression, ILambdaExpression, IAnonymousMethodExpression, IExpression, IElement, IWithParameters
	{
		private SourceRange _OperatorRange;

		public virtual bool IsFunction { get; set; }

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression;

		public SourceRange OperatorRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_OperatorRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_OperatorRange = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool ParameterListOmitted
		{
			get
			{
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is LambdaExpression)
				{
					LambdaExpression lambdaExpression = (LambdaExpression)source;
					_OperatorRange = lambdaExpression.OperatorRange;
					IsFunction = lambdaExpression.IsFunction;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_OperatorRange = OperatorRange;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			LambdaExpression lambdaExpression = new LambdaExpression();
			lambdaExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return lambdaExpression;
		}

		public void AddStatement(Statement statement)
		{
			if (statement != null)
			{
				if (statement.SourceExpression == null)
				{
					AddNode(statement);
				}
				else
				{
					AddNode(statement.SourceExpression);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class LetExpression : QueryExpressionBase
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _Declarations;

		public LanguageElementCollection Declarations
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Declarations == null)
				{
					_Declarations = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _Declarations;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.LetExpression;

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is LetExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			LetExpression letExpression = (LetExpression)source;
			if (letExpression._Declarations == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_Declarations = new LanguageElementCollection();
			ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, letExpression.DetailNodes, _Declarations, letExpression._Declarations);
			if (_Declarations.Count == 0 && letExpression._Declarations.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < letExpression._Declarations.Count; i++)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = letExpression._Declarations[i];
					_Declarations.Add(languageElement.Clone());
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Declarations != null && _Declarations.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Declarations.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			LetExpression letExpression = new LetExpression();
			letExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return letExpression;
		}

		public void AddDeclarations(IEnumerable<LanguageElement> declarations)
		{
			if (declarations == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement declaration in declarations)
			{
				AddDeclaration(declaration);
			}
		}

		public void AddDeclaration(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				Declarations.Add(element);
				AddDetailNode(element);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "LetExpression";
		}
	}
	public class MemberInitializerExpression : Expression, IMemberInitializerExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private Expression _Value;

		private SourceRange _NameRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private bool _IsKey;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _Value;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsKey
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsKey;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsKey = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.MemberInitializerExpression;

		IExpression IMemberInitializerExpression.Value => _Value;

		public MemberInitializerExpression()
		{
		}

		public MemberInitializerExpression(string name, Expression value)
		{
			Name = name;
			SetValue(value);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is MemberInitializerExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			MemberInitializerExpression memberInitializerExpression = (MemberInitializerExpression)source;
			if (memberInitializerExpression._Value != null)
			{
				_Value = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, memberInitializerExpression, memberInitializerExpression._Value) as Expression;
				if (_Value == null)
				{
					_Value = memberInitializerExpression._Value.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			_IsKey = memberInitializerExpression.IsKey;
			_NameRange = memberInitializerExpression.NameRange;
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Value == oldElement)
			{
				_Value = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return resolver?.Resolve(this);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			MemberInitializerExpression memberInitializerExpression = new MemberInitializerExpression();
			memberInitializerExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return memberInitializerExpression;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is MemberInitializerExpression memberInitializerExpression)
			{
				if (Name != memberInitializerExpression.Name)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Value == null && memberInitializerExpression.Value == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return Value.IsIdenticalTo(memberInitializerExpression.Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetValue(Expression expression)
		{
			if (_Value != null)
			{
				RemoveDetailNode(_Value);
			}
			_Value = expression;
			if (_Value != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ObjectInitializerExpression : Expression, IObjectInitializerExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private ExpressionCollection _Initializers;

		public ExpressionCollection Initializers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Initializers == null)
				{
					_Initializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Initializers;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression;

		IExpressionCollection IObjectInitializerExpression.Initializers => Initializers;

		private bool ComareInitializers(ObjectInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Initializers == null && expression.Initializers == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Initializers == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Initializers.IsIdenticalTo(expression.Initializers);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ObjectInitializerExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			ObjectInitializerExpression objectInitializerExpression = (ObjectInitializerExpression)source;
			if (objectInitializerExpression._Initializers != null)
			{
				_Initializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, objectInitializerExpression.DetailNodes, _Initializers, objectInitializerExpression._Initializers);
				if (_Initializers.Count == 0 && objectInitializerExpression._Initializers.Count > 0)
				{
					_Initializers = objectInitializerExpression._Initializers.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Initializers != null && _Initializers.Contains(oldElement as Expression))
			{
				_Initializers.ReplaceExpression(oldElement as Expression, newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ObjectInitializerExpression objectInitializerExpression = new ObjectInitializerExpression();
			objectInitializerExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return objectInitializerExpression;
		}

		public override bool IsIdenticalTo(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (expression is ObjectInitializerExpression expression2)
			{
				return ComareInitializers(expression2);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void AddInitializers(IEnumerable<Expression> initializers)
		{
			if (initializers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Expression initializer in initializers)
			{
				AddInitializer(initializer);
			}
		}

		public void AddInitializer(Expression init)
		{
			if (init != null)
			{
				Initializers.Add(init);
				AddDetailNode(init);
			}
		}
	}

	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression : Expression, IQueryableCollectionReferenceExpression, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private Expression _Expression;

		private TypeReferenceExpression _Type;

		private ExpressionCollection _AdditionalExpressions;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				_Expression = value;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection AdditionalExpressions
		{
			get
			{
				if (_AdditionalExpressions == null)
				{
					_AdditionalExpressions = GetAdditionalExpressions();
				}
				return _AdditionalExpressions;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression;

		IExpression IQueryableCollectionReferenceExpression.Expression => Expression;

		IExpressionCollection IQueryableCollectionReferenceExpression.AdditionalExpressions => AdditionalExpressions;

		public QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression()
		{
		}

		public QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression(Expression expression, TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			SetExpression(expression);
			_Type = type;
		}

		private MethodCallExpression GetMethodCall(Expression expression, string name, TypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeArguments)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(expression.Clone() is Expression source))
			{
				return null;
			}
			MethodReferenceExpression methodReferenceExpression = new MethodReferenceExpression(source, name);
			if (typeArguments != null)
			{
				methodReferenceExpression.AddTypeArguments(typeArguments);
			}
			MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = new MethodCallExpression(methodReferenceExpression);
			methodCallExpression.SetParent(this);
			return methodCallExpression;
		}

		private MethodCallExpression GetAsQueryableMethodCall(Expression expression)
		{
			return GetMethodCall(expression, "AsQueryable", null);
		}

		private MethodCallExpression GetAsEnumerableMethodCall(Expression expression)
		{
			return GetMethodCall(expression, "AsEnumerable", null);
		}

		private MethodCallExpression GetCastMethodCall(Expression expression, TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			TypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeReferenceExpressionCollection = new TypeReferenceExpressionCollection();
			typeReferenceExpressionCollection.Add(CreateSystemObjectTypeReference());
			MethodCallExpression methodCall = GetMethodCall(expression, "Cast", typeReferenceExpressionCollection);
			if (methodCall == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeReferenceExpressionCollection2 = new TypeReferenceExpressionCollection();
			typeReferenceExpressionCollection2.Add(CreateSystemObjectTypeReference());
			typeReferenceExpressionCollection2.Add(type.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression);
			MethodCallExpression methodCall2 = GetMethodCall(methodCall, "Select", typeReferenceExpressionCollection2);
			if (methodCall2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LambdaFunctionExpression lambdaFunctionExpression = new LambdaFunctionExpression();
			lambdaFunctionExpression.AddParameter(new LambdaImplicitlyTypedParam("t"));
			lambdaFunctionExpression.AddNode(new TypeCastExpression(type.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression, new ElementReferenceExpression("t")));
			methodCall2.AddArgument(lambdaFunctionExpression);
			return methodCall2;
		}

		private TypeReferenceExpression CreateSystemObjectTypeReference()
		{
			TypeReferenceExpression type = new TypeReferenceExpression("System");
			return new TypeReferenceExpression("Object", SourceRange.Empty, type);
		}

		private ExpressionCollection GetAdditionalExpressions()
		{
			ExpressionCollection expressionCollection = new ExpressionCollection();
			Expression asQueryableMethodCall = GetAsQueryableMethodCall(_Expression);
			if (asQueryableMethodCall != null)
			{
				expressionCollection.Add(asQueryableMethodCall);
			}
			asQueryableMethodCall = GetAsEnumerableMethodCall(_Expression);
			if (asQueryableMethodCall != null)
			{
				expressionCollection.Add(asQueryableMethodCall);
			}
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = _Type;
			if (typeReferenceExpression == null)
			{
				typeReferenceExpression = CreateSystemObjectTypeReference();
			}
			asQueryableMethodCall = GetCastMethodCall(_Expression, typeReferenceExpression);
			if (asQueryableMethodCall != null)
			{
				expressionCollection.Add(asQueryableMethodCall);
			}
			return expressionCollection;
		}

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = expression;
				AddNode(expression);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression queryableCollectionReferenceExpression = new QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression();
			queryableCollectionReferenceExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return queryableCollectionReferenceExpression;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression queryableCollectionReferenceExpression)
			{
				if (queryableCollectionReferenceExpression._Expression != null)
				{
					SetExpression(queryableCollectionReferenceExpression._Expression.Clone() as Expression);
				}
				if (queryableCollectionReferenceExpression._Type != null)
				{
					_Type = queryableCollectionReferenceExpression._Type.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				return _Expression.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			if (_Expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _Expression.Resolve(resolver);
		}
	}

				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is TakeExpressionBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			TakeExpressionBase takeExpressionBase = source as TakeExpressionBase;
			if (takeExpressionBase._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, takeExpressionBase, takeExpressionBase._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = takeExpressionBase._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	{
		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.TakeWhileExpression;

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TakeWhileExpression takeWhileExpression = new TakeWhileExpression();
			takeWhileExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return takeWhileExpression;

		{
			return "TakeWhileExpression";

	public class WhereExpression : QueryExpressionBase, IWhereExpression, IQueryExpressionBase, IExpression, IElement
	{
		private Expression _WhereClause;

		public Expression WhereClause => _WhereClause;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.WhereExpression;

		IExpression IWhereExpression.WhereClause => WhereClause;

		public WhereExpression()
		{
		}

		public WhereExpression(Expression whereClause)
		{
			SetWhereClause(whereClause);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is WhereExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			WhereExpression whereExpression = (WhereExpression)source;
			if (whereExpression._WhereClause != null)
			{
				_WhereClause = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, whereExpression, whereExpression._WhereClause) as Expression;
				if (_WhereClause == null)
				{
					_WhereClause = whereExpression._WhereClause.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_WhereClause == oldElement)
			{
				_WhereClause = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public void SetWhereClause(Expression whereClause)
		{
			if (whereClause != null)
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_WhereClause, whereClause);
				_WhereClause = whereClause;
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			WhereExpression whereExpression = new WhereExpression();
			whereExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return whereExpression;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "WhereExpression";
		}
	}

	public class FloatNum : Number
	{
		protected decimal DecimalItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (decimal)base.Item;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Item = value;
			}
		}

		protected FloatNum GetZeroNumber()
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = new FloatNum();
			floatNum.Item = 0m;
			return floatNum;
		}

		protected FloatNum DoCalculate(Number param)
		{
			decimal num = default(decimal);
			if (param is FloatNum)
			{
				num = (param as FloatNum).DecimalItem;
			}
			if (param is IntNum)
			{
				num = Convert.ToDecimal(param.Item);
			}
			FloatNum floatNum = new FloatNum();
			floatNum.Item = num;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number Add(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			floatNum.Item = DecimalItem + floatNum.DecimalItem;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number Sub(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			floatNum.Item = DecimalItem - floatNum.DecimalItem;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number Mul(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			floatNum.Item = DecimalItem * floatNum.DecimalItem;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number Div(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			if ((decimal)floatNum.Item == 0m)
			{
				return floatNum;
			}
			floatNum.Item = DecimalItem / floatNum.DecimalItem;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number ModDiv(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			if ((decimal)floatNum.Item == 0m)
			{
				return floatNum;
			}
			floatNum.Item = DecimalItem % floatNum.DecimalItem;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number MinusSign()
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = new FloatNum();
			floatNum.Item = -(decimal)base.Item;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number PlusSign()
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = new FloatNum();
			floatNum.Item = floatNum.DecimalItem;
			return floatNum;
		}

		public override Number Decrement()
		{
			return GetZeroNumber();
		}

		public override Number Increment()
		{
			return GetZeroNumber();
		}

		public override Number And(Number param)
		{
			return GetZeroNumber();
		}

		public override Number Or(Number param)
		{
			return GetZeroNumber();
		}

		public override Number Xor(Number param)
		{
			return GetZeroNumber();
		}

		public override Number LeftShift(Number param)
		{
			return GetZeroNumber();
		}

		public override Number RightShift(Number param)
		{
			return GetZeroNumber();
		}

		public override bool IsTrue()
		{
			return DecimalItem != 0m;
		}

		public override bool IsEqualTo(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			return floatNum.DecimalItem == DecimalItem;
		}

		public override bool IsBelow(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			return DecimalItem < floatNum.DecimalItem;
		}

		public override bool IsBelowOrEqual(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			return DecimalItem <= floatNum.DecimalItem;
		}

		public override bool IsGreater(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			return DecimalItem > floatNum.DecimalItem;
		}

		public override bool IsGreaterOrEqual(Number param)
		{
			FloatNum floatNum = DoCalculate(param);
			return DecimalItem >= floatNum.DecimalItem;
		}
	}
	public class IntNum : Number
	{
		protected int IntItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)base.Item;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Item = value;
			}
		}

		protected Number DoCalculate(Number param)
		{
			Number number = null;
			if (param is FloatNum)
			{
				number = new FloatNum();
				number.Item = Convert.ToDecimal(base.Item);
			}
			if (param is IntNum)
			{
				number = new IntNum();
				number.Item = (param as IntNum).IntItem;
			}
			return number;
		}

		protected Number ReturnNumberForItem(int item)
		{
			IntNum intNum = new IntNum();
			intNum.Item = item;
			return intNum;
		}

		public override Number Add(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = (number as IntNum).IntItem + IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).Add(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Number Sub(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem - (number as IntNum).IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).Sub(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Number Mul(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem * (number as IntNum).IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).Mul(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Number Div(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			try
			{
				if (number is IntNum)
				{
					(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem / (number as IntNum).IntItem;
					return number;
				}
				if (number is FloatNum)
				{
					return (number as FloatNum).Div(param);
				}
				return null;
			}
			catch
			{
				return number;
			}
		}

		public override Number ModDiv(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			try
			{
				if (number is IntNum)
				{
					(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem % (number as IntNum).IntItem;
					return number;
				}
				if (number is FloatNum)
				{
					return (number as FloatNum).ModDiv(param);
				}
				return null;
			}
			catch
			{
				return number;
			}
		}

		public override Number MinusSign()
		{
			return ReturnNumberForItem(-IntItem);
		}

		public override Number PlusSign()
		{
			return ReturnNumberForItem(-IntItem);
		}

		public override Number Decrement()
		{
			return ReturnNumberForItem(IntItem - 1);
		}

		public override Number Increment()
		{
			return ReturnNumberForItem(IntItem + 1);
		}

		public override Number And(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem & (number as IntNum).IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).And(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Number Or(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem | (number as IntNum).IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).Or(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Number Xor(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem ^ (number as IntNum).IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).Xor(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Number LeftShift(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem << (number as IntNum).IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).LeftShift(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override Number RightShift(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				(number as IntNum).Item = IntItem >> (number as IntNum).IntItem;
				return number;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).RightShift(param);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool IsTrue()
		{
			return IntItem != 0;
		}

		public override bool IsEqualTo(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				return (number as IntNum).IntItem == IntItem;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).IsEqualTo(param);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsBelow(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				return IntItem < (number as IntNum).IntItem;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).IsBelow(param);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsBelowOrEqual(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				return IntItem <= (number as IntNum).IntItem;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).IsBelowOrEqual(param);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsGreater(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				return IntItem > (number as IntNum).IntItem;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).IsGreater(param);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsGreaterOrEqual(Number param)
		{
			Number number = DoCalculate(param);
			if (number is IntNum)
			{
				return IntItem >= (number as IntNum).IntItem;
			}
			if (number is FloatNum)
			{
				return (number as FloatNum).IsGreaterOrEqual(param);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public abstract class Accessor : ParentingStatement, IMemberElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier
	{
		private BaseVariable _ImplicitVariable;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		private bool __IsNewContext;

		private MemberVisibility _Visibility;

		private AccessSpecifiersFlags _Specifiers;

		private AccessSpecifiers _AccessSpecifiers = new AccessSpecifiers();

		private bool _GenerateCodeBlock = true;

		private bool _HasEndingSemicolon;

		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public BaseVariable ImplicitVariable
		{
			get
			{
				return _ImplicitVariable;
			}
			set
			{
				_ImplicitVariable = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasImplicitVariable => _ImplicitVariable != null;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanContainCode => true;

		public override bool IsNewContext => __IsNewContext;

		public MemberVisibility Visibility
		{
			get
			{
				return _Visibility;
			}
			set
			{
				_Visibility = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange VisibilityRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasAccessSpecifiers)
				{
					return _AccessSpecifiers.VisibilityRange;
				}

		public Accessor()
		{
			__IsNewContext = true;
			base.IsBreakable = false;
		}

		private ITypeReferenceExpression GetTypeRef()
		{
			IHasType hasType = (IHasType)this;
			if (hasType != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return hasType.Type;
		}

		protected virtual string GetAccessorName()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is Accessor)
			{
				Accessor accessor = (Accessor)source;
				_ImplicitVariable = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, accessor, accessor._ImplicitVariable) as BaseVariable;
				_NameRange = accessor.NameRange;
				__IsNewContext = accessor.__IsNewContext;
				_Visibility = accessor._Visibility;
				_Specifiers = accessor._Specifiers;
				if (accessor._AccessSpecifiers != null)
				{
					_AccessSpecifiers = accessor._AccessSpecifiers.Clone();
				}
				_GenerateCodeBlock = accessor.GenerateCodeBlock;
				_HasEndingSemicolon = accessor.HasEndingSemicolon;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		public override void SetHistory(int index, DocumentHistorySlice history, bool isRecursive)
		{
			if (_AccessSpecifiers != null)
			{
				_AccessSpecifiers.SetHistory(history);
			}
			base.SetHistory(index, history, isRecursive);
		}

		public override void ClearHistory()
		{
			if (History != null)
			{
				if (_AccessSpecifiers != null)
				{
					_AccessSpecifiers.ClearHistory();
				}
				base.ClearHistory();
			}
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Local;
		}

		public override bool RangeIsClean(SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			if (sourceRange.Top > base.BlockStart.Bottom)
			{
				return sourceRange.Bottom < base.BlockEnd.Top;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetSpecifiers(AccessSpecifiersFlags specifiers)
		{
			_Specifiers = specifiers;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool SpecifierIsSet(AccessSpecifiersFlags flag)
		{
			return (_Specifiers & flag) == flag;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetSpecifierValue(AccessSpecifiersFlags flag, bool value)
		{
			_Specifiers = (value ? (_Specifiers | flag) : (_Specifiers & ~flag));
		}

		public bool Is(string fullTypeName)
		{
			return GetTypeRef()?.Is(fullTypeName) ?? false;
		}

		public bool Is(ITypeElement type)
		{
			return GetTypeRef()?.Is(type) ?? false;
		}

		public bool Is(Type type)
		{
			return GetTypeRef()?.Is(type) ?? false;
		}

		public bool Is(ISourceTreeResolver resolver, string fullTypeName)
		{
			return GetTypeRef()?.Is(resolver, fullTypeName) ?? false;
		}

		private void EnsureAccessSpecifiers()
		{
			if (_AccessSpecifiers == null)
			{
				_AccessSpecifiers = new AccessSpecifiers();
			}
		}

		private AttributeSection CreateAttributeSection(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			AttributeSection attributeSection = new AttributeSection();
			attributeSection.AddAttribute(attribute as Attribute);
			return attributeSection;
		}

		void IHasAttributesModifier.AddAttribute(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			AddAttributeSection(CreateAttributeSection(attribute));
		}

		void IHasAttributesModifier.RemoveAttribute(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			if (base.AttributeSections == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AttributeSection attributeSection in base.AttributeSections)
			{
				if (attributeSection != null && attributeSection.AttributeCollection.Contains(attribute))
				{
					attributeSection.RemoveAttribute(attribute as Attribute);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetIsAbstract(bool isAbstract)
		{
			IsAbstract = isAbstract;
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetIsExtern(bool isExtern)
		{
			IsExtern = isExtern;
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetIsOverride(bool isOverride)
		{
			IsOverride = isOverride;
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetIsReadOnly(bool isReadOnly)
		{
			IsReadOnly = isReadOnly;
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetIsSealed(bool isSealed)
		{
			IsSealed = isSealed;
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetIsStatic(bool isStatic)
		{
			IsStatic = isStatic;
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetIsVirtual(bool isVirtual)
		{
			IsVirtual = isVirtual;
		}

		void IMemberElementModifier.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			Visibility = visibility;
		}
	}
	public class Event : MemberWithParameters, IEventElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IHasType, IWithParameters, IEventElementModifier, IMemberElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier, IWithParametersModifier
	{
		private bool _IsInterfaceEvent;

		private Expression _Initializer;

		private bool _GenerateAccessors = true;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Event;

		public bool IsInterfaceEvent
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsInterfaceEvent;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsInterfaceEvent = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool GenerateAccessors
		{
			get
			{
				return _GenerateAccessors;
			}
			set
			{
				_GenerateAccessors = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets the Add accessor for this event, if declared.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public EventAdd Adder => FindChildByElementType(LanguageElementType.EventAdd) as EventAdd;

		[Description("Gets the Remove accessor for this event, if declared.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public EventRemove Remover => FindChildByElementType(LanguageElementType.EventRemove) as EventRemove;

		[Description("Gets the Raise accessor for this event, if declared.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public EventRaise Raise => FindChildByElementType(LanguageElementType.EventRaise) as EventRaise;

		public Expression Initializer
		{
			get
			{
				return _Initializer;
			}
			set
			{
				SetInitializer(value);
			}
		}

		public IMethodElement AddMethod
		{
			get
			{
				return Adder;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public IMethodElement RemoveMethod
		{
			get
			{
				return Remover;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public IMethodElement RaiseMethod
		{
			get
			{
				return Raise;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		IExpression IEventElement.Initializer => _Initializer;

		public virtual IElementCollection ImplicitElements => IElementCollection.Empty;

		public Event()
		{
		}

		public Event(string name)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		private void SetInitializer(Expression initializer)
		{
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_Initializer, initializer);
				_Initializer = initializer;
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return 78;
			}
			return 17;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return InternalName;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Illegal;
		}

		public void ClearInitializer()
		{
			if (_Initializer != null)
			{
				if (DetailNodes.Contains(_Initializer))
				{
					DetailNodes.Remove(_Initializer);
				}
				_Initializer = null;
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Event obj = new Event();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source == null || !(source is Event))
			{
				return;
			}
			Event obj = source as Event;
			_GenerateAccessors = obj._GenerateAccessors;
			_IsInterfaceEvent = obj.IsInterfaceEvent;
			if (obj._Initializer != null)
			{
				_Initializer = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Initializer) as Expression;
				if (_Initializer == null)
				{
					_Initializer = obj._Initializer.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		void IEventElementModifier.SetAddMethod(IMethodElement method)
		{
			if (method is EventAdd element)
			{
				AddNode(element);
			}
		}

		void IEventElementModifier.SetRemoveMethod(IMethodElement method)
		{
			if (method is EventRemove element)
			{
				AddNode(element);
			}
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IMemberElement.get_Signature()
		{
			return base.Signature;
		}
	}
	public abstract class EventAccessor : Accessor, IHasParameters, IMethodElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IGenericElement, IHasType, IWithParameters, IMethodElementModifier, IMemberElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier, IWithParametersModifier, IGenericElementModifier

					_ParametersList = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _ParametersList;
			}
		}

		public Event ParentEvent => base.Parent as Event;

		[Description("The name of the event that contains this accessor.")]

		public int ParameterCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParametersList == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _ParametersList.Count;
			}
		}

		bool IMethodElement.IsAsynchronous => false;

		{
			get
			{
				if (_ParametersList == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIParameterElementCollection;
				}
				LiteParameterElementCollection liteParameterElementCollection = new LiteParameterElementCollection();
				liteParameterElementCollection.AddRange(_ParametersList);
				return liteParameterElementCollection;
			}
		}

		public EventAccessor()
		{
		}

		protected override string GetAccessorName()
		{
			if (base.Parent is Event)
			{
				return base.Parent.Name;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is EventAccessor))
			{
				return;
			}
			EventAccessor eventAccessor = (EventAccessor)source;
			_ParametersList = null;
			if (eventAccessor._ParametersList != null)
			{
				_ParametersList = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, eventAccessor.DetailNodes, _ParametersList, eventAccessor._ParametersList);
				if (_ParametersList.Count == 0 && eventAccessor._ParametersList.Count > 0)
				{
					_ParametersList = eventAccessor._ParametersList.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (base.Parent is Event && ((Event)base.Parent).IsStatic)
			{
				return 46;
			}
			return 30;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_ParametersList != null)
			{
				_ParametersList.Clear();
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			int num = -1;
			if (_ParametersList != null)
			{
				num = _ParametersList.IndexOf(oldElement);
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				_ParametersList.RemoveAt(num);
				if (newElement != null)
				{
					_ParametersList.Insert(num, newElement);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public void AddParameter(Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Add(parameter);
				AddDetailNode(parameter);
			}
		}

		public void AddParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				AddParameter(parameter as Param);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveParameter(Param parameter)
		{

	public class Property : MemberWithParameters, IPropertyElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IHasType, IWithParameters, IPropertyElementModifier, IMemberElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier, IWithParametersModifier
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 0;

		private Expression _Initializer;

		private bool _IsAutoImplemented;

		private bool _GenerateAccessors = true;

		private bool _GenerateParens;

		private SourceRange _IndexOpenRange;

		private SourceRange _IndexCloseRange;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 0;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Property;

		[Description("True if this property can be read.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		public bool HasGetter => Getter != null;

		[Description("True if this property can be written to.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public bool HasSetter => Setter != null;

		[Description("True if this property can be read.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		[Obsolete("Use HasGetter instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsReadable => Getter != null;

		[Description("True if this property can be written to.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[Obsolete("Use HasSetter instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsWritable => Setter != null;

		[Description("True if this property is an indexer.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool IsIndexed => base.ParameterCount > 0;

		[Description("Gets the Set accessor for this property, if available. Returns null if this property is read-only.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public Set Setter => FindChildByElementType(LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet) as Set;

		[Description("Returns the Get accessor for this property, if available. Returns null if this property is write-only.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public Get Getter => FindChildByElementType(LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet) as Get;

		public SourceRange IndexOpenRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_IndexOpenRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_IndexOpenRange = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange IndexCloseRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_IndexCloseRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_IndexCloseRange = value;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		public bool IsAutoImplemented
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsAutoImplemented;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsAutoImplemented = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool GenerateAccessors
		{
			get
			{
				return _GenerateAccessors;
			}
			set
			{
				_GenerateAccessors = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool GenerateParens
		{
			get
			{
				return _GenerateParens;
			}
			set
			{
				_GenerateParens = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression Initializer
		{
			get
			{
				return _Initializer;
			}
			set
			{
				_Initializer = value;
			}
		}

		IMethodElement IPropertyElement.GetMethod => Getter;

		IMethodElement IPropertyElement.SetMethod => Setter;

		IExpression IPropertyElement.Initializer => _Initializer;

		public Property()
		{
		}

		public Property(string name)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		public Property(string type, string name)
			: this(name)
		{
			base.MemberType = type;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Initializer = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Initializer == oldElement)
			{
				_Initializer = (TypeReferenceExpression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is Property)
			{
				Property property = (Property)source;
				_IndexOpenRange = property.IndexOpenRange;
				_IndexCloseRange = property.IndexCloseRange;
				_IsAutoImplemented = property._IsAutoImplemented;
				_GenerateAccessors = property._GenerateAccessors;
				_GenerateParens = property._GenerateParens;
				_Initializer = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, property, property._Initializer) as Expression;
				if (_Initializer == null && property._Initializer != null)
				{
					_Initializer = property._Initializer.Clone() as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_IndexOpenRange = IndexOpenRange;
			_IndexCloseRange = IndexCloseRange;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetIndexedPropertyNameWithoutImplementsQualifier()
		{
			if (!IsIndexed)
			{
				return;
			}
			string name = Name;
			string text = name.Substring(0, name.LastIndexOf('.') + 1);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				Name = name.Replace(text, string.Empty);
				if (HasGetter)
				{
					string name2 = Getter.Name;
					Getter.Name = name2.Replace(text, string.Empty);
				}
				if (HasSetter)
				{
					string name3 = Setter.Name;
					Setter.Name = name3.Replace(text, string.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			int num = 0;
			Set setter = Setter;
			if (setter != null)
			{
				num += setter.GetCyclomaticComplexity();
			}
			Get getter = Getter;
			if (getter != null)
			{
				num += getter.GetCyclomaticComplexity();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Illegal;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return 47;
			}
			if (IsIndexed)
			{
				return 26;
			}
			return 34;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return InternalName;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Property property = new Property();
			property.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return property;
		}

		void IPropertyElementModifier.SetGetMethod(IMethodElement method)
		{
			if (method is Get element)
			{
				AddNode(element);
			}
		}

		void IPropertyElementModifier.SetSetMethod(IMethodElement method)
		{
			if (method is Set element)
			{
				AddNode(element);
			}
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IMemberElement.get_Signature()
		{
			return base.Signature;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PropertyAccessor : Accessor, IMethodElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IGenericElement, IHasType, IWithParameters, IHasParameters, IMethodElementModifier, IMemberElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier, IWithParametersModifier, IGenericElementModifier

		IParameterElementCollection IWithParameters.Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				int detailNodeCount = base.DetailNodeCount;
				if (detailNodeCount == 0)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIParameterElementCollection;
				}
				LiteParameterElementCollection liteParameterElementCollection = new LiteParameterElementCollection();
				for (int i = 0; i < detailNodeCount; i++)
				{
					if (DetailNodes[i] is IParameterElement)
					{
						liteParameterElementCollection.Add(DetailNodes[i]);
					}
				}
				return liteParameterElementCollection;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
				int detailNodeCount = base.DetailNodeCount;
				for (int i = 0; i < detailNodeCount; i++)
				{
					if (DetailNodes[i] is Param)
					{
						languageElementCollection.Add(DetailNodes[i]);
					}
				}
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
		}

		public int ParameterCount => Parameters?.Count ?? 0;

		public PropertyAccessor()
		{
		}

		protected override string GetAccessorName()
		{
			if (base.Parent is Property)
			{
				return base.Parent.Name;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return 1 + GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (base.Parent is Property && ((Property)base.Parent).IsStatic)
			{
				return 46;
			}
			return 30;
		}

		public void AddParameter(Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Add(parameter);
				AddDetailNode(parameter);
			}
		}

		public void AddParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				AddParameter(parameter as Param);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveParameter(Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Remove(parameter);
				RemoveDetailNode(parameter);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveParameters(LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
			{
				RemoveParameter(parameter as Param);
			}
		}

		public void InsertParameter(int index, Param parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				Parameters.Insert(index, parameter);
				InsertDetailNode(index, parameter);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is PropertyAccessor)
				{
					PropertyAccessor propertyAccessor = (PropertyAccessor)source;
					_AccessorType = propertyAccessor.AccessorType;
					_IsPrototype = propertyAccessor.IsPrototype;
				}
			}
		}

		public override MemberVisibility[] GetValidVisibilities()
		{
			if (ParentProperty != null)
			{
				MemberVisibility memberVisibility = ParentProperty.Visibility;
				if (memberVisibility == MemberVisibility.Illegal)
				{
					memberVisibility = ParentProperty.GetDefaultVisibility();
				}
				List<MemberVisibility> list;
				switch (memberVisibility)
				{
				case MemberVisibility.Private:
					return new MemberVisibility[0];
				case MemberVisibility.Protected:
				case MemberVisibility.Internal:
					list = new List<MemberVisibility>(new MemberVisibility[1] { MemberVisibility.Private });
					break;
				case MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal:
					list = new List<MemberVisibility>(new MemberVisibility[3]
					{
						MemberVisibility.Private,
						MemberVisibility.Protected,
						MemberVisibility.Internal
					});
					break;
				case MemberVisibility.Public:
					list = new List<MemberVisibility>(new MemberVisibility[4]
					{
						MemberVisibility.Private,
						MemberVisibility.Protected,
						MemberVisibility.Internal,
						MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal
					});
					break;
				default:
					return new MemberVisibility[0];
				}
				if (ParentProperty.IsAbstract || ParentProperty.IsVirtual || ParentProperty.IsOverride)
				{
					list.Remove(MemberVisibility.Private);
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return base.GetValidVisibilities();
		}

		bool IMethodElement.IsExtensionMethod()
		{
			return false;
		}

		bool IMethodElement.IsExtensionMethod(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return false;

		}

		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

	public class Set : PropertyAccessor
	{
		private const string STR_Value = "value";

		private LanguageElementCollection _Parameters;

		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet;

		public new virtual LanguageElementCollection Parameters
		{
			get
			{
				return _Parameters;
			}
			set
			{
				_Parameters = value;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			Property property = base.Parent as Property;
			if ("set_" + property == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return property.GetNameWithoutImplementsQualifier();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Set set = new Set();
			set.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return set;
		}

		public virtual string GetValueParameterName()
		{
			if (base.ParameterCount <= 0)
			{
				return "value";
			}
			return Parameters[0].Name;
		}
	}
	public class QueuedDelete : QueuedEdit
	{
		private const string STR_Delete = "Delete";

		private LanguageElementCollection _SeveredNodes;

		private LanguageElement _StartDelete;

		private LanguageElement _EndDelete;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.QueuedDelete;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElementCollection SeveredNodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SeveredNodes == null)
				{
					_SeveredNodes = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _SeveredNodes;
			}
		}

		protected QueuedDelete()
		{
		}

		public QueuedDelete(SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			SetRange(sourceRange);
			InternalName = "Delete";
		}

		public QueuedDelete(LanguageElement element)
		{
			ValidateElement(element);
			_StartDelete = element;
			_EndDelete = element;
			SetRange(element.Range);
			InternalName = "Delete";
			BorrowNodeFromTree(element);
		}

		public QueuedDelete(LanguageElement firstSibling, LanguageElement lastSibling)
		{
			ValidateSiblings(firstSibling, lastSibling);
			SetRange(new SourceRange(firstSibling.Range.Start, lastSibling.Range.End));
			InternalName = "Delete";
			BorrowNodesFromTree(firstSibling, lastSibling);
		}

		private void ValidateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("element parameter to Delete constructor must be assigned!");
			}
		}

		private void ValidateSiblings(LanguageElement firstSibling, LanguageElement lastSibling)
		{
			if (firstSibling == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("firstSibling parameter to Delete constructor must be assigned!");
			}
			if (lastSibling == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("lastSibling parameter to Delete constructor must be assigned!");
			}
			if (firstSibling != lastSibling)
			{
				if (!firstSibling.IsSibling(lastSibling))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Parameters to Delete constructor must be siblings!");
				}
				if (firstSibling.Index >= lastSibling.Index)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("firstSibling must come *before* lastSibling in Delete constructor!");
				}
			}
		}

		private void BorrowNodesFromTree(LanguageElement firstSibling, LanguageElement lastSibling)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = lastSibling;
			while (languageElement != null)
			{
				BorrowNodeFromTree(languageElement);
				if (languageElement != firstSibling)
				{
					languageElement = languageElement.PreviousSibling;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void BorrowNodeFromTree(LanguageElement element)
		{
			SeveredNodes.Add(element);
		}

		protected override void ApplyEdit(IDocument iDocument, bool format)
		{
			iDocument.DeleteText(base.BoundRange);
			SetRange(base.BoundRange.Start, base.BoundRange.Start);
			SeveredNodes.Clear();
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is QueuedDelete))
			{
				return;
			}
			QueuedDelete queuedDelete = (QueuedDelete)source;
			if (queuedDelete._StartDelete != null)
			{
				_StartDelete = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, queuedDelete, queuedDelete._StartDelete) as LanguageElement;
				if (_StartDelete == null)
				{
					_StartDelete = queuedDelete._StartDelete.Clone(options) as LanguageElement;
				}
			}
			if (queuedDelete._EndDelete != null)
			{
				_EndDelete = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, queuedDelete, queuedDelete._EndDelete) as LanguageElement;
				if (_EndDelete == null)
				{
					_EndDelete = queuedDelete._EndDelete.Clone(options) as LanguageElement;
				}
			}
			if (queuedDelete._SeveredNodes != null)
			{
				_SeveredNodes = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, queuedDelete.DetailNodes, _SeveredNodes, queuedDelete._SeveredNodes);
				if (_SeveredNodes.Count == 0 && queuedDelete._SeveredNodes.Count > 0)
				{
					ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(Nodes, queuedDelete.Nodes, _SeveredNodes, queuedDelete._SeveredNodes);
				}
				if (_SeveredNodes.Count == 0 && queuedDelete._SeveredNodes.Count > 0)
				{
					_SeveredNodes = queuedDelete._SeveredNodes.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			QueuedDelete queuedDelete = new QueuedDelete();
			queuedDelete.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return queuedDelete;
		}
	}
	public abstract class QueuedEdit : LanguageElement
	{
		private bool _AppliedEdit;

		private SourceRange _BoundRange;

		public SourceRange BoundRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (!_BoundRange.IsBoundToCode)
				{
					return base.Range;
				}
				return GetTransformedRange(_BoundRange);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ApplyEdit(IDocument iDocument, bool format);

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is QueuedEdit)
				{
					QueuedEdit queuedEdit = (QueuedEdit)source;
					_AppliedEdit = queuedEdit._AppliedEdit;
					_BoundRange = queuedEdit.BoundRange;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_BoundRange = BoundRange;
		}

		private void SetPushableOptions(bool start, bool end)
		{
			if (_BoundRange.Start.HasBindingPoint)
			{
				_BoundRange.Start.BindingPoint.IsPushable = start;
			}
			if (_BoundRange.End.HasBindingPoint)
			{
				_BoundRange.End.BindingPoint.IsPushable = end;
			}
		}

		private void GetPushableOptions(out bool start, out bool end)
		{
			start = false;
			end = false;
			if (_BoundRange.Start.HasBindingPoint)
			{
				start = _BoundRange.Start.BindingPoint.IsPushable;
			}
			if (_BoundRange.End.HasBindingPoint)
			{
				end = _BoundRange.End.BindingPoint.IsPushable;
			}
		}

		public void Apply(IDocument iDocument)
		{
			Apply(iDocument, format: false);
		}

		public void Apply(IDocument iDocument, bool format)
		{
			if (_AppliedEdit)
			{
				return;
			}
			_AppliedEdit = true;
			bool start = false;
			bool end = false;
			GetPushableOptions(out start, out end);
			try
			{
				SetPushableOptions(start: false, end: true);
				ApplyEdit(iDocument, format);
			}
			finally
			{
				SetPushableOptions(start, end);
			}
		}

		public void BindToCode(IDisposableEditPointFactory document)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_BoundRange = base.Range;
			_BoundRange.BindToCode(document);
		}

		public void RemoveBinding()
		{
			_BoundRange.RemoveAllBindings();
		}
	}
	public class QueuedEditCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		public QueuedEdit this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (QueuedEdit)base.InnerList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.InnerList[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Add(QueuedEdit edit)
		{
			if (edit == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return base.InnerList.Add(edit);
		}

		public void AddRange(QueuedEditCollection edits)
		{
			if (edits != null)
			{
				base.InnerList.AddRange(edits);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(QueuedEdit edit)
		{
			if (edit != null)
			{
				base.InnerList.Remove(edit);
			}
		}

		public void BindToCode(IDisposableEditPointFactory factory)
		{
			if (factory != null)
			{
				int count = base.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					this[i]?.BindToCode(factory);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveBinding()
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				this[i]?.RemoveBinding();
			}
		}
	}
	public class QueuedInsert : QueuedEdit

					_NewCode = queuedInsert._NewCode;

			queuedInsert.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return queuedInsert;

	public class QueuedReplace : QueuedDelete
	{
		private const string STR_Replace = "Replace";

		private string _NewCode;

		private bool _UseTextExpansion;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.QueuedReplace;

		public string NewCode
		{
			get
			{
				return _NewCode;
			}
			set
			{
				_NewCode = value;
			}
		}

		public bool UseTextExpansion
		{
			get
			{
				return _UseTextExpansion;
			}
			set
			{
				_UseTextExpansion = value;
			}
		}

		protected QueuedReplace()
		{
		}

		public QueuedReplace(SourceRange sourceRange, string newCode)
			: base(sourceRange)
		{
			_NewCode = newCode;
			InternalName = "Replace";
		}

		public QueuedReplace(LanguageElement element, string newCode)
			: base(element)
		{
			_NewCode = newCode;
			InternalName = "Replace";
		}

		public QueuedReplace(LanguageElement firstSibling, LanguageElement lastSibling, string newCode)
			: base(firstSibling, lastSibling)
		{
			_NewCode = newCode;
			InternalName = "Replace";
		}

		private void ReplaceText(IDocument iDocument, bool format)
		{
			SourceRange range = ((!_UseTextExpansion) ? iDocument.InsertText(base.BoundRange.Start, _NewCode) : iDocument.ExpandText(base.BoundRange.Start, _NewCode));
			if (format)
			{
				iDocument.Format(range);
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyEdit(IDocument iDocument, bool format)
		{
			base.ApplyEdit(iDocument, format);
			if (_NewCode != null && _NewCode != "")
			{
				ReplaceText(iDocument, format);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is QueuedReplace)
				{
					QueuedReplace queuedReplace = (QueuedReplace)source;
					_NewCode = queuedReplace._NewCode;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			QueuedReplace queuedReplace = new QueuedReplace();
			queuedReplace.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return queuedReplace;
		}
