	public class Assignment : Statement, IAssignmentStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 1;

		private Expression _LeftSide;

		private SourceTextRange _Operator;

		private AssignmentOperatorType _AssignmentOperatorType;

		private Expression _Expression;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 1;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Assignment;

		[Description("Left side of the assignment statement.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public Expression LeftSide
		{
			get
			{
				return _LeftSide;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_LeftSide != value)
				{
					SetLeftSide(value);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets assignment operator.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public SourceTextRange Operator
		{
			get
			{
				return _Operator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Operator != value)
				{
					_Operator = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public AssignmentOperatorType AssignmentOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _AssignmentOperatorType;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_AssignmentOperatorType != value)
				{
					_AssignmentOperatorType = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use AssignmentOperator instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public AssignmentOperatorType AssignmentOperatorType
		{
			get
			{
				return AssignmentOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				AssignmentOperator = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Right side of the assignment statement.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Expression != value)
				{
					SetExpression(value);
				}
			}
		}

		IExpression IAssignmentStatement.LeftSide => LeftSide;

		IExpression IAssignmentStatement.Expression => Expression;

		AssignmentOperatorType IAssignmentStatement.AssignmentOperator => AssignmentOperator;

		public Assignment()
		{
			_AssignmentOperatorType = AssignmentOperatorType.Assignment;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is Assignment)
			{
				Assignment assignment = (Assignment)source;
				_LeftSide = (Expression)GetLanguageElementLink(assignment._LeftSide);
				_Expression = (Expression)GetLanguageElementLink(assignment._Expression);
				_Operator = new SourceTextRange();
				if (assignment._Operator != null)
				{
					_Operator.Text = assignment._Operator.Text;
					_Operator.Range = assignment._Operator.Range.Clone();
				}
				_AssignmentOperatorType = assignment.AssignmentOperator;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetLeftSide(Expression left)
		{
			if (left != null)
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_LeftSide, left);
				_LeftSide = left;
				SetStart(left.Range);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetExpression(Expression exp)
		{
			if (exp != null)
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_Expression, exp);
				_Expression = exp;
				SetEnd(exp.Range);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (_LeftSide != null)
			{
				text += _LeftSide.ToString();
			}
			if (_Operator != null)
			{
				text += _Operator.Text;
			}
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				text += _Expression.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 1;
		}

		public static Assignment FromAssignmentExpression(AssignmentExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Assignment assignment = new Assignment();
			assignment.SourceExpression = expression;
			expression.TransferCommentsTo(assignment);
			assignment.LeftSide = expression.LeftSide;
			assignment.AddDetailNode(expression.LeftSide);
			SourceTextRange sourceTextRange = new SourceTextRange(expression.OperatorText, expression.OperatorRange);
			assignment.Operator = sourceTextRange;
			assignment.AssignmentOperator = expression.AssignmentOperator;
			assignment.Expression = expression.RightSide;
			assignment.AddDetailNode(expression.RightSide);
			assignment.SetRange(expression.Range);
			assignment.MacroCall = expression.MacroCall;
			return assignment;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Assignment assignment = new Assignment();
			assignment.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return assignment;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_LeftSide == oldElement)
			{
				_LeftSide = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}
	}
	public class BaseVariable : Member, IVariableDeclarationStatement, IStatement, IElement, IHasType, ILocalDeclaration, IBaseVariable, IHasArrayNameModifier

			}
		}

		public SourceRange OperatorRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_OperatorRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_OperatorRange = value;
			}
		}

		public bool HasIterationExpression => GetIterationExpression() != null;

		public IExpression IterationExpression => GetIterationExpression();

		public virtual bool IsObjectCreationInit
		{
			get
			{
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool IsAspxTag
		{
			get
			{
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool IsRunAtServer
		{
			get
			{
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public NullableTypeModifier NullableModifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _NullableModifier;
			}
			set
			{
				_NullableModifier = value;
			}
		}

		bool IVariableDeclarationStatement.IsConst => false;

		IExpression IVariableDeclarationStatement.Expression => null;

		bool IVariableDeclarationStatement.IsBitField => IsBitField;

		IExpression IVariableDeclarationStatement.BitFieldSize => BitFieldSize;

		ICollection IHasArrayNameModifier.Modifiers => _ArrayNameModifiers;

		bool IBaseVariable.IsParameter => false;

		IExpression IBaseVariable.NameQualifier => base.NameQualifier;

		public IEnumerable<IElement> GetBlockChildren()
		{
			foreach (object node in Nodes)
			{
				if (node is IElement element)
				{
					yield return element;
				}
			}
		}

		private Expression GetIterationExpression()
		{
			if (!(base.Parent is ForEach forEach))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!base.IsDetailNode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return forEach.Expression;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetParentAspxFieldOrHtmlAttribute()
		{
			if (GetParent(LanguageElementType.HtmlAttribute) is HtmlAttribute result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (GetParent(LanguageElementType.Variable, LanguageElementType.InitializedVariable) is Variable { IsAspxTag: not false } variable)
			{
				return variable;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected new virtual ArrayList FindAllReferences()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.FindAllReferencesForBaseVariable(this);
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_NullableModifier == oldElement)
			{
				_NullableModifier = newElement as NullableTypeModifier;
			}
			else if (_ArrayNameModifiers != null && _ArrayNameModifiers.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_ArrayNameModifiers.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is BaseVariable))
			{
				return;
			}
			BaseVariable baseVariable = (BaseVariable)source;
			_FullTypeName = baseVariable._FullTypeName;
			_IsInitOnly = baseVariable._IsInitOnly;
			_IsLiteral = baseVariable._IsLiteral;
			_OperatorRange = baseVariable.OperatorRange;
			NullableTypeModifier nullableModifier = baseVariable._NullableModifier;
			if (nullableModifier != null)
			{
				_NullableModifier = nullableModifier.Clone(options) as NullableTypeModifier;
			}
			if (baseVariable._ArrayNameModifiers != null)
			{
				_ArrayNameModifiers = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, baseVariable.DetailNodes, _ArrayNameModifiers, baseVariable._ArrayNameModifiers);
				if (_ArrayNameModifiers.Count == 0 && baseVariable._ArrayNameModifiers.Count > 0)
				{
					_ArrayNameModifiers = baseVariable._ArrayNameModifiers.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_OperatorRange = OperatorRange;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		public override MemberVisibility[] GetValidVisibilities()
		{
			return ValidVisibilities;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			BaseVariable baseVariable = new BaseVariable();
			baseVariable.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return baseVariable;
		}

		public bool HasUsedReferences()
		{
			ArrayList references = References;
			if (references == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (ElementReferenceExpression reference in References)
			{
				if (reference.IsUsed)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void AddArrayNameModifier(ArrayNameModifier modifier)
		{
			if (modifier != null)
			{
				ArrayNameModifiers.Add(modifier);
				AddDetailNode(modifier);
			}
		}

		public void AddArrayNameModifiers(IEnumerable<ArrayNameModifier> modifiers)
		{
			if (modifiers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ArrayNameModifier modifier in modifiers)
			{
				AddArrayNameModifier(modifier);
			}
		}

		protected void SetFullTypeName(string value)
		{
			_FullTypeName = value;
		}
	}

		}

		}

	public class CallStatement : Statement, ICallStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private Expression _CalledExpression;

		public Expression CalledExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _CalledExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_CalledExpression, value);
				_CalledExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CallStatement;

		IExpression ICallStatement.CalledExpression => _CalledExpression;

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (oldElement == _CalledExpression)
			{
				_CalledExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is CallStatement { _CalledExpression: not null } callStatement)
			{
				_CalledExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, callStatement, callStatement._CalledExpression) as Expression;
				if (_CalledExpression == null)
				{
					_CalledExpression = callStatement._CalledExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_CalledExpression = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CallStatement callStatement = new CallStatement();
			callStatement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return callStatement;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_CalledExpression = null;
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (_CalledExpression != null)
			{
				text = _CalledExpression.ToString();
			}
			return "Call " + text;
		}
	}
	public class Case : ConditionalParentingStatement, ICaseStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 2;

		private bool _IsDefault;

		private Expression _Expression;

		private CaseClausesList _CaseClauses;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 2;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Case;

		public bool IsDefault
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsDefault;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsDefault = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public CaseClausesList CaseClauses
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CaseClauses == null)
				{
					_CaseClauses = new CaseClausesList();
				}
				return _CaseClauses;
			}
		}

		IExpression ICaseStatement.Expression => Expression;

		ICaseClausesList ICaseStatement.CaseClauses => _CaseClauses;

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_Expression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_CaseClauses == oldElement)
			{
				_CaseClauses = (CaseClausesList)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Case))
			{
				return;
			}
			Case obj = (Case)source;
			_IsDefault = obj._IsDefault;
			if (obj._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = obj._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (obj._CaseClauses != null)
			{
				_CaseClauses = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._CaseClauses) as CaseClausesList;
				if (_CaseClauses == null)
				{
					_CaseClauses = obj._CaseClauses.Clone(options) as CaseClausesList;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetEndPoint()
		{
			LanguageElement lastNode = base.LastNode;
			if (lastNode != null)
			{
				SetEnd(lastNode.Range.End);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 3;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_Expression = null;
			_CaseClauses = null;
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Expression = null;
			_CaseClauses = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Case obj = new Case();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}

		public void AddCaseClause(CaseClause caseClause)
		{
			if (caseClause != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(caseClause);
				if (_CaseClauses == null)
				{
					_CaseClauses = new CaseClausesList();
				}
				_CaseClauses.Clauses.Add(caseClause);
				_CaseClauses.AddDetailNode(caseClause);
				caseClause.SetParent(this);
			}
		}

		public void AddCaseClauses(CaseClausesList clauses)
		{
			if (clauses == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement clause in clauses.Clauses)
			{
				if (clause is CaseClause caseClause)
				{
					AddCaseClause(caseClause);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class CaseClause : LanguageElement, ICaseClauseStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 1;

		private Expression _StartExpression;

		private Expression _EndExpression;

		private string _ComparisonOperator;

		private bool _IsComparison;

		private bool _IsFromToClause;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 1;

		public Expression StartExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _StartExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetStartExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression EndExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _EndExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetEndExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public bool IsComparisonClause
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsComparison;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsComparison = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsRangeCheckClause
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsFromToClause;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsFromToClause = value;
			}
		}

		public string ComparisonOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return _ComparisonOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				_ComparisonOperator = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CaseClause;

		IExpression ICaseClauseStatement.StartExpression => _StartExpression;

		IExpression ICaseClauseStatement.EndExpression => _EndExpression;

		public bool HasDelimitedBlock => false;

		public CaseClause()
		{
		}

		public CaseClause(Expression startExpression, Expression endExpression)
			: this()
		{
			SetStartExpression(startExpression);
			SetEndExpression(endExpression);
		}

		public IEnumerable<IElement> GetBlockChildren()
		{
			foreach (object node in Nodes)
			{
				if (node is IElement element)
				{
					yield return element;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SetStartExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_StartExpression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_StartExpression = expression;
			if (_StartExpression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_StartExpression);
			}
		}

		protected void SetEndExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_EndExpression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_EndExpression = expression;
			if (_EndExpression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_EndExpression);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_StartExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_StartExpression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_EndExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_EndExpression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is CaseClause))
			{
				return;
			}
			CaseClause caseClause = (CaseClause)source;
			_ComparisonOperator = caseClause._ComparisonOperator;
			_IsComparison = caseClause._IsComparison;
			_IsFromToClause = caseClause._IsFromToClause;
			if (caseClause._StartExpression != null)
			{
				_StartExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, caseClause, caseClause._StartExpression) as Expression;
				if (_StartExpression == null)
				{
					_StartExpression = caseClause._StartExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (caseClause._EndExpression != null)
			{
				_EndExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, caseClause, caseClause._EndExpression) as Expression;
				if (_EndExpression == null)
				{
					_EndExpression = caseClause._EndExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 50;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_StartExpression = null;
			_EndExpression = null;
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_StartExpression = null;
			_EndExpression = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (IsRangeCheckClause)
			{
				if (_StartExpression != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(_StartExpression.ToString());
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(" To ");
				if (_EndExpression != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(_EndExpression.ToString());
				}
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(_ComparisonOperator);
				stringBuilder.Append(" ");
				if (_StartExpression != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(_StartExpression.ToString());
				}
				if (IsComparisonClause)
				{
					stringBuilder.Insert(0, " Is ");
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CaseClause caseClause = new CaseClause();
			caseClause.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return caseClause;
		}
	}
	public class CaseClausesList : LanguageElement, ICaseClausesList, IElement
	{
		private NodeList _Clauses;

		public NodeList Clauses => _Clauses;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.CaseClausesList;

		ICaseClauseCollection ICaseClausesList.Clauses
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Clauses == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyICaseClauseCollection;
				}
				LiteCaseClauseCollection liteCaseClauseCollection = new LiteCaseClauseCollection();
				liteCaseClauseCollection.AddRange(_Clauses);
				return liteCaseClauseCollection;
			}
		}

		public CaseClausesList()
		{
			_Clauses = new NodeList();
		}

		public CaseClausesList(NodeList clauses)
		{
			_Clauses = clauses;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Clauses == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = _Clauses.IndexOf(oldElement);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				_Clauses.RemoveAt(num);
				if (newElement != null)
				{
					_Clauses.Insert(num, newElement);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is CaseClausesList))
			{
				return;
			}
			CaseClausesList caseClausesList = (CaseClausesList)source;
			if (caseClausesList._Clauses != null)
			{
				_Clauses = new NodeList();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, caseClausesList.DetailNodes, _Clauses, caseClausesList._Clauses);
				if (_Clauses.Count == 0 && caseClausesList._Clauses.Count > 0)
				{
					_Clauses = caseClausesList._Clauses.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 50;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			_Clauses.Clear();
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Clauses.Clear();
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			foreach (CaseClause clause in _Clauses)
			{
				text = text + text2 + clause.ToString();
				text2 = ", ";
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CaseClausesList caseClausesList = new CaseClausesList();
			caseClausesList.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return caseClausesList;
		}
	}
	public class Catch : ConditionalParentingStatement, ICatchStatement, IConditionalStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		public string CatchesException = string.Empty;

		private LanguageElement _Exception;

		private LanguageElement _Condition;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Catch;

		public override bool CompletesPrevious => true;

		public LanguageElement Exception
		{
			get
			{
				return _Exception;
			}
			set
			{
				SetException(value);
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return _Condition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetCondition(value);
			}
		}

		IElement ICatchStatement.ExceptionVariable
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DetailNodeCount == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DetailNodes[0] as LanguageElement;
			}
		}

		IElement ICatchStatement.Condition => _Condition;

		public Catch()
		{
		}

		public Catch(LanguageElement exception, LanguageElement condition)
		{
			SetException(exception);
			SetCondition(condition);
		}

		protected void SetException(LanguageElement expression)
		{
			_Exception?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Exception = expression;
			if (_Exception != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Exception);
			}
		}

		protected void SetCondition(LanguageElement expression)
		{
			_Condition?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Condition = expression;
			if (_Condition != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Condition);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Catch))
			{
				return;
			}
			Catch obj = (Catch)source;
			CatchesException = obj.CatchesException;
			if (obj._Condition != null)
			{
				_Condition = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Condition) as LanguageElement;
				if (_Condition == null)
				{
					_Condition = obj._Condition.Clone(options) as LanguageElement;
				}
			}
			if (obj._Exception != null)
			{
				_Exception = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Exception) as LanguageElement;
				if (_Exception == null)
				{
					_Exception = obj._Exception.Clone(options) as LanguageElement;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 4;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Catch obj = new Catch();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}

		public Finally GetFinally()
		{
			LanguageElement nextCodeSibling = NextCodeSibling;
			while (nextCodeSibling != null && nextCodeSibling.CompletesPrevious && nextCodeSibling.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Finally)
			{
				nextCodeSibling = nextCodeSibling.NextCodeSibling;
			}
			return nextCodeSibling as Finally;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetFinallyTarget()
		{
			Finally obj = GetFinally();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = obj.GetFirstCodeChild();
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = obj;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}
	}

			{
				return;

				if (_Expression == null)

	public class For : ConditionalParentToSingleStatement, IForStatement, IConditionalStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Condition;

		private LanguageElementList _Initializers = new LanguageElementList();

		private LanguageElementList _Incrementors = new LanguageElementList();

		private Expression _ToExpression;

		private Expression _StepExpression;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.For;

		public LanguageElementList Initializers => _Initializers;

		public LanguageElementList Incrementors => _Incrementors;

		public Expression Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return _Condition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetCondition(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression ToExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _ToExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetToExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression StepExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _StepExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetStepExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public virtual NodeList NextExpressionList
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		IExpression IForStatement.Condition => Condition;

		IElementCollection IForStatement.Initializers
		{
			get
			{
				IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
				if (Initializers != null)
				{
					int count = Initializers.Count;
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						LanguageElement languageElement = Initializers[i];
						if (languageElement != null)
						{
							elementCollection.Add(languageElement);
						}
					}
				}
				return elementCollection;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IForStatement.Incrementors
		{
			get
			{
				LiteExpressionCollection liteExpressionCollection = new LiteExpressionCollection();
				int count = Incrementors.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (Incrementors[i] is Expression value)
					{
						liteExpressionCollection.Add(value);
					}
				}
				return liteExpressionCollection;
			}
		}

		IExpression IForStatement.ToExpression => ToExpression;

		IExpression IForStatement.StepExpression => StepExpression;

		IExpressionCollection IForStatement.NextExpressions
		{
			get
			{
				LiteExpressionCollection liteExpressionCollection = new LiteExpressionCollection();
				int count = NextExpressionList.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (NextExpressionList[i] is Expression value)
					{
						liteExpressionCollection.Add(value);
					}
				}
				return liteExpressionCollection;
			}
		}

		public For()
		{
			base.IsBreakable = true;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is For))
			{
				return;
			}
			For obj = (For)source;
			if (obj._Condition != null)
			{
				_Condition = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Condition) as Expression;
				if (_Condition == null)
				{
					_Condition = obj._Condition.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (obj._Initializers != null)
			{
				_Initializers = new LanguageElementList();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, obj.DetailNodes, _Initializers, obj._Initializers);
				if (_Initializers.Count == 0 && obj._Initializers.Count > 0)
				{
					_Initializers = obj._Initializers.DeepClone(options) as LanguageElementList;
				}
			}
			if (obj._Incrementors != null)
			{
				_Incrementors = new LanguageElementList();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, obj.DetailNodes, _Incrementors, obj._Incrementors);
				if (_Incrementors.Count == 0 && obj._Incrementors.Count > 0)
				{
					_Incrementors = obj._Incrementors.DeepClone(options) as LanguageElementList;
				}
			}
			if (obj._ToExpression != null)
			{
				_ToExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._ToExpression) as Expression;
				if (_ToExpression == null)
				{
					_ToExpression = obj._ToExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (obj._StepExpression != null)
			{
				_StepExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._StepExpression) as Expression;
				if (_StepExpression == null)
				{
					_StepExpression = obj._StepExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddInitializer(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				Initializers.Add(element);
				AddDetailNode(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddInitializers(LanguageElementCollection elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement element in elements)
			{
				AddInitializer(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddIncrementor(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				Incrementors.Add(element);
				AddDetailNode(element);
			}
		}

		public void AddIncrementors(LanguageElementCollection elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement element in elements)
			{
				AddIncrementor(element);
			}
		}

		public virtual void AddNextExpression(LanguageElement element)
		{
		}

		public void AddNextExpressions(LanguageElementCollection elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement element in elements)
			{
				AddNextExpression(element);
			}
		}

		protected void SetCondition(Expression expression)
		{
			_Condition?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Condition = expression;
			if (_Condition != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Condition);
			}
		}

		protected void SetToExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_ToExpression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_ToExpression = expression;
			if (_ToExpression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_ToExpression);
			}
		}

		protected void SetStepExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_StepExpression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_StepExpression = expression;
			if (_StepExpression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_StepExpression);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 24;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Condition != null)
			{
				_Condition.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_Condition = null;
			}
			if (_ToExpression != null)
			{
				_ToExpression.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_ToExpression = null;
			}
			if (_StepExpression != null)
			{
				_StepExpression.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_StepExpression = null;
			}
			if (_Initializers != null)
			{
				_Initializers.Clear();
				_Initializers = null;
			}
			if (_Incrementors != null)
			{
				_Incrementors.Clear();
				_Incrementors = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Condition == oldElement)
			{
				_Condition = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else if (_Initializers != null && _Initializers.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Initializers.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else if (_Incrementors != null && _Incrementors.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Incrementors.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else if (_ToExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_ToExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else if (_StepExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_StepExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			For obj = new For();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class ForEach : ConditionalParentToSingleStatement, IForEachStatement, IConditionalStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Expression;

		private BaseVariable _LoopVariable;

		public string FieldType = string.Empty;

		public string Field = string.Empty;

		public string Collection;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ForEach;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public BaseVariable LoopVariable => _LoopVariable;

		public virtual Expression NextExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		IVariableDeclarationStatement IForEachStatement.LoopVariable => _LoopVariable;

		IExpression IForEachStatement.Expression => Expression;

		IExpression IForEachStatement.NextExpression => NextExpression;

		public ForEach()
		{
			base.IsBreakable = true;
		}

		public ForEach(BaseVariable loop, Expression expression, Expression nextExpression)
			: this()
		{
			SetLoopVariable(loop);
			SetExpression(expression);
			SetNextExpression(nextExpression);
		}

		internal void SetExpression(Expression value)
		{
			_Expression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Expression = value;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		internal void SetLoopVariable(BaseVariable value)
		{
			_LoopVariable?.RemoveFromParent();
			_LoopVariable = value;
			if (_LoopVariable != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_LoopVariable);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetNextExpression(Expression value)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void SetInitializer(LanguageElement value)
		{
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement && newElement is Expression)
			{
				Expression = (Expression)newElement;
			}
			else if (_LoopVariable == oldElement && newElement is BaseVariable)
			{
				_LoopVariable = (BaseVariable)newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ForEach))
			{
				return;
			}
			ForEach forEach = (ForEach)source;
			FieldType = forEach.FieldType;
			Field = forEach.FieldType;
			if (forEach._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, forEach, forEach._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = forEach._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (forEach._LoopVariable != null)
			{
				_LoopVariable = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, forEach, forEach._LoopVariable) as BaseVariable;
				if (_LoopVariable == null)
				{
					_LoopVariable = forEach._LoopVariable.Clone(options) as BaseVariable;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 23;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Expression = null;
			_LoopVariable = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ForEach forEach = new ForEach();
			forEach.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return forEach;
		}
	}
	public abstract class HandlerStatement : Statement, IHandlerStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private Expression _Expression;

		private Expression _AddressExpression;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression AddressExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _AddressExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetAddressExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IHandlerStatement.Expression => Expression;

		IExpression IHandlerStatement.AddressExpression => AddressExpression;

		public HandlerStatement()
		{
		}

		public HandlerStatement(Expression expression, Expression address)
		{
			SetExpression(expression);
			SetAddressExpression(address);
		}

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			ReplaceNode(_Expression, expression);
			_Expression = expression;
		}

		protected void SetAddressExpression(Expression address)
		{
			ReplaceNode(_AddressExpression, address);
			_AddressExpression = address;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				SetExpression(newElement as Expression);
			}
			else if (_AddressExpression == oldElement)
			{
				SetAddressExpression(newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is HandlerStatement))
			{
				return;
			}
			HandlerStatement handlerStatement = (HandlerStatement)source;
			if (handlerStatement._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, handlerStatement, handlerStatement._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = handlerStatement._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (handlerStatement._AddressExpression != null)
			{
				_AddressExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, handlerStatement, handlerStatement._AddressExpression) as Expression;
				if (_AddressExpression == null)
				{
					_AddressExpression = handlerStatement._AddressExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Expression = null;
			_AddressExpression = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 17;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "HandlerStatement";
		}
	}
	public class If : IfElse, IIfStatement, IConditionalStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private LanguageElement _Condition;

		private bool _HasElseStatement;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.If;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		[Description("True if this if-block has a matching else statement.")]
		[Category("Details")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]
		public bool HasElseStatement => ElseStatement != null;

		public Statement ElseStatement
		{
			get
			{
				LanguageElement nextCodeSibling = NextCodeSibling;
				if (nextCodeSibling is Else)
				{
					return (Else)nextCodeSibling;
				}
				if (nextCodeSibling is ElseIf)
				{
					return (ElseIf)nextCodeSibling;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override bool AcceptsElse
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.HasBlock)
				{
					return EndLine > 1;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange TrueStatementsBlockRange => base.BlockRange;

		public SourceRange FalseStatementsBlockRange => ElseStatement?.BlockRange ?? SourceRange.Empty;

		public SourceRange TrueStatementsRange => base.BlockCodeRange;

		public SourceRange FalseStatementsRange => ElseStatement?.BlockCodeRange ?? SourceRange.Empty;

		public LanguageElement Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return _Condition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetCondition(value);
			}
		}

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Condition as Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IIfStatement.Condition => _Condition as IExpression;

		IStatement IIfStatement.ElseStatement => ElseStatement;

		bool IIfStatement.HasElseStatement => HasElseStatement;

		public If()
		{
		}

		public If(Expression expression, LanguageElementCollection block)
			: this(expression, block, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public If(Expression expression, LanguageElementCollection block, SourceRange range)
		{
			SetExpression(expression);
			AddNodes(block);
			SetRange(range);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is If))
			{
				return;
			}
			If obj = (If)source;
			_HasElseStatement = obj._HasElseStatement;
			if (obj._Condition != null)
			{
				_Condition = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Condition) as LanguageElement;
				if (_Condition == null)
				{
					_Condition = obj._Condition.Clone(options) as LanguageElement;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Condition == oldElement)
			{
				_Condition = newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			SetCondition(expression);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetCondition(LanguageElement condition)
		{
			if (_Condition == null)
			{
				_Condition = condition;
				AddDetailNode(condition);
			}
			else
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_Condition, condition);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 25;
		}

		public override string GetDetailNodeDescription(int index)
		{
			return "If-block expression";
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			If obj = new If();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return base.ToString();
		}
	}
	public abstract class IfElse : ConditionalParentToSingleStatement
	{

		protected int StatementCount
		{
			get

				int num = 0;

				{
					if (!(node is If))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public bool IsOneLine
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsOneLine;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsOneLine = value;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is IfElse)
				{
					IfElse ifElse = (IfElse)source;
					_IsOneLine = ifElse._IsOneLine;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 14;
		}
	}
	public abstract class InitializedValue : Variable, IFieldElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IHasType, IBaseVariable, IHasArrayNameModifier, IVariableDeclarationStatement, IStatement, ILocalDeclaration
	{
		private Expression _Expression;

		private bool _IsShortInitialize;

		{
			get
			{
				return _IsShortInitialize;

			set
			{
				_IsShortInitialize = value;
			}
		}

		bool IFieldElement.IsConst => IsConst;

		IExpression IFieldElement.Expression => Expression;

		bool IFieldElement.IsBitField => IsBitField;

		IExpression IFieldElement.BitFieldSize => BitFieldSize;

		bool IVariableDeclarationStatement.IsConst => IsConst;

		IExpression IVariableDeclarationStatement.Expression => Expression;

		bool IVariableDeclarationStatement.IsBitField => IsBitField;

		IExpression IVariableDeclarationStatement.BitFieldSize => BitFieldSize;

		public InitializedValue()

		}

		public InitializedValue(string type, string name)
			: this(type, name, null)

		}

			: base(type, name)
		{
			if (expr != null)
			{
				Expression = expr;
			}
		}

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_Expression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{

			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is InitializedValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			InitializedValue initializedValue = (InitializedValue)source;
			if (initializedValue._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, initializedValue, initializedValue._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = initializedValue._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			_IsShortInitialize = initializedValue.IsShortInitialize;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_Expression = null;
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override string GetDetailNodeDescription(int index)
		{
			if (index == 0)
			{
				return "Variable initialization";
			}
			return base.GetDetailNodeDescription(index);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"{base.ToString()} = {_Expression}";
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IMemberElement.get_Signature()
		{
			return base.Signature;
		}
	}

	public class ReDim : Statement
	{

		}

		public ReDim(bool hasPreserve, ExpressionCollection expressions)
		{

			AddDetailNodes(expressions);
		}

		private void SetExpressionsModifiedFlag(ExpressionCollection expressions)
		{
			SetExpressionsModifiedFlag(expressions, force: true);
		}

		private void SetExpressionsModifiedFlag(ExpressionCollection expressions, bool force)
		{
			if (expressions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < expressions.Count; i++)
			{
				Expression expression = expressions[i];
				if (expression != null && (!force || expression is IndexerExpression))
				{
					LanguageElement startElement = expression.GetStartElement();
					if (startElement is ElementReferenceExpression)
					{
						ElementReferenceExpression elementReferenceExpression = (ElementReferenceExpression)startElement;
						elementReferenceExpression.IsModified = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ReDim))
			{
				return;
			}
			ReDim reDim = (ReDim)source;
			_HasPreserve = reDim._HasPreserve;
			if (reDim._Expressions != null)
			{
				_Expressions = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, reDim.DetailNodes, _Expressions, reDim._Expressions);
				if (_Expressions.Count == 0 && reDim._Expressions.Count > 0)
				{
					_Expressions = reDim._Expressions.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expressions != null && _Expressions.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Expressions.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 86;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = "ReDim";
			if (_HasPreserve)
			{
				text += " Preserve";
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ReDim reDim = new ReDim();
			reDim.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return reDim;
		}
	}

	public class Statement : DelimiterCapableBlock, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private Expression _SourceExpression;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Statement;

		public override bool CanContainCode => true;

		public Expression SourceExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_SourceExpression = value;
			}
		}

		public new bool HasDelimitedBlock => base.HasDelimitedBlock;

		public Statement()
		{
		}

		public Statement(string code)
		{
			InternalName = code;
		}

		public IEnumerable<IElement> GetBlockChildren()
		{
			foreach (object node in Nodes)
			{
				if (node is IElement element)
				{
					yield return element;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 86;
		}

		public static Statement FromExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			Statement statement = null;
			if (expression != null)
			{
				statement = new Statement(expression.ToString());
				statement.AddDetailNode(expression);
				expression.IsStatement = true;
				statement.MacroCall = expression.MacroCall;
				statement._SourceExpression = expression;
			}
			return statement;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Statement statement = new Statement();
			statement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return statement;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Local;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Statement))
			{
				return;
			}
			Statement statement = (Statement)source;
			if (statement._SourceExpression != null)
			{
				_SourceExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, statement, statement._SourceExpression) as Expression;
				if (_SourceExpression == null)
				{
					_SourceExpression = statement._SourceExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_SourceExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_SourceExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
		}
	}
	public class Switch : ParentingStatement, ISwitchStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Expression;

		private LiteCaseStatementCollection _CaseStatements;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Switch;

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		public Expression Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return _Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression ISwitchStatement.Expression => _Expression;

		ICaseStatementCollection ISwitchStatement.CaseStatements
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.NodeCount == 0)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyICaseStatementCollection;
				}
				return _CaseStatements;
			}
		}

		public Switch()
		{
			base.IsBreakable = true;
		}

		private void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			RemoveDetailNode(_Expression);
			_Expression = expression;
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Expression);
			}
		}

		public void AddCaseStatement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element is Case obj)
			{
				if (_CaseStatements == null)
				{
					_CaseStatements = new LiteCaseStatementCollection();
				}
				_CaseStatements.Add(obj);
				AddNode(obj);
			}
		}

		public void AddCaseStatements(LanguageElementCollection elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement element in elements)
			{
				AddCaseStatement(element);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Switch))
			{
				return;
			}
			Switch obj = (Switch)source;
			if (obj._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = obj._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (obj._CaseStatements != null)
			{
				_CaseStatements = new LiteCaseStatementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(Nodes, obj.Nodes, _CaseStatements, obj._CaseStatements);
				if (_CaseStatements.Count == 0 && obj._CaseStatements.Count > 0)
				{
					_CaseStatements = obj._CaseStatements.DeepClone(options) as LiteCaseStatementCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else if (_CaseStatements != null && _CaseStatements.Contains(oldElement) && newElement is Case)
			{
				_CaseStatements.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			if (_Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_Expression = null;
			}
			if (_CaseStatements != null)
			{
				_CaseStatements.Clear();
				_CaseStatements = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 50;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Switch obj = new Switch();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class Try : ParentingStatement, ITryStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Try;

		public override int GetCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			return GetChildCyclomaticComplexity();
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 52;
		}

		public Finally GetFinally()
		{
			LanguageElement nextCodeSibling = NextCodeSibling;
			while (nextCodeSibling != null && nextCodeSibling.CompletesPrevious && nextCodeSibling.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Finally)
			{
				nextCodeSibling = nextCodeSibling.NextCodeSibling;
			}
			if (nextCodeSibling is Finally)
			{
				return (Finally)nextCodeSibling;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public LanguageElement GetFinallyTarget()
		{
			Finally obj = GetFinally();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = obj.GetFirstCodeChild();
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = obj;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Try obj = new Try();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}

	public class UsingStatement : ParentToSingleStatement, IUsingStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _Initializers;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.UsingStatement;

		[Obsolete("Use Initializers instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement InitializedDeclaration
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Initializers.Count > 0)
				{
					return _Initializers[0];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection Initializers => _Initializers;

		IElementCollection IUsingStatement.Initializers
		{
			get
			{
				IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
				elementCollection.AddRange(Initializers);
				return elementCollection;
			}
		}

		public UsingStatement()
		{
			_Initializers = new LanguageElementCollection();
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is UsingStatement))
			{
				return;
			}
			UsingStatement usingStatement = (UsingStatement)source;
			if (usingStatement._Initializers != null)
			{
				_Initializers = new LanguageElementCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, usingStatement.DetailNodes, _Initializers, usingStatement._Initializers);
				if (_Initializers.Count == 0 && usingStatement._Initializers.Count > 0)
				{
					_Initializers = usingStatement._Initializers.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Initializers != null && _Initializers.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Initializers.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public void AddInitializer(LanguageElement initializer)
		{
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(initializer);
				if (_Initializers != null)
				{
					_Initializers.Add(initializer);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddInitializers(LanguageElementCollection initializers)
		{
			if (initializers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement initializer in initializers)
			{
				AddInitializer(initializer);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 54;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			UsingStatement usingStatement = new UsingStatement();
			usingStatement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return usingStatement;
		}
	}
	public class Variable : BaseVariable, IFieldElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IHasType, IBaseVariable, IHasArrayNameModifier

		[Description("The Variable that contibutes type, modifiers (static, volatile, new, and/or readonly), and visibility to this variable. This property will be assigned if this variable was declared in a list (e.g., \"int a, b;\").")]
		[Category("Modifiers")]
		public Variable AncestorVariable => _AncestorVariable;

		[Description("True if this variable inherits modifiers from a previously-declared variable. For example, in the C# declaration \"int aa, bb;\", bb inherits its type and modifiers from aa. If this property is true, you can access the variable providing the modifiers through the AncestorVariable property.")]
		[Category("Modifiers")]
		public bool InheritsModifiers => _AncestorVariable != null;

		[Description("Gets previous variable if this variable is in declaration list. E.g. for the code int i, j, k; previous variable for \"j\" will be \"i\".")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public Variable PreviousVariable => _PreviousVariable;

		[Description("Gets next variable if this variable is in declaration list. E.g. for the code int i, j, k; next variable for \"j\" will be \"k\".")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public Variable NextVariable => _NextVariable;

		[Description("Returns true if this variable is in variable declaration list. E.g. for the code int i, j, k; variables i, j, k are in list.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public bool IsInDeclarationList
		{
			get
			{
				if (PreviousVariable == null)
				{
					return NextVariable != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns first variable inside variable delcaration list. E.g. for the code int i, j, k; it will return i variable.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public Variable FirstVariable
		{
			get
			{
				Variable variable = this;
				for (Variable variable2 = variable; variable2 != null; variable2 = variable2.PreviousVariable)
				{

			}

		[Description("Returns last variable inside variable delcaration list. E.g. for the code int i, j, k; it will return k variable.")]
		[Category("Family")]

				Variable variable = this;
				for (Variable variable2 = variable; variable2 != null; variable2 = variable2.NextVariable)

					variable = variable2;
				}
				return variable;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this variable is in the start of a variable declaration list.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public bool IsStart

				if (PreviousVariable == null)
				{
					return NextVariable != null;
				}
				return false;
			}

		[Description("Returns true if this variable is in the middle of a variable declaration list.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public bool IsMiddle
		{
			get
			{
				if (PreviousVariable != null)
				{
					return NextVariable != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this variable is in the end of a variable declaration list.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public bool IsEnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (PreviousVariable != null)
				{
					return NextVariable == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this variable has type.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public bool HasType
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasType;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasType = value;
			}
		}

		[Description("Returns true if this variable declares fixed size buffer.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public override bool IsFixedSizeBuffer => _FixedSize != null;

		[Description("Gets or sets fixed size variable expression.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public Expression FixedSize
		{
			get
			{
				return _FixedSize;
			}
			set
			{

			}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool IsAspxTag

		public override bool IsRunAtServer
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsRunAtServer;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsRunAtServer = value;
			}
		}

		bool IFieldElement.IsConst => false;

		IExpression IFieldElement.Expression => null;

		bool IFieldElement.IsBitField => IsBitField;

		IExpression IFieldElement.BitFieldSize => BitFieldSize;

		IElement IFieldElement.NodeLink => null;

		bool IFieldElement.HasNodeLink => false;

		public bool IsEvent
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsEvent;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsEvent = value;
			}
		}

		public Variable()
		{
		}

		public Variable(string name)
			: this(string.Empty, name)
		{
		}

		public Variable(string type, string name)
		{
			base.MemberType = type;
			InternalName = name;
		}

		protected internal override bool GetCanBeDocumented()
		{
			if (!base.InsideMethod)
			{
				return !base.InsideProperty;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (base.MemberType == null || base.MemberType == string.Empty)
			{
				return Name;
			}
			return base.MemberType + " " + Name;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void SetFixedSize(Expression expression)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNode(_FixedSize, expression);
			_FixedSize = expression;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_FixedSize == oldElement)
			{
				SetFixedSize(newElement as Expression);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			_FixedSize = null;
			if (_PreviousVariable != null && _NextVariable != null)
			{
				_PreviousVariable._NextVariable = null;
				_PreviousVariable.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_PreviousVariable = null;
				_NextVariable._PreviousVariable = null;
				_NextVariable.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_NextVariable = null;
			}
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Variable variable))
			{
				return;
			}
			_HasType = variable._HasType;
			_IsAspxTag = variable._IsAspxTag;
			if (variable._FixedSize != null)
			{
				_FixedSize = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, variable, variable._FixedSize) as Expression;
				if (_FixedSize == null)
				{
					_FixedSize = variable._FixedSize.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (variable._FixedSize != null)
			{
				_FixedSize = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, variable, variable._FixedSize) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_FixedSize == null)
				{
					_FixedSize = variable._FixedSize.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
			options.AddClonedElement(variable, this);
			if (variable._PreviousVariable != null)
			{
				_PreviousVariable = RequestClonedVariable(variable._PreviousVariable, options);
			}
			if (variable._NextVariable != null)
			{
				_NextVariable = RequestClonedVariable(variable._NextVariable, options);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void SetNextVariable(Variable variable)
		{
			if (_NextVariable != variable)
			{
				_NextVariable = variable;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void SetPreviousVariable(Variable variable)
		{
			if (_PreviousVariable != variable)
			{
				_PreviousVariable = variable;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void SetAncestorVariable(Variable variable)
		{
			if (_AncestorVariable != variable)
			{
				_AncestorVariable = variable;
			}
		}

		public ArrayList GetDeclarationList()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (!IsInDeclarationList)
			{
				arrayList.Add(this);
				return arrayList;
			}
			Variable variable = this;
			while (variable != null && !variable.IsStart)
			{
				variable = variable.PreviousVariable;
			}
			if (variable == null)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			arrayList.Add(variable);
			while (variable != null && !variable.IsEnd)
			{
				variable = variable.NextVariable;
				arrayList.Add(variable);
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		public ArrayList GetReferencesInRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (range == SourceRange.Empty)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			ArrayList references = base.References;
			for (int i = 0; i < references.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)references[i];
				if (range.Contains(languageElement.Range))
				{
					arrayList.Add(languageElement);
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private Variable RequestClonedVariable(Variable variable, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (options.GetClonedElement(variable) is Variable result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			Variable variable2 = variable.Clone(options) as Variable;
			options.AddClonedElement(variable, variable2);
			return variable2;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Variable variable = new Variable();
			variable.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return variable;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IMemberElement.get_Signature()
		{
			return base.Signature;
		}
	}

	public class While : ConditionalParentToSingleStatement, IWhileStatement, IStatement, IElement
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private Expression _Condition;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.While;

		public Expression Condition
		{
			get
			{
				return _Condition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetExpression(value);
			}
		}

		IExpression IWhileStatement.Condition => Condition;

		public While()
		{
			base.IsBreakable = true;
		}

		public While(Expression expression, LanguageElementCollection block)
			: this(expression, block, SourceRange.Empty)
		{
		}

		public While(Expression expression, LanguageElementCollection block, SourceRange range)
		{
			base.IsBreakable = true;
			SetExpression(expression);
			SetRange(range);
			AddNodes(block);
		}

		protected void SetExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			_Condition?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Condition = expression;
			if (_Condition != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Condition);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is While))
			{
				return;
			}
			While obj = (While)source;
			if (obj._Condition != null)
			{
				_Condition = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, obj, obj._Condition) as Expression;
				if (_Condition == null)
				{
					_Condition = obj._Condition.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Condition == oldElement)
			{
				_Condition = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 55;
		}

		public override string GetDetailNodeDescription(int index)
		{
			return "While-loop expression";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetCondition(Expression condition)
		{
			_Condition = condition;
			AddDetailNode(condition);
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			While obj = new While();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}
