	public enum AttributeTargetType : byte
	{
		None,
		Assembly,
		Field,
		Event,
		Method,
		Module,
		Param,
		Property,
		Return,
		Type,
		Class,
		Constructor,
		Delegate,
		Enum,
		Interface,
		Struct
	}
	public class Attribute : SupportElement, IHasQualifier, IHasSource, IAttributeElement, IElement, IWithSource, IWithArguments, IWithArgumentsModifier, IHasParens
	{
		private const int INT_MaintainanceComplexity = 3;

		private TextRange _NameRange;

		private TextRange _ParensRange;

		private Expression _Qualifier;

		private ExpressionCollection _Arguments;

		private AttributeTargetType _TargetType;

		protected override int ThisMaintenanceComplexity => 3;

		public Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				SetQualifier(value);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Expression Source
		{
			get
			{
				return Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				Qualifier = value;
			}
		}

		public int ArgumentCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Arguments.Count;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Arguments != value)
				{
					_Arguments = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public AttributeTargetType TargetType
		{
			get
			{
				return _TargetType;
			}
			set
			{
				_TargetType = value;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Attribute;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange ParensRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_ParensRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_ParensRange = value;
			}
		}

		bool IAttributeElement.HasTargetNode => base.TargetNode != null;

		IExpressionCollection IAttributeElement.Arguments
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIExpressionCollection;
				}
				return _Arguments;
			}
		}

		IExpression IAttributeElement.Qualifier => Qualifier;

		IExpression IWithSource.Source => Qualifier;

		IExpressionCollection IWithArguments.Args => Arguments;

		public Attribute()
		{
			_TargetType = AttributeTargetType.None;
		}

		private void SetQualifier(Expression qualifier)
		{
			if (_Qualifier == null)
			{
				_Qualifier = qualifier;
				AddDetailNode(qualifier);
			}
			else
			{
				ReplaceDetailNode(_Qualifier, qualifier);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Attribute))
			{
				return;
			}
			Attribute attribute = (Attribute)source;
			_NameRange = attribute.NameRange;
			_TargetType = attribute._TargetType;
			if (attribute._Qualifier != null)
			{
				_Qualifier = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, attribute, attribute._Qualifier) as Expression;
				if (_Qualifier == null)
				{
					_Qualifier = attribute._Qualifier.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (attribute._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, attribute.DetailNodes, _Arguments, attribute._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && attribute._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = attribute._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
			_ParensRange = ParensRange;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Arguments != null && _Arguments.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_Arguments.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else if (_Qualifier != null && _Qualifier == oldElement)
			{
				_Qualifier = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 71;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (_TargetType != AttributeTargetType.None)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(_TargetType.ToString() + ": ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(InternalName);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Attribute attribute = new Attribute();
			attribute.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return attribute;
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression argument)
		{
			if (argument != null)
			{
				Arguments.Add(argument);
				AddDetailNode(argument);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveArgument(Expression argument)
		{
			if (argument != null)
			{
				Arguments.Remove(argument);
				RemoveDetailNode(argument);
			}
		}

		public void InsertArgument(int index, Expression argument)
		{
			if (argument != null)
			{
				Arguments.Insert(index, argument);
				InsertDetailNode(index, argument);
			}
		}

		public static AttributeTargetType GetTargetTypeFromName(string name)
		{
			return name.ToLower() switch
			{
				"assembly" => AttributeTargetType.Assembly, 
				"field" => AttributeTargetType.Field, 
				"event" => AttributeTargetType.Event, 
				"method" => AttributeTargetType.Method, 
				"module" => AttributeTargetType.Module, 
				"param" => AttributeTargetType.Param, 
				"property" => AttributeTargetType.Property, 
				"return" => AttributeTargetType.Return, 
				"type" => AttributeTargetType.Type, 
				_ => AttributeTargetType.None, 
			};
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.AddArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			AddArgument(argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.InsertArgument(int index, IExpression argument)
		{
			InsertArgument(index, argument as Expression);
		}

		void IWithArgumentsModifier.RemoveArgument(IExpression argument)
		{
			RemoveArgument(argument as Expression);
		}
	}
	public class AttributeCollection : LanguageElementCollectionBase
	{
		public new Attribute this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (Attribute)base[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Add(Attribute aAttribute)
		{
			return Add((LanguageElement)aAttribute);
		}

		public int IndexOf(Attribute aAttribute)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] == aAttribute)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, Attribute aAttribute)
		{
			Insert(index, (LanguageElement)aAttribute);
		}

		public void Remove(Attribute aAttribute)
		{
			Remove((LanguageElement)aAttribute);
		}

		public Attribute Find(Attribute aAttribute)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					Attribute attribute = (Attribute)enumerator.Current;
					if (attribute == aAttribute)
					{
						return attribute;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Contains(Attribute aAttribute)
		{
			return Find(aAttribute) != null;
		}
	}
	public class AttributeSection : SupportElement, IAttributeSectionElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IHasAttributesModifier
	{
		private NodeList _AttributeCollection;

		IAttributeElementCollection IHasAttributes.Attributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (AttributeCollection == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIAttributeElementCollection;
				}
				LiteAttributeElementCollection liteAttributeElementCollection = new LiteAttributeElementCollection();
				liteAttributeElementCollection.AddRange(AttributeCollection);
				return liteAttributeElementCollection;
			}
		}

		public NodeList AttributeCollection => _AttributeCollection;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.AttributeSection;

		bool IAttributeSectionElement.HasTargetNode => base.TargetNode != null;

		public AttributeSection()
		{
			_AttributeCollection = new NodeList();
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is AttributeSection))
			{
				return;
			}
			AttributeSection attributeSection = (AttributeSection)source;
			if (attributeSection.AttributeCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_AttributeCollection == null)
			{
				_AttributeCollection = new NodeList();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < attributeSection.AttributeCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				if (attributeSection.AttributeCollection[i] is Attribute value)
				{
					int num = attributeSection.DetailNodes.IndexOf(value);
					if (num >= 0 && num < attributeSection.DetailNodes.Count)
					{
						_AttributeCollection.Add(DetailNodes[num]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 71;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string arg = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < AttributeCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", arg, AttributeCollection[i].ToString());
				arg = ", ";
			}
			return $"[{stringBuilder.ToString()}]";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override void OwnedReferencesTransferred()
		{
			if (_AttributeCollection != null)
			{
				_AttributeCollection.Clear();
				_AttributeCollection = null;
			}
			base.OwnedReferencesTransferred();
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_AttributeCollection != null && _AttributeCollection.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_AttributeCollection.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override void SetTarget(LanguageElement targetNode)
		{
			base.SetTarget(targetNode);
			if (_AttributeCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < _AttributeCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				if (_AttributeCollection[i] is Attribute attribute)
				{
					attribute.SetTarget(targetNode);
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			AttributeSection attributeSection = new AttributeSection();
			attributeSection.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return attributeSection;
		}

		public void AddAttribute(Attribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				AttributeCollection.Add(attribute);
				AddDetailNode(attribute);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAttribute(Attribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				AttributeCollection.Remove(attribute);
				RemoveDetailNode(attribute);
			}
		}

		void IHasAttributesModifier.AddAttribute(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			AddAttribute(attribute as Attribute);
		}

		void IHasAttributesModifier.RemoveAttribute(IAttributeElement attribute)
		{
			RemoveAttribute(attribute as Attribute);
		}
	}
	public class Class : TypeDeclaration, IClassElement, ITypeElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IGenericElement
	{
		private string _AncestorName = string.Empty;

		private StringCollection _Implements;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Class;

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Description("Gets the name of the ancestor class.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public string AncestorName
		{
			get
			{
				return _AncestorName;
			}
			set
			{
				_AncestorName = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Description("Gets names of the implemented interfaces.")]
		[Category("Family")]
		public StringCollection Implements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Implements == null)
				{
					_Implements = new StringCollection();
				}
				return _Implements;
			}
		}

		public Class()
		{
		}

		public Class(string name)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		public bool AncestorDeclaresMember(LanguageElement member)
		{
			if (member == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (Class ancestor = GetAncestor(); ancestor != null; ancestor = ancestor.GetAncestor())
			{
				if (ancestor.DeclaresMember(member))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool DeclaresMember(LanguageElement member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				return member.Parent == this;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement GetMostComplexMember()
		{
			int num = 0;
			LanguageElement result = null;
			if (Nodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)Nodes[i];
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					int cyclomaticComplexity = languageElement.GetCyclomaticComplexity();
					if (cyclomaticComplexity > num)
					{
						num = cyclomaticComplexity;
						result = languageElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public virtual double GetAverageCyclomaticComplexity()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (Nodes == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				int num3 = 0;
				LanguageElement languageElement = (LanguageElement)Nodes[i];
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					num3 = languageElement.GetCyclomaticComplexity();
					if (num3 != 0)
					{
						num += num3;
						num2++;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return num / num2;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return 42;
			}
			return 5;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Private;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility[] GetValidVisibilities()
		{
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return new MemberVisibility[3]
				{
					MemberVisibility.Private,
					MemberVisibility.Internal,
					MemberVisibility.Public
				};
			}
			return new MemberVisibility[5]
			{
				MemberVisibility.Private,
				MemberVisibility.Protected,
				MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal,
				MemberVisibility.Internal,
				MemberVisibility.Public
			};
		}

		public override bool RangeIsClean(SourceRange sourceRange)
		{
			if (sourceRange.Top > base.BlockStart.Bottom)
			{
				return sourceRange.Bottom < base.BlockEnd.Top;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string GetTypeName()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Class)
				{
					Class obj = (Class)source;
					_AncestorName = obj._AncestorName;
					_Implements = StringHelper.CloneStringCollection(obj._Implements);
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Class obj = new Class();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Class GetAncestor()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = FindDeclaration(_AncestorName, this);
			if (languageElement is Class)
			{
				return (Class)languageElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElementList GetImplements()
		{
			LanguageElementList languageElementList = new LanguageElementList();
			for (int i = 0; i < Implements.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = FindDeclaration(Implements[i], this);
				if (languageElement != null && languageElement is Interface)
				{
					languageElementList.Add(languageElement);
				}
			}
			return languageElementList;
		}
	}

		private TypeReferenceExpression CreateTypeReference(string name)
		{
			return new TypeReferenceExpression(name);
		}

		private void AddDelegateParameters(LanguageElement parent, LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ParameterCount; i++)
			{
				if (base.Parameters[i].Clone() is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					parameters.Add(languageElement);
					parent.AddDetailNode(languageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddParameter(LanguageElement parent, LanguageElementCollection parameters, string type, string name)
		{
			Param param = new Param(type, name);
			param.MemberTypeReference = CreateTypeReference(type);
			param.AddDetailNode(param.MemberTypeReference);
			parameters.Add(param);
			parent.AddDetailNode(param);
		}

		private MethodPrototype GetMethodPrototype(TypeReferenceExpression returnType, string name, MethodTypeEnum methodType)
		{
			if (returnType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MethodPrototype methodPrototype = new MethodPrototype(returnType.FullSignature, name);
			methodPrototype.MethodType = methodType;
			methodPrototype.MemberTypeReference = returnType;
			methodPrototype.AddDetailNode(returnType);
			methodPrototype.SetParent(this);
			return methodPrototype;
		}

		private MethodPrototype GetInvokeMethod()
		{
			MethodPrototype methodPrototype = GetMethodPrototype(CreateTypeReference("void"), "Invoke", MethodTypeEnum.Void);
			if (base.MemberTypeReference != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.MemberTypeReference.FullSignature))
			{
				methodPrototype = GetMethodPrototype(base.MemberTypeReference.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression, "Invoke", MethodTypeEnum.Function);
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.MemberType))
			{
				methodPrototype = GetMethodPrototype(CreateTypeReference(base.MemberType), "Invoke", MethodTypeEnum.Function);
			}
			methodPrototype.SetParent(this);
			AddDelegateParameters(methodPrototype, methodPrototype.Parameters);
			return methodPrototype;
		}

		private MethodPrototype GetBeginInvokeMethod()
		{
			MethodPrototype methodPrototype = GetMethodPrototype(CreateTypeReference("IAsyncResult"), "BeginInvoke", MethodTypeEnum.Function);
			methodPrototype.SetParent(this);
			AddDelegateParameters(methodPrototype, methodPrototype.Parameters);
			AddParameter(methodPrototype, methodPrototype.Parameters, "AsyncCallback", "callback");
			AddParameter(methodPrototype, methodPrototype.Parameters, "object", "@object");
			return methodPrototype;
		}

		private MethodPrototype GetEndInvokeMethod()
		{
			MethodPrototype methodPrototype = GetMethodPrototype(CreateTypeReference("void"), "EndInvoke", MethodTypeEnum.Function);
			if (base.MemberTypeReference != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.MemberTypeReference.FullSignature))
			{
				methodPrototype = GetMethodPrototype(base.MemberTypeReference.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression, "EndInvoke", MethodTypeEnum.Function);
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.MemberType))
			{
				methodPrototype = GetMethodPrototype(CreateTypeReference(base.MemberType), "EndInvoke", MethodTypeEnum.Function);
			}
			methodPrototype.SetParent(this);
			AddOutAndRefParameters(methodPrototype, base.Parameters);
			AddParameter(methodPrototype, methodPrototype.Parameters, "IAsyncResult", "result");
			return methodPrototype;
		}

		private void AddOutAndRefParameters(MethodPrototype result, LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (result == null || parameters == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Param parameter in parameters)
			{
				if (parameter.Direction == ArgumentDirection.Out || parameter.Direction == ArgumentDirection.Ref)
				{
					Param param2 = parameter.Clone() as Param;
					result.Parameters.Add(param2);
					result.AddDetailNode(param2);
				}
			}
		}

		private IElementCollection GetDelegateMethods()
		{
			IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
			elementCollection.Add(GetInvokeMethod());
			elementCollection.Add(GetBeginInvokeMethod());
			elementCollection.Add(GetEndInvokeMethod());
			return elementCollection;
		}

		{
			return null;
		}

		{
			return null;

	public class EnumElement : Member, IEnumElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes
	{
		private string _Value = string.Empty;

		private Expression _ValueExpression;

		private bool _HasComma;

		public bool HasComma
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasComma;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasComma = value;
			}
		}

		public string Value => _Value;

		public Expression ValueExpression => _ValueExpression;

		public override bool VisibilityIsFixed => true;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.EnumElement;

		IExpression IEnumElement.ValueExpression => ValueExpression;

		public EnumElement()
		{
		}

		public EnumElement(string name, int startLine, int startOffset)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
			SetRange(startLine, startOffset, startLine, startOffset + name.Length);
		}

		public EnumElement(string name)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		public EnumElement(string name, Expression valueExpression)
			: this(name)
		{
			if (valueExpression != null)
			{
				SetValueExpression(valueExpression);
			}
		}

		private void SetValueExpression(Expression value)
		{
			_ValueExpression = value;
			AddDetailNode(_ValueExpression);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is EnumElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			EnumElement enumElement = (EnumElement)source;
			_Value = enumElement._Value;
			if (enumElement._ValueExpression != null)
			{
				_ValueExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, enumElement, enumElement._ValueExpression) as Expression;
				if (_ValueExpression == null)
				{
					SetValueExpression(enumElement._ValueExpression.Clone(options) as Expression);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_ValueExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_ValueExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 15;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			EnumElement enumElement = new EnumElement();
			enumElement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return enumElement;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		string IMemberElement.get_Signature()
		{
			return base.Signature;
		}
	}
	public class Enumeration : TypeDeclaration, IEnumerationElement, ITypeElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IGenericElement
	{
		private bool _IsEnumClass;

		private SourceRange _AsRange;

		private string _UnderlyingType;

		private SourceRange _UnderlyingTypeRange;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Enum;

		public SourceRange AsRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_AsRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_AsRange = value;
			}
		}

		public string UnderlyingType
		{
			get
			{
				return _UnderlyingType;
			}
			set
			{
				_UnderlyingType = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange UnderlyingTypeRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_UnderlyingTypeRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_UnderlyingTypeRange = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEnumClass
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsEnumClass;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsEnumClass = value;
			}
		}

		public Enumeration()
		{
			_AsRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			_UnderlyingType = string.Empty;
			_UnderlyingTypeRange = SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public Enumeration(string name)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		protected virtual void SetDefaultUnderlyingType()
		{
			_UnderlyingType = PrimitiveTypeUtils.GetFullTypeName(PrimitiveType.Int32);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is Enumeration)
				{
					Enumeration enumeration = (Enumeration)source;
					_AsRange = enumeration.AsRange;
					_UnderlyingType = enumeration._UnderlyingType;
					_UnderlyingTypeRange = enumeration.UnderlyingTypeRange;
					_IsEnumClass = enumeration.IsEnumClass;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_AsRange = AsRange;
			_UnderlyingTypeRange = UnderlyingTypeRange;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			if (IsStatic)
			{
				return 60;
			}
			return 16;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Public;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Enumeration enumeration = new Enumeration();
			enumeration.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return enumeration;
		}
	}

				MemberVisibility.Internal,
				MemberVisibility.Public
			};
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Struct obj = new Struct();
			obj.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class TypeDeclaration : AccessSpecifiedElement, ITypeElement, IMemberElement, IElement, IHasAttributes, IGenericElement, ITypeElementModifier, IMemberElementModifier, IElementModifier, IHasAttributesModifier, IGenericElementModifier
	{
		private bool _IsPartial;

		private TypeReferenceExpression _PrimaryAncestorType;

		private TypeReferenceExpressionCollection _SecondaryAncestorTypes;

		private bool _HasEndingSemicolon;

		private bool _GenerateBlock = true;

		public bool HasDefaultConstructor
		{
			get
			{
				IEnumerable allMethods = AllMethods;
				foreach (IElement item in allMethods)
				{
					if (item is IMethodElement { MethodType: MethodTypeEnum.Constructor, Visibility: not MemberVisibility.Private } methodElement && methodElement.Parameters.Count == 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.TypeDeclaration;

		public TypeReferenceExpression PrimaryAncestorType
		{
			get
			{
				return _PrimaryAncestorType;
			}
			set
			{
				SetPrimaryAncestorType(value);
			}
		}

		public TypeReferenceExpressionCollection SecondaryAncestorTypes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SecondaryAncestorTypes == null)
				{
					_SecondaryAncestorTypes = new TypeReferenceExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _SecondaryAncestorTypes;
			}
			set
			{
				SetSecondaryAncestorTypes(value);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		public string FullName
		{
			get
			{
				IProjectElement project = Project;
				if (project != null && project.SupportsRootNamespace)
				{
					return base.RootNamespaceLocation;
				}
				return base.Location;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable AllFields => new ElementEnumerable(this, new FieldFilter());

		public IEnumerable AllConstants => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Const));

		public IEnumerable AllProperties => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Property));

		public IEnumerable AllMethods => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Method));

		public IEnumerable AllEvents => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Event));

		public IEnumerable AllTypes => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(TypeDeclaration), useRecursion: true);

		public IEnumerable AllChildTypes => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(TypeDeclaration));

		public IEnumerable AllMembers => new ElementEnumerable(this, typeof(Member));

		bool ITypeElement.IsTypeParameter => false;

		ITypeReferenceExpression ITypeElement.PrimaryAncestor => PrimaryAncestorType;

		ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection ITypeElement.SecondaryAncestors
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SecondaryAncestorTypes == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyITypeReferenceExpressionCollection;
				}
				return _SecondaryAncestorTypes;
			}
		}

		IMemberElementCollection ITypeElement.Members
		{
			get
			{
				if (Nodes == null)
				{
					return EmptyLiteElements.EmptyIMemberElementCollection;
				}
				LiteMemberElementCollection liteMemberElementCollection = new LiteMemberElementCollection();
				int nodeCount = base.NodeCount;
				for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
				{
					object obj = Nodes[i];
					if (obj is IMemberElement)
					{
						liteMemberElementCollection.Add(obj);
					}
				}
				return liteMemberElementCollection;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool IsTypeDeclaration => true;

		public bool HasEndingSemicolon
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasEndingSemicolon;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasEndingSemicolon = value;
			}
		}

		public bool GenerateBlock
		{
			get
			{
				return _GenerateBlock;
			}
			set
			{
				_GenerateBlock = value;
			}
		}

		public TypeDeclaration()
		{
		}

		public TypeDeclaration(string name)
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		private bool CanHaveDeclarationInCurrentType(IElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || element is ITypeReferenceExpression)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is IWithSource)
			{
				return ((IWithSource)element).Source == null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void SetPrimaryAncestorType(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNode(_PrimaryAncestorType, type);
			_PrimaryAncestorType = type;
		}

		protected virtual void SetSecondaryAncestorTypes(TypeReferenceExpressionCollection types)
		{
			ReplaceDetailNodes(SecondaryAncestorTypes, types);
			SecondaryAncestorTypes.Clear();
			SecondaryAncestorTypes.AddRange(types);
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (oldElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_PrimaryAncestorType == oldElement)
			{
				SetPrimaryAncestorType(newElement as TypeReferenceExpression);
				return;
			}
			if (_SecondaryAncestorTypes != null && _SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count != 0)
			{
				int num = SecondaryAncestorTypes.IndexOf(oldElement);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					SecondaryAncestorTypes.RemoveAt(num);
					SecondaryAncestorTypes.Insert(num, newElement);
					ReplaceDetailNode(oldElement, newElement);
					return;
				}
			}
			base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration))
			{
				return;
			}
			_IsPartial = typeDeclaration._IsPartial;
			_HasEndingSemicolon = typeDeclaration._HasEndingSemicolon;
			_GenerateBlock = typeDeclaration._GenerateBlock;
			if (typeDeclaration._PrimaryAncestorType != null)
			{
				_PrimaryAncestorType = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, typeDeclaration, typeDeclaration._PrimaryAncestorType) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				if (_PrimaryAncestorType == null)
				{
					_PrimaryAncestorType = typeDeclaration._PrimaryAncestorType.Clone(options) as TypeReferenceExpression;
				}
			}
			if (typeDeclaration._SecondaryAncestorTypes != null)
			{
				_SecondaryAncestorTypes = new TypeReferenceExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, typeDeclaration.DetailNodes, _SecondaryAncestorTypes, typeDeclaration._SecondaryAncestorTypes);
				if (_SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count == 0 && typeDeclaration._SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count > 0)
				{
					_SecondaryAncestorTypes = typeDeclaration._SecondaryAncestorTypes.DeepClone(options) as TypeReferenceExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = new TypeDeclaration();
			typeDeclaration.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return typeDeclaration;
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()

		{
			if (types != null)
			{
				int count = types.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					AddSecondaryAncestorType(types[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private ITypeElement GetTypeElementFromCache(ITypeElement type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IProjectElement project = type.Project;
			if (project == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return project.FindElementByFullName(type.FullName) as ITypeElement;
		}

		private bool TypeContainsDeclaration(ISourceTreeResolver resolver, ITypeElement type, IMemberElement declaration, SearchScope scope)
		{
			if (!(declaration.Parent is ITypeElement typeElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (StructuralParserServicesHolder.DeclarationsMatch(resolver, type, typeElement))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (scope != SearchScope.AllPartialClasses)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ITypeElement typeElementFromCache = GetTypeElementFromCache(type);
			if (typeElementFromCache == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ITypeElement typeElementFromCache2 = GetTypeElementFromCache(typeElement);
			if (typeElementFromCache2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.DeclarationsMatch(resolver, typeElementFromCache, typeElementFromCache2);
		}

		public bool Declares(IElement element)
		{
			return Declares(element, searchBaseClasses: false);
		}

		public bool Declares(IElement element, bool searchBaseClasses)
		{
			return Declares(element, SearchScope.AllPartialClasses, searchBaseClasses);
		}

		public bool Declares(IElement element, SearchScope scope, bool searchBaseClasses)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetDeclaration(element) is IMemberElement memberElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ISourceTreeResolver sourceTreeResolver = StructuralParserServicesHolder.SourceTreeResolver;
			if (TypeContainsDeclaration(sourceTreeResolver, this, memberElement, scope))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!searchBaseClasses || (memberElement.Visibility != MemberVisibility.Protected && memberElement.Visibility != MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal && memberElement.Visibility != MemberVisibility.Public))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ITypeElement typeElement = GetTypeElementFromCache(this);
			if (typeElement == null)
			{
				typeElement = this;
			}
			ITypeElement[] allBaseTypes = StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetAllBaseTypes(typeElement);
			if (allBaseTypes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = allBaseTypes.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (TypeContainsDeclaration(sourceTreeResolver, allBaseTypes[i], memberElement, scope))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ITypeElementModifier.SetPrimaryAncestor(ITypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			SetPrimaryAncestorType(type as TypeReferenceExpression);
		}

		void ITypeElementModifier.AddSecondaryAncestor(ITypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			AddSecondaryAncestorType(type as TypeReferenceExpression);
		}

		void ITypeElementModifier.AddMember(IMemberElement member)
		{
			AddNode(member as LanguageElement);
		}

		void ITypeElementModifier.RemoveMember(IMemberElement member)
		{
			RemoveNode(member as LanguageElement);
		}
	}
	public class ArrayNameModifier : LanguageElement, IArrayNameModifier, IElement
	{
		private int _Rank;

		private SourceRange _NameRange = SourceRange.Empty;

		private ExpressionCollection _SizeInitializers;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.ArrayNameModifier;

		public int Rank
		{
			get
			{
				return _Rank;
			}
			set
			{
				_Rank = value;
			}
		}

		public ExpressionCollection SizeInitializers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SizeInitializers == null)
				{
					_SizeInitializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _SizeInitializers;
			}
		}

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return GetTransformedRange(_NameRange);
			}
			set
			{
				ClearHistory();
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		IExpressionCollection IArrayNameModifier.SizeInitializers
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SizeInitializers == null)
				{
					_SizeInitializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				return _SizeInitializers;
			}
		}

		public ArrayNameModifier(int rank, ExpressionCollection sizeInitializers)
		{
			_Rank = rank;
			_SizeInitializers = sizeInitializers;
			AddDetailNodes(sizeInitializers);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is ArrayNameModifier))
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayNameModifier arrayNameModifier = (ArrayNameModifier)source;
			_Rank = arrayNameModifier._Rank;
			_NameRange = arrayNameModifier.NameRange;
			if (arrayNameModifier._SizeInitializers != null)
			{
				_SizeInitializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, arrayNameModifier.DetailNodes, _SizeInitializers, arrayNameModifier._SizeInitializers);
				if (_SizeInitializers.Count == 0 && arrayNameModifier._SizeInitializers.Count > 0)
				{
					_SizeInitializers = arrayNameModifier._SizeInitializers.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateRanges()
		{
			base.UpdateRanges();
			_NameRange = NameRange;
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_SizeInitializers != null && _SizeInitializers.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_SizeInitializers.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 94;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("[");
			if (SizeInitializers != null && SizeInitializers.Count > 0)
			{
				string arg = string.Empty;
				for (int i = 0; i < Rank; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", arg, SizeInitializers[i].ToString());
					arg = ", ";
				}
			}
			else if (Rank > 1)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Rank - 1; j++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("]");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	public class MarkupExtensionExpression : Expression, IMarkupExtensionExpression, IExpression, IElement, IObjectInitializerExpression, IWithSource, IWithArguments, IHasArguments, IHasQualifier, IHasSource
	{
		private SourceRange _NameRange;

		private ExpressionCollection _Arguments;

		private ExpressionCollection _Initializers;

		private Expression _Qualifier;

		public ExpressionCollection Arguments => _Arguments;

		IExpressionCollection IWithArguments.Args => _Arguments;

		public int ArgumentCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Arguments.Count;
			}
		}

		public int InitializerCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Initializers == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Initializers.Count;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression;

		public ExpressionCollection Initializers => _Initializers;

		public override SourceRange NameRange
		{
			get
			{
				return _NameRange;
			}
			set
			{
				_NameRange = value;
			}
		}

		public Expression Qualifier
		{
			get
			{
				return _Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				ReplaceNode(_Qualifier, value);
				_Qualifier = value;
			}
		}

		Expression IHasSource.Source
		{
			get
			{
				return Qualifier;
			}
			set
			{
				Qualifier = value;
			}
		}

		IExpression IWithSource.Source => Qualifier;

		int IHasArguments.ArgumentsCount => ArgumentCount;

		IExpressionCollection IObjectInitializerExpression.Initializers => Initializers;

		public MarkupExtensionExpression()
		{
			Name = string.Empty;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is MarkupExtensionExpression markupExtensionExpression))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (markupExtensionExpression._Initializers != null)
			{
				_Initializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, markupExtensionExpression.DetailNodes, _Initializers, markupExtensionExpression._Initializers);
				if (_Initializers.Count == 0 && markupExtensionExpression._Initializers.Count > 0)
				{
					_Initializers = markupExtensionExpression._Initializers.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (markupExtensionExpression._Arguments != null)
			{
				_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, markupExtensionExpression.DetailNodes, _Arguments, markupExtensionExpression._Arguments);
				if (_Arguments.Count == 0 && markupExtensionExpression._Arguments.Count > 0)
				{
					_Arguments = markupExtensionExpression._Arguments.DeepClone(options) as ExpressionCollection;
				}
			}
			if (markupExtensionExpression._Qualifier != null)
			{
				Qualifier = markupExtensionExpression._Qualifier.Clone(options) as Expression;
			}
			_NameRange = markupExtensionExpression._NameRange;
		}

		public void AddArgument(Expression argument)
		{
			if (argument != null)
			{
				if (_Arguments == null)
				{
					_Arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				_Arguments.Add(argument);
				AddDetailNode(argument);
			}
		}

		public void AddInitializer(Expression initializer)
		{
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				if (_Initializers == null)
				{
					_Initializers = new ExpressionCollection();
				}
				_Initializers.Add(initializer);
				AddDetailNode(initializer);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			MarkupExtensionExpression markupExtensionExpression = new MarkupExtensionExpression();
			markupExtensionExpression.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return markupExtensionExpression;
		}

		public override IElement Resolve(ISourceTreeResolver resolver)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

		public LanguageElementCollection Names
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Names == null)
				{
					_Names = new LanguageElementCollection();
				}
				return _Names;
			}
		}

		public int NamesCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Names == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Names.Count;
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			XmlMixedContentSpec xmlMixedContentSpec = new XmlMixedContentSpec();
			xmlMixedContentSpec.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return xmlMixedContentSpec;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is XmlMixedContentSpec))
			{
				return;
			}
			XmlMixedContentSpec xmlMixedContentSpec = (XmlMixedContentSpec)source;
			Names.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < xmlMixedContentSpec.Names.Count; i++)
			{
				if (xmlMixedContentSpec.Names[i] != null)
				{
					Names.Add(xmlMixedContentSpec.Names[i].Clone() as LanguageElement);
				}
			}
		}
	}

				_NDataValue = value;
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			XmlEntityDecl xmlEntityDecl = new XmlEntityDecl();
			xmlEntityDecl.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return xmlEntityDecl;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (source is XmlEntityDecl)
			{
				XmlEntityDecl xmlEntityDecl = (XmlEntityDecl)source;
				_IsParameterEntity = xmlEntityDecl._IsParameterEntity;
				_ImmediateValue = xmlEntityDecl._ImmediateValue;
				if (xmlEntityDecl._ExternalLinkValue != null)
				{
					_ExternalLinkValue = xmlEntityDecl._ExternalLinkValue.Clone() as NewExternalIDLink;
				}
				else
				{
					_ExternalLinkValue = null;
				}
				_NDataValue = xmlEntityDecl._NDataValue;
			}
		}
	}

	public class XmlElement : XmlNode, ICapableBlock, IHasBlock, IMarkupElement
	{
		private XmlElementType _XmlElementType;

		private TextRangeWrapper _BlockStart;

		private TextRangeWrapper _BlockEnd;

		private bool _HasCloseTag = true;

		public bool HasCloseTag
		{
			get
			{
				return _HasCloseTag;
			}
			set
			{
				_HasCloseTag = value;
			}
		}

		public NodeList XmlAttributes => InnerDetailNodes;

		public bool HasAttributes => XmlAttributes.Count > 0;

		public XmlElementType XmlElementType
		{
			get
			{
				if (_XmlElementType == XmlElementType.NotSet)
				{
					switch (InternalName)
					{
					case "summary":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Summary;
						break;
					case "param":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Param;
						break;
					case "seealso":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.SeeAlso;
						break;
					case "returns":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Returns;
						break;
					case "c":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.FormattedSingleLineCode;
						break;
					case "code":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.FormattedMultiLineCode;
						break;
					case "list":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.List;
						break;
					case "item":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Item;
						break;
					case "description":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Description;
						break;
					case "example":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Example;
						break;
					case "exception":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Exception;
						break;
					case "include":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Include;
						break;
					case "para":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Paragraph;
						break;
					case "paramref":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.ParamRef;
						break;
					case "permission":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Permission;
						break;
					case "value":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Value;
						break;
					case "remarks":
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Remarks;
						break;
					default:
						_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.Unknown;
						break;
					}
				}
				return _XmlElementType;
			}
		}

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.XmlDocElement;

		public DelimiterBlockType BlockType => DelimiterBlockType.Middle;

		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public virtual bool HasDelimitedBlock
		{
			get
			{
				if (BlockStart != SourceRange.Empty)
				{
					return BlockEnd != SourceRange.Empty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public SourceRange BlockStart => GetTransformedRange(_BlockStart);

		[Category("Block Delimiters")]
		public SourceRange BlockEnd => GetTransformedRange(_BlockEnd);

		public XmlElement()
		{
			_XmlElementType = XmlElementType.NotSet;
		}

		public XmlElement(string name)
			: this()
		{
			InternalName = name;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is XmlElement)
				{
					XmlElement xmlElement = (XmlElement)source;
					_XmlElementType = xmlElement._XmlElementType;
					_HasCloseTag = xmlElement._HasCloseTag;
				}
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return XmlElementType switch
			{
				XmlElementType.Summary => 112, 
				XmlElementType.Param => 113, 
				XmlElementType.SeeAlso => 115, 
				XmlElementType.Returns => 114, 
				XmlElementType.FormattedSingleLineCode => 123, 
				XmlElementType.FormattedMultiLineCode => 122, 
				XmlElementType.List => 120, 
				XmlElementType.Item => 121, 
				_ => 116, 
			};
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "<" + InternalName + ">";
		}

		public XmlAttribute GetAttribute(string attributeName)
		{
			return GetAttribute(attributeName, ignoreCase: false);
		}

		public XmlAttribute GetAttribute(string attributeName, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			StringComparison comparisonType = (ignoreCase ? StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase : StringComparison.CurrentCulture);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DetailNodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (DetailNodes[i] is XmlAttribute)
				{
					XmlAttribute xmlAttribute = (XmlAttribute)DetailNodes[i];
					if (string.Compare(xmlAttribute.Name, attributeName, comparisonType) == 0)
					{
						return xmlAttribute;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public string GetValue(string attributeName)
		{
			XmlAttribute attribute = GetAttribute(attributeName);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				return attribute.Value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			XmlElement xmlElement = new XmlElement();
			xmlElement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return xmlElement;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetBlockStart(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_BlockStart = range;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetBlockEnd(SourceRange range)
		{
			ClearHistory();
			_BlockEnd = range;
		}
	}

	public class MacroInfoCollection : DictionaryBase
	{
		private Hashtable _FullMacroRanges = new Hashtable();

		private bool _SyncMacroRanges = true;

		public ICollection Keys => base.InnerHashtable.Keys;

		public ICollection Values => base.InnerHashtable.Values;

		public MacroInfo this[SourceRange keyRange]
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.InnerHashtable.Contains(keyRange))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.InnerHashtable[keyRange] as MacroInfo;
			}
			set
			{
				base.InnerHashtable[keyRange] = value;
			}
		}

		public Hashtable FullMacroRanges
		{
			get
			{
				if (_SyncMacroRanges)
				{
					UpdateFullMacroRanges();
				}
				return _FullMacroRanges;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFullMacroRanges()
		{
			_SyncMacroRanges = false;
			_FullMacroRanges.Clear();
			foreach (object value in Values)
			{
				if (value is MacroInfo { MacroFullRange: { IsEmpty: false } macroFullRange } && !_FullMacroRanges.ContainsKey(macroFullRange))
				{
					_FullMacroRanges.Add(macroFullRange, macroFullRange);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClear()
		{
			base.OnClear();
			_SyncMacroRanges = true;
		}

		protected override void OnInsert(object key, object value)
		{
			base.OnInsert(key, value);
			_SyncMacroRanges = true;
		}

		protected override void OnRemove(object key, object value)
		{
			base.OnRemove(key, value);
			_SyncMacroRanges = true;
		}

		public void Add(SourceRange keyRange, MacroInfo info)
		{
			base.InnerHashtable.Add(keyRange, info);
		}

		public void AddRange(IDictionary range)
		{
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = range.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				base.InnerHashtable.Add(enumerator.Key, enumerator.Value);
			}
		}

		public bool ContainsKey(object key)
		{
			return base.InnerHashtable.ContainsKey(key);
		}

		public void Remove(SourceRange keyRange)
		{
			base.InnerHashtable.Remove(keyRange);
		}

		public string GetExpansion(SourceRange keyRange)
		{
			return this[keyRange]?.MacroExpansion;
		}

		public bool ContainsFullRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (!range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return FullMacroRanges.Contains(range);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public static class ParserFactory
	{
		private const ParserVersion DefaultParserVersion = ParserVersion.VS2010;

		public static ParserBase CreateParserForFileExtension(string extension)
		{
			return CreateParserForFileExtension(extension, ParserVersion.VS2010);
		}

		public static ParserBase CreateParserForFileExtension(string extension, ParserVersion parserVersion)
		{
			return CreateParser(ParserLanguage.FromFileExtension(extension), parserVersion);
		}

		public static ParserBase CreateParser(string language)
		{
			return CreateParser(language, ParserVersion.VS2010);
		}

		public static ParserBase CreateParser(string language, ParserVersion parserVersion)
		{
			return CreateParser(ParserLanguage.FromString(language), parserVersion);
		}

		public static ParserBase CreateParser(ParserLanguageID languageID)
		{
			return CreateParser(languageID, ParserVersion.VS2010);
		}

		public static ParserBase CreateParser(ParserLanguageID languageID, ParserVersion parserVersion)
		{
			switch (languageID)
			{
			case ParserLanguageID.None:
				return null;
			case ParserLanguageID.CSharp:
			{
				CSharp30Parser cSharp30Parser = new CSharp30Parser();
				if (parserVersion == ParserVersion.VS2008 || parserVersion == ParserVersion.VS2010 || parserVersion == ParserVersion.VS2011)
				{
					cSharp30Parser.WorkAsCSharp30Parser = true;
				}
				return cSharp30Parser;
			}
			case ParserLanguageID.Basic:
			{
				VB10Parser vB10Parser = new VB10Parser();
				vB10Parser.VsVersion = parserVersion;
				return vB10Parser;
			}
			case ParserLanguageID.JavaScript:
				return new JavaScriptParser();
			case ParserLanguageID.Html:
				return new HtmlParser();
			case ParserLanguageID.Xaml:
				return new HtmlParser(workAsXAMLParser: true);
			case ParserLanguageID.Xml:
				return new NewXmlParser();
			case ParserLanguageID.Css:
				return new CssParser();
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class TokenCategoryHelperFactory
	{
		public static ITokenCategoryHelper CreateHelperForFileExtensions(string extension)
		{
			if (extension.ToLower() == "css" || extension.ToLower() == ".css")
			{
				return CreateHelper(ParserLanguageID.Css);
			}
			return CreateHelper(ParserLanguage.FromFileExtension(extension));
		}

		public static ITokenCategoryHelper CreateHelper(ParserLanguageID languageID)
		{
			return languageID switch
			{
				ParserLanguageID.None => null, 
				ParserLanguageID.CSharp => new CSharpTokensCategoryHelper(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Basic => new VBTokensCategoryHelper(), 
				ParserLanguageID.JavaScript => new JavaScriptTokensCategoryHelper(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Html => new HtmlTokensCategoryHelper(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Xaml => new HtmlTokensCategoryHelper(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Xml => new XmlTokensCategoryHelper(), 
				ParserLanguageID.Css => new CssTokensCategoryHelper(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum ParserLanguageID
	{
		None = 0,
		CSharp = 1,
		Basic = 2,
		Cpp = 4,
		Html = 8,
		JavaScript = 0x10,
		Xaml = 0x20,
		Xml = 0x40,
		Css = 0x80,
		FSharp = 0x100
	}
	public static class ParserLanguage
	{
		private const string STR_Cs = "cs";

		private const string STR_DotCs = ".cs";

		private const string STR_Csproj = "csproj";

		private const string STR_DotCSProj = ".csproj";

		private const string STR_Vb = "vb";

		private const string STR_DotVb = ".vb";

		private const string STR_Vbproj = "vbproj";

		private const string STR_DotVBProj = ".vbproj";

		private const string STR_H = "h";

		private const string STR_DotH = ".h";

		private const string STR_Hh = "hh";

		private const string STR_DotHh = ".hh";

		private const string STR_Cpp = "cpp";

		private const string STR_DotCpp = ".cpp";

		private const string STR_CPPproj = "vcproj";

		private const string STR_DotCppProj = ".vcproj";

		private const string STR_Xaml = "xaml";

		private const string STR_DotXaml = ".xaml";

		private const string STR_Js = "js";

		private const string STR_DotJs = ".js";

		private const string STR_Html = "html";

		private const string STR_DotHtml = ".html";

		private const string STR_Htm = "htm";

		private const string STR_DotHtm = ".htm";

		private const string STR_Xml = "xml";

		private const string STR_DotXml = ".xml";

		private const string STR_Css = "css";

		private const string STR_DotCss = ".css";

		public static string ToString(ParserLanguageID language)
		{
			return language.ToString();
		}

		public static ParserLanguageID FromString(string language)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(language))
			{
				return ParserLanguageID.None;
			}
			if (string.Compare(language, "InternalHTML", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				return ParserLanguageID.Html;
			}
			try
			{
				return (ParserLanguageID)Enum.Parse(typeof(ParserLanguageID), language, ignoreCase: true);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return ParserLanguageID.None;
		}

		public static ParserLanguageID FromFileExtension(string extension)
		{
			switch (extension.ToLower())
			{
			case "cs":
			case ".cs":
			case "csproj":
			case ".csproj":
				return ParserLanguageID.CSharp;
			case "vb":
			case ".vb":
			case "vbproj":
			case ".vbproj":
				return ParserLanguageID.Basic;
			case "h":
			case ".h":
			case "hh":
			case ".hh":
			case "cpp":
			case ".cpp":
			case "vcproj":
			case ".vcproj":
				return ParserLanguageID.Cpp;
			case "xaml":
			case ".xaml":
				return ParserLanguageID.Xaml;
			case "js":
			case ".js":
				return ParserLanguageID.JavaScript;
			case "html":
			case ".html":
			case "htm":
			case ".htm":
				return ParserLanguageID.Html;
			case "xml":
			case ".xml":
				return ParserLanguageID.Xml;
			case "css":
			case ".css":
				return ParserLanguageID.Xml;
			default:
				return ParserLanguageID.None;
			}
		}
	}
	public enum ParserVersion
	{
		Unknown = -1,
		VS2002 = 1,
		VS2003 = 2,
		VS2005 = 3,
		VS2008 = 4,
		VS2010 = 5,
		VS2011 = 6,
		VS2012 = 6,
		VS2014 = 7
	}

	public class CategorizedToken : Token
	{
		private TokenCategory _Category = TokenCategory.Unknown;

		private TokenLanguage _Language;

		private bool _WasCheckedCategorizedToken;

		public bool WasCheckedCategorizedToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _WasCheckedCategorizedToken;
			}
			set

			}
		}

		public TokenCategory Category

			get

			}
			set

				_Category = value;
			}
		}

		public TokenLanguage Language
		{
			get
			{
				return _Language;
			}
			set
			{
				_Language = value;
			}
		}

		public CategorizedToken()
			: this(-1, -1, -1, -1, 6, null)
		{
		}

		public CategorizedToken(TokenLanguage language)
			: this()
		{
			_Language = language;
		}

		public CategorizedToken(int startPosition, int endPosition, int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, int tokenType, string value)
			: base(startPosition, endPosition, line, column, endLine, endColumn, tokenType, value)
		{
		}

		public CategorizedToken(int startPosition, int endPosition, int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, int tokenType, string value, TokenCategory category)
			: base(startPosition, endPosition, line, column, endLine, endColumn, tokenType, value)
		{
			_Category = category;
		}

		public CategorizedToken(int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, int tokenType, string value)
			: base(-1, -1, line, column, endLine, endColumn, tokenType, value)
		{
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(Token source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is CategorizedToken categorizedToken)
				{
					_Category = categorizedToken._Category;
					_Language = categorizedToken._Language;
				}
			}
		}

		public string GetTokenCategory()
		{
			return _Category switch
			{
				TokenCategory.Keyword => "Keyword", 
				TokenCategory.Operator => "Operator", 
				TokenCategory.PreprocessorKeyword => "Preprocessor Keyword", 
				TokenCategory.String => "String", 
				TokenCategory.Number => "Number", 
				TokenCategory.Comment => "Comment", 
				TokenCategory.XmlComment => "XML Doc Tag", 
				TokenCategory.Identifier => "Identifier", 
				TokenCategory.CssComment => "CSS Comment", 
				TokenCategory.CssKeyword => "CSS Keyword", 
				TokenCategory.CssPropertyName => "CSS Property Name", 
				TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue => "CSS Property Value", 
				TokenCategory.CssSelector => "CSS Selector", 
				TokenCategory.CssStringValue => "CSS String Value", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlServerSideScript => "HTML Server-Side Script", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlElementName => "HTML Element Name", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlEntity => "HTML Entity", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlOperator => "HTML Operator", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlComment => "HTML Comment", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlAttributeName => "HTML Attribute Name", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlAttributeValue => "HTML Attribute Value", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlString => "HTML String", 
				TokenCategory.HtmlTagDelimiter => "HTML Tag Delimiter", 
				_ => "Text", 
			};
		}

		public override Token Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CategorizedToken categorizedToken = new CategorizedToken();
			categorizedToken.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return categorizedToken;
		}

	internal class CharReader : TextReader
	{
		private string _Str;

		private int _Position;

		public int Length
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Str == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Str.Length;
			}
		}

		public int Position
		{
			get
			{
				return _Position;
			}
			set
			{
				_Position = value;
			}
		}

		public CharReader(string s)
		{
			_Str = s;
			_Position = 0;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			_Str = null;
			_Position = 0;
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override void Close()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
		}

		public override int Peek()
		{
			if (_Str == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_Position < 0 || _Position >= Length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _Str[_Position];
		}

		public override int Read()
		{
			if (_Str == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (_Position < 0 || _Position >= Length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _Str[_Position++];
		}

		public override int Read(char[] buffer, int index, int count)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buffer");
			}
			if (index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			if (count < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("count");
			}
			if (buffer.Length - index < count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid offset & length");
			}
			if (_Str == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = Length - _Position;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				if (num > count)
				{
					num = count;
				}
				_Str.CopyTo(_Position, buffer, index, num);
				_Position += num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override string ReadLine()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException("ReadLine");
		}

		public override string ReadToEnd()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException("ReadToEnd");
		}
	}
	public class CharProvider
	{
		private class CharListItem
		{
			public char Value;

			public CharListItem Next;
		}

		private const char EOL = '\n';

		private TextReader _Reader;

		private CharListItem _CharsQueueHead;

		private CharListItem _PeekCharPosition;

		private string _Str;

		public bool HasPeekedChars
		{
			get
			{
				if (_CharsQueueHead != null)
				{
					return _CharsQueueHead.Next != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public CharProvider(TextReader reader)
		{
			_Str = reader.ReadToEnd();
			_Reader = new CharReader(_Str);
		}

		protected char ReadChar()
		{
			char c = (char)_Reader.Read();
			if (c == 'В' && _Reader.Peek() == 160)
			{
				_Reader.Read();
				c = ' ';
			}
			if (c == '\r' && _Reader.Peek() != 10)
			{
				c = '\n';
			}
			return c;
		}

		public char Get()
		{
			if (_CharsQueueHead != null)
			{
				char value = _CharsQueueHead.Value;
				if (_PeekCharPosition == _CharsQueueHead)
				{
					_PeekCharPosition = _CharsQueueHead.Next;
				}
				_CharsQueueHead = _CharsQueueHead.Next;
				return value;
			}
			return ReadChar();
		}

		public void Seek(int position)
		{
			((CharReader)_Reader).Position = position;
		}

		public char Peek()
		{
			char result;
			if (_PeekCharPosition == null)
			{
				CharListItem charListItem = new CharListItem();
				result = (charListItem.Value = ReadChar());
				_PeekCharPosition = charListItem;
				_CharsQueueHead = charListItem;
			}
			else
			{
				result = _PeekCharPosition.Value;
			}
			if (_PeekCharPosition.Next == null)
			{
				CharListItem charListItem2 = new CharListItem();
				charListItem2.Value = ReadChar();
				_PeekCharPosition.Next = charListItem2;
			}
			_PeekCharPosition = _PeekCharPosition.Next;
			return result;
		}

		public void ResetPeek()
		{
			_PeekCharPosition = _CharsQueueHead;
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			if (_Reader != null)
			{
				_Reader.Close();
				_Reader = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class FormattingElements : List<IFormattingElement>
	{
		public FormattingElements()
		{
		}

		public FormattingElements(List<IFormattingElement> elements)
		{
			AddRange(elements);
		}

		public void AddDeadCode(string text)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				DeadCode item = new DeadCode(text);
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void AddSourceFileStartText(string text)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				SourceFileStartText item = new SourceFileStartText(text);
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public FormattingElements CloneArray(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = new FormattingElements();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				IFormattingElement current = enumerator.Current;
				IFormattingElement formattingElement = CloneElement(current, options);
				if (formattingElement != null)
				{
					formattingElements.Add(formattingElement);
				}
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public FormattingElements GetElements(int index, int count)
		{
			List<IFormattingElement> range = GetRange(index, count);
			return new FormattingElements(range);
		}

		private IFormattingElement CloneElement(IFormattingElement element, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element is XmlDocComment)
			{
				return ((XmlDocComment)element).Clone(options) as IFormattingElement;
			}
			if (element is Comment)
			{
				return ((Comment)element).Clone(options) as IFormattingElement;
			}
			if (element is PreprocessorDirective)
			{
				return ((PreprocessorDirective)element).Clone(options) as IFormattingElement;
			}
			return element.Clone() as IFormattingElement;
		}

		private bool IsLastElement(FormattingElementType type)
		{
			int count = base.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(base[count - 1] is FormattingElement formattingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (formattingElement.Type != type)
			{
				return formattingElement.Type == type;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void Add(FormattingElementType type, int countConsecutive)
		{
			FormattingElement item = new FormattingElement(type, countConsecutive);
			Add(item);
		}

		public void RemoveRange(FormattingElements list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IFormattingElement item in list)
			{
				Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public int GetEndEOLIndex(int index)
		{
			if (base.Count <= index)
			{
				return index;
			}
			if (!(base[index] is FormattingElement formattingElement))
			{
				return index;
			}
			if (formattingElement.Type != FormattingElementType.CR)
			{
				return index;
			}
			if (index + 1 >= base.Count)
			{
				return index;
			}
			if (!(base[index + 1] is FormattingElement formattingElement2))
			{
				return index;
			}
			if (formattingElement2.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL)
			{
				return index + 1;
			}
			return index;
		}

		public FormattingElement GetLastEOLElement(int index)
		{
			if (base.Count <= index)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(base[index] is FormattingElement formattingElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (formattingElement.Type != FormattingElementType.CR)
			{
				return formattingElement;
			}
			if (index + 1 >= base.Count)
			{
				return formattingElement;
			}
			if (!(base[index + 1] is FormattingElement formattingElement2))
			{
				return formattingElement;
			}
			if (formattingElement2.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL)
			{
				return formattingElement2;
			}
			return formattingElement;
		}

		public bool HasOnlyNewLine()
		{
			if (base.Count != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(base[0] is FormattingElement formattingElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return formattingElement.IsEol();
		}

		public void RemoveFirstEOL()
		{
			if (base.Count > 0 && base[0] is FormattingElement formattingElement)
			{
				if (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.CR)
				{
					RemoveAt(0);
				}
				else if (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL)
				{
					RemoveAt(0);
					return;
				}
				if (base.Count > 0 && base[0] is FormattingElement { Type: FormattingElementType.EOL })
				{
					RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}
		}

		public void RemoveEOL(int index)
		{
			if (index < base.Count && index >= 0 && base[index] is FormattingElement formattingElement && formattingElement.IsEol())
			{
				RemoveAt(index--);
				if (index < base.Count && index >= 0 && base[index] is FormattingElement formattingElement2 && formattingElement2.IsEol() && formattingElement2.Type != formattingElement.Type)
				{
					RemoveAt(index);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddWhiteSpace()
		{
			AddWhiteSpace(1);
		}

		public void AddWhiteSpace(int countConsecutive)
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.WS, countConsecutive);
		}

		public void AddIncreaseIndent()
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.IncreaseIndent, 1);
		}

		public void AddDecreaseIndent()
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.DecreaseIndent, 1);
		}

		public void AddIncreaseAlignment()
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.IncreaseAlignment, 1);
		}

		public void AddDecreaseAlignment()
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.DecreaseAlignment, 1);
		}

		public void AddClearIndent()
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.ClearIndent, 1);
		}

		public void AddRestoreIndent()
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.RestoreIndent, 1);
		}

		public void AddNewLine()
		{
			AddNewLine(1);
		}

		public void AddNewLine(int countConsecutive)
		{
			Add(FormattingElementType.EOL, countConsecutive);
		}

		public bool IsLastElementNewLine()
		{
			if (!IsLastElement(FormattingElementType.EOL))
			{
				return IsLastElement(FormattingElementType.CR);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsLastElementWhiteSpace()
		{
			return IsLastElement(FormattingElementType.WS);
		}

		public bool IsLastElementIndent()
		{
			if (!IsLastElement(FormattingElementType.IncreaseIndent))
			{
				return IsLastElement(FormattingElementType.DecreaseIndent);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool DeleteDirective(PreprocessorDirective searchElement)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = base.Count;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				IFormattingElement formattingElement = base[i];
				if (!flag && formattingElement == searchElement)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (formattingElement is FormattingElement { Type: FormattingElementType.EOL })
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						RemoveRange(num, i - num + 1);
						return true;
					}
					num = i + 1;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RemoveRange(num, count - num);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public void DeleteEmptyLines(bool attemptDeleteLastLine)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base[i] is FormattingElement formattingElement)
				{
					if (formattingElement.IsEol())
					{
						if (!flag && num != -1)
						{
							int num2 = i - num + 1;
							RemoveRange(num, num2);
							i -= num2;
						}
						flag = false;
						num = i + 1;
					}
				}
				else if (num != -1)
				{
					flag2 = (flag = true);
				}
				else
				{
					flag3 = base[i] is Comment comment && comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine;
				}
			}
			if (attemptDeleteLastLine && !flag2 && !flag3 && num != -1)
			{
				RemoveRange(num - 1, base.Count - num + 1);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveLastEolIfNeeded()
		{
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = base.Count - 1;
			while (num2 >= 0 && base[num2] is FormattingElement formattingElement)
			{
				if (formattingElement.IsEol())
				{
					num = num2;
				}
				num2--;
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num3 = base.Count - 1; num3 >= num; num3--)
			{
				if (base[num3] is FormattingElement formattingElement2 && (formattingElement2.IsEol() || formattingElement2.IsWsOrTab()))
				{
					RemoveAt(num3);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddNewLineAfterIndex(int i)
		{
			if (i >= base.Count)
			{
				AddNewLine();
			}
			else
			{
				Insert(i + 1, new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL));
			}
		}

		internal void AddFirstIfNeeded(FormattingElementType type)
		{
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				Add(new FormattingElement(type));
			}
			else if (!(base[0] is FormattingElement formattingElement) || formattingElement.Type != type)
			{
				Insert(0, new FormattingElement(type));
			}
		}
	}
