	public abstract class FormattingParserBase : TokenCategorizedParserBase
	{
		private bool _SaveFormat;

		private FormattingParsingElement _LastParsingElement;

		private FormattingParsingElementCollection _FormattingParsingElements;

		internal FormattingParsingElement LastFormattingParsingElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (_FormattingParsingElements == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return _FormattingParsingElements.LastElement;
			}
		}

		protected virtual FormattingTable FormattingTable => CSharpFormattingTable.Instance;

		protected FormattingParsingElementCollection FormattingParsingElements => _FormattingParsingElements;

		protected FormattingParsingElement LastParsingElement
		{
			get
			{
				return _LastParsingElement;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					_LastParsingElement = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool SaveFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return _SaveFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				_SaveFormat = value;
				if (scanner != null)
				{
					scanner.SaveFormat = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private FormattingParsingElement AddFormattingParsingElement(FormattingToken token)
		{
			if (token == null || token.WasChecked)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormattingTokenType tokenType = GetTokenType(token);
			token.WasChecked = true;
			return AddFormattingParsingElement(token.Range, new FormattingParsingElement(tokenType, token.FormattingElements));
		}

		private FormattingParsingElement AddFormattingParsingElement(SourceRange range, FormattingParsingElement element)
		{
			if (_FormattingParsingElements == null)
			{
				_FormattingParsingElements = new FormattingParsingElementCollection();
			}
			_FormattingParsingElements.Add(range, element);
			return element;
		}

		internal void AddToParsingElement(FormattingParsingElement parsingElement, FormattingElements formattingElements)
		{
			if (parsingElement != null && formattingElements != null)
			{
				parsingElement.AddFormattingElements(formattingElements);
			}
		}

		protected FormattingTokenType GetTokenType(FormattingToken token)
		{
			if (token.Column == -1)
			{
				return FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart;
			}
			string value = token.Value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return FormattingTokenType.None;
			}
			if (IsIdent(token))
			{
				return FormattingTokenType.Ident;
			}
			return GetFormattingTokenType(value);
		}

		protected FormattingTokenType GetFormattingTokenType(string tokenText)
		{
			return FormattingTable.Get(tokenText.Trim());
		}

		protected FormattingParsingElement ReplaceOrAddFormattingParsingElement(FormattingToken token, FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (type == FormattingTokenType.None)
			{
				type = GetFormattingTokenType(token.Value);
			}
			if (_FormattingParsingElements == null)
			{
				_FormattingParsingElements = new FormattingParsingElementCollection();
			}
			FormattingParsingElement formattingParsingElement = new FormattingParsingElement(type, token.FormattingElements);
			_FormattingParsingElements.ReplaceOrAdd(token.Range, formattingParsingElement);
			return formattingParsingElement;
		}

		protected virtual void AfterParsingWithClearing(LanguageElement element)
		{
			AfterParsing(element);
			ClearFormattingParsingElements();
		}

		protected virtual void AfterParsing()
		{
			AfterParsing(base.RootNode);
			ClearFormattingParsingElements();
		}

		protected virtual void AfterParsing(LanguageElementCollectionBase coll)
		{
			if (coll == null || !SaveFormat)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement item in coll)
			{
				AfterParsing(item);
			}
			ClearFormattingParsingElements();
		}

		protected virtual void AfterParsing(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && SaveFormat && element is SourceFile sourceFile)
			{
				sourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode.FillFormattingCollectionWithChildren(_FormattingParsingElements);
				sourceFile.SimpleDirectiveHolder.FillFormattingCollectionWithChildren(_FormattingParsingElements);
				element.FillFormattingCollectionWithChildren(_FormattingParsingElements);
			}
		}

		protected void ClearFormattingParsingElements()
		{
			if (_FormattingParsingElements != null)
			{
				_FormattingParsingElements.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected override void Get()
		{
			if (SaveFormat)
			{
				LastParsingElement = AddFormattingParsingElement(la as FormattingToken);
			}
			base.Get();
		}

		protected override void PrepareForParse(ParserContext parserContext)
		{
			base.PrepareForParse(parserContext);
			SaveFormat = parserContext.SaveUserFormat;
		}

		protected override void CleanUpInternalData()
		{
			base.CleanUpInternalData();
			SaveFormat = false;
		}

		protected override void CleanUpParser()
		{
			base.CleanUpParser();
			SaveFormat = false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsIdent(Token token)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void AddCommentNode(Token lCommentToken, FormattingParsingElement lastElement)
		{
		}

		public FormattingParsingElement AddFormattingElements(FormattingToken token)
		{
			if (token == null || !SaveFormat)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return AddFormattingParsingElement(token);
		}

		public void AddToParsingElement(FormattingParsingElement parsingElement, IFormattingElement formattingElement)
		{
			if (formattingElement != null && parsingElement != null && SaveFormat)
			{
				parsingElement.AddFormattingElement(formattingElement);
			}
		}
	}
	public class FormattingParsingElementCollection
	{
		private List<FormattingParsingElement> _Coll;

		public FormattingParsingElement LastElement
		{
			get
			{
				int num = Coll.Count - 1;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Coll[num];
			}
		}

		private List<FormattingParsingElement> Coll
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Coll == null)
				{
					_Coll = new List<FormattingParsingElement>();
				}
				return _Coll;
			}
		}

		public void Add(SourceRange range, FormattingParsingElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && !range.IsEmpty)
			{
				element.Range = range;
				Coll.Add(element);
			}
		}

		internal void ReplaceOrAdd(SourceRange range, FormattingParsingElement element)
		{
			element.Range = range;
			int num = Coll.BinarySearch(element);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				Add(range, element);
			}
			else if (!(_Coll[num].Range != range))
			{
				_Coll[num] = element;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (_Coll != null)
			{
				_Coll.Clear();
			}
		}

		public LanguageElementTokens GetSourceFileTokens()
		{
			if (_Coll == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormattingParsingElement formattingParsingElement = null;
			foreach (FormattingParsingElement item in _Coll)
			{
				if (item.FormattingType == FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart)
				{
					if (formattingParsingElement == null)
					{
						formattingParsingElement = item;
					}
					else
					{
						formattingParsingElement.AddFormattingElements(item);
					}
				}
			}
			_Coll.Clear();
			if (formattingParsingElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<FormattingParsingElement> list = new List<FormattingParsingElement>();
			list.Add(formattingParsingElement);
			return new LanguageElementTokens(list);
		}

		public LanguageElementTokens GetTokens(SourceRange scopeRange)
		{
			if (_Coll == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<FormattingParsingElement> list = new List<FormattingParsingElement>();
			FormattingParsingElement formattingParsingElement = new FormattingParsingElement(FormattingTokenType.Fictive, null);
			formattingParsingElement.Range = scopeRange;
			int num = _Coll.BinarySearch(formattingParsingElement);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = _Coll.Count;
			int num2;
			for (num2 = num - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				FormattingParsingElement formattingParsingElement2 = _Coll[num2];
				if (!formattingParsingElement.Contains(formattingParsingElement2))
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(formattingParsingElement2);
			}
			num2++;
			list.Reverse();
			list.Add(_Coll[num]);
			for (num++; num < count; num++)
			{
				FormattingParsingElement formattingParsingElement2 = _Coll[num];
				if (!formattingParsingElement.Contains(formattingParsingElement2))
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(formattingParsingElement2);
			}
			_Coll.RemoveRange(num2, list.Count);
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new LanguageElementTokens(list);
		}
	}
	public class FormattingToken : CategorizedToken
	{
		private bool _WasChecked;

		private FormattingElements _FormattingElements;

		public FormattingElements FormattingElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_FormattingElements == null)
				{
					_FormattingElements = new FormattingElements();
				}
				return _FormattingElements;
			}
			set
			{
				_FormattingElements = value;
			}
		}

		public bool WasChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return _WasChecked;
			}
			set
			{
				_WasChecked = value;
			}
		}

		public FormattingToken(TokenLanguage language)
			: base(language)
		{
			_WasChecked = false;
		}

		public void SetFormattingElement(FormattingElements formattingElement)
		{
			FormattingElements.AddRange(formattingElement);
		}

		public void ResetFormattingElements()
		{
			if (FormattingElements != null)
			{
				FormattingElements = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class FormattingElement : IFormattingElement, ICloneable
	{
		private int _CountConsecutive = 1;

		private FormattingElementType _Type;

		public FormattingElementType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return _Type;
			}
			set
			{
				_Type = value;
			}
		}

		public int CountConsecutive
		{
			get
			{
				return _CountConsecutive;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_CountConsecutive = value;
			}
		}

		public FormattingElement(FormattingElementType type)
		{
			Type = type;
		}

		public FormattingElement(FormattingElementType type, int countConsecutive)
			: this(type)
		{
			_CountConsecutive = countConsecutive;
		}

		public bool IsEol()
		{
			if (Type != FormattingElementType.EOL)
			{
				return Type == FormattingElementType.CR;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsWsOrTab()
		{
			if (Type != FormattingElementType.WS)
			{
				return Type == FormattingElementType.Tab;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsIndent()
		{
			if (Type != FormattingElementType.IncreaseIndent)
			{
				return Type == FormattingElementType.DecreaseIndent;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public object Clone()
		{
			return new FormattingElement(Type, CountConsecutive);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (CountConsecutive == 1)
			{
				return Type.ToString();
			}
			return $"{Type} (Count consecutive: {CountConsecutive}";
		}
	}
	public class FormattingElementCollection : List<FormattingElements>
	{
		public FormattingElementCollection CloneList(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			FormattingElementCollection result = new FormattingElementCollection();
			ForEach(delegate(FormattingElements sourceArray)
			{
				result.Add(sourceArray.CloneArray(options));
			});
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class FormattingParsingElement : IComparable<FormattingParsingElement>
	{
		private FormattingElements _FormattingElements;

		private FormattingTokenType _FormattingType;

		private int _StartLine;

		private int _StartOffset;

		private int _EndLine;

		private int _EndOffset;

		public FormattingElements FormattingElements
		{
			get
			{
				return _FormattingElements;
			}
			set
			{
				_FormattingElements = value;
			}
		}

		public FormattingTokenType FormattingType
		{
			get
			{
				return _FormattingType;
			}
			set
			{
				_FormattingType = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange Range
		{
			get
			{
				return new SourceRange(_StartLine, _StartOffset, _EndLine, _EndOffset);
			}
			set
			{
				_StartLine = value.Start.Line;
				_StartOffset = value.Start.Offset;
				_EndLine = value.End.Line;
				_EndOffset = value.End.Offset;
			}
		}

		public FormattingParsingElement(FormattingTokenType type, FormattingElements formattingElements)
		{
			FormattingType = type;
			FormattingElements = formattingElements;
		}

		public void AddFormattingElements(FormattingParsingElement formattingParsingElement)
		{
			if (formattingParsingElement != null && formattingParsingElement != this)
			{
				AddFormattingElements(formattingParsingElement.FormattingElements);
			}
		}

		public void AddFormattingElements(FormattingElements formattingElements)
		{
			if (formattingElements != null)
			{
				if (FormattingElements == null)
				{
					FormattingElements = formattingElements;
				}
				else
				{
					FormattingElements.AddRange(formattingElements);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddFormattingElement(IFormattingElement formattingElement)
		{
			if (formattingElement != null)
			{
				if (FormattingElements == null)
				{
					FormattingElements = new FormattingElements();
				}
				FormattingElements.Add(formattingElement);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"Range = {Range}; Type: \"{_FormattingType}\"";
		}

		public int CompareTo(FormattingParsingElement other)
		{
			if (other.Contains(_StartLine, _StartOffset) && other.Contains(_EndLine, _EndOffset))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (_StartLine > other._EndLine)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (_StartLine == other._EndLine && _StartOffset >= other._EndOffset)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal bool Contains(FormattingParsingElement element)
		{
			if (Contains(element._StartLine, element._StartOffset))
			{
				return Contains(element._EndLine, element._EndOffset);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool Contains(int line, int offset)
		{
			if (line < _StartLine || line > _EndLine)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (line == _StartLine)
			{
				flag = offset >= _StartOffset;
			}
			if (line == _EndLine)
			{
				flag &= offset <= _EndOffset;
			}
			return flag;
		}
	}
	public interface IFormattingElement : ICloneable
	{
	}
	public enum TokenPosition : byte
	{
		Inside = byte.MaxValue,
		BeforeFirstCodeChild = 1,
		AfterEnd = 3
	}
	public class LanguageElementTokens
	{
		private Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, FormattingElementCollection> _Coll;

		private LanguageElementTokens()
		{
		}

		public LanguageElementTokens(List<FormattingParsingElement> elements)
		{
			Convert(elements);
		}

		public LanguageElementTokens(FormattingTokenType type, FormattingElementCollection collection)
		{
			if (_Coll == null)
			{
				_Coll = new Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, FormattingElementCollection>();
			}
			_Coll[type] = collection;
		}

		public LanguageElementTokens(FormattingTokenType[] type, FormattingElementCollection[] collection)
		{
			if (type.Length == collection.Length)
			{
				if (_Coll == null)
				{
					_Coll = new Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, FormattingElementCollection>();
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < type.Length; i++)
				{
					_Coll[type[i]] = collection[i];
				}
			}
		}

		private void Convert(List<FormattingParsingElement> elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_Coll = new Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, FormattingElementCollection>();
			int count = elements.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				FormattingParsingElement formattingParsingElement = elements[i];
				FormattingTokenType formattingType = formattingParsingElement.FormattingType;
				if (!_Coll.TryGetValue(formattingType, out var value))
				{
					value = new FormattingElementCollection();
					_Coll.Add(formattingType, value);
				}
				if (formattingParsingElement.FormattingElements != null)
				{
					value.Add(formattingParsingElement.FormattingElements);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool DeleteDirective(LanguageElement fromElement, PreprocessorDirective searchElement)
		{
			foreach (FormattingElementCollection value in fromElement.Tokens._Coll.Values)
			{
				foreach (FormattingElements item in value)
				{
					if (item.DeleteDirective(searchElement))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement detailNode in fromElement.DetailNodes)
			{
				if (DeleteDirective(detailNode, searchElement))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private FormattingElementCollection GetFormattingElementCollection(TokenPosition position)
		{
			FormattingElementCollection value = null;
			switch (position)
			{
			case TokenPosition.BeforeFirstCodeChild:
				if (!_Coll.TryGetValue(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen, out value))
				{
					_Coll.TryGetValue(FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart, out value);
				}
				break;
			case TokenPosition.AfterEnd:
				if (!_Coll.TryGetValue(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose, out value) && !_Coll.TryGetValue(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon, out value) && !_Coll.TryGetValue(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose, out value) && !_Coll.TryGetValue(FormattingTokenType.Comma, out value))
				{
					_Coll.TryGetValue(FormattingTokenType.Ident, out value);
				}
				break;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private FormattingElements GetFormattingElements(TokenPosition position)
		{
			FormattingElementCollection formattingElementCollection = GetFormattingElementCollection(position);
			if (formattingElementCollection == null || formattingElementCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return formattingElementCollection[0];
		}

		private bool LastIsEOL(FormattingElements elements)
		{
			if (elements.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (elements[elements.Count - 1] is FormattingElement formattingElement)
			{
				return formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int FindLineByIndex(List<int> indexesEOLs, int index)
		{
			if (index == -1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < indexesEOLs.Count; i++)
			{
				if (indexesEOLs[i] >= index)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		private FormattingElements CutTokens(FormattingElements elements, PreprocessorDirective leave, LanguageElement cut, List<FullDirective> emptyFulls, Dictionary<PreprocessorDirective, LanguageElement> regionsToDelete, out LanguageElementCollection commentsToFirst, out LanguageElementCollection commentsToSecond)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				commentsToFirst = (commentsToSecond = null);
				return null;
			}
			commentsToFirst = new LanguageElementCollection();
			commentsToSecond = new LanguageElementCollection();
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			List<bool> list2 = new List<bool>();
			Dictionary<LanguageElement, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<LanguageElement, int>();
			int num = ((leave != null) ? elements.IndexOf(leave) : (-1));
			if (num == -1)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			int num2 = ((cut != null) ? elements.IndexOf(cut as IFormattingElement) : (-1));
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				num2 = elements.Count;
			}
			bool item = false;
			int num3 = 1;
			for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
			{
				IFormattingElement formattingElement = elements[i];
				if (formattingElement is SourceFileStartText)
				{
					list2.Add(item = false);
					list.Add(i);
					num3 = 0;
				}
				if (formattingElement is FormattingElement formattingElement2)
				{
					if (formattingElement2.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL)
					{
						list2.Add(item);
						item = false;
						list.Add(i);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(formattingElement is LanguageElement { ElementType: var elementType } languageElement))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (regionsToDelete != null && (elementType == LanguageElementType.Region || elementType == LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective))
					{
						PreprocessorDirective key = languageElement as PreprocessorDirective;
						if (languageElement != null && regionsToDelete.ContainsKey(key))
						{
							elements.RemoveAt(i);
							if (num > i)
							{
								num--;
							}
							if (num2 > i)
							{
								num2--;
							}
							i--;
							regionsToDelete.Remove(key);
						}
						else
						{
							item = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						item = true;
						if (elementType == LanguageElementType.Comment || elementType == LanguageElementType.FictiveAspComment || elementType == LanguageElementType.XmlDocComment)
						{
							dictionary.Add(languageElement, list.Count);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			int num4 = (FindLineByIndex(list, num2) + FindLineByIndex(list, num) + 1) / 2;
			if (emptyFulls != null)
			{
				foreach (FullDirective emptyFull in emptyFulls)
				{
					int num5 = FindLineByIndex(list, elements.IndexOf(emptyFull.FirstSimple));
					if (num5 > num4)
					{
						break;
					}
					int num6 = FindLineByIndex(list, elements.IndexOf(emptyFull.LastSimple));
					if (num5 != -1 && num6 != -1 && num6 >= num4)
					{
						num4 = ((num4 - num5 > num6 - num4) ? (num6 + 1) : num5);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<LanguageElement, int> item2 in dictionary)
			{
				if (item2.Value < num4)
				{
					commentsToFirst.Add(item2.Key);
				}
				else
				{
					commentsToSecond.Add(item2.Key);
				}
			}
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int j = num3; j < count; j++)
			{
				if (!list2[j])
				{
					int num7 = ((j > 0) ? list[j - 1] : (-1));
					int num8 = list[j];
					int num9 = num8 - num7;
					elements.RemoveRange(num7 + 1, num9);
					for (int k = j; k < count; k++)
					{
						list[k] -= num9;
					}
				}
			}
			int num10 = ((num4 > 0) ? (list[num4 - 1] + 1) : 0);
			FormattingElements formattingElements = new FormattingElements();
			for (int l = num10; l < elements.Count; l++)
			{
				formattingElements.Add(elements[l]);
			}
			elements.RemoveRange(num10, elements.Count - num10);
			return formattingElements;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddElements(FormattingTokenType type, IEnumerable<IFormattingElement> fe)
		{
			if (_Coll != null)
			{
				FormattingElementCollection formattingElementCollection = null;
				if (!_Coll.ContainsKey(type))
				{
					formattingElementCollection = new FormattingElementCollection();
					_Coll.Add(type, formattingElementCollection);
				}
				else
				{
					formattingElementCollection = _Coll[type];
				}
				FormattingElements formattingElements = null;
				if (formattingElementCollection.Count == 0)
				{
					formattingElements = new FormattingElements();
					formattingElementCollection.Add(formattingElements);
				}
				else
				{
					formattingElements = formattingElementCollection[0];
				}
				formattingElements.AddRange(fe);
			}
		}

		public bool HasElement(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			if (_Coll == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _Coll.ContainsKey(type);
		}

		public void RemoveAll(Type type)
		{
			foreach (FormattingElementCollection value in _Coll.Values)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Count; i++)
				{
					FormattingElements formattingElements = value[i];
					FormattingElements formattingElements2 = new FormattingElements();
					foreach (IFormattingElement item in formattingElements)
					{
						if (item.GetType() != type)
						{
							formattingElements2.Add(item);
						}
					}
					if (formattingElements2.Count != formattingElements.Count)
					{
						value[i] = formattingElements2;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public FormattingElements Get(FormattingTokenType type, int index)
		{
			if (type == FormattingTokenType.None || index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!_Coll.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (value == null || value.Count <= index)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value[index];
		}

		public LanguageElementTokens Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			LanguageElementTokens languageElementTokens = new LanguageElementTokens();
			languageElementTokens._Coll = new Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, FormattingElementCollection>();
			foreach (FormattingTokenType key in _Coll.Keys)
			{
				FormattingElementCollection formattingElementCollection = _Coll[key];
				if (formattingElementCollection != null)
				{
					languageElementTokens._Coll[key] = formattingElementCollection.CloneList(options);
				}
			}
			return languageElementTokens;
		}

		public PreprocessorDirective GetLeaveFromSourceFile(SourceFile file, List<FullDirective> fulls)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = GetFormattingElements(TokenPosition.BeforeFirstCodeChild);
			PreprocessorDirective preprocessorDirective = null;
			int num = formattingElements.Count - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && (preprocessorDirective = formattingElements[num] as DefineDirective) == null && (preprocessorDirective = formattingElements[num] as UndefDirective) == null)
			{
				num--;
			}
			if (preprocessorDirective == null || fulls == null)
			{
				return preprocessorDirective;
			}
			foreach (FullDirective full in fulls)
			{
				if (full.EndLine >= preprocessorDirective.StartLine)
				{
					if (full.StartLine < preprocessorDirective.StartLine)
					{
						return full.LastSimple;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return preprocessorDirective;
		}

		public FormattingElements CutTokens(TokenPosition positionFrom, PreprocessorDirective leave, LanguageElement cut, List<FullDirective> emptyFulls, Dictionary<PreprocessorDirective, LanguageElement> regionsToDelete, out LanguageElementCollection commentsToFirst, out LanguageElementCollection commentsToSecond)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = GetFormattingElements(positionFrom);
			return CutTokens(formattingElements, leave, cut, emptyFulls, regionsToDelete, out commentsToFirst, out commentsToSecond);
		}

		public void CutTokens(FormattingTokenType type, int index, PreprocessorDirective leave, LanguageElement cut, List<FullDirective> emptyFulls, Dictionary<PreprocessorDirective, LanguageElement> regionsToDelete, out FormattingElements fesToFirst, out FormattingElements fesToSecond, out LanguageElementCollection elementsToFirst, out LanguageElementCollection elementsToSecond)
		{
			if (!_Coll.TryGetValue(type, out var value) || value.Count <= index)
			{
				fesToFirst = (fesToSecond = null);
				elementsToFirst = (elementsToSecond = null);
			}
			else
			{
				fesToFirst = value[index];
				fesToSecond = CutTokens(fesToFirst, leave, cut, emptyFulls, regionsToDelete, out elementsToFirst, out elementsToSecond);
				value[index] = new FormattingElements();
			}
		}

		public static void DeleteRegions(Dictionary<PreprocessorDirective, LanguageElement> regionsToDelete)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<PreprocessorDirective, LanguageElement> item in regionsToDelete)
			{
				DeleteDirective(item.Value, item.Key);
			}
		}

		public bool AddEOLToEnd()
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = GetFormattingElements(TokenPosition.AfterEnd);
			if (formattingElements.Count > 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			formattingElements.Add(new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL));
			return true;
		}

		public void DeleteLastEOL()
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = GetFormattingElements(TokenPosition.AfterEnd);
			if (LastIsEOL(formattingElements))
			{
				formattingElements.RemoveAt(formattingElements.Count - 1);
			}
		}

		public bool PasteTokens(TokenPosition toPosition, FormattingElements elementsToAdd)
		{
			if (elementsToAdd == null || elementsToAdd.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FormattingElements formattingElements = GetFormattingElements(toPosition);
			formattingElements.AddRange(elementsToAdd);
			return true;
		}

		public void PasteTokens(FormattingTokenType typeToAdd, int indexToAdd, FormattingElements elementsToAdd)
		{
			if (_Coll.TryGetValue(typeToAdd, out var value) && value.Count > indexToAdd)
			{
				value[indexToAdd].AddRange(elementsToAdd);
			}
		}

		public void AddCommentOrRegion(TokenPosition toPosition, int indent, LanguageElement toAdd)
		{
			if (toAdd is IFormattingElement item)
			{
				FormattingElements formattingElements = (formattingElements = GetFormattingElements(toPosition));
				if (!_Coll.ContainsKey(FormattingTokenType.SourceFileStart) && !LastIsEOL(formattingElements))
				{
					formattingElements.Add(new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL));
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < indent + indent; i++)
				{
					formattingElements.Add(new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.WS));
				}
				formattingElements.Add(item);
				formattingElements.Add(new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL));
			}
		}

		public void AddEmptyLinesToEnd(int countEmptyLines)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = GetFormattingElements(TokenPosition.AfterEnd);
			if (!LastIsEOL(formattingElements))
			{
				countEmptyLines++;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < countEmptyLines; i++)
			{
				formattingElements.Add(new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL));
			}
		}

		public void DeleteEmptyLines(FormattingTokenType type, int index)
		{
			DeleteEmptyLines(type, index, attemptDeleteLastLine: false);
		}

		public void DeleteEmptyLines(FormattingTokenType type, int index, bool attemptDeleteLastLine)
		{
			if (_Coll.TryGetValue(type, out var value) && value.Count > index)
			{
				FormattingElements formattingElements = value[index];
				formattingElements.DeleteEmptyLines(attemptDeleteLastLine);
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IRazorCodeParser
	{
		LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorFunctions(ISourceReader reader, out int scannerPositionDelta);

		LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorCode(ISourceReader reader, ref int scannerPositionDelta);

		LanguageElement ParseRazorHelper(ISourceReader reader, out int scannerPositionDelta);
	}
	public abstract class GeneratedParserBase : ParserBase
	{
		private const int minErrDist = 2;

		protected const bool T = true;

		protected const bool x = false;

		protected int errDist = 2;

		protected Token tToken;

		protected Token la;

		protected GeneratedScannerBase scanner;

		protected bool[,] set;

		protected int maxTokens;

		private TextStringCollection _TextStrings;

		private LanguageElement _RootNode;

		public new TextStringCollection TextStrings
		{
			get
			{
				if (_TextStrings == null)
				{
					_TextStrings = new TextStringCollection();
				}
				return _TextStrings;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement RootNode => _RootNode;

		public virtual CommentCollection Comments => null;

		protected abstract bool[,] CreateSetArray();

		protected virtual void Get()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				tToken = la;
				la = scanner.Scan();
				if (la.Type <= maxTokens)
				{
					break;
				}
				HandlePragmas();
				la = tToken;
			}
			errDist++;
		}

		protected void AddNamespaceToDeclaredList(Namespace declaredNamespace)
		{
			if (declaredNamespace != null && declaredNamespace.FileNode != null)
			{
				StringCollection declaredNamespaces = declaredNamespace.FileNode.DeclaredNamespaces;
				string name = declaredNamespace.Name;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && !declaredNamespaces.Contains(name))
				{
					declaredNamespaces.Add(name);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CheckForErrors(LanguageElement rootNode)
		{
			if (rootNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceFile sourceFile = null;
			sourceFile = ((!(rootNode is SourceFile)) ? rootNode.FileNode : (rootNode as SourceFile));
			if (sourceFile != null)
			{
				if (parserErrors == null || parserErrors.Count == 0)
				{
					sourceFile.HasErrors = false;
				}
				else
				{
					sourceFile.HasErrors = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void HandlePragmas()
		{
		}

		protected Token Peek()
		{
			return scanner.Peek();
		}

		protected Token Peek(int pos)
		{
			return scanner.Peek(pos);
		}

		protected void ResetPeek()
		{
			scanner.ResetPeek();
		}

		protected void Expect(int n)
		{
			if (la.Type == n)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(n);
			}
		}

		protected void ExpectWeak(int n, int follow)
		{
			if (la.Type == n)
			{
				Get();
				return;
			}
			SynErr(n);
			while (!StartOf(follow))
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		protected bool WeakSeparator(int n, int syFol, int repFol)
		{
			bool[] array = new bool[maxTokens + 1];
			if (la.Type == n)
			{
				Get();
				return true;
			}
			if (StartOf(repFol))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i <= maxTokens; i++)
			{
				array[i] = set[syFol, i] || set[repFol, i] || set[0, i];
			}
			SynErr(n);
			while (!array[la.Type])
			{
				Get();
			}
			return StartOf(syFol);
		}

		protected void SynErr(int n)
		{
			if (errDist >= 2)
			{
				parserErrors.SynErr(la.Line, la.Column, n);
			}
			errDist = 0;
		}

		protected void SemErr(string msg)
		{
			if (errDist >= 2)
			{
				parserErrors.Error(tToken.Line, tToken.Column, msg);
			}
			errDist = 0;
		}

		protected bool StartOf(int s)
		{
			return set[s, la.Type];
		}

		protected static SourceRange GetRange(object a, object b)
		{
			return SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(a, b);
		}

		protected static SourceRange GetRange(object a)
		{
			return SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(a);
		}

		protected static SourceRange GetRange(params object[] objs)
		{
			return SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(objs);
		}

		protected virtual void BindComments()
		{
			if (RootNode != null && base.AllowCommentsInParseTree)
			{
				SourceTreeCommenter sourceTreeCommenter = new SourceTreeCommenter();
				CommentCollection comments = Comments;
				if (comments != null)
				{
					sourceTreeCommenter.CommentNode(RootNode, Comments);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetRootNode(LanguageElement newContext)
		{
			SetContext(newContext);
			_RootNode = newContext;
		}

		protected void OpenContextWithoutAddNode(LanguageElement newContext)
		{
			if (base.Context != null && (base.Context == null || base.Context != newContext))
			{
				newContext.SetParent(base.Context);
				SetContext(newContext);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OpenContext(LanguageElement newContext)
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				newContext.SetParent(base.Context);
				AddNode(newContext);
				SetContext(newContext);
			}
			else
			{
				_RootNode = newContext;
				SetContext(newContext);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CloseContext()
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				SetContext(base.Context.Parent);
			}
		}

		protected void ReadBlockStart(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (base.Context is IHasBlock)
			{
				(base.Context as IHasBlock).SetBlockStart(range);
			}
			if (base.Context is DelimiterCapableBlock)
			{
				DelimiterCapableBlock delimiterCapableBlock = (DelimiterCapableBlock)base.Context;
				delimiterCapableBlock.SetBlockType(DelimiterBlockType.Brace);
			}
		}

		protected void ReadBlockEnd(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (base.Context is IHasBlock)
			{
				(base.Context as IHasBlock).SetBlockEnd(range);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddNode(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.AddNode(node);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddDetailNode(LanguageElement detailNode)
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.AddDetailNode(detailNode);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetContextEnd(SourcePoint end)
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.SetEnd(end);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CleanUpParser()
		{
			base.FinishParsing();
			_RootNode = null;
			if (scanner != null)
			{
				if (!scanner.IsDisposed)
				{
					scanner.Dispose();
				}
				scanner = null;
			}
			if (parserErrors != null)
			{
				parserErrors.Clear();
			}
			SetContext(null);
			_TextStrings = null;
		}

		protected override LanguageElement CallParsing(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			SourceFile sourceFile = parserContext?.SourceFile;
			try
			{
				if (parserContext != null)
				{
					base.AllowCommentsInParseTree = parserContext.AllowCommentsInParseTree;
				}
				sourceFile?.InvalidateSimples(parserContext.ParseRange, languageElementCollection);
				languageElement = DoParse(parserContext, reader);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.AllowCommentsInParseTree = true;
				sourceFile?.RestoreTrailingRegions(languageElementCollection);
			}
			if (languageElement != null && languageElement is SourceFile)
			{
				SourceFile sourceFile2 = (SourceFile)languageElement;
				sourceFile2.CompilerDirectiveRootNode?.SetParent(sourceFile2);
				sourceFile2.SetRegionDirectiveHolderParent(sourceFile2);
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		protected Token ConcatTokens(Token left, Token right)
		{
			left.StartPosition = left.StartPosition;
			left.Column = left.Column;
			left.Line = left.Line;
			left.EndPosition = right.EndPosition;
			left.EndColumn = right.EndColumn;
			left.EndLine = right.EndLine;
			return left;
		}

		protected Token ConcatTokens(Token left, Token right, int kind, string val)
		{
			Token token = ConcatTokens(left, right);
			token.Type = kind;
			token.Value = val;
			return token;
		}

		private string GetAssemblyName(Attribute attributeDef)
		{
			if (attributeDef == null || attributeDef.ArgumentCount < 1)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (!(attributeDef.Arguments[0] is PrimitiveExpression { PrimitiveType: PrimitiveType.String } primitiveExpression))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return primitiveExpression.PrimitiveValue as string;
		}

		private SourceFile GetFileNode()
		{
			if (base.Context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SourceFile sourceFile = null;
			if (base.Context is SourceFile)
			{
				return base.Context as SourceFile;
			}
			return base.Context.FileNode;
		}

		protected void ProcessAttribute(Attribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute != null && attribute.TargetType == AttributeTargetType.Assembly && string.Compare(attribute.Name, "InternalsVisibleTo", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				SourceFile fileNode = GetFileNode();
				if (fileNode != null)
				{
					string assemblyName = GetAssemblyName(attribute);
					fileNode.AddFriendAssemblyName(assemblyName);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool SupportsFileExtension(string ext)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override ExpressionParserBase CreateExpressionParser()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override IExpressionInverter CreateExpressionInverter()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override string GetFullTypeName(string simpleName)
		{
			return simpleName;
		}
	}
	public abstract class GeneratedScannerBase : IDisposable
	{
		private ISourceReader _SourceReader;

		private CharProvider _CharProvider;

		private bool _OwnReader;

		private bool _IsDisposed;

		private bool _SaveFormat;

		protected const char EOF = '\uffff';

		protected const char EOL = '\n';

		protected const int eofSym = 0;

		protected char ch;

		protected int pos;

		protected int lineValue;

		protected int lineStart;

		protected int prevLineStart;

		protected int prevLine;

		protected BitArray ignore;

		protected Token t;

		protected Token pt;

		protected Token tokens;

		protected char[] tval = new char[128];

		protected int tlen;

		public virtual ISourceReader SourceReader => _SourceReader;

		public CharProvider CharProvider => _CharProvider;

		public virtual int Position => pos + 1;

		public int Line => lineValue;

		public int Column => pos - lineStart;

		public char CurrentChar => ch;

		public bool IsDisposed => _IsDisposed;

		public bool SaveFormat
		{
			get
			{
				return _SaveFormat;
			}
			set
			{
				_SaveFormat = value;
			}
		}

		public int EndLineValue
		{
			get
			{
				if (ch != '\n')
				{
					return lineValue;
				}
				return prevLine;
			}
		}

		internal Token tToken => t;

		private void CreateFormatingToken()
		{
			FormattingElements formatingElement = null;
			if (SaveFormat)
			{
				formatingElement = GetFormatingTokenElement();
			}
			t = CreateToken();
			SetFormatingElement(t as FormattingToken, formatingElement);
		}

		private void SetFormatingElement(FormattingToken formatingToken, FormattingElements formatingElement)
		{
			if (formatingToken != null && formatingElement != null)
			{
				formatingToken.FormattingElements = formatingElement;
			}
		}

		internal FormattingElements GetFormatingTokenElement()
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = null;
			while (IsFormatChar(ch))
			{
				if (formattingElements == null)
				{
					formattingElements = new FormattingElements();
				}
				FormattingElement formattingElement = CreateFormatingTokenElement(ch);
				if (formattingElement != null)
				{
					formattingElements.Add(formattingElement);
				}
				NextCh();
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		internal FormattingElement CreateFormatingTokenElement(char ch)
		{
			if (IsWSChar(ch))
			{
				return new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.WS);
			}
			if (IsTabChar(ch))
			{
				return new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.Tab);
			}
			if (IsEOLChar(ch))
			{
				return new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void Initialize(ISourceReader s)
		{
			Initialize(s, ownReader: false);
		}

		protected void Initialize(ISourceReader s, bool ownReader)
		{
			_OwnReader = ownReader;
			SaveFormat = false;
			IntializeReader(s);
			InitializeIgnoreTable();
			pt = (tokens = CreateToken());
		}

		protected void IntializeReader(ISourceReader s)
		{
			_SourceReader = s;
			_CharProvider = new CharProvider(s.GetStream());
			lineValue = s.StartLine;
			lineStart = s.StartColumn - 1;
			if (lineStart > 0)
			{
				pos = lineStart;
				lineStart = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				pos = -1;
			}
			NextCh();
		}

		protected static SourceRange GetRange(object a, object b)
		{
			return SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(a, b);
		}

		protected static SourceRange GetRange(object a)
		{
			return SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(a);
		}

		protected static SourceRange GetRange(params object[] objs)
		{
			return SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(objs);
		}

		protected void BackTrackScannerToToken()
		{
			pos = t.StartPosition - 1;
			int startColumn = _SourceReader.StartColumn;
			if (startColumn - 1 > 0)
			{
				CharProvider.Seek(t.StartPosition - startColumn);
			}
			else
			{
				CharProvider.Seek(t.StartPosition);
			}
			lineValue = t.Line;
			prevLine = lineValue - 1;
			lineStart = t.StartPosition - t.Column + 1;
			NextCh();
			for (int i = 0; i < tlen; i++)
			{
				NextCh();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void AddCh()
		{
			if (tlen >= tval.Length)
			{
				char[] destinationArray = new char[tval.Length * 2];
				Array.Copy(tval, 0, destinationArray, 0, tval.Length);
				tval = destinationArray;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void NextCh()
		{
			ch = _CharProvider.Get();
			pos++;
			if (ch == '\n')
			{
				prevLine = lineValue;
				lineValue++;
				prevLineStart = lineStart;
				lineStart = pos + 1;
			}
			NextChCasing();
		}

		protected virtual Token CreateToken()
		{
			return new Token();
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeIgnoreTable()
		{
		}

		protected virtual int GetUnicodeLetterIndex()
		{
			return -1;
		}

		protected virtual int GetNextState(int input)
		{
			return -1;
		}

		protected virtual void NextChCasing()
		{
		}

		protected virtual Token NextToken()
		{
			if (NextTokenStart())
			{
				return t;
			}
			NextTokenComments();
			CreateFormatingToken();
			t.StartPosition = pos;
			t.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			t.Line = lineValue;
			int state = ((ch == '\uffff') ? (-1) : ((ch <= 'ÿ') ? GetNextState(ch) : (char.IsLetter(ch) ? GetNextState(GetUnicodeLetterIndex()) : 0)));
			tlen = 0;
			NextTokenScan(state);
			if (t.Value == null)
			{
				t.Value = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(new string(tval, 0, tlen));
			}
			else
			{
				t.Value = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(t.Value);
			}
			NextTokenAfterScan();
			t.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				t.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				t.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				t.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				t.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			NextTokenEnd();
			if (SaveFormat)
			{
				SetInPreprocess();
				FormattingElements nextFormattingTokenElements = GetNextFormattingTokenElements();
				FormattingToken formattingToken = t as FormattingToken;
				if (nextFormattingTokenElements != null)
				{
					formattingToken?.SetFormattingElement(nextFormattingTokenElements);
				}
				ResetInPreprocess();
			}
			return t;
		}

		protected virtual bool NextTokenStart()
		{
			SkipIgnoredChars();
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void NextTokenComments()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void NextTokenScan(int state)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void NextTokenAfterScan()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void NextTokenEnd()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void SetInPreprocess()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void ResetInPreprocess()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void SkipIgnoredChars()
		{
			while (ch != '\uffff' && ch < 'ÿ' && ignore[ch])
			{
				NextCh();
			}
		}

		protected virtual FormattingElements GetNextFormattingTokenElements()
		{
			return GetFormatingTokenElement();
		}

		protected virtual bool NeedSaveFormat()
		{
			if (!SaveFormat)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsFormatChar(ch);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsFormatChar(char ch)
		{
			if (!IsWSChar(ch) && !IsTabChar(ch) && !IsEOLChar(ch))
			{
				return IsCRChar(ch);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsWSChar(char ch)
		{
			return ch == ' ';
		}

		protected virtual bool IsTabChar(char ch)
		{
			return ch == '\t';
		}

		protected virtual bool IsEOLChar(char ch)
		{
			return ch == '\n';
		}

		protected virtual bool IsCRChar(char ch)
		{
			return ch == '\r';
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			_IsDisposed = true;
			_CharProvider = null;
			if (_OwnReader && _SourceReader != null)
			{
				_SourceReader.Dispose();
				_SourceReader = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual Token Scan()
		{
			if (tokens.Next == null)
			{
				pt = (tokens = NextToken());
			}
			else
			{
				pt = (tokens = tokens.Next);
			}
			return tokens;
		}

		public Token Peek(int pos)
		{
			Token result = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < pos; i++)
			{
				result = Peek();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public virtual Token Peek()
		{
			if (pt.Next == null)
			{
				pt.Next = NextToken();
			}
			pt = pt.Next;
			return pt;
		}

		public void ResetPeek()
		{
			pt = tokens;
		}

		public void SyncPosition(int positionDelta)
		{
			SyncPosition(positionDelta, addChars: false);
		}

		public void SyncPosition(int positionDelta, bool addChars)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < positionDelta; i++)
			{
				if (addChars)
				{
					AddCh();
				}
				else
				{
					NextCh();
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetTokens(Token newTokens)
		{
			if (newTokens != null)
			{
				tokens = newTokens;
			}
		}

		public Token GetTokens()
		{
			return tokens;
		}

		public Token GetPt()
		{
			return pt;
		}

		public void SetOnPeek(Token oldPt, Token newPt)
		{
			if (oldPt != null && newPt != null)
			{
				oldPt.Next = newPt;
				pt = newPt;
			}
		}

		public bool IsUnicodeLetter(char ch)
		{
			if (char.IsLetter(ch))
			{
				return true;
			}
			UnicodeCategory unicodeCategory = char.GetUnicodeCategory(ch);
			if ((uint)(unicodeCategory - 5) <= 2u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public string FirstSkip()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			while (!IsEof(stringBuilder) && (IsWSChar(ch) || IsCRChar(ch) || IsTabChar(ch) || IsEOLChar(ch)))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(ch);
				NextCh();
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public bool IsEof(StringBuilder sb)
		{
			return IsNextChar('\uffff', sb);
		}

		public bool IsNextChar(char c, StringBuilder sb)
		{
			while (ch == ' ' || ch == '\t')
			{
				sb.Append(ch);
				NextCh();
			}
			return ch == c;
		}
	}
	public sealed class GlobalStringStorage
	{
		private static object _InstanceLock = new object();

		private static GlobalStringStorage _Instance;

		private Dictionary<string, string> _Strings = new Dictionary<string, string>();

		private int _UpdatesCount;

		private bool Updating => _UpdatesCount > 0;

		public static GlobalStringStorage Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Instance == null)
				{
					lock (_InstanceLock)
					{
						if (_Instance == null)
						{
							_Instance = new GlobalStringStorage();
						}
						return _Instance;
					}
				}
				return _Instance;
			}
		}

		private bool BeginUpdateInternal()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				_UpdatesCount++;
				return _UpdatesCount == 1;
			}
		}

		private bool EndUpdateInternal()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				_UpdatesCount--;
				if (_UpdatesCount == 0)
				{
					ClearStrings();
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public string InternString(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				if (_Strings.TryGetValue(s, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				_Strings.Add(s, s);
				return s;
			}
		}

		public bool IsInternedString(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				return _Strings.ContainsKey(s);
			}
		}

		public void ClearStrings()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				if (!Updating)
				{
					_Strings = new Dictionary<string, string>();
				}
			}
		}

		public static string Intern(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Instance.InternString(s);
		}

		public static bool IsInterned(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Instance.IsInternedString(s);
		}

		public static void Clear()
		{
			Instance.ClearStrings();
		}

		public static void BeginUpdate()
		{
			Instance.BeginUpdateInternal();
		}

		public static void EndUpdate()
		{
			Instance.EndUpdateInternal();
		}
	}
	public abstract class FormattingTable
	{
		private Dictionary<string, FormattingTokenType> _FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable;

		private Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, string> _FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceReversedTable;

		private Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, string> _OnlyGetValueTable;

		protected Dictionary<string, FormattingTokenType> FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable => _FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable;

		protected Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, string> FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceReversedTable => _FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceReversedTable;

		protected Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, string> OnlyGetValueTable => _OnlyGetValueTable;

		internal FormattingTable()
		{
			_FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable = new Dictionary<string, FormattingTokenType>();
			_FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceReversedTable = new Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, string>();
			_OnlyGetValueTable = new Dictionary<FormattingTokenType, string>();
			FillFormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable();
		}

		protected abstract void FillFormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable();

		protected void AddToOnlyGetValue(FormattingTokenType type, string text)
		{
			OnlyGetValueTable.Add(type, text);
		}

		protected void AddToken(FormattingTokenType type, string text)
		{
			FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable.Add(text, type);
			FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceReversedTable.Add(type, text);
		}

		public virtual string Get(FormattingTokenType type)
		{
			string value = string.Empty;
			if (OnlyGetValueTable.TryGetValue(type, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceReversedTable.TryGetValue(type, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public virtual FormattingTokenType Get(string text)
		{
			FormattingTokenType value = FormattingTokenType.None;
			if (FormattingTokenTypeCorrespondanceTable.TryGetValue(text, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return FormattingTokenType.Ident;
		}
	}

	public abstract class ParserBase
	{
		private double _ParseTime;

		private bool _IsParsing;

		private ExpressionParserBase _ExpressionParser;

		private LanguageElement _RootContext;

		private LanguageElement _Context;

		private TextStringCollection _TextStrings;

		private RegionDirective _RegionContext;

		private CompilerDirective _CompilerDirectiveContext;

		private IDocument _Document;

		private SourceRange _ParseRange;

		private bool _AllowCommentsInParseTree = true;

		private object _SyncObject = new object();

		private bool _LastParsingHasEOF = true;

		protected ParserErrorsBase parserErrors;

		public abstract string Language { get; }

		public bool IsParsing => _IsParsing;

		public bool LastParsingHasEOF
		{
			get
			{
				return _LastParsingHasEOF;
			}
			set
			{
				_LastParsingHasEOF = value;
			}
		}

		public double ParseTime => _ParseTime;

		public ExpressionParserBase ExpressionParser
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ExpressionParser == null)
				{
					_ExpressionParser = CreateExpressionParser();
				}
				return _ExpressionParser;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement Context => _Context;

		public LanguageElement RootContext => _RootContext;

		public TextStringCollection TextStrings => _TextStrings;

		public RegionDirective RegionContext
		{
			get

		public ParserBase()
		{
			_ExpressionParser = CreateExpressionParser();
		}

		private void CorrectContextRange(LanguageElement context, CommentCollection remainingComments)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourcePoint end = context.InternalRange.End;
			LanguageElement lastChild = context.LastChild;
			if (lastChild != null && lastChild.InternalRange.End.IsEmpty)
			{
				lastChild = lastChild.LastChild;
			}
			if (lastChild != null && lastChild.InternalRange.End > end)
			{
				end = lastChild.InternalRange.End;
			}
			if (remainingComments != null)
			{
				Comment lastComment = remainingComments.LastComment;
				if (lastComment != null && lastComment.InternalRange.End > end)
				{
					end = lastComment.InternalRange.End;
				}
			}
			if (context.InternalRange.End != end)
			{
				context.SetEnd(end);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessTextStrings()
		{
			SourceFile sourceFile = null;
			if (_RootContext == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			sourceFile = ((!(_RootContext is SourceFile)) ? _RootContext.FileNode : ((SourceFile)_RootContext));
			if (sourceFile == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TextStringCollection textStrings = sourceFile.TextStrings;
			if (textStrings != null && textStrings.Count != 0)
			{
				int count = textStrings.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					textStrings[i]?.SetParent(sourceFile);
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract ExpressionParserBase CreateExpressionParser();

		public abstract IExpressionInverter CreateExpressionInverter();

		protected virtual void PrepareForParse(ParserContext parserContext)
		{
			_ParseTime = -1.0;
			_Context = parserContext.Context;
			_RootContext = _Context;
			_CompilerDirectiveContext = parserContext.CompilerDirectiveContext;
			_RegionContext = parserContext.RegionContext;
			_ParseRange = parserContext.ParseRange;
			_Document = parserContext.Document;
			_TextStrings = parserContext.TextStrings;
			_AllowCommentsInParseTree = parserContext.AllowCommentsInParseTree;
		}

		protected virtual void FinishParsing()
		{
			if (AllowCommentsInParseTree)
			{
				IntroduceComments(RootContext);
			}
			if (Context != null && (Context is SourceFile || Context is Namespace))
			{
				CorrectContextRange(Context, null);
			}
			GlobalStringStorage.Clear();
			_IsParsing = false;
		}

		protected virtual void CleanUpInternalData()
		{
			_Context = null;
			_CompilerDirectiveContext = null;
			_RegionContext = null;
			_Document = null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual InitializedVariable CreateInitializedVariable()
		{
			return new InitializedVariable();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual Variable CreateVariable()
		{
			return new Variable();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual Const CreateConst()
		{
			return new Const();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void LinkVariablesList(LanguageElementCollection variables)
		{
			if (variables == null || variables.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = variables.Count;
			Variable ancestorVariable = variables[0] as Variable;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (variables[i] is Variable variable)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						variable.SetAncestorVariable(ancestorVariable);
						variable.SetPreviousVariable(variables[i - 1] as Variable);
					}
					if (i < count - 1)
					{
						variable.SetNextVariable(variables[i + 1] as Variable);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected virtual void SetVariableTypes(LanguageElementCollection variables)
		{
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement DoParse(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			double parseTime = _ParseTime;
			LanguageElement context = _Context;
			LanguageElement rootContext = _RootContext;
			TextStringCollection textStrings = _TextStrings;
			RegionDirective regionContext = _RegionContext;
			CompilerDirective compilerDirectiveContext = _CompilerDirectiveContext;
			IDocument document = _Document;
			LanguageElement context2 = Context;
			try
			{
				PrepareForParse(parserContext);
				SetupSourceFile();
			}
			finally
			{
				FinishParsing();
				ProcessTextStrings();
				reader.Dispose();
				context2 = _Context;
				if (_RootContext is SourceFile)
				{
					context2 = _RootContext;
				}
				_AllowCommentsInParseTree = true;
				_ParseTime = parseTime;
				_Context = context;
				_RootContext = rootContext;
				_TextStrings = textStrings;
				_RegionContext = regionContext;
				_CompilerDirectiveContext = compilerDirectiveContext;
				_Document = document;
				CleanUpInternalData();
			}
			if (context2 == null)
			{
				context2 = parserContext.Context;
			}
			return context2;
		}

		public abstract bool SupportsFileExtension(string ext);

		public abstract string GetFullTypeName(string simpleName);

		public virtual SourceFile GetSourceFile(string fileName)
		{
			return new SourceFile(fileName);
		}

		public virtual void GotoParent(Token endToken, int adjustment)
		{
			GotoParent(endToken, adjustment, overwrite: true);
		}

		public virtual void GotoParent(Token endToken, int adjustment, bool overwrite)
		{
			if (overwrite || (Context.EndOffset == 1 && Context.EndLine == 1))
			{
				_Context.SetEnd(endToken.Line, endToken.Column + adjustment);
			}
			GotoParentContext();
		}

		public virtual void GotoParent(Token endToken)
		{
			GotoParent(endToken, 0);
		}

		public virtual void GotoParent(LanguageElement element)
		{
			_Context.SetEnd(element.InternalRange.Start);
			GotoParentContext();
		}

		public virtual void GotoParent(int endLine, int endOffset)
		{
			_Context.SetEnd(endLine, endOffset);
			GotoParentContext();
		}

		public void GotoParentContext()
		{
			if (_Context == null)
			{
				Log.SendError("GotoParentContext failed. Current context is null.");
			}
			else
			{
				_Context = _Context.Parent;
			}
		}

		public void GotoParentRegion()
		{
			if (_RegionContext != null)
			{
				LanguageElement parent = _RegionContext.Parent;
				if (parent == null)
				{
					_RegionContext = null;
				}
				else if (!(parent is SourceFile))
				{
					_RegionContext = (RegionDirective)parent;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void IntroduceComments(LanguageElement context)
		{
		}

		public virtual void IntroduceComments(LanguageElement context, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			SourceTreeCommenter sourceTreeCommenter = new SourceTreeCommenter();
			sourceTreeCommenter.CommentNode(context, comments);
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement Parse(LanguageElement context, RegionDirective regionContext, TextStringCollection textStrings, CompilerDirective compilerDirective, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			return Parse(context, regionContext, textStrings, compilerDirective, reader, null);
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement Parse(LanguageElement context, RegionDirective regionContext, TextStringCollection textStrings, CompilerDirective compilerDirectiveContext, ISourceReader reader, IDocument document)
		{
			ParserContext parserContext = new ParserContext();
			parserContext.Context = context;
			parserContext.RegionContext = regionContext;
			parserContext.TextStrings = textStrings;
			parserContext.CompilerDirectiveContext = compilerDirectiveContext;
			parserContext.Document = document;
			return Parse(parserContext, reader);
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement Parse(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			if (parserContext == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parserContext");
			}
			if (reader == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("reader");
			}
			lock (_SyncObject)
			{
				return CallParsing(parserContext, reader);
			}
		}

		public virtual LanguageElement ParseMiscFile(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			return Parse(parserContext, reader);
		}

		protected virtual LanguageElement CallParsing(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			return DoParse(parserContext, reader);
		}

		protected void SetupSourceFile()
		{
			if (Context != null && Context is SourceFile)
			{
				SourceFile sourceFile = (SourceFile)Context;
				sourceFile.SetDocument(Document);
				CompilerDirective compilerDirectiveRootNode = sourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode;
				RegionDirective regionRootNode = sourceFile.RegionRootNode;
				compilerDirectiveRootNode?.SetParent(sourceFile);
				regionRootNode?.SetParent(sourceFile);
			}
		}

		[Obsolete("Use ParseString instead.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public LanguageElement ParseSring(string code)
		{
			return ParseString(code);
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseString(string code)
		{
			return ParseString(code, 1, 1);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ICollection ParseStatements(string code)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISourceReader sourceReader = new SourceStringReader(code);
			ParserContext parserContext = new ParserContext();
			parserContext.Context = new Method();
			parserContext.SourceReader = sourceReader;
			parserContext.AllowCommentsInParseTree = true;
			parserContext.AutoSetValues();
			LanguageElement languageElement = Parse(parserContext, sourceReader);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICollection collection = languageElement.Nodes;
			if (collection.Count == 0)
			{
				collection = parserContext.Comments;
			}
			return collection;
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseString(string code, int line, int column)
		{
			if (code == null || code.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISourceReader sourceReader = new SourceStringReader(code, line, column);
			SourceFile sourceFile = GetSourceFile(string.Empty);
			ParserContext parserContext = new ParserContext();
			parserContext.Context = sourceFile;
			parserContext.SourceFile = sourceFile;
			parserContext.SourceReader = sourceReader;
			parserContext.AllowCommentsInParseTree = true;
			parserContext.AutoSetValues();
			return Parse(parserContext, sourceReader);
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseFile(string path)
		{
			return ParseFile(path, Encoding.Default);
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseFile(string path, Encoding encoding)
		{
			ErrorList errors;
			return ParseFile(path, encoding, out errors);
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseFile(string path, Encoding encoding, out ErrorList errors)
		{
			errors = null;
			if (!File.Exists(path))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISourceReader sourceReader = new SourceStringReader(path, encoding);
			SourceFile sourceFile = GetSourceFile(path);
			ParserContext parserContext = new ParserContext();
			parserContext.Context = sourceFile;
			parserContext.SourceFile = sourceFile;
			parserContext.SourceReader = sourceReader;
			parserContext.AllowCommentsInParseTree = true;
			parserContext.AutoSetValues();
			LanguageElement result = Parse(parserContext, sourceReader);
			errors = parserContext.Errors;
			return result;
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseFile(SourceFile file)
		{
			if (file == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string name = file.Name;
			if (!File.Exists(name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISourceReader sourceReader = new SourceStringReader(name, Encoding.Default);
			ParserContext parserContext = new ParserContext();
			parserContext.Context = file;
			parserContext.SourceFile = file;
			parserContext.SourceReader = sourceReader;
			parserContext.AllowCommentsInParseTree = true;
			parserContext.AutoSetValues();
			return Parse(parserContext, sourceReader);
		}

		public void SetContext(LanguageElement value)
		{
			if (_Context != value)
			{
				_Context = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsQueryExpressionStart(string str)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class ParserContext

		private IDocument _Document;

		private SourceRange _ParseRange;

		private CommentCollection _Comments;

		private SourceFile _SourceFile;

		private bool _AllowCommentsInParseTree;

		private bool _SaveUserFormat;

		private ScannerExtension _ScannerExtension;

		private ErrorList _Errors;

		public LanguageElement Context
		{
			get
			{
				return _Context;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_Context != value)
				{
					_Context = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement ContextAfterParse
		{
			get
			{
				return _ContextAfterParse;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_ContextAfterParse != value)
				{
					_ContextAfterParse = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public RegionDirective RegionContext

				if (RegionContext == null)

					RegionContext = regionDirectives;

				if (TextStrings == null)
				{
					TextStrings = strings;
				}
				if (CompilerDirectiveContext == null)
				{
					CompilerDirectiveContext = compilerDirectives;
				}
				if (SourceFile == null)
				{
					SourceFile = sourceFile;
				}
			}
		}

	public abstract class ParserErrorsBase
	{
		private const string errMsgFormat = "-- line {0} col {1}: {2}\r\n";

		private StringCollection errors;

		private ErrorList _Errors;

		public ErrorList Errors
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Errors == null)
				{
					_Errors = new ErrorList();
				}
				return _Errors;
			}
		}

		public int Count => errors.Count;

		public ParserErrorsBase()
		{
			errors = new StringCollection();
		}

		protected abstract string GetSyntaxErrorText(int n);

		protected void LogError(string format, params object[] args)
		{
			errors.Add(string.Format(format, args));
		}

		public void SynErr(int line, int col, int n)
		{
			string syntaxErrorText = GetSyntaxErrorText(n);
			LogError("-- line {0} col {1}: {2}\r\n", line, col, syntaxErrorText);
			Errors.Add(new Error(line, col, n));
		}

		public void SemErr(int line, int col, int n)
		{
			string text = $"error {n}";
			LogError("-- line {0} col {1}: {2}\r\n", line, col, text);
			Errors.Add(new Error(line, col, n));
		}

		public void Error(int line, int col, string s)
		{
			LogError("-- line {0} col {1}: {2}\r\n", line, col, s);
			Errors.Add(new Error(line, col, -1));
		}

		public void Exception(string s)
		{
			LogError("-- line {0} col {1}: {2}\r\n", 0, 0, s);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (errors != null)
			{
				errors.Clear();
			}
			_Errors = null;
		}

		public ErrorList GetClonedErrorList()
		{
			ErrorList errorList = new ErrorList();
			foreach (Error error in Errors)
			{
				errorList.Add(error);
			}
			return errorList;
		}
	}

	public class TokenBlock
	{
		private int _Type;

		private SourceRange _Range;

		public SourceRange Range => _Range;

		public int Type => _Type;

		public bool IsUnknown => _Type == -1;

		public TokenBlock(SourceRange range, int type)
		{
			_Range = range;
			_Type = type;
		}
	}
	public class ScannerExtension
	{
		private Queue _TokenBlocks;

		public ScannerExtension()
		{
			_TokenBlocks = new Queue();
		}

		private Token GetTokenFromBlock(TokenBlock block)
		{
			if (block == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new Token(block.Range, block.Type, string.Empty);
		}

		public void EnqueueBlock(SourceRange range, int type)
		{
			EnqueueBlock(new TokenBlock(range, type));
		}

		public void EnqueueBlock(TokenBlock block)
		{
			_TokenBlocks.Enqueue(block);
		}

		public Token Scan(int startLine, int startOffset)
		{
			return Scan(new SourcePoint(startLine, startOffset));
		}

		public Token Scan(SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (_TokenBlocks.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TokenBlock tokenBlock = _TokenBlocks.Peek() as TokenBlock;
			while (tokenBlock != null && tokenBlock.IsUnknown && point >= tokenBlock.Range.End)
			{
				_TokenBlocks.Dequeue();
				tokenBlock = _TokenBlocks.Peek() as TokenBlock;
			}
			if (tokenBlock.IsUnknown)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (point < tokenBlock.Range.Start)
			{
				return null;
			}
			_TokenBlocks.Dequeue();
			return GetTokenFromBlock(tokenBlock);
		}

		public TokenCollection GetTailTokens()
		{
			TokenCollection tokenCollection = new TokenCollection();
			while (_TokenBlocks.Count > 0)
			{
				TokenBlock tokenBlock = (TokenBlock)_TokenBlocks.Dequeue();
				if (!tokenBlock.IsUnknown)
				{
					Token tokenFromBlock = GetTokenFromBlock(tokenBlock);
					tokenCollection.Add(tokenFromBlock);
				}
			}
			return tokenCollection;
		}
	}

	public class SourceLineCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		public SourceLine this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return (SourceLine)base.List[index];
			}
			set
			{
				base.List[index] = value;
			}
		}

		public int Add(SourceLine aSourceLine)
		{
			return base.List.Add(aSourceLine);
		}

		public int IndexOf(SourceLine aSourceLine)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i] == aSourceLine)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, SourceLine aSourceLine)
		{
			base.List.Insert(index, aSourceLine);
		}

		public void Remove(SourceLine aSourceLine)
		{
			base.List.Remove(aSourceLine);
		}

		public SourceLine Find(SourceLine aSourceLine)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SourceLine sourceLine = (SourceLine)enumerator.Current;
					if (sourceLine == aSourceLine)
					{
						return sourceLine;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool Contains(SourceLine aSourceLine)
		{
			return Find(aSourceLine) != null;
		}
	}
	public class SourceLinesReader : ISourceReader, IDisposable
	{
		private SourceLineCollection _SourceLines;

		private string _Text;

		private bool _Eof;

		private int _StartLine;

		private int _StartColumn;

		private int _CurrentLine;

		private int _CurrentColumn;

		private int _Line;

		private int _LinePos;

		public int StartLine => _StartLine;

		public int StartColumn => _StartColumn;

		public int CurrentLine
		{
			get
			{
				return _CurrentLine;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_CurrentLine != value)
				{
					_CurrentLine = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int CurrentColumn
		{
			get
			{
				return _CurrentColumn;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_CurrentColumn != value)
				{
					_CurrentColumn = value;
				}
			}
		}

		bool ISourceReader.IsDocumentReader => false;

		public SourceLineCollection SourceLines => _SourceLines;

		public int LineCount => SourceLines.Count;

		public int Line => _Line;

		public int LinePos => _LinePos;

		public bool ManagesCoordinates => true;

		public bool IsDisposing => false;

		public bool IsDisposed => false;

		public SourceLinesReader(SourceLineCollection lines)
		{
			_SourceLines = lines;
			_StartLine = 1;
			_StartColumn = 1;
			_CurrentLine = 1;
			_CurrentColumn = 1;
			if (lines != null && lines.Count > 0)
			{
				SourceLine sourceLine = lines[0];
				_StartLine = sourceLine.Start.Line;
				_StartColumn = sourceLine.Start.Offset;
				_CurrentLine = _StartLine;
				_CurrentColumn = _StartColumn;
			}
			_Text = GetText();
		}

		public TextReader GetStream()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public char CurrentChar()
		{
			if (SourceLines == null || LineCount == 0)
			{
				_Eof = true;
				return '\0';
			}
			if (_Line >= 0 && _Line <= LineCount - 1)
			{
				SourceLine sourceLine = SourceLines[_Line];
				return sourceLine.Text[_LinePos];
			}
			return '\0';
		}

		public char NextChar()
		{
			if (SourceLines == null || LineCount == 0)
			{
				_Eof = true;
				return '\0';
			}
			if (_Line == LineCount - 1 && _LinePos >= SourceLines[_Line].Text.Length - 1)
			{
				_Eof = true;
				return '\0';
			}
			if (_Line >= 0 && _Line <= LineCount - 1)
			{
				SourceLine sourceLine = SourceLines[_Line];
				if (_LinePos == sourceLine.Text.Length - 1)
				{
					_Line++;
					_LinePos = 0;
					sourceLine = SourceLines[_Line];
					CurrentLine = sourceLine.Start.Line;
					CurrentColumn = sourceLine.Start.Offset;
					return sourceLine.Text[_LinePos];
				}
				CurrentColumn++;
				return sourceLine.Text[++_LinePos];
			}
			_Eof = true;
			return '\0';
		}

		public void UndoChar()
		{
			if (SourceLines != null && LineCount != 0 && (_Line != 0 || _LinePos != 0) && _Line >= 0 && _Line <= LineCount - 1)
			{
				SourceLine sourceLine = SourceLines[_Line];
				if (_LinePos == 0)
				{
					_Line--;
					sourceLine = SourceLines[_Line];
					_LinePos = sourceLine.Text.Length - 1;
					CurrentLine = sourceLine.Start.Line;
					CurrentColumn = sourceLine.Start.Offset + _LinePos;
				}
				else
				{
					CurrentColumn--;
					_LinePos--;
				}
			}
		}

		public string Text(int aStartPos, int aLength)
		{
			return _Text.Substring(aStartPos, aLength);
		}

		public bool Eof()
		{
			return _Eof;
		}

		public void IncreaseColumn()
		{
			_CurrentColumn++;
		}

		public int Position()
		{
			return ToPosition(Line, LinePos);
		}

		public void Seek(int position)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int maxPosition = GetMaxPosition();
			num = ((position >= 0) ? ((position < maxPosition) ? position : maxPosition) : 0);
			if (num == maxPosition)
			{
				_Eof = true;
			}
			else
			{
				_Eof = false;
			}
			SourcePoint sourcePoint = ToPoint(num);
			_Line = sourcePoint.Line;
			_LinePos = sourcePoint.Offset;
			SourceLine sourceLine = SourceLines[_Line];
			CurrentLine = sourceLine.Start.Line;
			CurrentColumn = _LinePos + sourceLine.Start.Offset;
		}

		public int ToPosition(int line, int linePos)
		{
			if (SourceLines == null || SourceLines.Count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = line;
			int num3 = linePos;
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			if (num2 > SourceLines.Count - 1)
			{
				num2 = SourceLines.Count - 1;
			}
			if (num3 > SourceLines[num2].Text.Length - 1)
			{
				num3 = SourceLines[num2].Text.Length - 1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
			{
				num += SourceLines[i].Text.Length;
			}
			return num + num3;
		}

		public SourcePoint ToPoint(int pos)
		{
			if (SourceLines == null || SourceLines.Count == 0)
			{
				return SourcePoint.Empty;
			}
			int num = pos;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			int maxPosition = GetMaxPosition();
			if (num > maxPosition)
			{
				num = maxPosition;
			}
			int line = 0;
			int offset = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < LineCount; i++)
			{
				SourceLine sourceLine = SourceLines[i];
				int length = sourceLine.Text.Length;
				if (i == 0)
				{
					num3 = length - 1;
				}
				if (num <= num3)
				{
					line = i;
					offset = num - num2;
					break;
				}
				num2 = num3 + 1;
				num3 += length;
			}
			return new SourcePoint(line, offset);
		}

		public int GetMaxPosition()
		{
			if (SourceLines == null || SourceLines.Count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return _Text.Length - 1;
		}

		public string GetText()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (SourceLines == null || SourceLines.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < LineCount; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(SourceLines[i].Text);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void OffsetSubStream(int line, int column)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException("SourceLinesReader.OffsetSubStream");
		}

		public ISourceReader GetSubStream(int startPos, int length, int line, int column)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException("SourceLinesReader.GetSubStream");
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}

		public bool IsDisposed => false;

		}
