		}
	}
	public class SourceTreeCommenter
	{
		private SourceFile _SourceFile;

		private DocumentHistorySlice _History;

		private Hashtable NodesAndIndexes;

		private IncludeDirective _FirstInclude;

		private bool _UseSorting;

		protected SourceFile SourceFile
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceFile;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_SourceFile != value)
				{
					_SourceFile = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool UseSorting
		{
			get
			{
				return _UseSorting;
			}
			set
			{
				_UseSorting = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceTreeCommenter()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public SourceTreeCommenter(DocumentHistorySlice history)
		{
			_History = history;
		}

		private void AddComment(CodeElement taget, Comment comment)
		{
			if (taget != null && comment != null)
			{
				taget.AddComment(comment, _UseSorting);
			}
		}

		private void AddComment(SourceFile taget, Comment comment)
		{
			if (taget != null && comment != null)
			{
				taget.AddComment(comment, _UseSorting);
			}
		}

		private void AddXmlDocCommentToStartNode(XmlDocComment xmlDoc)
		{
			if (xmlDoc != null)
			{
				SourceFile?.AddXmlDocComment(xmlDoc);
			}
		}

		private void AddUsualCommentToStartNode(Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment != null)
			{
				SourceFile sourceFile = SourceFile;
				if (sourceFile != null)
				{
					AddComment(sourceFile, comment);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddCommentToSourceFile(SourceFile fileNode, Comment comment)
		{
			AddCommentToSourceFile(fileNode, comment, null);
		}

		private void AddCommentToSourceFile(SourceFile fileNode, Comment comment, LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (fileNode == null || comment == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (node != null && node.Parent == fileNode)
			{
				int index = node.Index;
				fileNode.InsertNode(index, comment);
				return;
			}
			NodeList nodes = fileNode.Nodes;
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				fileNode.AddNode(comment);
				return;
			}
			int num = nodes.Count;
			while (num > 0 && nodes[num - 1] is SupportElement documentElement && !comment.StartsAfter(documentElement))
			{
				num--;
			}
			fileNode.InsertNode(num, comment);
		}

		private void AddCommentsToStartNode(CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (comments == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceFile sourceFile = SourceFile;
			if (sourceFile == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < comments.Count; i++)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[i];
				if (comment != null)
				{
					BindCommentToSourceFile(sourceFile, comment);
					if (sourceFile.Range.End < comment.Range.End)
					{
						sourceFile.SetEnd(comment.EndLine, comment.EndOffset);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InsertSupportElement(CodeElement node, SupportElement element)
		{
			node.InsertSupportElement(element, out var nodeList, out var index);
			if (nodeList != null && nodeList.Count != index + 1)
			{
				NodesAndIndexes[nodeList] = null;
			}
		}

		private void ReindexNode(NodeList nodes)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement2)
				{
					languageElement2.SetIndex(i);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReindexNodes()
		{
			foreach (DictionaryEntry nodesAndIndex in NodesAndIndexes)
			{
				ReindexNode((NodeList)nodesAndIndex.Key);
			}
		}

		private XmlDocComment BindXmlDocCommentToNode(CodeElement node, XmlDocComment xmlDoc)
		{
			XmlDocComment xmlDocComment = xmlDoc.ParseXmlNodes();
			if (xmlDocComment == null)
			{
				xmlDocComment = xmlDoc;
			}
			node.SetDocComment(xmlDocComment);
			InsertSupportElement(node, xmlDocComment);
			AddXmlDocCommentToStartNode(xmlDocComment);
			return xmlDocComment;
		}

		private void BindUsualCommentToNode(CodeElement node, Comment comment)
		{
			InsertSupportElement(node, comment);
			AddComment(node, comment);
			AddUsualCommentToStartNode(comment);
		}

		private void BindCommentToNode(CodeElement node, Comment comment)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				if (comment is XmlDocComment)
				{
					comment = BindXmlDocCommentToNode(node, comment as XmlDocComment);
				}
				else
				{
					BindUsualCommentToNode(node, comment);
				}
				if (_History != null)
				{
					comment.SetHistory(_History);
				}
			}
		}

		private void BindCommentToSourceFile(SourceFile fileNode, Comment comment)
		{
			BindCommentToSourceFile(fileNode, comment, null);
		}

		private void BindCommentToSourceFile(SourceFile fileNode, Comment comment, LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (comment == null || fileNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (comment is XmlDocComment)
			{
				XmlDocComment xmlDocComment = comment as XmlDocComment;
				XmlDocComment xmlDocComment2 = xmlDocComment.ParseXmlNodes();
				if (xmlDocComment2 == null)
				{
					xmlDocComment2 = xmlDocComment;
				}
				AddCommentToSourceFile(fileNode, xmlDocComment2, node);
				fileNode.AddXmlDocComment(xmlDocComment2);
				comment = xmlDocComment2;
			}
			else
			{
				AddCommentToSourceFile(fileNode, comment, node);
				AddComment(fileNode, comment);
			}
			if (_History != null)
			{
				comment.SetHistory(_History);
			}
		}

		public CodeElement GetNextCodeElementSibling(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			NodeList owningList = node.OwningList;
			if (owningList == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = owningList.IndexOf(node) + 1; i < owningList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (owningList[i] is CodeElement result)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanStartFromComment(LanguageElement node, Comment comment)
		{
			if (node == null || comment == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceRange internalRange = comment.InternalRange;
			if (node.Range.Start.Line != internalRange.Start.Line)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(node is Statement) && !(node is Method) && !(node is Property) && !(node is Class))
			{
				return node is Namespace;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanBindTrailingComment(CodeElement node, Comment comment)
		{
			if (node == null || comment == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceRange range = node.Range;
			SourceRange sourceRange = ((node.Parent != null) ? node.Parent.Range : SourceRange.Empty);
			SourceRange range2 = comment.Range;
			if (!sourceRange.Contains(range2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (range2.Start.Line != range.End.Line || range2.Start < range.End)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement nextCodeElementSibling = GetNextCodeElementSibling(node);
			if (nextCodeElementSibling != null && range2.Start > nextCodeElementSibling.Range.Start)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CanStartFromComment(nextCodeElementSibling, comment))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CouldEnterChildren(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				if (!node.ParsingPostponedTokens)
				{
					return !node.HasUnparsedCode;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ContainRange(SourceRange[] innerRanges, SourceRange range)
		{
			if (innerRanges == null || range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = innerRanges.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (innerRanges[i].Contains(range))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private SourcePoint GetNodesStartPoint(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return SourcePoint.Empty;
			}
			SourcePoint result = SourcePoint.Empty;
			int count = nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!result.IsEmpty)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					result = languageElement.Range.Start;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SourcePoint GetNodesEndPoint(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return SourcePoint.Empty;
			}
			SourcePoint result = SourcePoint.Empty;
			int count = nodes.Count;
			int num = count - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && result.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (nodes[num] is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					result = languageElement.Range.End;
				}
				num--;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SourceRange GetRangeFromNodes(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourcePoint nodesStartPoint = GetNodesStartPoint(nodes);
			SourcePoint nodesEndPoint = GetNodesEndPoint(nodes);
			return new SourceRange(nodesStartPoint, nodesEndPoint);
		}

		private SourceRange GetDetailsRange(LanguageElement node, bool invertedOrder)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange result = GetRangeFromNodes(node.DetailNodes);
			if (result.IsEmpty)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			IHasParens hasParens = node as IHasParens;
			if (hasParens != null && !hasParens.ParensRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = hasParens.ParensRange;
			}
			else if (!invertedOrder)
			{
				result = new SourceRange(result.Start, new SourcePoint(result.End.Line + 1, 1));
			}
			if (hasParens != null && hasParens.ParensRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = new SourceRange(node.Range.Start, result.End);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SourceRange GetNodesRange(LanguageElement node, bool invertedOrder)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange rangeFromNodes = GetRangeFromNodes(node.Nodes);
			if (rangeFromNodes.IsEmpty)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange result = new SourceRange(rangeFromNodes.Start, new SourcePoint(rangeFromNodes.End.Line + 1, 1));
			DelimiterCapableBlock delimiterCapableBlock = node as DelimiterCapableBlock;
			IHasBlock hasBlock = node as IHasBlock;
			if (delimiterCapableBlock != null && (delimiterCapableBlock.BlockType == DelimiterBlockType.Brace || (!delimiterCapableBlock.BlockStart.IsEmpty && !delimiterCapableBlock.BlockEnd.IsEmpty)))
			{
				if (delimiterCapableBlock.BlockType == DelimiterBlockType.Brace)
				{
					return (!invertedOrder) ? delimiterCapableBlock.BlockRange : new SourceRange(delimiterCapableBlock.BlockRange.Start, new SourcePoint(rangeFromNodes.End.Line + 1, 1));
				}
				if (!delimiterCapableBlock.BlockStart.IsEmpty && !delimiterCapableBlock.BlockEnd.IsEmpty)
				{
					result = new SourceRange(delimiterCapableBlock.BlockStart.End, delimiterCapableBlock.BlockEnd.Start);
				}
			}
			else if (hasBlock != null && !hasBlock.BlockStart.IsEmpty && !hasBlock.BlockEnd.IsEmpty)
			{
				result = new SourceRange(hasBlock.BlockStart.End, hasBlock.BlockEnd.Start);
			}
			else if (!invertedOrder)
			{
				SourceRange sourceRange = node.GetDetailNodeRange();
				if (node is IHasParens { ParensRange: { IsEmpty: false } } hasParens)
				{
					sourceRange = hasParens.ParensRange;
				}
				if (sourceRange.IsEmpty || !sourceRange.StartsBefore(rangeFromNodes.End.Line, rangeFromNodes.End.Offset))
				{
					return rangeFromNodes;
				}
				result = new SourceRange(new SourcePoint(sourceRange.End.Line + 1, 1), new SourcePoint(rangeFromNodes.End.Line + 1, 1));
			}
			return result;
		}

		private SourceRange[] GetInnerSourceRanges(SourceRange commonRange, SourceRange detailsRange, SourceRange nodesRange)
		{
			detailsRange = detailsRange.LogicalRange;
			nodesRange = nodesRange.LogicalRange;
			if (nodesRange.Contains(detailsRange) || detailsRange.IntersectsWith(nodesRange))
			{
				nodesRange = SourceRange.Union(detailsRange, nodesRange);
				detailsRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange = detailsRange;
			SourceRange sourceRange2 = nodesRange;
			if (sourceRange2.Start < sourceRange.Start)
			{
				sourceRange = nodesRange;
				sourceRange2 = detailsRange;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (commonRange.Start < sourceRange.Start)
			{
				arrayList.Add(new SourceRange(commonRange.Start, sourceRange.Start));
			}
			if (sourceRange.End < sourceRange2.Start)
			{
				arrayList.Add(new SourceRange(sourceRange.End, sourceRange2.Start));
			}
			if (sourceRange2.End < commonRange.End)
			{
				arrayList.Add(new SourceRange(sourceRange2.End, commonRange.End));
			}
			if (arrayList.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (SourceRange[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(SourceRange));
		}

		private SourceRange[] GetInnerSourceRangesForNode(LanguageElement node)
		{
			bool invertedOrder = node.DetailNodesFollowChildNodes();
			SourceRange detailsRange = GetDetailsRange(node, invertedOrder);
			SourceRange nodesRange = GetNodesRange(node, invertedOrder);
			return GetInnerSourceRanges(node.InternalRange, detailsRange, nodesRange);
		}

		private bool HasIncludeDirectiveInside(SourcePoint start, SourcePoint end)
		{
			if (_FirstInclude == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourcePoint start2 = _FirstInclude.Range.Start;
			if (start2 >= start)
			{
				return start2 <= end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddPrecedingCommentsToNode(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (!(node is CodeElement node2))
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceRange internalRange = node.InternalRange;
			while (comments.Count > 0)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[0];
				SourceRange internalRange2 = comment.InternalRange;
				if (internalRange2.End <= internalRange.Start)
				{
					if (HasIncludeDirectiveInside(internalRange2.End, internalRange.Start))
					{
						comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.Inside;
						BindCommentToSourceFile(_SourceFile, comment, node);
						comments.RemoveAt(0);
					}
					else
					{
						comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.Before;
						BindCommentToNode(node2, comment);
						comments.RemoveAt(0);
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool AddCommentToNextObjectInitializerChildren(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments, Comment comment, int index)
		{
			if (node.Parent == null || node.Parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CodeElement nextCodeElementSibling = GetNextCodeElementSibling(node);
			if (nextCodeElementSibling == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.Before;
			BindCommentToNode(nextCodeElementSibling, comment);
			comments.RemoveAt(index);
			return true;
		}

		private void AddTrailingComment(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (node == null || comments == null || !(node is CodeElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			CodeElement node2 = node as CodeElement;
			while (num < comments.Count)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[num];
				if (comment.InternalRange.Start.Line > node.InternalRange.End.Line)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (CanBindTrailingComment(node2, comment))
				{
					if (!AddCommentToNextObjectInitializerChildren(node2, comments, comment, num))
					{
						comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.After;
						BindCommentToNode(node2, comment);
						comments.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool AddCommentToFirstObjectInitializerChildren(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments, Comment comment, int index)
		{
			if (node.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression || node.DetailNodeCount <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(node.DetailNodes[0] is CodeElement node2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.Before;
			BindCommentToNode(node2, comment);
			comments.RemoveAt(index);
			return true;
		}

		private void AddInnerCommentsBeforeChildren(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (!CouldEnterChildren(node) || node is SourceFile)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceRange[] array = null;
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			while (num <= comments.Count - 1)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[num];
				if (comment == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				SourceRange internalRange = comment.InternalRange;
				SourceRange internalRange2 = node.InternalRange;
				if (internalRange.Start > internalRange2.End)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (comment.Range.End < internalRange2.Start)
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					array = GetInnerSourceRangesForNode(node);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (array == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (!ContainRange(array, internalRange))
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (!AddCommentToFirstObjectInitializerChildren(node, comments, comment, num))
				{
					comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.Inside;
					BindCommentToNode(node as CodeElement, comment);
					comments.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddCommentsToNodes(NodeList nodes, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (num < nodes.Count)
			{
				LanguageElement node = (LanguageElement)nodes[num];
				LanguageElement languageElement = null;
				if (num < nodes.Count - 1)
				{
					languageElement = (LanguageElement)nodes[num + 1];
				}
				if (comments.Count != 0)
				{
					if (languageElement == null || comments[0].Range.Start <= languageElement.Range.Start)
					{
						AddCommentsToNode(node, comments);
					}
					if (languageElement != null)
					{
						while (languageElement != nodes[++num])
						{
						}
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddCommentsToChildren(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (node is SupportElement || comments == null || comments.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElement nextCodeElementSibling = GetNextCodeElementSibling(node);
			if ((nextCodeElementSibling == null || !(comments[0].Range.Start > nextCodeElementSibling.Range.Start)) && CouldEnterChildren(node))
			{
				if (node is MethodCallExpression || node is MethodCall || node is ObjectCreationExpression || !node.DetailNodesFollowChildNodes())
				{
					AddCommentsToNodes(node.DetailNodes, comments);
					AddCommentsToNodes(node.Nodes, comments);
				}
				else
				{
					AddCommentsToNodes(node.Nodes, comments);
					AddCommentsToNodes(node.DetailNodes, comments);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddInnerCommentsAfterChildren(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (!(node is CodeElement node2))
			{
				return;
			}
			while (comments.Count > 0)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[0];
				if (node.Contains(comment.InternalRange))
				{
					comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.Inside;
					BindCommentToNode(node2, comment);
					comments.RemoveAt(0);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddTrailingCommentsToNode(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (!(node is CodeElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			while (comments.Count > 0)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[0];
				if (CanBindTrailingComment(node as CodeElement, comment))
				{
					comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.After;
					BindCommentToNode(node as CodeElement, comment);
					comments.RemoveAt(0);
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void AddSourceFileLevelComments(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (!(node.Parent is SourceFile) || node.NextCodeSibling != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			while (num <= comments.Count - 1)
			{
				Comment comment = comments[num];
				if (comment.InternalRange.Start > node.InternalRange.End)
				{
					comment.Position = SupportElementPosition.After;
					BindCommentToNode((CodeElement)node, comment);
					comments.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
		}

		private LanguageElement GetHasParensParent(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = node;
			while (true)
			{
				LanguageElement parent = languageElement.Parent;
				if (parent == null || MemberFilter.IsMember(parent) || TypeDeclarationFilter.IsTypeDeclaration(parent))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (parent is IHasParens)
				{
					return parent;
				}
				languageElement = parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool OutOfParentParens(LanguageElement node, Comment comment)
		{
			if (node == null || comment == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceRange internalRange = comment.InternalRange;
			LanguageElement parent = node.Parent;
			if (parent == null || !(parent is IHasParens))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.HasInDetails(node))
			{
				return !((IHasParens)parent).ParensRange.Contains(internalRange);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddCommentsToNode(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (!(node is SupportElement) && comments != null && comments.Count != 0)
			{
				AddPrecedingCommentsToNode(node, comments);
				AddTrailingComment(node, comments);
				AddInnerCommentsBeforeChildren(node, comments);
				AddCommentsToChildren(node, comments);
				AddInnerCommentsAfterChildren(node, comments);
				AddTrailingCommentsToNode(node, comments);
				AddSourceFileLevelComments(node, comments);
			}
		}

		private IncludeDirective GetFirstIncludeDirective(CompilerDirectiveCollection directives)
		{
			if (directives == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (CompilerDirective directive in directives)
			{
				if (directive is IncludeDirective result)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void StoreSourceFileNode(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (node is SourceFile)
			{
				_SourceFile = (SourceFile)node;
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStudioDocument parentDocument = node.GetParentDocument();
				if (parentDocument is SourceFile)
				{
					_SourceFile = (SourceFile)parentDocument;
				}
			}
			if (_SourceFile != null && _SourceFile.CompilerDirectives != null)
			{
				_FirstInclude = GetFirstIncludeDirective(_SourceFile.CompilerDirectives);
			}
		}

		private void CleanUpSourceFileNode()
		{
			_SourceFile = null;
		}

		public void CommentNode(LanguageElement node, CommentCollection comments)
		{
			if (node != null && comments != null)
			{
				NodesAndIndexes = new Hashtable();
				StoreSourceFileNode(node);
				AddCommentsToNode(node, comments);
				AddCommentsToStartNode(comments);
				CleanUpSourceFileNode();
				ReindexNodes();
			}
		}
	}
	public class Token : ICloneable, IToken
	{
		private short _Type;

		private int _StartPosition;

		private int _EndPosition;

		private int _Line;

		private int _EndLine;

		private int _Column;

		private int _EndColumn;

		private string _Value;

		private Token _Next;

		public int StartPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _StartPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				_StartPosition = value;
			}
		}

		public int EndPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _EndPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndPosition = value;
			}
		}

		public int Line
		{
			get
			{
				return _Line;
			}
			set
			{
				_Line = value;
			}
		}

		public int EndLine
		{
			get
			{
				if (_EndLine == 0)
				{
					return _Line;
				}
				return _EndLine;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndLine = value;
			}
		}

		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				return _Column;
			}
			set
			{
				_Column = value;
			}
		}

		public int EndColumn
		{
			get
			{
				if (_EndColumn == 0)
				{
					return _Column;
				}
				return _EndColumn;
			}
			set
			{
				_EndColumn = value;
			}
		}

		public int Type
		{
			get
			{
				return _Type;
			}
			set
			{
				_Type = (short)value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange Range
		{
			get
			{
				return new SourceRange(Line, Column, EndLine, EndColumn);
			}
			set
			{
				_Line = value.Top.Line;
				_Column = value.Top.Offset;
				_EndLine = value.Bottom.Line;
				_EndColumn = value.Bottom.Offset;
			}
		}

		public int Length
		{
			get
			{
				if (_EndPosition != -1 && _StartPosition != -1)
				{
					return _EndPosition - _StartPosition;
				}
				if (_Line == _EndLine)
				{
					return _EndColumn - _Column;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public string EscapedValue => Value;

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				return _Value;
			}
			set
			{
				_Value = value;
			}
		}

		public Token Next
		{
			get
			{
				return _Next;
			}
			set
			{
				_Next = value;
			}
		}

		public Token()
			: this(-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, 6, null)
		{
		}

		public Token(int type)
			: this(-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, type, null)
		{
		}

		public Token(SourceRange range, int tokenType, string value)
			: this(-1, -1, range.Start.Line, range.Start.Offset, range.End.Line, range.End.Offset, tokenType, value)
		{
		}

		public Token(int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, int tokenType, string value)
			: this(-1, -1, line, column, endLine, endColumn, tokenType, value)
		{
		}

		public Token(int startPosition, int endPosition, int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, int tokenType, string value)
		{
			_StartPosition = startPosition;
			_EndPosition = endPosition;
			_Line = line;
			_Column = column;
			_EndLine = endLine;
			_EndColumn = endColumn;
			_Type = (short)tokenType;
			_Value = ((tokenType == 1) ? ReplaceUnicodeEscapes(value) : value);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		private string ReplaceUnicodeEscape(string s, int pos)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = s.Substring(0, pos);
			string text2 = s.Substring(pos, 6);
			string text3 = s.Substring(pos + 6);
			text2 = text2.Substring(2);
			for (int i = 0; i < text2.Length; i++)
			{
				if ("0123456789ABCDEFabcdef".IndexOf(text2[i]) < 0)
				{
					return s;
				}
			}
			int value = Convert.ToInt32(text2, 16);
			text2 = Convert.ToChar(value).ToString();
			return text + text2 + text3;
		}

		protected string ReplaceUnicodeEscapes(string s)
		{
			if (s == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = s;
			int num = text.IndexOf("\\u");
			while (num > -1 && text != string.Empty && num + 6 <= text.Length)
			{
				text = ReplaceUnicodeEscape(text, num);
				num = text.IndexOf("\\u", num + 1);
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected virtual void CloneDataFrom(Token source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				_Type = source._Type;
				_StartPosition = source._StartPosition;
				_EndPosition = source._EndPosition;
				_Line = source._Line;
				_EndLine = source._EndLine;
				_Column = source._Column;
				_EndColumn = source._EndColumn;
				_Value = source._Value;
			}
		}

		public SourceRange GetRange()
		{
			return Range;
		}

		public bool Match(int type)
		{
			return _Type == type;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return EscapedValue + " ";
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual Token Clone()
		{
			return Clone(ElementCloneOptions.Default);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual Token Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Token token = new Token();
			token.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return token;
		}
	}
	public abstract class TokenCategorizedParserBase : GeneratedParserBase
	{
		private TokenCollection _SavedTokens;

		public TokenCollection SavedTokens
		{

			{
				if (_SavedTokens == null)
				{
					_SavedTokens = new TokenCollection();
				}
				return _SavedTokens;
			}
		}

		public bool SetTokensCategory
		{
			get
			{
				return _SetTokensCategory;
			}
			set
			{
				_SetTokensCategory = value;
			}
		}

		protected abstract TokenCategory GetTokenCategory(CategorizedToken token);

		protected void SetKeywordTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (SetTokensCategory && token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken)
			{
				categorizedToken.Category = TokenCategory.Keyword;
			}
		}

		protected override void Get()
		{
			base.Get();
			SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(la);
		}

		public void SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(Token token)
		{
			if (_SetTokensCategory && token is CategorizedToken { WasCheckedCategorizedToken: false } categorizedToken && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(categorizedToken.Value))
			{
				categorizedToken.Category = GetTokenCategory(categorizedToken);
				if (categorizedToken.Category != TokenCategory.Unknown)
				{
					SavedTokens.Add(categorizedToken);
					categorizedToken.WasCheckedCategorizedToken = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class TokenizerBase : ITokenReader
	{
		private ISourceReader _SourceReader;

		private ScannerExtension _ScannerExtension;

		private Token _CurrentToken;

		private Token _NextToken;

		private TextStringCollection _TextStrings;

		private CommentCollection _Comments;

		private LanguageTokensBase _Tokens;

		private Queue _TokenQueue;

		private string[] emptyString = new string[1] { string.Empty };

		protected LanguageTokensBase Tokens
		{
			get
			{
				return _Tokens;
			}
			set
			{
				_Tokens = value;
			}
		}

		protected Queue TokenQueue => _TokenQueue;

		public ISourceReader SourceReader
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceReader;
			}
			set
			{
				_SourceReader = value;
			}
		}

		public ScannerExtension ScannerExtension
		{
			get
			{
				return _ScannerExtension;
			}
			set
			{
				_ScannerExtension = value;
			}
		}

		public Token CurrentToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _CurrentToken;
			}
			set
			{
				_CurrentToken = value;
			}
		}

		public Token NextToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _NextToken;
			}
			set
			{
				_NextToken = value;
			}
		}

		public CommentCollection Comments
		{
			get
			{
				return _Comments;
			}
			set
			{
				_Comments = value;
			}
		}

		public TextStringCollection TextStrings
		{
			get
			{
				return _TextStrings;
			}
			set
			{
				_TextStrings = value;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool Eof => CurrentToken == null;

		public TokenizerBase(ISourceReader reader)
			: this(reader, null)
		{
		}

		public TokenizerBase(ISourceReader reader, ScannerExtension extension)
		{
			SourceReader = reader;
			_Comments = new CommentCollection();
			_ScannerExtension = extension;
			Prepare();
		}

		protected abstract void CreateTokens();

		protected abstract Token GotoNext();

		protected virtual Token GotoNextWithScannerExtension()
		{
			if (_TokenQueue != null && _TokenQueue.Count > 0)
			{
				return _TokenQueue.Dequeue() as Token;
			}
			Token nextTokenFromLexer = GetNextTokenFromLexer();
			ScannerExtension scannerExtension = ScannerExtension;
			if (scannerExtension != null)
			{
				return GetNextTokenWithScannerExtension(scannerExtension, nextTokenFromLexer);
			}
			return nextTokenFromLexer;
		}

		protected virtual Token GetNextTokenFromLexer()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual Token GetNextTokenWithScannerExtension(ScannerExtension extension, Token lexerToken)
		{
			if (extension == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Token token = null;
			if (lexerToken == null)
			{
				TokenCollection tailTokens = extension.GetTailTokens();
				if (tailTokens != null)
				{
					foreach (Token item in tailTokens)
					{
						_TokenQueue.Enqueue(item);
					}
					if (_TokenQueue.Count > 0)
					{
						return _TokenQueue.Dequeue() as Token;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			for (token = extension.Scan(lexerToken.Range.Start); token != null; token = extension.Scan(lexerToken.Range.Start))
			{
				_TokenQueue.Enqueue(token);
			}
			_TokenQueue.Enqueue(lexerToken);
			return _TokenQueue.Dequeue() as Token;
		}

		protected virtual void Prepare()
		{
			_TokenQueue = new Queue();
			CreateTokens();
			MoveForward();
			MoveForward();
		}

		protected string GetEmptyString(int length)
		{
			if (emptyString.Length > length)
			{
				return emptyString[length];
			}
			string[] array = new string[length + 1];
			emptyString.CopyTo(array, 0);
			int i = emptyString.Length;
			emptyString = array;
			for (; i <= length; i++)
			{
				emptyString[i] = new string(' ', i);
			}
			return emptyString[length];
		}

		public abstract Token GetCodeBlock(Token token);

		public virtual void Reset(ISourceReader sourceReader)
		{
			SourceReader = sourceReader;
			_Comments = new CommentCollection();
			_TokenQueue = new Queue();
		}

		public virtual Token MoveForward()
		{
			CurrentToken = NextToken;
			NextToken = GotoNext();
			return CurrentToken;
		}
	}
	public class TokenQueueBase : ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable, ITokenReader
	{
		private LinkedList _Queue;

		private int _CurrentPos;

		private Token _LastDequeuedToken;

		public int CurrentPos
		{
			get
			{
				return _CurrentPos;
			}
			set
			{
				SetCurrentPos(value);
			}
		}

		public int Count => _Queue.Count - _CurrentPos;

		public bool IsSynchronized => _Queue.IsSynchronized;

		public object SyncRoot => _Queue.SyncRoot;

		public Token CurrentToken
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count > 0)
				{
					return Peek();
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public Token NextToken
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count > 1)
				{
					return LookUpToken(1);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public Token LastToken
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Peek(Count - 1);
			}
		}

		public Token LastDequeuedToken => _LastDequeuedToken;

		public bool Eof => CurrentToken == null;

		public TokenQueueBase()
		{
			_Queue = new LinkedList();
			_CurrentPos = 0;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			return Clone();
		}

		public void Append(TokenQueueBase queue)
		{
			if (queue != null && queue._Queue != null)
			{
				_Queue.AddRange(queue._Queue);
			}
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			_Queue.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public bool Contains(Token token)
		{
			return _Queue.Contains(token);
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _Queue.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public TokenQueueBase Clone()
		{
			return CloneQueue();
		}

		public Token Peek()
		{
			return Peek(CurrentPos);
		}

		public Token Peek(int index)
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ParserException("Token queue is empty.");
			}
			return (Token)_Queue[index];
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			_Queue.Clear();
			_CurrentPos = 0;
		}

		public Token Dequeue()
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ParserException("Token queue is empty.");
			}
			Token token = Peek(_CurrentPos);
			_Queue.RemoveAt(_CurrentPos);
			_LastDequeuedToken = token;
			return token;
		}

		public void Enqueue(Token token)
		{
			_Queue.Add(token);
		}

		public Token DequeueToken()
		{
			return Dequeue();
		}

		public void EnqueueToken(Token token)
		{
			Enqueue(token);
		}

		public int TokenPosition(int token)
		{
			int num = 0;
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				Token token2 = (Token)enumerator.Current;
				if (token2.Type == token)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public Token LookUpToken(int pos)
		{
			int num = _CurrentPos + pos;
			if (num < 0 || num >= _Queue.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Peek(num);
		}

		public Token MoveForward()
		{
			Dequeue();
			return CurrentToken;
		}

		public bool ContainsToken(int token)
		{
			return TokenPosition(token) != -1;
		}

		public int GetUnparentedTokenPosition(int tokenType, int openType, int closeType)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (_Queue[i] is Token token)
				{
					if (token.Type == openType)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (token.Type == closeType)
					{
						num--;
					}
					else if (token.Type == tokenType && num == 0)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public bool ContainsUnparentedToken(int token)
		{
			return GetUnparentedTokenPosition(token, 73, 74) >= 0;
		}

		public virtual TokenQueueBase CloneQueue()
		{
			TokenQueueBase tokenQueueBase = new TokenQueueBase();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				tokenQueueBase.Enqueue((Token)enumerator.Current);
			}
			return tokenQueueBase;
		}

		public bool CurrentTokenMatches(int tokenType)
		{
			if (CurrentToken != null)
			{
				return CurrentToken.Match(tokenType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			string arg = string.Empty;
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				Token token = (Token)enumerator.Current;
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", arg, token.EscapedValue);
				arg = " ";
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void SkipUpTo(int tokenType)
		{
			SkipUpTo(tokenType, include: false);
		}

		public void SkipUpTo(int tokenType, bool include)
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Token token = Peek();
			while (Count > 0 && token.Type != tokenType)
			{
				Dequeue();
				if (Count > 0)
				{
					token = Peek();
				}
			}
			if (Count > 0 && include)
			{
				Dequeue();
			}
		}

		public TokenQueueBase QueueUpTo(int tokenType)
		{
			return QueueUpTo(tokenType, include: true);
		}

		public TokenQueueBase QueueUpTo(int tokenType, bool include)
		{
			TokenQueueBase tokenQueueBase = new TokenQueueBase();
			Token token = Peek();
			while (Count > 0 && token.Type != tokenType)
			{
				tokenQueueBase.Enqueue(token);
				Dequeue();
				if (Count > 0)
				{
					token = Peek();
				}
			}
			if (Count > 0 && include)
			{
				tokenQueueBase.Enqueue(token);
				Dequeue();
			}
			return tokenQueueBase;
		}

		public void SetCurrentPos(int pos)
		{
			if (pos < 0)
			{
				pos = 0;
			}
			if (pos >= _Queue.Count)
			{
				pos = _Queue.Count - 1;
			}
			_CurrentPos = pos;
		}
	}
	public static class PathUtils
	{
		public static string GetLocalPath(string uri)
		{
			if (uri == null || uri.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			Uri uri2 = new Uri(uri);
			return uri2.LocalPath + uri2.Fragment;
		}

		public static string AddDirSeparatorIfNeed(string path)
		{
			string text = new string(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, 1);
			if (path.EndsWith(text))
			{
				return path;
			}
			return path + text;
		}
	}

					_LocalPath = PathUtils.GetLocalPath(FilePath);
				}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)

			if (source != null)

				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is PathElement)
				{
					PathElement pathElement = (PathElement)source;
					_FilePath = pathElement._FilePath;
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetFilePath(string newPath)
		{
			_FilePath = newPath;
			_LocalPath = null;
		}
	}
	public class ExpressionSignatureBuilder
	{
		private const char CHAR_LessThan = '<';

		private const char CHAR_GreaterThan = '>';

		private const string CHAR_Dot = ".";

		private ExpressionSignatureBuilder()
		{
		}

		private static void AppendGeneric(StringBuilder builder, IGenericExpression expr)
		{
			if (builder == null || expr == null || !expr.IsGeneric)
			{
				return;
			}
			builder.Append('<');
			ITypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeArguments = expr.TypeArguments;
			int count = typeArguments.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				builder.Append(BuildSignature(typeArguments[i]));
				if (i < count - 1)
				{
					builder.Append(", ");
				}
			}
			builder.Append('>');
		}

		private static void AppendTypeReferenceModifiers(StringBuilder builder, ITypeReferenceExpression expr)
		{
			if (builder == null || expr == null || !expr.IsArrayType)
			{
				return;
			}
			builder.Append("[");
			for (int i = 0; i < expr.Rank - 1; i++)
			{
				builder.Append(",");
			}
			builder.Append("]");
			if (expr.IsConst)
			{
				builder.Append("const ");
			}
			if (expr.IsVolatile)
			{
				builder.Append("volatile ");
			}
			if (expr.IsPointerType)
			{
				if (expr.IsManaged)
				{
					builder.Append("^");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append("*");
				}
			}
			if (expr.IsReferenceType)
			{
				if (expr.IsManaged)
				{
					builder.Append("%");
				}
				else
				{
					builder.Append("&");
				}
			}
			if (expr.IsNullable)
			{
				builder.Append("?");
			}
		}

		private static void AppendExpressionsSignature(StringBuilder builder, IExpressionCollection expressions)
		{
			if (builder == null || expressions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = expressions.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				IExpression expression = expressions[i];
				if (expression != null)
				{
					builder.Append(GetSignature(expression));
					if (i < count - 1)
					{
						builder.Append(", ");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AppendArgumentsSignature(StringBuilder builder, IMethodCallExpression methodCall)
		{
			if (builder != null && methodCall != null)
			{
				builder.Append("(");
				AppendExpressionsSignature(builder, methodCall.Arguments);
				builder.Append(")");
			}
		}

		private static string BuildSignature(IExpression expr)
		{
			if (expr == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (expr is IWithSource)
			{
				IWithSource withSource = (IWithSource)expr;
				if (withSource.Source != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(BuildSignature(withSource.Source));
					if (!(expr is ITypeReferenceExpression { IsArrayType: not false }))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(".");
					}
				}
			}
			if (expr is IMethodCallExpression)
			{
				AppendArgumentsSignature(stringBuilder, expr as IMethodCallExpression);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(expr.Name);
			}
			AppendGeneric(stringBuilder, expr as IGenericExpression);
			AppendTypeReferenceModifiers(stringBuilder, expr as ITypeReferenceExpression);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static string GetSignature(IExpression expr)
		{
			if (expr == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return BuildSignature(expr);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class MemberSignatureBuilder
	{
		private const char CHAR_AccentChar = '`';

		private const char CHAR_Comma = ',';

		private const char CHAR_Space = ' ';

		private const string STR_TypeSeparator = " : ";

		private const char CHAR_OpenParen = '(';

		private const char CHAR_CloseParen = ')';

		private const char CHAR_OpenSquareBracket = '[';

		private const char CHAR_CloseSquareBracket = ']';

		private const char CHAR_LessThan = '<';

		private const char CHAR_GreaterThan = '>';

		private const string STR_ConstructorName = ".ctor";

		private const string STR_DestructorName = "Finalize";

		private const string STR_DoubleColons = "::";

		private const string STR_Reference = "&";

		private const string STR_Void = "void";

		private static bool ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(ICollection collection)
		{
			if (collection != null)
			{
				return collection.Count == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool MethodHasNoReturnType(IMethodElement method)
		{
			if (method != null)
			{
				if (method.ElementType != LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet && method.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EventAdd && method.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EventRemove)
				{
					return method.ElementType == LanguageElementType.EventRaise;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void AppendType(StringBuilder builder, IHasType hasType)
		{
			AppendType(builder, hasType, addVoid: true);
		}

		private static void AppendType(StringBuilder builder, IHasType hasType, bool addVoid)
		{
			if (builder == null || hasType == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ITypeReferenceExpression type = hasType.Type;
			if (type == null || MethodHasNoReturnType(hasType as IMethodElement))
			{
				if (addVoid)
				{
					builder.Append("void");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				builder.Append(ExpressionSignatureBuilder.GetSignature(type));
			}
		}

		private static void AppendAccessorParameters(StringBuilder builder, IMemberElement member, IMethodElement accessor)
		{
			IWithParameters withParameters = member as IWithParameters;
			switch (accessor.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
				if (withParameters != null)
				{
					AppendParameters(builder, withParameters.Parameters);
				}
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
				AppendType(builder, member as IHasType);
				if (withParameters != null && !ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(withParameters.Parameters))
				{
					builder.Append(',');
					builder.Append(' ');
					AppendParameters(builder, withParameters.Parameters);
				}
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRaise:
				AppendType(builder, member as IHasType);
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void AppendParameters(StringBuilder builder, IParameterElementCollection parameters)
		{
			AppendParameters(builder, parameters, addSpaceSplitter: true);
		}

		private static bool IsActivatedGenericParameter(IParameterElement parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null || parameter.Type == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ITypeElement parentType = parameter.ParentType;
			if (parentType == null || parentType.TypeParameters == null || parentType.TypeParameters.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < parentType.TypeParameters.Count; i++)
			{
				ITypeParameter typeParameter = parentType.TypeParameters[i];
				if (typeParameter != null && typeParameter.IsActivated && typeParameter.ActivatedType != null && parameter.Type.Name == typeParameter.ActivatedType.Name)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void AppendParameters(StringBuilder builder, IParameterElementCollection parameters, bool addSpaceSplitter)
		{
			if (builder == null || ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(parameters))
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = parameters.Count;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				IParameterElement parameterElement = parameters[i];
				if (IsActivatedGenericParameter(parameterElement))
				{
					builder.Append($"`{num}");
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					AppendType(builder, parameterElement);
				}
				if (parameterElement.Direction == ArgumentDirection.Out || parameterElement.Direction == ArgumentDirection.Ref)
				{
					builder.Append("&");
				}
				if (i < count - 1)
				{
					builder.Append(',');
					if (addSpaceSplitter)
					{
						builder.Append(' ');
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AppendParameters(StringBuilder builder, IMethodElement method)
		{
			AppendParameters(builder, method, addSpaceSplitter: true);
		}

		private static void AppendParameters(StringBuilder builder, IMethodElement method, bool addSpaceSplitter)
		{
			IMemberElement member = method.Parent as IMemberElement;
			if (IsAccessor(method) && CanContainAccessor(member))
			{
				AppendAccessorParameters(builder, member, method);
			}
			else
			{
				AppendParameters(builder, method.Parameters, addSpaceSplitter);
			}
		}

		private static void AppendParameters(StringBuilder builder, IDelegateElement del)
		{
			AppendParameters(builder, del.Parameters);
		}

		private static void AppendParentType(StringBuilder builder, IMemberElement member)
		{
			ITypeElement parentType = member.ParentType;
			if (parentType != null)
			{
				string fullName = parentType.FullName;
				builder.Append(fullName + ".");
			}
		}

		private static string BuildSignaturePart(string baseName, ITypeParameterCollection typeParameters, bool buildGenerics)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (typeParameters != null)
			{
				num = typeParameters.Count;
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			if (!buildGenerics)
			{
				return BuildSignaturePart(baseName, num);
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(baseName);
			stringBuilder.Append('<');
			if (typeParameters != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(typeParameters[i].Name);
					if (i < num - 1)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append('>');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string BuildSignaturePart(string baseName, int paramsCount)
		{
			if (paramsCount == 0)
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			return $"{baseName}{'`'}{paramsCount}";
		}

		private static string BuildSignaturePart(IMemberElement member, bool buildGenerics, ref string name, ref int nameIndex)
		{
			if (member == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			name = member.Name;
			nameIndex = 0;
			if (member is IMethodElement)
			{
				IMethodElement methodElement = (IMethodElement)member;
				if (methodElement.IsConstructor)
				{
					name = ".ctor";
				}
				else if (methodElement.IsDestructor)
				{
					name = "Finalize";
				}
			}
			string text = name;
			if (member.NameQualifier != null && member.NameQualifier is IReferenceExpression)
			{
				IReferenceExpression referenceExpression = (IReferenceExpression)member.NameQualifier;
				text = referenceExpression.FullSignature + "::" + name;
				nameIndex += referenceExpression.FullSignature.Length + "::".Length;
			}
			if (member is IGenericElement)
			{
				name = BuildSignaturePart(name, ((IGenericElement)member).TypeParameters, buildGenerics);
			}
			return name;
		}

		private static bool CanContainAccessor(IMemberElement member)
		{
			if (member == null || !(member is IEventElement))
			{
				return member is IPropertyElement;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsAccessor(IMethodElement method)
		{
			if (method != null)
			{
				if (method.ElementType != LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet && method.ElementType != LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet && method.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EventAdd && method.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EventRemove)
				{
					return method.ElementType == LanguageElementType.EventRaise;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetTypeSignature(ITypeElement type, bool buildGenerics, ref string name, ref int nameIndex)
		{
			if (type is IDelegateElement)
			{
				return GetDelegateSignature((IDelegateElement)type, buildGenerics, ref name, ref nameIndex);
			}
			return BuildSignaturePart(type, buildGenerics, ref name, ref nameIndex);
		}

		private static string GetDelegateSignature(IDelegateElement delegateElement, bool buildGenerics, ref string name, ref int nameIndex)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(BuildSignaturePart(delegateElement, buildGenerics, ref name, ref nameIndex));
			stringBuilder.Append(" : ");
			AppendType(stringBuilder, delegateElement);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string GetMethodSignature(IMethodElement method, bool buildGenerics, ref string name, ref int nameIndex)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(BuildSignaturePart(method, buildGenerics, ref name, ref nameIndex));
			stringBuilder.Append('(');
			AppendParameters(stringBuilder, method);
			stringBuilder.Append(')');
			if (!method.IsConstructor && !method.IsDestructor)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" : ");
				AppendType(stringBuilder, method);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string GetPropertySignature(IPropertyElement property, ref string name, ref int nameIndex)
		{
			name = property.Name;
			nameIndex = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(property.Name);
			if (!ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(property.Parameters))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append('[');
			}
			AppendParameters(stringBuilder, property.Parameters);
			if (!ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(property.Parameters))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(']');
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(" : ");
			AppendType(stringBuilder, property);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string GetEventSignature(IEventElement eventElement, ref string name, ref int nameIndex)
		{
			name = eventElement.Name;
			nameIndex = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append(eventElement.Name);
			stringBuilder.Append(" : ");
			AppendType(stringBuilder, eventElement);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public static string GetSignature(IMemberElement member)
		{
			string name;
			int nameIndex;
			return GetSignature(member, buildGenerics: false, out name, out nameIndex);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static string GetSignature(IMemberElement member, bool buildGenerics, out string name, out int nameIndex)
		{
			name = string.Empty;
			nameIndex = -1;
			if (member == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			name = member.Name;
			nameIndex = 0;
			if (member is ITypeElement)
			{
				return GetTypeSignature((ITypeElement)member, buildGenerics, ref name, ref nameIndex);
			}
			if (member is IMethodElement)
			{
				return GetMethodSignature((IMethodElement)member, buildGenerics, ref name, ref nameIndex);
			}
			if (member is IPropertyElement)
			{
				return GetPropertySignature((IPropertyElement)member, ref name, ref nameIndex);
			}
			if (member is IEventElement)
			{
				return GetEventSignature((IEventElement)member, ref name, ref nameIndex);
			}
			return member.Name;
		}

		internal static string GetSignatureForXmlDocumentation(IMemberElement member, bool buildGenerics, out string name, out int nameIndex)
		{
			name = string.Empty;
			nameIndex = -1;
			if (member == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			name = member.Name;
			nameIndex = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (member is IMethodElement)
			{
				IMethodElement methodElement = member as IMethodElement;
				stringBuilder.Append("M:");
				AppendParentType(stringBuilder, member);
				stringBuilder.Append(BuildSignaturePart(methodElement, buildGenerics, ref name, ref nameIndex));
				if (!ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(methodElement.Parameters))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('(');
					AppendParameters(stringBuilder, methodElement, addSpaceSplitter: false);
					stringBuilder.Append(')');
				}
			}
			else if (member is IPropertyElement)
			{
				IPropertyElement propertyElement = member as IPropertyElement;
				stringBuilder.Append("P:");
				AppendParentType(stringBuilder, member);
				stringBuilder.Append(propertyElement.Name);
				if (!ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(propertyElement.Parameters))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append('[');
				}
				AppendParameters(stringBuilder, propertyElement.Parameters, addSpaceSplitter: false);
				if (!ArrayIsNullOrEmpty(propertyElement.Parameters))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(']');
				}
			}
			else if (member is IFieldElement)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("F:");
				AppendParentType(stringBuilder, member);
				stringBuilder.Append(name);
			}
			else if (member is IEventElement)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("E:");
				AppendParentType(stringBuilder, member);
				stringBuilder.Append(name);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public static class SignatureBuilder
	{
		public static string GetSignature(IElement element)
		{
			string name;
			int nameIndex;
			return GetSignature(element, buildGenerics: false, out name, out nameIndex);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static string GetSignatureForXmlDocumentation(IMemberElement member)
		{
			if (member == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string name;
			int nameIndex;
			return MemberSignatureBuilder.GetSignatureForXmlDocumentation(member, buildGenerics: false, out name, out nameIndex);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static string GetSignature(IElement element, bool buildGenerics, out string name, out int nameIndex)
		{
			name = string.Empty;
			nameIndex = -1;
			if (element == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			name = element.Name;
			nameIndex = 0;
			if (element is IExpression)
			{
				return ExpressionSignatureBuilder.GetSignature((IExpression)element);
			}
			if (element is IMemberElement)
			{
				return MemberSignatureBuilder.GetSignature((IMemberElement)element, buildGenerics, out name, out nameIndex);
			}
			if (element is XmlNode)
			{
				return XmlSignatureBuilder.GetSignature((XmlNode)element);
			}
			if (element is BaseCssElement)
			{
				return XmlSignatureBuilder.GetSignature((BaseCssElement)element);
			}
			return element.Name;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class XmlSignatureBuilder
	{
		private const string STR_OpenTag = "<";

		private const string STR_CloseTag = ">";

		private const string STR_Comma = ",";

		private const string STR_Space = " ";

		private const string STR_Equal = "=";

		private XmlSignatureBuilder()
		{
		}

		private static void AppendArtibutes(StringBuilder builder, HtmlAttributeCollection attributes)
		{
			if (attributes == null || attributes.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = attributes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				string xmlAttributeSignature = GetXmlAttributeSignature(attributes[i]);
				builder.Append(xmlAttributeSignature);
				if (i < count - 1)
				{
					builder.Append(", ");
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetXmlNodeSignature(BaseXmlNode element)
		{
			return string.Format("{0}{1} {2}{3}", "<", element.ElementType, element.Name, ">");
		}

		private static string GetHtmlElementSignature(HtmlElement element)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			stringBuilder.Append("<");
			stringBuilder.Append(element.ElementType);
			stringBuilder.Append(" ");
			stringBuilder.Append(element.Name + " ");
			AppendArtibutes(stringBuilder, element.Attributes);
			stringBuilder.Append(">");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private static string GetXmlAttributeSignature(XmlAttribute element)
		{
			return string.Format("{0}{1}{2}", element.Name.ToLower(), "=", element.Value);
		}

		private static string GetXmlTextSignature(XmlText element)
		{
			return string.Format("{0}{1}{2}", "<", element.ElementType, ">");
		}

		private static string DefaultXmlSignature(XmlNode element)
		{
			return string.Format("{0}{1} {2}{3}", "<", element.ElementType, element.Name, ">");
		}

		public static string GetSignature(XmlNode element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (element is BaseXmlNode)
			{
				return GetXmlNodeSignature((BaseXmlNode)element);
			}
			if (element is HtmlElement)
			{
				return GetHtmlElementSignature((HtmlElement)element);
			}
			if (element is XmlAttribute)
			{
				return GetXmlAttributeSignature((XmlAttribute)element);
			}
			if (element is XmlText)
			{
				return GetXmlTextSignature((XmlText)element);
			}
			return DefaultXmlSignature(element);
		}

		public static string GetSignature(BaseCssElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return $"{element.ElementType} {element.Name}{element.Index}";
		}
	}

		public bool IsGenerated
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.FilePath))
				{
					return false;
				}
				string fileNameWithoutExtension = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(base.FilePath);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileNameWithoutExtension))
				{
					return fileNameWithoutExtension.EndsWith(".g.i");
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

					SetFileSizeAndLastWriteTime();
				}
				return _FileSize.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				_FileSize = value;
			}
		}

		public bool WasModifiedOnDisk
		{
			get
			{
				FileInfo fileInfo = new FileInfo(Name);
				try
				{
					if (LastWriteTime.ToString() == fileInfo.LastWriteTime.ToString() && FileSize == fileInfo.Length)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				catch
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsHeaderFile
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.FilePath))
				{
					return false;
				}
				string extension = Path.GetExtension(base.FilePath);
				if (extension != null)
				{
					return string.Compare(extension, ".h", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public SourceFile()
			: this(string.Empty)
