		}

		public SourceFile(string fileName)
		{
			InternalName = fileName;
			_TextStringCollection = new TextStringCollection();
			_AllXmlDocComments = new CommentCollection();
			_AllComments = new CommentCollection();
			_LoadBuildAction = SourceFileBuildAction.Compile;
			_SimpleDirectiveHolder = new RegionDirective();
			_MustCreateFullDirectiveRootNode = true;
			SetFilePath(fileName);
		}

		private void SetFileSizeAndLastWriteTime()
		{
			string internalName = InternalName;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(internalName))
			{
				return;
			}
			DateTime lastWriteTime = DateTime.MinValue;
			long fileSize = 0L;
			try
			{
				FileInfo fileInfo = new FileInfo(internalName);
				if (fileInfo.Exists)
				{
					lastWriteTime = fileInfo.LastWriteTime;
					fileSize = fileInfo.Length;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			FileSize = fileSize;
			LastWriteTime = lastWriteTime;
		}

		private StringCollection CloneStringCollection(StringCollection sourceCollection)
		{
			if (sourceCollection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			StringCollection stringCollection = new StringCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < sourceCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				stringCollection.Add(sourceCollection[i]);
			}
			return stringCollection;
		}

		private RegionDirective CalculateRegionRootNode()
		{
			RegionDirective regionDirective = new RegionDirective();
			RegionDirective simpleDirectiveHolder = SimpleDirectiveHolder;
			if (simpleDirectiveHolder == null || simpleDirectiveHolder.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return regionDirective;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = regionDirective;
			for (int i = 0; i < simpleDirectiveHolder.NodeCount; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement2 = simpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes[i] as LanguageElement;
				LanguageElement languageElement3 = languageElement2.Clone() as LanguageElement;
				switch (languageElement3.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.Region:
					languageElement.AddNode(languageElement3);
					languageElement = languageElement3;
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective:
				{
					SourcePoint end = languageElement3.Range.End;
					UpdateParentRanges(languageElement, regionDirective, end);
					UpdateParentEndTokenLength(languageElement, languageElement3.Range);
					if (languageElement != regionDirective)
					{
						languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (Document != null && Document.History != null)
			{
				regionDirective.SetHistory(Document.History.Branch());
			}
			regionDirective.SetParent(this);
			return regionDirective;
		}

		private FullIfDirective CalculateFullDirectiveRootNode()
		{
			_MustCreateFullDirectiveRootNode = false;
			_FullDirectiveRootNode = new FullIfDirective();
			FullDirective fullDirective = _FullDirectiveRootNode;
			bool flag = true;
			Stack<LastSimple> stack = new Stack<LastSimple>();
			foreach (PreprocessorDirective node in _SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes)
			{
				if (node == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				switch (node.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.IfDirective:
				{
					IfDirective ifDirective = node as IfDirective;
					if (!flag || ifDirective == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					FullIfDirective fullIfDirective2 = new FullIfDirective();
					fullIfDirective2.IfDirective = ifDirective;
					fullIfDirective2.Range = new SourceRange(ifDirective.Range.Start, SourcePoint.Empty);
					flag = ifDirective.ExpressionValue;
					stack.Push(LastSimple.IfOrRegion);
					fullIfDirective2.ParentFull = fullDirective;
					fullDirective.NestedFull.Add(fullIfDirective2);
					fullDirective = fullIfDirective2;
					break;
				}
				case LanguageElementType.ElifDirective:
				{
					FullIfDirective fullIfDirective3 = fullDirective as FullIfDirective;
					ElifDirective elifDirective = node as ElifDirective;
					if (fullIfDirective3 == null || elifDirective == null || stack.Count == 0 || stack.Pop() > LastSimple.Elif)
					{
						return null;
					}
					fullIfDirective3.ElifDirectives.Add(elifDirective);
					flag = elifDirective.ExpressionValue;
					stack.Push(LastSimple.Elif);
					break;
				}
				case LanguageElementType.ElseDirective:
				{
					FullIfDirective fullIfDirective = fullDirective as FullIfDirective;
					ElseDirective elseDirective = node as ElseDirective;
					if (fullIfDirective == null || elseDirective == null || stack.Count == 0 || stack.Pop() >= LastSimple.Else)
					{
						return null;
					}
					fullIfDirective.ElseDirective = elseDirective;
					flag = elseDirective.IsSatisfied;
					stack.Push(LastSimple.Else);
					break;
				}
				case LanguageElementType.EndifDirective:
				{
					FullIfDirective fullIfDirective4 = fullDirective as FullIfDirective;
					EndIfDirective endIfDirective = node as EndIfDirective;
					if (fullIfDirective4 == null || fullIfDirective4.ParentFull == null || endIfDirective == null || stack.Count == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					fullIfDirective4.EndifDirective = endIfDirective;
					fullIfDirective4.Range = new SourceRange(fullIfDirective4.Range.Start, endIfDirective.Range.End);
					fullDirective = fullIfDirective4.ParentFull;
					flag = true;
					stack.Pop();
					break;
				}
				case LanguageElementType.Region:
				{
					RegionDirective regionDirective = node as RegionDirective;
					if (!flag || regionDirective == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					FullRegionDirective fullRegionDirective2 = new FullRegionDirective();
					fullRegionDirective2.RegionDirective = regionDirective;
					fullRegionDirective2.Range = new SourceRange(regionDirective.Range.Start, SourcePoint.Empty);
					flag = true;
					stack.Push(LastSimple.IfOrRegion);
					fullRegionDirective2.ParentFull = fullDirective;
					fullDirective.NestedFull.Add(fullRegionDirective2);
					fullDirective = fullRegionDirective2;
					break;
				}
				case LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective:
				{
					FullRegionDirective fullRegionDirective = fullDirective as FullRegionDirective;
					EndRegionDirective endRegionDirective = node as EndRegionDirective;
					if (fullRegionDirective == null || fullRegionDirective.ParentFull == null || endRegionDirective == null || stack.Count == 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					fullRegionDirective.EndRegionDirective = endRegionDirective;
					fullRegionDirective.Range = new SourceRange(fullRegionDirective.Range.Start, endRegionDirective.Range.End);
					fullDirective = fullRegionDirective.ParentFull;
					flag = true;
					stack.Pop();
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (fullDirective != _FullDirectiveRootNode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _FullDirectiveRootNode;
		}

		private SourceFile DemandObjectData(DemandObjectManager manager)
		{
			if (manager != null)
			{
				return (SourceFile)manager.RequestObject(this);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private NodeList DemandNodes()
		{
			DemandObjectManager manager = _Manager;
			if (manager != null)
			{
				SourceFile sourceFile = DemandObjectData(manager);
				if (sourceFile == null)
				{
					return base.Nodes;
				}
				return sourceFile.Nodes;
			}
			return base.Nodes;
		}

		public SourceFile GetParsedFile(bool bindComments)
		{
			ParsingMode mode = ParsingMode.Simple;
			if (bindComments)
			{
				mode = ParsingMode.BindComments;
			}
			return GetParsedFile(mode);
		}

		public SourceFile GetParsedFile(ParsingMode mode)
		{
			if (!(_Manager is ISourceFileManager sourceFileManager))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return sourceFileManager.GetParsedFile(this, mode) as SourceFile;
		}

		private NameValueCollection CloneNameValueCollection(NameValueCollection source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			NameValueCollection nameValueCollection = new NameValueCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
			{
				string key = source.GetKey(i);
				string[] values = source.GetValues(i);
				if (values != null && values.Length != 0)
				{
					string value = values[0];
					nameValueCollection.Add(key, value);
				}
			}
			return nameValueCollection;
		}

		private Hashtable CloneHashtable(Hashtable source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = source.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object key = enumerator.Key;
				ICloneable cloneable = enumerator.Value as ICloneable;
				if (cloneable != null)
				{
					cloneable = cloneable.Clone() as ICloneable;
				}
				hashtable.Add(key, cloneable);
			}
			return hashtable;
		}

		private SortedList CloneSortedList(SortedList source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SortedList sortedList = new SortedList();
			IDictionaryEnumerator enumerator = source.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				object key = enumerator.Key;
				object value = enumerator.Value;
				sortedList.Add(key, value);
			}
			return sortedList;
		}

		private void SetParent(Hashtable aliasHash)
		{
			if (aliasHash == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in aliasHash)
			{
				if (item.Value is IElementModifier elementModifier)
				{
					elementModifier.SetParent(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private SourceFileBuildAction GetBuildAction()
		{
			return StructuralParserServicesHolder.StructuralParserServices.GetBuildAction(this);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (options != null)
			{
				options.SourceFile = this;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is SourceFile))
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceFile sourceFile = (SourceFile)source;
			_IsOpened = sourceFile._IsOpened;
			_SymbolsInvalidated = sourceFile._SymbolsInvalidated;
			_SymbolsInvalidating = sourceFile._SymbolsInvalidating;
			_OptionStrict = sourceFile._OptionStrict;
			_OptionInfer = sourceFile._OptionInfer;
			_OptionExplicit = sourceFile.OptionExplicit;
			_WasParsedWithNullProject = sourceFile._WasParsedWithNullProject;
			_CodeBehindFileName = sourceFile._CodeBehindFileName;
			if (sourceFile._CompilerDirectiveRootNode != null)
			{
				_CompilerDirectiveRootNode = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, sourceFile, sourceFile._CompilerDirectiveRootNode) as CompilerDirective;
				if (_CompilerDirectiveRootNode == null)
				{
					_CompilerDirectiveRootNode = sourceFile._CompilerDirectiveRootNode.Clone(options) as CompilerDirective;
				}
			}
			if (sourceFile._SimpleDirectiveHolder != null)
			{
				_SimpleDirectiveHolder = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, sourceFile, sourceFile._SimpleDirectiveHolder) as RegionDirective;
				if (_SimpleDirectiveHolder == null)
				{
					_SimpleDirectiveHolder = sourceFile._SimpleDirectiveHolder.Clone(options) as RegionDirective;
				}
			}
			NameValueCollection aliasList = sourceFile._AliasList;
			if (aliasList != null && aliasList.Count != 0)
			{
				_AliasList = CloneNameValueCollection(aliasList);
			}
			Hashtable aliasHash = sourceFile._AliasHash;
			if (aliasHash != null && aliasHash.Count != 0)
			{
				_AliasHash = CloneHashtable(aliasHash);
			}
			SortedList usingList = sourceFile._UsingList;
			if (usingList != null && usingList.Count != 0)
			{
				_UsingList = CloneSortedList(usingList);
			}
			SortedList includeDirectiveList = sourceFile._IncludeDirectiveList;
			if (includeDirectiveList != null && includeDirectiveList.Count != 0)
			{
				_IncludeDirectiveList = CloneSortedList(includeDirectiveList);
			}
			StringCollection includedScriptFiles = sourceFile._IncludedScriptFiles;
			if (includedScriptFiles != null && includedScriptFiles.Count != 0)
			{
				_IncludedScriptFiles = CloneStringCollection(includedScriptFiles);
			}
			StringCollection includedStyleSheetFiles = sourceFile._IncludedStyleSheetFiles;
			if (includedStyleSheetFiles != null && includedStyleSheetFiles.Count != 0)
			{
				_IncludedStyleSheetFiles = CloneStringCollection(includedStyleSheetFiles);
			}
			_MasterPageFile = sourceFile.MasterPageFile;
			_ModelTypeName = sourceFile._ModelTypeName;
			SortedList assemblyList = sourceFile._AssemblyList;
			if (assemblyList != null && assemblyList.Count != 0)
			{
				_AssemblyList = CloneSortedList(assemblyList);
			}
			CloneMacrosCalls(sourceFile.MacrosCalls);
			if (sourceFile._TextStringCollection != null)
			{
				_TextStringCollection = new TextStringCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(Nodes, sourceFile.Nodes, _TextStringCollection, sourceFile._TextStringCollection);
				if (_TextStringCollection.Count == 0 && sourceFile._TextStringCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					_TextStringCollection = sourceFile._TextStringCollection.DeepClone(options) as TextStringCollection;
				}
			}
			if ((_AllComments == null || _AllComments.Count == 0) && sourceFile._AllComments != null)
			{
				_AllComments = new CommentCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(Nodes, sourceFile.Nodes, _AllComments, sourceFile._AllComments);
				if (_AllComments.Count == 0 && sourceFile._AllComments.Count > 0)
				{
					_AllComments = sourceFile._AllComments.DeepClone(options) as CommentCollection;
				}
			}
			if ((_AllXmlDocComments == null || _AllXmlDocComments.Count == 0) && sourceFile._AllXmlDocComments != null)
			{
				_AllXmlDocComments = new CommentCollection();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(Nodes, sourceFile.Nodes, _AllXmlDocComments, sourceFile._AllXmlDocComments);
				if (_AllXmlDocComments.Count == 0 && sourceFile._AllXmlDocComments.Count > 0)
				{
					_AllXmlDocComments = sourceFile._AllXmlDocComments.DeepClone(options) as CommentCollection;
				}
			}
			if (sourceFile.DeclaredNamespacesCount > 0)
			{
				_DeclaredNamespaces = CloneStringCollection(sourceFile.DeclaredNamespaces);
			}
			if (sourceFile.FriendAssemblyNamesCount > 0)
			{
				_FriendAssemblyNamesList = CloneStringCollection(sourceFile._FriendAssemblyNamesList);
			}
		}

		protected override SourceRange GetTransformedRange(TextRange original)
		{
			if (History == null || original.IsEmpty)
			{
				return original.ToSourceRange();
			}
			TextPoint end = History.TransformWithRecover(original).End;
			return new SourceRange(1, 1, end.Line, end.Offset);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override void FillFormattingCollection(FormattingParsingElementCollection data)
		{
			base.Tokens = data.GetSourceFileTokens();
		}

		public virtual void LoadCache()
		{
			IProjectElement project = Project;
			if (project == null || SymbolsBuilt)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CachedProjectItem != null)
			{
				LoadBuildAction = CachedProjectItem.GetBuildAction();
				CachedProjectItem = null;
			}
			if ((IsOpened || HasUnparsedDocumentCode) && !NeedReload && !WasParsedWithNullProject)
			{
				InvalidateProjectSymbols();
				return;
			}
			StartThreadHandling();
			try
			{
				ClearProjectSymbols();
				BuildProjectSymbols();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndThreadHandling();
			}
		}

		public override void InvalidateRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (_AllXmlDocComments != null)
			{
				ParserUtils.RemoveNodesInRange(_AllXmlDocComments, range, useBinarySerach: true);
			}
			if (_AllComments != null)
			{
				ParserUtils.RemoveNodesInRange(_AllComments, range, useBinarySerach: true);
			}
			_TextStringCollection.RemoveElementsInRange(range);
			RemoveRegionsInRange(range);
			if (_CompilerDirectiveRootNode != null)
			{
				ParserUtils.RemoveNodesInRange(_CompilerDirectiveRootNode.Nodes, range, useBinarySerach: true);
			}
		}

		public virtual void BindAdditionalElementsToCode(IDisposableEditPointFactory textDoc)
		{
			if (_SimpleDirectiveHolder != null && _SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes != null)
			{
				foreach (LanguageElement node in _SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes)
				{
					node.SetHistory(History);
				}
			}
			if (_CompilerDirectiveRootNode == null || _CompilerDirectiveRootNode.Nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement node2 in _CompilerDirectiveRootNode.Nodes)
			{
				node2.SetHistory(History);
			}
		}

		public virtual void BindAdditionalElementsToCode(IDisposableEditPointFactory textDoc, SourceRange containingRange)
		{
			if (_SimpleDirectiveHolder != null && _SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes != null)
			{
				foreach (LanguageElement node in _SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes)
				{
					if (containingRange.Contains(node.Range))
					{
						node.SetHistory(History);
					}
				}
			}
			if (_CompilerDirectiveRootNode == null || _CompilerDirectiveRootNode.Nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement node2 in _CompilerDirectiveRootNode.Nodes)
			{
				if (containingRange.Contains(node2.Range))
				{
					node2.SetHistory(History);
				}
			}
		}

		public static SourceFile Parse(string code, string language)
		{
			if (code == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ParserBase parserFromLanguageID = StructuralParserServicesHolder.StructuralParserServices.GetParserFromLanguageID(language);
			if (parserFromLanguageID == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return parserFromLanguageID.ParseString(code) as SourceFile;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Open()
		{
			_IsOpened = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Close()
		{
			_IsOpened = false;
			if (HasManager)
			{
				_Manager.ReplaceObject(this, null);
			}
			SetDocument(null);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetName(string value)
		{
			object key = ((IDemandObjectProxy)this).Key;
			InternalName = value;
			if (value != null)
			{
				SetFilePath(value);
			}
			ClearFileName();
			if (HasManager)
			{
				_Manager.UpdateKey(key, ((IDemandObjectProxy)this).Key);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void InvalidateProjectSymbols()
		{
			IProjectElement project = Project;
			if (project != null && !SymbolsInvalidated)
			{
				project.InvalidateProjectSymbols(this);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void Invalidate()
		{
			IProjectElement project = Project;
			if (project != null && project.FindDiskFile(this) is SourceFile sourceFile)
			{
				project.SynchronizeDiskFile(sourceFile.Name, null);
				project.ReleaseDiskFile(sourceFile);
				sourceFile.InvalidateProjectSymbols();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual void BuildProjectSymbols()
		{
			Project?.BuildProjectSymbols(this);
		}

		private void ClearProjectSymbols()
		{
			Project?.ClearProjectSymbols(this);
		}

		private void CloneMacrosCalls(List<string> macrosCalls)
		{
			if (macrosCalls == null)
			{
				_MacrosCalls = null;
				return;
			}
			_MacrosCalls = new List<string>();
			_MacrosCalls.AddRange(macrosCalls);
		}

		private void RemoveMacrosCalls(List<string> macroCalls, string fileName)
		{
			if (macroCalls != null && macroCalls.Count != 0 && Project != null)
			{
				Project.RemoveFilePathsForMacroCalls(macroCalls, fileName);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveMacrosCalls()
		{
			RemoveMacrosCalls(MacrosCalls, Name);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Synchronize(SourceFile fileNode)
		{
			SetRange(fileNode.Range);
			_UsingList = fileNode._UsingList;
			_AliasList = fileNode._AliasList;
			_AliasHash = fileNode._AliasHash;
			_IncludeDirectiveList = fileNode._IncludeDirectiveList;
			_IncludedScriptFiles = fileNode._IncludedScriptFiles;
			_IncludedStyleSheetFiles = fileNode._IncludedStyleSheetFiles;
			_MasterPageFile = fileNode._MasterPageFile;
			_ModelTypeName = fileNode._ModelTypeName;
			WasParsedWithNullProject = fileNode.WasParsedWithNullProject;
			_FriendAssemblyNamesList = fileNode._FriendAssemblyNamesList;
			CloneMacrosCalls(fileNode.MacrosCalls);
			_RegionRootNode = null;
			_FullDirectiveRootNode = null;
			MacroRanges.Clear();
			MacroInfoCollection macroRanges = fileNode.MacroRanges;
			if (macroRanges != null && macroRanges.Count > 0)
			{
				MacroRanges.AddRange(macroRanges);
			}
			HasUnparsedDocumentCode = fileNode.HasUnparsedDocumentCode;
			AspPageLanguage = fileNode.AspPageLanguage;
			AspPageBaseType = fileNode.AspPageBaseType;
			CodeBehindFileName = fileNode.CodeBehindFileName;
			OptionStrict = fileNode.OptionStrict;
			OptionInfer = fileNode.OptionInfer;
			OptionExplicit = fileNode.OptionExplicit;
			fileNode.IsLink = IsLink;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public SourceFile GetSourceFileProxy()
		{
			IProjectElement project = Project;
			if (project == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return project.FindDiskFile(this) as SourceFile;
		}

		public override MemberVisibility[] GetValidVisibilities()
		{
			return new MemberVisibility[2]
			{
				MemberVisibility.Public,
				MemberVisibility.Internal
			};
		}

		public void AddComment(Comment comment)
		{
			AddComment(comment, useSorting: false);
		}

		public void AddComment(Comment comment, bool useSorting)
		{
			if (comment == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (useSorting)
			{
				SourcePoint start = comment.Range.Start;
				int nodeIndexAfter = GetNodeIndexAfter(InnerAllComments, start.Line, start.Offset);
				if (nodeIndexAfter < 0)
				{
					InnerAllComments.Add(comment);
				}
				else
				{
					InnerAllComments.Insert(nodeIndexAfter, comment);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InnerAllComments.Add(comment);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveComment(Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment != null)
			{
				InnerAllComments.Remove(comment);
			}
		}

		public void AddXmlDocComment(XmlDocComment xmlDoc)
		{
			if (xmlDoc != null)
			{
				InnerAllXmlDocComments.Add(xmlDoc);
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			SourceFile sourceFile = new SourceFile();
			sourceFile.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return sourceFile;
		}

		public Expression GetAlias(string name)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Hashtable aliasHash = AliasHash;
			if (aliasHash == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = aliasHash[name];
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return obj as Expression;
		}

		public T GetData<T>(string key)
		{
			if (!HasData(key))
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			return (T)_Data[key];
		}

		public void SetData<T>(string key, T data)
		{
			if (_Data == null)
			{
				_Data = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			}
			_Data[key] = data;
		}

		public bool HasData(string key)
		{
			if (_Data != null)
			{
				return _Data.ContainsKey(key);
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		private void UpdateParentRanges(LanguageElement currentRootNode, RegionDirective resultNode, SourcePoint endPoint)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = currentRootNode;
			while (languageElement != null && languageElement != resultNode)
			{
				languageElement.SetRange(new SourceRange(languageElement.Range.Start, endPoint));
				languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateParentEndTokenLength(LanguageElement currentRootNode, SourceRange endRange)
		{
			if (currentRootNode is RegionDirective regionDirective && !endRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				int offset = endRange.Start.Offset;
				int offset2 = endRange.End.Offset;
				regionDirective.SetEndTokenLength(offset2 - offset);
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateSimples(SourceRange range, LanguageElementCollection trailingSimples)
		{
			if (ParserUtils.GetBounds(SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes, range, out var left, out var right) || left != -1)
			{
				int nodeCount = SimpleDirectiveHolder.NodeCount;
				for (int i = right + 1; i < nodeCount; i++)
				{
					trailingSimples.Add(SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes[i]);
				}
				SimpleDirectiveHolder.RemoveNodesFromIndex(left);
			}
		}

		internal void RestoreTrailingRegions(LanguageElementCollection trailingRegions)
		{
			if (trailingRegions != null)
			{
				int count = trailingRegions.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					AddRegionDirective(trailingRegions[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetRegionDirectiveHolderParent(LanguageElement parent)
		{
			SimpleDirectiveHolder.SetParent(parent);
		}

		public void AddRegionDirective(RegionDirective regionDirective)
		{
			AddSimpleDirective(regionDirective);
		}

		public void AddEndRegionDirective(EndRegionDirective endRegionDirective)
		{
			AddSimpleDirective(endRegionDirective);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddRegionDirective(LanguageElement region)
		{
			AddSimpleDirective(region as PreprocessorDirective);
		}

		public void AddDirective(PreprocessorDirective directive)
		{
			if (directive != null)
			{
				LanguageElementType elementType = directive.ElementType;
				if (elementType != LanguageElementType.Region && elementType != LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective)
				{
					CompilerDirectiveRootNode.AddNode(directive);
				}
				AddSimpleDirective(directive, inEach: false);
			}
		}

		public void AddSimpleDirective(PreprocessorDirective directive)
		{
			AddSimpleDirective(directive, inEach: true);
		}

		public void AddSimpleDirective(PreprocessorDirective directive, bool inEach)
		{
			if (directive == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = directive.ElementType;
			bool flag = elementType == LanguageElementType.Region || elementType == LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective;
			if (flag || elementType == LanguageElementType.IfDirective || elementType == LanguageElementType.ElifDirective || elementType == LanguageElementType.ElseDirective || elementType == LanguageElementType.EndifDirective)
			{
				_MustCreateFullDirectiveRootNode = true;
				SimpleDirectiveHolder.AddNode(directive);
				if (flag)
				{
					_RegionRootNode = null;
				}
				else if (inEach)
				{
					CompilerDirectiveRootNode.AddNode(directive);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveRegionDirective(LanguageElement region)
		{
			if (region != null)
			{
				_RegionRootNode = null;
				_FullDirectiveRootNode = null;
				SimpleDirectiveHolder.RemoveNode(region);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveRegionDirectives(IList<LanguageElement> regions)
		{
			if (regions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement region in regions)
			{
				RemoveRegionDirective(region);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveRegionsInRange(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (_SimpleDirectiveHolder == null)
			{
				_SimpleDirectiveHolder = new RegionDirective();
			}
			if (ParserUtils.GetBounds(_SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes, range, out var left, out var right))
			{
				_RegionRootNode = null;
				_FullDirectiveRootNode = null;
				_SimpleDirectiveHolder.RemoveNodesBetweenIndexes(left, right);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveRegionDirectivesFrom(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				_RegionRootNode = null;
				_FullDirectiveRootNode = null;
				SimpleDirectiveHolder.RemoveNodesFromIndex(index);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveCorruptedRegions(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (!ParserUtils.GetBounds(SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes, range, out var left, out var right))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = left; i <= right; i++)
			{
				if (SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement && ParserUtils.RangeIsCorrupted(languageElement.Range))
				{
					SimpleDirectiveHolder.Nodes.Remove(languageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetHistoryForRegions(DocumentHistorySlice history)
		{
			if (history != null && SimpleDirectiveHolder != null)
			{
				SimpleDirectiveHolder.SetHistory(history);
			}
		}
	}

	public class SourceTreeEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private IElementFilter _Filter;

		private LanguageElement _StartNodeParent;

		private LanguageElement _StartNode;

		private LanguageElement _StopNode;

		private LanguageElement _CurrentNode;

		private bool _IsInStart;

		private bool _SkipScope;

		private Hashtable _IteratedNodes;

		private Hashtable IteratedNodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (_IteratedNodes == null)
				{
					_IteratedNodes = new Hashtable();
				}
				return _IteratedNodes;
			}
		}

		private bool HasFilter => _Filter != null;

		private IElementFilter Filter => _Filter;

		public object Current => _CurrentNode;

		public bool SkipScope
		{
			get
			{
				return _SkipScope;
			}
			set
			{
				_SkipScope = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceTreeEnumerator(LanguageElement start)
			: this(start, null)
		{
		}

		public SourceTreeEnumerator(LanguageElement start, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			if (start == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("start");
			}
			_Filter = filter;
			_IsInStart = true;
			_SkipScope = false;
			_StartNode = start;
			_StopNode = DefineStopNode(start);
			_StartNodeParent = _StartNode.Parent;
			_CurrentNode = null;
		}

		public SourceTreeEnumerator(LanguageElement scope, LanguageElement start, IElementFilter filter)
		{
			if (scope == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("scope");
			}
			if (start == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("start");
			}
			_Filter = filter;
			_IsInStart = true;
			_SkipScope = false;
			_StartNode = start;
			_StopNode = DefineStopNode(scope);
			_StartNodeParent = scope.Parent;
			_CurrentNode = null;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetLastChild(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (node.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return node.LastDetail;
			}
			return node.LastChild;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetDeepestChild(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetLastChild(node);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				LanguageElement lastChild = GetLastChild(languageElement);
				if (lastChild == null || lastChild == languageElement)
				{
					break;
				}
				languageElement = lastChild;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private LanguageElement DefineStopNode(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = GetDeepestChild(node);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = node;
			}
			return languageElement.NextNode;
		}

		private bool IsIterationCompleted(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node != null && node != _StopNode)
			{
				return _StartNodeParent == node.Parent;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ApplyFilter(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (_Filter != null)
			{
				return _Filter.Apply(node);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetFirstChild(LanguageElement node)
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = node.FirstDetail;
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = node.FirstChild;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetStartNode(LanguageElement node, bool skipStart)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = node;
			if (skipStart)
			{
				languageElement = GetFirstChild(node);
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			do
			{
				if (ApplyFilter(languageElement))
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
				languageElement = languageElement.NextNode;
			}
			while (!IsIterationCompleted(languageElement));
			return null;
		}

		private bool GetNextNode(ref LanguageElement node)
		{
			bool nextNodeInternal = GetNextNodeInternal(ref node);
			if (IteratedNodes.ContainsKey(node))
			{
				_IteratedNodes = null;
				return false;
			}
			IteratedNodes.Add(node, node);
			return nextNodeInternal;
		}

		private bool GetNextNodeInternal(ref LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			languageElement = node.FirstDetail;
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				node = languageElement;
				return true;
			}
			languageElement = node.FirstChild;
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				node = languageElement;
				return true;
			}
			languageElement = node.NextSibling;
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				node = languageElement;
				return !IsIterationCompleted(node);
			}
			LanguageElement parent = node.Parent;
			if (node.IsDetailNode && parent != null)
			{
				languageElement = parent.FirstChild;
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					node = languageElement;
					return !IsIterationCompleted(node);
				}
			}
			parent = node;
			do
			{
				parent = parent.Parent;
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (parent == _StartNodeParent)
				{
					return false;
				}
				languageElement = parent.NextSibling;
				if (languageElement == null && parent.IsDetailNode && parent.Parent != null)
				{
					languageElement = parent.Parent.FirstChild;
				}
			}
			while (languageElement == null);
			node = languageElement;
			return !IsIterationCompleted(node);
		}

		private bool GetNextFilteredNode(ref LanguageElement node)
		{
			LanguageElement node2 = node;
			while (GetNextNode(ref node2))
			{
				if (ApplyFilter(node2))
				{
					node = node2;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_IsInStart = true;
			_CurrentNode = null;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (_IsInStart)
			{
				_CurrentNode = GetStartNode(_StartNode, _SkipScope);
				_IsInStart = false;
				return _CurrentNode != null;
			}
			return GetNextFilteredNode(ref _CurrentNode);
		}
	}
	public abstract class Tokenizer
	{
		internal Tokenizer()
		{
		}

		public virtual TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (!(token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}
			return categorizedToken.Category;
		}

		public virtual string GetTokenCategory(Token token, ParserVersion version)
		{
			if (!(token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return categorizedToken.GetTokenCategory();
		}

		public abstract IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embeddingDefaultLanguage);

		public IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage)
		{
			return GetTokens(code, EmbededLanguageKind.Asp, codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage);
		}

		public IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code)
		{
			return GetTokens(code, EmbededLanguageKind.Asp, DotNetLanguageType.CSharp);
		}

		public string GetTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			return GetTokenCategory(token, ParserVersion.VS2014);
		}
	}

	public class VisualStudioDocument : PathElement
	{
		private string _FileNameOnly;

		private IDocument _Document;

		private IProjectElement _Project;

		private string _Kind;

		public override IDocument Document => _Document;

		public override IProjectElement Project
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Project == null && Document != null)
				{
					_Project = Document.ProjectElement;
				}
				return _Project;
			}
		}

		public string Kind => _Kind;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.VisualStudioDocument;

		public override bool IsNewContext => true;

		public VisualStudioDocument()
		{
			SetStart(1, 1);
			_Kind = string.Empty;
		}

		public VisualStudioDocument(string kind, string name)
		{
			SetStart(1, 1);
			_Kind = kind;
			InternalName = name;
		}

		protected void ClearFileName()
		{
			_FileNameOnly = null;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is VisualStudioDocument)
				{
					VisualStudioDocument visualStudioDocument = (VisualStudioDocument)source;
					_Document = visualStudioDocument.Document;
					_FileNameOnly = visualStudioDocument._FileNameOnly;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetProject(IProjectElement project)
		{
			_Project = project;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 20;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (_FileNameOnly == null || _FileNameOnly == string.Empty)
			{
				_FileNameOnly = Path.GetFileName(InternalName);
			}
			return _FileNameOnly;
		}

		public void SetDocument(IDocument aDocument)
		{
			_Document = aDocument;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AssignProject(IProjectElement project)
		{
			_Project = project;
		}

		public virtual void InvalidateRange(SourceRange range)
		{
		}

		public virtual void RangedParseComplete(SourceRange range, LanguageElement context)
		{
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			VisualStudioDocument visualStudioDocument = new VisualStudioDocument();
			visualStudioDocument.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return visualStudioDocument;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.CodeParser.Xml
{
	public class HtmlCodeGen
	{
	}
	public class HtmlXmlCodeGen : CodeGen
	{
		public HtmlXmlCodeGen()
		{
			if (Options != null)
			{
				Options.IndentString = "\t";
			}
		}

		public HtmlXmlCodeGen(CodeGenOptions options)
			: base(options)
		{
		}

		protected override HtmlXmlCodeGenBase CreateHtmlXmlGen()
		{
			return new HtmlXmlNodesCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override TemplateParameterCodeGenBase CreateTemplateParameterGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override TemplateCodeGenBase CreateTemplateGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override DirectiveCodeGenBase CreateDirectiveGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override ExpressionCodeGenBase CreateExpressionGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override MemberCodeGenBase CreateMemberGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override StatementCodeGenBase CreateStatementGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override SupportElementCodeGenBase CreateSupportElementGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase CreateTypeDeclarationGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override XmlCodeGenBase CreateXmlGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override NamespaceReferenceGenBase CreateNamespaceReferenceGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override NamespaceGenBase CreateNamespaceGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override SnippetCodeGenBase CreateSnippetGen()
		{
			return new HtmlXmlSnippetCodeGen(this);
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (element is XmlNode || element is Comment || element is BaseCssElement)
				{
					base.HtmlXmlCodeGen.GenerateElement(element);
				}
				else if (element is ISnippetCodeElement)
				{
					base.SnippetGen.GenerateElement(element);
				}
				else if (element is ElementList)
				{
					GenerateXmlElementList(element as ElementList);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateNodes(element.Nodes);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateNodes(ICollection nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = nodes.Count;
			if (count > 0)
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = nodes.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = enumerator.Current as LanguageElement;
					GenerateElement(languageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateXmlElementList(ElementList list)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = list.Nodes.Count;
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (list.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement2 && (languageElement2 is XmlNode || languageElement2 is Comment || languageElement2 is BaseCssElement || languageElement2 is ISnippetCodeElement))
				{
					GenerateElement(languageElement2);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateMemberVisibilitySpecifier(MemberVisibilitySpecifier specifier)
		{
		}
	}
	public class HtmlXmlNodesCodeGen : HtmlXmlCodeGenBase
	{
		public HtmlXmlNodesCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement languageElement)
		{
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (languageElement is Comment)
			{
				GenerateHtmlXmlComment(languageElement as Comment);
				return;
			}
			if (languageElement is ISnippetCodeElement)
			{
				CodeGen.SnippetGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			}
			else if (GenerateHtmlXmlNode(languageElement as XmlNode))
			{
				return;
			}
			GenerateCssNode(languageElement as BaseCssElement);
		}

		protected override bool GenerateHtmlXmlNode(XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GenerateHtmlNodes(xmlNode))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return GenerateXmlNodes(xmlNode);
		}

		public void GenerateHtmlXmlComment(Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment != null)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine(comment.Name);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateRazorModelDirective(RazorModelDirective modelDirective)
		{
			base.Code.WriteLine("@model {0}", modelDirective.Model);
		}

		private void GenerateRazorSection(RazorSection razorSection)
		{
			base.Code.WriteLine("@section {0}", razorSection.Name);
			if (razorSection.DotNetLanguageType == DotNetLanguageType.CSharp)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine("{");
			}
			base.Code.WriteLine(razorSection.Code);
			if (razorSection.DotNetLanguageType == DotNetLanguageType.CSharp)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine("}");
			}
			else if (razorSection.DotNetLanguageType == DotNetLanguageType.VisualBasic)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine("End Section");
			}
		}

		protected bool GenerateCssNode(BaseCssElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (element.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.CssStyleSheet:
				GenerateCssStyleSheet(element as CssStyleSheet);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssStyleRule:
				GenerateCssStyleRule(element as CssStyleRule);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssPropertyDeclaration:
				GenerateCssPropertyDeclaration(element as CssPropertyDeclaration);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssSelector:
				GenerateCssSelector(element as CssSelector);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssAttribute:
				GenerateCssAttributeSelector(element as CssAttributeSelector);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssPseudoId:
				GenerateCssPseudoSelector(element as CssPseudoSelector);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssPseudoFunction:
				GenerateCssPseudoFunctionSelector(element as CssPseudoFunctionSelector);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssIdentifierReference:
				GenerateCssIdentifierReference(element as CssIdentifierReference);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssFunctionReference:
				GenerateCssFunctionReference(element as CssFunctionReference);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssStringLiteral:
				GenerateCssStringLiteral(element as CssStringLiteral);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssURI:
				GenerateCssURIReference(element as CssURIReference);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssColorReference:
				GenerateCssColorReference(element as CssColorReference);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssNumberLiteral:
				GenerateCssNumberLiteral(element as CssNumberLiteral);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssLengthLiteral:
				GenerateCssLengthLiteral(element as CssLengthLiteral);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssPercentLiteral:
				GenerateCssPercentLiteral(element as CssPercentLiteral);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssTimeLiteral:
				GenerateCssTimeLiteral(element as CssTimeLiteral);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssAngleLiteral:
				GenerateCssAngleLiteral(element as CssAngleLiteral);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssFrequencyLiteral:
				GenerateCssFrequencyLiteral(element as CssFrequencyLiteral);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssCharsetDeclaration:
				GenerateCssCharsetDeclaration(element as CssCharsetDeclaration);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssImportDirective:
				GenerateCssImportDirective(element as CssImportDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssMediaDirective:
				GenerateCssMediaDirective(element as CssMediaDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssPageStyleDefinition:
				GenerateCssPageStyle(element as CssPageStyle);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CssCommentTag:
				GenerateCssCommentTag(element as CssCommentTag);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssStyleSheet(CssStyleSheet element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateDescendantList(element.Nodes, "");
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssStyleRule(CssStyleRule element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateDescendantList(element.Selectors, ", ", writeFirstDelimiter: false, writeDelimiterAfterElements: true, writeLastDelimiter: false, addNewLine: false);
				base.Code.WriteLine();
				base.Code.WriteLine("{");
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				GenerateDescendantList(element.Properties, ";", writeFirstDelimiter: false, writeDelimiterAfterElements: true);
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				base.Code.WriteLine("}");
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssPropertyDeclaration(CssPropertyDeclaration element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (element.Name != null && element.Name != string.Empty)
				{
					base.Code.Write(element.Name);
				}
				if (element.IsEqual)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" = ");
				}
				else
				{
					base.Code.Write(": ");
				}
				GenerateCssTermCollection(element.Values);
				if (element.IsImportant)
				{
					base.Code.Write("!important");
				}
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssSelector(CssSelector element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				WriteCssSelector(element);
			}
		}

		private void WriteCssSelector(CssSelector element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			do
			{
				if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CssAttribute && element is CssAttributeSelector)
				{
					WriteCssAttributeSelector(element as CssAttributeSelector);
				}
				else if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CssPseudoId && element is CssPseudoSelector)
				{
					WriteCssPseudoSelector(element as CssPseudoSelector);
				}
				else if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CssPseudoFunction && element is CssPseudoFunctionSelector)
				{
					WriteCssPseudoFunctionSelector(element as CssPseudoFunctionSelector);
				}
				else if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CssSelector)
				{
					GenerateSelectorType(element.SelectorType, element.Name, flag);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (element.Nodes != null && element.NodeCount != 0)
				{
					element = element.ChildSelector;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
			while (element != null);
		}

		private void GenerateSelectorType(CssSelectorType type, string name, bool isFirst)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty = type switch
			{
				CssSelectorType.CombinedSibling => "+", 
				CssSelectorType.CombinedChild => ">", 
				CssSelectorType.Class => AddString(".", name), 
				CssSelectorType.Hash => AddString("#", name), 
				CssSelectorType.Name => (!isFirst) ? AddString(" ", name) : name, 
				_ => name, 
			};
			if (empty != null && empty != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(empty);
			}
		}

		private string AddString(string str, string addStr)
		{
			if (str == null || str.Length == 0 || addStr == null || addStr.Length == 0)
			{
				return str;
			}
			return str + addStr;
		}

		public void GenerateCssAttributeSelector(CssAttributeSelector element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				WriteCssSelector(element);
			}
		}

		private void WriteCssAttributeSelector(CssAttributeSelector element)
		{
			base.Code.Write("[ {0}", element.Name);
			GenerateCssAttrValue(element);
			base.Code.WriteLine("]");
		}

		private void GenerateCssAttrValue(CssAttributeSelector element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				switch (element.EqualityType)
				{
				case AttributeSelectorEqualityType.ExactMatch:
					text = "=";
					break;
				case AttributeSelectorEqualityType.SpaceSeparatedMatch:
					text = "~=";
					break;
				case AttributeSelectorEqualityType.HyphenSeparatedMatch:
					text = "|=";
					break;
				}
				if (element.Value != null)
				{
					text += element.Value;
				}
				if (text != string.Empty)
				{
					base.Code.Write(text);
				}
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssPseudoSelector(CssPseudoSelector element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				WriteCssSelector(element);
			}
		}

		private void WriteCssPseudoSelector(CssPseudoSelector element)
		{
			base.Code.Write(": {0}", element.Name);
		}

		public void GenerateCssPseudoFunctionSelector(CssPseudoFunctionSelector element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				WriteCssSelector(element);
			}
		}

		private void WriteCssPseudoFunctionSelector(CssPseudoFunctionSelector element)
		{
			base.Code.Write(": {0} ({1})", element.Name, element.Param);
		}

		public void GenerateCssIdentifierReference(CssIdentifierReference element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateTermElement(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssFunctionReference(CssFunctionReference element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateTermElement(element);
				base.Code.Write("(");
				GenerateCssTermCollection(element.Parameters);
				base.Code.Write(")");
			}
		}

		private void GenerateCssTermCollection(CssTermCollection coll)
		{
			if (coll != null && coll.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < coll.Count; i++)
				{
					GenerateElement(coll[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssStringLiteral(CssStringLiteral element)
		{
			if (element != null && element.Value != null && element.Value != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(element.Value);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssURIReference(CssURIReference element)
		{
			if (element != null && element.URI != null && element.URI != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(element.URI);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssColorReference(CssColorReference element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateTermElement(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssNumberLiteral(CssNumberLiteral element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateNumberLiteralBase(element);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateTermElement(CssTerm element)
		{
			GenerateTermElement(element, addNewLine: false);
		}

		private void GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(CssMeasuredNumber element)
		{
			GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(element, addNewLine: false);
		}

		private void GenerateNumberLiteralBase(CssNumberLiteral element)
		{
			GenerateNumberLiteralBase(element, addNewLine: false);
		}

		private void GenerateNumberLiteralBase(CssNumberLiteral element, bool addNewLine)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateTermDelimiter(element);
				GeneratePrecedingSign(element.Sign);
				if (element.Value != null)
				{
					GenerateCssValue(element);
				}
				if (addNewLine)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(CssMeasuredNumber element, bool addNewLine)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateNumberLiteralBase(element, addNewLine: false);
				GenerateCssMeasureUnit(element.Unit);
				if (addNewLine)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateTermElement(CssTerm element, bool addNewLine)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateTermDelimiter(element);
				GeneratePrecedingSign(element.Sign);
				if (element.Name != null && element.Name != string.Empty)
				{
					base.Code.Write(element.Name);
				}
				if (addNewLine)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateCssValue(object element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				empty = ((!(element is string)) ? element.ToString() : (element as string));
				if (empty != null && empty != string.Empty)
				{
					base.Code.Write(empty);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateCssMeasureUnit(CssMeasureUnit unit)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (unit)
			{
			case CssMeasureUnit.Percent:
				text = "%";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Grad:
				text = "grad";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Rad:
				text = "rad";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Deg:
				text = "deg";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.kHz:
				text = "khz";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Hz:
				text = "hz";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Px:
				text = "px";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Cm:
				text = "cm";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Mm:
				text = "mm";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.In:
				text = "in";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Pt:
				text = "pt";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Pc:
				text = "pc";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Em:
				text = "em";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Ex:
				text = "ex";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.Ms:
				text = "ms";
				break;
			case CssMeasureUnit.S:
				text = "s";
				break;
			}
			if (text != null && text != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(text);
			}
		}

		private void GeneratePrecedingSign(PrecedingSign sign)
		{
			string s = string.Empty;
			switch (sign)
			{
			case PrecedingSign.Minus:
				s = "-";
				break;
			case PrecedingSign.Plus:
				s = "+";
				break;
			}
			base.Code.Write(s);
		}

		public void GenerateCssLengthLiteral(CssLengthLiteral element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssPercentLiteral(CssPercentLiteral element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(element);
			}
		}
