		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssAngleLiteral(CssAngleLiteral element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssFrequencyLiteral(CssFrequencyLiteral element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateCssMeasuredNumber(element);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateTermDelimiter(CssTerm element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				WriteTermDelimiter(element.Delimiter);
			}
		}

		private void WriteTermDelimiter(ExpressionDelimiter element)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (element)
			{
			case ExpressionDelimiter.Whitespace:
				text = " ";
				break;
			case ExpressionDelimiter.Comma:
				text = ", ";
				break;
			case ExpressionDelimiter.Slash:
				text = "/";
				break;
			case ExpressionDelimiter.Equals:
				text = "=";
				break;
			}
			if (text != null && text != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(text);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssCharsetDeclaration(CssCharsetDeclaration element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine("@charset {0};", element.Charset);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssImportDirective(CssImportDirective element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write("@import {0}", element.Source);
				GenerateStringCollection(element.SupportedMediaTypes, ", ");
				base.Code.WriteLine(";");
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssMediaDirective(CssMediaDirective element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateStringCollection(element.MediaTypes, ", ");
				base.Code.WriteLine("@media\n{");
				GenerateDescendantList(element.DetailNodes);
				base.Code.WriteLine("}");
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssCommentTag(CssCommentTag element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				string s = string.Empty;
				if (element.Kind == CommentTagKind.Open)
				{
					s = "<!--";
				}
				else if (element.Kind == CommentTagKind.Close)
				{
					s = "-->";
				}
				base.Code.Write(s);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateCssPageStyle(CssPageStyle element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write("@page");
				if (element.Name != null && element.Name != string.Empty)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine(": {0} ", element.Name);
				}
				base.Code.WriteLine("{");
				GenerateDescendantList(element.Properties, ", ");
				base.Code.WriteLine("}");
			}
		}

		private bool GenerateHtmlNodes(XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (xmlNode.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.HtmlAttribute:
				GenerateHtmlAttribute(xmlNode as HtmlAttribute);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.HtmlElement:
				GenerateHtmlElement(xmlNode as HtmlElement);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.HtmlScript:
				GenerateHtmlScript(xmlNode as HtmlScriptDefinition);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.HtmlStyle:
				GenerateHtmlStyle(xmlNode as HtmlStyleDefinition);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.HtmlText:
				GenerateHtmlText(xmlNode as HtmlText);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.RazorModelDirective:
				GenerateRazorModelDirective(xmlNode as RazorModelDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AspCodeEmbedding:
				GenerateAspCodeEmbedding(xmlNode as AspCodeEmbedding);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AspDirective:
				GenerateAspDirective(xmlNode as AspDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.RegisterDirective:
				GenerateRegisterDirective(xmlNode as RegisterDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.PageDirective:
				GeneratePageDirective(xmlNode as PageDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AspImportDirective:
				GenerateAspDirective(xmlNode as AspDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.MasterDirective:
				GenerateAspDirective(xmlNode as AspDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ControlDirective:
				GenerateAspDirective(xmlNode as AspDirective);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ServerControlElement:
				GenerateServerControlElement(xmlNode as ServerControlElement);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ContentPlaceHolder:
				GenerateHtmlElement(xmlNode as HtmlElement);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.RazorSectionElement:
				GenerateRazorSection(xmlNode as RazorSection);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool GenerateXmlNodes(XmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (xmlNode is BaseXmlNode)
			{
				GenerateBaseXmlNodes(xmlNode as BaseXmlNode);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GenerateBaseXmlNodes(BaseXmlNode xmlNode)
		{
			if (xmlNode == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (xmlNode.XmlNodeType)
			{
			case XmlNodeType.AnyContentSpec:
				GenerateXmlAnyContentSpec(xmlNode as XmlAnyContentSpec);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.AttributeDecl:
				GenerateXmlAttributeDecl(xmlNode as XmlAttributeDeclaration);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.AttributeListDecl:
				GenerateXmlAttributeListDecl(xmlNode as XmlAttributeListDeclaration);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.CharacterData:
				GenerateXmlCharacterData(xmlNode as XmlCharacterData);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.CharReference:
				GenerateXmlCharReference(xmlNode as XmlCharReference);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.ChildrenContentSpec:
				GenerateXmlChildrenContentSpec(xmlNode as XmlChildrenContentSpec);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.CPChoice:
				GenerateXmlCPChoice(xmlNode as XmlChoiceContentParticle);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.CPSequence:
				GenerateXmlCPSequence(xmlNode as XmlSequenceContentParticle);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.Decl:
				GenerateXmlDecl(xmlNode as XmlDecl);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.DocTypeDecl:
				GenerateXmlDocTypeDecl(xmlNode as XmlDocTypeDecl);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.ElementDecl:
				GenerateXmlElementDecl(xmlNode as XmlElementDecl);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.EmptyContentSpec:
				GenerateXmlEmptyContentSpec(xmlNode as XmlEmptyContentSpec);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.EntityDecl:
				GenerateXmlEntityDecl(xmlNode as XmlEntityDecl);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.ExternalPublicID:
				GenerateXmlExternalPublicID(xmlNode as NewExternalIDPublicLink);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.ExternalSystemID:
				GenerateXmlExternalSystemID(xmlNode as NewExternalIDSystemLink);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.MixedContentSpec:
				GenerateXmlMixedContentSpec(xmlNode as XmlMixedContentSpec);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.Name:
				GenerateXmlName(xmlNode as XmlName);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.NamedCP:
				GenerateXmlNamedCP(xmlNode as XmlNamedContentParticle);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.NameReference:
				GenerateXmlNameReference(xmlNode as XmlNameReference);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.NotationDecl:
				GenerateXmlNotationDecl(xmlNode as XmlNotationDecl);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.ProcessingInstruction:
				GenerateXmlProcessingInstruction(xmlNode as XmlProcessingInstruction);
				return true;
			case XmlNodeType.Reference:
				GenerateXmlReference(xmlNode as XmlReference);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void GenerateHtmlAttribute(HtmlAttribute atr)
		{
			string attributeDelimiters = GetAttributeDelimiters(atr);
			string text = atr.Value;
			if (atr.DetailNodeCount > 0 && atr.DetailNodes[0] is MarkupExtensionExpression)
			{
				text = GenerateMarkupExtensionExpression((MarkupExtensionExpression)atr.DetailNodes[0]);
			}
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			string text3 = string.Empty;
			if (atr.ValueIsAspCodeEmbedding)
			{
				text2 = "<%";
				text3 = "%>";
			}
			base.Code.Write(" {0}={3}{2}{1}{2}{4}", atr.Name, text, attributeDelimiters, text2, text3);
		}

		public string GenerateMarkupExtensionExpression(MarkupExtensionExpression expression)
		{
			CSharpCodeGen cSharpCodeGen = new CSharpCodeGen(Options);
			return cSharpCodeGen.ExpressionGen.GenerateCode(expression);
		}

		private string GetAttributeDelimiters(HtmlAttribute atr)
		{
			return atr.AttributeQuoteType switch
			{
				QuoteType.SingleQuote => "'", 
				QuoteType.DoubleQuote => "\"", 
				QuoteType.None => string.Empty, 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private bool ShouldAddNewLine(HtmlElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !(element.Nodes[0] is HtmlText);
		}

		public void GenerateHtmlElement(HtmlElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateElementBeg(element, ShouldAddNewLine(element));
				if (!element.IsEmptyTag)
				{
					bool isIncreaseIndent = IncreaseIndent(element);
					GenerateNodesList(element.Nodes, isIncreaseIndent);
					GenerateElementEnd(element);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IncreaseIndent(HtmlElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			NodeList nodes = element.Nodes;
			if (nodes != null && nodes.Count != 0)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = nodes[0] as LanguageElement;
				if (languageElement is XmlNode && languageElement.ElementType == LanguageElementType.HtmlText)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (element.HasCloseTag && !flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void GenerateElementBeg(HtmlElement element, bool addNewLine)
		{
			if (element.IsEmptyTag)
			{
				GenerateElementBeg(element, "<", "/>", addNewLine);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateElementBeg(element, "<", ">", addNewLine);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateElementBeg(HtmlElement element)
		{
			GenerateElementBeg(element, addNewLine: true);
		}

		private void GenerateElementBeg(HtmlElement element, string openSign, string closeSign, bool addNewLine)
		{
			GenerateElementBeg(element, openSign, closeSign, addNewLine, string.Empty);
		}

		private void GenerateElementBeg(HtmlElement element, string openSign, string closeSign, bool addNewLine, string elementName)
		{
			string text = elementName;
			if (elementName == null || elementName == string.Empty)
			{
				text = GetHtmlElementName(element);
			}
			base.Code.Write("{0}{1}", openSign, text);
			GenerateHtmlAttributesList(element.XmlAttributes);
			base.Code.Write(closeSign);
			if (addNewLine)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
		}

		private string GetHtmlElementName(HtmlElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string result = element.Name;
			switch (element.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.RegisterDirective:
				result = "Register";
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.PageDirective:
				result = "Page";
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.ControlDirective:
				result = "Control";
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.MasterDirective:
				result = "Master";
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.ImportDirective:
				result = "Import";
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.HtmlScript:
				result = "SCRIPT";
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.HtmlStyle:
				result = "STYLE";
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void GenerateElementEnd(HtmlElement element)
		{
			GenerateElementEnd(element, "</", ">");
		}

		private void GenerateElementEnd(HtmlElement element, string elementName)
		{
			GenerateElementEnd(element, "</", ">", elementName);
		}

		private void GenerateElementEnd(HtmlElement element, string openSign, string closeSign)
		{
			GenerateElementEnd(element, openSign, closeSign, string.Empty);
		}

		private void GenerateElementEnd(HtmlElement element, string openSign, string closeSign, string elementName)
		{
			if (element.HasCloseTag)
			{
				string text = elementName;
				if (elementName == null || elementName == string.Empty)
				{
					text = element.Name;
				}
				bool flag = true;
				if (element.NodeCount > 0)
				{
					flag = !(element.Nodes[element.NodeCount - 1] is HtmlText);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine("{0}{1}{2}", openSign, text, closeSign);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Code.WriteClearFormat($"{openSign}{text}{closeSign}");
					base.Code.WriteLine();
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateHtmlAttributesList(NodeList attributes)
		{
			if (attributes != null && attributes.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < attributes.Count; i++)
				{
					GenerateHtmlAttribute(attributes[i] as HtmlAttribute);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateNodesList(NodeList elements, bool isIncreaseIndent)
		{
			if (elements == null || elements.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			if (isIncreaseIndent)
			{
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
			}
			int count = elements.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (elements[i] is LanguageElement languageElement2)
				{
					GenerateElement(languageElement2);
				}
			}
			if (isIncreaseIndent)
			{
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		public void GenerateHtmlScript(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			if (script != null)
			{
				GenerateElementBeg(script, "<", ">", addNewLine: false, "script");
				if ((script.Nodes == null || script.NodeCount == 0 || IsUnknowLanguage(script)) && script.ScriptText != null && script.ScriptText != string.Empty)
				{
					base.Code.WriteClearFormat(script.ScriptText);
				}
				else if (script.Nodes != null || script.NodeCount != 0)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					DotNetLanguageType languageType = GetLanguageType(script);
					CodeGen scriptCodeGen = GetScriptCodeGen(languageType);
					GenerateNodesFromOtherLanguages(scriptCodeGen, script.Nodes);
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
				GenerateElementEnd(script, "script");
			}
		}

		private void GenerateNodesFromOtherLanguages(CodeGen codeGen, NodeList nodes)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				codeGen.GenerateElement(nodes[i] as LanguageElement);
			}
		}

		private string GetScriptLanguage(DotNetLanguageType languageType)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			switch (languageType)
			{
			case DotNetLanguageType.CSharp:
				result = "CSharp";
				break;
			case DotNetLanguageType.VisualBasic:
				result = "Basic";
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsUnknowLanguage(HtmlScriptDefinition element)
		{
			if (GetLanguageType(element) == DotNetLanguageType.Unknown)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private DotNetLanguageType GetLanguageType(HtmlScriptDefinition element)
		{
			DotNetLanguageType language = element.Language;
			if (language != DotNetLanguageType.Unknown)
			{
				return language;
			}
			if (element.FileNode == null)
			{
				return DotNetLanguageType.Unknown;
			}
			return element.FileNode?.AspPageLanguage ?? DotNetLanguageType.Unknown;
		}

		private CodeGen GetCodeGenerator(string languageName)
		{
			if (!(languageName == "CSharp"))
			{
				if (languageName == "Basic")
				{
					return new VBCodeGen();
				}
				return null;
			}
			return new CSharpCodeGen();
		}

		private CodeGen GetScriptCodeGen(DotNetLanguageType languageType)
		{
			string scriptLanguage = GetScriptLanguage(languageType);
			if (scriptLanguage == null && scriptLanguage == string.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CodeGen codeGenerator = GetCodeGenerator(scriptLanguage);
			if (codeGenerator == null)
			{
				return CodeGen;
			}
			codeGenerator.Code = CodeGen.Code;
			return codeGenerator;
		}

		public void GenerateHtmlStyle(HtmlStyleDefinition style)
		{
			if (style != null)
			{
				GenerateElementBeg(style, "<", ">", addNewLine: true, "style");
				if ((style.Nodes == null || style.NodeCount == 0) && style.StyleText != null && style.StyleText != string.Empty)
				{
					base.Code.WriteClearFormat(style.StyleText);
				}
				else if (style.Nodes != null || style.NodeCount != 0)
				{
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					GenerateDescendantList(style.Nodes, "");
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
				GenerateElementEnd(style, "style");
			}
		}

		public void GenerateRegisterDirective(RegisterDirective element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateAspDirective(element);
			}
		}

		public void GeneratePageDirective(PageDirective element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateAspDirective(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateServerControlElement(ServerControlElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				GenerateHtmlElement(element);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateHtmlText(HtmlText text)
		{
			if (text != null)
			{
				string text2 = text.Text;
				base.Code.WriteClearFormat(text2);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateAspCodeEmbedding(AspCodeEmbedding code)
		{
			string text = "<%";
			string text2 = "%>";
			if (code.IsRazorEmbedding)
			{
				text = "@";
				text2 = string.Empty;
			}
			base.Code.WriteLine("{0}{1}{2}", text, code.Code, text2);
		}

		public void GenerateAspDirective(AspDirective directive)
		{
			GenerateElementBeg(directive, "<%@ ", " %>", addNewLine: true);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlAnyContentSpec(XmlAnyContentSpec spec)
		{
			base.Code.Write("ANY");
		}

		public void GenerateXmlAttributeDecl(XmlAttributeDeclaration decl)
		{
			base.Code.Write(decl.Name);
			WriteAttribute(decl);
			GenerateDefaultAttributeValueType(decl);
		}

		private void GenerateDefaultAttributeValueType(XmlAttributeDeclaration decl)
		{
			if (decl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (decl.DefaultAttributeValueType)
			{
			case DefaultAttributeValueType.Required:
				text = "#REQUIRED";
				break;
			case DefaultAttributeValueType.Implied:
				text = "#IMPLIED";
				break;
			case DefaultAttributeValueType.Fixed:
				text = "#FIXED";
				if (decl.DefaultAttributeValue != null || decl.DefaultAttributeValue != string.Empty)
				{
					text += decl.DefaultAttributeValue;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (text != null && text != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" {0}", text);
			}
		}

		private void WriteAttribute(XmlAttributeDeclaration decl)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (decl.AttributeType)
			{
			case AttributeType.CData:
				text = "CDATA";
				break;
			case AttributeType.IdRef:
				text = "IDREF";
				break;
			case AttributeType.IdRefs:
				text = "IDREFS";
				break;
			case AttributeType.Entity:
				text = "ENTITY";
				break;
			case AttributeType.Entities:
				text = "ENTITIES";
				break;
			case AttributeType.NmToken:
				text = "NMTOKEN";
				break;
			case AttributeType.NmTokens:
				text = "NMTOKENS";
				break;
			case AttributeType.Id:
				text = "ID";
				break;
			case AttributeType.Enumeration:
			case AttributeType.Notation:
				GenerateAttlistEnumeration(decl);
				return;
			}
			if (text != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" {0}", text);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAttlistEnumeration(XmlAttributeDeclaration decl)
		{
			if (decl.AttributeType == AttributeType.Notation)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" NOTATION");
			}
			base.Code.Write(" (");
			GenerateStringCollection(decl.EnumerationMembers, " | ");
			base.Code.Write(")");
		}

		private void GenerateStringCollection(StringCollection coll, string delimiter)
		{
			if (coll == null || coll.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < coll.Count; i++)
			{
				if (coll[i] != null && !(coll[i] == string.Empty))
				{
					if (i != 0)
					{
						base.Code.Write(delimiter);
					}
					base.Code.Write(coll[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void GenerateXmlAttributeListDecl(XmlAttributeListDeclaration decl)
		{
			base.Code.Write("<!ATTLIST {0}", decl.Name);
			GenerateDescendantList(decl.AttributesDecl, writeFirstDelimiter: true);
			base.Code.WriteLine(">");
		}

		public void GenerateXmlCharacterData(XmlCharacterData data)
		{
			base.Code.Write("<![CDATA[\n");
			base.Code.Write(data.Name, split: false);
			base.Code.WriteLine("]]>", split: false);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlCharReference(XmlCharReference data)
		{
			base.Code.Write("{0};", data.Name);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlChildrenContentSpec(XmlChildrenContentSpec spec)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(spec.DetailNodes);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlCPChoice(XmlChoiceContentParticle part)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(part.DetailNodes, "|");
			GenerateRepeatCount(part);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlCPSequence(XmlSequenceContentParticle part)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(part.DetailNodes, ", ");
			GenerateRepeatCount(part);
		}

		private void GenerateRepeatCount(XmlContentParticle content)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (content.RepeatCount)
			{
			case RepeatCount.ZeroOrOnce:
				text = "?";
				break;
			case RepeatCount.ZeroOrMore:
				text = "*";
				break;
			case RepeatCount.OnceOrMore:
				text = "+";
				break;
			}
			if (text != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(text);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateXmlDecl(XmlDecl decl)
		{
			base.Code.Write("<?xml");
			WriteXmlString(" version=", decl.Version);
			WriteXmlString(" standalone=", decl.StandAlone);
			WriteXmlString(" encording=", decl.Encoding);
			base.Code.WriteLine(" ?>");
		}

		private void WriteXmlString(string name, string str)
		{
			if (str != null && str != string.Empty && name != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write("{0}{1}", name, str);
			}
		}

		private void WriteString(string str)
		{
			if (str != null && str != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" {0}", str);
			}
		}

		public void GenerateXmlDocTypeDecl(XmlDocTypeDecl decl)
		{
			base.Code.Write("<!DOCTYPE {0}", decl.Name);
			GenerateDescendantList(decl.DetailNodes, writeFirstDelimiter: true);
			if (decl.Nodes != null && decl.NodeCount != 0)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine("[");
				GenerateDescendantList(decl.Nodes, "", writeFirstDelimiter: false);
				base.Code.Write("]");
			}
			base.Code.WriteLine(">");
		}

		public void GenerateXmlElementDecl(XmlElementDecl decl)
		{
			base.Code.Write("<!ELEMENT {0}", decl.Name);
			GenerateDescendantList(decl.DetailNodes, writeFirstDelimiter: true);
			base.Code.WriteLine(">");
		}

		private void GenerateDescendantList(NodeList list, string delimiter, bool writeFirstDelimiter)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(list, delimiter, writeFirstDelimiter, writeDelimiterAfterElements: false);
		}

		private void GenerateDescendantList(NodeList list, string delimiter, bool writeFirstDelimiter, bool writeDelimiterAfterElements)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(list, delimiter, writeFirstDelimiter, writeDelimiterAfterElements, writeLastDelimiter: true);
		}

		private void GenerateDescendantList(NodeList list, string delimiter, bool writeFirstDelimiter, bool writeDelimiterAfterElements, bool writeLastDelimiter)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(list, delimiter, writeFirstDelimiter, writeDelimiterAfterElements, writeLastDelimiter, addNewLine: true);
		}

		private void GenerateDescendantList(NodeList list, string delimiter, bool writeFirstDelimiter, bool writeDelimiterAfterElements, bool writeLastDelimiter, bool addNewLine)
		{
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!(list[i] is LanguageElement languageElement2))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (writeFirstDelimiter && !writeDelimiterAfterElements)
				{
					base.Code.Write(delimiter);
				}
				else
				{
					writeFirstDelimiter = true;
				}
				GenerateElement(languageElement2);
				if (writeDelimiterAfterElements && (writeLastDelimiter || i != count - 1))
				{
					if (addNewLine)
					{
						base.Code.WriteLine(delimiter);
					}
					else
					{
						base.Code.Write(delimiter);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateDescendantList(NodeList list, string delimiter)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(list, delimiter, writeFirstDelimiter: false);
		}

		private void GenerateDescendantList(NodeList list)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(list, " ");
		}

		private void GenerateDescendantList(NodeList list, bool writeFirstDelimiter)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(list, " ", writeFirstDelimiter);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlEmptyContentSpec(XmlEmptyContentSpec spec)
		{
			base.Code.Write("EMPTY");
		}

		public void GenerateXmlEntityDecl(XmlEntityDecl decl)
		{
			base.Code.Write("<!ENTITY");
			if (decl.IsParameterEntity)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" %");
			}
			base.Code.Write(" {0}", decl.Name);
			if (decl.ImmediateValue != null && decl.ImmediateValue != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" {0}", decl.ImmediateValue);
			}
			if (decl.ExternalLinkValue != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
				GenerateHtmlXmlNode(decl.ExternalLinkValue);
			}
			if (decl.NDataValue != null && decl.NDataValue != string.Empty)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" NDATA {0}", decl.NDataValue);
			}
			base.Code.WriteLine(">");
		}

		public void GenerateXmlExternalPublicID(NewExternalIDPublicLink link)
		{
			base.Code.Write("PUBLIC {0}", link.PublicID);
			WriteString(link.SystemURI);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlExternalSystemID(NewExternalIDSystemLink link)
		{
			base.Code.Write("SYSTEM {0}", link.SystemURI);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlMixedContentSpec(XmlMixedContentSpec spec)
		{
			base.Code.Write("(");
			base.Code.Write("#PCDATA");
			GenerateDescendantList(spec.DetailNodes, " | ", writeFirstDelimiter: true);
			base.Code.Write(")");
		}

		public void GenerateXmlName(XmlName name)
		{
			base.Code.Write(name.Name);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlNamedCP(XmlNamedContentParticle part)
		{
			GenerateDescendantList(part.DetailNodes);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlNameReference(XmlNameReference reference)
		{
			base.Code.Write("%{0};", reference.Name);
		}

		public void GenerateXmlNotationDecl(XmlNotationDecl decl)
		{
			base.Code.Write("<!NOTATION {0}", decl.Name);
			if (decl.NotationLink != null)
			{
				base.Code.Write(" ");
				GenerateHtmlXmlNode(decl.NotationLink);
			}
			base.Code.WriteLine(">");
		}

		public void GenerateXmlProcessingInstruction(XmlProcessingInstruction instr)
		{
			if (instr.DetailNodeCount == 0)
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine("<?{0} {1}?>", instr.Name, instr.InstructionText);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Code.Write("<?{0}", instr.Name);
				GenerateNodesList(instr.DetailNodes, isIncreaseIndent: false);
				base.Code.WriteLine("?>");
			}
		}

		public void GenerateXmlReference(XmlReference reference)
		{
			base.Code.Write("&{0};", reference.Name);
		}
	}
	public class HtmlXmlSnippetCodeGen : SnippetCodeGenBase
	{
		public HtmlXmlSnippetCodeGen(CodeGen gen)
			: base(gen)
		{
		}

		protected override bool GenerateSnippet(LanguageElement snippet)
		{
			if (snippet is ISnippetCodeElement snippetCodeElement)
			{
				base.Code.Write(snippetCodeElement.Code);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeElement(SnippetCodeElement snippet)
		{
			GenerateSnippet(snippet);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeMember(SnippetCodeMember snippet)
		{
			GenerateSnippet(snippet);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeStatement(SnippetCodeStatement snippet)
		{
			GenerateSnippet(snippet);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetCodeStatementBlock(SnippetCodeStatementBlock snippet)
		{
			GenerateSnippet(snippet);
		}

		protected override void GenerateSnippetExpression(SnippetExpression snippet)
		{
			GenerateSnippet(snippet);
		}
	}

	public class NewXmlParser : XmlParserBase
	{
		public NewXmlParser()
		{
			parserErrors = new XmlParserErrors();
			set = CreateSetArray();
			maxTokens = 56;
		}

		protected override void HandlePragmas()
		{
		}

		private void Parser()
		{
			if (la.Type == 54)
			{
				Text(useTrim: true);
			}
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			Prolog();
			if (la.Type == 48)
			{
				Element();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 54)
			{
				Text(useTrim: true);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(57);
			}
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			while (la.Type == 48 || la.Type == 54)
			{
				if (la.Type == 48)
				{
					Element();
				}
				else
				{
					Text(useTrim: true);
				}
				base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			}
			if (la.Type == 54)
			{
				Get();
			}
			while (StartOf(1))
			{
				if (la.Type == 48 || la.Type == 54)
				{
					base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
					if (la.Type == 48)
					{
						Element();
					}
					else if (la.Type == 54)
					{
						Text(useTrim: true);
					}
					else
					{
						SynErr(58);
					}
					base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
					if (la.Type == 54)
					{
						Get();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Misc();
				}
			}
		}

		private void Text(bool useTrim)
		{
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			Expect(54);
			string text = tToken.Value;
			if (useTrim)
			{
				text = text.Trim(' ', '\r', '\n');
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && (la.Type != 0 || !(text == "*/")))
			{
				XmlText xmlText = new XmlText();
				xmlText.Name = tToken.Value;
				xmlText.Text = tToken.Value;
				AddNode(xmlText);
				xmlText.SetRange(tToken.Range);
			}
		}

		private void Prolog()
		{
			if (la.Type == 5)
			{
				XMLDecl();
			}
			while (la.Type == 2 || la.Type == 10)
			{
				Misc();
			}
			if (la.Type == 15)
			{
				DocTypeDecl();
			}
			while (la.Type == 2 || la.Type == 10)
			{
				Misc();
			}
		}

		private void Element()
		{
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			XmlAttribute attribute = null;
			XmlElement xmlElement = new XmlElement();
			OpenContext(xmlElement);
			xmlElement.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(48);
			Name();
			xmlElement.Name = tToken.Value;
			while (StartOf(2))
			{
				Attribute(out attribute);
				if (attribute != null)
				{
					xmlElement.AddDetailNode(attribute);
				}
			}
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
			if (la.Type == 17)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				if (la.Type == 49)
				{
					Get();
					CloseContext();
					xmlElement.HasCloseTag = false;
					xmlElement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(xmlElement, tToken));
					return;
				}
				SynErr(59);
			}
			while (StartOf(3))
			{
				Content();
			}
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			if (la.Type != 50)
			{
				base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
			}
			if (la.Type == 50)
			{
				Get();
				Name();
				base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
				Expect(17);
			}
			xmlElement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(xmlElement, tToken));
			CloseContext();
		}

		private void Misc()
		{
			XmlProcessingInstruction processingInstruction = null;
			if (la.Type == 2)
			{
				Comment();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 10)
			{
				PI(out processingInstruction, checkForText: true);
				if (processingInstruction != null)
				{
					AddNode(processingInstruction);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(60);
			}
		}

		private void XMLDecl()
		{
			XmlDecl xmlDecl = new XmlDecl();
			AddNode(xmlDecl);
			xmlDecl.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(5);
			VersionInfo(xmlDecl);
			if (la.Type == 9)
			{
				EncodingDecl(xmlDecl);
			}
			if (la.Type == 12)
			{
				SDDecl(xmlDecl);
			}
			Expect(11);
			xmlDecl.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(xmlDecl, tToken));
		}

		private void DocTypeDecl()
		{
			XmlDocTypeDecl xmlDocTypeDecl = new XmlDocTypeDecl();
			AddNode(xmlDocTypeDecl);
			xmlDocTypeDecl.SetRange(la.Range);
			NewExternalIDLink extID = null;
			Expect(15);
			Name();
			xmlDocTypeDecl.Name = tToken.Value;
			if (la.Type == 13 || la.Type == 14)
			{
				ExternalID(out extID);
				if (extID != null)
				{
					xmlDocTypeDecl.AddDetailNode(extID);
				}
			}
			if (la.Type == 18)
			{
				Get();
				IntSubset(xmlDocTypeDecl);
				Expect(19);
			}
			Expect(17);
			xmlDocTypeDecl.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(xmlDocTypeDecl, tToken));
		}

		private void VersionInfo(XmlDecl xmlDecl)
		{
			Expect(8);
			Expect(6);
			Expect(3);
			xmlDecl.Version = tToken.Value;
		}

		private void EncodingDecl(XmlDecl xmlDecl)
		{
			Expect(9);
			Expect(6);
			Expect(3);
			xmlDecl.Encoding = tToken.Value;
		}

		private void SDDecl(XmlDecl xmlDecl)
		{
			Expect(12);
			Expect(6);
			Expect(3);
			xmlDecl.StandAlone = tToken.Value;
		}

		private void Name()
		{
			switch (la.Type)
			{
			case 1:
				Get();
				break;
			case 8:
				Get();
				break;
			case 9:
				Get();
				break;
			case 13:
				Get();
				break;
			case 14:
				Get();
				break;
			case 20:
				Get();
				break;
			case 21:
				Get();
				break;
			case 35:
				Get();
				break;
			case 36:
				Get();
				break;
			case 37:
				Get();
				break;
			case 38:
				Get();
				break;
			case 39:
				Get();
				break;
			case 40:
				Get();
				break;
			case 41:
				Get();
				break;
			case 42:
				Get();
				break;
			case 47:
				Get();
				break;
			default:
				SynErr(61);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ExternalID(out NewExternalIDLink extID)
		{
			extID = null;
			Token a = la;
			if (la.Type == 13)
			{
				Get();
				Expect(3);
				NewExternalIDSystemLink newExternalIDSystemLink = new NewExternalIDSystemLink();
				newExternalIDSystemLink.SystemURI = tToken.Value;
				extID = newExternalIDSystemLink;
			}
			else if (la.Type == 14)
			{
				Get();
				NewExternalIDPublicLink newExternalIDPublicLink = (NewExternalIDPublicLink)(extID = new NewExternalIDPublicLink());
				Expect(3);
				newExternalIDPublicLink.PublicID = tToken.Value;
				if (la.Type == 3)
				{
					Get();
					newExternalIDPublicLink.SystemURI = tToken.Value;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(62);
			}
			if (extID != null)
			{
				extID.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(a, tToken));
			}
		}

		private void IntSubset(XmlDocTypeDecl docTypeDecl)
		{
			while (StartOf(4))
			{
				if (StartOf(5))
				{
					MarkupDecl(docTypeDecl);
				}
				else
				{
					DeclSep();
				}
			}
		}

		private void MarkupDecl(XmlDocTypeDecl docTypeDecl)
		{
			XmlElementDecl elementDecl = null;
			XmlNotationDecl notationDecl = null;
			XmlAttributeListDeclaration result = null;
			XmlEntityDecl entityDecl = null;
			XmlProcessingInstruction processingInstruction = null;
			switch (la.Type)
			{
			case 16:
				ElementDecl(out elementDecl);
				if (docTypeDecl != null && elementDecl != null)
				{
					docTypeDecl.AddNode(elementDecl);
				}
				break;
			case 33:
				AttlistDecl(out result);
				if (docTypeDecl != null && result != null)
				{
					docTypeDecl.AddNode(result);
				}
				break;
			case 46:
				EntityDecl(out entityDecl);
				if (docTypeDecl != null && entityDecl != null)
				{
					docTypeDecl.AddNode(entityDecl);
				}
				break;
			case 32:
				NotationDecl(out notationDecl);
				if (docTypeDecl != null && notationDecl != null)
				{
					docTypeDecl.AddNode(notationDecl);
				}
				break;
			case 10:
				PI(out processingInstruction, checkForText: false);
				if (docTypeDecl != null && processingInstruction != null)
				{
					docTypeDecl.AddNode(processingInstruction);
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				Comment();
				break;
			default:
				SynErr(63);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void DeclSep()
		{
			PEReference(out var nameRef);
			if (nameRef != null)
			{
				AddNode(nameRef);
			}
		}

		private void ElementDecl(out XmlElementDecl elementDecl)
		{
			elementDecl = new XmlElementDecl();
			elementDecl.SetRange(la.Range);
			XmlBaseContentSpec contentSpec = null;
			Expect(16);
			Name();
			elementDecl.Name = tToken.Value;
			ContentSpec(out contentSpec);
			if (contentSpec != null)
			{
				elementDecl.AddDetailNode(contentSpec);
			}
			Expect(17);
			elementDecl.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(elementDecl, tToken));
		}

		private void AttlistDecl(out XmlAttributeListDeclaration result)
		{
			result = new XmlAttributeListDeclaration();
			XmlAttributeDeclaration attrDecl = null;
			result.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(33);
			Name();
			result.Name = tToken.Value;
			while (StartOf(2))
			{
				AttDef(out attrDecl);
				if (attrDecl != null)
				{
					result.AddNode(attrDecl);
					result.AttributesDecl.Add(attrDecl);
				}
			}
			Expect(17);
			result.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(result, tToken));
		}

		private void EntityDecl(out XmlEntityDecl entityDecl)
		{
			entityDecl = new XmlEntityDecl();
			entityDecl.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(46);
			if (la.Type == 26)
			{
				Get();
				entityDecl.IsParameterEntity = true;
			}
			Name();
			entityDecl.Name = tToken.Value;
			EntityDef(entityDecl);
			Expect(17);
			entityDecl.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(entityDecl, tToken));
		}

		private void NotationDecl(out XmlNotationDecl notationDecl)
		{
			NewExternalIDLink extID = null;
			notationDecl = new XmlNotationDecl();
			notationDecl.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(32);
			Name();
			notationDecl.Name = tToken.Value;
			ExternalID(out extID);
			if (extID != null)
			{
				notationDecl.NotationLink = extID;
				notationDecl.AddDetailNode(extID);
			}
			Expect(17);
			notationDecl.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(notationDecl, tToken));
		}

		private void PI(out XmlProcessingInstruction processingInstruction, bool checkForText)
		{
			processingInstruction = new XmlProcessingInstruction();
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			processingInstruction.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(10);
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldReturnPIChars = true;
			Name();
			processingInstruction.Name = tToken.Value;
			Expect(55);
			processingInstruction.InstructionText = tToken.Value;
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = checkForText;
			Expect(11);
			processingInstruction.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(processingInstruction, tToken));
		}

		private void Comment()
		{

		}

		private void ContentSpec(out XmlBaseContentSpec contentSpec)
		{
			contentSpec = null;

		private void Children(out XmlChildrenContentSpec children)
		{
			XmlContentParticle choiceCP = null;
			children = new XmlChildrenContentSpec();

			{
				if (la.Type == 29)
				{
					Get();

				}
				else if (la.Type == 30)
				{
					Get();
					repeatCount = RepeatCount.ZeroOrMore;

				children.Source = choiceCP;
				children.AddDetailNode(choiceCP);
			}
		}

		private void CpSequence(out XmlContentParticle choiceCP)
		{
			choiceCP = null;
			XmlContentParticle contentParticle = null;
			XmlSequencedContentParticle xmlSequencedContentParticle = null;
			Cp(out contentParticle);
			while (la.Type == 25 || la.Type == 28)
			{
				if (la.Type == 25)
				{
					Get();

					{

							xmlSequencedContentParticle.Particles.Add(contentParticle);
							xmlSequencedContentParticle.AddDetailNode(contentParticle);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
					if (xmlSequencedContentParticle == null)
					{
						xmlSequencedContentParticle = new XmlSequenceContentParticle();
						if (contentParticle != null)
						{
							xmlSequencedContentParticle.Particles.Add(contentParticle);
							xmlSequencedContentParticle.AddDetailNode(contentParticle);
						}
					}

				Cp(out contentParticle);
				if (contentParticle != null)
				{
					xmlSequencedContentParticle.Particles.Add(contentParticle);
					xmlSequencedContentParticle.AddDetailNode(contentParticle);
				}
			}
			Expect(23);
			choiceCP = xmlSequencedContentParticle;
		}

		private void Cp(out XmlContentParticle contentParticle)
		{
			XmlNameReference nameRef = null;
			contentParticle = null;
			RepeatCount repeatCount = RepeatCount.Once;
			Token a = la;
			if (StartOf(2))
			{
				Name();

				xmlName.Name = tToken.Value;
				contentParticle = new XmlNamedContentParticle();
				(contentParticle as XmlNamedContentParticle).ParticleName = xmlName;
				contentParticle.AddDetailNode(xmlName);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 26)

				PEReference(out nameRef);

				{
					contentParticle = new XmlNamedContentParticle();
					(contentParticle as XmlNamedContentParticle).ParticleName = nameRef;
					contentParticle.AddDetailNode(nameRef);
				}
			}
			else if (la.Type == 22)
			{
				Get();
				CpSequence(out contentParticle);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(67);
			}
			if (la.Type == 29 || la.Type == 30 || la.Type == 31)
			{
				if (la.Type == 29)
				{
					Get();
					repeatCount = RepeatCount.ZeroOrOnce;
				}
				else if (la.Type == 30)
				{
					Get();
					repeatCount = RepeatCount.ZeroOrMore;
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
					repeatCount = RepeatCount.OnceOrMore;
				}
			}
			if (contentParticle != null)
			{
				contentParticle.RepeatCount = repeatCount;
				contentParticle.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(a, tToken));
			}
		}

		private void CDSect()
		{
			XmlCharacterData xmlCharacterData = new XmlCharacterData();

			Expect(52);

			Expect(53);
			xmlCharacterData.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(xmlCharacterData, tToken));
		}

		private void Attribute(out XmlAttribute attribute)
		{
			attribute = new XmlAttribute();
			attribute.SetRange(la.Range);
			Name();
			attribute.Name = tToken.Value;
			attribute.SetNameRange(tToken.Range);
			Expect(6);
			Expect(3);
			if (tToken.Value != null && tToken.Value.Length > 0)
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = tToken.Value.Length;
				if (tToken.Value[0] == '"' || tToken.Value[0] == '\'')
				{
					num = 1;
				}
				if (tToken.Value[tToken.Value.Length - 1] == '"' || tToken.Value[tToken.Value.Length - 1] == '\'')
				{
					num2 = tToken.Value.Length - 1;
				}
				attribute.Value = tToken.Value.Substring(num, num2 - num);
			}
			attribute.SetValueRange(new SourceRange(tToken.Range.Start.Line, tToken.Range.Start.Offset + 1, tToken.Range.End.Line, tToken.Range.End.Offset - 1));
			attribute.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(attribute, tToken));
		}

		private void Content()
		{
			XmlProcessingInstruction processingInstruction = null;
			switch (la.Type)
			{
			case 48:
				Element();
				break;
			case 4:
			case 51:
				Reference();
				break;
			case 52:
				CDSect();
				break;
			case 10:
				PI(out processingInstruction, checkForText: true);
				if (processingInstruction != null)
				{
					AddNode(processingInstruction);
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				Comment();
				break;
			case 54:
				Text(useTrim: false);
				break;
			default:
				SynErr(72);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void Reference()

				Expect(27);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 4)
			{
				Get();
				XmlCharReference xmlCharReference = new XmlCharReference();
				AddNode(xmlCharReference);
				xmlCharReference.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(tToken, la));
				xmlCharReference.Name = tToken.Value;
				base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
				Expect(27);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(73);
			}
		}

		private void Parse()
		{
			la = new Token();
			la.Value = "";
			base.XmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
			Get();
			Parser();
			Expect(0);
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
			}
			CloseContext();
		}

		protected override LanguageElement Parse(string code, int startLine, int startColumn)
		{
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, startLine, startColumn);
			return Parse(reader);
		}

		protected override LanguageElement DoParse(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			LanguageElement context = parserContext.Context;
			if (context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SetRootNode(context);
			if (context is SourceFile)
			{
				((SourceFile)context).SetDocument(parserContext.Document);
			}
			return Parse(reader);
		}

		public LanguageElement Parse(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				scanner = new XmlScanner(reader);
				if (!(base.RootNode is SourceFile))
				{
					OpenContext(GetSourceFile("dsf"));
				}
				Parse();
				return base.RootNode;
			}
			finally
			{
				CleanUpParser();
			}
		}

	public abstract class XmlLanguageParserBase : EmbeddedCodeParserBase
	{
		public override string Language => "Xml";

		}

	internal class XmlLanguageUtils : LanguageUtils
	{
		private sealed class XmlTokenizer : Tokenizer
		{
			public override TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			public override IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingLanguage)
			{
				if (code == null || code.Length == 0)
				{
					return new List<CategorizedToken>().AsReadOnly();
				}
				ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
				HtmlParser htmlParser = new HtmlParser(isRazorParser: false, workAsXAMLParser: true, codeEmbeddingLanguage);
				htmlParser.SetTokensCategory = true;
				htmlParser.Parse(reader);
				TokenCollection savedTokens = htmlParser.SavedTokens;
				int count = savedTokens.Count;
				List<CategorizedToken> list = new List<CategorizedToken>(count);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					CategorizedToken item = (CategorizedToken)savedTokens[i];
					list.Add(item);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public override Tokenizer CreateTokenizer()
		{
			return new XmlTokenizer();
		}

		public override ParserBase CreateParser(ParserVersion version, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embededLanguage)
		{
			return new NewXmlParser();
		}

		public override CodeGen CreateCodeGen()
		{
			CodeGen codeGen = new HtmlXmlCodeGen();
			if (codeGen != null)
			{
				codeGen.Code = new CodeWriter(new StringWriter(), new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.Xml));
			}
			return codeGen;
		}

		public override ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder()
		{
			return new AspElementBuilder();
		}
	}
	public abstract class XmlParserBase : XmlLanguageParserBase, IXmlDocParser
	{
		protected XmlScanner XmlScanner => (XmlScanner)scanner;

		private XmlNode GetXmlNode(LanguageElement root)
		{
			if (root == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (root is XmlNode)
			{
				return root as XmlNode;
			}
			if (root is SourceFile)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < root.NodeCount; i++)
				{
					if (root.Nodes[i] is XmlNode)
					{
						return root.Nodes[i] as XmlNode;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void FillArrayListWithNodes(ArrayList list, LanguageElement root)
		{
			if (root is SourceFile)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < root.NodeCount; i++)
				{
					list.Add(root.Nodes[i]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list.Add(root);
			}
		}

		private string GetTextFromSourceLinesReader(SourceLinesReader linesReader)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (linesReader.SourceLines == null || linesReader.SourceLines.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < linesReader.LineCount; i++)
			{
				SourcePoint start = linesReader.SourceLines[i].Start;
				if (num != -1 && start.Line - num > 1)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < start.Line - num - 1; j++)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
					}
				}
				if (i > 0 && start.Offset != 1)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < start.Offset - 1; k++)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(' ');
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(linesReader.SourceLines[i].Text);
				num = start.Line;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override TokenCategory GetTokenCategory(CategorizedToken token)
		{
			if (token.Type == 0)
			{
				return TokenCategory.Unknown;
			}
			return TokenCategory.Text;
		}

		protected abstract LanguageElement Parse(string code, int startLine, int startColumn);

		public XmlNode ParseXmlDocNode(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			if (reader == null || !(reader is SourceLinesReader))
			{
				return null;
			}
			SourceLinesReader sourceLinesReader = reader as SourceLinesReader;
			string textFromSourceLinesReader = GetTextFromSourceLinesReader(sourceLinesReader);
			LanguageElement root = Parse(textFromSourceLinesReader, sourceLinesReader.StartLine, sourceLinesReader.StartColumn);
			return GetXmlNode(root);
		}

		public XmlNode ParseXmlDocNode(string xmlDoc)
		{
			if (xmlDoc == null || xmlDoc.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement root = Parse(xmlDoc, 1, 1);
			return GetXmlNode(root);
		}

		public ArrayList ParseXmlDocNodes(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (reader == null || !(reader is SourceLinesReader))
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			SourceLinesReader sourceLinesReader = reader as SourceLinesReader;
			string textFromSourceLinesReader = GetTextFromSourceLinesReader(sourceLinesReader);
			LanguageElement languageElement = Parse(textFromSourceLinesReader, sourceLinesReader.StartLine, sourceLinesReader.StartColumn);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			FillArrayListWithNodes(arrayList, languageElement);
			return arrayList;
		}

		public ArrayList ParseXmlDocNodes(string xmlDoc)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (xmlDoc == null || xmlDoc.Length == 0)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = Parse(xmlDoc, 1, 1);
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			FillArrayListWithNodes(arrayList, languageElement);
			return arrayList;
		}
	}
