				if (ch == 'D')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 17;
				}
				if (ch == 'E')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 109;
				}
				if (ch == 'N')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 46;
				}
				if (ch == 'A')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 54;
				}
				if (ch != '[')
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 89;
			case 106:
				num2 = pos;
				num = 10;
				if (ch == 'x')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 12;
				}
				t.Type = 10;
				break;
			case 107:
				if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 9;
				}
				if (ch != 'x')
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 10;
			case 108:
				if (ch <= ',' || (ch >= '.' && ch <= '=') || (ch >= '?' && ch <= 'ď') || (ch > 'ÿ' && ch != '\uffff'))
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 3;
				}
				if (ch == '>')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 5;
				}
				if (ch != '-')
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 4;
			case 109:
				if (ch == 'L')
				{
					AddCh();
					goto case 24;
				}
				if (ch != 'N')
				{
					goto case 0;
				}
				AddCh();
				goto case 81;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class XmlScannerBase : GeneratedScannerBase
	{
		private bool _ShouldReturnCharDataToken;

		private bool _ShouldReturnPIChars;

		private bool _ShouldCheckForXmlText;

		private bool _IsRazor;

		protected bool IsRazor
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsRazor;
			}
			set
			{
				_IsRazor = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual int CDataTokenType => 54;

		protected virtual int PICharsTokenType => 55;

		public bool ShouldReturnPIChars
		{
			get
			{
				return _ShouldReturnPIChars;
			}
			set
			{
				_ShouldReturnPIChars = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldCheckForXmlText
		{
			get
			{
				return _ShouldCheckForXmlText;
			}
			set
			{
				_ShouldCheckForXmlText = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldReturnCharDataToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _ShouldReturnCharDataToken;
			}
			set
			{
				_ShouldReturnCharDataToken = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsRazorEmbeddingStartChar(char ch)
		{
			if (IsRazor)
			{
				return ch == '@';
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Token CreateToken()
		{
			return new Token();
		}

		protected char PeekForSignificantChar()
		{
			if (ch == '\uffff' || ch > 'ÿ' || !ignore[ch])
			{
				return ch;
			}
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			char c = base.CharProvider.Peek();
			while (c != '\uffff' && c < 'ÿ' && ignore[c])
			{
				c = base.CharProvider.Peek();
			}
			return c;
		}

		protected override bool NextTokenStart()
		{
			if (ShouldCheckForXmlText)
			{
				char c = PeekForSignificantChar();
				if (c != '<' && !IsReference(c) && !IsRazorEmbeddingStartChar(c))
				{
					t = GetXmlTextToken();
					return true;
				}
				if (c == '<' && ch != '<')
				{
					t = GetXmlTextToken();
					return true;
				}
			}
			SkipIgnoredChars();
			if (ShouldReturnCharDataToken)
			{
				t = GetCharDataToken();
				return true;
			}
			if (ShouldReturnPIChars)
			{
				t = GetPICharToken();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsElementName(string name)
		{
			char c = base.CharProvider.Peek();
			while (c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == ' ')
			{
				c = base.CharProvider.Peek();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < name.Length; i++)
			{
				if (char.ToUpper(name[i]) != char.ToUpper(c))
				{
					return false;
				}
				c = base.CharProvider.Peek();
			}
			if (c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == ' ' || c == '>')
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected Token GetCharDataToken()
		{
			Token token = CreateToken();
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (token.Column <= 0)
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			token.Line = lineValue;
			token.Type = CDataTokenType;
			tlen = 0;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			string text = ch.ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			while (ch != '\uffff' && text != "]]>")
			{
				AddCh();
				text = text[1].ToString() + text[2] + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			_ShouldReturnCharDataToken = false;
			return token;
		}

		protected Token GetPICharToken()
		{
			Token token = CreateToken();
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (token.Column <= 0)
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			token.Line = lineValue;
			token.Type = PICharsTokenType;
			tlen = 0;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			string text = ch.ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			while (ch != '\uffff' && text != "?>")
			{
				AddCh();
				text = text[1].ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			ShouldReturnPIChars = false;
			return token;
		}

		protected Token GetXmlTextToken()
		{
			Token token = CreateToken();
			if (ch == '\n')
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.Line = prevLine;
			}
			else
			{
				token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.Line = lineValue;
			}
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Type = CDataTokenType;
			tlen = 0;
			while (ch != '\uffff' && ch != '<' && !IsReference(ch) && !IsRazorEmbeddingStartChar(ch))
			{
				AddCh();
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			if (ch == '\uffff' && token.Value.Length == 0)
			{
				token.Type = 0;
			}
			return token;
		}

		protected bool IsReference(char currentChar)
		{
			if (currentChar != '&')
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = base.CharProvider.Peek();
			if (c != ' ' && c != '\r' && c != '\n')
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.CodeParser.VB
{
	public class VB90CodeGen : VBCodeGen
	{
		public VB90CodeGen()
			: this(new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.Basic))
		{
		}

		public VB90CodeGen(CodeGenOptions options)
			: base(options)
		{
		}

		protected override ExpressionCodeGenBase CreateExpressionGen()
		{
			return new VB90ExpressionCodeGen(this);
		}
	}
	public class VB90ExpressionCodeGen : VBExpressionCodeGen
	{
		public VB90ExpressionCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateConditionalExpression(ConditionalExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.IsNeededResultsCasting)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.IIf);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.If);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Condition);
			bool wrapTernaryExpression = Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTernaryExpression;
			using (GetIndent(wrapTernaryExpression))
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				if (wrapTernaryExpression)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
				}
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TrueExpression);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				if (wrapTernaryExpression)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
				}
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.FalseExpression);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}
	}
	public class VBCodeGen : CodeGen
	{
		private bool _CheckForDetailNodes = true;

		private LanguageElement _FirstElement;

		protected override string LineContinuation => " _";

		internal override FormattingTable FormattingTable => VBFormattingTable.Instance;

		public bool CheckForDetailNodes
		{
			get
			{
				return _CheckForDetailNodes;
			}
			set
			{
				_CheckForDetailNodes = value;
			}
		}

		public VBCodeGen()
			: this(new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.Basic))
		{
		}

		public VBCodeGen(CodeGenOptions options)
			: base(options)
		{
		}

		private void GenerateCaseClauseList(CaseClausesList caseClausesList)
		{
			if (caseClausesList != null)
			{
				base.StatementGen.GenerateElementCollection(caseClausesList.Clauses, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateCaseClause(CaseClause caseClause)
		{
			if (caseClause != null)
			{
				((VBStatementCodeGen)base.StatementGen).GenerateCaseClause(caseClause);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateArrayNameModifier(ArrayNameModifier element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ExpressionCollection sizeInitializers = element.SizeInitializers;
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			int count = sizeInitializers.Count;
			int num = element.Rank;
			if (count > element.Rank)
			{
				num = count;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma, i - 1);
				}
				if (sizeInitializers != null && i < count)
				{
					LanguageElement languageElement = sizeInitializers[i];
					GenerateElement(languageElement);
				}
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		private void AddOperatorTokens(FormattingTokenType tokenType, FormattingElements tokens)
		{
			if (base.Context is Method { IsClassOperator: not false })
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Ampersand:
			case FormattingTokenType.Minus:
			case FormattingTokenType.Plus:
			case FormattingTokenType.Asterisk:
			case FormattingTokenType.Caret:
			case FormattingTokenType.Slash:
			case FormattingTokenType.BackSlash:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators && !ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.UnaryOperatorExpression))
				{
					tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Equal:
				if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.NamespaceReference) && !ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.XmlNamespaceReference) && Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators)
				{
					tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
				if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.AttributeSection) && !ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.XmlNamespaceReference) && !ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.XmlElementReference) && !ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.XmlReference) && Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators)
				{
					tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThenEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.MinusEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.PlusEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanGreaterThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.ColonEquals:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundTwoCharOperators)
				{
					tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.And:
			case FormattingTokenType.AndAlso:
			case FormattingTokenType.Like:
			case FormattingTokenType.Mod:
			case FormattingTokenType.Or:
			case FormattingTokenType.OrElse:
			case FormattingTokenType.Xor:
				tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void VBContextPoped(LanguageElement oldContext)
		{
			if (oldContext != null && !oldContext.IsRemoved && (base.StatementGen == null || !base.StatementGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.TypeDeclarationGen == null || !base.TypeDeclarationGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.MemberGen == null || !base.MemberGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.NamespaceReferenceGen == null || !base.NamespaceReferenceGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.NamespaceGen == null || !base.NamespaceGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.ExpressionGen == null || !base.ExpressionGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.SupportElementGen == null || !base.SupportElementGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.XmlGen == null || !base.XmlGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && base.DirectiveGen != null)
			{
				base.DirectiveGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext);
			}
		}

		private bool ContextIsEmptyArgumentList()
		{
			if (base.Context is IWithArguments withArguments)
			{
				if (withArguments.Args != null)
				{
					return withArguments.Args.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ContextIsNotEmptyArgumentList()
		{
			if (base.Context is IWithArguments { Args: not null } withArguments)
			{
				return withArguments.Args.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override HtmlXmlCodeGenBase CreateHtmlXmlGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override TemplateParameterCodeGenBase CreateTemplateParameterGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override TemplateCodeGenBase CreateTemplateGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override DirectiveCodeGenBase CreateDirectiveGen()
		{
			return new VBDirectiveCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override ExpressionCodeGenBase CreateExpressionGen()
		{
			return new VBExpressionCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override MemberCodeGenBase CreateMemberGen()
		{
			return new VBMemberCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override StatementCodeGenBase CreateStatementGen()
		{
			return new VBStatementCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override SupportElementCodeGenBase CreateSupportElementGen()
		{
			return new VBSupportElementCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase CreateTypeDeclarationGen()
		{
			return new VBTypeDeclarationCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override XmlCodeGenBase CreateXmlGen()
		{
			return new VBXmlCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override NamespaceReferenceGenBase CreateNamespaceReferenceGen()
		{
			return new VBNamespaceReferenceGen(this);
		}

		protected override NamespaceGenBase CreateNamespaceGen()
		{
			return new VBNamespaceGen(this);
		}

		protected override SnippetCodeGenBase CreateSnippetGen()
		{
			return new VBSnippetCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override bool IsSpecificElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ArrayNameModifier || element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CaseClause || element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CaseClausesList)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsFirstTypeAncestor(LanguageElement context, TypeDeclaration type)
		{
			if (context == null || type == null || type.SecondaryAncestorTypes == null || type.SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return type.SecondaryAncestorTypes[0] == context;
		}

		protected override bool IsFirst(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (base.IsFirst(context))
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeParameter)
			{
				TypeParameter typeParameter = (TypeParameter)parent;
				if (typeParameter == null || typeParameter.Constraints == null || typeParameter.Constraints.Count <= 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return IsFirst(typeParameter.Constraints, context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsLast(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (base.IsLast(context))
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeParameter)
			{
				TypeParameter typeParameter = (TypeParameter)parent;
				return IsLast(typeParameter.Constraints, context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsNotFirst(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (base.IsNotFirst(context))
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeParameter)
			{
				return IsNotFirst(((TypeParameter)parent).Constraints, context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool NeedIndenting(LanguageElement context, bool pushed)
		{
			if (base.NeedIndenting(context, pushed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeParameter)
			{
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint || (!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameterConstraints))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((TypeParameter)parent).Constraints.Contains(context);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool NeedWrapWithoutFirst(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (base.NeedWrapWithoutFirst(context))
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeParameter)
			{
				TypeParameter typeParameter = (TypeParameter)parent;
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameterConstraints)
				{
					return IsNotFirst(typeParameter.Constraints, context);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool NeedWrapFirst(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (base.NeedWrapFirst(context))
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeParameter)
			{
				return Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool NeedAlignment(LanguageElement context, bool pushed)
		{
			if (base.NeedAlignment(context, pushed))
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
			if (parent == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeParameter)
			{
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstTypeParameterConstraint)
				{
					return !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void GenerateSpecificElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ArrayNameModifier)
				{
					GenerateArrayNameModifier(element as ArrayNameModifier);
				}
				else if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CaseClause)
				{
					GenerateCaseClause(element as CaseClause);
				}
				else if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.CaseClausesList)
				{
					GenerateCaseClauseList(element as CaseClausesList);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ContextPushed()
		{
			Alignment(base.Context, pushed: true);
		}

		protected override void ContextPoped(LanguageElement oldContext)
		{
			Alignment(oldContext, pushed: false);
			VBContextPoped(oldContext);
		}

		protected override void AddWrappingNewLine()
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
		}

		protected bool ContextMatch(LanguageElementType type)
		{
			return base.Context.ElementType == type;
		}

		protected override void GenerateElementList(LanguageElement element)
		{
			base.ExpressionGen.GenerateElementCollection(element.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: true);
		}

		public void GenerateVisibility(MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			switch (visibility)
			{
			case MemberVisibility.Public:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Public);
				break;
			case MemberVisibility.Private:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Private);
				break;
			case MemberVisibility.Protected:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Protected);
				break;
			case MemberVisibility.Friend:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Friend);
				break;
			case MemberVisibility.ProtectedFriend:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Protected);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Friend);
				break;
			case MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal:
			case MemberVisibility.Internal:
			case MemberVisibility.Published:
				break;
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateMemberVisibilitySpecifier(MemberVisibilitySpecifier specifier)
		{
			if (specifier != null)
			{
				GenerateVisibility(specifier.MemberVisibility);
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (_FirstElement == null)
			{
				_FirstElement = element;
			}
			base.GenerateElement(element);
			if (_FirstElement == element && (element is Statement || (!element.IsDetailNode && element is IMemberElement && !(element is Param))) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Code.LastLine))
			{
				base.Code.WriteLine();
			}
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Async:
			case FormattingTokenType.Const:
			case FormattingTokenType.Continue:
			case FormattingTokenType.Do:
			case FormattingTokenType.Equals:
			case FormattingTokenType.Explicit:
			case FormattingTokenType.Extern:
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Is:
			case FormattingTokenType.Operator:
			case FormattingTokenType.OrderBy:
			case FormattingTokenType.Out:
			case FormattingTokenType.Private:
			case FormattingTokenType.Protected:
			case FormattingTokenType.Public:
			case FormattingTokenType.Return:
			case FormattingTokenType.Static:
			case FormattingTokenType.Using:
			case FormattingTokenType.While:
			case FormattingTokenType.Partial:
			case FormattingTokenType.Overloads:
			case FormattingTokenType.By:
			case FormattingTokenType.From:
			case FormattingTokenType.Select:
			case FormattingTokenType.On:
			case FormattingTokenType.Where:
			case FormattingTokenType.Join:
			case FormattingTokenType.Into:
			case FormattingTokenType.Group:
			case FormattingTokenType.Skip:
			case FormattingTokenType.Take:
			case FormattingTokenType.Aggregate:
			case FormattingTokenType.AddHandler:
			case FormattingTokenType.Alias:
			case FormattingTokenType.ByRef:
			case FormattingTokenType.ByVal:
			case FormattingTokenType.Declare:
			case FormattingTokenType.Dim:
			case FormattingTokenType.End:
			case FormattingTokenType.Erase:
			case FormattingTokenType.Error:
			case FormattingTokenType.Exit:
			case FormattingTokenType.Friend:
			case FormattingTokenType.GoTo:
			case FormattingTokenType.Handles:
			case FormattingTokenType.Implements:
			case FormattingTokenType.Lib:
			case FormattingTokenType.Of:
			case FormattingTokenType.Option:
			case FormattingTokenType.Overrides:
			case FormattingTokenType.ParamArray:
			case FormattingTokenType.ReDim:
			case FormattingTokenType.RemoveHandler:
			case FormattingTokenType.Resume:
			case FormattingTokenType.Shared:
			case FormattingTokenType.Step:
			case FormattingTokenType.SyncLock:
			case FormattingTokenType.To:
			case FormattingTokenType.When:
			case FormattingTokenType.With:
			case FormattingTokenType.WithEvents:
			case FormattingTokenType.Key:
			case FormattingTokenType.Infer:
			case FormattingTokenType.Strict:
			case FormattingTokenType.Compare:
			case FormattingTokenType.Until:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
				if (Options.Spacing.AfterComma && (base.Context.Parent == null || base.Context.Parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.ArrayCreateExpression) && (!(base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression2) || (!typeReferenceExpression2.IsUnbound && !typeReferenceExpression2.IsArrayType)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Try:
			case FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation:
				formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayInitializerBraces && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Dot:
				if (Options.Spacing.AfterDot)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				if (Options.Spacing.AfterTypeCastParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.CTypeExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInDeclaration && base.Context is IWithParameters)
				{
					formattingElements.AddDecreaseIndent();
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInInvocation && base.Context is IWithArguments)
				{
					formattingElements.AddDecreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeCastParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.CTypeExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankParentheses && base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = (TypeReferenceExpression)base.Context;
					if (typeReferenceExpression.Rank > 1)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankEmptyParentheses && base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = (TypeReferenceExpression)base.Context;
					if (typeReferenceExpression.Rank == 1)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArgumentsListParentheses && ContextIsNotEmptyArgumentList())
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinEmptyArgumentsListParentheses && ContextIsEmptyArgumentList())
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinExpressionParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ParenthesizedExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinMethodDeclarationParentheses && base.Context is Method { ParameterCount: >0 })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeArgumentParenthesis && base.Context is ReferenceExpressionBase { IsGeneric: not false })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeParameterParenthesis && base.Context is GenericModifier)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinAttributeBrackets && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.AttributeSection))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			AddOperatorTokens(tokenType, formattingElements);
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeComma)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Equals:
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Is:
			case FormattingTokenType.Lock:
			case FormattingTokenType.OrderBy:
			case FormattingTokenType.Order:
			case FormattingTokenType.Select:
			case FormattingTokenType.Where:
			case FormattingTokenType.Ascending:
			case FormattingTokenType.Alias:
			case FormattingTokenType.Handles:
			case FormattingTokenType.Lib:
			case FormattingTokenType.Step:
			case FormattingTokenType.To:
			case FormattingTokenType.When:
			case FormattingTokenType.Until:
			case FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.From:
				if (!(base.Context is FromExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression) && base.Context.Parent is ArrayCreateExpression)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayInitializerBraces && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Implements:
				if (base.Context is Method || base.Context is Property)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.With:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Dot:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeDot)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeCastParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.CTypeExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankParentheses && base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = (TypeReferenceExpression)base.Context;
					if (typeReferenceExpression.Rank > 1)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArrayRankEmptyParentheses && base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression2 = (TypeReferenceExpression)base.Context;
					if (typeReferenceExpression2.Rank == 1)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinArgumentsListParentheses && ContextIsNotEmptyArgumentList())
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinEmptyArgumentsListParentheses && ContextIsEmptyArgumentList())
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinEmptyMethodDeclarationParentheses && base.Context is Method { ParameterCount: 0 })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinExpressionParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ParenthesizedExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinMethodDeclarationParentheses && base.Context is Method { ParameterCount: >0 })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeArgumentParenthesis && base.Context is ReferenceExpressionBase { IsGeneric: not false })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeParameterParenthesis && base.Context is GenericModifier)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeCloseBraceInDeclaration && base.Context is IWithParameters)
				{
					AddWrappingNewLine();
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeCloseBraceInInvocation && base.Context is IWithArguments)
				{
					AddWrappingNewLine();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeArrayRankParentheses && base.Context is TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodCallWithArguments && ContextIsNotEmptyArgumentList())
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodCallWithoutArguments && ContextIsEmptyArgumentList())
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodWithParameters && base.Context is Method { ParameterCount: >0 })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodWithoutParameters && base.Context is Method { ParameterCount: 0 })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeTypeArgumentParenthesis && base.Context is ReferenceExpressionBase { IsGeneric: not false })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeTypeParameterParenthesis && base.Context is GenericModifier)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInDeclaration && base.Context is IWithParameters)
				{
					formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
					AddWrappingNewLine();
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInInvocation && base.Context is IWithArguments)
				{
					formattingElements.AddIncreaseIndent();
					AddWrappingNewLine();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeColonInLabels && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Label))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinAttributeBrackets && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.AttributeSection))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			AddOperatorTokens(tokenType, formattingElements);
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}

	public class VBExpressionCodeGen : TokenExpressionCodeGenBase
	{
		private CodeGen _HtmlCodeGen;

		private CodeGen HtmlCodeGen
		{
			get
			{
				if (_HtmlCodeGen == null)
				{
					_HtmlCodeGen = new HtmlXmlCodeGen(Options);
				}
				return _HtmlCodeGen;
			}
		}

		public VBExpressionCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		private string DeleteLastEOL(string str)
		{
			if (str == null || str == string.Empty || str.Length < 3)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = str.Length - 2;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			str = str.Substring(0, num);
			return str;
		}

		private bool IsNotNull(NodeList list)
		{
			if (list != null)
			{
				return list.Count != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParentIsValidForArrayBoundsGeneration(Expression exp)
		{
			if (exp == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = exp.Parent as Expression;
				if (languageElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (languageElement.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ObjectCreationExpression || languageElement.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ArrayCreateExpression)
				{
					break;
				}
				exp = languageElement as Expression;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void GenerateTypeCharacter(string name)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				switch (name.ToLower())
				{
				case "integer":
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Percent);
					break;
				case "long":
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Ampersand);
					break;
				case "single":
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Exclamation);
					break;
				case "double":
					Write(FormattingTokenType.NumberSign);
					break;
				case "decimal":
					Write(FormattingTokenType.At);
					break;
				case "string":
					Write(FormattingTokenType.DollarSign);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void GeneratesIntoTail(IIntoContainingElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Into);
				GenerateElementCollection(element.IntoElements, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateLambdaFunctionExpression(LambdaFunctionExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Function);
			GenerateParameters(expression.Parameters);
			if (expression.Type != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.As);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Type);
			}
			if (expression.NodeCount < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			Expression expression2 = expression.Nodes[0] as Expression;
			if (expression.NodeCount != 1 || expression2 == null || expression.Type != null)
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
				using (GetIndent())
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None, lineBreakAfterDelimiter: true);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.End, FormattingTokenType.Function);
			}
			else
			{
				CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression2);
			}
		}

		private void WrapQuery()
		{
			if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapQueryExpression)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
			}
			else
			{
				CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		private void GenerateJoinExpressionBase(JoinExpressionBase expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.InExpression);
			WrapQuery();
			if (expression.JoinExpressions != null && expression.JoinExpressions.Count > 0)
			{
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapQueryExpression)
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.JoinExpressions, FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.JoinExpressions);
				}
				WrapQuery();
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.On);
			if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapQueryExpression)
			{
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.EqualsExpressions, new FormattingTokenType[2]
				{
					FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation,
					FormattingTokenType.And
				});
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.EqualsExpressions, FormattingTokenType.And);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAwaitExpression(AwaitExpression awaitExpression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Await);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(awaitExpression.SourceExpression);
		}

		private void GenerateQueryaleCollectionReferenceExpression(QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override bool GenerateMacroExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool GenerateSpecificExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			switch (expression.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.DirectCastExpression:
				GenerateDirectCastExpression(expression as DirectCastExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CTypeExpression:
				GenerateCTypeExpression(expression as CTypeExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.CastTargetExpression:
				GenerateCastTargetExpression(expression as CastTargetExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.Is:
				GenerateIsExpression(expression as Is);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.IsNot:
				GenerateTypeCheck(expression as IsNot);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectCollectionInitializer:
				GenerateObjectCollectionInitializer(expression as ObjectCollectionInitializer);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.VbXmlExpression:
				GenerateXmlExpression(expression as XmlExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AggregateExpression:
				GenerateAggregateExpression(expression as AggregateExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.SkipExpression:
				GenerateSkipExpression(expression as SkipExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.SkipWhileExpression:
				GenerateSkipWhileExpression(expression as SkipWhileExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.TakeExpression:
				GenerateTakeExpression(expression as TakeExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.TakeWhileExpression:
				GenerateTakeWhileExpression(expression as TakeWhileExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.XmlAttributeReference:
				GenerateXmlAttributeReferenceExpression(expression as XmlAttributeReferenceExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.XmlElementReference:
				GenerateXmlElementReferenceExpression(expression as XmlElementReferenceExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ReDimExpression:
				GenerateReDimExpression(expression as ReDimExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.LambdaFunctionExpression:
				GenerateLambdaFunctionExpression(expression as LambdaFunctionExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.GetXmlNamespaceOperator:
				GenerateMethodCallExpression(expression as MethodCallExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AwaitExpression:
				GenerateAwaitExpression(expression as AwaitExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression:
				GenerateQueryaleCollectionReferenceExpression(expression as QueryableCollectionReferenceExpression);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateBinaryOperator(BinaryOperatorExpression expression)
		{
			FormattingTokenType binaryOperatorToken = GetBinaryOperatorToken(expression.BinaryOperator);
			if (binaryOperatorToken == FormattingTokenType.None && expression.OperatorText != null)
			{
				string text = $" {expression.OperatorText} ";
				Write(text);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(binaryOperatorToken);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateLogicalOperation(LogicalOperation expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
			FormattingTokenType binaryOperatorToken = GetBinaryOperatorToken(expression.BinaryOperator);
			if (binaryOperatorToken == FormattingTokenType.None && expression.OperatorText != null)
			{
				string text = $" {expression.OperatorText} ";
				Write(text);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(binaryOperatorToken);
				CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
			}
		}

		protected override string GetBinaryOperatorText(BinaryOperatorType operatorType)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected override FormattingTokenType GetBinaryOperatorToken(BinaryOperatorType op)
		{
			return op switch
			{
				BinaryOperatorType.Add => FormattingTokenType.Plus, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Assign => FormattingTokenType.Equal, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseAnd => FormattingTokenType.And, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BitwiseOr => FormattingTokenType.Or, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BooleanAnd => FormattingTokenType.AndAlso, 
				BinaryOperatorType.BooleanOr => FormattingTokenType.OrElse, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ExclusiveOr => FormattingTokenType.Xor, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Divide => FormattingTokenType.Slash, 
				BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThan => FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen, 
				BinaryOperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual => FormattingTokenType.GreaterThenEqual, 
				BinaryOperatorType.IdentityEquality => FormattingTokenType.Equal, 
				BinaryOperatorType.IdentityInequality => FormattingTokenType.LessThanGreaterThan, 
				BinaryOperatorType.LessThan => FormattingTokenType.LessThan, 
				BinaryOperatorType.LessThanOrEqual => FormattingTokenType.LessThanEqual, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Modulus => FormattingTokenType.Mod, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Multiply => FormattingTokenType.Asterisk, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Subtract => FormattingTokenType.Minus, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ValueEquality => FormattingTokenType.Equal, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Like => FormattingTokenType.Like, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Concatenation => FormattingTokenType.Ampersand, 
				BinaryOperatorType.Exponentiation => FormattingTokenType.Caret, 
				BinaryOperatorType.IntegerDivision => FormattingTokenType.BackSlash, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ShiftLeft => FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThan, 
				BinaryOperatorType.ShiftRight => FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThan, 
				_ => FormattingTokenType.None, 
			};
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypedElementReferenceExpression(TypedElementReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				GenerateElementReferenceExpression(expression);
				Write(expression.TypeCharacter.ToString());
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateMyClassExpression(MyClassExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.MyClass);
		}

		protected override void GenerateElementReferenceExpression(ElementReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (expression.IsKey)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Key);
				}
				base.GenerateElementReferenceExpression(expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateManagedArrayCreateExpression(ManagedArrayCreateExpression expression)
		{

		protected override void GenerateArrayCreateExpression(ArrayCreateExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.New);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.BaseType);
			bool flag = expression.BaseType != null && expression.BaseType.IsArrayType;
			if (!flag)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			}
			if (expression.Dimensions != null && expression.Dimensions.Count > 0)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Dimensions, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				if (flag)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Initializer);
		}

		protected override void GenerateArrayInitializerExpression(ArrayInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			bool placeOpenBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers;
			bool placeCloseBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers;
			using (GetIndent(placeOpenBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers))
			{
				if (placeOpenBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Initializers, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				if (placeCloseBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateAssignmentExpression(AssignmentExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			if (expression.AssignmentOperator == AssignmentOperatorType.PercentEquals)
			{
				GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(CodeGen, AssignmentOperatorType.Assignment);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Mod);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateAssignmentOperatorText(CodeGen, expression.AssignmentOperator);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
		}

		protected override bool IsEscapedString(string value)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void GenerateStringLiteral(string value)
		{
			GenerateStringLiteralCore(value, canHasEscapeConstants: false);
		}

		protected override void GenerateStringLiteralWithEscapeSequence(string value)
		{
			GenerateStringLiteralCore(value, canHasEscapeConstants: true);
		}

		protected override void GenerateCharLiteral(char value)
		{
			if (value == '\0')
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Char, FormattingTokenType.Dot);
				Write("MinValue");
			}
			else if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(value) || char.IsPunctuation(value))
			{
				Write("\"" + value + "\"C");
			}
			else
			{
				Write($"Microsoft.VisualBasic.ChrW({(int)value})");
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateNullLiteral()
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Nothing);
		}

		protected override void GenerateNumberLiteral(string name, object value, PrimitiveType type)
		{
			if (name != null && name != string.Empty)
			{
				Write(name);
				return;
			}
			string stringValue = GetStringValue(value);
			if (stringValue != null)
			{
				stringValue += VBPrimitiveTypeUtils.GetTypeSuffix(value, type);
				Write(stringValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateDateTime(object value)
		{
			if ((DateTime)value == DateTime.MinValue)
			{
				Write("#1/1/1#");
				return;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)value;
			Write(FormattingTokenType.NumberSign);
			bool flag = false;
			if (dateTime.Year != 1 || dateTime.Month != 1 || dateTime.Day != 1)
			{
				Write($"{dateTime.Month}/{dateTime.Day}/{dateTime.Year}");
				flag = true;
			}
			if (dateTime.Hour > 0 || dateTime.Minute > 0)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					Write(" ");
				}
				Write($"{dateTime.Hour}:{dateTime.Minute}");
				if (dateTime.Second > 0)
				{
					Write($":{dateTime.Second}");
				}
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.NumberSign);
		}

		protected override void GenerateThisReferenceExpression(ThisReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Me);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeCastExpression(TypeCastExpression expression)

		protected override void GenerateTypeOfIsExpression(TypeOfIsExpression expression)
		{

			Write(FormattingTokenType.Is);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TypeReference);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeReferenceExpression(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.BaseType != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.BaseType);
			}
			if (expression.Name != null && expression.Name.Length > 0)
			{
				if (expression.BaseType != null)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Dot);
				}
				if (expression.IsTypeCharacter && expression.BaseType == null)
				{
					GenerateTypeCharacter(expression.Name);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateTypeString(expression.Name);
				}
			}
			if (expression.IsGeneric)
			{
				GenerateGenericTypeArguments(expression.TypeArguments);
			}
			if (expression.IsNullable)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Question);
			}
			else if (expression.IsUnbound)
			{
				int typeArity = expression.TypeArity;
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen, FormattingTokenType.Of);
				for (int i = 0; i < typeArity - 1; i++)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!expression.IsArrayType)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag = ParentIsValidForArrayBoundsGeneration(expression);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
				int rank = expression.Rank;
				ExpressionCollection arrayBounds = expression.ArrayBounds;
				int num = 0;
				if (flag && arrayBounds != null)
				{
					num = arrayBounds.Count;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < rank; j++)
				{
					if (j != 0)
					{
						Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
					}
					if (num > j)
					{
						if (j != 0 && Options.Spacing.AfterComma)
						{
							CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
						}
						CodeGen.GenerateElement(arrayBounds[j]);
					}
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateLogicalInversion(LogicalInversion expression)

		protected override void GenerateConditionalTypeCast(ConditionalTypeCast expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Expression leftSide = expression.LeftSide;
				Expression rightSide = expression.RightSide;
				if (expression.IsIfOperator)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.IIf, FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen, FormattingTokenType.TypeOf);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(leftSide);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Is);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(rightSide);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma, FormattingTokenType.CType, FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(leftSide);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(rightSide);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose, FormattingTokenType.Comma, FormattingTokenType.Nothing, FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
				}
				else
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.TryCast, FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(leftSide);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(rightSide);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateLambdaExpression(LambdaExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.IsAsynchronous)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Async);
			}
			if (expression.IsFunction)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Function);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Sub);
			}
			GenerateParameters(expression.Parameters);
			bool flag = (int)expression.Range.LineCount > 1 || expression.NodeCount > 1;
			if (flag)
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			}
			else
			{
				CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
			}
			using (GetIndent())
			{
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None, flag);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.End);
				if (expression.IsFunction)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Function);
				}
				else
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Sub);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlElementReferenceExpression(XmlElementReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (expression.IsKey)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Key);
				}
				FormattingTokenType delimiter = FormattingTokenType.Do;
				if (expression.XmlReferenceType == XmlReferenceType.TripleDot)
				{
					delimiter = FormattingTokenType.DotDotDot;
				}
				GenerateReferenceExpressionBase(expression, FormattingTokenType.LessThan, FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen, delimiter);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlAttributeReferenceExpression(XmlAttributeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (expression.IsKey)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Key);
				}
				GenerateReferenceExpressionBase(expression, FormattingTokenType.At, FormattingTokenType.None, FormattingTokenType.Dot);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateXmlExpression(XmlExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null || expression.Nodes == null || expression.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < expression.NodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (!(expression.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (HtmlCodeGen == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				string text = HtmlCodeGen.GenerateCode(languageElement);
				if (text != null)
				{
					text = DeleteLastEOL(text);
					if (text != null && text != string.Empty)
					{
						Write(text);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateIsExpression(Is expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Is);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
		}

			}
		}

		protected void GenerateAggregateExpression(AggregateExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Aggregate);
			GenerateElementCollection(expression.InExpressions, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			WrapQuery();
			if (IsNotNull(expression.QueryOperators))
			{
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapQueryExpression)
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.QueryOperators, FormattingTokenType.LineContinuation);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.QueryOperators);
				}
				WrapQuery();
			}
			GeneratesIntoTail(expression);
		}
