	public enum ContinueKind : byte
	{
		Unknown,
		Do,
		For,
		While
	}
	public class VBContinue : Continue
	{
		private ContinueKind _ContinueKind;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Continue;

		public ContinueKind ContinueKind => _ContinueKind;

		public VBContinue()
		{
		}

		public VBContinue(ContinueKind continueKind)
		{
			_ContinueKind = continueKind;
		}

		public VBContinue(Token continueKind, SourceRange range)
		{
			if (continueKind != null)
			{
				_ContinueKind = ToContinueKind(continueKind.Type);
			}
			SetRange(range);
		}

		private ContinueKind ToContinueKind(int tokenType)
		{
			return tokenType switch
			{
				33 => ContinueKind.Do, 
				51 => ContinueKind.For, 
				112 => ContinueKind.While, 
				_ => ContinueKind.Unknown, 
			};
		}

		private bool MatchesContinueKind(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (ContinueKind)
			{
			case ContinueKind.Do:
				return element is Do;
			case ContinueKind.For:
				if (!(element is VBFor))
				{
					return element is VBForEach;
				}
				return true;
			case ContinueKind.While:
				return element is While;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
				if (source is VBContinue)
				{
					VBContinue vBContinue = (VBContinue)source;
					_ContinueKind = vBContinue._ContinueKind;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Continue";
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 80;
		}

		public override LanguageElement FindTarget()
		{
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			LanguageElement languageElement2 = base.ParentLoop;
			if (ContinueKind == ContinueKind.Unknown)
			{
				return languageElement2;
			}
			while (languageElement == null && languageElement2 != null)
			{
				if (MatchesContinueKind(languageElement2))
				{
					languageElement = languageElement2;
					continue;
				}
				if (ElementFilters.IsMember(languageElement2))
				{
					languageElement = languageElement2;
				}
				languageElement2 = languageElement2.Parent;
			}
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = base.ParentLoop;
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			VBContinue vBContinue = new VBContinue();
			vBContinue.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return vBContinue;
		}
	}
	public class ExitStatement : Exit
	{
		public ExitStatement()
		{
		}

		public ExitStatement(string exitKind, SourceRange range)
			: base(exitKind, range)
		{
		}

		public override ExitKind ResolveExitKind(string exitKind)
		{
			return exitKind.ToLower() switch
			{
				"do" => ExitKind.Do, 
				"for" => ExitKind.For, 
				"while" => ExitKind.While, 
				"select" => ExitKind.Select, 
				"sub" => ExitKind.Sub, 
				"function" => ExitKind.Function, 
				"property" => ExitKind.Property, 
				"try" => ExitKind.Try, 
				_ => ExitKind.Try, 
			};
		}

		public override bool MatchesExitKind(LanguageElement target)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			switch (base.ExitKind)
			{
			case ExitKind.Do:
				return target is Do;
			case ExitKind.For:
				return target is VBFor || target is VBForEach;
			case ExitKind.While:
				return target is While;
			case ExitKind.Select:
				return target is Switch;
			case ExitKind.Sub:
			case ExitKind.Function:
				return target is Method;
			case ExitKind.Property:
				return target is PropertyAccessor;
			case ExitKind.Try:
				return target is Try;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			ExitStatement exitStatement = new ExitStatement();
			exitStatement.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return exitStatement;
		}
	}
	public class VBMethod : Method
	{
		public override MemberVisibility[] ValidVisibilities
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.IsClassOperator)
				{
					return new MemberVisibility[1] { MemberVisibility.Public };
				}
				MemberVisibility[] baseValidVisibilities = base.BaseValidVisibilities;
				if (base.IsOverride | base.IsVirtual)
				{
					baseValidVisibilities = base.ValidVisibilities;
					if (baseValidVisibilities == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					List<MemberVisibility> list = new List<MemberVisibility>();
					MemberVisibility[] array = baseValidVisibilities;
					foreach (MemberVisibility memberVisibility in array)
					{
						if (memberVisibility != MemberVisibility.Private)
						{
							list.Add(memberVisibility);
						}
					}
					return list.ToArray();
				}
				return baseValidVisibilities;
			}
		}

		public override bool VisibilityIsFixed
		{
			get
			{
				if ((IsStatic && base.IsConstructor) || base.IsDestructor || base.IsClassOperator)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public VBMethod()
		{
		}

		public VBMethod(string typeName, string name)
			: base(typeName, name)
		{
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (base.MethodType == MethodTypeEnum.Void)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("Sub ");
			}
			if (base.MethodType == MethodTypeEnum.Function)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("Function ");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(InternalName + "(");
			if (base.Parameters != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Parameters.Count; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0} As {1}{2}", ((Param)base.Parameters[i]).InternalName, ((Param)base.Parameters[i]).ParamType, (i == base.Parameters.Count - 1) ? "" : ",");
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(")");
			if (base.MethodType == MethodTypeEnum.Function)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" As " + base.MemberType);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			VBMethod vBMethod = new VBMethod();
			vBMethod.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return vBMethod;
		}
	}

	public class Error : FlowBreak
	{
		private Expression _Expression;

		public override LanguageElementType ElementType => LanguageElementType.Statement;

		public Expression Expression => _Expression;

		public Error()
		{
		}

		public Error(Expression expression)
		{
			_Expression = expression;
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is Error))
			{
				return;
			}
			Error error = (Error)source;
			if (error._Expression != null)
			{
				_Expression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, error, error._Expression) as Expression;
				if (_Expression == null)
				{
					_Expression = error._Expression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_Expression == oldElement)
			{
				_Expression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 86;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "Error";
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			Error error = new Error();
			error.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return error;
		}
	}
	public class VBFor : For
	{
		private NodeList _NextExpressionList;

		public new NodeList NextExpressionList
		{
			get
			{
				return _NextExpressionList;
			}
			set
			{
				_NextExpressionList = value;
			}
		}

		public override void AddNextExpression(LanguageElement element)
		{
			base.AddNextExpression(element);
			_NextExpressionList.Add(element);
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is VBFor))
			{
				return;
			}
			VBFor vBFor = (VBFor)source;
			if (vBFor._NextExpressionList != null)
			{
				_NextExpressionList = new NodeList();
				ParserUtils.GetClonesFromNodes(DetailNodes, vBFor.DetailNodes, _NextExpressionList, vBFor._NextExpressionList);
				if (_NextExpressionList.Count == 0 && vBFor._NextExpressionList.Count > 0)
				{
					_NextExpressionList = vBFor._NextExpressionList.DeepClone(options);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_NextExpressionList != null && _NextExpressionList.Contains(oldElement))
			{
				_NextExpressionList.Replace(oldElement, newElement);
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
			if (_NextExpressionList != null)
			{
				_NextExpressionList.Clear();
				_NextExpressionList = null;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "For";
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			VBFor vBFor = new VBFor();
			vBFor.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return vBFor;
		}
	}
	public class VBForEach : ForEach
	{
		private Expression _NextExpression;

		private LanguageElement _Initializer;

		public LanguageElement Initializer
		{
			get
			{
				return _Initializer;
			}
			set
			{
				SetInitializer(value);
			}
		}

		public override Expression NextExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _NextExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetNextExpression(value);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetInitializer(LanguageElement value)
		{
			base.SetInitializer(value);
			_Initializer?.RemoveFromParent();
			_Initializer = value;
			if (_Initializer != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_Initializer);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetNextExpression(Expression value)
		{
			base.SetNextExpression(value);
			_NextExpression?.RemoveFromParent();
			_NextExpression = value;
			if (_NextExpression != null)
			{
				AddDetailNode(_NextExpression);
			}
		}

		protected override void ReplaceOwnedReference(LanguageElement oldElement, LanguageElement newElement)
		{
			if (_NextExpression == oldElement)
			{
				_NextExpression = newElement as Expression;
			}
			else if (_Initializer == oldElement)
			{
				_Initializer = newElement;
			}
			else
			{
				base.ReplaceOwnedReference(oldElement, newElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void CloneDataFrom(BaseElement source, ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.CloneDataFrom(source, options);
			if (!(source is VBForEach))
			{
				return;
			}
			VBForEach vBForEach = (VBForEach)source;
			if (vBForEach._NextExpression != null)
			{
				_NextExpression = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, vBForEach, vBForEach._NextExpression) as Expression;
				if (_NextExpression == null)
				{
					_NextExpression = vBForEach._NextExpression.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
			if (vBForEach._Initializer != null)
			{
				_Initializer = ParserUtils.GetCloneFromNodes(this, vBForEach, vBForEach._Initializer) as Expression;
				if (_Initializer == null)
				{
					_Initializer = vBForEach._Initializer.Clone(options) as Expression;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "For Each";
		}

		public override void CleanUpOwnedReferences()
		{
			base.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
			if (_Initializer != null)
			{
				_Initializer.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_Initializer = null;
			}
			if (_NextExpression != null)
			{
				_NextExpression.CleanUpOwnedReferences();
				_NextExpression = null;
			}
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			VBForEach vBForEach = new VBForEach();
			vBForEach.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return vBForEach;
		}
	}
	public class VBEvent : Event
	{
		private IElementCollection _ImplicitElements;

		public override MemberVisibility[] ValidVisibilities => base.BaseValidVisibilities;

		public override bool VisibilityIsFixed
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsStatic)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override IElementCollection ImplicitElements
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ImplicitElements == null)
				{
					_ImplicitElements = GetImplicitElements();
				}
				return _ImplicitElements;
			}
		}

		public VBEvent()
		{
		}

		public VBEvent(string name)
			: base(name)
		{
		}

		private DelegateDefinition GetEventDelegate()
		{
			string name = Name + "EventHandler";
			DelegateDefinition delegateDefinition = new DelegateDefinition(name);
			if (base.Parameters != null)
			{
				foreach (Param parameter2 in base.Parameters)
				{
					if (parameter2 != null && parameter2.Clone() is Param parameter)
					{
						delegateDefinition.AddParameter(parameter);
					}
				}
			}
			delegateDefinition.Visibility = Visibility;
			delegateDefinition.SetRange(base.Range);
			delegateDefinition.SetNameRange(NameRange);
			delegateDefinition.SetParent(this);
			return delegateDefinition;
		}

		private Variable GetEventField(TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			Variable variable = new Variable(Name + "Event");
			if (type != null)
			{
				variable.MemberType = type.Name;
				variable.SetMemberTypeReference(type);
			}
			variable.Visibility = MemberVisibility.Private;
			variable.SetRange(base.Range);
			variable.SetNameRange(NameRange);
			variable.SetParent(this);
			return variable;
		}

		private IElementCollection GetImplicitElements()
		{
			IElementCollection elementCollection = new IElementCollection();
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = null;
			if (base.MemberTypeReference == null)
			{
				DelegateDefinition eventDelegate = GetEventDelegate();
				elementCollection.Add(eventDelegate);
				typeReferenceExpression = new TypeReferenceExpression(eventDelegate.Name);
			}
			else
			{
				typeReferenceExpression = base.MemberTypeReference.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression;
			}
			if (typeReferenceExpression == null)
			{
				return elementCollection;
			}
			Variable eventField = GetEventField(typeReferenceExpression.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression);
			elementCollection.Add(eventField);
			return elementCollection;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			VBEvent vBEvent = new VBEvent();
			vBEvent.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return vBEvent;
		}
	}

		protected override void SetUpLineContinuationCheckState()

			_ImplicitLineContinuationAfterTokenTable[26] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationAfterTokenTable[37] = true;
		}

		private void FillImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable()
		{
			int num = _ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[i] = false;
			}
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[36] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[34] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[235] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[232] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[228] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[128] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[226] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[236] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[237] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[222] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[119] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[225] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[150] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[229] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[230] = true;
			_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[223] = true;
		}

		private bool IsImplicitLineContinuationAfterToken(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			if (type > 248 || type < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _ImplicitLineContinuationAfterTokenTable[type];
		}

		private bool IsImplicitLineContinuationBeforeToken(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			if (type > 248 || type < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_ImplicitLineContinuationBeforeTokenTable[type])
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (type == 226 && Peek().Type != 227)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void Get()
		{
			base.Get();
			if (tToken.Match(187) || !base.CheckImplicitLineContinuations)
			{
				return;
			}
			Token token = tToken;
			if (IsImplicitLineContinuationAfterToken(tToken))
			{
				while (la.Match(1))
				{
					base.Get();
				}
			}
			if (la.Type == 1 && IsImplicitLineContinuationBeforeToken(GetPeek()))
			{
				while (la.Type == 1)
				{
					base.Get();
				}
			}
			tToken = token;
		}
	}

	public class DeclarationsCache
	{
		private ArrayList _Scopes;

		private Hashtable _VisibleDeclarations;

		private Hashtable ActiveScope
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Scopes == null || _Scopes.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int index = _Scopes.Count - 1;
				return _Scopes[index] as Hashtable;
			}
		}

		public DeclarationsCache()
		{
			_Scopes = new ArrayList();
			_VisibleDeclarations = new Hashtable();
		}

		public DeclarationsCache GetClone()
		{
			DeclarationsCache declarationsCache = new DeclarationsCache();
			declarationsCache._Scopes = _Scopes.Clone() as ArrayList;
			declarationsCache._VisibleDeclarations = _VisibleDeclarations.Clone() as Hashtable;
			return declarationsCache;
		}

		public void AddDeclaration(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Hashtable activeScope = ActiveScope;
			if (activeScope != null)
			{
				string name = element.Name;
				if (name != null)
				{
					activeScope[element.Name] = element;
				}
			}
		}

		public void OpenScope()
		{
			if (_Scopes != null)
			{
				Hashtable value = HashtableUtils.CreateHashtable(caseSensitive: false);
				_Scopes.Add(value);
			}
		}

		public void CloseScope()
		{
			if (_Scopes != null && _Scopes.Count != 0)
			{
				int index = _Scopes.Count - 1;
				_Scopes.RemoveAt(index);
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement GetDeclaration(string name)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = _Scopes.Count - 1;
			for (int num2 = num; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (_Scopes[num2] is Hashtable hashtable && hashtable.Contains(name))
				{
					return hashtable[name] as LanguageElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool HasDeclaration(string name)
		{
			return GetDeclaration(name) != null;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			_Scopes.Clear();
			_VisibleDeclarations.Clear();
		}

		public void Remove(LanguageElement element)
		{
			Hashtable activeScope = ActiveScope;
			if (activeScope != null && element != null && element.Name != null && !(element.Name == string.Empty))
			{
				activeScope.Remove(element.Name);
			}
		}
	}

	public class MethodHelper
	{
		public bool IsMustInherit;

		private TokenQueueBase _Modifiers;

		public MethodHelper(TokenQueueBase modifiers)
		{
			_Modifiers = modifiers;
		}

		public bool WithoutBody()
		{
			if (_Modifiers == null || _Modifiers.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = _Modifiers.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Token token = _Modifiers.Peek(i);
				if (token.Type == 137)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class VariableNameCollection : CollectionBase
	{
		private class NestedVarColl
		{
			public VBDeclarator Declarator;

			public string Name;

			public SourceRange Range = SourceRange.Empty;

			public SourceRange NameRange = SourceRange.Empty;

			public NestedVarColl(VBDeclarator decl, string name, SourceRange range, SourceRange nameRange)
			{
				Declarator = decl;
				Name = name;
				Range = range;
				NameRange = nameRange;
			}
		}

		public new int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.InnerList == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return base.InnerList.Count;
			}
		}

		public string this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.InnerList == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!(base.InnerList[index] is NestedVarColl nestedVarColl))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return nestedVarColl.Name;
			}
		}

		public void Add(string name, VBDeclarator decl, SourceRange range, SourceRange nameRange)
		{
			NestedVarColl value = new NestedVarColl(decl, name, range, nameRange);
			base.InnerList.Add(value);
		}

		public VBDeclarator GetDeclarator(int index)
		{
			if (base.InnerList == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(base.InnerList[index] is NestedVarColl nestedVarColl))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return nestedVarColl.Declarator;
		}

		public SourceRange GetRange(int index)
		{
			if (base.InnerList == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			if (!(base.InnerList[index] is NestedVarColl nestedVarColl))
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			return nestedVarColl.Range;
		}

		public SourceRange GetNameRange(int index)
		{
			if (base.InnerList == null)
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			if (!(base.InnerList[index] is NestedVarColl nestedVarColl))
			{
				return SourceRange.Empty;
			}
			return nestedVarColl.NameRange;
		}
	}

	public class LocalVarArrayCollection
	{
		private StringCollection _VarNames;

		public void AddVarArrayName(BaseVariable var)
		{
			if (var == null || var.Name == null || var.Name == string.Empty)
			{
				return;
			}
			TypeReferenceExpression memberTypeReference = var.MemberTypeReference;
			if (memberTypeReference == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!memberTypeReference.IsArrayType)
			{
				LanguageElementCollection arrayNameModifiers = var.ArrayNameModifiers;
				if (arrayNameModifiers == null && arrayNameModifiers.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			string name = var.Name;
			if (_VarNames == null)
			{
				_VarNames = new StringCollection();
			}
			_VarNames.Add(name);
		}

		public bool IsVarArrayName(string name)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (_VarNames != null)
			{
				_VarNames.Clear();
			}
		}
	}

			get
			{
				return _PrevChar;
			}
			set
			{
				_PrevChar = value;
			}
		}

		protected Token Tokens
		{
			get
			{
				return tokens;
			}
			set
			{
				tokens = value;
			}
		}

		protected char Ch
		{
			get
			{
				return ch;
			}
			set
			{
				ch = value;
			}
		}

		public char CurrentChar
		{
			get
			{
				return ch;
			}
			set
			{
				ch = value;
			}
		}

		private void AddCharsFromPeek(string str)
		{
			if (str != null && !(str == string.Empty) && CharsFromPeekTokens != null)
			{
				CharsFromPeekTokens += str;
			}
		}

		private ArrayList GetXmlTokens(Token peekToken, int startIndex)
		{
			if (peekToken == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			while (peekToken != null)
			{
				if (peekToken.StartPosition >= startIndex)
				{
					arrayList.Add(peekToken);
				}
				peekToken = peekToken.Next;
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private string GetIntervalValue(SourceRange fRange, SourceRange sRange)
		{
			if (fRange == SourceRange.Empty || sRange == SourceRange.Empty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return GetIntervalValue(fRange.End, sRange.Start);
		}

		private string GetIntervalValue(SourcePoint fPoint, SourcePoint sPoint)
		{
			if (fPoint == SourcePoint.Empty || sPoint == SourcePoint.Empty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (fPoint.Line == sPoint.Line)
			{
				int count = sPoint.Line - fPoint.Line;
				return GetWhitespaces(count);
			}
			int count2 = sPoint.Offset - fPoint.Offset;
			empty = GetLineTerms(count2);
			return empty + GetWhitespaces(sPoint.Offset);
		}

		private string GetLineTerms(int count)
		{
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = string.Empty;
			string text2 = "\r\n";
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				text += text2;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetWhitespaces(int count)
		{
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return new string(' ', count);
		}

		private char GetCharsInPeekTokens()
		{
			if (!HasCharsInPeekTokens())
			{
				_CharPeekIndex++;
				return ' ';
			}
			char result = CharsFromPeekTokens[_CharPeekIndex + CharIndex - 1];
			_CharPeekIndex++;
			return result;
		}

		private bool HasCharsInPeekTokens()
		{
			if (CharsFromPeekTokens == string.Empty || CharsFromPeekTokens == null || (CharIndex != 0 && CharsFromPeekTokens.Length <= _CharPeekIndex + CharIndex - 1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected char PeekChar(out bool correctChar)
		{
			correctChar = true;
			return _Scanner.CharProvider.Peek();
		}

		protected void NextCh()
		{
			_PrevChar = ch;
			_Scanner.NextChar();
			ch = _Scanner.CharValue;
		}

		protected void SetCharFromScanner()
		{
			_PrevChar = ch;
			ch = _Scanner.CharValue;
		}

		protected void ResetCharPeek()
		{
			_Scanner.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
		}

		protected void ResetCharsFromPeekTokens()
		{
			CharIndex = 0;
			CharsFromPeekTokens = string.Empty;
		}

		protected void SetCharsFromPeekTokens(ArrayList xmlTokens)
		{
			if (xmlTokens == null || xmlTokens.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResetCharsFromPeekTokens();
			int num = xmlTokens.Count - 1;
			for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
			{
				Token fToken = xmlTokens[i] as Token;
				Token sToken = null;
				if (i + 1 <= num)
				{
					sToken = xmlTokens[i + 1] as Token;
				}
				SetCharsFromPeekTokens(fToken, sToken);
			}
		}

		protected void SetCharsFromPeekTokens(Token fToken, Token sToken)
		{
			if (fToken != null)
			{
				AddCharsFromPeek(fToken.Value);
				if (sToken != null)
				{
					string intervalValue = GetIntervalValue(fToken.Range, sToken.Range);
					AddCharsFromPeek(intervalValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ResetPeekIndex()
		{
			_CharPeekIndex = 1;
		}

		protected bool IsEof()
		{
			return IsEof(ch);
		}

		protected bool IsEof(char chr)
		{
			if (chr != '\uffff')
			{
				return chr == '\u0081';
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void DeletePeekElements(int startIndex, string peekString)
		{
			if (startIndex <= 0 || tokens == null || tokens == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Token next = tokens;
			int num = 0;
			ArrayList xmlTokens = GetXmlTokens(next, startIndex);
			while (next.Next != null)
			{
				num = next.Next.StartPosition;
				if (num >= startIndex)
				{
					next.Next = null;
					break;
				}
				next = next.Next;
			}
			if (xmlTokens != null && xmlTokens.Count != 0)
			{
				SetCharsFromPeekTokens(xmlTokens);
				if (peekString != null && peekString != string.Empty && CharsFromPeekTokens.IndexOf(peekString) != 0)
				{
					CharsFromPeekTokens = peekString + CharsFromPeekTokens;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CharsFromPeekTokens = peekString;
			}
		}

		protected char GetPeekChar(out bool correctChar)
		{
			ResetPeekIndex();
			correctChar = false;
			if (HasCharsInPeekTokens())
			{
				correctChar = true;
				return GetCharsInPeekTokens();
			}
			if (Ch != _Scanner.CharValue)
			{
				correctChar = true;
				return _Scanner.CharValue;
			}
			ResetCharPeek();
			char c = PeekChar(out correctChar);
			if (IsEof(c) || !correctChar)
			{
				return c;
			}
			correctChar = true;
			return c;
		}

		protected char GetPeekCharCore(out bool correctChar)
		{
			correctChar = false;
			if (HasCharsInPeekTokens())
			{
				correctChar = true;
				return GetCharsInPeekTokens();
			}
			return PeekChar(out correctChar);
		}

		public void SetScanner(VBScannerBase scanner)
		{
			_Scanner = scanner;
		}
	}
	public abstract class VBScannerBase : GeneratedScannerBase
	{
		private const char EOT = '\u0081';

		private XmlString _XmlString;

		public virtual char CharValue => ch;

		public VBScannerBase(string input)
			: this(new SourceStringReader(input))
		{
		}

		public VBScannerBase(ISourceReader reader)
			: this(reader, reader.StartLine, reader.StartColumn)
		{
		}

		public VBScannerBase(ISourceReader reader, int line, int offset)
		{
			if (line <= 0)
			{
				line = 1;
			}
			if (offset <= 0)
			{
				offset = 1;
			}
			_XmlString = new XmlString();
			Initialize(reader);
			pt = (tokens = CreateToken());
			_XmlString.SetScanner(this);
		}

		private void SeparateTypeCharacterFromId(string source, out string idText, out string typeCharText)
		{
			idText = string.Empty;
			typeCharText = string.Empty;
			if (source != null && source.Length != 0)
			{
				int length = source.Length;
				idText = source.Substring(0, length - 1);
				typeCharText = source.Substring(length - 1, 1);
			}
		}

		private void SetTokenProperties(Token token, int tokenType, int startPosition, int endPosition, int line, int column, int endLine, int endColumn, string tokenText)
		{
			token.StartPosition = startPosition;
			token.EndPosition = endPosition;
			token.Line = line;
			token.Column = column;
			token.EndLine = endLine;
			token.EndColumn = endColumn;
			token.Type = tokenType;
			token.Value = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(tokenText);
		}

		private bool IdentifierContainsTypeCharacter(string tokenText)
		{
			if (tokenText == null || tokenText.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = tokenText[tokenText.Length - 1];
			if (c != '%' && c != '&' && c != '@' && c != '!' && c != '#')
			{
				return c == '$';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int GetTokenTypeForTypeCharacter(string typeCharText)
		{
			if (typeCharText == null || typeCharText.Length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return typeCharText switch
			{
				"%" => 246, 
				"&" => 50, 
				"@" => 242, 
				"!" => 45, 
				"#" => 51, 
				"$" => 245, 
				_ => -1, 
			};
		}

		private Token GetTokenForIdentifierWithTypeCharacter(Token token)
		{
			Token token2 = CreateToken();
			Token token3 = (token2.Next = CreateToken());
			string idText = string.Empty;
			string typeCharText = string.Empty;
			SeparateTypeCharacterFromId(token.Value, out idText, out typeCharText);
			SetTokenProperties(token2, 4, token.StartPosition, token.EndPosition - 1, token.Line, token.Column, token.EndLine, token.EndColumn - 1, idText);
			SetTokenProperties(token3, GetTokenTypeForTypeCharacter(typeCharText), token.EndPosition - 1, token.EndPosition, token.Line, token.EndColumn - 1, token.EndLine, token.EndColumn, typeCharText);
			return token2;
		}

		protected Token GetToken(Token token)
		{
			string value = token.Value;
			if (token.Type == 4 && IdentifierContainsTypeCharacter(value))
			{
				return GetTokenForIdentifierWithTypeCharacter(token);
			}
			return token;
		}

		private void SkipWs()
		{
			while (ch == ' ' || ch == '\t')
			{
				NextCh();
			}
		}

		private bool IsLineTerminator()
		{
			if (ch == '\r')
			{
				NextCh();
				if (ch == '\n')
				{
					NextCh();
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (ch == '\n')
			{
				NextCh();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Token CreateToken()
		{
			return new FormattingToken(TokenLanguage.Basic);
		}

		protected override void NextTokenEnd()
		{
			if (t != null && t.Type == 15 && t.Value.StartsWith("'''"))
			{
				t.Type = 247;
			}
		}

		protected override Token NextToken()
		{
			Token token = base.NextToken();
			if (token != null)
			{
				return GetToken(token);
			}
			return token;
		}

		public char GetTypeCharacter()
		{
			return ch;
		}

		public string GetXmlString(int startBufferIndex, string peekString)
		{
			_XmlString.CurrentChar = CharValue;
			string xmlString = _XmlString.GetXmlString(startBufferIndex, peekString, tokens);
			NextChar();
			return xmlString;
		}

		public string GetXmlString(int startBufferIndex)
		{
			_XmlString.CurrentChar = CharValue;
			string xmlString = _XmlString.GetXmlString(startBufferIndex, tokens);
			NextChar();
			return xmlString;
		}

		public string GetXmlImports(int startBufferIndex)
		{
			return GetXmlOneTag(startBufferIndex);
		}

		public string GetXmlOneTag(int startBufferIndex)
		{
			_XmlString.CurrentChar = CharValue;
			string xmlOneTag = _XmlString.GetXmlOneTag(startBufferIndex, tokens);
			if (ch != '>')
			{
				NextChar();
			}
			return xmlOneTag;
		}

		public void ResetNextChCounter()
		{
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
		}

		public void NextChar()
		{
			NextCh();
		}

		public bool IsEof()
		{
			if (!IsNextChar('\uffff'))
			{
				return IsNextChar('\u0081');
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void SkipToEOL()
		{
			while (!IsLineTerminator() && !IsEof())
			{
				NextCh();
			}
		}

		public bool IsNextChar(char c)
		{
			SkipWs();
			return ch == c;
		}
	}
	public class XmlString : AdaptedScannerBase
	{
		private const int XML_CHARS_SIZE = 5000;

		private int _XmlStack;

		private char[] _XmlChars = new char[5000];

		private int _XmlCharIndex;

		private bool _FromCharTokens;

		private void PrepareXmlString(int startBufferIndex, string peekString, Token tokens)
		{
			base.Tokens = tokens;
			if (peekString == null)
			{
				peekString = "<";
			}
			ResetCharsFromPeekTokens();
			DeletePeekElements(startBufferIndex, peekString);
			ResetXmlSettings();
			WriteStep();
		}

		private bool IsPeekCharsCore(char[] mas, int startIndex)
		{
			if (mas == null || mas.Length < startIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetCharPeek();
			ResetPeekIndex();
			for (int i = startIndex; i < mas.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = mas[i];
				bool correctChar = false;
				char peekCharCore = GetPeekCharCore(out correctChar);
				if (!correctChar || IsEof(peekCharCore) || c != peekCharCore)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private char[] DoubleXmlChars(char[] buf)
		{
			char[] array = new char[2 * buf.Length];
			Array.Copy(buf, array, buf.Length);
			return array;
		}

		private void DeleteWhitespaces()
		{
			while (IsNotSignificantChar())
			{
				WriteStep();
			}
		}

		private bool BodyStep()
		{
			if (IsEof() || _XmlStack == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			WriteStep();
			if (IsEof())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsOneTagXmlString()
		{
			if (base.Ch != '<' || !PeekCharIsIdentifier())
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (!IsPeekChar('>') && !IsEof())
			{
				StepCore();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsTag()
		{
			bool flag = IsTagBegin();
			bool flag2 = IsTagEnd();
			bool flag3 = IsXmlComment();
			bool flag4 = IsDtdTag();
			bool flag5 = SkipEmbeddedCode();
			return flag || flag2 || flag3 || flag4 || flag5;
		}

		private bool IsPrologTag()
		{
			if (base.Ch != '<' || !IsPeekChar('?'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			WriteStep();
			SkipToGT();
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsNotSignificantChar()
		{
			char[] array = new char[4] { ' ', '\r', '\n', '\t' };
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				char c = array[i];
				if (base.Ch == c)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsDtdTag()
		{
			if (base.Ch != '<' || !IsPeekChar('!'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SkipToGT();
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsTagBegin()
		{
			if (base.Ch != '<' || !PeekCharIsIdentifier())
			{
				return false;
			}
			_XmlStack++;
			while (!IsTagCloseSymbol() && !IsOneLineTagEnd() && !IsEof())
			{
				Step();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsTagCloseSymbol()
		{
			if (base.Ch == '>')
			{
				return base.PrevChar != '%';
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsOneLineTagEnd()
		{
			if (base.Ch != '/')
			{
				return false;
			}
			Step();
			if (IsEof() || base.Ch != '>')
			{
				return false;
			}
			_XmlStack--;
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsTagEnd()
		{
			if (base.Ch != '<' || !IsPeekChar('/'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SkipToGT();
			_XmlStack--;
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsIdentifierStart(char chr)
		{
			if (('Z' < chr || chr < 'A') && ('z' < chr || chr < 'a'))
			{
				return base.Ch == '_';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsXmlComment()
		{
			if (IsEof() || !IsPeekChars('<', '!', '-', '-'))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SkipToEndXmlComment();
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsPeekChar(char peekChar)
		{
			bool correctChar = false;
			char peekChar2 = GetPeekChar(out correctChar);
			if (!correctChar)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return peekChar == peekChar2;
		}

		private bool IsPeekChars(params char[] mas)
		{
			if (mas == null || mas.Length == 0 || base.Ch != mas[0])
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mas.Length == 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return IsPeekCharsCore(mas, 1);
		}

		private bool PeekCharIsIdentifier()
		{
			bool correctChar = false;
			char peekChar = GetPeekChar(out correctChar);
			if (!correctChar || IsEof(peekChar))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsIdentifierStart(peekChar))
			{
				return peekChar == '<';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SkipToGT()
		{
			while (!IsTagCloseSymbol() && !IsEof())
			{
				StepCore();
			}
		}

		private bool SkipEmbeddedCode()
		{
			if (!IsPeekChars('<', '%', '='))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SkipToEndEmbCode();
			return true;
		}

		private void SkipCData()
		{
			if (IsPeekChars('[', 'C', 'D', 'A', 'T', 'A'))
			{
				SkipToEndCdata();
			}
		}

		private bool SkipString()
		{
			if (base.Ch == '"' || base.Ch == '\'')
			{
				SkipToChar(base.Ch);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SkipToChar(char sym)
		{
			if (!IsEof())
			{
				WriteStep();
				while (base.Ch != sym && !IsEof())
				{
					WriteStep();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SkipToEndCdata()
		{
			while (!IsPeekChars(']', ']', '>') && !IsEof())
			{
				WriteStep();
			}
			SkipChars(2);
		}

		private void SkipToEndXmlComment()
		{
			while (!IsPeekChars('-', '-', '>') && !IsEof())
			{
				WriteStep();
			}
			SkipChars(2);
		}

		private void SkipToEndEmbCode()
		{
			while (!IsPeekChars('%', '>') && !IsEof())
			{
				StepCore();
			}
			SkipChars(1);
		}

		private void SkipChars(int count)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (IsEof())
				{
					break;
				}
				WriteStep();
			}
		}

		private bool SkipPrologTags()
		{
			bool result = false;
			while (IsPrologTag())
			{
				WriteStep();
				DeleteWhitespaces();
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void SkipXmlBody()
		{
			while (BodyStep())
			{
				IsTag();
			}
		}

		private void SkipInternalComment()
		{
			while (IsXmlComment())
			{
				WriteStep();
				DeleteWhitespaces();
			}
		}

		private bool Step()
		{
			if (IsEof() || _XmlStack == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			StepCore();
			return !IsEof();
		}

		private void StepCore()
		{
			WriteStep();
			SkipString();
			SkipCData();
			SkipEmbeddedCode();
		}

		private void WriteStep()
		{
			if (base.CharsFromPeekTokens != null && base.CharsFromPeekTokens.Length != 0 && base.CharsFromPeekTokens.Length > base.CharIndex)
			{
				base.Ch = base.CharsFromPeekTokens[base.CharIndex];
				base.CharIndex++;
				_FromCharTokens = true;
			}
			else if (_FromCharTokens)
			{
				_FromCharTokens = false;
				SetCharFromScanner();
			}
			else if (_XmlCharIndex != 0)
			{
				NextCh();
			}
			if (!IsEof())
			{
				if (_XmlCharIndex >= _XmlChars.Length)
				{
					_XmlChars = DoubleXmlChars(_XmlChars);
				}
				_XmlChars[_XmlCharIndex] = base.Ch;
				_XmlCharIndex++;
			}
		}

		private void ResetXmlSettings()
		{
			_XmlStack = 0;
			_XmlChars = new char[5000];
			_XmlCharIndex = 0;
		}

		public string GetXmlImports(int startBufferIndex, Token tokens)
		{
			return GetXmlOneTag(startBufferIndex, tokens);
		}

		public string GetXmlElementRef(int startBufferIndex, Token tokens)
		{
			return GetXmlOneTag(startBufferIndex, tokens);
		}

		public string GetXmlOneTag(int startBufferIndex, Token tokens)
		{
			PrepareXmlString(startBufferIndex, "<", tokens);
			if (IsOneTagXmlString())
			{
				return new string(_XmlChars, 0, _XmlCharIndex);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public string GetXmlString(int startBufferIndex, Token tokens)
		{
			return GetXmlString(startBufferIndex, "<", tokens);
		}

		public string GetXmlString(int startBufferIndex, string peekString, Token tokens)
		{
			PrepareXmlString(startBufferIndex, peekString, tokens);
			SkipPrologTags();
			SkipInternalComment();
			if (!IsTag() || _XmlStack == 0)
			{
				return new string(_XmlChars, 0, _XmlCharIndex);
			}
			SkipXmlBody();
			return new string(_XmlChars, 0, _XmlCharIndex);
		}
	}
	public class VB90Parser : FormattingParserBase, IRazorCodeParser
	{
		private LanguageElementCollection _MissedAttributes;

		private TokenQueueBase _MissedModifiers;

		private bool _IsNewContext;

		private static object _SyncObject = new object();

		private bool _PreviousTokenWasComment;

		private CommentCollection _Comments = new CommentCollection();

		private VBPreprocessor _Preprocessor;

		private LocalVarArrayCollection _LocalVarArrayCollection;

		private ParserVersion _VsVersion = ParserVersion.VS2008;

		private DeclarationsCache _DeclarationsCache = new DeclarationsCache();

		private int _ExpressionNestingLevel;

		private bool _NotXmlNode;

		private bool _CheckImplicitLineContinuationAfterToken = true;

		private string[] _AggregateMethodNames = new string[42]
		{
			"All", "Any", "AsEnumerable", "AsQueryable", "Average", "Cast", "Clone", "Concat", "Count", "DefaultIfEmpty",
			"Distinct", "ElementAt", "ElementAtOrDefault", "First", "FirstOrDefault", "GetEnumerator", "GetHashCode", "GetType", "GroupBy", "Last",
			"LastOrDefault", "LongCount", "Max", "Min", "OfType", "OrderBy", "OrderByDescending", "Select", "SelectMany", "Single",
			"SingleOrDefault", "Skip", "SkipWhile", "Sum", "Take", "TakeWhile", "ToArray", "ToDictionary", "ToList", "ToLookup",
			"ToString", "Where"
		};

		private ParserBase _HtmlParser;

		private static bool[,] _VbSet;

		private bool _SavedLineContinuationCheckState;

		private bool _LineContinuationCheckState;

		protected bool IsAsynchronousContext;

		private int[] _EndTokens = new int[6] { 73, 184, 100, 135, 185, 109 };

		private int[] _StartDeclTokens = new int[39]
		{
			88, 109, 185, 151, 210, 212, 213, 211, 135, 76,
			137, 136, 89, 108, 176, 158, 161, 163, 164, 146,
			147, 177, 157, 156, 167, 206, 203, 141, 160, 205,
			73, 184, 123, 135, 100, 90, 162, 220, 103
		};

		private int[] _EndDeclTokens = new int[16]
		{
			140, 73, 184, 123, 135, 100, 109, 185, 151, 162,
			110, 103, 52, 169, 166, 175
		};

		private int _FirstTokenStartPosition;

		private bool _ParseOnlyExpression;

		private bool _ParsingRazor;

		protected bool IsRazorEndCode;

		protected bool CheckImplicitLineContinuations => _LineContinuationCheckState;

		protected bool CheckImplicitLineContinuationAfterToken
		{
			get
			{
				return _CheckImplicitLineContinuationAfterToken;
			}
			set
			{
				_CheckImplicitLineContinuationAfterToken = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool OnDemand => false;

		public override string Language => "Basic";

		public override CommentCollection Comments => _Comments;

		public VB90ParserErrors Errors => (VB90ParserErrors)parserErrors;

		public bool ParseOnlyExpression
		{
			get
			{
				return _ParseOnlyExpression;
			}
			set
			{
				_ParseOnlyExpression = value;
			}
		}

		protected LocalVarArrayCollection LocalVarArrayCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (_LocalVarArrayCollection == null)
				{
					_LocalVarArrayCollection = new LocalVarArrayCollection();
				}
				return _LocalVarArrayCollection;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual ParserVersion VsVersion
		{
			get
			{
				return _VsVersion;
			}
			set
			{
				_VsVersion = value;
			}

		protected bool ParsingRazor => _ParsingRazor;

		protected override FormattingTable FormattingTable => VBFormattingTable.Instance;

		private void SetMissedAttributesAndModifiersIfNeeded(LanguageElementCollection missedAttributes, TokenQueueBase missedModifiers)
		{
			if (!LaIsStartPropertyAccessor())
			{
				if (missedAttributes != null && missedAttributes.Count != 0)
				{
					_MissedAttributes = missedAttributes;
				}
				if (missedModifiers != null && missedModifiers.Count != 0)
				{
					_MissedModifiers = missedModifiers;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool LaIsStartPropertyAccessor()
		{
			if (la.Type != 110)
			{
				return la.Type == 175;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool GetMissedAttributesAndModifiers(out LanguageElementCollection missedAttributes, out TokenQueueBase missedModifiers)
		{
			missedAttributes = null;
			missedModifiers = null;
			if ((_MissedAttributes == null || _MissedAttributes.Count == 0) && (_MissedModifiers == null || _MissedModifiers.Count == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			missedAttributes = _MissedAttributes;
			missedModifiers = _MissedModifiers;
			ResetMissedAttributesAndModifiers();
			return true;
		}

		private void ResetMissedAttributesAndModifiers()
		{
			_MissedAttributes = null;
			_MissedModifiers = null;
		}

		protected void ParseRootRule()
		{
			ParserRoot();
		}

		protected string GetAccessorName(string prefix)
		{
			if (base.Context is Member { ImplementsCount: >0 } member && member.ImplementsExpressions[0] is QualifiedElementReference { Qualifier: not null } qualifiedElementReference)
			{
				return qualifiedElementReference.Qualifier.ToString() + "." + prefix + member.GetNameWithoutImplementsQualifier();
			}
			return prefix + base.Context.Name;
		}

		protected void CallAppropriateParseRule(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElementCollection accessors = new LanguageElementCollection();
			StatementTerminatorCall();
			if (context is Member || context is Statement || context is Enumeration)
			{
				_DeclarationsCache.Reset();
				if (context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Property)
				{
					string text = base.Context.Name;
					if (text == null)
					{
						text = string.Empty;
					}
					SourceRange blockEndRange = SourceRange.Empty;
					PropertyAccessorDeclarationList(accessors, text, ref blockEndRange);
					SetPropertyAccessors(base.RootNode as VBProperty, accessors);
				}
				else if (context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Event)
				{
					EventAccessorDeclarations();
				}
				else if (context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Enum)
				{
					EnumBody();
				}
				else
				{
					SourceRange endBlockRange = SourceRange.Empty;
					BlockRule(context.Range, BlockType.None, skipSetBounds: true, out endBlockRange);
					ParseMemberEnd();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ParserRoot();
			}
		}

		protected override LanguageElement DoParse(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				_ExpressionNestingLevel = 0;
				base.SaveFormat = parserContext.SaveUserFormat;
				LanguageElement context = parserContext.Context;
				if (context == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				SetRootNode(context);
				if (context is SourceFile && parserContext != null)
				{
					((SourceFile)context).SetDocument(parserContext.Document);
				}
				scanner = new VB90Scanner(reader);
				PrepareParse(context);
				CallAppropriateParseRule(context);
				if (parserContext != null && Comments != null)
				{
					parserContext.Comments.AddRange(Comments);
				}
				if (parserContext != null)
				{
					parserContext.ContextAfterParse = base.Context;
				}
				FinishParse(base.RootNode);
				if (parserContext != null)
				{
					parserContext.ContextAfterParse = base.Context;
				}
				return base.RootNode;
			}
			finally
			{
				CleanUpParser();
				_ExpressionNestingLevel = 0;
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected int ConstructedTypeNameTailBase(out ExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			int typeArity = 0;
			ConstructedTypeNameTail(out arguments, out typeArity);
			return typeArity;
		}

		private void QualifiedIdentifier(out QualifiedIdentifier identifier)
		{
			QualifiedIdentifier(out identifier, CreateElementType.ElementReferenceExpression);
		}

		private void ObjectCreationExpressionCore(out Expression result, out VBDeclarator decl)
		{
			decl = new VBDeclarator(CreateElementType.ObjectCreationExpression);
			CreationExpressionCore(out result, ref decl);
		}

		private void ArrayCreationExpressionCore(out Expression result)
		{
			VBDeclarator decl = new VBDeclarator(CreateElementType.ArrayCreationExpression);
			CreationExpressionCore(out result, ref decl);
		}

		private void DelegateCreationExpressionCore(out Expression result)
		{
			VBDeclarator decl = new VBDeclarator(CreateElementType.DelegateCreationExpression);
			CreationExpressionCore(out result, ref decl);
		}

		public static string GetSimpleTypeName(string fullName)
		{
			return VB90Tokens.Instance.GetSimpleTypeName(fullName);
		}

		protected void StatementRuleBase(out Statement result)
		{
			StatementRule(out result);
		}

		protected TypeReferenceExpression ParseTypeExpressionRule(out TypeReferenceExpression result)
		{
			result = null;
			VBDeclarator decl = null;
			TypeName(out result, out decl);
			return result;
		}

		protected void ExpressionRuleBase(out Expression result)
		{
			WhitespaceLines();
			ExpressionRule(out result);
		}

		protected void LocalDeclarationStatementCoreBase(out BaseVariable result)
		{
			LanguageElement result2 = null;
			LocalDeclarationStatementCore(out result2, addToContext: false);
			result = result2 as BaseVariable;
		}

		protected void ClassMemberDeclarationBase(out Member result)
		{
			LanguageElement element = null;
			ElementMemberDeclaration(out element);
			StatementTerminator();
			result = element as Member;
		}

		protected void WhitespaceLinesBase()
		{
			WhitespaceLines();
		}

		private void ParseMemberEnd()
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				LanguageElement context = base.Context;
				LanguageElementType elementType = context.ElementType;
				if (elementType == LanguageElementType.Method)
				{
					ParseMethodEnd();
				}
				if (context != base.Context)
				{
					CallAppropriateParseRule(base.Context);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseMethodEnd()
		{
			if (IsDeclEnd())
			{
				_DeclarationsCache.CloseScope();
				ReadBlockEnd(la.Range);
				SetBlockRangeForEmptyContext();
				Get();
				Get();
				StatementTerminatorCall();
				CloseContext();
			}
		}

		private void SetBlockRangeForEmptyContext()
		{
			if (base.Context is IHasBlock hasBlock)
			{
				SetBlockRangeForEmptyElement(base.Context, hasBlock.BlockStart, la.Range);
			}
		}

		private bool HasContextElementType(params LanguageElementType[] elementTypes)
		{
			if (elementTypes == null || base.Context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = base.Context.ElementType;
			foreach (LanguageElementType languageElementType in elementTypes)
			{
				if (languageElementType == elementType)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsCorruptedElement()
		{
			if (!IsNamespaceCorruptedEnd() && !IsTypeCorruptedEnd())
			{
				return IsMemberCorruptedEnd();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsNamespaceCorruptedEnd()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type != 98)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!HasContextElementType(LanguageElementType.SourceFile))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsPeekToken(140))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsTypeCorruptedEnd()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type != 98)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!HasContextElementType(LanguageElementType.SourceFile, LanguageElementType.Namespace))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsPeekToken(73, 184, 100, 135, 123))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsMemberCorruptedEnd()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type != 98)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!HasContextElementType(LanguageElementType.SourceFile, LanguageElementType.Namespace, LanguageElementType.Class, LanguageElementType.Struct, LanguageElementType.Enum, LanguageElementType.Module, LanguageElementType.Interface))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsPeekToken(109, 185, 151, 166, 169, 52, 103))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetCorruptedType(Token token, CorruptedLanguageElement element)
		{
			if (token != null && element != null)
			{
				int type = token.Type;
				CorruptedType corruptedType = CorruptedType.Block;
				switch (type)
				{
				case 73:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Class;
					break;
				case 184:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Struct;
					break;
				case 135:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Module;
					break;
				case 123:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Interface;
					break;
				case 103:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Event;
					break;
				case 140:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Namespace;
					break;
				case 52:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.AddHandler;
					break;
				case 169:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.RemoveHandler;
					break;
				case 166:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.RaiseEvent;
					break;
				case 110:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Get;
					break;
				case 175:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Set;
					break;
				case 100:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Enum;
					break;
				case 162:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Property;
					break;
				case 185:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Sub;
					break;
				case 109:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Function;
					break;
				case 151:
					corruptedType = CorruptedType.Operator;
					break;
				}
				element.CorruptedType = corruptedType;
			}
		}

		private bool IsYieldStatement()
		{
			if (la.Type != 4 || la.Value.ToLower() != "yield")
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			switch (Peek().Type)
			{
			case 2:
			case 3:
			case 4:
			case 17:
			case 35:
			case 105:
			case 183:
			case 190:
			case 193:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override void HandlePragmas()
		{
		}

		private void ParserRoot()
		{
			SetDefaultOptionStrict();
			SetDefaultOptionInfer();
			ParserRootCore();
			if (IsDeclEnd())
			{
				LanguageElement context = base.Context;
				EndNamespaceOrType();
				if (context != base.Context)
				{
					CallAppropriateParseRule(base.Context);
				}
			}
			else if (!IsValidEndParsing())
			{
				ParserRootCore();
			}
		}

		private void ParserRootCore()
		{
			WhitespaceLines();
			while (la.Type == 152)
			{
				OptionDirective();
			}
			while (la.Type == 118)
			{
				ImportsStmt();
			}
			while (IsFileAttributeSection())
			{
				FileAttributesSection();
			}
			while (StartOf(1))
			{
				if (StartOf(2))
				{
					NamespaceDeclaration();
					continue;
				}
				bool wasCorruptedElement = false;
				CorruptedEndDeclaration(out wasCorruptedElement);
				if (!wasCorruptedElement)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			StatementTerminatorCall();
		}

		private void EndNamespaceOrType()
		{
			LanguageElement context = base.Context;
			SetBlockRangeForEmptyContext();
			Expect(98);
			switch (la.Type)
			{
			case 140:
				Get();
				break;
			case 73:
				Get();
				break;
			case 184:
				Get();
				break;
			case 123:
				Get();
				break;
			case 135:
				Get();
				break;
			case 100:
				Get();
				break;
			case 109:
				Get();
				break;
			case 185:
				Get();
				break;
			case 151:
				Get();
				break;
			case 162:
				Get();
				break;
			case 110:
				Get();
				break;
			case 103:
				Get();
				break;
			case 52:
				Get();
				break;
			case 169:
				Get();
				break;
			case 166:
				Get();
				Expect(175);
				break;
			default:
				SynErr(249);
				break;
			}
			context?.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(context, tToken));
			CloseContext();
			if (context is Namespace declaredNamespace)
			{
				AddNamespaceToDeclaredList(declaredNamespace);
			}
		}

		private void WhitespaceLines()
		{
			while (la.Type == 1)
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		private void OptionDirective()
		{
			Token a = la;
			OptionState optionState = OptionState.On;
			OptionType type = OptionType.Explicit;
			Expect(152);
			if (la.Type == 214)
			{
				Get();
				type = OptionType.Explicit;
				OptionValue(out optionState);
				SetOptionExplicit(optionState);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 215)
			{
				Get();
				type = OptionType.Strict;
				OptionValue(out optionState);
				SetOptionStrict(optionState);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 233)
			{
				Get();
				type = OptionType.Infer;
				OptionValue(out optionState);
				SetOptionInfer(optionState);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 216)
			{
				Get();
				type = OptionType.Compare;
				if (la.Type == 217)
				{
					Get();
					optionState = OptionState.Binary;
				}
				else if (la.Type == 218)
				{
					Get();
					optionState = OptionState.Text;
				}
				else
				{
					SynErr(250);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(251);
			}
			OptionStatement optionStatement = new OptionStatement(optionState, type);
			optionStatement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(a, tToken.Range));
			AddNode(optionStatement);
			StatementTerminator();
		}

		private void ImportsStmt()
		{
			Expect(118);
			NamespaceReference result = null;
			ImportClause(out result);
			AddNode(result);
			while (la.Type == 32)
			{
				Get();
				result?.SetEnd(tToken.Range.End);
				ImportClause(out result);
				AddNode(result);
			}
			StatementTerminator();
		}

		private void FileAttributesSection()
		{
			AttributeSection attributeSection = null;
			Token token = la;
			Expect(49);
			while (la.Type == 1)
			{
				Get();
			}
			attributeSection = new AttributeSection();
			AttributeList(attributeSection);
			while (la.Type == 1)
			{
				Get();
			}
			Expect(48);
			SetRange(attributeSection, token, tToken);
			StatementTerminator();
			if (attributeSection != null)
			{
				AddNode(attributeSection);
			}
		}

		private void NamespaceDeclaration()
		{
			LanguageElement element = null;
			if (la.Type == 140)
			{
				Token token = la;
				QualifiedIdentifier identifier = null;
				Get();
				QualifiedIdentifier(out identifier);
				StatementTerminator();
				element = new Namespace(identifier.Identifier);
				OpenContext(element);
				element.NameRange = identifier.Range;
				bool wasCorruptedElement = false;
				while (StartOf(1))
				{
					if (StartOf(2))
					{
						NamespaceDeclaration();
						continue;
					}
					CorruptedEndDeclaration(out wasCorruptedElement);
					if (!wasCorruptedElement)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				bool flag = WaitNamespaceEndToken();
				GetEndToken(flag);
				SetBlockStart(element, token.Range);
				SetBlockEnd(element);
				if (!flag)
				{
					Expect(140);
					CloseContext();
				}
				SetRange(element, token, tToken);
				AddNamespaceToDeclaredList(element as Namespace);
			}
			else if (StartOf(3))
			{
				ElementMemberDeclaration(out element);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(252);
			}
			StatementTerminatorCall();
		}

		private void CorruptedEndDeclaration(out bool wasCorruptedElement)
		{
			LanguageElement declaration = null;
			wasCorruptedElement = false;
			CorruptedEndDeclarationCore(out declaration, out wasCorruptedElement);
		}

		private void StatementTerminatorCall()
		{
			while (la.Type == 1 || la.Type == 38)
			{
				if (la.Type == 1)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
				}
			}
		}

		private void StatementTerminator()
		{
			SkipToEol();
			StatementTerminatorCall();
		}

		private void OptionValue(out OptionState optionState)
		{
			optionState = OptionState.On;
			if (la.Type == 150)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 219)
			{
				Get();
				optionState = OptionState.Off;
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(253);
			}
		}

		private void ImportClause(out NamespaceReference result)
		{
			Token a = la;
			Token afterImportsToken = la;
			if (tToken.Type == 118)
			{
				a = tToken;
			}
			string importsXmlValue = GetImportsXmlValue();
			if (importsXmlValue != null && importsXmlValue != string.Empty)
			{
				result = CreateXmlImports(importsXmlValue, afterImportsToken);
				result.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(a, tToken));
				return;
			}
			bool isAlias = false;
			string name = string.Empty;
			SourceRange nameRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			QualifiedIdentifier identifier = null;
			NamespaceReference namespaceReference = new NamespaceReference();
			Expression expression = null;
			if (IsAliasImports())
			{
				isAlias = true;
				VarKeyword();
				namespaceReference.AliasName = tToken.Value;
				namespaceReference.AliasNameRange = tToken.Range;
				Expression elementReference = GetElementReference(tToken.Value, tToken.Range);
				namespaceReference.AddDetailNode(elementReference);
				EqualOperator();
			}
			QualifiedIdentifier(out identifier);
			Token b = tToken;
			namespaceReference.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(a, b));
			if (identifier != null)
			{
				name = identifier.Identifier;
				nameRange = identifier.Range;
				expression = identifier.Expression;
				if (expression != null)
				{
					namespaceReference.AddDetailNode(expression);
				}
			}
			namespaceReference.NameRange = nameRange;
			namespaceReference.Name = name;
			namespaceReference.IsAlias = isAlias;
			string aliasName = namespaceReference.AliasName;
			AddToUsingList(name, aliasName, expression);
			result = namespaceReference;
		}

		private void VarKeyword()
		{
			switch (la.Type)
			{
			case 4:
				Get();
				break;
			case 218:
				Get();
				break;
			case 77:
				Get();
				break;
			case 219:
				Get();
				break;
			case 112:
				Get();
				break;
			case 125:
				Get();

		private void BlockRule(SourceRange startBlockRange, BlockType blockType, bool skipSetBounds, out SourceRange endBlockRange)
		{
			Statement statement = null;
			endBlockRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			SetHasBlockAndBlockType();

			{
				ReadBlockStartVB(startBlockRange);
			}
			_DeclarationsCache.OpenScope();
			if (base.Context != null && base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Method)
			{
				Method method = base.Context as Method;
				foreach (BaseVariable parameter in method.Parameters)
				{
					AddVarToCache(parameter);
				}
			}
			while (StartOf(16))
			{
				StatementRule(out statement);
				if (statement != null)
				{
					endBlockRange = statement.Range;
				}
				if (la.Type == 1 && blockType == BlockType.IfSingleLineStatement && !skipSetBounds)
				{
					_DeclarationsCache.CloseScope();
					return;
				}
				if (NeedExitFromStatementLoop())
				{
					break;
				}
				if (IsRazorEndCode)
				{
					IsRazorEndCode = false;
					break;
				}
				StatementTerminatorCall();
			}
			_DeclarationsCache.CloseScope();
			if (blockType != BlockType.IfSingleLineStatement && !skipSetBounds)
			{
				ReadBlockEnd(la.Range);
			}
		}

			_SavedLineContinuationCheckState = _LineContinuationCheckState;
			_LineContinuationCheckState = false;

		}

		private ParserBase GetHtmlParser()
		{
			if (_HtmlParser == null)
			{
				_HtmlParser = new HtmlParser();
				if (_HtmlParser == null || !(_HtmlParser is EmbeddedCodeParserBase))
				{
					return null;
				}
				(_HtmlParser as EmbeddedCodeParserBase).InitialDefaultDotNetLanguage = DotNetLanguageType.VisualBasic;
			}
			if (_HtmlParser is TokenCategorizedParserBase tokenCategorizedParserBase)
			{
				tokenCategorizedParserBase.SetTokensCategory = base.SetTokensCategory;
				if (tokenCategorizedParserBase.SavedTokens != null)
				{
					tokenCategorizedParserBase.SavedTokens.Clear();
				}
			}
			return _HtmlParser;
		}

		protected override TokenCategory GetTokenCategory(CategorizedToken token)
		{
			int type = token.Type;
			if (IsOperator(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Operator;
			}
			if (type != 216 && IsKeyword(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Keyword;
			}
			if (IsPreprocessorDirective(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.PreprocessorKeyword;
			}
			switch (type)
			{
			case 16:
			case 17:
				return TokenCategory.String;
			case 2:
			case 3:
				return TokenCategory.Number;
			case 15:
				return TokenCategory.Comment;
			case 247:
				return TokenCategory.XmlComment;
			case 4:
				switch (token.Value.ToLower())
				{
				case "string":
				case "object":
				case "getxmlnamespace":
					return TokenCategory.Keyword;
				default:
					return TokenCategory.Identifier;
				}
			case 0:
			case 1:
				return TokenCategory.Unknown;
			default:
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}
		}

		protected bool XmlCommentStringIsNextNode()
		{
			if (la != null && la.Type == 244)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			while (token != null && token.Type != 0 && token.Type == 1)
			{
				token = Peek();
			}
			if (token != null && token.Type == 244)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetTokensCategoryForXml(ParserBase htmlParser)
		{
			Token token = null;
			int num = 0;
			if (base.SavedTokens.Count > 0)
			{
				token = base.SavedTokens[base.SavedTokens.Count - 1];
				if (token != null)
				{
					num = token.StartPosition;
				}
			}
			if (token != null && token.Type == 49)
			{
				base.SavedTokens.Remove(token);
			}
			if (!(htmlParser is TokenCategorizedParserBase { SavedTokens: not null } tokenCategorizedParserBase) || tokenCategorizedParserBase.SavedTokens.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Token token2 = tokenCategorizedParserBase.SavedTokens[0];
			int num2 = 0;
			if (token2 != null)
			{
				num2 = token2.StartPosition;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < tokenCategorizedParserBase.SavedTokens.Count; i++)
			{
				Token token3 = tokenCategorizedParserBase.SavedTokens[i];
				if (token3 != null)
				{
					token3.StartPosition -= num3;
					token3.EndPosition -= num3;
					base.SavedTokens.Add(token3);
				}
			}
		}

		private Expression ParseXmlString(string str, SourceRange startRange)
		{
			ParserBase htmlParser = GetHtmlParser();
			if (htmlParser == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int line = startRange.Start.Line;
			int offset = startRange.Start.Offset;
			LanguageElement languageElement = htmlParser.ParseString(str, line, offset);
			if (base.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				SetTokensCategoryForXml(htmlParser);
			}
			if (languageElement != null && languageElement.Nodes != null && languageElement.NodeCount != 0)
			{
				XmlExpression xmlExpression = new XmlExpression();
				LanguageElement languageElement2 = null;
				LanguageElement languageElement3 = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < languageElement.NodeCount; i++)
				{
					if (languageElement.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement { ElementType: not LanguageElementType.Method } languageElement4)
					{
						xmlExpression.AddNode(languageElement4);
						languageElement3 = languageElement4;
					}
				}
				if (languageElement3 != null)
				{
					xmlExpression.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(startRange, languageElement3.Range));
				}
				else
				{
					xmlExpression.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(startRange));
				}
				return xmlExpression;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected string GetImportsXmlValue()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type != 49)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetOneTagXmlValue();
		}

		protected NamespaceReference CreateXmlImports(string str, Token afterImportsToken)
		{
			if (str == null || str == string.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string xmlImportsName = GetXmlImportsName(str);
			string xmlImportsNamespace = GetXmlImportsNamespace(str);
			NamespaceReference namespaceReference = new XmlNamespaceReference(xmlImportsName, xmlImportsNamespace);
			ElementReferenceExpression importsElementRef = GetImportsElementRef(str, afterImportsToken, xmlImportsName);
			if (importsElementRef != null)
			{
				namespaceReference.AddDetailNode(importsElementRef);
			}
			return namespaceReference;
		}

		protected ElementReferenceExpression GetImportsElementRef(string str, Token afterImportsToken, string name)
		{
			if (str == null || str == string.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ElementReferenceExpression elementReferenceExpression = new ElementReferenceExpression(name);
			if (afterImportsToken == null)
			{
				return elementReferenceExpression;
			}
			int offset = afterImportsToken.Range.Start.Offset;
			int num = GetStartIndex(str) + offset;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return elementReferenceExpression;
			}
			int num2 = 1;
			if (name != null)
			{
				num2 = name.Length;
			}
			int line = afterImportsToken.Line;
			int endOffset = num + num2;
			SourceRange range = new SourceRange(line, num, line, endOffset);
			elementReferenceExpression.SetRange(range);
			return elementReferenceExpression;
		}

		private int GetStartIndex(string str)
		{
			if (str == null || str == string.Empty)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (str == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int length = str.Length;
			if (length <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			str = str.Trim();
			int num = str.IndexOf(":");
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			num++;
			if (num >= length)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			for (char c = str[num]; c == ' '; c = str[num])
			{
				num++;
				if (num >= length)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected static string GetXmlImportsName(string str)
		{
			if (str == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int length = str.Length;
			if (length <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			str = str.Trim();
			int num = str.IndexOf("xmlns");
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			num += 5;
			if (num >= length)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			char c = str[num];
			while (true)
			{
				switch (c)
				{
				case ' ':
				case ':':
					num++;
					if (num >= length)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					break;
				case '=':
					return string.Empty;
				default:
				{
					string text = string.Empty;
					while (c != '=')
					{
						text += c;
						num++;
						if (num >= length)
						{
							return text.Trim();
						}
						c = str[num];
					}
					return text.Trim();
				}
				}
				c = str[num];
			}
		}

		protected static string GetXmlImportsNamespace(string str)
		{
			if (str == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int length = str.Length;
			if (length <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			str = str.Trim();
			int num = str.IndexOf("=");
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			num++;
			if (num >= length)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			char c = str[num];
			string text = str.Substring(num);
			length = text.Length - 1;
			if (length <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			text = text.Remove(length);
			return text.Trim();
		}

		protected string GetOneTagXmlValue()
		{
			return GetOneTagXmlValue(deleteAngelBrackets: false);
		}

		protected string GetOneTagXmlValue(bool deleteAngelBrackets)
		{
			if (LessThanOrcas() || scanner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			VB90Scanner vB90Scanner = scanner as VB90Scanner;
			if (scanner is VB90Scanner)
			{
				string text = vB90Scanner.GetXmlOneTag(la.StartPosition);
				if (text != null && text != string.Empty)
				{
					Get();
					if (deleteAngelBrackets)
					{
						text = text.Substring(1);
					}
					else if (la != null && la.Type == 48)
					{
						Get();
						text += ">";
					}
					return text;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected Expression CreateXmlExpression()
		{
			if (la == null || LessThanOrcas() || (la.Type != 49 && la.Type != 25) || _NotXmlNode || scanner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			VB90Scanner vB90Scanner = scanner as VB90Scanner;
			if (scanner is VB90Scanner)
			{
				string xmlString = vB90Scanner.GetXmlString(la.StartPosition, la.Value);
				if (xmlString != null && xmlString != string.Empty)
				{
					SourceRange range = la.Range;
					Expression expression = ParseXmlString(xmlString, range);
					Get();
					if (expression != null && expression.Range != SourceRange.Empty)
					{
						tToken.Range = expression.Range;
						tToken.Value = ">";
					}
					return expression;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void Get()
		{
			_PreviousTokenWasComment = false;
			base.Get();
			Token token = tToken;
			while (la.Type == 14)
			{
				base.Get();
			}
			while (TokenIsComment(la) || IsPreprocessorDirective(la))
			{
				if (TokenIsComment(la))
				{
					AddCommentNode(la);
					_PreviousTokenWasComment = true;
					base.Get();
					if (TokenIsComment(la))
					{
						PassStatementTerminator();
					}
				}
				else if (IsPreprocessorDirective(la))
				{
					PreprocessToken();
					if (IsPreprocessorDirective(la))
					{
						PassStatementTerminator();
					}
				}
			}
			tToken = token;
		}

		private void PassStatementTerminator()
		{
			while (la.Type == 1 || la.Type == 38)
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		private void PreprocessToken()
		{
			if (_Preprocessor == null)
			{
				Get();
				return;
			}
			CompilerDirective compilerDirective = null;
			if (base.RootNode != null && base.RootNode is SourceFile)
			{
				compilerDirective = ((SourceFile)base.RootNode).CompilerDirectiveRootNode;
				if (compilerDirective != null && compilerDirective.Parent == null)
				{
					compilerDirective.SetParent(base.RootNode);
				}
			}
			la = _Preprocessor.Preprocess(la);
		}

		}

		}

		private bool IsPeekToken(params int[] nextTokens)
		{
			if (nextTokens == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			int num = nextTokens.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				int num2 = nextTokens[i];
				if (num2 == type)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool WaitToken(int type, params int[] nextTokens)
		{
			while (la != null)
			{
				int type2 = la.Type;
				if (type2 == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (type2 == type && IsPeekToken(nextTokens))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsStartNewDecl(type2) || (type2 == type && IsEndDeclOnPeek()))
				{
					return true;
				}
				ResetPeek();
				Get();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsEndDeclOnPeek()
		{
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token == null || token.Type == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			return IsEndDecl(type);
		}

		protected bool IsDeclEnd()
		{
			if (la != null && la.Type == 98)
			{
				return IsEndDeclOnPeek();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool HasTokenType(int tokenType, int[] tokens)
		{
			int num = tokens.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{

				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected LanguageElement SetOperatorAttributes(Method method)
		{
			if (method == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			method.IsClassOperator = true;
			string name = method.Name;
			if (name == null || name == string.Empty)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int parameterCount = 1;
			if (method.Parameters != null && method.Parameters.Count > 1)
			{
				parameterCount = 2;
			}
			OperatorType type = (method.OverloadsOperator = VBOperatorHelper.GetOperatorType(name, parameterCount));
			string operatorName = VBOperatorHelper.GetOperatorName(type, parameterCount);
			if (operatorName != null && operatorName != string.Empty)
			{
				method.Name = operatorName;
			}
			return method;
		}

		protected string GetMemberType(TypeReferenceExpression typeReference, ICollection arrayModifiers)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			if (arrayModifiers != null && arrayModifiers.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayModifiers.Count; i++)
				{
					if (text != null)
					{
						text += "()";
					}
				}
			}
			if (typeReference == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			TypeReferenceExpression baseType = typeReference.BaseType;
			if (baseType != null)
			{
				text2 = GetMemberType(baseType, null);
				if (!typeReference.IsArrayType && !typeReference.IsNullable)
				{
					text2 += ".";
				}
			}
			if (text2 == null)
			{
				text2 = string.Empty;
			}
			if (typeReference != null && typeReference.IsArrayType)
			{
				text2 += "()";
			}
			else if (typeReference != null && typeReference.IsNullable)
			{
				text2 += "?";
			}
			else if (typeReference != null)
			{
				string name = typeReference.Name;
				if (name != null)
				{
					text2 += name;
				}
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				text2 += text;
			}
			TypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeArguments = typeReference.TypeArguments;
			if (typeArguments == null || typeArguments.Count == 0)
			{
				return text2;
			}
			text2 += "(Of ";
			string text3 = null;
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = null;
			for (int j = 0; j < typeArguments.Count; j++)
			{
				typeReferenceExpression = typeArguments[j];
				if (typeReferenceExpression == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				text3 = typeReferenceExpression.Name;
				if (text3 != null && !(text3 == string.Empty))
				{
					if (j != 0)
					{
						text2 += ",";
					}
					text2 += text3;
				}
			}
			return text2 + ")";
		}

		protected Variable CreateVariableList(out Variable endVar, VariableNameCollection coll, VBDeclarator decl, DeclaratorType declaratorType, VariableListHelper varListHelper)
		{
			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = varListHelper.Type;
			Expression initializer = varListHelper.Initializer;
			SourceRange operatorRange = varListHelper.OperatorRange;
			bool isObjectCreation = varListHelper.IsObjectCreation;
