		protected BaseVariable CreateVariable(string name, string type, LanguageElementCollection arrayModifiers, NullableTypeModifier nullableModifier, TypeReferenceExpression typeReference, Expression initializer, DeclaratorType declaratorType, bool addTypeToDetailNode, bool isImplicitOnly)
		{
			BaseVariable baseVariable = null;
			bool flag = true;
			if (typeReference == null)
			{
				flag = false;
				if (LessThanOrcas())
				{
					typeReference = new TypeReferenceExpression("Object", SourceRange.Empty);
				}
			}
			baseVariable = GetVar(name, type, typeReference, initializer, declaratorType, isImplicitOnly);
			if (nullableModifier != null)
			{
				baseVariable.AddDetailNode(nullableModifier);
				baseVariable.NullableModifier = nullableModifier;
			}
			if (arrayModifiers != null && arrayModifiers.Count != 0)
			{
				foreach (ArrayNameModifier arrayModifier in arrayModifiers)
				{
					baseVariable.ArrayNameModifiers.Add(arrayModifier);
					baseVariable.AddDetailNode(arrayModifier);
				}
			}
			if (type != null && type != string.Empty && baseVariable != null)
			{
				baseVariable.MemberType = type;
			}
			if (typeReference != null)
			{
				baseVariable.MemberTypeReference = ToTypeReferenceExpression(typeReference, arrayModifiers, nullableModifier, baseVariable);
				baseVariable.TypeRange = typeReference.Range;
				if (addTypeToDetailNode && flag)
				{
					baseVariable.AddDetailNode(baseVariable.MemberTypeReference);
				}
				if (baseVariable is Variable variable)
				{
					variable.HasType = flag;
				}
				string memberType = GetMemberType(typeReference, arrayModifiers);
				if (memberType != null && memberType != string.Empty)
				{
					baseVariable.MemberType = memberType;
				}
			}
			if (initializer != null && baseVariable != null && baseVariable is InitializedVariable)
			{
				((InitializedVariable)baseVariable).Expression = initializer;
			}
			AddVarToCache(baseVariable);
			return baseVariable;
		}

		private BaseVariable GetVar(string name, string type, TypeReferenceExpression typeReference, Expression initializer, DeclaratorType declaratorType, bool isImplicitOnly)
		{
			BaseVariable baseVariable = null;
			if (typeReference == null && AtLeastOrcas() && (initializer != null || isImplicitOnly))
			{
				baseVariable = new ImplicitVariable(name, initializer);
				switch (declaratorType)
				{
				case DeclaratorType.Const:
					baseVariable.IsConst = true;
					break;
				case DeclaratorType.Static:
					baseVariable.IsStatic = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (declaratorType)
				{
				case DeclaratorType.Const:
					baseVariable = new Const(type, name, initializer);
					break;
				case DeclaratorType.Dim:
				case DeclaratorType.Static:
				case DeclaratorType.None:
					if (initializer == null)
					{
						baseVariable = new Variable(type, name);
					}
					else
					{
						InitializedVariable initializedVariable = new InitializedVariable(type, name);
						baseVariable = initializedVariable;
					}
					if (declaratorType == DeclaratorType.Static)
					{
						baseVariable.IsStatic = true;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return baseVariable;
		}

		protected bool IsQueryIdent(DeclaratorType declaratorType)
		{
			if (AtLeastOrcas())
			{
				if (declaratorType != DeclaratorType.QueryIdent && declaratorType != DeclaratorType.CanAggregateFunction)
				{
					return declaratorType == DeclaratorType.CanAggregateElement;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected BaseVariable CreateQueryIdent(string name, string typeName, TypeReferenceExpression type, Expression initializer, DeclaratorType declaratorType)
		{
			QueryIdent queryIdent = new QueryIdent(typeName, name);
			if (type != null)
			{
				queryIdent.MemberTypeReference = type;
				queryIdent.AddDetailNode(type);
			}
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				if (declaratorType == DeclaratorType.CanAggregateFunction || declaratorType == DeclaratorType.CanAggregateElement)
				{
					initializer = CreateAggregateExpressionIfNeeded(initializer, declaratorType);
				}
				queryIdent.Expression = initializer;
				queryIdent.AddDetailNode(initializer);
			}
			return queryIdent;
		}

			{

				ExpressionCollection expressionCollection = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayModifiers.Count; i++)

						SourceRange range = type.Range;

		protected string GetDateLiteral(string month, string day, string year, string hour, string minute, string second, string ampm, string dateDelemiter)
		{
			string result = null;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (dateDelemiter == null)
			{
				dateDelemiter = "-";
			}
			if (month != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(month);
				if (day == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(dateDelemiter);
				stringBuilder.Append(day);
				if (year == null)
				{
					return result;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(dateDelemiter);
				stringBuilder.Append(year);
			}
			if (hour != null)
			{
				if (month != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(" ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(hour);
				if (minute != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(":");
					stringBuilder.Append(minute);
				}
				if (second != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(":");
					stringBuilder.Append(second);
				}
				if (ampm != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(ampm);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected PrimitiveExpression GetPrimitiveExpression(string value, SourceRange range, PrimitiveType type)
		{
			string text = value;
			if (type == PrimitiveType.DateTime)

				text = "#" + value + "#";
			}
			PrimitiveExpression primitiveExpression = new PrimitiveExpression(text);
			primitiveExpression.Name = text;
			primitiveExpression.PrimitiveType = type;
			try
			{
				primitiveExpression.PrimitiveValue = VBPrimitiveTypeUtils.ToPrimitiveValueFromPrimitiveType(type, value);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			primitiveExpression.SetRange(range);
			return primitiveExpression;
		}

		protected bool IsField(TokenQueueBase modifiers)
		{
			if (base.Context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (modifiers != null && modifiers.Count != 0)
			{
				int count = modifiers.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					Token token = modifiers.LookUpToken(i);
					switch (token.Type)
					{
					case 76:
					case 108:
					case 161:
					case 163:
					case 164:
					case 167:
					case 176:
					case 177:
					case 205:
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			int type = la.Type;
			bool flag2 = type == 91 || type == 76;
			bool flag3 = type == 73 || type == 184 || type == 123 || type == 135 || type == 100 || type == 90 || type == 88 || type == 109 || type == 185 || type == 151 || type == 103 || type == 210 || type == 212 || type == 213 || type == 162 || type == 220;
			if (flag2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (flag && !flag3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Token SkipParamQualifiers()
		{
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = la;
			while (token != null && IsParamQualifier(token.Type))
			{
				token = Peek();
			}
			if (token == null)
			{
				return token;
			}
			return Peek();
		}

		private bool IsParamQualifier(int type)
		{
			if (type != 59 && type != 61)
			{
				return type == 159;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsLambdaParameter()
		{
			Token token = SkipParamQualifiers();
			if (token == null || token.Type == 57)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected VBEvent CreateEvent(SubMemberData subMember, VBDeclarator decl)

		protected Method CreateMethod(SubMemberData subMember, MethodTypeEnum methodTypeEnum, TokenQueueBase modifiers, VBDeclarator decl, SourceRange methodKeyWordRange)
		{
			if (subMember == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Token nameToken = subMember.NameToken;
			string name = null;
			if (nameToken != null)
			{
				if (nameToken.Type == 142)
				{
					methodTypeEnum = MethodTypeEnum.Constructor;
				}
				name = nameToken.Value;
			}
			TypeReferenceExpression memberTypeReference = subMember.MemberTypeReference;
			string typeName = null;
			if (memberTypeReference != null)
			{
				typeName = memberTypeReference.Name;
			}
			Method method = new VBMethod(typeName, name);
			method.MethodType = methodTypeEnum;
			method.Lib = subMember.LibString;
			method.Alias = subMember.AliasString;
			FinishCreateMember(method, subMember, decl, modifiers);
			method.SetMethodKeyWordRange(methodKeyWordRange);
			method.ParamOpenRange = subMember.ParamOpenRange;
			method.ParamCloseRange = subMember.ParamCloseRange;
			if (methodTypeEnum != MethodTypeEnum.Void)
			{
				BaseVariable implicitVariableToMethod = GetImplicitVariableToMethod(subMember);
				implicitVariableToMethod.IsImplicit = true;
				implicitVariableToMethod.IsReturnedValue = true;
				implicitVariableToMethod.SetParent(method);
				method.ImplicitVariable = implicitVariableToMethod;
			}
			SourceRange asRange = subMember.AsRange;
			method.SetAsRange(asRange);
			return method;
		}

		private bool NeedToTrimEndDoubleQuote(string value)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = value.Length - 1;
				int num3 = num2;
				while (num3 >= 0 && value[num3] == '"')
				{
					num++;
					num3--;
				}
				if (num % 2 == 0)
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void AddTextString(Token stringToken)
		{
			if (stringToken != null)
			{
				string value = stringToken.Value;
				bool flag = NeedToTrimEndDoubleQuote(value);
				int num = value.Length - 1;
				if (flag && num > 0)
				{
					num--;
				}
				TextString textString = new TextString(value.Substring(1, num), isVerbatim: false);
				SourceRange range = stringToken.Range;
				SourcePoint start = range.Start;
				SourcePoint end = range.End;
				int offset = start.Offset + 1;
				int offset2 = end.Offset - (flag ? 1 : 0);
				start.SetOffset(offset);
				end.SetOffset(offset2);
				range = new SourceRange(start, end);
				textString.SetRange(range);
				base.TextStrings.Add(textString);
			}
		}

		private BaseVariable GetImplicitVariableToMethod(SubMemberData subMember)
		{
			if (subMember == null)

			TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = subMember.MemberTypeReference;

			}

			if (typeReferenceExpression != null)
			{
				type = typeReferenceExpression.Name;
			}
			Token nameToken = subMember.NameToken;
			string name = null;
			if (nameToken != null)
			{
				name = nameToken.Value;
			}
			return CreateVariable(name, type, typeReferenceExpression, null, DeclaratorType.Dim);
		}

		private void FinishCreateMember(MemberWithParameters result, SubMemberData subMember, VBDeclarator decl, TokenQueueBase modifiers)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection paramCollection = subMember.ParamCollection;
			GenericModifier genericModifier = subMember.GenericModifier;
			SourceRange nameRange = subMember.NameRange;
			ExpressionCollection handlesExpressions = subMember.HandlesExpressions;
			TypeReferenceExpression memberTypeReference = subMember.MemberTypeReference;
			LocalVarArrayCollection.Clear();
			FinishCreateMember(result, paramCollection, memberTypeReference, modifiers, decl, genericModifier, nameRange);
			SourceRange range = GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(subMember.ParamOpenRange, subMember.ParamCloseRange);
			result.SetParensRange(range);
			if (handlesExpressions != null && handlesExpressions.Count != 0 && result != null)
			{
				foreach (Expression item in handlesExpressions)
				{
					result.AddHandlesExpression(item);
					if (result is Method)
					{
						(result as Method).Handles.Add(item.ToString());
					}
				}
			}
			ExpressionCollection implementsCollection = subMember.ImplementsCollection;
			if (implementsCollection != null)
			{
				result.IsExplicitInterfaceMember = true;
				foreach (Expression item2 in implementsCollection)
				{
					result.AddImplementsExpression(item2);
				}
			}
			SetDefaultVisibility(result);
		}

		private void SetDefaultVisibility(AccessSpecifiedElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && element.IsDefaultVisibility && base.Context != null)
			{
				MemberVisibility memberVisibility = MemberVisibility.Illegal;
				memberVisibility = ((base.Context is SourceFile || base.Context is Namespace) ? MemberVisibility.Internal : ((base.Context is Struct) ? MemberVisibility.Public : ((!(base.Context is TypeDeclaration)) ? MemberVisibility.Local : ((!(element is Variable)) ? MemberVisibility.Public : MemberVisibility.Private))));
				element.SetVisibility(memberVisibility);
				element.IsDefaultVisibility = true;
			}
		}

		private void AddType(MemberWithParameters result, TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			if (result != null && type != null)
			{
				result.MemberTypeReference = type;
				result.TypeRange = type.Range;
				PassAttributes(result, type);
			}
		}

		protected void FinishCreateMember(MemberWithParameters result, LanguageElementCollection parameters, TypeReferenceExpression type, TokenQueueBase modifiers, VBDeclarator decl, GenericModifier genericModifier, SourceRange nameRange)
		{
			if (result == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (type != null && type.IsTypeCharacter)
			{
				AddType(result, type);
			}
			if (parameters != null && parameters.Count != 0)
			{
				foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
				{
					LocalVarArrayCollection.AddVarArrayName(parameter as BaseVariable);
					PassAttributes(result, parameter as CodeElement);
					result.Parameters.Add(parameter);
				}
			}
			if (type != null && !type.IsTypeCharacter)
			{
				AddType(result, type);
			}
			if (modifiers != null)
			{
				VB90SpecifiersHelper.ParseSpecifiers(modifiers, result);
			}
			if (genericModifier != null)
			{
				result.SetGenericModifier(genericModifier);
			}
			if (decl != null)
			{
				result.MemberType = decl.FullTypeName;
			}
			if (type != null)
			{
				result.MemberType = GetMemberType(type, modifiers);
			}
			if (nameRange != SourceRange.Empty)
			{
				result.NameRange = nameRange;
			}
		}

		protected void SetGenericTypeArguments(ExpressionCollection arguments, Token endToken, ReferenceExpressionBase result)
		{
			if (arguments == null || result == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (arguments.Count != 0)
			{
				int num = arguments.Count - 1;
				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = null;
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					if (arguments[i] is TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression2)
					{
						result.TypeArguments.Add(typeReferenceExpression2);
						result.AddDetailNode(typeReferenceExpression2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (endToken != null)
			{
				result.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(result.Range, endToken.Range));
			}
		}

		private void PreparePreprocessor()
		{
			if (base.RootNode != null && scanner != null)
			{
				SourceFile sourceFile = base.RootNode as SourceFile;
				if (sourceFile == null)
				{
					sourceFile = base.RootNode.GetSourceFile();
				}
				if (sourceFile == null)
				{
					sourceFile = GetSourceFile(string.Empty);
				}
				_Preprocessor = new VBPreprocessor(scanner as VB90Scanner, this, sourceFile);
				_Preprocessor.VbParser = this;
			}
		}

		protected void PrepareParse()
		{
			PrepareParse(base.RootNode);
		}

		protected void PrepareParse(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (context != null && context is SourceFile)
			{
				((SourceFile)context).TextStrings = base.TextStrings;
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				Comments.Clear();
			}
			_NotXmlNode = false;
			_DeclarationsCache.Reset();
			PreparePreprocessor();
			la = new Token();
			la.Value = "";
			Get();
		}

		protected void FinishParse(LanguageElement context)
		{
			SourcePoint end = tToken.Range.End;
			end.Offset++;
			Expect(0);
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				if (base.Context is SourceFile)
				{
					SetContextEnd(end);
					CloseContext();
				}
				_NotXmlNode = false;
				BindComments();
			}
			AfterParsing(context);
		}

			}
		}

		private void AddTextStringOnDemand(Token token)
		{
			if (token != null && token.Type == 17)
			{
				AddTextString(token);
			}
		}

		protected Token SkipTokens(params int[] tokenTypes)
		{
			if (tokenTypes == null)
			{
				return tToken;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				if (la.Type == 0 || la == null)
				{
					return tToken;
				}
				AddTextStringOnDemand(la);
				if (la.Type == 98)
				{
					Token result = tToken;
					Get();
					AddTextStringOnDemand(la);
					if (la.Type == 0 || la == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					foreach (int num in tokenTypes)
					{
						if (la.Type == num)
						{
							return result;
						}
					}
				}
				Get();
			}
			return tToken;
		}

		protected void SetPropertyAccessors(VBProperty property, LanguageElementCollection accessors)
		{
			if (property == null || accessors == null || accessors.Count == 0)
			{
				return;

			foreach (Accessor accessor in accessors)
			{
				AddImplicitParamToAccessor(property, accessor);
				if (accessor != null && accessor.Visibility == MemberVisibility.Illegal)
				{
					accessor.Visibility = property.Visibility;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool IsStatementTerminator()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1 && la.Type != 0)
			{
				return la.Type == 38;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected Expression MethodReferenceToMethodCall(Expression mre, ExpressionCollection parameters)
		{
			return MethodReferenceToMethodCall(mre, parameters, isBaseConstructorCall: false);
		}

		protected Expression MethodReferenceToMethodCall(Expression mre, ExpressionCollection parameters, bool isBaseConstructorCall)
		{
			if (mre == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MethodCallExpression methodCallExpression = null;
			string name = mre.Name;
			bool flag = name != null && AtLeastOrcas();
			if (flag)
			{
				name = name.ToLower();
				flag = name == "getxmlnamespace";
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				methodCallExpression = new GetXmlNamespaceOperator(mre);
				methodCallExpression.Name = "GetXmlNamespace";
			}
			else
			{
				methodCallExpression = new MethodCallExpression(mre);
				methodCallExpression.AddNode(mre);
			}
			methodCallExpression.IsBaseConstructorCall = isBaseConstructorCall;
			if (parameters != null)
			{
				methodCallExpression.Arguments = parameters;
				foreach (LanguageElement parameter in parameters)
				{
					methodCallExpression.AddDetailNode(parameter);
				}
			}
			return methodCallExpression;
		}

		private bool IsSingleLineXmlComment(Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment is XMLDocComment)
			{
				return comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsRemComment(Token token)
		{
			return IsSingleLineCommentName(token, "rem");
		}

		private bool IsXmlComment(Token token)
		{
			return IsSingleLineCommentName(token, "'''");
		}

		private bool IsSimpleSingleLineComment(Token token)
		{
			return IsSingleLineCommentName(token, "'");
		}

		private bool IsSingleLineCommentName(Token token, string name)
		{
			if (name == null || name == string.Empty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int length = name.Length;
			string subStringInTokenValue = GetSubStringInTokenValue(0, length, token);
			if (subStringInTokenValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (subStringInTokenValue == name)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetSubStringInTokenValue(int startIndex, int lenght, Token token)
		{
			if (token == null || token.Value == null || token.Value.Length < lenght)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string value = token.Value;
			string value2 = token.Value;
			value2 = value2.Substring(0, 3);
			return value2.ToLower();
		}

		protected void AddCommentNode(Token lCommentToken)
		{
			CommentType commentType = CommentType.SingleLine;
			string text = lCommentToken.Value;
			int num = 1;
			Comment comment;
			if (IsXmlComment(lCommentToken))
			{
				comment = new XMLDocComment();
				num = 3;
			}
			else
			{
				if (IsRemComment(lCommentToken))
				{
					num = 3;
				}
				comment = new Comment();
			}
			comment.SetCommentType(commentType);
			comment.SetTextStartOffset(num);
			if (!(comment is XMLDocComment))
			{
				text = ((text.Length <= num) ? "" : text.Substring(num));
			}
			if (_PreviousTokenWasComment && IsSingleLineXmlComment(comment) && Comments[Comments.Count - 1] is XMLDocComment xMLDocComment && IsSingleLineXmlComment(xMLDocComment))
			{
				xMLDocComment.InternalName += "\r\n";
				int num2 = 0;
				num2 = lCommentToken.Range.Start.Offset - 1;
				int num3 = 0;
				num3 = lCommentToken.Range.Start.Line - xMLDocComment.Range.End.Line - 1;
				string text2 = new string('\n', num3);
				string text3 = new string('\t', num2);
				xMLDocComment.InternalName += text2;
				xMLDocComment.InternalName += text3;
				xMLDocComment.InternalName += text;
				xMLDocComment.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(xMLDocComment, lCommentToken));
			}
			else
			{
				comment.SetRange(lCommentToken.Range);
				comment.StartPos = lCommentToken.StartPosition;
				comment.EndPos = lCommentToken.EndPosition;
				comment.InternalName = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(text);
				Comments.Add(comment);
			}
		}

		private bool TokenIsComment(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (token.Type != 15)
			{
				return token.Type == 247;
			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			return new VB90ExpressionParser(this);
		}

		protected override void CleanUpParser()
		{
			base.CleanUpParser();
			if (_Preprocessor != null)
			{
				_Preprocessor.CleanUp();
				_Preprocessor = null;
			}
			if (Comments != null)
			{
				Comments.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected void AddToUsingList(string name, string aliasName, Expression exp)
		{
			if (exp == null || !(base.RootNode is SourceFile sourceFile))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (aliasName != null)
			{
				sourceFile.AliasList.Add(aliasName, name);
				if (exp != null)
				{
					Expression value = exp.Clone() as Expression;
					if (!sourceFile.AliasHash.ContainsKey(aliasName))
					{
						sourceFile.AliasHash.Add(aliasName, value);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (name != null && sourceFile.UsingList.IndexOfKey(name) < 0)
			{
				sourceFile.UsingList.Add(name, name);
			}
		}

		protected bool IsAssignmentOperator(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			if ((uint)(type - 18) <= 6u || (uint)(type - 27) <= 1u || type == 47)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsRelationalOp(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 29:
			case 30:
			case 31:
			case 47:
			case 48:
			case 49:
			case 124:
			case 125:
			case 130:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		}

		{
			switch (VsVersion)
			{
			case ParserVersion.VS2002:
			case ParserVersion.VS2003:
				return new VBOldExpressionInverter();
			case ParserVersion.VS2005:
			case ParserVersion.VS2008:
				return new VB90ExpressionInverter();
			default:
				return new VB90ExpressionInverter();
			}
		}

		protected bool IsQueryIdentForDeclaration(DeclaratorType type)
		{
			if (type == DeclaratorType.CanAggregateElement && la.Type == 228)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			return token.Type == 47;
		}

		protected Expression CreateAggregateExpressionIfNeeded(Expression exp, DeclaratorType declaratorType)
		{
			if (exp == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag = declaratorType == DeclaratorType.CanAggregateElement;
			if (declaratorType != DeclaratorType.CanAggregateFunction && !flag)
			{
				return exp;
			}
			if (exp is MethodCallExpression { Name: var name } methodCallExpression && IsAggregateMethodName(name))
			{
				return new AggregateMethodCallExpression(methodCallExpression);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return exp;
			}
			if (exp is ElementReferenceExpression { Name: var name2 } elementReferenceExpression && IsAggregateElementName(name2))
			{
				return new AggregateElementReferenceExpression(elementReferenceExpression);
			}
			return exp;
		}

		private bool IsAggregateElementName(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			name = name.Trim();
			int length = name.Length;
			if (length > 2 && name[0] == '[' && name[length - 1] == ']')
			{
				name = name.Substring(1, length - 2);
			}
			if (string.Compare(name, "Group", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAggregateMethodName(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			name = name.Trim();
			int length = name.Length;
			if (length > 2 && name[0] == '[' && name[length - 1] == ']')
			{
				name = name.Substring(1, length - 2);
			}
			string[] aggregateMethodNames = _AggregateMethodNames;
			foreach (string strB in aggregateMethodNames)
			{
				if (string.Compare(name, strB, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected Expression GetInitializer(QueryIdent ident)
		{
			if (ident == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Expression expression = ident.Expression;
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SourceRange sourceRange = ident.NameRange;
			if (ident.MemberTypeReference != null)
			{
				sourceRange = ident.MemberTypeReference.Range;
			}
			ident.Expression = null;
			ident.DetailNodes.Remove(expression);
			ident.SetRange(new SourceRange(ident.Range.Start, sourceRange.End));
			return expression;
		}

		protected string GetTypeCharacter()
		{
			if (!(scanner is VB90Scanner) || !IsTypeCharacter())
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			Get();
			return tToken.Value;
		}

		private bool IsTypeCharacter()
		{
			if (IsRelationalTokens(tToken, la) && (la.Type == 51 || la.Type == 242 || la.Type == 246 || la.Type == 50 || la.Type == 45 || la.Type == 245))
			{
				return !IsIndexer();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsIndexer()
		{
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (IsIdentifierOrKeyword(token.Type) && IsRelationalTokens(la, token))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsRelationalTokens(Token first, Token second)
		{
			if (first == null || second == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int offset = first.Range.End.Offset;
			int line = first.Range.End.Line;
			int line2 = second.Range.Start.Line;
			int offset2 = second.Range.Start.Offset;
			if (line == line2)
			{
				return offset2 == offset;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsValidEndParsing()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void RecoverParsing()
		{
			if (!IsValidEndParsing())
			{
				SkipTokenToBlockEnd();
				if (la != null && la.Type != 0)
				{
					SetContext(base.RootNode);
					ParseRootRule();
				}
			}
		}

		private void LogSkipToken()
		{
			string text = la.Value;
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = "NullNameToken";
			}
			Log.Send($"Token with name - {text} is skiped.");
			Get();
		}

		private void SkipTokenToBlockEnd()
		{
			while (IsSkipTokensEnd())
			{
				LogSkipToken();
			}
		}

		private bool IsSkipTokensEnd()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (la.Type == 98)
			{
				LogSkipToken();
				if (la == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i <= _EndTokens.Length; i++)
				{
					int num = _EndTokens[i];
					if (la.Type == num)
					{
						LogSkipToken();
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void SetParamProperties(Param param, VBDeclarator decl)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection arrayModifiers = null;
			NullableTypeModifier nullableModifier = null;
			TypeReferenceExpression type = null;
			SetParamProperties(param, decl, out arrayModifiers, out nullableModifier, out type);
		}

		protected void SetParamProperties(Param param, VBDeclarator decl, out LanguageElementCollection arrayModifiers, out NullableTypeModifier nullableModifier, out TypeReferenceExpression type)
		{
			arrayModifiers = null;
			nullableModifier = null;
			type = null;
			if (param == null || decl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (decl != null)
			{
				type = decl.CharacterType;
				arrayModifiers = decl.ArrayModifiers;
				nullableModifier = decl.NullableModifier;
			}
			if (nullableModifier != null)
			{
				param.AddDetailNode(nullableModifier);
				param.NullableModifier = nullableModifier;
			}
			if (arrayModifiers == null || arrayModifiers.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement arrayModifier in arrayModifiers)
			{
				param.AddDetailNode(arrayModifier);
			}
		}

		{
			ConditionalExpression conditionalExpression = null;

		}

		protected LanguageElementCollection CreateVarNextColl(Variable firstVar)
		{
			if (firstVar == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			for (Variable variable = firstVar; variable != null; variable = variable.NextVariable)
			{
				if (firstVar != variable)
				{
					variable.SetAncestorVariable(firstVar);
				}
				languageElementCollection.Add(variable);
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		protected bool IsMethodReferenceExpression()
		{
			if (la.Type != 35)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token.Type != 149)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			if (type == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = 1;
			while (type != 1 && num != 0)
			{
				switch (type)
				{
				case 35:
					num++;
					break;
				case 36:
					num--;
					break;
				}
				token = Peek();
				type = token.Type;
				if (type == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return type == 35;
		}

			target?.SetParensRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(parenOpenRange, parenCloseRange));
		}

		private void AddImplicitParamToAccessor(VBProperty member, Accessor accessor)
		{
			if (accessor is Set set && member != null)
			{
				LanguageElementCollection parameters = set.Parameters;
				if (parameters == null || parameters.Count <= 0)
				{
					string memberType = member.MemberType;
					TypeReferenceExpression memberTypeReference = member.MemberTypeReference;
					Param param = new Param(memberType, "Value");
					param.IsImplicit = true;
					param.MemberTypeReference = memberTypeReference;
					param.SetParent(accessor);
					accessor.ImplicitVariable = param;
				}
			}
		}

		protected Statement GetSimpleStatement(Expression leftPart, SourceRange startRange)
		{
			if (leftPart == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			leftPart.IsStatement = true;
			Statement statement = Statement.FromExpression(leftPart);
			statement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(startRange, tToken.Range));
			return statement;
		}

		private bool IsEndDecl(int tokenType)
		{
			int[] endDeclTokens = _EndDeclTokens;
			foreach (int num in endDeclTokens)
			{
				if (num == tokenType)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsStartNewDecl(int tokenType)
		{
			int[] startDeclTokens = _StartDeclTokens;
			foreach (int num in startDeclTokens)
			{
				if (num == tokenType)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void GetEndToken(bool skipToken)
		{
			if (!skipToken && la.Type == 98)
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidRazorStatementStart(Token la, int scannerStartPosition)
		{
			if (la == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (la.Type)
			{
			case 93:
			case 96:
			case 107:
			case 116:
			case 197:
			case 202:
				return true;
			case 4:
				if (la.Value == "Code" && scannerStartPosition == _FirstTokenStartPosition)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				if (ParsingRazor && la.Value == "<")
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorFunctions(ISourceReader reader, out int scannerPositionDelta)
		{
			scannerPositionDelta = 0;
			return null;
		}

		private LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorStatement()
		{
			LanguageElementCollection result = null;
			Block block = new Block();
			OpenContext(block);
			IsRazorEndCode = false;
			if (IsRazorCodeKeyword(la))
			{
				Get();
				while (la.Type == 1)
				{
					Get();
				}
				BlockRule(SourceRange.Empty, BlockType.IfSingleLineStatement, skipSetBounds: true, out var _);
			}
			else
			{
				Statement statement = null;
				StatementRule(out statement);
			}
			if (block.NodeCount <= 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			int nodeCount = block.NodeCount;
			result = new LanguageElementCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (block.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement value)
				{
					result.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsRazorMarkup()
		{
			if (!ParsingRazor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (la.Type != 242)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ParseRazorMarkup()
		{
			HtmlParser htmlParser = new HtmlParser(isRazorParser: true, workAsXAMLParser: false, DotNetLanguageType.VisualBasic);
			ISourceReader razorReader = GetRazorReader();
			int scannerPositionDelta = -1;
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = htmlParser.ParseSingleElement(razorReader, out scannerPositionDelta);
			if (languageElementCollection != null && base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.AddNodes(languageElementCollection);
			}
			if (scanner.CurrentChar != ':' && scanner.CurrentChar != '*')
			{
				scannerPositionDelta++;
			}
			scannerPositionDelta = la.StartPosition + scannerPositionDelta - scanner.Position + 1;
			scanner.SyncPosition(scannerPositionDelta);
		}

		private LanguageElementCollection ParseHtmlCode(out int scannerPositionDelta)
		{
			HtmlParser htmlParser = new HtmlParser(isRazorParser: true, workAsXAMLParser: false, DotNetLanguageType.VisualBasic);
			ISourceReader razorReader = GetRazorReader();
			scannerPositionDelta = -1;
			return htmlParser.ParseSingleElement(razorReader, out scannerPositionDelta);
		}

		private ISourceReader GetRazorReader()
		{
			ISourceReader sourceReader = scanner.SourceReader;
			TextReader stream = sourceReader.GetStream();
			string text = stream.ReadToEnd();
			int num = la.StartPosition - _FirstTokenStartPosition + 1;
			int num2 = la.EndColumn;
			if (la.Value == "<")
			{
				return sourceReader.GetSubStream(0, text.Length, la.EndLine, la.Column);
			}
			if (scanner.CurrentChar == ':' || scanner.CurrentChar == '*')
			{
				num--;
				num2--;
			}
			return sourceReader.GetSubStream(num, text.Length - num, la.EndLine, num2);
		}

		protected LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorExpression()
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			Expression result = null;
			PrimaryExpression(out result);
			if (result != null)
			{
				languageElementCollection.Add(result);
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		private bool IsRazorCodeKeyword(Token token)
		{
			if (!ParsingRazor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (token.Type != 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.Compare(token.Value, "Code", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorCode(ISourceReader reader, ref int scannerPositionDelta)
		{
			try
			{
				_ParsingRazor = true;
				scanner = new VB90Scanner(reader);
				int num = scanner.Position - 1;
				int num2 = num;
				Comments.Clear();
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				PreparePreprocessor();
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				_FirstTokenStartPosition = la.StartPosition;
				LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = null;
				if (la.Value == "<")
				{
					return ParseHtmlCode(out scannerPositionDelta);
				}
				languageElementCollection = ((!IsValidRazorStatementStart(la, num)) ? ParseRazorExpression() : ParseRazorStatement());
				num2 = tToken.EndPosition;
				scannerPositionDelta = num2 - num;
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				_ParsingRazor = false;
				IsRazorEndCode = false;
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseRazorHelper(ISourceReader reader, out int scannerPositionDelta)
		{
			try
			{
				_ParsingRazor = true;
				scanner = new VB90Scanner(reader);
				int num = scanner.Position - 1;
				int num2 = num;
				Comments.Clear();
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				PreparePreprocessor();
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				_FirstTokenStartPosition = la.StartPosition;
				LanguageElement result = ParseRazorHelper();
				num2 = tToken.EndPosition;
				scannerPositionDelta = num2 - num;
				return result;
			}
			finally
			{
				_ParsingRazor = false;
				IsRazorEndCode = false;
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private LanguageElement ParseRazorHelper()
		{
			Token token = la;
			SubMemberData result = null;
			MethodTypeEnum methodTypeEnum = MethodTypeEnum.Function;
			VBDeclarator decl = null;
			MethodSignature(out result, out decl);
			if (result == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Method method = CreateMethod(result, methodTypeEnum, null, decl, SourceRange.Empty);
			StatementTerminator();
			OpenContext(method);
			Block(token);
			CloseContext();
			if (la.Type == 98)
			{
				Get();
			}
			if (la.Type == 4 && string.Compare("helper", la.Value, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				Get();
			}
			method.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(token, tToken));
			return method;
		}
	}
	public class VB90ExpressionInverter : ExpressionInverterBase

	public sealed class VB90SpecifiersHelper
	{
		private VB90SpecifiersHelper()
		{
		}

		public static void ParseSpecifiers(TokenQueueBase queue, Accessor element)
		{
			if (queue == null || element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetBlockRange(element, queue);
			while (queue.Count > 0)
			{
				Token currentToken = queue.CurrentToken;
				switch (currentToken.Type)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case 161:
					element.Visibility = MemberVisibility.Private;
					element.VisibilityRange = currentToken.Range;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 164:
					element.Visibility = MemberVisibility.Public;
					element.VisibilityRange = currentToken.Range;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 163:
					element.Visibility = MemberVisibility.Protected;
					element.VisibilityRange = currentToken.Range;
					queue.Dequeue();
					if (queue.Count > 0 && queue.CurrentToken.Type == 108)
					{
						element.Visibility = MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal;
						element.VisibilityRange = new SourceRange(element.VisibilityRange.Start, queue.CurrentToken.Range.End);
						queue.Dequeue();
					}
					break;
				case 108:
					element.Visibility = MemberVisibility.Internal;
					element.VisibilityRange = currentToken.Range;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 157:
					element.IsVirtual = true;
					element.VirtualRange = currentToken.Range;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 156:
					element.IsOverloads = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 158:
					element.IsOverride = true;
					element.OverrideRange = currentToken.Range;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 177:
				case 180:
					element.IsStatic = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 136:
					element.IsAbstract = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 137:
					if (!element.IsAbstract)
					{
						element.IsAbstract = true;
						queue.Dequeue();
					}
					break;
				case 176:
					element.IsNew = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 205:
					element.IsWithEvents = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 167:
					element.IsReadOnly = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 206:
					element.IsWriteOnly = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 89:
					element.IsDefault = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 146:
					element.IsSealed = true;
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 147:
					if (!element.IsSealed)
					{
						element.IsSealed = true;
						queue.Dequeue();
					}
					break;
				case 91:
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 76:
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 160:
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SetBlockRange(DelimiterCapableBlock block, TokenQueueBase queue)
		{
			if (block != null && queue != null && queue.Count != 0)
			{
				Token currentToken = queue.CurrentToken;
				block.SetBlockStart(currentToken.Range);
			}
		}

		public static void ParseSpecifiers(TokenQueueBase queue, AccessSpecifiedElement element)
		{
			if (queue == null || element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetBlockRange(element, queue);
			if (element.AccessSpecifiers == null)
			{
				AccessSpecifiers accessSpecifiers = new AccessSpecifiers();
				element.SetAccessSpecifiers(accessSpecifiers);
			}
			int num = 0;
			int count = queue.Count;
			while (count > num)
			{
				Token token = queue.Peek(num);
				num++;
				switch (token.Type)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case 160:
					element.IsPartial = true;
					element.SetPartialRange(token);
					break;
				case 203:
					if (element != null && element is Method)
					{
						((Method)element).IsImplicitCast = true;
						((Method)element).Name = "op_Implicit";
					}
					break;
				case 141:
					if (element != null && element is Method)
					{
						((Method)element).IsExplicitCast = true;
						((Method)element).Name = "op_Explicit";
					}
					break;
				case 161:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Private, token);
					break;
				case 4:
				{
					string text = token.Value.ToLower();
					if (!(text == "async"))
					{
						if (text == "iterator")
						{
							element.AccessSpecifiers.SetIteratorRange(token);
							element.AccessSpecifiers.IsIterator = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						element.AccessSpecifiers.SetAsynchronousRange(token);
						element.AccessSpecifiers.IsAsynchronous = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				case 164:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Public, token);
					break;
				case 163:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Protected, token);
					break;
				case 108:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Internal, token);
					break;
				case 157:
					element.IsVirtual = true;
					element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(token);
					break;
				case 156:
					element.IsOverloads = true;
					element.SetOverloadsRange(token);
					break;
				case 158:
					element.IsOverride = true;
					element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(token);
					break;
				case 177:
				case 180:
					element.IsStatic = true;
					element.SetStaticRange(token);
					break;
				case 136:
					element.IsAbstract = true;
					element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(token);
					break;
				case 137:
					if (!element.IsAbstract)
					{
						element.IsAbstract = true;
						element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(token);
					}
					break;
				case 176:
					element.IsNew = true;
					element.SetNewRange(token);
					break;
				case 205:
					element.IsWithEvents = true;
					element.SetWithEventsRange(token);
					break;
				case 167:
					element.IsReadOnly = true;
					element.SetReadOnlyRange(token);
					break;
				case 206:
					element.IsWriteOnly = true;
					element.SetWriteOnlyRange(token);
					break;
				case 89:
					element.IsDefault = true;
					element.SetDefaultRange(token);
					break;
				case 146:
					element.IsSealed = true;
					element.SetSealedRange(token);
					break;
				case 147:
					if (!element.IsSealed)
					{
						element.IsSealed = true;
						element.SetSealedRange(token);
					}
					break;
				case 76:
				case 91:
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public sealed class VBSpecifiersHelper
	{
		private VBSpecifiersHelper()
		{
		}

		public static void ParseSpecifiers(TokenQueueBase queue, AccessSpecifiedElement element)
		{
			if (queue == null || element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AccessSpecifiers accessSpecifiers = new AccessSpecifiers();
			element.SetAccessSpecifiers(accessSpecifiers);
			while (queue.Count > 0)
			{
				Token currentToken = queue.CurrentToken;
				switch (currentToken.Type)
				{
				default:
					return;
				case 76:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Private, currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 78:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Public, currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 77:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Protected, currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1036:
					element.SetVisibility(MemberVisibility.Internal, currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1065:
					element.IsVirtual = true;
					element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1064:
					element.IsOverloads = true;
					element.SetOverloadsRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1066:
					element.IsOverride = true;
					element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 92:
				case 1076:
					element.IsStatic = true;
					element.SetStaticRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1050:
					element.IsAbstract = true;
					element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1051:
					if (!element.IsAbstract)
					{
						element.IsAbstract = true;
						element.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(currentToken);
						queue.Dequeue();
					}
					break;
				case 1075:
					element.IsNew = true;
					element.SetNewRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1090:
					element.IsWithEvents = true;
					element.SetWithEventsRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 79:
					element.IsReadOnly = true;
					element.SetReadOnlyRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1091:
					element.IsWriteOnly = true;
					element.SetWriteOnlyRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 30:
					element.IsDefault = true;
					element.SetDefaultRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1057:
					element.IsSealed = true;
					element.SetSealedRange(currentToken);
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 1058:
					if (!element.IsSealed)
					{
						element.IsSealed = true;
						element.SetSealedRange(currentToken);
						queue.Dequeue();
					}
					break;
				case 1027:
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 25:
					queue.Dequeue();
					break;
				case 157:
					queue.Dequeue();
					if (element is TypeDeclaration)
					{
						TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = (TypeDeclaration)element;
						typeDeclaration.IsPartial = true;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class VBExpressionParserBase : ExpressionParserBase
	{
		public abstract VBTokensBase VBTokens { get; }

		public VBExpressionParserBase(ParserBase parser)
			: base(parser)
		{
		}
	}
	internal sealed class VBLanguageUtils : LanguageUtils
	{
		private class VBTokenizer : Tokenizer
		{
			private const string STR_XMLDocTag = "XML Doc Tag";

			private static bool IsString(int type)
			{
				if (type != 17)
				{
					return type == 16;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static bool IsNumber(int type)
			{
				if (type != 2)
				{
					return type == 3;
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static bool IsComment(int type)
			{
				return type == 15;
			}

			private static bool IsKeyword(int type)
			{
				if (type == 216)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return VB90Parser.IsKeyword(type);
			}

			public override TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
			{
				if (token == null)
				{
					return TokenCategory.Text;
				}
				if (IsKeyword(token.Type))
				{
					return TokenCategory.Keyword;
				}
				if (VB90Parser.IsOperator(token.Type))
				{
					return TokenCategory.Operator;
				}
				if (VB90Parser.IsPreprocessorDirective(token.Type))
				{
					return TokenCategory.PreprocessorKeyword;
				}
				if (IsString(token.Type))
				{
					return TokenCategory.String;
				}
				if (IsComment(token.Type))
				{
					return TokenCategory.Comment;
				}
				if (token.Type == 247)
				{
					return TokenCategory.XmlComment;
				}
				if (token.Type == 4)
				{
					switch (token.Value.ToLower())
					{
					case "string":
					case "object":
					case "getxmlnamespace":
						return TokenCategory.Keyword;
					default:
						return TokenCategory.Identifier;
					}
				}
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}

			public override string GetTokenCategory(Token token, ParserVersion version)
			{
				if (token == null)
				{
					return "Text";
				}
				if (!(token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken))
				{
					return "Text";
				}
				if (token.Type == 4)
				{
					string text = token.Value.ToLower();
					switch (text)
					{
					default:
						if (version < ParserVersion.VS2008 || !(text == "getxmlnamespace"))
						{
							break;
						}
						goto case "string";
					case "string":
					case "object":
						return "Keyword";
					case null:
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (token.Type == 247)
				{
					try
					{
						string xMLTagName = StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetXMLTagName();
						if (xMLTagName != null)
						{
							return xMLTagName;
						}
						return "XML Doc Tag";
					}
					catch
					{
						return "XML Doc Tag";
					}
				}
				return categorizedToken.GetTokenCategory();
			}

			public override IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
				{
					return new List<CategorizedToken>().AsReadOnly();
				}
				ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
				VB10Parser vB10Parser = new VB10Parser();
				vB10Parser.SetTokensCategory = true;
				vB10Parser.Parse(reader);
				TokenCollection savedTokens = vB10Parser.SavedTokens;
				int count = vB10Parser.SavedTokens.Count;
				List<CategorizedToken> list = new List<CategorizedToken>(count);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					CategorizedToken item = (CategorizedToken)savedTokens[i];
					list.Add(item);
				}
				return list.AsReadOnly();
			}
		}

		public override ParserBase CreateParser(ParserVersion version, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embededLanguage)
		{
			if (version > ParserVersion.VS2008)
			{
				return new VB10Parser();
			}
			return new VB90Parser();
		}

		public override CodeGen CreateCodeGen()
		{
			CodeGen codeGen = new VB90CodeGen();
			if (codeGen != null)
			{
				codeGen.Code = new CodeWriter(new StringWriter(), new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.Basic));
			}
			return codeGen;
		}

		public override ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder()
		{
			return new VBElementBuilder();
		}

		public override Tokenizer CreateTokenizer()
		{
			return new VBTokenizer();
		}
	}
	public sealed class VBOperatorHelper
	{
		public static FormattingTokenType GetOperatorNaturalName(string name)
		{
			if (name == null || name == string.Empty)
			{
				return FormattingTokenType.Ident;
			}
			switch (name.ToLower())
			{
			case "op_subtraction":
			case "op_unarynegation":
				return FormattingTokenType.Minus;
			case "op_addition":
			case "op_unaryplus":
				return FormattingTokenType.Plus;
			case "op_true":
				return FormattingTokenType.IsTrue;
			case "op_false":
				return FormattingTokenType.IsFalse;
			case "op_onescomplement":
				return FormattingTokenType.Not;
			case "op_multiply":
				return FormattingTokenType.Asterisk;
			case "op_division":
				return FormattingTokenType.Slash;
			case "op_integerdivision":
				return FormattingTokenType.BackSlash;
			case "op_modulus":
				return FormattingTokenType.Mod;
			case "op_exclusiveor":
				return FormattingTokenType.Xor;
			case "op_bitwiseand":
				return FormattingTokenType.And;
			case "op_bitwiseor":
				return FormattingTokenType.Or;
			case "op_leftshift":
				return FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThan;
			case "op_rightshift":
				return FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThan;
			case "op_equality":
				return FormattingTokenType.Equal;
			case "op_greaterthan":
				return FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen;
			case "op_lessthan":
				return FormattingTokenType.LessThan;
			case "op_inequality":
				return FormattingTokenType.LessThanGreaterThan;
			case "op_greaterthanorequal":
				return FormattingTokenType.GreaterThenEqual;
			case "op_lessthanorequal":
				return FormattingTokenType.LessThanEqual;
			case "op_exponent":
				return FormattingTokenType.Caret;
			case "op_Like":
				return FormattingTokenType.Like;
			case "op_concatenate":
				return FormattingTokenType.Ampersand;
			default:
				return FormattingTokenType.Ident;
			}
		}

		private static OperatorType GetUnaryOperatorType(string name)
		{
			return name.ToLower() switch
			{
				"-" => OperatorType.UnaryNegation, 
				"+" => OperatorType.UnaryPlus, 
				"not" => OperatorType.OnesComplement, 
				"istrue" => OperatorType.True, 
				"isfalse" => OperatorType.False, 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		private static OperatorType GetBinaryOperatorType(string name)
		{
			return name.ToLower() switch
			{
				"+" => OperatorType.Addition, 
				"-" => OperatorType.Subtraction, 
				"*" => OperatorType.Multiply, 
				"/" => OperatorType.Division, 
				"\\" => OperatorType.IntegerDivision, 
				"mod" => OperatorType.Modulus, 
				"xor" => OperatorType.ExclusiveOr, 
				"and" => OperatorType.BitwiseAnd, 
				"or" => OperatorType.BitwiseOr, 
				"<<" => OperatorType.LeftShift, 
				">>" => OperatorType.RightShift, 
				"=" => OperatorType.Equality, 
				">" => OperatorType.GreaterThan, 
				"<" => OperatorType.LessThan, 
				"<>" => OperatorType.Inequality, 
				">=" => OperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual, 
				"<=" => OperatorType.LessThanOrEqual, 
				"^" => OperatorType.Exponent, 
				"like" => OperatorType.Like, 
				"&" => OperatorType.Concatenate, 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		private static string GetUnaryOperatorName(OperatorType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				OperatorType.UnaryNegation => "op_UnaryNegation", 
				OperatorType.UnaryPlus => "op_UnaryPlus", 
				OperatorType.True => "op_True", 
				OperatorType.False => "op_False", 
				OperatorType.OnesComplement => "op_OnesComplement", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private static string GetBinaryOperatorName(OperatorType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				OperatorType.Addition => "op_Addition", 
				OperatorType.Subtraction => "op_Subtraction", 
				OperatorType.Multiply => "op_Multiply", 
				OperatorType.Division => "op_Division", 
				OperatorType.IntegerDivision => "op_IntegerDivision", 
				OperatorType.Modulus => "op_Modulus", 
				OperatorType.ExclusiveOr => "op_ExclusiveOr", 
				OperatorType.BitwiseAnd => "op_BitwiseAnd", 
				OperatorType.BitwiseOr => "op_BitwiseOr", 
				OperatorType.LeftShift => "op_LeftShift", 
				OperatorType.RightShift => "op_RightShift", 
				OperatorType.Equality => "op_Equality", 
				OperatorType.GreaterThan => "op_GreaterThan", 
				OperatorType.LessThan => "op_LessThan", 
				OperatorType.Inequality => "op_Inequality", 
				OperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual => "op_GreaterThanOrEqual", 
				OperatorType.LessThanOrEqual => "op_LessThanOrEqual", 
				OperatorType.Exponent => "op_Exponent", 
				OperatorType.Like => "op_Like", 
				OperatorType.Concatenate => "op_Concatenate", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		public static OperatorType GetOperatorType(string value, int parameterCount)
		{
			return parameterCount switch
			{
				1 => GetUnaryOperatorType(value), 
				2 => GetBinaryOperatorType(value), 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		public static string GetOperatorName(OperatorType type, int parameterCount)
		{
			return parameterCount switch
			{
				1 => GetUnaryOperatorName(type), 
				2 => GetBinaryOperatorName(type), 
				_ => "", 
			};
		}
	}
	public abstract class VBParserBase : ParserBase
	{
		public override string Language => "Basic";

		public VBParserBase()
		{
		}

		protected override InitializedVariable CreateInitializedVariable()
		{
			return new InitializedVariable();
		}

		protected override Variable CreateVariable()
		{
			return new Variable();
		}

		protected override Const CreateConst()
		{
			return new Const();
		}

		public override bool SupportsFileExtension(string ext)
		{
			return ext.ToLower() == ".vb";
		}

		public override SourceFile GetSourceFile(string aSourceFileName)
		{
			return new VBSourceFile(aSourceFileName);
		}
	}
	public class VBPrimitiveTypeUtils
	{
		private const string STR_H = "&H";

		private const string STR_h = "&h";

		private const string STR_O = "&O";

		private const string STR_o = "&o";

		private const string STR_S = "s";

		private const string STR_US = "US";

		private const string STR_uS = "uS";

		private const string STR_Us = "Us";

		private const string STR_us = "us";

		private const string STR_I = "i";

		private const string STR_UI = "UI";

		private const string STR_uI = "uI";

		private const string STR_Ui = "Ui";

		private const string STR_ui = "ui";

		private const string STR_L = "L";

		private const string STR_UL = "UL";

		private const string STR_uL = "uL";

		private const string STR_Ul = "Ul";

		private const string STR_ul = "ul";

		private const string STR_F = "f";

		private const string STR_R = "r";

		private const string STR_D = "d";

		private const string STR_F_ = "!";

		private const string STR_R_ = "#";

		private const string STR_D_ = "@";

		private VBPrimitiveTypeUtils()
		{
		}

		private static bool ConvertToDecimal(string value, out decimal result)
		{
			result = -1m;
			try
			{
				decimal num;
				if (IsHexLiteral(value))
				{
					num = Convert.ToUInt64(value.Substring(2), 16);
					result = num;
					return true;
				}
				if (IsOctalLiteral(value))
				{
					num = Convert.ToUInt64(value.Substring(2), 8);
					result = num;
					return true;
				}
				num = Convert.ToDecimal(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.NumberFormat);
				result = num;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static PrimitiveType GetIntegerTypeFromValue(string value)
		{
			if (!ConvertToDecimal(value, out var result))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			return PrimitiveTypeUtils.GetPrimitiveType(result);
		}

		private static bool EndsWith(string str, string strEnd)
		{
			if (str == null || strEnd == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return str.EndsWith(strEnd, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		private static string GetIntegerLiteralSuffix(string value)
		{
			string str = value.ToLower();
			if (EndsWith(str, "US"))
			{
				return "US";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "uS"))
			{
				return "uS";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "Us"))
			{
				return "Us";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "us"))
			{
				return "us";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "s"))
			{
				return "s";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "UI"))
			{
				return "UI";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "uI"))
			{
				return "uI";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "Ui"))
			{
				return "Ui";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "ui"))
			{
				return "ui";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "i"))
			{
				return "i";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "UL"))
			{
				return "UL";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "uL"))
			{
				return "uL";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "Ul"))
			{
				return "Ul";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "ul"))
			{
				return "ul";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "L"))
			{
				return "L";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static string GetFloatingPointLiteralSuffix(string value)
		{
			string str = value.ToLower();
			if (EndsWith(str, "f"))
			{
				return "f";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "r"))
			{
				return "r";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "d"))
			{
				return "d";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "!"))
			{
				return "!";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "#"))
			{
				return "#";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "@"))
			{
				return "@";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static bool GetIntegerLiteralValue(string value, out decimal intValue)
		{
			intValue = -1m;
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string integerLiteralSuffix = GetIntegerLiteralSuffix(value);
			decimal result;
			if (integerLiteralSuffix != null && integerLiteralSuffix.Length > 0)
			{
				string value2 = value.Substring(0, value.Length - integerLiteralSuffix.Length);
				if (!ConvertToDecimal(value2, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
				intValue = result;
				return true;
			}
			if (!ConvertToDecimal(value, out result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			intValue = result;
			return true;
		}

		private static bool GetFloatingPointLiteralValue(string value, out decimal realValue)
		{
			realValue = -1m;
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string floatingPointLiteralSuffix = GetFloatingPointLiteralSuffix(value);
			decimal result;
			if (floatingPointLiteralSuffix != null && floatingPointLiteralSuffix.Length > 0)
			{
				string value2 = value.Substring(0, value.Length - floatingPointLiteralSuffix.Length);
				if (!ConvertToDecimal(value2, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
				realValue = result;
				return true;
			}
			if (!ConvertToDecimal(value, out result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			realValue = result;
			return true;
		}

		public static PrimitiveType NarrowIntegerLiteralType(string value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			if (!GetIntegerLiteralValue(value, out var intValue))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			string integerLiteralSuffix = GetIntegerLiteralSuffix(value);
			if (integerLiteralSuffix != null && integerLiteralSuffix.Length > 0)
			{
				return NarrowIntegerLiteralType(integerLiteralSuffix, intValue);
			}
			switch (GetIntegerTypeFromValue(value))
			{
			case PrimitiveType.Byte:
			case PrimitiveType.SByte:
			case PrimitiveType.Int16:
			case PrimitiveType.Int32:
			case PrimitiveType.UInt16:
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			default:
				return PrimitiveType.Int64;
			}
		}

		private static PrimitiveType NarrowIntegerLiteralType(string suffix, decimal intValue)
		{
			if (suffix == null && suffix.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			switch (suffix)
			{
			case "s":
				return PrimitiveType.Int16;
			case "US":
			case "uS":
			case "Us":
			case "us":
				return PrimitiveType.UInt16;
			case "i":
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			case "UI":
			case "uI":
			case "Ui":
			case "ui":
				return PrimitiveType.UInt32;
			case "L":
				return PrimitiveType.Int64;
			case "UL":
			case "uL":
			case "Ul":
			case "ul":
				return PrimitiveType.UInt64;
			default:
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
		}

		public static PrimitiveType NarrowFloatingPointLiteralType(string value)
		{
			string floatingPointLiteralSuffix = GetFloatingPointLiteralSuffix(value);
			if (floatingPointLiteralSuffix == null || floatingPointLiteralSuffix.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Double;
			}
			return floatingPointLiteralSuffix switch
			{
				"f" => PrimitiveType.Single, 
				"r" => PrimitiveType.Double, 
				"d" => PrimitiveType.Decimal, 
				"!" => PrimitiveType.Single, 
				"#" => PrimitiveType.Double, 
				"@" => PrimitiveType.Decimal, 
				_ => PrimitiveType.Double, 
			};
		}

		public static PrimitiveType NarrowCharAndStringLiteralType(string value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.String;
			}
			if (HasCharSuffix(value))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Char;
			}
			return PrimitiveType.String;
		}

		private static bool HasCharSuffix(string value)
		{
			if (value.EndsWith("C") || value.EndsWith("c"))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string RemoveQuotes(string s)
		{
			if (s == null || s.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (s == "\"\"")
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = 1;
			int length = s.Length - num - 1;
			return s.Substring(num, length);
		}

		private static string RemoveCharQuotes(string s)
		{
			if (s == null || s.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (s == "\"\"c")
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (s == "\"\"C")
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = 1;
			int length = s.Length - num - 2;
			return s.Substring(num, length);
		}

		public static PrimitiveType ToPrimitiveType(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			return ToPrimitiveType(token.Type, token.EscapedValue);
		}

		public static PrimitiveType ToPrimitiveType(int tokenType, string value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Void;
			}
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case 47:
			case 98:
				return PrimitiveType.Boolean;
			case 1056:
				return PrimitiveType.Void;
			case 132:
				return PrimitiveType.String;
			case 131:
				return PrimitiveType.Char;
			case 1108:
				return PrimitiveType.DateTime;
			case 133:
				return NarrowIntegerLiteralType(value);
			case 134:
				return NarrowFloatingPointLiteralType(value);
			default:
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
		}

		public static object ToPrimitiveValue(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ToPrimitiveValue(token.Type, token.EscapedValue);
		}

		public static object ToPrimitiveValue(int tokenType, string value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Void;
			}
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case 98:
				return true;
			case 47:
				return false;
			case 69:
				return null;
			case 132:
				return RemoveQuotes(value);
			case 131:
				return RemoveCharQuotes(value);
			case 1108:
				return DateTime.MinValue;
			case 133:
			{
				if (!GetIntegerLiteralValue(value, out var intValue))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return intValue;
			}
			case 134:
			{
				if (!GetFloatingPointLiteralValue(value, out var realValue))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return realValue;
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static object ToPrimitiveValueFromPrimitiveType(PrimitiveType primitiveType, string value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Void;
			}
			switch (primitiveType)
			{
			case PrimitiveType.Boolean:
				if (value.ToLower() == "TRUE")
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case PrimitiveType.Void:
				return null;
			case PrimitiveType.String:
				return RemoveQuotes(value);
			case PrimitiveType.Char:
				return RemoveCharQuotes(value);
			case PrimitiveType.DateTime:
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					return DateTime.MinValue;
				}
				DateTime result = DateTime.MinValue;
				if (DateTime.TryParse(value, out result))
				{
					return result;
				}
				return DateTime.MinValue;
			}
			case PrimitiveType.Int16:
			case PrimitiveType.Int32:
			case PrimitiveType.Int64:
			{
				if (!GetIntegerLiteralValue(value, out var intValue))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return intValue;
			}
			case PrimitiveType.Double:
			{
				if (!GetFloatingPointLiteralValue(value, out var realValue))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return realValue;
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsHexLiteral(string value)
		{
			if (!value.StartsWith("&H"))
			{
				return value.StartsWith("&h");
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsOctalLiteral(string value)
		{
			if (!value.StartsWith("&O"))
			{
				return value.StartsWith("&o");
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static string GetTypeSuffix(object value, PrimitiveType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				PrimitiveType.SByte => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.Byte => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.Int32 => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.UInt32 => "Ui", 
				PrimitiveType.UInt16 => "Us", 
				PrimitiveType.UInt64 => "Ul", 
				PrimitiveType.Int16 => "s", 
				PrimitiveType.Int64 => "L", 
				PrimitiveType.Single => "f", 
				PrimitiveType.Double => "r", 
				PrimitiveType.Decimal => "d", 
				_ => GetTypeSuffix(value), 
			};
		}

		private static string GetTypeSuffix(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is sbyte)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is byte)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is int)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is uint)
			{
				return "Ui";
			}
			if (value is ushort)
			{
				return "Us";
			}
			if (value is ulong)
			{
				return "Ul";
			}
			if (value is short)
			{
				return "s";
			}
			if (value is long)
			{
				return "L";
			}
			if (value is float)
			{
				return "f";
			}
			if (value is double)
			{
				return "r";
			}
			if (value is decimal)
			{
				return "d";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
