	public abstract class VBTokensBase : LanguageTokensBase
	{
		private Hashtable _Keywords;

		private Hashtable _Punctuators;

		private Hashtable _Directives;

		private Hashtable _Tokens;

		private string[] tokens;

		private Hashtable _PrimitiveToFullTypes;

		private Hashtable _FullToPrimitiveTypes;

		private static StringBuilder _Worker = new StringBuilder("");

		public const char IntegerTypeCharacter = '%';

		public const char LongTypeCharacter = '&';

		public const char DecimalTypeCharacter = '@';

		public const char SingleTypeCharacter = '!';

		public const char DoubleTypeCharacter = '#';

		public const char StringTypeCharacter = '$';

		public const char ShortCharacter = 'S';

		public const char IntegerCharacter = 'I';

		public const char LongCharacter = 'L';

		public const char SingleCharacter = 'F';

		public const char DoubleCharacter = 'R';

		public const char DecimalCharacter = 'D';

		public Hashtable Keywords => _Keywords;

		public Hashtable Punctuators => _Punctuators;

		public Hashtable Directives => _Directives;

		protected VBTokensBase()
		{
			tokens = new string[1560];
			PopulateTokenTable();
		}

		private void AddToken(int token, string name)
		{
			tokens[token] = name;
		}

		private void AddDirective(string name, int token)
		{
			_Directives[name] = token;
			AddToken(token, name);
		}

		private void PopulateTokenTable()
		{
			LoadKeyWords();
			LoadPunctuators();
			LoadDirectives();
			LoadTokens();
			LoadTypeConversionTables();
		}

		private void LoadTokens(Hashtable source)
		{
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in source)
			{
				_Tokens.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
		}

		private void LoadTokens()
		{
			_Tokens = CollectionsUtil.CreateCaseInsensitiveHashtable();
			LoadTokens(_Keywords);
			LoadTokens(_Directives);
			LoadTokens(_Punctuators);
		}

		private void LoadKeyWords()
		{
			_Keywords = CollectionsUtil.CreateCaseInsensitiveHashtable();
			StringCollection stringCollection = CreateKeywords();
			StringEnumerator enumerator = stringCollection.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					string current = enumerator.Current;
					int tokenType = TokenType.GetTokenType(current);
					AddToken(tokenType, current);
					_Keywords[current] = tokenType;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private void LoadPunctuator(int type)
		{
			string punctuator = VBPunctuators.GetPunctuator(type);
			AddToken(type, punctuator);
			if (punctuator != null)
			{
				_Punctuators[punctuator] = type;
			}
		}

		private void LoadPunctuators()
		{
			_Punctuators = new Hashtable();
			IEnumerator enumerator = VBPunctuators.TokenTypes.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				LoadPunctuator((int)enumerator.Current);
			}
		}

		private void LoadDirectives()
		{
			_Directives = CollectionsUtil.CreateCaseInsensitiveHashtable();
			AddDirective("#const", 1104);
			AddDirective("#if", 56);
			AddDirective("#else", 38);
			AddDirective("#elseif", 1105);
			AddDirective("#region", 80);
			AddDirective("#externalsource", 1106);
			AddDirective("#endif", 39);
			AddDirective("#end if", 39);
			AddDirective("#end region", 40);
			AddDirective("#end externalsource", 1107);
		}

		private void LoadTypeConversionTables()
		{
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes = new Hashtable();
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["sbyte"] = "System.SByte";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["boolean"] = "System.Boolean";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["date"] = "System.DateTime";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["byte"] = "System.Byte";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["char"] = "System.Char";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["decimal"] = "System.Decimal";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["double"] = "System.Double";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["single"] = "System.Single";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["integer"] = "System.Int32";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["long"] = "System.Int64";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["object"] = "System.Object";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["short"] = "System.Int16";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["string"] = "System.String";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["void"] = "System.Void";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["ushort"] = "System.UInt16";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["uinteger"] = "System.UInt32";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["ulong"] = "System.UInt64";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes = new Hashtable();
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.uint16"] = "UShort";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.uint32"] = "UInteger";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.uint64"] = "ULong";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.sbyte"] = "SByte";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.boolean"] = "Boolean";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.byte"] = "Byte";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.datetime"] = "Date";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.char"] = "Char";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.decimal"] = "Decimal";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.double"] = "Double";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.single"] = "Single";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.int32"] = "Integer";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.int64"] = "Long";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.object"] = "Object";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.int16"] = "Short";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.string"] = "String";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["system.void"] = "Void";
		}

		public static bool IsEscapedIdentifier(string name)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = name.Trim();
			if (text.IndexOf("[") >= 0)
			{
				return text.IndexOf("]") >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static string RemoveIdentifierEscapes(string name)
		{
			if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return name;
			}
			return name.Substring(1, name.Length - 2);
		}

		public int GetKeywordToken(string word)
		{
			object obj = _Keywords[word];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return (int)obj;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public string GetTokenString(int tokenType)
		{
			return tokens[tokenType];
		}

		public int GetDirectiveToken(string word)
		{
			object obj = _Directives[word];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return (int)obj;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public string GetFullTypeName(string simpleName)
		{
			if (simpleName == null || simpleName.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string text = simpleName.ToLower();
			if (IsEscapedIdentifier(text))
			{
				text = RemoveIdentifierEscapes(text);
			}
			if (_PrimitiveToFullTypes.ContainsKey(text))
			{
				return (string)_PrimitiveToFullTypes[text];
			}
			return simpleName;
		}

		public string GetSimpleTypeName(string fullName)
		{
			if (fullName == null || fullName.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			string key = fullName.ToLower();
			if (_FullToPrimitiveTypes.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return (string)_FullToPrimitiveTypes[key];
			}
			return fullName;
		}

		public bool IsBooleanLiteral(int tokenType)
		{
			if (tokenType != 98)
			{
				return tokenType == 47;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsBooleanLiteral(string word)
		{
			int tokenType = ToTokenType(word);
			return IsBooleanLiteral(tokenType);
		}

		public bool IsNullLiteral(int tokenType)
		{
			return tokenType == 1056;
		}

		public bool IsNullLiteral(string word)
		{
			int tokenType = ToTokenType(word);
			return IsNullLiteral(tokenType);
		}

		public bool IsCastTargetToken(Token token)
		{
			int type = token.Type;
			if ((uint)(type - 163) <= 11u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsTypeCharacter(char aCh)
		{
			switch (aCh)
			{
			case '!':
			case '#':
			case '$':
			case '%':
			case '&':
			case '@':
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsIntegralTypeCharacter(char aCh)
		{
			switch (char.ToUpper(aCh))
			{
			case '%':
			case '&':
			case 'I':
			case 'L':
			case 'S':
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsFloatingPointTypeCharacter(char aCh)
		{
			switch (char.ToUpper(aCh))
			{
			case '!':
			case '#':
			case '@':
			case 'D':
			case 'F':
			case 'R':
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsLineContinuation(char ch)
		{
			if (ch == '_')
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsKeyword(string word)
		{
			return _Keywords.Contains(word);
		}

		public override bool IsIdentifier(string word)
		{
			return ToTokenType(word) == 1;
		}

		public bool IsIdentifier(Token token)
		{
			if (token.Match(162))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (token.Match(-1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return token.Type == 1;
		}

		public override bool IsStandardType(string word)
		{
			if (IsKeyword(word))
			{
				return IsStandardType(ToTokenType(word));
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsStandardType(int tokenType)
		{
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case 13:
			case 17:
			case 20:
			case 29:
			case 35:
			case 59:
			case 66:
			case 70:
			case 85:
			case 89:
			case 93:
			case 102:
			case 103:
			case 107:
			case 109:
			case 1025:
			case 1077:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsOctalDigit(char ch)
		{
			if (char.IsDigit(ch))
			{
				int num = int.Parse(ch.ToString());
				if (num >= 0 && num <= 7)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsHexDigit(char ch)
		{
			if (char.IsDigit(ch))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (char.IsLetter(ch))
			{
				switch (char.ToUpper(ch))
				{
				case 'A':
				case 'B':
				case 'C':
				case 'D':
				case 'E':
				case 'F':
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsDirective(int type)
		{
			return _Directives.ContainsValue(type);
		}

		public bool IsPunctuator(string s)
		{
			return _Punctuators.Contains(s);
		}

		public override bool IsOperator(int type)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public string GetPunctuator(char[] chars, int length)
		{
			string text = new string(chars, 0, length);
			if (!_Punctuators.Contains(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return text;
		}

		public bool IsPunctuator(char ch)
		{
			return IsPunctuator(ch.ToString());
		}

		public bool IsPunctuator(params char[] chars)
		{
			_Worker.Length = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < chars.Length; i++)
			{
				_Worker.Append(chars[i]);
			}
			return IsPunctuator(_Worker.ToString());
		}

		public override bool IsComment(int type)
		{
			return 151 == type;
		}

		public override bool IsXmlDocComment(int type)
		{
			return 153 == type;
		}

		public override bool IsNumber(int type)
		{
			if (133 != type)
			{
				return 134 == type;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsStringLiteral(int type)
		{
			return 132 == type;
		}

		public override int ToTokenType(string token)
		{
			object obj = _Tokens[token];
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return (int)obj;
		}
	}
	public class VBTokensCategoryHelper : ITokenCategoryHelper
	{
		public TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			return VBTokensHelper.GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(token);
		}

		public TokenCollection GetTokens(string code)
		{
			try
			{
				return VBTokensHelper.GetTokens(code);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public string GetTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			return VBTokensHelper.GetTokenCategory(token);
		}

			return VBTokensHelper.GetTokenCategory(token, version);
		}

	public class VBTokensHelper
	{
		private const string STR_XMLDocTag = "XML Doc Tag";

		public static TokenCollection GetTokens(string code)
		{
			if (code == null || code.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
			VB10Parser vB10Parser = new VB10Parser();
			vB10Parser.SetTokensCategory = true;
			vB10Parser.Parse(reader);
			return vB10Parser.SavedTokens;
		}

		private static bool IsString(int type)
		{
			if (type != 17)
			{
				return type == 16;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsNumber(int type)
		{
			if (type != 2)
			{
				return type == 3;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsComment(int type)
		{
			return type == 15;
		}

		private static bool IsKeyword(int type)
		{
			if (type == 216)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return VB90Parser.IsKeyword(type);
		}

		public static string GetTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			return GetTokenCategory(token, ParserVersion.VS2008);
		}

		public static TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}
			if (IsKeyword(token.Type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Keyword;
			}
			if (VB90Parser.IsOperator(token.Type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Operator;
			}
			if (VB90Parser.IsPreprocessorDirective(token.Type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.PreprocessorKeyword;
			}
			if (IsString(token.Type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.String;
			}
			if (IsComment(token.Type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Comment;
			}
			if (token.Type == 247)
			{
				return TokenCategory.XmlComment;
			}
			if (token.Type == 4)
			{
				switch (token.Value.ToLower())
				{
				case "string":
				case "object":
				case "getxmlnamespace":
					return TokenCategory.Keyword;
				default:
					return TokenCategory.Identifier;
				}
			}
			return TokenCategory.Text;
		}

		public static string GetTokenCategory(Token token, ParserVersion version)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return "Text";
			}
			if (!(token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken))
			{
				return "Text";
			}
			if (token.Type == 4)
			{
				string text = token.Value.ToLower();
				switch (text)
				{
				default:
					if (version < ParserVersion.VS2008 || !(text == "getxmlnamespace"))
					{
						break;
					}
					goto case "string";
				case "string":
				case "object":
					return "Keyword";
				case null:
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (token.Type == 247)
			{
				try
				{
					string xMLTagName = StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetXMLTagName();
					if (xMLTagName != null)
					{
						return xMLTagName;
					}
					return "XML Doc Tag";
				}
				catch
				{
					return "XML Doc Tag";
				}
			}
			return categorizedToken.GetTokenCategory();
		}
	}

		public new static int GetTokenType(string name)
		{
			switch (name)
			{
			case "gettype":
				return 1038;
			case "ulong":
				return 103;
			case "ushort":
				return 107;
			default:
			{
				int tokenType = DevExpress.CodeParser.Base.TokenType.GetTokenType(name);
				if (tokenType != -1)
				{
					return tokenType;
				}
				return DevExpress.CodeParser.Base.TokenType.GetTokenType(typeof(TokenType), name);
			}
			}
		}

		public new static string GetTokenName(int token)
		{
			switch (token)
			{
			case 1038:
				return "Gettype";
			case 103:
				return "ULong";
			case 107:
				return "UShort";
			default:
			{
				string tokenName = DevExpress.CodeParser.Base.TokenType.GetTokenName(typeof(TokenType), token);
				if (tokenName != "UnknownToken")
				{
					return tokenName;
				}
				return DevExpress.CodeParser.Base.TokenType.GetTokenName(token);
			}
			}
		}

namespace DevExpress.CodeParser.VB.Preprocessor
{
	public enum PpResult
	{
		True,
		False,
		Invalid
	}
	public abstract class Evaluator
	{
		public enum ResultType
		{
			Invalid,
			Number,
			String,
			Nothing
		}

		private static object ProcessOperation(int type, string lExp, string rExp)
		{
			if (rExp == null)
			{
				return GetZeroInt();
			}
			return ProcessBinaryOperation(type, lExp, rExp);
		}

		private static object ProcessOperation(int type, Number lExp, Number rExp)
		{
			if (rExp == null)
			{
				return ProcessUnaryOperation(type, lExp);
			}
			return ProcessBinaryOperation(type, lExp, rExp);
		}

		private static object PrepareExp(object exp)
		{
			if (exp == null)
			{
				return exp;
			}
			if (exp is bool)
			{
				return GetNumberFromCondition((bool)exp);
			}
			return exp;
		}

		public static object Eval(object lExp, object rExp, int operatorType)
		{
			if (lExp == null && rExp == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lExp = PrepareExp(lExp);
			rExp = PrepareExp(rExp);
			ResultType conversationType = GetConversationType(lExp, rExp);
			return ProcessOperation(operatorType, conversationType, lExp, rExp);
		}

		private static object ProcessOperation(int opType, ResultType ppType, object lExp, object rExp)
		{
			return ppType switch
			{
				ResultType.Invalid => GetZeroInt(), 
				ResultType.Nothing => GetZeroInt(), 
				ResultType.Number => ProcessOperation(opType, GetNumber(lExp), GetNumber(rExp)), 
				ResultType.String => ProcessOperation(opType, GetString(lExp), GetString(rExp)), 
				_ => GetZeroInt(), 
			};
		}

		public static PpResult GetResult(object exp)
		{
			if (exp == null)
			{
				return PpResult.Invalid;
			}
			if (exp is PpResult)
			{
				return (PpResult)exp;
			}
			if (exp is bool)
			{
				return GetPpResult((bool)exp);
			}
			if (exp is string)
			{
				return PpResult.Invalid;
			}
			if (exp is Number number)
			{
				return GetPpResult(number.IsTrue());
			}
			if (exp is Nothing)
			{
				return PpResult.False;
			}
			return PpResult.Invalid;
		}

		private static PpResult GetPpResult(bool cond)
		{
			if (cond)
			{
				return PpResult.True;
			}
			return PpResult.False;
		}

		private static ResultType GetConversationType(object lExp, object rExp)
		{
			ResultType type = GetType(lExp);
			if (rExp == null)
			{
				return type;
			}
			ResultType type2 = GetType(rExp);
			return GetConversationType(type, type2);
		}

		private static ResultType GetConversationType(ResultType lType, ResultType rType)
		{
			if (lType == ResultType.Invalid || rType == ResultType.Invalid)
			{
				return ResultType.Invalid;
			}
			switch (lType)
			{
			case ResultType.String:
				if (rType == ResultType.String || rType == ResultType.Nothing)
				{
					return ResultType.String;
				}
				return ResultType.Invalid;
			case ResultType.Number:
				if (rType == ResultType.Number || rType == ResultType.Nothing)
				{
					return ResultType.Number;
				}
				return ResultType.Invalid;
			case ResultType.Nothing:
				if (rType == ResultType.Number)
				{
					return ResultType.Number;
				}
				if (lType == ResultType.String)
				{
					return ResultType.String;
				}
				return ResultType.Nothing;
			default:
				return ResultType.Invalid;
			}
		}

		private static ResultType GetType(object exp)
		{
			if (exp == null)
			{
				return ResultType.Invalid;
			}
			if (exp is string)
			{
				return ResultType.String;
			}
			if (exp is Number)
			{
				return ResultType.Number;
			}
			if (exp is Nothing)
			{
				return ResultType.Nothing;
			}
			return ResultType.Invalid;
		}

		private static Number GetNumber(object val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (val is Number result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (val is Nothing)
			{
				return Nothing.GetNumber();
			}
			return GetZeroInt();
		}

		public static IntNum GetZeroInt()
		{
			IntNum intNum = new IntNum();
			intNum.Item = 0;
			return intNum;
		}

		private static object OrElse(Number lExp, Number rExp)
		{
			bool flag = lExp.IsTrue();
			bool flag2 = rExp.IsTrue();
			bool cond = flag || flag2;
			return GetNumberFromCondition(cond);
		}

		private static object AndAlso(Number lExp, Number rExp)
		{
			bool flag = lExp.IsTrue();
			bool flag2 = rExp.IsTrue();
			bool cond = flag && flag2;
			return GetNumberFromCondition(cond);
		}

		private static object NotEquals(Number lExp, Number rExp)
		{
			bool cond = !lExp.IsEqualTo(rExp);
			return GetNumberFromCondition(cond);
		}

		private static object Equals(Number lExp, Number rExp)
		{
			bool cond = lExp.IsEqualTo(rExp);
			return GetNumberFromCondition(cond);
		}

		private static object ProcessBinaryOperation(int type, Number lExp, Number rExp)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				207 => lExp.Xor(rExp), 
				154 => lExp.Or(rExp), 
				155 => OrElse(lExp, rExp), 
				55 => lExp.And(rExp), 
				56 => AndAlso(lExp, rExp), 
				29 => NotEquals(lExp, rExp), 
				47 => Equals(lExp, rExp), 
				49 => lExp.IsBelow(rExp), 
				48 => lExp.IsGreater(rExp), 
				30 => lExp.IsBelowOrEqual(rExp), 
				31 => lExp.IsGreaterOrEqual(rExp), 
				25 => lExp.LeftShift(rExp), 
				26 => lExp.RightShift(rExp), 
				50 => lExp.And(rExp), 
				40 => lExp.Add(rExp), 
				41 => lExp.Sub(rExp), 
				134 => lExp.ModDiv(rExp), 
				44 => lExp.Div(rExp), 
				42 => lExp.Mul(rExp), 
				43 => lExp.Div(rExp), 
				_ => GetZeroInt(), 
			};
		}

		private static object Not(Number lExp)
		{
			bool cond = !GetConditionFromNumber(lExp);
			return GetNumberFromCondition(cond);
		}

		private static object ProcessUnaryOperation(int type, Number lExp)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				144 => Not(lExp), 
				41 => lExp.MinusSign(), 
				_ => GetZeroInt(), 
			};
		}

		private static string GetString(object val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (val is string result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static object ProcessBinaryOperation(int type, string lExp, string rExp)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				29 => lExp != rExp, 
				47 => lExp == rExp, 
				40 => lExp + rExp, 
				48 => GetNumberFromCondition(string.Compare(lExp, rExp, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) > 0), 
				31 => GetNumberFromCondition(string.Compare(lExp, rExp, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) >= 0), 
				49 => GetNumberFromCondition(string.Compare(lExp, rExp, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) < 0), 
				30 => GetNumberFromCondition(string.Compare(lExp, rExp, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) <= 0), 
				_ => GetZeroInt(), 
			};
		}

		private static bool GetConditionFromNumber(Number num)
		{
			return num?.IsTrue() ?? false;
		}

		public static Number GetNumberFromCondition(bool cond)
		{
			Number number = new IntNum();
			if (cond)
			{
				number.Item = -1;
			}
			else
			{
				number.Item = 0;
			}
			return number;
		}
	}
	public class VBPreprocessor
	{
		private const int minErrDist = 2;

		private Stack _IfConditions;

		private SourceFile _SourceFile;

		private VB90Parser _VbParser;

		private VB90Scanner _Scanner;

		private Dictionary<string, object> _Defines;

		private Dictionary<string, object> _OnlyThisFileDefines;

		protected const bool T = true;

		protected const bool x = false;

		protected int errDist = 2;

		protected Token tToken;

		protected Token la;

		protected ParserErrorsBase errors;

		protected bool[,] set;

		protected int maxTokens;

		private TokenCategorizedParserBase parser;

		public bool ConditionWasTrue
		{
			get
			{
				if (_IfConditions.Count > 0)
				{
					return (bool)_IfConditions.Peek();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected Stack IfConditions => _IfConditions;

		protected VB90Scanner Scanner
		{
			get
			{
				return _Scanner;
			}
			set
			{
				_Scanner = value;
			}
		}

		public VB90Parser VbParser
		{
			get
			{
				return _VbParser;
			}
			set
			{
				_VbParser = value;
			}
		}

		public SourceFile SourceFile
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceFile;
			}
			set
			{
				_SourceFile = value;
			}
		}

		private bool IsEOF()
		{
			return _Scanner.IsEof();
		}

		private void IfWaitEndIf()
		{
			ResetNextChCounter();
			int num = 0;
			while (!IsEOF())
			{
				if (IsNextChar('#'))
				{
					tToken = la;
					la = _Scanner.Scan();
					if (la.Type == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (la.Type == 6)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if ((la.Type == 9 || la.Type == 8) && num == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (la.Type == 7)
					{
						if (num == 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						num--;
					}
				}
				SkipToEOL();
			}
		}

		protected void SkipToEolIfNeeded()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1 && la.Type != 0)
			{
				SkipToEOL();
			}
		}

		protected void SkipToEOL()
		{
			_Scanner.SkipToEOL();
		}

		private void ResetNextChCounter()
		{
			_Scanner.ResetNextChCounter();
		}

		private bool IsNextChar(char ch)
		{
			return _Scanner.IsNextChar(ch);
		}

		private bool GetBool(object expValue)
		{
			if (expValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			PpResult result = Evaluator.GetResult(expValue);
			return GetBool(result);
		}

		private bool GetBool(PpResult result)
		{
			if (result == PpResult.True)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void ProcessIFDirectiveCondition(bool condition)
		{
			IfConditions.Push(condition);
			if (!condition)
			{
				IfWaitEndIf();
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessDirectiveCondition(bool condition)
		{
			if (ConditionWasTrue)
			{
				IfWaitEndIf();
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessDirectiveConditionCore(condition);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessDirectiveConditionCore(object expVal)
		{
			if (GetBool(expVal))
			{
				if (IfConditions.Count > 0)
				{
					IfConditions.Pop();
				}
				IfConditions.Push(true);
			}
			else
			{
				IfWaitEndIf();
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessEndIf()
		{
			if (IfConditions.Count > 0)
			{
				IfConditions.Pop();
			}
		}

		public void CleanUp()
		{
			_Defines.Clear();
			_IfConditions.Clear();
			_SourceFile = null;
			_Scanner = null;
			_VbParser = null;
			tToken = null;
			la = null;
			errors = null;
			set = null;
		}

		internal VBPreprocessor(VB90Scanner scanner, TokenCategorizedParserBase parser, Dictionary<string, object> defines)
		{
			this.parser = parser;
			_Scanner = scanner;
			CreateDefinesCollections();
			AddProjectDefines(defines);
			InitStandartPrep();
		}

		protected void Get()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				tToken = la;
				la = _Scanner.Scan();
				while (la.Type == 14)
				{
					la = _Scanner.Scan();
				}
				if (parser != null)
				{
					parser.SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(la);
				}
				if (la.Type <= 248)
				{
					break;
				}
				la = tToken;
			}
			errDist++;
		}

		private void CreateDefinesCollections()
		{
			_Defines = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			_OnlyThisFileDefines = new Dictionary<string, object>();
		}

		public VBPreprocessor(VB90Scanner scanner, TokenCategorizedParserBase parser, SourceFile rootNode)
		{
			this.parser = parser;
			InitPreprocessor(scanner, rootNode);
			InitStandartPrep();
		}

		private void InitStandartPrep()
		{
			errors = new PreprocessorErrors();
			set = CreateSetArray();
			maxTokens = 248;
		}

		private void AddProjectDefines(SourceFile sourceFile)
		{
			if (sourceFile != null)
			{
				IProjectElement project = sourceFile.Project;
				if (project != null)
				{
					AddProjectDefines(project.ValueDefines);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddProjectDefines(Dictionary<string, object> projectDefines)
		{
			if (projectDefines == null || projectDefines.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ICollection<string> keys = projectDefines.Keys;
			foreach (string item in keys)
			{
				object value = projectDefines[item];
				_Defines.Add(item, value);
			}
		}

		protected void AddConst(string name, object value)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && value != null)
			{
				name = name.ToUpper();
				if (_Defines.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					_Defines[name] = value;
					return;
				}
				_Defines.Add(name, value);
				_OnlyThisFileDefines.Add(name, null);
			}
		}

		private object GetConstValue(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return null;
			}
			name = name.ToUpper();
			AddDefineCall(name);
			if (!_Defines.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return _Defines[name];
		}

		public void InitPreprocessor(VB90Scanner scanner, SourceFile rootNode)
		{
			_IfConditions = new Stack();
			_Scanner = scanner;
			_SourceFile = rootNode;
			InitDefines(rootNode);
		}

		private void InitDefines(SourceFile sourceFile)
		{
			CreateDefinesCollections();
			AddProjectDefines(sourceFile);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static PpResult EvaluateExpression(string str)
		{
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(str);
			VB90Scanner scanner = new VB90Scanner(reader);
			VBPreprocessor vBPreprocessor = new VBPreprocessor(scanner, null, new SourceFile());
			return vBPreprocessor.EvaluateExpression();
		}

		public static object GetExpressionValue(string str, Dictionary<string, object> prevProjectDefines)
		{
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(str);
			VB90Scanner scanner = new VB90Scanner(reader);
			VBPreprocessor vBPreprocessor = new VBPreprocessor(scanner, null, prevProjectDefines);
			return vBPreprocessor.EvaluateExpressionCore();
		}

		private object EvaluateExpressionCore()
		{
			Get();
			Expression(out var result);
			return result;
		}

		private PpResult EvaluateExpression()
		{
			object exp = EvaluateExpressionCore();
			return Evaluator.GetResult(exp);
		}

		protected void AddRegion(RegionDirective regionDirective)
		{
			RegionDirective regionRootNode = _SourceFile.RegionRootNode;
			if (regionRootNode == null)
			{
				regionRootNode = new RegionDirective();
			}
			_SourceFile.RegionRootNode.AddNode(regionDirective);
		}

		protected void AddDirectiveNode(PreprocessorDirective directive)
		{
			if (_SourceFile != null)
			{
				if (_SourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode != null)
				{
					_SourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode.AddNode(directive);
				}
				_SourceFile.AddSimpleDirective(directive, inEach: false);
			}
		}

		protected void Expect(int n)
		{
			if (la.Type == n)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(n);
			}
		}

		protected void SynErr(int n)
		{
			if (errDist >= 2)
			{
				errors.SynErr(la.Line, la.Column, n);
			}
			errDist = 0;
		}

		public Token Preprocess(Token laToken)
		{
			la = laToken;
			StartRule();
			return la;
		}

		protected IntNum GetZeroInt()
		{
			IntNum intNum = new IntNum();
			intNum.Item = 0;
			return intNum;
		}

		protected bool StartOf(int s)
		{
			return set[s, la.Type];
		}

		protected Number GetDoubleValue(string val)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(val))
			{
				return null;
			}
			decimal num;
			try
			{
				object obj = VBPrimitiveTypeUtils.ToPrimitiveValue(134, val);
				num = ((!(obj is decimal)) ? Convert.ToDecimal(val) : ((decimal)obj));
			}
			catch
			{
				num = default(decimal);
			}
			FloatNum floatNum = new FloatNum();
			floatNum.Item = num;
			return floatNum;
		}

		protected Number GetIntegerValue(string val)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(val))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num;
			try
			{
				object obj = VBPrimitiveTypeUtils.ToPrimitiveValue(133, val);
				num = ((!(obj is int)) ? Convert.ToInt32(obj) : ((int)obj));
			}
			catch
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			IntNum intNum = new IntNum();
			intNum.Item = num;
			return intNum;
		}

		protected string GetStringValue(string val)
		{
			return GetStringValueCore(val, 0);
		}

		protected string GetStringValueFromChar(string val)
		{
			return GetStringValueCore(val, 1);
		}

		protected string GetStringValueCore(string val, int oddSymbols)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int length = val.Length;
			if (length <= 2 + oddSymbols)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return val.Substring(1, length - (2 + oddSymbols));
		}

		private void AddDefineCall(string name)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && _SourceFile != null && !_OnlyThisFileDefines.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				string name2 = _SourceFile.Name;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
				{
					_SourceFile.AddInvalidateMacro(name);
				}
			}
		}

		public object Eval(object lExp, object rExp, int operatorType)
		{
			return Evaluator.Eval(lExp, rExp, operatorType);
		}

		protected void HandlePragmas()
		{
		}

		private void PreprocessorRoot()
		{
			WhitespaceLines();
			if (la.Type == 10 || la.Type == 11)
			{
				RegionGroup();
			}
			else if (StartOf(1))
			{
				ConditionGroup();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 5)
			{
				ConstRule();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 12 || la.Type == 13)
			{
				ExternalRule();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(249);
			}
			StatementTerminator();
		}

		private void WhitespaceLines()
		{
			while (la.Type == 1)
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		private void RegionGroup()
		{
			if (la.Type == 10)
			{
				StartRegionRule();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 11)
			{
				EndRegionRule();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(250);
			}
		}

		private void ConditionGroup()
		{
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			PreprocessorDirective preprocessorDirective = null;
			bool result;
			if (la.Type == 6)
			{
				Get();
				ExpressionValue(out result);
				if (la.Type == 187)
				{
					Get();
				}
				ProcessIFDirectiveCondition(result);
				IfDirective ifDirective = new IfDirective();
				ifDirective.ExpressionValue = result;
				preprocessorDirective = ifDirective;
			}
			else if (la.Type == 8)
			{
				Get();
				ExpressionValue(out result);
				if (la.Type == 187)
				{
					Get();
				}
				ProcessDirectiveCondition(result);
				ElifDirective elifDirective = new ElifDirective();
				elifDirective.ExpressionValue = result;
				preprocessorDirective = elifDirective;
			}
			else if (la.Type == 9)
			{
				Get();
				ProcessDirectiveCondition(condition: true);
				ElseDirective elseDirective = new ElseDirective();
				elseDirective.IsSatisfied = !ConditionWasTrue;
				preprocessorDirective = elseDirective;
			}
			else if (la.Type == 7)
			{
				Get();
				preprocessorDirective = new EndIfDirective();
				ProcessEndIf();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(251);
			}
			SourceRange range2 = SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(range, tToken.Range);
			preprocessorDirective.SetRange(range2);
			AddDirectiveNode(preprocessorDirective);
		}

		private void ConstRule()
		{
			ConstDirective constDirective = new ConstDirective();
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			string text = null;
			Expect(5);
			Expect(4);
			text = tToken.Value;
			Expect(47);
			Expression(out var result);
			AddConst(text, result);
			SourceRange range2 = SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(range, tToken.Range);
			constDirective.SetRange(range2);
			AddDirectiveNode(constDirective);
		}

		private void ExternalRule()
		{
			if (la.Type == 12)
			{
				EternalSourceBegin();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 13)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(255);
			}
		}

		private void StatementTerminator()
		{
			while (la.Type == 1 || la.Type == 38)
			{
				if (la.Type == 1)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
				}
			}
		}

		private void EternalSourceBegin()
		{
			Expect(12);
			Expect(35);
			StringLiteralRule();
			Expect(32);
			Expect(2);
			Expect(36);
		}

		private void StringLiteralRule()
		{
			if (la.Type == 17)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 16)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(253);
			}
		}

		private void Expression(out object result)
		{
			result = null;
			LogicalXorOp(out result);
		}

		private void ExpressionValue(out bool result)
		{
			Expression(out var result2);
			result = GetBool(result2);
		}

		private void StartRegionRule()
		{
			RegionDirective regionDirective = new RegionDirective();
			regionDirective.SetRange(la.Range);
			regionDirective.SetStartTokenLength(7);
			Expect(10);
			if (la.Type == 16 || la.Type == 17)
			{
				StringLiteralRule();
				string value = tToken.Value;
				if (value != string.Empty)
				{
					int length = value.Length;
					value = ((length < 2) ? string.Empty : value.Substring(1, length - 2));
					regionDirective.Name = value;
				}
				regionDirective.NameRange = tToken.Range;
			}
			if (SourceFile != null)
			{
				SourceFile.AddRegionDirective(regionDirective);
			}
			StatementTerminator();
		}

		private void EndRegionRule()
		{
			EndRegionDirective endRegionDirective = new EndRegionDirective();
			Expect(11);
			if (StartOf(2))
			{
				IdentifierOrKeywordOrOperator();
			}
			endRegionDirective.SetRange(tToken.Range);
			if (SourceFile != null)
			{
				SourceFile.AddEndRegionDirective(endRegionDirective);
			}
			StatementTerminator();
		}

		private void IdentifierOrKeywordOrOperator()
		{
			if (VB90Parser.IsIdentifierOrKeywordOrOperator(la))
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		private void SimpleName(out object result)
		{
			result = null;
			Expect(4);
			result = GetConstValue(tToken.Value);
		}

		private void LogicalXorOp(out object result)
		{
			result = null;
			LogicalOrOp(out result);
			while (la.Type == 207)
			{
				Get();
				object result2 = null;
				int operatorType = 207;
				LogicalOrOp(out result2);
				result = Eval(result, result2, operatorType);
			}
		}

		private void LogicalOrOp(out object result)
		{
			result = null;
			LogicalAndOp(out result);
			while (la.Type == 154 || la.Type == 155)
			{
				if (la.Type == 154)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
				}
				int type = tToken.Type;
				LogicalAndOp(out var result2);
				result = Eval(result, result2, type);
			}
		}

		private void LogicalAndOp(out object result)
		{
			result = null;
			LogicalNotOp(out result);
			while (la.Type == 55 || la.Type == 56)
			{
				if (la.Type == 55)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
				}
				object result2 = null;
				int type = tToken.Type;
				LogicalNotOp(out result2);
				result = Eval(result, result2, type);
			}
		}

		protected static int GetTokenType(Type type, string name)
		{
			FieldInfo field = type.GetField(name, BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			if (field != null)
			{
				return (int)field.GetValue(null);
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected static string GetTokenName(Type type, int token)
		{
			FieldInfo[] fields = type.GetFields(BindingFlags.IgnoreCase | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			if (fields != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < fields.Length; i++)
				{
					if ((int)fields[i].GetValue(null) == token)
					{
						return fields[i].Name;
					}
				}
			}
			return "UnknownToken";
		}

		public static int GetTokenType(string name)
		{
			return GetTokenType(typeof(TokenType), name);
		}

		public static string GetTokenName(int type)
		{
			return GetTokenName(typeof(TokenType), type);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.CodeParser.JavaScript
{
	public class JavaScriptCodegen : CodeGen
	{
		internal override FormattingTable FormattingTable => CSharpFormattingTable.Instance;

		public JavaScriptCodegen()
		{
		}

		public JavaScriptCodegen(CodeGenOptions options)
			: base(options)
		{
		}

		private void AddCharOperatorsToFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType, FormattingElements result)
		{
			if (result == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = base.Context.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.UnaryOperatorExpression && elementType != LanguageElementType.UnaryIncrement && elementType != LanguageElementType.UnaryDecrement)
			{
				switch (tokenType)
				{
				case FormattingTokenType.BackSlashEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanGreatThanEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.In:
				case FormattingTokenType.Ampersand:
				case FormattingTokenType.AmpersandEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.Equal:
				case FormattingTokenType.SlashEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.EqualEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
				case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThenEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThanEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
				case FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThan:
				case FormattingTokenType.Minus:
				case FormattingTokenType.MinusEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.PercentEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.ExclamationEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBarEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.Plus:
				case FormattingTokenType.PlusEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.Asterisk:
				case FormattingTokenType.AsteriskEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.CaretEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.QuestionQuestion:
				case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBarVerticalBar:
				case FormattingTokenType.AmpersandAmpersand:
				case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBar:
				case FormattingTokenType.Caret:
				case FormattingTokenType.LessThanEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.Slash:
				case FormattingTokenType.Percent:
				case FormattingTokenType.EqualEqualEqual:
				case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThan:
					result.AddWhiteSpace();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ContextIsInitializerExpression()
		{
			LanguageElementType elementType = base.Context.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.MemberInitializerExpression)
			{
				return elementType == LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ContextIsAnonymousMethodExpression()
		{
			LanguageElementType elementType = base.Context.ElementType;
			return elementType == LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression;
		}

		protected override DirectiveCodeGenBase CreateDirectiveGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override ExpressionCodeGenBase CreateExpressionGen()
		{
			return new JavaScriptExpressionCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override MemberCodeGenBase CreateMemberGen()
		{
			return new JavaScriptMemberCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override StatementCodeGenBase CreateStatementGen()
		{
			return new JavaScriptStatementCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override SupportElementCodeGenBase CreateSupportElementGen()
		{
			return new JavaScriptSupportElementCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase CreateTypeDeclarationGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override XmlCodeGenBase CreateXmlGen()
		{
			return new JavaScriptXmlCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override NamespaceReferenceGenBase CreateNamespaceReferenceGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override NamespaceGenBase CreateNamespaceGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override SnippetCodeGenBase CreateSnippetGen()
		{
			return new TokenCSnippetCodeGen(this);
		}

		protected override TemplateCodeGenBase CreateTemplateGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override TemplateParameterCodeGenBase CreateTemplateParameterGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override HtmlXmlCodeGenBase CreateHtmlXmlGen()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override void GenerateMemberVisibilitySpecifier(MemberVisibilitySpecifier specifier)
		{
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			AddCharOperatorsToFormattingElements(tokenType, formattingElements);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				if (!ContextIsInitializerExpression())
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose:
				if (!ContextIsInitializerExpression() && !ContextIsAnonymousMethodExpression())
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Function:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				if (base.Context.NodeCount > 0 && !ContextIsInitializerExpression())
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			AddCharOperatorsToFormattingElements(tokenType, formattingElements);
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}

		private void GenerateAnonymousConstructorExpression(AnonymousConstructorExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.New);
			GenerateAnonymousMethodExpression(expression);
		}

		private void GenerateParenthesizedTypeReferenceExpression(ParenthesizedTypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		protected override void GenerateAnonymousMethodExpression(AnonymousMethodExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Function);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(expression.Name))
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
			GenerateParameters(expression.Parameters);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(expression.Nodes);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateArrayInitializerExpression(ArrayInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Initializers, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
			}
		}

		protected override bool GenerateExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			switch (expression.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.EmptyArrayElementExpression:
				GenerateEmptyArrayElementExpression(expression as EmptyArrayElementExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AnonymousConstructorExpression:
				GenerateAnonymousConstructorExpression(expression as AnonymousConstructorExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.ParenthesizedTypeReferenceExpression:
				GenerateParenthesizedTypeReferenceExpression(expression as ParenthesizedTypeReferenceExpression);
				return true;
			default:
				return base.GenerateExpression(expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateBooleanLiteral(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.True);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.False);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateCharLiteral(char value)
		{
			Write($"'{value}'");
		}

		protected override void GenerateComplexExpression(ComplexExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				ExpressionCollection expressions = expression.Expressions;
				if (expressions != null && expressions.Count > 0)
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expressions, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateDeleteExpression(DeleteExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Delete);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			}
		}

		protected void GenerateEmptyArrayElementExpression(EmptyArrayElementExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				string text = new string(',', expression.EmptyElementsCount - 1);
				Write(text);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateMemberInitializerExpression(MemberInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null && expression.Name != null)
			{
				Write($"{expression.Name} : ");
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Value);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateNullLiteral()
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Null);
		}

		protected override void GenerateNumberLiteral(string name, object value, PrimitiveType type)
		{
			Write(name);
		}

		protected override void GenerateObjectInitializerExpression(ObjectInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Initializers, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateStringLiteral(string value)
		{
			Write(value);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeCheck(TypeCheck expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.InstanceOf);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeOfExpression(TypeOfExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.TypeOf);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateUnaryOperatorExpression(UnaryOperatorExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (expression.OperatorText != "void")
				{
					base.GenerateUnaryOperatorExpression(expression);
					return;
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Void);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsEscapedString(string value)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Ident:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression)
				{
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.InstanceOf:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanGreatThan:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression)
				{
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.New:
			case FormattingTokenType.TypeOf:
			case FormattingTokenType.Void:
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
			case FormattingTokenType.InstanceOf:
			case FormattingTokenType.Delete:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanGreatThan:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override void GenerateParameters(ICollection parameters)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(parameters, GetCommaDelimeter());
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}
	}
	public class JavaScriptMemberCodeGen : MemberCodeGenBase
	{
		public JavaScriptMemberCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		private void GenerateVariableStart(Variable member)
		{
			if (member.PreviousVariable == null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Var);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
		}

		private void GenerateVariableEnd(Variable member)
		{
			Variable nextVariable = member.NextVariable;
			if (nextVariable == null)
			{
				if (!member.IsDetailNode)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
				}
			}
			else if (member.PreviousVariable == null)
			{
				while (nextVariable != null)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
					CodeGen.AddSkipped(nextVariable);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(nextVariable);
					nextVariable = nextVariable.NextVariable;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateConst(Const member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateConstVolatile(ConstVolatile member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateDelegate(DelegateDefinition member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateEnumElement(EnumElement member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateEvent(Event member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateExtensionMethodParam(ExtensionMethodParam member)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateGenericModifier(GenericModifier generic)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateInitializedVolatile(InitializedVolatile member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethodPrototype(MethodPrototype member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateProperty(Property member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateQueryIdent(QueryIdent expression)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateTypeParameter(TypeParameter parameter)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateTypeParameterConstraint(TypeParameterConstraint constraint)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateVolatile(Volatile member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateImplicitVariable(ImplicitVariable member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				if (member.Expression != null)
				{
					GenerateInitializedVariable(member);
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateVariable(member);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateLambdaImplicitlyTypedParam(LambdaImplicitlyTypedParam member)
		{
			GenerateParameter(member);
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethod(Method member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Function);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(member.Parameters, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				GenerateElementCollection(member.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
				base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateVariable(Variable member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				GenerateVariableStart(member);
				GenerateVariableEnd(member);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateInitializedVariable(InitializedVariable member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				GenerateVariableStart(member);
				if (member.Expression != null)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(member.Expression);
				}
				GenerateVariableEnd(member);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateParameter(Param member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			if (tokenType == FormattingTokenType.Var || tokenType == FormattingTokenType.Comma)
			{
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}

			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		protected override void GenerateCheckedStatement(Checked statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateConstructorInitializer(ConstructorInitializer initializer)

		}

		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateRaiseEventStatement(RaiseEvent statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateUncheckedStatement(Unchecked statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateYieldBreakStatement(YieldBreak statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateYieldReturnStatement(YieldReturn statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateBreakStatement(Break statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Break);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(statement.Name) && statement.Name != "break")
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateContinueStatement(Continue statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Continue);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(statement.Name) && statement.Name != "continue")
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEmptyStatement(EmptyStatement statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateForEachStatement(ForEach statement)
		{
			if (statement.DetailNodeCount >= 2)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.For);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement((LanguageElement)statement.DetailNodes[0]);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.In);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement((LanguageElement)statement.DetailNodes[1]);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
				GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateThrowStatement(Throw statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Throw);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateWithStatement(With statement)
		{
			GenerateParentingStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.With, FormattingTokenType.None);
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements result = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Block || base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Switch)
				{
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Default:
				base.Code.WriteLine();
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Semicolon:
				if (base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.For)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Block || base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Switch)
				{
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.For:
			case FormattingTokenType.Throw:
			case FormattingTokenType.With:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Continue:
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Context.Name) && base.Context.Name != "continue")
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Break:
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Context.Name) && base.Context.Name != "break")
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class JavaScriptLanguageUtils : LanguageUtils
	{
		private class JavaScriptTokenizer : Tokenizer
		{
			private TokenCategory GetTokenCategoryInternal(Token token)
			{
				if (token == null)
				{
					return TokenCategory.Text;
				}
				switch (token.Type)
				{
				case 6:
				case 7:
				case 8:
				case 9:
				case 10:
				case 11:
				case 12:
				case 13:
				case 14:
				case 15:
				case 16:
				case 17:
				case 18:
				case 19:
				case 20:
				case 21:
				case 22:
				case 23:
				case 24:
				case 25:
				case 26:
				case 27:
				case 28:
				case 29:
				case 30:
				case 31:
				case 32:
				case 33:
					return TokenCategory.Keyword;
				case 42:
				case 43:
				case 44:
				case 45:
				case 46:
				case 47:
				case 48:
				case 49:
				case 50:
				case 51:
				case 52:
				case 53:
				case 54:
				case 55:
				case 56:
				case 57:
				case 58:
				case 59:
				case 60:
				case 61:
				case 62:
				case 63:
				case 64:
				case 65:
				case 66:
				case 67:
				case 68:
				case 69:
				case 70:
				case 71:
				case 72:
				case 73:
				case 74:
				case 75:
				case 76:
				case 77:
				case 78:
				case 79:
				case 80:
				case 81:
					return TokenCategory.Operator;
				case 3:
				case 4:
					return TokenCategory.Number;
				case 1:
					return TokenCategory.Identifier;
				case 5:
				case 85:
					return TokenCategory.String;
				case 82:
				case 83:
					return TokenCategory.Comment;
				case 0:
					return TokenCategory.Unknown;
				default:
					return TokenCategory.Text;
				}
			}

			public override TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
			{
				return GetTokenCategoryInternal(token);
			}

			public override IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage)
			{
				List<CategorizedToken> list = new List<CategorizedToken>();
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
				{
					return list.AsReadOnly();
				}
				SourceStringReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
				JavaScriptParser javaScriptParser = new JavaScriptParser();
				javaScriptParser.SetTokensCategory = true;
				javaScriptParser.Parse(reader);
				for (int i = 0; i < javaScriptParser.SavedTokens.Count; i++)
				{
					list.Add(javaScriptParser.SavedTokens[i] as CategorizedToken);
				}
				return list.AsReadOnly();
			}
		}

		public override Tokenizer CreateTokenizer()
		{
			return new JavaScriptTokenizer();
		}

		public override ParserBase CreateParser(ParserVersion version, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embededLanguage)
		{
			return new JavaScriptParser();
		}

		public override CodeGen CreateCodeGen()
		{
			CodeGen codeGen = new JavaScriptCodegen();
			if (codeGen != null)
			{
				codeGen.Code = new CodeWriter(new StringWriter(), new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.JavaScript));
			}
			return codeGen;
		}

		public override ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder()
		{
			return new ElementBuilder();
		}
	}

		protected override Expression InvertIsNotExpression(IsNot expression)

	public class JavaScriptTokensCategoryHelper : ITokenCategoryHelper

		}

	public class JavaScriptTokensHelper
	{
		public static Token GetFirstToken(string number)
		{
			TokenCollection tokens = GetTokens(number);
			if (tokens == null || tokens.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return tokens[0];
		}

		public static bool IsIdentifier(int type)
		{
			return type == 1;
		}

		public static bool IsString(int type)
		{
			if (type != 5)
			{
				return type == 85;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsComment(int type)
		{
			if ((uint)(type - 82) <= 1u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsKeyword(string keyword)
		{
			Token firstToken = GetFirstToken(keyword);
			if (firstToken == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (keyword == "debugger")
			{
				return true;
			}
			return IsKeyword(firstToken.Type);
		}

		public static bool IsKeyword(int type)
		{
			if ((uint)(type - 6) <= 27u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsNumber(string number)
		{
			Token firstToken = GetFirstToken(number);
			if (firstToken == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsNumber(firstToken.Type);
		}

		public static bool IsNumber(int type)
		{
			if ((uint)(type - 3) <= 1u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsOperator(int type)
		{
			if ((uint)(type - 42) <= 39u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static string GetTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken)
			{
				return categorizedToken.GetTokenCategory();
			}
			if (token == null)
			{
				return "Text";
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			if (IsKeyword(type))
			{
				return "Keyword";
			}
			if (IsOperator(type))
			{
				return "Operator";
			}
			if (IsNumber(type))
			{
				return "Number";
			}
			if (IsIdentifier(type))
			{
				return "Identifier";
			}
			if (IsString(type))
			{
				return "String";
			}
			if (IsComment(type))
			{
				return "Comment";
			}
			return "Text";
		}

		public static TokenCollection GetTokens(string text)
		{
			LanguageUtils languageUtils = LanguageUtils.Create(ParserLanguageID.JavaScript);
			Tokenizer tokenizer = languageUtils.CreateTokenizer();
			IList<CategorizedToken> tokens = tokenizer.GetTokens(text);
			TokenCollection tokenCollection = new TokenCollection();
			foreach (CategorizedToken item in tokens)
			{
				tokenCollection.Add(item);
			}
			return tokenCollection;
		}

		public static TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			if (IsKeyword(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Keyword;
			}
			if (IsOperator(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Operator;
			}
			if (IsNumber(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Number;
			}
			if (IsIdentifier(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Identifier;
			}
			if (IsString(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.String;
			}
			if (IsComment(type))
			{
				return TokenCategory.Comment;
			}
			if (token.Type == 0)
			{
				return TokenCategory.Unknown;
			}
			return TokenCategory.Text;
		}
	}

	public class JavaScriptParser : FormattingParserBase
	{
		private bool _InsideForEachLoop;

		private bool _PreviousTokenWasComment;

		private CommentCollection _Comments = new CommentCollection();

		private const int _MaxMult = 200;

		protected bool InsideForEachLoop
		{
			get
			{
				return _InsideForEachLoop;
			}
			set
			{
				_InsideForEachLoop = value;
			}
		}

		public override string Language => "JavaScript";

		public override CommentCollection Comments => _Comments;

		protected override void HandlePragmas()
		{
		}

		private void Parser()
		{
			if (la.Type == 84)
			{
				Get();
			}
			SourceElement();
			while (StartOf(1))
			{
				SourceElement();
			}
		}

		private void SourceElement()
		{
			if (la.Type != 16)
			{
				Statement();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 16)
			{
				FunctionDeclaration();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(87);
			}
		}

		private void Statement()
		{
			if (IsLabelledStatement())
			{
				LabelledStatement();
			}
			else if (StartOf(1))
			{
				if (la.Type == 34)
				{
					Block();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 41)
				{
					EmptyStatement();
				}
				else if (StartOf(2))
				{
					ExpressionStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 17)
				{
					IfStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 12)
				{
					DoStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 29)
				{
					WhileStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 15)
				{
					ForStatements();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 9)
				{
					ContinueStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 6)
				{
					BreakStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 21)
				{
					ReturnStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 30)
				{
					WithStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 27)
				{
					VariableStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 22)
				{
					SwitchStatement();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 24)
				{
					ThrowStatement();
				}
				else
				{
					TryStatement();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(88);
			}
		}

		private void FunctionDeclaration()
		{
			Method method = null;
			SourceRange empty = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange empty2 = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange empty3 = SourceRange.Empty;
			LanguageElementCollection parameters = null;
			Expect(16);
			method = new Method(la.Value);
			method.Visibility = MemberVisibility.Public;
			OpenContext(method);
			method.SetRange(tToken.Range);
			empty = la.Range;
			Identifier();
			Expect(36);
			empty2 = tToken.Range;
			if (la.Type == 1 || la.Type == 2)
			{
				FormalParameterList(out parameters);
			}
			Expect(37);
			empty3 = tToken.Range;
			Expect(34);
			SetMethodProperties(method, empty, empty2, empty3, parameters);
			ReadBlockStart(tToken.Range);
			FunctionBody();
			ReadBlockEnd(la.Range);
			Expect(35);
			CloseContext();
			method.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(method, tToken));
		}

		private void Identifier()
		{
			if (la.Type == 1)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 2)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(89);
			}
		}

		private void FormalParameterList(out LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			parameters = new LanguageElementCollection();
			Param parameter = null;
			FormalParameter(out parameter);
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				parameters.Add(parameter);
			}
			while (la.Type == 42)
			{
				Get();
				FormalParameter(out parameter);
				if (parameter != null)
				{
					parameters.Add(parameter);
				}
			}
		}

		private void FunctionBody()
		{
			SourceElement();
			while (StartOf(1))
			{
				SourceElement();
			}
		}

		private void FormalParameter(out Param parameter)
		{
			parameter = CreateParam(la);
			Identifier();
		}

		private void LabelledStatement()
		{
			Label label = new Label();
			label.Name = la.Value;
			AddNode(label);
			Identifier();
			label.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(tToken, la));
			Expect(68);
			Statement();
		}

		private void Block()
		{
			Block block = null;
			if ((base.Context != null && base.Context is DelimiterCapableBlock && !(base.Context as DelimiterCapableBlock).BlockStart.IsEmpty) || base.Context is Block || base.Context is Case)
			{
				block = new Block();
				OpenContext(block);
				block.SetRange(la.Range);
			}
			ReadBlockStart(la.Range);
			if (base.Context != null && base.Context is ParentingStatement)
			{
				(base.Context as ParentingStatement).HasBlock = true;
			}
			Expect(34);
			if (StartOf(1))
			{
				StatementList();
			}
			Expect(35);
			ReadBlockEnd(tToken.Range);
			if (block != null)
			{
				block.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(block, tToken.Range));
				CloseContext();
			}
		}

		private void EmptyStatement()
		{
			Statement statement = new EmptyStatement();
			statement.Name = ";";
			statement.SetRange(la.Range);
			AddNode(statement);
			Expect(41);
		}

		private void ExpressionStatement()
		{
			Expression result = null;
			Statement statement = null;
			Token token = tToken;
			Expression(out result);
			Expect(41);
			if (result != null)
			{
				statement = ((result is AssignmentExpression) ? Assignment.FromAssignmentExpression(result as AssignmentExpression) : ((!(result is MethodCallExpression)) ? DevExpress.CodeParser.Statement.FromExpression(result) : MethodCall.FromMethodCallExpression(result as MethodCallExpression)));
				statement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(result, tToken));
			}
			else if (tToken.Type == 41)
			{
				statement = new Statement(tToken.Value);
				statement.SetRange(tToken.Range);
			}
			else
			{
				Get();
			}
			if (token == tToken)
			{
				Get();
			}
			if (statement != null)
			{
				AddNode(statement);
			}
		}

		private void IfStatement()
		{
			Expression result = null;
			SourceRange empty = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange empty2 = SourceRange.Empty;
			If obj = new If();
			obj.SetRange(la.Range);
			OpenContext(obj);
			Expect(17);
			Expect(36);
			empty = tToken.Range;
			Expression(out result);
			Expect(37);
			empty2 = tToken.Range;
			Statement();
			CloseContext();
			obj.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(obj, tToken));
			obj.SetParensRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(empty, empty2));
			if (result != null)
			{
				obj.SetExpression(result);
			}
			if (la.Type == 13)
			{
				Get();
				Else obj2 = new Else();
				obj2.SetRange(tToken.Range);
				OpenContext(obj2);
				Statement();
				CloseContext();
				obj2.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(obj2, tToken));
			}
		}

		private void DoStatement()
		{
			Expression result = null;
			SourceRange empty = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange empty2 = SourceRange.Empty;
			Do obj = new Do();
			obj.SetRange(la.Range);
			OpenContext(obj);
			Expect(12);
			Statement();
			Expect(29);
			Expect(36);
			empty = tToken.Range;
			Expression(out result);
			Expect(37);
			empty2 = tToken.Range;
			Expect(41);
			CloseContext();
			if (result != null)
			{
				obj.SetCondition(result);
			}
			obj.SetParensRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(empty, empty2));
			obj.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(obj, tToken));
		}

		private void WhileStatement()
		{
			Expression result = null;
			SourceRange empty = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange empty2 = SourceRange.Empty;
			While obj = new While();
			obj.SetRange(la.Range);
			OpenContext(obj);
			Expect(29);
			Expect(36);
			empty = tToken.Range;
			Expression(out result);
			Expect(37);
			empty2 = tToken.Range;
			Statement();
			CloseContext();
			if (result != null)
			{
				obj.SetCondition(result);
			}
			obj.SetParensRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(empty, empty2));
			obj.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(obj, tToken));
		}

		private void ForStatements()
		{
			Expression result = null;
			Expression result2 = null;
			Expression result3 = null;
			Expression result4 = null;
			Expression result5 = null;
			Variable variable = null;
			SourceRange empty = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange empty2 = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange empty3 = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			LanguageElementCollection variableList = null;
			Expect(15);
			Expect(36);
			empty2 = tToken.Range;
			if (IsForEachLoop())
			{
				InsideForEachLoop = true;
				if (StartOf(2))
				{
					Expression(out result);
				}
				else if (la.Type == 27)
				{
					Get();
					VariableDeclaration(tToken.Range, tToken.Range, out variable);
				}
				else
				{
					SynErr(90);
				}
				Expect(18);
				Expression(out result2);
				Expect(37);
				empty3 = tToken.Range;
				ForEach forEach = new ForEach(variable, result2, null);
				forEach.SetRange(range);
				OpenContext(forEach);
				languageElement = forEach;
				forEach.SetParensRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(empty2, empty3));
				forEach.FieldType = string.Empty;
				if (result != null)
				{
					forEach.AddDetailNode(result);
					forEach.Field = result.ToString();
				}
				else if (variable != null)
				{
					forEach.AddDetailNode(variable);
					forEach.Field = variable.Name;
				}
				if (result2 != null)
				{
					forEach.Expression = result2;
					forEach.Collection = result2.ToString();
				}
				InsideForEachLoop = false;
				Statement();
			}
			else if (StartOf(3))
			{
				if (StartOf(4))
				{
					if (StartOf(2))
					{
						Expression(out result3);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
					VariableDeclarationList(out variableList);
				}
				Expect(41);
				if (StartOf(2))
				{
					Expression(out result4);
				}
				Expect(41);
				if (StartOf(2))
				{
					Expression(out result5);
				}
				Expect(37);
				empty3 = tToken.Range;
				For obj = new For();
				obj.SetRange(range);
				OpenContext(obj);
				languageElement = obj;
				obj.SetParensRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(empty2, empty3));
				if (result3 != null)
				{
					obj.AddInitializer(result3);
				}
				else if (variableList != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < variableList.Count; i++)
					{
						obj.AddInitializer(variableList[i]);
					}
				}
				if (result4 != null)
				{
					obj.Condition = result4;
					obj.AddDetailNode(result4);
				}
				if (result5 != null)
				{
					obj.AddIncrementor(result5);
				}
				Statement();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(91);
			}
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				CloseContext();
				languageElement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(languageElement, tToken));
			}
		}

		private void ContinueStatement()
		{
			Continue obj = new Continue();
			AddNode(obj);
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			Expect(9);
			if (la.Type == 1 || la.Type == 2)
			{
				Identifier();
				obj.Name = tToken.Value;
			}
			Expect(41);
			obj.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(range, tToken.Range));
		}

		private void BreakStatement()
		{

		private void RelationalExpression(out Expression result)
		{
			Expression result2 = null;
			Token token = null;
			result = null;
			ShiftExpression(out result);
			if (la.Type == 18 && InsideForEachLoop)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (StartOf(12))
			{
				token = la;
				if (la.Type == 18)
				{
					Get();
					ShiftExpression(out result2);
					result = CreateBinaryOperatorExpression(result, result2, token);
					continue;
				}
				if (la.Type == 19)
				{
					Get();
					ShiftExpression(out result2);
					result = CreateTypeCheckExpression(result, result2, token);
					continue;
				}
				if (la.Type == 43)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 44)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 46)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 45)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					SynErr(101);
				}
				ShiftExpression(out result2);
				result = CreateRelationalOperation(result, result2, token);
			}
		}

		private void EqualityExpression(out Expression result)
		{
			Expression result2 = null;
			Token token = null;
			result = null;
			RelationalExpression(out result);
			while (StartOf(13))
			{
				if (la.Type == 47)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 48)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 49)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
				}
				token = tToken;
				RelationalExpression(out result2);
				result = CreateRelationalOperation(result, result2, token);
			}
		}

		private void BitwiseAndExpression(out Expression result)
		{
			Expression result2 = null;

			result = null;
			EqualityExpression(out result);
			while (la.Type == 60)
			{
				Get();
				token = tToken;
				EqualityExpression(out result2);
				result = CreateLogicalOperation(result, result2, token);
			}
		}

		private void ConditionalExpression(out Expression result)
		{
			Expression result2 = null;
			Expression result3 = null;
			result = null;
			LogicalOrExpression(out result);
			if (la.Type == 67)
			{
				Get();
				AssignmentExpression(out result2);
				Expect(68);
				AssignmentExpression(out result3);
				result = CreateConditionalExpression(result, result2, result3);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		private void Parse()
		{

			Get();
			Parser();

			{
				base.Context.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
			}
			CloseContext();
			BindComments();
		}

		private Expression CreateUnaryIncrement(Expression sourceExpression, Token operatorToken, bool isPostfix)
		{
			if (sourceExpression == null || operatorToken == null)
			{
				return sourceExpression;
			}
			UnaryIncrement unaryIncrement = new UnaryIncrement(operatorToken, sourceExpression, isPostfix);
			if (isPostfix)
			{
				unaryIncrement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(sourceExpression, operatorToken));
			}
			else
			{
				unaryIncrement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(operatorToken, sourceExpression));
			}
			ProcessExpressionForUnary(sourceExpression);
			return unaryIncrement;
		}

		private void ProcessExpressionForUnary(Expression expr)
		{
			if (expr is ElementReferenceExpression elementReferenceExpression)
			{
				elementReferenceExpression.IsModified = true;
			}
		}

		private Expression CreateUnaryDecrement(Expression sourceExpression, Token operatorToken, bool isPostfix)
		{
			if (sourceExpression == null || operatorToken == null)
			{
				return sourceExpression;
			}
			UnaryDecrement unaryDecrement = new UnaryDecrement(operatorToken, sourceExpression, isPostfix);
			if (isPostfix)
			{
				unaryDecrement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(sourceExpression, operatorToken));
			}
			else
			{
				unaryDecrement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(operatorToken, sourceExpression));
			}
			ProcessExpressionForUnary(sourceExpression);
			return unaryDecrement;
		}

				break;

				result = BinaryOperatorType.Subtract;
				break;
			case 80:
				result = BinaryOperatorType.Divide;
				break;
			case 54:
				result = BinaryOperatorType.Modulus;
				break;
			case 53:
				result = BinaryOperatorType.Multiply;
				break;
			case 57:
				result = BinaryOperatorType.ShiftLeft;
				break;
			case 58:
				result = BinaryOperatorType.ShiftRight;
				break;
			case 59:

		}
