		private DotNetLanguageType GetDotNetLanguageFromString(string language)
		{
			string text = language.ToLower();
			if (text.IndexOf("csharp") != -1 || text.IndexOf("cs") != -1 || text.IndexOf("c#") != -1)
			{
				return DotNetLanguageType.CSharp;
			}
			if (text.IndexOf("vb") != -1 || text.IndexOf("vbasic") != -1 || text.IndexOf("visualbasic") != -1)
			{
				return DotNetLanguageType.VisualBasic;
			}
			return DotNetLanguageType.ScriptLanguage;
		}

		private void GetDefaultScriptFromVs(HtmlElement element)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			XmlAttribute attribute = element.GetAttribute("name", ignoreCase: true);
			if (attribute != null && string.Compare(attribute.Value, "vs_defaultClientScript", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				XmlAttribute attribute2 = element.GetAttribute("content", ignoreCase: true);
				if (attribute2 != null)
				{
					SetDefaultScriptLanguage(attribute2.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetDefaultScriptFromHttpEq(HtmlElement element)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			XmlAttribute attribute = element.GetAttribute("http-equiv", ignoreCase: true);
			if (attribute != null && string.Compare(attribute.Value, "Content-Script-Type", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				XmlAttribute attribute2 = element.GetAttribute("content", ignoreCase: true);
				if (attribute2 != null)
				{
					SetDefaultScriptLanguage(attribute2.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetDefaultScriptLanguage(string language)
		{
			if (language != null)
			{
				string text = language.ToLower();
				if (text.IndexOf("javascript") != -1)
				{
					_DefaultScriptLanguage = ScriptLanguageType.JavaScript;
				}
				else if (text.IndexOf("ecmascript") != -1)
				{
					_DefaultScriptLanguage = ScriptLanguageType.EcmaScript;
				}
				else if (text.IndexOf("vbscript") != -1)
				{
					_DefaultScriptLanguage = ScriptLanguageType.VBScript;
				}
				else
				{
					_DefaultScriptLanguage = ScriptLanguageType.Unknown;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetDefaultLanguage(string language)
		{
			if (language != null)
			{
				_DefaultDotNetLanguage = GetDotNetLanguageFromString(language);
				if (_DefaultDotNetLanguage == DotNetLanguageType.ScriptLanguage)
				{
					_DefaultDotNetLanguage = DotNetLanguageType.Unknown;
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetInlineCodeStart(string text)
		{
			if (WorkAsXAMLParser)
			{
				return text.IndexOf('{');
			}
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (text[i])
				{
				case '<':
					if (text2 == string.Empty)
					{
						text2 = "<";
						break;
					}
					return -1;
				case '%':
					if (text2 == "<")
					{
						text2 = "<%";
						break;
					}
					return -1;
				case '#':
				case ':':
				case '=':
					if (text2 == "<%")
					{
						return i + 1;
					}
					return -1;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private CSharp30Parser GetCsParser()
		{
			CSharp30Parser cSharp30Parser = new CSharp30Parser();
			cSharp30Parser.WorkAsCSharp30Parser = true;
			return cSharp30Parser;
		}

		private TokenCategorizedParserBase GetParserByLanguageType(DotNetLanguageType languageType, bool aspxExpressionParser)
		{
			TokenCategorizedParserBase tokenCategorizedParserBase = null;
			switch (languageType)
			{
			case DotNetLanguageType.CSharp:
				if (aspxExpressionParser)
				{
					if (_CsExpressionParser == null)
					{
						_CsExpressionParser = GetCsParser();
					}
					tokenCategorizedParserBase = _CsExpressionParser;
				}
				else
				{
					tokenCategorizedParserBase = GetCsParser();
				}
				break;
			case DotNetLanguageType.VisualBasic:
				if (IsRazor)
				{
					return new VB10Parser();
				}
				if (_VbParser == null)
				{
					_VbParser = new VB10Parser();
				}
				tokenCategorizedParserBase = _VbParser as TokenCategorizedParserBase;
				break;
			}
			if (WorkAsXAMLParser)
			{
				tokenCategorizedParserBase = new MarkupExtensionParser();
			}
			if (tokenCategorizedParserBase != null)
			{
				tokenCategorizedParserBase.SetTokensCategory = base.SetTokensCategory;
			}
			return tokenCategorizedParserBase;
		}

		private void ClearFictiveCommentStart()
		{
			FictiveCommentStart = SourceFileStartRange;
		}

		private void SetLastFictiveComment()
		{
			SourceRange item = new SourceRange(FictiveCommentStart.Start, SourceFileEndRange.End);
			FictiveCommentRanges.Add(item);
		}

		private void AddFictiveCommentRange(SourceRange codeEmbeddingRange)
		{
			if (!codeEmbeddingRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (FictiveCommentRanges == null)
				{
					FictiveCommentRanges = new List<SourceRange>();
				}
				SourceRange item = new SourceRange(FictiveCommentStart.Start, codeEmbeddingRange.Start);
				FictiveCommentRanges.Add(item);
				FictiveCommentStart = new SourceRange(codeEmbeddingRange.End);
			}
		}

		private void CheckForInlineExpression(ArrayList codeEmbeddings)
		{
			if (codeEmbeddings == null || codeEmbeddings.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClearFictiveCommentStart();
			int num = 0;
			while (num < codeEmbeddings.Count)
			{
				AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding = codeEmbeddings[num] as AspCodeEmbedding;
				if (aspCodeEmbedding == null)
				{
					num++;
				}
				int equalityOrHashPos = GetEqualityOrHashPos(aspCodeEmbedding.Code);
				if (equalityOrHashPos != -1)
				{
					codeEmbeddings.RemoveAt(num);
					string inlineCode = aspCodeEmbedding.Code.Substring(equalityOrHashPos, aspCodeEmbedding.Code.Length - equalityOrHashPos);
					int line = aspCodeEmbedding.Range.Start.Line;
					int startOffset = aspCodeEmbedding.Range.Start.Offset + equalityOrHashPos + 2;
					Expression expression = ParseInlineExpression(inlineCode, line, startOffset, aspCodeEmbedding.CodeEmbeddingToken);
					if (expression != null)
					{
						Expression expression2 = expression.Clone() as Expression;
						InlineExpressions.Add(expression2);
						aspCodeEmbedding.AddDetailNode(expression);
						AddFictiveCommentRange(expression.Range);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
					AddFictiveCommentRange(aspCodeEmbedding.CodeRange);
				}
			}
			SetLastFictiveComment();
		}

		private int GetEqualityOrHashPos(string text)
		{
			if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (text[i])
				{
				case '#':
				case ':':
				case '=':
					return i + 1;
				default:
					return -1;
				case '\t':
				case '\n':
				case '\r':
				case ' ':
					break;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private string GetFictiveString(SourceRange rangeStart, SourceRange rangeEnd)
		{
			int num = rangeEnd.Start.Line - rangeStart.End.Line;
			int num2 = rangeEnd.Start.Offset + 1;
			string text = ((num < 0) ? string.Empty : new string('\n', num));
			string text2 = ((num2 < 0) ? string.Empty : new string(' ', num2));
			return text + text2;
		}

		private ArrayList GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromAttributes(HtmlAttributeCollection attributes, ref SourceRange codeBlockRange)
		{
			if (attributes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool shouldAddBlock = attributes["runat"] != null;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < attributes.Count; i++)
			{
				HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = attributes[i];
				if (htmlAttribute != null)
				{
					ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddingsFromAttribute = GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromAttribute(htmlAttribute, ref codeBlockRange, shouldAddBlock);
					if (aspCodeEmbeddingsFromAttribute != null)
					{
						arrayList.AddRange(aspCodeEmbeddingsFromAttribute);
					}
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count > 0)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ArrayList GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromAttribute(HtmlAttribute node, ref SourceRange codeBlockRange, bool shouldAddBlock)
		{
			if (node == null || node.DetailNodeCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int i = 0; i < node.DetailNodeCount; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = node.DetailNodes[i] as AspCodeEmbedding;
				if (languageElement == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (shouldAddBlock)
				{
					if (codeBlockRange == SourceRange.Empty)
					{
						codeBlockRange = languageElement.Range;
					}
					else
					{
						codeBlockRange = GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(codeBlockRange, languageElement);
					}
				}
				arrayList.Add(languageElement as AspCodeEmbedding);
			}
			if (arrayList.Count > 0)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanGetAspEmbCode(LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (node is HtmlElement)
			{
				if (node.NodeCount == 0 && node.DetailNodeCount == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (node.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private ArrayList GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode(ArrayList runAtServer, ArrayList nodes, LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (!CanGetAspEmbCode(node))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ElementNestingLevel++;
			try
			{
				if (ShouldPreventCycling())
				{
					return null;
				}
				HtmlElement htmlElement = node as HtmlElement;
				bool flag = htmlElement != null && htmlElement.Attributes["runat"] != null;
				if (flag)
				{
					runAtServer.Add(htmlElement);
				}
				else
				{
					nodes.Add(htmlElement);
				}
				SourceRange codeBlockRange = SourceRange.Empty;
				ArrayList arrayList = null;
				if (htmlElement != null)
				{
					arrayList = GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromAttributes(htmlElement.Attributes, ref codeBlockRange);
					for (int i = 0; i < htmlElement.DetailNodeCount; i++)
					{
						if (htmlElement.DetailNodes[i] is AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding)
						{
							if (arrayList == null)
							{
								arrayList = new ArrayList();
							}
							arrayList.Add(aspCodeEmbedding);
							ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode = GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode(runAtServer, nodes, aspCodeEmbedding);
							if (aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode != null)
							{
								arrayList.AddRange(aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (arrayList == null)
				{
					arrayList = new ArrayList();
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < node.NodeCount; j++)
				{
					if (!(node.Nodes[j] is LanguageElement languageElement))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (languageElement is AspCodeEmbedding)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							codeBlockRange = ((!(codeBlockRange == SourceRange.Empty)) ? GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(codeBlockRange, languageElement) : languageElement.Range);
						}
						arrayList.Add(languageElement as AspCodeEmbedding);
					}
					ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode2 = GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode(runAtServer, nodes, languageElement);
					if (aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode2 != null)
					{
						arrayList.AddRange(aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode2);
					}
				}
				if (!codeBlockRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					BlockRanges.Insert(0, codeBlockRange);
				}
				if (arrayList.Count > 0)
				{
					return arrayList;
				}
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				ElementNestingLevel--;
			}
		}

		private Expression ParseInlineExpression(string inlineCode, int startLine, int startOffset, Token codeEmbeddingToken)
		{
			try
			{
				ParserBase parserByLanguageType = GetParserByLanguageType(DefaultDotNetLanguage, aspxExpressionParser: true);
				TokenCategorizedParserBase tokenCategorizedParserBase = parserByLanguageType as TokenCategorizedParserBase;
				if (parserByLanguageType == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (base.SetTokensCategory && tokenCategorizedParserBase != null)
				{
					tokenCategorizedParserBase.SetTokensCategory = true;
				}
				ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(inlineCode, startLine, startOffset);
				ExpressionParserBase expressionParserBase = parserByLanguageType.CreateExpressionParser();
				return expressionParserBase.Parse(reader);
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException(value);
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void ReplaceEmbeddingToken(Token codeEmbeddingToken, TokenCollection embeddingTokens)
		{
			if (codeEmbeddingToken == null || embeddingTokens == null || embeddingTokens.Count < 1 || base.SavedTokens == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = base.SavedTokens.IndexOf(codeEmbeddingToken);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				Token token = embeddingTokens[0];
				base.SavedTokens.Remove(codeEmbeddingToken);
				int num2 = codeEmbeddingToken.StartPosition + codeEmbeddingToken.Value.IndexOf(token.Value) - token.StartPosition;
				for (int i = 0; i < embeddingTokens.Count; i++)
				{
					Token token2 = embeddingTokens[embeddingTokens.Count - i - 1];
					token2.StartPosition += num2;
					token2.EndPosition += num2;
					base.SavedTokens.Insert(num, token2);
				}
				if (WorkAsXAMLParser)
				{
					CategorizedToken categorizedToken = new CategorizedToken(TokenLanguage.Html);
					categorizedToken.Category = TokenCategory.HtmlAttributeValue;
					categorizedToken.Value = codeEmbeddingToken.Value[0].ToString();
					categorizedToken.StartPosition = codeEmbeddingToken.StartPosition;
					categorizedToken.EndPosition = categorizedToken.StartPosition + 1;
					categorizedToken.Line = codeEmbeddingToken.Line;
					categorizedToken.EndLine = codeEmbeddingToken.Line;
					categorizedToken.Column = codeEmbeddingToken.Column;
					categorizedToken.EndColumn = codeEmbeddingToken.Column + 1;
					base.SavedTokens.Insert(num, categorizedToken);
					CategorizedToken categorizedToken2 = new CategorizedToken(TokenLanguage.Html);
					categorizedToken2.Category = TokenCategory.HtmlAttributeValue;
					categorizedToken2.Value = codeEmbeddingToken.Value[codeEmbeddingToken.Value.Length - 1].ToString();
					categorizedToken2.StartPosition = codeEmbeddingToken.EndPosition - 1;
					categorizedToken2.EndPosition = codeEmbeddingToken.EndPosition;
					categorizedToken2.Line = codeEmbeddingToken.EndLine;
					categorizedToken2.EndLine = codeEmbeddingToken.EndLine;
					categorizedToken2.Column = codeEmbeddingToken.EndColumn - 1;
					categorizedToken2.EndColumn = codeEmbeddingToken.EndColumn;
					base.SavedTokens.Insert(num + embeddingTokens.Count + 1, categorizedToken2);
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetCodeEmbeddingsText(ArrayList aspTokenBlocks, ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddings, ArrayList runAtServerNodes, ArrayList nodes, ref int startLine, ref int startOffset)
		{
			AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding = null;
			AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding2 = null;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < aspCodeEmbeddings.Count; i++)
			{
				if (aspCodeEmbeddings[i] is AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding3)
				{
					if (aspCodeEmbedding2 == null)
					{
						startLine = aspCodeEmbedding3.Range.Start.Line;
						startOffset = aspCodeEmbedding3.Range.Start.Offset + 2;
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}", aspCodeEmbedding3.Code);
						aspTokenBlocks.Add(new TokenBlock(aspCodeEmbedding3.Range, -1));
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendFormat("{0}{1}", GetFictiveString(aspCodeEmbedding2.Range, aspCodeEmbedding3.Range), aspCodeEmbedding3.Code);
						SourceRange range = new SourceRange(aspCodeEmbedding2.Range.End, aspCodeEmbedding3.Range.Start);
						aspTokenBlocks.Add(new TokenBlock(range, 177));
						aspTokenBlocks.Add(new TokenBlock(aspCodeEmbedding3.Range, -1));
					}
					aspCodeEmbedding2 = aspCodeEmbedding3;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void SplitAspTokenBlocks(ArrayList aspTokenBlocks, ArrayList runAtServerNodes)
		{
			if (runAtServerNodes != null)
			{
				int count = runAtServerNodes.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					HtmlElement node = runAtServerNodes[i] as HtmlElement;
					SplitStartAspTokenBlock(aspTokenBlocks, node);
					SplitEndAspTokenBlock(aspTokenBlocks, node);
				}
			}
		}

		private int FindAspTokenBlock(ArrayList aspTokenBlocks, SourcePoint point)
		{
			if (aspTokenBlocks == null || point.IsEmpty)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int count = aspTokenBlocks.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (aspTokenBlocks[i] is TokenBlock { Range: var range } && range.Contains(point))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void SplitStartAspTokenBlock(ArrayList aspTokenBlocks, HtmlElement node)
		{
			if (!node.HasCloseTag)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = FindAspTokenBlock(aspTokenBlocks, node.Range.Start);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				if (aspTokenBlocks.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				TokenBlock tokenBlock = (TokenBlock)aspTokenBlocks[0];
				if (node.Range.Start < tokenBlock.Range.Start)
				{
					SourceRange range = new SourceRange(node.Range.Start, node.InnerRange.Start);
					SourceRange range2 = new SourceRange(node.InnerRange.Start, tokenBlock.Range.Start);
					if (!range2.IsEmpty)
					{
						aspTokenBlocks.Insert(0, new TokenBlock(range2, 177));
					}
					aspTokenBlocks.Insert(0, new TokenBlock(range, 175));
				}
				return;
			}
			TokenBlock tokenBlock2 = (TokenBlock)aspTokenBlocks[num];
			SourceRange range3 = new SourceRange(node.Range.Start, node.InnerRange.Start);
			SourceRange range4 = new SourceRange(tokenBlock2.Range.Start, range3.Start);
			SourceRange range5 = new SourceRange(range3.End, tokenBlock2.Range.End);
			aspTokenBlocks.RemoveAt(num);
			if (!range5.IsEmpty)
			{
				aspTokenBlocks.Insert(num, new TokenBlock(range5, 177));
			}
			if (!range3.IsEmpty)
			{
				aspTokenBlocks.Insert(num, new TokenBlock(range3, 175));
			}
			if (!range4.IsEmpty)
			{
				aspTokenBlocks.Insert(num, new TokenBlock(range4, 177));
			}
		}

		private void SplitEndAspTokenBlock(ArrayList aspTokenBlocks, HtmlElement node)
		{
			if (!node.HasCloseTag)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = FindAspTokenBlock(aspTokenBlocks, node.Range.End);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				if (aspTokenBlocks.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				TokenBlock tokenBlock = (TokenBlock)aspTokenBlocks[aspTokenBlocks.Count - 1];
				if (node.Range.End > tokenBlock.Range.End)
				{
					SourceRange range = new SourceRange(node.InnerRange.End, node.Range.End);
					SourceRange range2 = new SourceRange(tokenBlock.Range.End, node.InnerRange.End);
					if (!range2.IsEmpty)
					{
						aspTokenBlocks.Add(new TokenBlock(range2, 177));
					}
					aspTokenBlocks.Add(new TokenBlock(range, 176));
				}
				return;
			}
			TokenBlock tokenBlock2 = (TokenBlock)aspTokenBlocks[num];
			SourceRange range3 = new SourceRange(node.InnerRange.End, node.Range.End);
			SourceRange range4 = new SourceRange(tokenBlock2.Range.Start, range3.Start);
			SourceRange range5 = new SourceRange(range3.End, tokenBlock2.Range.End);
			aspTokenBlocks.RemoveAt(num);
			if (!range5.IsEmpty)
			{
				aspTokenBlocks.Insert(num, new TokenBlock(range5, 177));
			}
			if (!range3.IsEmpty)
			{
				aspTokenBlocks.Insert(num, new TokenBlock(range3, 176));
			}
			if (!range4.IsEmpty)
			{
				aspTokenBlocks.Insert(num, new TokenBlock(range4, 177));
			}
		}

		private void SplitAspCommentBlocks(ArrayList aspTokenBlocks, ArrayList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = aspTokenBlocks.Count;
			TokenBlock[] array = new TokenBlock[count];
			aspTokenBlocks.CopyTo(array);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				TokenBlock tokenBlock = array[i];
				if (tokenBlock != null && tokenBlock.Type == 177)
				{
					ArrayList nodesInRange = GetNodesInRange(nodes, tokenBlock.Range);
					if (nodesInRange == null || nodesInRange.Count == 0)
					{
						aspTokenBlocks.Remove(tokenBlock);
					}
					if (nodesInRange.Count >= 2)
					{
						SplitAspCommentBlock(aspTokenBlocks, tokenBlock, nodesInRange);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private ArrayList GetNodesInRange(ArrayList nodes, SourceRange range)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			int count = nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement && range.Contains(languageElement.Range))
				{
					arrayList.Add(languageElement);
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		private void SplitAspCommentBlock(ArrayList aspTokenBlocks, TokenBlock block, ArrayList nodes)
		{
			if (block == null || aspTokenBlocks == null || nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = aspTokenBlocks.IndexOf(block);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			aspTokenBlocks.RemoveAt(num);
			int count = nodes.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					TokenBlock value = new TokenBlock(languageElement.Range, 177);
					aspTokenBlocks.Insert(num + i, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InsertBlockNodes(LanguageElement rootNode, NodeList blockNodes, int insertAtIndex)
		{
			NestedMethod nestedMethod = new NestedMethod();
			for (int i = 0; i < blockNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				rootNode.RemoveNode(blockNodes[i] as LanguageElement);
				nestedMethod.AddNode(blockNodes[i] as LanguageElement);
			}
			nestedMethod.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(blockNodes[0], blockNodes[blockNodes.Count - 1]));
			rootNode.InsertNode(insertAtIndex, nestedMethod);
		}

		private void InsertCodeBlocks(LanguageElement rootNode)
		{
			if (rootNode == null || BlockRanges == null || BlockRanges.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = BlockRanges.Count; count > i; i++)
			{
				SourceRange currentBlockRange = BlockRanges[num];
				NodeList nodeList = new NodeList();
				int insertAtIndex = -1;
				GetBlockNodes(nodeList, rootNode, currentBlockRange, out insertAtIndex);
				if (nodeList.Count > 0)
				{
					InsertBlockNodes(rootNode, nodeList, insertAtIndex);
					BlockRanges.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (BlockRanges.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < rootNode.NodeCount; j++)
				{
					InsertCodeBlocks(rootNode.Nodes[j] as LanguageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private ParserBase CreateJavaScriptParser()
		{
			ParserBase parserBase = null;
			return new JavaScriptParser();
		}

		private bool IsScriptBlockWithoutLanguageInformation(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			if (script == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (script.GetAttribute("language", ignoreCase: true) != null || script.GetAttribute("type", ignoreCase: true) != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_DefaultScriptLanguage != ScriptLanguageType.Unknown)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private ParserBase GetClientSideParser(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			if (script != null && (script.Language == DotNetLanguageType.JavaScript || IsScriptBlockWithoutLanguageInformation(script)))
			{
				return CreateJavaScriptParser();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetClientSideScriptTypeByAttributeValue(string value, HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && script != null && (value.IndexOf("javascript", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) != -1 || value.IndexOf("jscript", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) != -1))
			{
				script.Language = DotNetLanguageType.JavaScript;
			}
		}

		private void ParseClientSideScript(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			ParserBase clientSideParser = GetClientSideParser(script);
			if (clientSideParser != null)
			{
				PosOffset = la.EndPosition - la.EndColumn;
				ParseEmbeddedCode(script, clientSideParser, RemoveHtmlCommentEndIfNeeded(script.ScriptText), script.CodeRange.Start);
			}
		}

		private string RemoveHtmlCommentEndIfNeeded(string scriptText)
		{
			string text = scriptText;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(scriptText))
			{
				return text;
			}
			string value = "-->";
			text = text.TrimEnd();
			if (text.EndsWith(value))
			{
				int num = text.LastIndexOf("\r\n");
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = text.LastIndexOf("\n");
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = text.LastIndexOf("\r");
				}
				if (num > -1)
				{
					text = text.Remove(num);
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private LanguageElement GetRootNodeForScript(ParserBase parser, string scriptText, SourcePoint strtPoint)
		{
			TokenCategorizedParserBase tokenCategorizedParserBase = parser as TokenCategorizedParserBase;
			if (tokenCategorizedParserBase != null)
			{
				tokenCategorizedParserBase.SetTokensCategory = base.SetTokensCategory;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = null;
			if (parser != null)
			{
				int num = strtPoint.Line;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scriptText) && scriptText[0] == '\n')
				{
					num--;
				}
				languageElement = parser.ParseString(scriptText, num, strtPoint.Offset);
			}
			if (base.SetTokensCategory && tokenCategorizedParserBase != null && languageElement != null)
			{
				if (languageElement is SourceFile && languageElement.NodeCount == 0)
				{
					return languageElement;
				}
				foreach (CategorizedToken savedToken in tokenCategorizedParserBase.SavedTokens)
				{
					savedToken.StartPosition += PosOffset;
					savedToken.EndPosition += PosOffset;
					if (savedToken.Category != TokenCategory.Unknown)
					{
						base.SavedTokens.Add(savedToken);
					}
				}
			}
			return languageElement;
		}

		private void ParseEmbeddedCode(LanguageElement element, ParserBase parser, string scriptText, SourcePoint strtPoint)
		{
			LanguageElement rootNodeForScript = GetRootNodeForScript(parser, scriptText, strtPoint);
			try
			{
				if (rootNodeForScript == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (rootNodeForScript is SourceFile)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < rootNodeForScript.NodeCount; i++)
					{
						element.AddNode(rootNodeForScript.Nodes[i] as LanguageElement);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					element.AddNode(rootNodeForScript);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException(value);
			}
		}

		private bool IsScriptLanguage(DotNetLanguageType currentLanguage)
		{
			if (currentLanguage != DotNetLanguageType.ScriptLanguage)
			{
				return currentLanguage == DotNetLanguageType.JavaScript;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ParseServerSideScript(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			DotNetLanguageType dotNetLanguageType = script.Language;
			if (IsScriptLanguage(dotNetLanguageType))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dotNetLanguageType == DotNetLanguageType.Unknown)
			{
				dotNetLanguageType = _DefaultDotNetLanguage;
				if (dotNetLanguageType != DotNetLanguageType.Unknown)
				{
					script.Language = dotNetLanguageType;
				}
			}
			PosOffset = la.EndPosition - la.EndColumn;
			ParseEmbeddedCode(script, GetParserByLanguageType(dotNetLanguageType, aspxExpressionParser: false), RemoveHtmlCommentEndIfNeeded(script.ScriptText), script.CodeRange.Start);
		}

		protected void ParseScript(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			if (script != null)
			{
				if (script.Attributes["runat"] == null || IsScriptLanguage(script.Language))
				{
					ParseClientSideScript(script);
				}
				else
				{
					ParseServerSideScript(script);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ParseStyleDefinition(HtmlStyleDefinition styleTag)
		{
			if (styleTag == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PosOffset = tToken.StartPosition - tToken.Column;
			LanguageElement rootNodeForScript = GetRootNodeForScript(new CssParser(), styleTag.StyleText, styleTag.TextRange.Start);
			if (rootNodeForScript == null || !(rootNodeForScript is SourceFile))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (LanguageElement node in rootNodeForScript.Nodes)
			{
				if (node != null)
				{
					styleTag.AddNode(node);
				}
				else
				{
					styleTag.AddNode(rootNodeForScript);
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetAttributeValue(AspDirective directive, string attributeName)
		{
			if (directive == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = directive.Attributes[attributeName];
			if (htmlAttribute == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return htmlAttribute.Value;
		}

		private void SetCodeBehindFileName(SourceFile fileNode, AspDirective directive)
		{
			if (fileNode != null && directive != null)
			{
				string attributeValue = GetAttributeValue(directive, "codebehind");
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					attributeValue = GetAttributeValue(directive, "codefile");
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					fileNode.CodeBehindFileName = attributeValue;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetAspPageBaseType(SourceFile rootFile, AspDirective directive)
		{
			if (rootFile != null && directive != null)
			{
				string attributeValue = GetAttributeValue(directive, "inherits");
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					rootFile.AspPageBaseType = attributeValue;
				}
				if (directive.ElementType == LanguageElementType.RazorModelDirective)
				{
					rootFile.SetModelTypeName(((RazorModelDirective)directive).Model);
				}
				else
				{
					rootFile.SetModelTypeName(ExtractModelFromPageOrControlDirective(directive));
				}
			}
		}

		public string ExtractModelFromPageOrControlDirective(LanguageElement modelDirective)
		{
			if (modelDirective == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (modelDirective.ElementType == LanguageElementType.PageDirective || modelDirective.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ControlDirective)
			{
				string attributeValue = GetAttributeValue(modelDirective as AspDirective, "inherits");
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeValue))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				int num = attributeValue.IndexOf("<", 0);
				int num2 = attributeValue.LastIndexOf(">");
				if (num < 0 || num2 < 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return attributeValue.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private void InsertFictiveCommentInProperPlace(LanguageElement root, SourceRange fictiveCommentRange)
		{
			if (root == null || fictiveCommentRange.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < root.NodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (root.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					if (languageElement.Range.Start >= fictiveCommentRange.End)
					{
						root.InsertNode(i, CreateFictiveComment(fictiveCommentRange));
						return;
					}
					if (fictiveCommentRange.Start >= languageElement.Range.Start && fictiveCommentRange.End <= languageElement.Range.End)
					{
						InsertFictiveCommentInProperPlace(languageElement, fictiveCommentRange);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			root.AddNode(CreateFictiveComment(fictiveCommentRange));
		}

		private LanguageElement CreateFictiveComment(SourceRange range)
		{
			FictiveAspComment fictiveAspComment = new FictiveAspComment();
			fictiveAspComment.SetRange(range);
			return fictiveAspComment;
		}

		private void InsertInlineExpressionsStatements(LanguageElement root)
		{
			if (root == null || InlineExpressions == null || InlineExpressions.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < InlineExpressions.Count; i++)
			{
				Expression expression = InlineExpressions[i];
				if (expression != null)
				{
					Statement statement = Statement.FromExpression(expression);
					statement.SetRange(expression.Range);
					InsertInlineExpressionStatement(root, statement);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool InsertInlineExpressionStatement(LanguageElement root, LanguageElement node)
		{
			if (root == null || node == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SourceRange range = node.Range;
			if (!root.Range.Contains(range))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int nodeCount = root.NodeCount;
			if (nodeCount > 0)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = root.Nodes[nodeCount - 1] as LanguageElement;
				if (languageElement.Range.EndsBefore(range))
				{
					root.AddNode(node);
					return true;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount - 1; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement2 = root.Nodes[i] as LanguageElement;
				LanguageElement languageElement3 = root.Nodes[i + 1] as LanguageElement;
				if (languageElement2 != null && languageElement3 != null)
				{
					SourceRange range2 = languageElement2.Range;
					if (range2.Contains(range))
					{
						return InsertInlineExpressionStatement(languageElement2, node);
					}
					SourceRange range3 = languageElement3.Range;
					if (range3.Contains(range))
					{
						return InsertInlineExpressionStatement(languageElement3, node);
					}
					if (range2.EndsBefore(range) && range3.StartsAfter(range))
					{
						root.InsertNode(i + 1, node);
						return true;
					}
					if (range2.StartsAfter(range))
					{
						root.InsertNode(i, node);
						return true;
					}
					if (i == nodeCount - 2 && range3.EndsBefore(range))
					{
						root.AddNode(node);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			switch (nodeCount)
			{
			case 0:
				root.AddNode(node);
				return true;
			case 1:
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement4 = root.Nodes[0] as LanguageElement;
				if (languageElement4.Range.Contains(range))
				{
					return InsertInlineExpressionStatement(languageElement4, node);
				}
				if (languageElement4.Range.StartsAfter(range))
				{
					root.InsertNode(0, node);
				}
				else
				{
					root.AddNode(node);
				}
				return true;
			}
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void GetBlockNodes(NodeList blockNodes, LanguageElement rootNode, SourceRange currentBlockRange, out int insertAtIndex)
		{
			insertAtIndex = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < rootNode.NodeCount; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = rootNode.Nodes[i] as LanguageElement;
				if (currentBlockRange.Contains(languageElement.Range))
				{
					if (insertAtIndex == -1)
					{
						insertAtIndex = i;
					}
					blockNodes.Add(languageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetServerSideScriptType(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			XmlAttribute attribute = script.GetAttribute("language", ignoreCase: true);
			if (attribute == null || attribute.Value == null)
			{
				script.Language = DotNetLanguageType.Unknown;
			}
			else
			{
				script.Language = GetDotNetLanguageFromString(attribute.Value);
			}
		}

		private void SetClientSideScriptType(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			if (script != null)
			{
				script.Language = DotNetLanguageType.ScriptLanguage;
				if (_DefaultScriptLanguage == ScriptLanguageType.EcmaScript || _DefaultScriptLanguage == ScriptLanguageType.JavaScript)
				{
					script.Language = DotNetLanguageType.JavaScript;
				}
				XmlAttribute attribute = script.GetAttribute("language", ignoreCase: true);
				XmlAttribute attribute2 = script.GetAttribute("type", ignoreCase: true);
				if (attribute != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute.Value))
				{
					SetClientSideScriptTypeByAttributeValue(attribute.Value, script);
				}
				else if (attribute2 != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(attribute2.Value))
				{
					SetClientSideScriptTypeByAttributeValue(attribute2.Value, script);
				}
				if ((script.Language == DotNetLanguageType.ScriptLanguage || script.Language == DotNetLanguageType.Unknown) && _DefaultScriptLanguage == ScriptLanguageType.Unknown)
				{
					script.Language = DotNetLanguageType.JavaScript;
				}
			}
		}

		private DotNetLanguageType GetScriptLanguage(ScriptLanguageType defaultScriptLanguage)
		{
			DotNetLanguageType result = DotNetLanguageType.Unknown;
			if (_DefaultScriptLanguage == ScriptLanguageType.EcmaScript || _DefaultScriptLanguage == ScriptLanguageType.JavaScript || _DefaultScriptLanguage == ScriptLanguageType.Unknown)
			{
				result = DotNetLanguageType.JavaScript;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ParserBase GetClientSideParser(DotNetLanguageType codeLanguage)
		{
			if (codeLanguage == DotNetLanguageType.JavaScript || codeLanguage == DotNetLanguageType.Unknown || codeLanguage == DotNetLanguageType.ScriptLanguage)
			{
				return CreateJavaScriptParser();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void AddToUsingList(SourceFile fileNode, AspImportDirective directive)
		{
			if (fileNode != null && directive != null)
			{
				string text = directive.Namespace;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !fileNode.UsingList.Contains(text))
				{
					fileNode.UsingList.Add(text, text);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SetSourceFileProperties(SourceFile fileNode, AspDirective directive, DotNetLanguageType language)
		{
			if (fileNode != null)
			{
				fileNode.AspPageLanguage = language;
				SetAspPageBaseType(fileNode, directive);
				SetCodeBehindFileName(fileNode, directive);
			}
		}

		{
			fileNode?.SetMasterPageFile(masterPageFile);
		}

		protected void SplitAspDirectiveTagStartIfNeeded()
		{
			if (base.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				Token token = base.SavedTokens[base.SavedTokens.Count - 1];
				CategorizedToken categorizedToken = new CategorizedToken(token.EndPosition - 1, token.EndPosition, token.Line, token.EndColumn - 1, token.EndLine, token.EndColumn, 47, "@", TokenCategory.HtmlTagDelimiter);
				token.EndPosition = categorizedToken.StartPosition;
				token.EndColumn = categorizedToken.Column;
				token.Value = "<%";
				base.SavedTokens.Add(categorizedToken);
			}
		}

		protected void SplitInlineExpressionIfNeeded()
		{
			if (WorkAsXAMLParser || !base.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				return;
			}
			string value = tToken.Value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || value.Length < 4)
			{
				return;
			}
			char c = value[0];
			if (c != '\'' && c != '"')
			{
				return;
			}
			c = value[value.Length - 1];
			if (c == '\'' || c == '"')
			{
				value = value.Substring(1, value.Length - 2);
				string text = value.Trim();
				if (text.StartsWith("<%") && text.EndsWith("%>"))
				{
					int num = value.IndexOf(text);
					CategorizedToken categorizedToken = new CategorizedToken(tToken.StartPosition + num + 1, tToken.StartPosition + num + 3, tToken.Line, tToken.Column + num + 1, tToken.EndLine, tToken.Column + num + 3, 10, "<%", TokenCategory.HtmlServerSideScript);
					int length = value.Length;
					string text2 = text.Substring(2, text.Length - 4);
					int length2 = text2.Length;
					CategorizedToken categorizedToken2 = new CategorizedToken(categorizedToken.EndPosition, categorizedToken.EndPosition + length2, tToken.Line, categorizedToken.EndColumn, tToken.EndLine, categorizedToken.EndColumn + length2, 1, text2, TokenCategory.Text);
					CategorizedToken token = new CategorizedToken(categorizedToken2.EndPosition, categorizedToken2.EndPosition + 2, tToken.Line, categorizedToken2.EndColumn, tToken.EndLine, categorizedToken2.EndColumn + 2, 11, "%>", TokenCategory.HtmlServerSideScript);
					CategorizedToken token2 = new CategorizedToken(tToken.EndPosition - 1, tToken.EndPosition, tToken.EndLine, tToken.EndColumn - 1, tToken.EndLine, tToken.EndColumn, 1, tToken.Value[tToken.Value.Length - 1].ToString(), TokenCategory.HtmlAttributeValue);
					tToken.Value = tToken.Value[0].ToString();
					tToken.EndPosition = tToken.StartPosition + 1;
					tToken.EndColumn = tToken.Column + 1;
					SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.HtmlAttributeValue);
					base.SavedTokens.RemoveAt(base.SavedTokens.Count - 1);
					base.SavedTokens.Add(categorizedToken);
					base.SavedTokens.Add(categorizedToken2);
					base.SavedTokens.Add(token);
					base.SavedTokens.Add(token2);
					base.SavedTokens.Add(la);
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldCloseEmptyTag(string tagName)
		{
			if (!EmptyElements.Contains(tagName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void MoveNodesInsideElement(LanguageElement newParentElement, LanguageElement activeContext)
		{
			if (newParentElement == null || activeContext == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = activeContext.Nodes.IndexOf(newParentElement);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int nodeCount = activeContext.NodeCount;
			int num2 = num + 1;
			for (int i = num2; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (num2 >= activeContext.NodeCount)
				{
					break;
				}
				LanguageElement element = activeContext.Nodes[num2] as LanguageElement;
				activeContext.RemoveNode(element);
				newParentElement.AddNode(element);
			}
		}

		protected void ParseAttributeStyle(HtmlAttribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute == null || attribute.Name == null || attribute.Value == null || string.Compare(attribute.Name, "style", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(attribute.Value, attribute.ValueRange.Start.Line, attribute.ValueRange.Start.Offset);
			CssParser cssParser = new CssParser();
			if (cssParser == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = cssParser.ParseAttributeStyleDefinition(reader);
			if (arrayList == null || arrayList.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			attribute.StyleProperties = new CssPropertyDeclarationCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (arrayList[i] is CssPropertyDeclaration cssPropertyDeclaration)
				{
					attribute.AddDetailNode(cssPropertyDeclaration);
					attribute.StyleProperties.Add(cssPropertyDeclaration);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SetupForAspDirectiveParsing(string aspDirectiveString, SourceRange aspDirectiveRange)
		{
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(aspDirectiveString, aspDirectiveRange.Start.Line, aspDirectiveRange.Start.Offset);
			scanner = CreateScanner(reader);
			la = new Token();
			la.Value = "";
			Get();
		}

		protected void ParseWebHandlerDotNetCode(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				GetParserByLanguageType(DefaultDotNetLanguage, aspxExpressionParser: false)?.Parse(parserContext, reader);
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException(value);
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldPreventCycling()
		{
			return ElementNestingLevel >= 500;
		}

		protected bool IsBadCloseTag(string closeTagElementName)
		{
			if (closeTagElementName == null || base.Context == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (EmptyElements != null && EmptyElements.Contains(closeTagElementName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = base.Context;
			while (languageElement != null && !(languageElement is SourceFile))
			{
				if (languageElement.Name != null && string.Compare(closeTagElementName, languageElement.Name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				languageElement = languageElement.Parent;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SkipCloseTag()
		{
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.HasErrors = true;
			}
			Get();
			if (la.Type != 18)
			{
				Get();
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.HtmlElementName);
			}
			HtmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
			Get();
		}

		protected void SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory category)
		{
			if (base.SetTokensCategory && tToken is CategorizedToken categorizedToken)
			{
				categorizedToken.Category = category;
			}
		}

		internal ISourceReader GetReaderForWebHandler(HtmlScannerBase scanner, ISourceReader baseReader)
		{
			if (baseReader == null || scanner == null)
			{
				return baseReader;
			}
			TextReader stream = baseReader.GetStream();
			string text = stream.ReadToEnd();
			return baseReader.GetSubStream(scanner.Position, text.Length - scanner.Position, scanner.Line, scanner.Column);
		}

		protected void ClearDefaultLanguages()
		{
			_DefaultDotNetLanguage = base.InitialDefaultDotNetLanguage;
			_DefaultScriptLanguage = ScriptLanguageType.Unknown;
		}

		protected bool IsWebHandlerOrWebService(HtmlElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is AspDirective))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (string.Compare("WebService", element.Name) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare("WebHandler", element.Name) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.Compare("Application", element.Name) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected DotNetLanguageType GetDefaultLanguage(HtmlElement element)
		{
			DotNetLanguageType result = DotNetLanguageType.Unknown;
			if (!(element is PageDirective) && !(element is ControlDirective) && !IsWebHandlerOrWebService(element))
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (element == null || element.Name == null || !element.HasAttributes)
			{
				return result;
			}
			XmlAttribute attribute = element.GetAttribute("language", ignoreCase: true);
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				result = GetDotNetLanguageFromString(attribute.Value);
				SetDefaultLanguage(attribute.Value);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected string GetMasterPageFile(HtmlElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is PageDirective { HasAttributes: not false }))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			XmlAttribute attribute = element.GetAttribute("MasterPageFile", ignoreCase: true);
			if (attribute == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SourceFile fileNode = element.FileNode;
			if (fileNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetIncludedFilePath(fileNode, attribute.Value);
		}

		protected void GetDefaultScript(HtmlElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && element.Name != null && string.Compare(element.Name, "meta", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0 && element.HasAttributes)
			{
				GetDefaultScriptFromHttpEq(element);
				GetDefaultScriptFromVs(element);
			}
		}

		protected void SetScriptLanguageType(HtmlScriptDefinition script)
		{
			if (script != null)
			{
				if (script.Attributes["runat"] == null)
				{
					SetClientSideScriptType(script);
				}
				else
				{
					SetServerSideScriptType(script);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckForRazorExpression(HtmlAttribute attribute)
		{
			if (_StringEmbedding != null && attribute != null)
			{
				_StringEmbedding.SetRange(attribute.Range);
				_StringEmbedding.IsRazorEmbedding = true;
				attribute.AddDetailNode(_StringEmbedding);
				if (_StringEmbedding.DetailNodeCount > 0 && _StringEmbedding.DetailNodes[0] is Expression expression)
				{
					attribute.InlineExpression = expression;
					SourceRange range = expression.Range;
					_StringEmbedding.SetRange(new SourceRange(range.Start.Line, range.Start.Offset - 1, range.End.Line, range.End.Offset));
				}
				_StringEmbedding = null;
			}
		}

		protected void CheckForInlineExpression(HtmlAttribute attribute)
		{
			if (IsRazor)
			{
				CheckForRazorExpression(attribute);
			}
			if (attribute == null || attribute.Value == null || attribute.Value.Length == 0 || (!WorkAsXAMLParser && DefaultDotNetLanguage == DotNetLanguageType.Unknown))
			{
				return;
			}
			string value = attribute.Value;
			int inlineCodeStart = GetInlineCodeStart(value);
			if (inlineCodeStart == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			num = ((!WorkAsXAMLParser) ? value.IndexOf("%>") : (value.LastIndexOf('}') + 1));
			if (num == -1 || inlineCodeStart > num)
			{
				return;
			}
			string inlineCode = value.Substring(inlineCodeStart, num - inlineCodeStart);
			int line = attribute.ValueRange.Start.Line;
			int startOffset = attribute.ValueRange.Start.Offset + inlineCodeStart;
			Expression expression = ParseInlineExpression(inlineCode, line, startOffset, null);
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			attribute.InlineExpression = expression;
			if (WorkAsXAMLParser)
			{
				attribute.AddDetailNode(expression);
				return;
			}
			if (expression.Clone() is Expression expression2)
			{
				InlineExpressions.Add(expression2);
			}
			AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding = new AspCodeEmbedding();
			aspCodeEmbedding.SetRange(expression.Range);
			aspCodeEmbedding.AddDetailNode(expression);
			attribute.AddDetailNode(aspCodeEmbedding);
		}

		protected void PerformPostProcessing()
		{
			if (base.RootNode == null || base.RootNode.NodeCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ElementNestingLevel = 0;
			try
			{
				BlockRanges = new List<SourceRange>();
				FictiveCommentRanges = new List<SourceRange>();
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				ArrayList nodes = new ArrayList();
				ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode = GetAspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode(arrayList, nodes, base.RootNode);
				if (aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				CheckForInlineExpression(aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode);
				List<AspCodeEmbedding> razorEmbeddings = GetRazorEmbeddings(aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode);
				TokenCategorizedParserBase parserByLanguageType = GetParserByLanguageType(_DefaultDotNetLanguage, aspxExpressionParser: false);
				if (parserByLanguageType == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Method method = new Method("void", "FictiveMethod");
				method.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(SourceFileStartRange, SourceFileEndRange));
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Function;
				parserByLanguageType.SetTokensCategory = base.SetTokensCategory;
				ParserContext aspEmbeddingsParserContext = GetAspEmbeddingsParserContext(method, aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode, arrayList, nodes);
				LanguageElement languageElement = parserByLanguageType.Parse(aspEmbeddingsParserContext, aspEmbeddingsParserContext.SourceReader);
				if (languageElement != null)
				{
					if (base.RootNode is SourceFile sourceFile)
					{
						sourceFile.Code = method;
					}
					base.RootNode.AddNode(method);
					InsertInlineExpressionsStatements(method);
					InsertRazorEmbeddings(method, razorEmbeddings);
					if (base.SetTokensCategory)
					{
						ReplaceAllEmbeddingTokens(aspCodeEmbeddingsFromNode, parserByLanguageType.SavedTokens);
					}
				}
				BlockRanges = null;
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException(value);
			}
		}

		private LanguageElementCollection NodeListToLanguageElementCollection(NodeList nodes)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i] is LanguageElement value)
				{
					languageElementCollection.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		private LanguageElementCollection FilterRazorEmbeddingNodes(AspCodeEmbedding codeEmbedding, LanguageElementCollection nodes)
		{
			if (codeEmbedding == null || !codeEmbedding.IsRazorEmbedding)
			{
				return nodes;
			}
			if (codeEmbedding is RazorSection || codeEmbedding is RazorFunctions)
			{
				return nodes;
			}
			if (nodes.Count != 1)
			{
				return nodes;
			}
			if (!(nodes[0] is Block block))
			{
				return nodes;
			}
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			int nodeCount = block.NodeCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (block.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement value)
				{
					languageElementCollection.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		private void InsertRazorEmbeddings(Method aspFictiveMethod, List<AspCodeEmbedding> razorEmbeddings)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = null;
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection2 = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < razorEmbeddings.Count; i++)
			{
				AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding = razorEmbeddings[i];
				if (aspCodeEmbedding.DetailNodeCount > 0)
				{
					languageElementCollection2 = NodeListToLanguageElementCollection(aspCodeEmbedding.DetailNodes);
					languageElementCollection2 = FilterRazorEmbeddingNodes(aspCodeEmbedding, languageElementCollection2);
					AddEmbeddingNodes(aspFictiveMethod, languageElementCollection2);
				}
				if (aspCodeEmbedding.NodeCount > 0)
				{
					languageElementCollection = NodeListToLanguageElementCollection(aspCodeEmbedding.Nodes);
					languageElementCollection = FilterRazorEmbeddingNodes(aspCodeEmbedding, languageElementCollection);
					AddEmbeddingNodes(aspFictiveMethod, languageElementCollection);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddEmbeddingNodes(Method aspFictiveMethod, NodeList nodeList)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeList.Count; i++)
			{
				LanguageElement languageElement = nodeList[i] as LanguageElement;
				if (languageElement is Expression expression)
				{
					Statement statement = Statement.FromExpression(expression.Clone() as Expression);
					statement.SetRange(expression.Range);
					InsertInlineExpressionStatement(aspFictiveMethod, statement);
				}
				else
				{
					InsertInlineExpressionStatement(aspFictiveMethod, languageElement.Clone() as LanguageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		private List<AspCodeEmbedding> GetRazorEmbeddings(ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddings)
		{
			List<AspCodeEmbedding> list = new List<AspCodeEmbedding>();
			for (int i = 0; i < aspCodeEmbeddings.Count; i++)
			{
				if (aspCodeEmbeddings[i] is AspCodeEmbedding { IsRazorEmbedding: not false } aspCodeEmbedding)
				{
					list.Add(aspCodeEmbedding);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void ReplaceAllEmbeddingTokens(ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddings, TokenCollection tokenCollection)
		{
			if (aspCodeEmbeddings == null || aspCodeEmbeddings.Count == 0 || tokenCollection == null || tokenCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AspCodeEmbedding aspCodeEmbedding in aspCodeEmbeddings)
			{
				if (aspCodeEmbedding == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Token codeEmbeddingToken = aspCodeEmbedding.CodeEmbeddingToken;
				if (codeEmbeddingToken != null)
				{
					TokenCollection codeEmbeddingsTokens = GetCodeEmbeddingsTokens(codeEmbeddingToken, tokenCollection);
					if (codeEmbeddingsTokens != null && codeEmbeddingsTokens.Count > 0)
					{
						ReplaceEmbeddingToken(codeEmbeddingToken, codeEmbeddingsTokens);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private TokenCollection GetCodeEmbeddingsTokens(Token codeEmbeddingToken, TokenCollection savedTokens)
		{
			TokenCollection tokenCollection = new TokenCollection();
			SourceRange range = codeEmbeddingToken.Range;
			for (int i = 0; i < savedTokens.Count; i++)
			{
				Token token = savedTokens[i];
				if (token != null)
				{
					SourceRange range2 = token.Range;
					if (range.Contains(range2) || (range2.Contains(range.End) && !range2.Contains(range.Start)))
					{
						tokenCollection.Add(token);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < tokenCollection.Count; j++)
			{
				savedTokens.Remove(tokenCollection[j]);
			}
			return tokenCollection;
		}

		private ParserContext GetAspEmbeddingsParserContext(Method aspFictiveMethod, ArrayList aspCodeEmbeddings, ArrayList runAtServerNodes, ArrayList nodes)
		{
			int startLine = 1;
			int startOffset = 1;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			string codeEmbeddingsText = GetCodeEmbeddingsText(arrayList, aspCodeEmbeddings, runAtServerNodes, nodes, ref startLine, ref startOffset);
			ScannerExtension scannerExtension = new ScannerExtension();
			foreach (TokenBlock item in arrayList)
			{
				scannerExtension.EnqueueBlock(item);
			}
			ISourceReader sourceReader = new SourceStringReader(codeEmbeddingsText, startLine, startOffset);
			ParserContext parserContext = new ParserContext();
			if (base.RootNode != null)
			{
				parserContext.Document = base.RootNode.Document;
			}
			parserContext.Context = aspFictiveMethod;
			parserContext.SourceReader = sourceReader;
			parserContext.ScannerExtension = scannerExtension;
			return parserContext;
		}

		private void InsertFictiveComments(LanguageElement root)
		{
			if (root != null && FictiveCommentRanges != null && FictiveCommentRanges.Count > 1)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < FictiveCommentRanges.Count; i++)
				{
					InsertFictiveCommentInProperPlace(root, FictiveCommentRanges[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldCloseTopLevelTag(string currentTagName, string topLevelTagName)
		{
			if (currentTagName == null || topLevelTagName == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = currentTagName.ToLower();
			if (text.IndexOf("asp:") != -1 || text.IndexOf("atlas:") != -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_OptionalEndTagElements.Contains(topLevelTagName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!HtmlElementTypes.Contains(currentTagName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(_OptionalEndTagElements[topLevelTagName] is Hashtable hashtable))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !hashtable.Contains(currentTagName);
		}

		protected void HandleCodeEmbedding(HtmlElement htmlElement, AspCodeEmbedding codeEmbedding)
		{
			if (codeEmbedding != null && htmlElement != null)
			{
				htmlElement.NameRange = codeEmbedding.Range;
				htmlElement.AddDetailNode(codeEmbedding);
				tToken.Value = $"<%{codeEmbedding.Code}%>";
				tToken.Range = codeEmbedding.Range;
			}
		}

		protected void SetContextForHtmlElement(HtmlElement htmlElement, SourceRange lastTagRange, SourceRange tagOpenRange)
		{
			if (htmlElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.HtmlElementName);
			TopLevelReturnCount = 0;
			while (base.Context != null && tToken != null && ShouldCloseTopLevelTag(tToken.Value, base.Context.Name))
			{
				if (lastTagRange != SourceRange.Empty)
				{
					base.Context.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(base.Context, lastTagRange));
				}
				if (base.Context is HtmlElement)
				{
					(base.Context as HtmlElement).InnerRange = GeneratedParserBase.GetRange((base.Context as HtmlElement).InnerRange, new SourceRange(tagOpenRange.Start.Line, tagOpenRange.Start.Offset));
				}
				CloseContext();
				TopLevelReturnCount++;
			}
			if (TopLevelReturnCount > ElementNestingLevel)
			{
				TopLevelReturnCount = ElementNestingLevel;
			}
			OpenContext(htmlElement);
			SetHtmlElementType(htmlElement, tToken.Value);
		}

		protected void HandleTagClose(HtmlElement htmlElement, out bool shouldReturn)
		{
			shouldReturn = true;
			if (htmlElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceRange range = GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(htmlElement, tToken);
			htmlElement.SetRange(range);
			htmlElement.SetBlockStart(range);
			htmlElement.InnerRange = new SourceRange(tToken.Range.End.Line, tToken.Range.End.Offset);
			if (ShouldCloseEmptyTag(base.Context.Name))
			{
				CloseContext();
				if (!WorkAsXAMLParser && IsRazor && la.Type == 53 && la.Value.Trim() == "}")
				{
					htmlElement.HasCloseTag = false;
					return;
				}
				if (ShouldPreventCycling())
				{
					htmlElement.HasCloseTag = false;
					ElementNestingLevel--;
					return;
				}
			}
			ElementNestingLevel++;
			shouldReturn = false;
		}

		protected void HandleEndingTagClose(HtmlElement htmlElement, SourceRange tagCloseRange, out bool shouldReturn)
		{
			shouldReturn = true;
			htmlElement.SetBlockEnd(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(tagCloseRange, tToken));
			ElementNestingLevel--;
			while (la.Type == 49)
			{
				ResetPeek();
				HtmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
				Token token = Peek();
				if (token.Type != 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				string value = token.Value;
				if (string.Compare(value, base.Context.Name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0 || !IsBadCloseTag(value))
				{
					break;
				}
				SkipCloseTag();
				if (la.Type != 49)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			shouldReturn = false;
		}

		protected void HanldeEmptyTagClose(HtmlElement htmlElement)
		{
			htmlElement.IsEmptyTag = true;
			htmlElement.HasCloseTag = false;
			htmlElement.InnerRange = new SourceRange(tToken.Range.End.Line, tToken.Range.End.Offset);
			CloseContext();
			htmlElement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(htmlElement, tToken));
		}

		protected void HandleTagCloseStart(HtmlElement htmlElement, out SourceRange tagCloseRange, out bool shouldReturn)
		{
			shouldReturn = true;
			tagCloseRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			if (htmlElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token.Type == 1)
			{
				string value = token.Value;
				if (string.Compare(value, htmlElement.Name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
				{
					if (htmlElement != null)
					{
						htmlElement.HasCloseTag = false;
					}
					if (!IsBadCloseTag(value))
					{
						if (base.Context != null)
						{
							base.Context.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
						}
						if (string.Compare(value, base.Context.Name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
						{
							CloseContext();
						}
						ElementNestingLevel--;
						return;
					}
					SkipCloseTag();
					if (la.Type != 49)
					{
						if (base.Context != null)
						{
							base.Context.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
							CloseContext();
						}
						ElementNestingLevel--;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			tagCloseRange = la.Range;
			HtmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = false;
			htmlElement.SetBlockEnd(la.Range);
			shouldReturn = false;
		}

		protected void HandleClosingNameToken(HtmlElement htmlElement, SourceRange tagCloseRange, out string closeTagElementName)
		{
			closeTagElementName = string.Empty;
			if (tToken.Type == 1)
			{
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.HtmlElementName);
				closeTagElementName = tToken.Value;
			}
			bool flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(closeTagElementName);
			if (string.Compare(closeTagElementName, htmlElement.Name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0 || flag)
			{
				htmlElement.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(htmlElement, la));
				if (!flag)
				{
					htmlElement.CloseTagNameRange = tToken.Range;
				}
				htmlElement.InnerRange = GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(htmlElement.InnerRange, new SourceRange(tagCloseRange.Start.Line, tagCloseRange.Start.Offset));
				if (EmptyElements.Contains(closeTagElementName))
				{
					MoveNodesInsideElement(htmlElement, base.Context);
				}
			}
			if (string.Compare(closeTagElementName, base.Context.Name, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0 || flag)
			{
				CloseContext();
			}
			HtmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
		}

		protected void TryToHandleScriptOrStyleSheets(HtmlElement htmlElement)
		{
			if (htmlElement == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(htmlElement.Name))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = htmlElement.Name.ToLower();
			GetDefaultScript(htmlElement);
			if (htmlElement is HtmlScriptDefinition)
			{
				HtmlScriptDefinition htmlScriptDefinition = htmlElement as HtmlScriptDefinition;
				SetScriptLanguageType(htmlScriptDefinition);
				AddIncludedScriptFilesItem(htmlScriptDefinition);
			}
			if (htmlElement != null && string.Compare(htmlElement.Name, "link", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				AddIncludedStyleSheetFilesItem(htmlElement);
			}
			string contentString = string.Empty;
			SourceRange contentRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			if ((text == "style" && !WorkAsXAMLParser) || text == "script")
			{
				if (la.Type != 48)
				{
					HtmlScanner.GetElementContent(htmlElement.Name, out contentString, out contentRange);
				}
				if (htmlElement is HtmlScriptDefinition)
				{
					HtmlScriptDefinition htmlScriptDefinition2 = (HtmlScriptDefinition)htmlElement;
					htmlScriptDefinition2.ScriptText = contentString;
					htmlScriptDefinition2.CodeRange = contentRange;
					int nodeCount = htmlScriptDefinition2.NodeCount;
					ParseScript(htmlScriptDefinition2);
					if (nodeCount == htmlScriptDefinition2.NodeCount && contentString.Length > 0 && base.SetTokensCategory)
					{
						CategorizedToken categorizedToken = new CategorizedToken();
						categorizedToken.Value = contentString;
						categorizedToken.Range = contentRange;
						categorizedToken.Category = TokenCategory.Text;
						categorizedToken.StartPosition = la.EndPosition;
						categorizedToken.EndPosition = contentString.Length + categorizedToken.StartPosition;
						base.SavedTokens.Add(categorizedToken);
					}
				}
				else if (htmlElement is HtmlStyleDefinition)
				{
					(htmlElement as HtmlStyleDefinition).StyleText = contentString;
					(htmlElement as HtmlStyleDefinition).TextRange = contentRange;
					ParseStyleDefinition(htmlElement as HtmlStyleDefinition);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HtmlScanner.ShouldCheckForXmlText = true;
			}
		}

		protected HtmlElement CreateElement(string elementName, SourceRange elementNameRange, SourceRange openTagRange)
		{
			HtmlElement htmlElement;
			if (string.Compare(elementName, "SCRIPT", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				htmlElement = new HtmlScriptDefinition();
			}
			else if (string.Compare(elementName, "STYLE", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0)
			{
				htmlElement = new HtmlStyleDefinition();
			}
			else if (elementName.IndexOf(":") != -1)
			{
				string text = elementName.ToUpper();
				htmlElement = ((text.IndexOf("CONTENTPLACEHOLDER") == -1) ? new ServerControlElement() : new ContentPlaceHolder());
			}
			else
			{
				htmlElement = new HtmlElement();
			}
			htmlElement.SetRange(openTagRange);
			htmlElement.NameRange = elementNameRange;
			return htmlElement;
		}

		protected void SetHtmlElementType(HtmlElement htmlElement, string name)
		{
			if (htmlElement != null && name != null)
			{
				htmlElement.Name = name;
				HtmlElementType htmlElementType = HtmlElementType.Unknown;
				if (HtmlElementTypes.Contains(name))
				{
					htmlElementType = (HtmlElementType)HtmlElementTypes[name];
				}
				htmlElement.HtmlElementType = htmlElementType;
			}
		}

		protected override TokenCategory GetTokenCategory(CategorizedToken token)
		{
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 5:
				return TokenCategory.HtmlOperator;
			case 2:
			case 3:
				return TokenCategory.HtmlComment;
			case 10:
			case 11:
			case 12:
			case 56:
				return TokenCategory.HtmlServerSideScript;
			case 8:
			case 9:
			case 15:
			case 18:
			case 47:
			case 48:
			case 49:
			case 50:
				return TokenCategory.HtmlTagDelimiter;
			case 57:
				return TokenCategory.HtmlString;
			case 0:
				return TokenCategory.Unknown;
			default:
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}
		}

		protected void CheckForEventHandlerScriptCode(HtmlAttribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string value = attribute.Value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || !EventAttributeNames.Contains(attribute.Name))
			{
				return;
			}
			DotNetLanguageType scriptLanguage = GetScriptLanguage(_DefaultScriptLanguage);
			ParserBase clientSideParser = GetClientSideParser(scriptLanguage);
			if (clientSideParser == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PosOffset = tToken.StartPosition - tToken.Column;
			int count = base.SavedTokens.Count;
			LanguageElement rootNodeForScript = GetRootNodeForScript(clientSideParser, value, attribute.ValueRange.Start);
			while (base.SavedTokens.Count > count)
			{
				base.SavedTokens.RemoveAt(base.SavedTokens.Count - 1);
			}
			if (rootNodeForScript == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			attribute.ScriptLanguage = scriptLanguage;
			attribute.ScriptCode = new LanguageElementCollection();
			LanguageElementCollection scriptCode = attribute.ScriptCode;
			if (rootNodeForScript is SourceFile)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < rootNodeForScript.NodeCount; i++)
				{
					scriptCode.Add(rootNodeForScript.Nodes[i]);
					attribute.AddDetailNode(rootNodeForScript.Nodes[i] as LanguageElement);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				scriptCode.Add(rootNodeForScript);
			}
		}

		private string GetIncludedFilePath(SourceFile fileNode, string includedFileName)
		{
			if (fileNode == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(includedFileName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (IsHttpPath(includedFileName))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			includedFileName = includedFileName.Replace('/', '\\');
			string empty = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				string directoryName = Path.GetDirectoryName(fileNode.Name);
				if (includedFileName.StartsWith("~"))
				{
					includedFileName = includedFileName.Substring(1);
					IProjectElement project = fileNode.Project;
					if (project == null)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					string filePath = project.FilePath;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					directoryName = Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath);
				}
				if (includedFileName.StartsWith("\\"))
				{
					includedFileName = includedFileName.Substring(1);
				}
				if (includedFileName.StartsWith("<%") || includedFileName.StartsWith("@"))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				empty = Path.Combine(directoryName, includedFileName);
				return Path.GetFullPath(empty);
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException("Exception while trying to get full included file path", value);
				Log.Send(includedFileName);
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		protected void AddIncludedStyleSheetFilesItem(HtmlElement htmlLink)
		{
			if (htmlLink == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HtmlAttributeCollection attributes = htmlLink.Attributes;
			if (attributes == null || attributes.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = htmlLink.Attributes["type"];
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute2 = htmlLink.Attributes["rel"];
			if (htmlAttribute == null || htmlAttribute2 == null || string.Compare("text/css", htmlAttribute.Value, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0 || string.Compare("stylesheet", htmlAttribute2.Value, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute3 = htmlLink.Attributes["href"];
			if (htmlAttribute3 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string value = htmlAttribute3.Value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceFile fileNode = htmlLink.FileNode;
			if (fileNode != null)
			{
				value = GetIncludedFilePath(fileNode, value);
				StringCollection includedStyleSheetFiles = fileNode.IncludedStyleSheetFiles;
				if (includedStyleSheetFiles != null && !includedStyleSheetFiles.Contains(value))
				{
					includedStyleSheetFiles.Add(value);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void AddIncludedScriptFilesItem(HtmlScriptDefinition htmlScript)
		{
			if (htmlScript == null || htmlScript.FileNode == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HtmlAttribute htmlAttribute = htmlScript.Attributes["src"];
			if (htmlAttribute == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(htmlAttribute.Value))
			{
				return;
			}
			string value = htmlAttribute.Value;
			if (IsHttpPath(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceFile fileNode = htmlScript.FileNode;
			try
			{
				string directoryName = Path.GetDirectoryName(fileNode.Name);
				value = Path.Combine(directoryName, value);
				value = Path.GetFullPath(value);
				StringCollection includedScriptFiles = fileNode.IncludedScriptFiles;
				if (includedScriptFiles != null && !includedScriptFiles.Contains(value))
				{
					includedScriptFiles.Add(value);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception value2)
			{
				Log.SendException("Exception while trying to get full script source path", value2);
				Log.Send(htmlAttribute.Value);
			}
		}
	}

		private void CheckLiteral()
		{
			switch (t.Value)
			{
			case "SYSTEM":

				break;
			case "ANY":
				t.Type = 22;
				break;
			case "ATTLIST":
				t.Type = 33;
				break;
			case "ID":
				t.Type = 34;
				break;
			case "CDATA":
				t.Type = 35;
				break;
			case "IDREF":
				t.Type = 36;

			case "IDREFS":

			}
		}
