	public abstract class HtmlScannerBase : XmlScannerBase
	{
		private char _PreviousChar;

		private bool _ShouldCheckForAttribute;

		private const string STR_Model = "model";

		private const string STR_Inherits = "inherits";

		private const string STR_Helper = "helper";

		private const string STR_Functions = "functions";

		private const string STR_Section = "section";

		private const string STR_CDATAStart = "<![CDATA";

		private const string STR_CDATAEnd = "]]>";

		private const string STR_CodeEmbeddingStart = "<%";

		private const string STR_CodeEmbeddingEnd = "%>";

		protected override int CDataTokenType => 53;

		protected override int PICharsTokenType => 54;

		public int RazorStartCharToken => 56;

		public bool ShouldCheckForAttribute
		{
			get
			{
				return _ShouldCheckForAttribute;
			}
			set
			{
				_ShouldCheckForAttribute = value;
			}
		}

		protected override Token CreateToken()
		{
			return new CategorizedToken(TokenLanguage.Html);
		}

		private void ReadRazorComment()
		{
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			string text = ch.ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				if (text == "*@")
				{
					AddCh();
					AddCh();
					break;
				}
				AddCh();
				base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
				text = ch.ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			}
		}

		private void ReadSectionName(Token sectionToken)
		{
			Token token = CreateToken();
			while (ch == ' ' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\n')
			{
				NextCh();
			}
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (token.Column <= 0)
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			token.Line = lineValue;
			token.Type = 1;
			tlen = 0;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			while (char.IsLetterOrDigit(ch))
			{
				AddCh();
			}
			while (ch == ' ' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\n')
			{
				NextCh();
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			sectionToken.Next = token;
		}

		private Token GetRazorStartToken()
		{
			if (!IsRazorEmbeddingStartChar(ch))
			{
				return null;
			}
			Token token = CreateToken();
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (token.Column <= 0)
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			token.Line = lineValue;
			token.Type = RazorStartCharToken;
			tlen = 0;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			AddCh();
			if (ch == ':')
			{
				token.Type = 58;
				AddCh();
			}
			if (ch == '*')
			{
				AddCh();
				ReadRazorComment();
				token.Type = 59;
			}
			if (ArePeekChars("model"))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < "model".Length; i++)
				{
					AddCh();
					token.Type = 60;
				}
			}
			if (ArePeekChars("inherits"))
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < "inherits".Length; j++)
				{
					AddCh();
					token.Type = 61;
				}
			}
			if (ArePeekChars("section"))
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < "section".Length; k++)
				{
					AddCh();
				}
				token.Type = 62;
			}
			if (ArePeekChars("functions"))
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < "functions".Length; l++)
				{
					AddCh();
				}
				token.Type = 64;
			}
			if (ArePeekChars("helper"))
			{
				for (int m = 0; m < "helper".Length; m++)
				{
					AddCh();
					token.Type = 63;
				}
				while (ch == ' ' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\n')
				{
					NextCh();
				}
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			if (token.Type == 62)
			{
				ReadSectionName(token);
			}
			return token;
		}

		protected override void AddCh()
		{
			_PreviousChar = ch;
			base.AddCh();
		}

		private bool SkipString()
		{
			if (ch != '"')
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_PreviousChar == '\\')
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddCh();
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				if (ch == '"' && _PreviousChar != '\\')
				{
					AddCh();
					if (ch == '\uffff')
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (ch != '"')
					{
						return true;
					}
					AddCh();
				}
				else
				{
					AddCh();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SkipCData()
		{
			if (!ArePeekChars("<![CDATA"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SkipChars(8);
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				AddCh();
				base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
				if (ArePeekChars("]]>"))
				{
					SkipChars(3);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SkipChars(int count)
		{
			if (ch == '\uffff')
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				AddCh();
				if (ch == '\uffff')
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ArePeekChars(string chars)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(chars))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ch != chars[0])
			{
				return false;
			}
			int length = chars.Length;
			if (ch == '\uffff')
			{
				if (length == 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			for (int i = 1; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = chars[i];
				char c2 = base.CharProvider.Peek();
				if (c2 == '\uffff')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (c != c2)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool SkipCodeEmbedding(bool isEmbeddingStart)
		{
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			int num = 1;
			if (isEmbeddingStart)
			{
				num = 0;
				if (!ArePeekChars("<%"))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				if (ArePeekChars("<%"))
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (ArePeekChars("%>"))
				{
					num--;
					if (num == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!SkipString() && !SkipCData())
				{
					AddCh();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public Token GetCodeEmbeddingText()
		{
			Token token = CreateToken();
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (token.Column <= 0)
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			token.Line = lineValue;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			tlen = 0;
			SkipCodeEmbedding(isEmbeddingStart: false);
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			return token;
		}

		protected override void NextTokenAfterScan()
		{
			if (t.Type != 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			string value = t.Value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) || value.EndsWith("-->"))
			{
				return;
			}
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				if (ch == '-')
				{
					AddCh();
					if (ch == '-')
					{
						AddCh();
						if (ch == '>')
						{
							AddCh();
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				AddCh();
			}
			t.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
		}

		protected override bool NextTokenStart()
		{
			if (base.ShouldCheckForXmlText)
			{
				char c = PeekForSignificantChar();
				if (c != '<' && c != '\uffff' && !IsReference(c) && !IsRazorEmbeddingStartChar(ch))
				{
					t = GetXmlTextToken();
					return true;
				}
			}
			SkipIgnoredChars();
			if (base.ShouldReturnCharDataToken)
			{
				t = GetCharDataToken();
				return true;
			}
			if (IsRazorEmbeddingStartChar(ch))
			{
				t = GetRazorStartToken();
				return true;
			}
			if (base.ShouldReturnPIChars)
			{
				t = GetPICharToken();
				return true;
			}
			if (ShouldCheckForAttribute)
			{
				ShouldCheckForAttribute = false;
				if (ch != '\'' && ch != '>' && ch != '"' && ch != '<')
				{
					t = GetAttributeValue();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsEmptyCloseTag()
		{
			if (ch != '/')
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			char c = base.CharProvider.Peek();
			return c == '>';
		}

		protected Token GetAttributeValue()
		{
			Token token = CreateToken();
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (token.Column <= 0)
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			token.Line = lineValue;
			token.Type = 55;
			tlen = 0;
			while (ch != '\uffff' && ch != '>' && ch != ' ' && ch != '\n' && ch != '\t' && !IsEmptyCloseTag())
			{
				AddCh();
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			return token;
		}

		public Token ReadStringLiteral(int quoteTokenType, HtmlParser parser)
		{
			char c = '"';
			if (quoteTokenType == 6)
			{
				c = '\'';
			}
			Token token = CreateToken();
			token.StartPosition = pos;
			token.Column = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (token.Column <= 0)
			{
				token.Column = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			token.Line = lineValue;
			token.Type = 57;
			tlen = 0;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				if (IsRazorEmbeddingStartChar(ch))
				{
					AddCh();
					parser.ParseRazorInlineExpressionInString(pos, SourceReader);
				}
				if (ch == c)
				{
					if (base.CharProvider.Peek() != c)
					{
						break;
					}
					AddCh();
					AddCh();
				}
				else if (base.IsRazor)
				{
					AddCh();
				}
				else if (!SkipCodeEmbedding(isEmbeddingStart: true))
				{
					AddCh();
				}
			}
			if (ch == c)
			{
				AddCh();
			}
			if (token.Value == null)
			{
				token.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			}
			token.EndPosition = pos;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - lineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				token.EndColumn = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				token.EndLine = prevLine;
			}
			return token;
		}

		public void GetAspDirectiveString(out string contentString, out SourceRange contentRange)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			contentRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			tlen = 0;
			int num = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				num = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			int startLine = lineValue;
			string text = ch.ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				if (text == "%>")
				{
					while (base.CharProvider.HasPeekedChars)
					{
						AddCh();
					}
					break;
				}
				AddCh();
				text = text[1].ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			}
			int endOffset;
			int endLine;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				endOffset = pos - lineStart + 1;
				endLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				endOffset = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				endLine = prevLine;
			}
			contentRange = new SourceRange(startLine, num, endLine, endOffset);
			empty = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			contentString = empty;
		}

		public string ReadSingleLine(out SourceRange lineRange)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			lineRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			tlen = 0;
			int num = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				num = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			int startLine = lineValue;
			while (ch != '\uffff' && ch != '\n')
			{
				AddCh();
			}
			int endOffset;
			int endLine;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				endOffset = pos - lineStart + 1;
				endLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				endOffset = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				endLine = prevLine;
			}
			lineRange = new SourceRange(startLine, num, endLine, endOffset);
			return new string(tval, 0, tlen);
		}

		public void GetElementContent(string elementName, out string contentString, out SourceRange contentRange)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			contentRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			base.CharProvider.ResetPeek();
			tlen = 0;
			int num = pos - lineStart + 1;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				num = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
			}
			int startLine = lineValue;
			string text = ch.ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
			while (ch != '\uffff')
			{
				if (text == "</")
				{
					if (IsElementName(elementName))
					{
						break;
					}
					while (base.CharProvider.HasPeekedChars)
					{
						AddCh();
					}
					text = ch.ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
				}
				else
				{
					AddCh();
					text = text[1].ToString() + base.CharProvider.Peek();
				}
			}
			int endOffset;
			int endLine;
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				endOffset = pos - lineStart + 1;
				endLine = lineValue;
			}
			else
			{
				endOffset = pos - prevLineStart + 1;
				endLine = prevLine;
			}
			contentRange = new SourceRange(startLine, num, endLine, endOffset);
			empty = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
			contentString = empty;
		}
	}
	public enum LanguageKind
	{
		Unknown,
		Xml,
		Html,
		Razor
	}
	public class HtmlTokensCategoryHelper : ITokenCategoryHelper
	{
		public TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			return TokenCategory.Unknown;
		}

		public TokenCollection GetTokens(string code)
		{
			return GetTokens(code, DotNetLanguageType.Unknown);
		}

		public TokenCollection GetTokens(string code, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingLanguage)
		{
			try
			{
				return HtmlTokensHelper.GetTokens(code, LanguageKind.Html, codeEmbeddingLanguage);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

			return HtmlTokensHelper.GetTokenCategory(token);
		}

		}
	}

			try

				return HtmlTokensHelper.GetTokens(code, LanguageKind.Xml);
			}

				return null;
			}
		}

	public class HtmlTokensHelper
	{
		private static void CalculatePositions(TokenCollection tokens, string code)
		{
			for (int num = tokens.Count - 2; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (tokens[num].Range == tokens[num + 1].Range)
				{
					tokens.Remove(tokens[num]);
				}
			}
			int startIndex = 0;
			foreach (Token token in tokens)
			{
				string value = token.Value;
				startIndex = (token.StartPosition = code.IndexOf(value, startIndex));
				startIndex = (token.EndPosition = startIndex + value.Length);
			}
		}

		public static TokenCollection GetTokens(string code)
		{
			return GetTokens(code, LanguageKind.Html);
		}

		public static TokenCollection GetTokens(string code, LanguageKind languageKind)
		{
			return GetTokens(code, languageKind, DotNetLanguageType.Unknown);
		}

		public static TokenCollection GetTokens(string code, LanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage)
		{
			if (code == null || code.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
			HtmlParser htmlParser = new HtmlParser(languageKind == LanguageKind.Razor, languageKind == LanguageKind.Xml, codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage);
			htmlParser.SetTokensCategory = true;
			htmlParser.Parse(reader);
			TokenCollection savedTokens = htmlParser.SavedTokens;
			if (languageKind == LanguageKind.Razor)
			{
				CalculatePositions(savedTokens, code);
			}
			return savedTokens;
		}

		public static string GetTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken)
			{
				return categorizedToken.GetTokenCategory();
			}
			return "Text";
		}
	}
	internal sealed class XamlLanguageUtils : LanguageUtils
	{
		private class XamlTokenizer : Tokenizer
		{
			public override IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingLanguage)
			{
				if (code == null || code.Length == 0)
				{
					return new List<CategorizedToken>().AsReadOnly();
				}
				ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
				HtmlParser htmlParser = new HtmlParser(isRazorParser: false, workAsXAMLParser: true, codeEmbeddingLanguage);
				htmlParser.SetTokensCategory = true;
				htmlParser.Parse(reader);
				TokenCollection savedTokens = htmlParser.SavedTokens;
				int count = savedTokens.Count;
				List<CategorizedToken> list = new List<CategorizedToken>(count);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					CategorizedToken item = (CategorizedToken)savedTokens[i];
					list.Add(item);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public override Tokenizer CreateTokenizer()
		{
			return new XamlTokenizer();
		}

		public override ParserBase CreateParser(ParserVersion version, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embededLanguage)
		{
			return new HtmlParser(workAsXAMLParser: true);
		}

		public override CodeGen CreateCodeGen()
		{
			CodeGen codeGen = new HtmlXmlCodeGen();
			if (codeGen != null)
			{
				codeGen.Code = new CodeWriter(new StringWriter(), new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.Xaml));
			}
			return codeGen;
		}

		public override ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder()
		{
			return new AspElementBuilder();
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.CodeParser.Patterns
{
	public interface IDemandObjectProxy
	{
		object Key { get; }

		DemandObjectManager Manager { get; set; }
	}
	public abstract class DemandObjectManager : IDisposable
	{
		private Hashtable _ProxiesHash;

		private Hashtable _Proxies;

		private ArrayList _ObjectsToLive;

		protected ArrayList ObjectsToLive
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ObjectsToLive == null)
				{
					_ObjectsToLive = new ArrayList();
				}
				return _ObjectsToLive;
			}
		}

		protected Hashtable Proxies
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Proxies == null)
				{
					_Proxies = new Hashtable();
				}
				return _Proxies;
			}
		}

		protected int ProxiesCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Proxies == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return _Proxies.Count;
			}
		}

		protected Hashtable ProxiesHash
		{
			get
			{
				if (_ProxiesHash == null)
				{
					_ProxiesHash = new Hashtable(StringComparer.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
				}
				return _ProxiesHash;
			}
		}

		public int LiveObjectsCount => GetLiveObjectsCount();

		~DemandObjectManager()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		private int GetLiveObjectsCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			lock (this)
			{
				foreach (DictionaryEntry proxy in Proxies)
				{
					object aliveObject = GetAliveObject((IDemandObjectProxy)proxy.Key);
					if (aliveObject != null)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				foreach (DictionaryEntry proxy in Proxies)
				{
					IDemandObjectProxy demandObjectProxy = (IDemandObjectProxy)proxy.Key;
					if (demandObjectProxy != null)
					{
						demandObjectProxy.Manager = null;
					}
				}
				if (_Proxies != null)
				{
					_Proxies.Clear();
					_Proxies = null;
				}
				if (_ProxiesHash != null)
				{
					_ProxiesHash.Clear();
					_ProxiesHash = null;
				}
				if (_ObjectsToLive != null)
				{
					_ObjectsToLive.Clear();
					_ObjectsToLive = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RegisterObject(IDemandObjectProxy proxy, object obj)
		{
			if (proxy == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				WeakReference value = null;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					value = new WeakReference(obj);
				}
				Proxies.Remove(proxy);
				Proxies.Add(proxy, value);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					ObjectsToLive.Add(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		protected abstract object CreateObjectForProxy(IDemandObjectProxy proxy);

		public void UpdateKey(object oldKey, object newKey)
		{
			if (oldKey != null && newKey != null && ProxiesHash.Contains(oldKey))
			{
				object value = ProxiesHash[oldKey];
				ProxiesHash.Remove(oldKey);
				ProxiesHash.Add(newKey, value);
			}
		}

		public void AddProxy(IDemandObjectProxy proxy)
		{
			if (proxy == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				proxy.Manager = this;
				Proxies.Add(proxy, null);
				ProxiesHash.Add(proxy.Key, proxy);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveProxy(IDemandObjectProxy proxy)
		{
			if (proxy == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ReleaseObject(proxy);
			lock (this)
			{
				proxy.Manager = null;
				Proxies.Remove(proxy);
				ProxiesHash.Remove(proxy.Key);
			}
		}

		public object RequestObject(IDemandObjectProxy proxy)
		{
			return RequestObject(proxy, forceCreate: false);
		}

		public object RequestObject(IDemandObjectProxy proxy, bool forceCreate)
		{
			object aliveObject = GetAliveObject(proxy);
			if (aliveObject != null && !forceCreate)
			{
				return aliveObject;
			}
			aliveObject = CreateObjectForProxy(proxy);
			if (aliveObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RegisterObject(proxy, aliveObject);
			return aliveObject;
		}

		public void ReleaseObject(IDemandObjectProxy proxy)
		{
			object aliveObject = GetAliveObject(proxy);
			if (aliveObject != null)
			{
				lock (this)
				{
					ObjectsToLive.Remove(aliveObject);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ReleaseAllObjects()
		{
			lock (this)
			{
				foreach (DictionaryEntry proxy2 in Proxies)
				{
					if (proxy2.Key is IDemandObjectProxy proxy)
					{
						ReleaseObject(proxy);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void ReplaceObject(IDemandObjectProxy proxy, object obj)
		{
			if (proxy != null)
			{
				ReleaseObject(proxy);
				RegisterObject(proxy, obj);
			}
		}

		public object GetAliveObject(IDemandObjectProxy proxy)
		{
			if (proxy == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			lock (this)
			{
				WeakReference weakReference = (WeakReference)Proxies[proxy];
				if (weakReference == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (weakReference.IsAlive)
				{
					return weakReference.Target;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}
	}

		public class CssTokenizer : Tokenizer
		{
			public override IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage)
			{
				List<CategorizedToken> list = new List<CategorizedToken>();
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
				{
					return list.AsReadOnly();
				}
				ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
				CssParser cssParser = new CssParser();
				cssParser.SetTokensCategory = true;
				cssParser.Parse(reader);
				TokenCollection savedTokens = cssParser.SavedTokens;
				int num = (list.Capacity = savedTokens.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					CategorizedToken item = (CategorizedToken)savedTokens[i];
					list.Add(item);
				}
				return list.AsReadOnly();
			}
		}

		public override Tokenizer CreateTokenizer()
		{
			return new CssTokenizer();
		}

		public override ParserBase CreateParser(ParserVersion version, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embededLanguage)
		{
			return new CssParser();
		}

		public override CodeGen CreateCodeGen()
		{
			CodeGen codeGen = new HtmlXmlCodeGen();
			if (codeGen != null)
			{
				codeGen.Code = new CodeWriter(new StringWriter(), new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.Css));
			}
			return codeGen;
		}

		public override ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder()
		{
			return new AspElementBuilder();
		}
	}

		private void Parser()
		{
			CssStyleSheet cssStyleSheet = new CssStyleSheet();
			cssStyleSheet.SetRange(la.Range);
			OpenContext(cssStyleSheet);
			if (IsSpecialName("charset"))
			{
				Expect(1);
				Expect(10);
				SetKeywordTokenCategory(tToken);
				CssCharsetDeclaration cssCharsetDeclaration = new CssCharsetDeclaration();
				cssCharsetDeclaration.SetRange(tToken.Range);
				cssCharsetDeclaration.Charset = la.Value;
				cssCharsetDeclaration.Name = la.Value;
				cssCharsetDeclaration.NameRange = la.Range;
				Expect(4);
				Expect(5);
				cssCharsetDeclaration.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(cssCharsetDeclaration, tToken));
				AddNode(cssCharsetDeclaration);
			}
			while (la.Type == 2 || la.Type == 3)
			{
				HtmlCommentTags();
			}
			while (IsSpecialName("import"))
			{
				Import();
				while (la.Type == 2 || la.Type == 3)
				{
					HtmlCommentTags();
				}
			}
			while (StartOf(1))
			{
				if (la.Type == 1)
				{
					Get();
					if (IsSpecialNameWithoutAt("font-face"))
					{
						FontFace();
					}
					if (IsSpecialNameWithoutAt("media"))
					{
						Media();
					}
					if (IsSpecialNameWithoutAt("page"))
					{
						Page();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RuleSet();
				}
				while (la.Type == 2 || la.Type == 3)
				{
					HtmlCommentTags();
				}
			}
			CloseContext();
			cssStyleSheet.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(cssStyleSheet, tToken));
		}

		private void Term(out CssTerm result)
		{
			result = null;
			PrecedingSign sign = PrecedingSign.None;
			CssMeasureUnit unit = CssMeasureUnit.None;
			CssFunctionReference functionReference = null;
			object decValue = null;
			switch (la.Type)
			{
			case 13:
			case 15:
			case 35:
			case 36:
			case 37:
			case 38:
			case 39:
			case 40:
			case 41:
			case 42:
				if (la.Type == 13 || la.Type == 15)
				{
					if (la.Type == 15)
					{
						Get();
						sign = PrecedingSign.Minus;
					}
					else
					{
						Get();
						sign = PrecedingSign.Plus;
					}
				}
				if (la.Type == 35)
				{
					Get();
					result = new CssNumberLiteral();
					result.Name = tToken.Value;
					result.SetRange(tToken.Range);
					int length = tToken.Value.Length;
					if (tToken.Value[length - 1] == '%')
					{
						(result as CssMeasuredNumber).Unit = CssMeasureUnit.Percent;
						length--;
					}
					(result as CssNumberLiteral).Value = GetValueFromString(tToken.Value, tToken.Value.Length);
				}
				else if (la.Type == 36)
				{
					Get();
					result = new CssPercentLiteral();
					result.Name = tToken.Value;
					result.SetRange(tToken.Range);
					(result as CssMeasuredNumber).Value = GetValueFromString(tToken.Value, tToken.Value.Length - 1);
				}
				else if (StartOf(3))
				{
					if (la.Type == 37 || la.Type == 38 || la.Type == 39)
					{
						if (la.Type == 37)
						{
							Get();
						}
						else if (la.Type == 38)
						{
							Get();
						}
						else if (la.Type == 39)
						{
							Get();
						}
						else
						{
							SynErr(49);
						}
						result = new CssLengthLiteral();
					}
					else if (la.Type == 40)
					{
						Get();
						result = new CssAngleLiteral();
					}
					else if (la.Type == 41)
					{
						Get();
						result = new CssTimeLiteral();
					}
					else
					{
						Get();
						result = new CssFrequencyLiteral();
					}
					result.Name = tToken.Value;
					result.SetRange(tToken.Range);
					GetMeasuredLiteralValue(tToken.Value, out decValue, out unit);
					(result as CssMeasuredNumber).Value = decValue;
					(result as CssMeasuredNumber).Unit = unit;
				}
				else
				{
					SynErr(50);
				}
				if (result != null)
				{
					result.Sign = sign;
				}
				break;
			case 4:
				Get();
				result = new CssStringLiteral();
				result.Name = tToken.Value;
				(result as CssStringLiteral).Value = tToken.Value;
				result.SetRange(tToken.Range);
				break;
			case 10:
			case 18:
				if (la.Type == 18)
				{
					Get();
					SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue);
				}
				Expect(10);
				result = new CssIdentifierReference();
				result.Name = tToken.Value;
				result.SetRange(tToken.Range);
				while (la.Type == 11 || la.Type == 18)
				{
					if (la.Type == 18)
					{
						Get();
					}
					else
					{
						Get();
					}
					SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue);
					if (la.Type == 10)
					{
						Get();
						SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue);
						CssIdentifierReference cssIdentifierReference = new CssIdentifierReference();
						cssIdentifierReference.Name = tToken.Value;
						cssIdentifierReference.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(result, tToken));
						cssIdentifierReference.AddDetailNode(result);
						result = cssIdentifierReference;
					}
					else if (la.Type == 28)
					{
						Function(out functionReference);
						functionReference.AddDetailNode(result);
						result = functionReference;
					}
					else
					{
						SynErr(51);
					}
				}
				break;
			case 6:
				Get();
				result = new CssURIReference();
				result.Name = tToken.Value;
				result.SetRange(tToken.Range);
				(result as CssURIReference).URI = tToken.Value;
				break;
			case 17:
				Get();
				result = new CssColorReference();
				result.Name = tToken.Value;
				result.SetRange(tToken.Range);
				break;
			case 28:
				Function(out functionReference);
				result = functionReference;
				break;
			default:
				SynErr(52);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void Combinator(out CssSelectorType combinatorType)
		{
			combinatorType = CssSelectorType.Name;
			if (la.Type == 13)

				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 14)
			{
				Get();
				combinatorType = CssSelectorType.CombinedChild;
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 16)
			{
				Get();
				combinatorType = CssSelectorType.CombinedGeneralSibling;
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(54);
			}
		}

		private void Selector(out CssSelector selector)
		{
			CssSelector cssSelector = null;
			CssSelectorType combinatorType = CssSelectorType.Name;
			CssSelector selector2 = null;
			selector = null;
			SimpleSelector(out selector2);
			cssSelector = selector2;
			while (la.Type == 13 || la.Type == 14 || la.Type == 16)
			{
				Combinator(out combinatorType);
				SimpleSelector(out selector);
				if (cssSelector != null && selector != null)
				{
					selector.SelectorType = combinatorType;
					ConnectSelectors(cssSelector, selector);
				}
				cssSelector = selector;
				selector2?.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(selector2, cssSelector));
			}
			selector = selector2;
		}

		private void SimpleSelector(out CssSelector selector)
		{
			selector = new CssSelector();
			CssSelector parent = null;
			if (tToken.Type == 1)
			{
				selector.SetRange(tToken.Range);
			}
			else
			{
				selector.SetRange(la.Range);
			}
			CssAttributeSelector attrSelector = null;
			CssPseudoSelector pseudoSelector = null;
			CssSelector cssSelector = null;
			while (StartOf(4))
			{
				if (la.Type == 10 || la.Type == 19)
				{
					ElementName();
					selector = new CssSelector();
					selector.Name = tToken.Value;
					selector.NameRange = tToken.Range;
					selector.SetRange(tToken.Range);
					ConnectSelectors(parent, selector);
					SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
					if (cssSelector == null)
					{
						cssSelector = selector;
					}
					parent = selector;
				}
				else if (la.Type == 17)
				{
					Get();
					selector = new CssSelector();
					selector.SetRange(tToken.Range);
					selector.SelectorType = CssSelectorType.Hash;
					SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
					if (tToken.Value.Length > 1)
					{
						selector.Name = tToken.Value.Substring(1);
						SourceRange range = tToken.Range;
						selector.NameRange = new SourceRange(range.Top.Line, range.Top.Offset + 1, range.End.Line, range.End.Offset);
					}
					ConnectSelectors(parent, selector);
					if (cssSelector == null)
					{
						cssSelector = selector;
					}
					parent = selector;
				}
				else if (la.Type == 18)
				{
					Class(out selector);
					ConnectSelectors(parent, selector);
					if (cssSelector == null)
					{
						cssSelector = selector;
					}
					parent = selector;
				}
				else if (la.Type == 20)
				{
					Attrib(out attrSelector);
					ConnectSelectors(parent, attrSelector);
					if (cssSelector == null)
					{
						cssSelector = selector;
					}
					parent = attrSelector;
				}
				else
				{
					Pseudo(out pseudoSelector);
					ConnectSelectors(parent, pseudoSelector);
					if (cssSelector == null)
					{
						cssSelector = selector;
					}
					parent = pseudoSelector;
				}
			}
			selector = cssSelector;
		}

		private void ElementName()
		{
			if (la.Type == 10)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 19)
			{
				Get();
				if (la.Type == 10)
				{
					Get();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(55);
			}
		}

		private void Class(out CssSelector selector)
		{
			selector = new CssSelector();
			selector.SelectorType = CssSelectorType.Class;
			Expect(18);
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			selector.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(tToken, la));
			selector.Name = la.Value;
			selector.NameRange = la.Range;
			Expect(10);
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
		}

		private void Attrib(out CssAttributeSelector attrSelector)
		{
			attrSelector = new CssAttributeSelector();
			attrSelector.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(20);
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			Expect(10);
			attrSelector.Name = tToken.Value;
			attrSelector.NameRange = tToken.Range;
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			if (StartOf(5))
			{
				switch (la.Type)
				{
				case 21:
					Get();
					attrSelector.EqualityType = AttributeSelectorEqualityType.ExactMatch;
					break;
				case 22:
					Get();
					attrSelector.EqualityType = AttributeSelectorEqualityType.SpaceSeparatedMatch;
					break;
				case 23:
					Get();
					attrSelector.EqualityType = AttributeSelectorEqualityType.HyphenSeparatedMatch;
					break;
				case 24:
					Get();
					attrSelector.EqualityType = AttributeSelectorEqualityType.BeginsWith;
					break;
				case 25:
					Get();
					attrSelector.EqualityType = AttributeSelectorEqualityType.EndsWith;
					break;
				case 26:
					Get();
					attrSelector.EqualityType = AttributeSelectorEqualityType.Contains;
					break;
				}
				if (la.Type == 10)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else if (la.Type == 4)
				{
					Get();
				}
				else
				{
					SynErr(56);
				}
				attrSelector.Value = tToken.Value;
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			}
			Expect(27);
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			attrSelector.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(attrSelector, tToken));
		}

		private void Pseudo(out CssPseudoSelector pseudoSelector)
		{
			Token a = la;
			pseudoSelector = null;
			Expect(11);
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			if (la.Type == 10)
			{
				Get();
				pseudoSelector = new CssPseudoSelector();
				pseudoSelector.Name = tToken.Value;
				pseudoSelector.NameRange = tToken.Range;
				pseudoSelector.PseudoClassType = GetPseudoClassType(tToken.Value);
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 28)
			{
				Get();
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
				pseudoSelector = new CssPseudoFunctionSelector();
				pseudoSelector.Name = tToken.Value.Substring(0, tToken.Value.Length - 1);
				SourceRange range = tToken.Range;
				pseudoSelector.NameRange = new SourceRange(range.Top.Line, range.Top.Offset, range.End.Line, range.End.Offset - 1);
				pseudoSelector.PseudoClassType = GetPseudoClassType(pseudoSelector.Name);
				if (StartOf(6))
				{
					if (la.Type == 10 || la.Type == 18)
					{
						if (la.Type == 18)
						{
							Get();
							SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
						}
						Expect(10);
						if (la.Type == 13 || la.Type == 15)
						{
							if (la.Type == 13)
							{
								Get();
							}
							else
							{
								Get();
							}
							Expect(35);
						}
						(pseudoSelector as CssPseudoFunctionSelector).Param = tToken.Value;
						SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
					}
					else if (la.Type == 35)
					{
						Get();
						if (la.Type == 10)
						{
							Get();
							if (la.Type == 13 || la.Type == 15)
							{
								if (la.Type == 13)
								{
									Get();
								}
								else
								{
									Get();
								}
								Expect(35);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (la.Type == 13)
						{
							Get();
						}
						else if (la.Type == 15)
						{
							Get();
						}
						else
						{
							SynErr(57);
						}
						if (la.Type == 35)
						{
							Get();
							if (la.Type == 10)
							{
								Get();
								if (la.Type == 13 || la.Type == 15)
								{
									if (la.Type == 13)
									{
										Get();
									}
									else
									{
										Get();
									}
									Expect(35);
								}
							}
						}
						else if (la.Type == 10)
						{
							Get();
							if (la.Type == 13 || la.Type == 15)
							{
								if (la.Type == 13)
								{
									Get();
								}
								else
								{
									Get();
								}
								Expect(35);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							SynErr(58);
						}
					}
				}
				Expect(30);
				SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssSelector);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(59);
			}
			if (pseudoSelector != null)
			{
				pseudoSelector.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(a, tToken));
			}
		}

		private void Expr(out CssTermCollection terms)
		{
			CssTerm result = null;
			terms = new CssTermCollection();
			ExpressionDelimiter expressionDelimiter = ExpressionDelimiter.None;
			Term(out result);
			if (result != null)
			{
				result.Delimiter = ExpressionDelimiter.None;
				terms.Add(result);
			}
			while (StartOf(7))
			{
				expressionDelimiter = ExpressionDelimiter.Whitespace;
				if (la.Type == 7 || la.Type == 12 || la.Type == 21)
				{
					if (la.Type == 12)
					{
						Get();
						expressionDelimiter = ExpressionDelimiter.Slash;
					}
					else if (la.Type == 7)
					{
						Get();
						expressionDelimiter = ExpressionDelimiter.Comma;
					}
					else
					{
						Get();
						expressionDelimiter = ExpressionDelimiter.Equals;
					}
					SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue);
				}
				Term(out result);
				if (result != null)
				{
					result.Delimiter = expressionDelimiter;
					terms.Add(result);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Function(out CssFunctionReference functionReference)
		{
			functionReference = new CssFunctionReference();
			functionReference.SetRange(la.Range);
			CssTermCollection terms = null;
			Expect(28);
			functionReference.Name = tToken.Value.Substring(0, tToken.Value.Length - 1);
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue);
			Expr(out terms);
			Expect(30);
			SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue);
			functionReference.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(functionReference, tToken));
			if (terms != null && terms.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < terms.Count; i++)
				{
					functionReference.Parameters.Add(terms[i]);
					functionReference.AddDetailNode(terms[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Parse()
		{
			la = new Token();
			la.Value = "";
			Get();
			Parser();
			if (base.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				while (la != null && la.Type != 0)
				{
					Get();
				}
			}
			Expect(0);
		}

		public CssParser()
		{
			parserErrors = new CssParserErrors();
			if (_CssSet == null)
			{
				_CssSet = CreateSetArray();
			}
			set = _CssSet;
			maxTokens = 45;
			_Comments = new CommentCollection();
		}

		private CssPseudoClassType GetPseudoClassType(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return CssPseudoClassType.Unknown;
			}
			return name.ToLower() switch
			{
				"not" => CssPseudoClassType.Negation, 
				"matches" => CssPseudoClassType.MatchesAny, 
				"dir" => CssPseudoClassType.Dir, 
				"lang" => CssPseudoClassType.Lang, 
				"any-link" => CssPseudoClassType.Hyperlink, 
				"link" => CssPseudoClassType.NotVisitedLink, 
				"visited" => CssPseudoClassType.VisitedLink, 
				"local-link" => CssPseudoClassType.LocalLink, 
				"target" => CssPseudoClassType.Target, 
				"scope" => CssPseudoClassType.Scope, 
				"current" => CssPseudoClassType.Current, 
				"past" => CssPseudoClassType.Past, 
				"future" => CssPseudoClassType.Future, 
				"active" => CssPseudoClassType.Active, 
				"hover" => CssPseudoClassType.Hover, 
				"focus" => CssPseudoClassType.Focus, 
				"enabled" => CssPseudoClassType.Enabled, 
				"disabled" => CssPseudoClassType.Disabled, 
				"checked" => CssPseudoClassType.SelectedOption, 
				"indeterminate" => CssPseudoClassType.IndeterminateValue, 
				"default" => CssPseudoClassType.DefaultOption, 
				"in-range" => CssPseudoClassType.InRange, 
				"out-of-range" => CssPseudoClassType.OutOfRange, 
				"required" => CssPseudoClassType.Required, 
				"optional" => CssPseudoClassType.Optional, 
				"read-only" => CssPseudoClassType.ReadOnly, 
				"read-write" => CssPseudoClassType.ReadWrite, 
				"root" => CssPseudoClassType.Root, 
				"empty" => CssPseudoClassType.Empty, 
				"first-child" => CssPseudoClassType.FirstChild, 
				"nth-child" => CssPseudoClassType.NthChild, 
				"last-child" => CssPseudoClassType.LastChild, 
				"nth-last-child" => CssPseudoClassType.NthLastChild, 
				"only-child" => CssPseudoClassType.OnlyChild, 
				"first-of-type" => CssPseudoClassType.FirstOfType, 
				"nth-of-type" => CssPseudoClassType.NthOfType, 
				"last-of-type" => CssPseudoClassType.LastOfType, 
				"nth-last-of-type" => CssPseudoClassType.NthLastOfType, 
				"only-of-type" => CssPseudoClassType.OnlyOfType, 
				"nth-match" => CssPseudoClassType.NthMatch, 
				"column" => CssPseudoClassType.Column, 
				"nth-column" => CssPseudoClassType.NthColumn, 
				"nth-last-column" => CssPseudoClassType.NthLastColumn, 
				_ => CssPseudoClassType.Unknown, 
			};
		}

		private object GetValueFromString(string strValue, int suffixPos)
		{
			decimal num = default(decimal);
			try
			{
				string value = strValue.Substring(0, suffixPos);
				num = Convert.ToDecimal(value, NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void ConnectSelectors(CssSelector parent, CssSelector child)
		{
			if (child != null)
			{
				if (parent != null)
				{
					child.SetParent(parent);
					parent.ChildSelector = child;
					parent.AddNode(child);
					parent.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(parent, child));
				}
				for (CssSelector cssSelector = child.Parent as CssSelector; cssSelector != null; cssSelector = cssSelector.Parent as CssSelector)
				{
					cssSelector.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(cssSelector, child));
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetMeasuredLiteralValue(string strValue, out object decValue, out CssMeasureUnit unit)
		{
			decValue = null;
			unit = CssMeasureUnit.None;
			if (strValue != null && strValue.Length >= 2)
			{
				int num = -1;
				if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("grad")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Grad;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("rad")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Rad;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("deg")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Deg;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("khz")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.kHz;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("hz")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Hz;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("px")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Px;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("cm")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Cm;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("mm")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Mm;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("in")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.In;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("pt")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Pt;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("pc")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Pc;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("em")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Em;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("ex")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Ex;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("ms")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.Ms;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
				else if ((num = strValue.IndexOf("s")) != -1)
				{
					unit = CssMeasureUnit.S;
					decValue = GetValueFromString(strValue, num);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsSpecialNameWithoutAt(string name)
		{
			if (la.Type == 10)
			{
				return la.Value == name;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsSpecialName(string name)
		{
			if (la.Type != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token.Type == 10)
			{
				return token.Value == name;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AddCommentNode(Token commentToken)
		{
			Comment comment = new Comment();
			CommentType commentType = ((commentToken.Type != 43) ? CommentType.MultiLine : CommentType.SingleLine);
			string value = commentToken.Value;
			bool flag = value.StartsWith("/*");
			comment.SetCommentType(commentType);
			comment.SetTextStartOffset(2);
			value = ((value.Length <= 2) ? string.Empty : value.Substring(2));
			int num = value.LastIndexOf("*/");
			bool flag2 = num >= 0;
			if (commentType == CommentType.MultiLine && flag2)
			{
				value = value.Substring(0, num);
			}
			if (flag && !flag2)
			{
				comment.IsUnfinished = true;
			}
			comment.SetRange(commentToken.Range);
			comment.StartPos = commentToken.StartPosition;
			comment.EndPos = commentToken.EndPosition;
			comment.InternalName = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(value);
			Comments.Add(comment);
		}

		private void SetCategoryIfNeeded(TokenCategory category)
		{
			if (base.SetTokensCategory && tToken is CategorizedToken categorizedToken)
			{
				categorizedToken.Category = category;
			}
		}

		protected override void Get()
		{
			base.Get();
			Token token = tToken;
			while (la.Match(43) || la.Match(44))
			{
				token = tToken;
				AddCommentNode(la);
				base.Get();
			}
			tToken = token;
		}

		protected override TokenCategory GetTokenCategory(CategorizedToken token)
		{
			if (token.Type == 0)
			{
				return TokenCategory.Unknown;
			}
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 5:
			case 7:
			case 8:
			case 9:
			case 11:
			case 12:
			case 13:
			case 14:
			case 15:
			case 18:
			case 19:
			case 20:
			case 21:
			case 22:
			case 23:
			case 27:
			case 30:
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			case 4:
				return TokenCategory.CssStringValue;
			case 6:
			case 10:
			case 17:
			case 35:
			case 36:
			case 37:
			case 38:
			case 39:
			case 40:
			case 41:
			case 42:
				return TokenCategory.CssPropertyValue;
			case 43:
			case 44:
				return TokenCategory.CssComment;
			case 1:
			case 31:
				return TokenCategory.CssKeyword;
			default:
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}
		}

		protected override LanguageElement DoParse(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			LanguageElement context = parserContext.Context;
			if (context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SetRootNode(context);
			if (context is SourceFile)
			{
				((SourceFile)context).SetDocument(parserContext.Document);
			}
			return Parse(reader);
		}

		public LanguageElement Parse(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				scanner = new CssScanner(reader);
				Parse();
				BindComments();
				return base.RootNode;
			}
			finally
			{
				CleanUpParser();
			}
		}

		public ArrayList ParseAttributeStyleDefinition(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				CssPropertyDeclaration propertyDecl = null;
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				scanner = new CssScanner(reader);
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				while (la.Type == 10)
				{
					Declaration(out propertyDecl);
					if (la.Type == 5)
					{
						Get();
					}
					if (propertyDecl != null)
					{
						if (tToken.Type == 5)
						{
							propertyDecl.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(propertyDecl, tToken));
						}
						arrayList.Add(propertyDecl);
					}
				}
				return arrayList;
			}
			catch (Exception value)
			{
				Log.SendException(value);
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				CleanUpParser();
			}
		}

		protected override void CleanUpParser()
		{
			base.CleanUpParser();
			_Comments.Clear();
		}
	}

		public CssScanner(ISourceReader s)
		{
			Initialize(s);
		}

		protected override int GetUnicodeLetterIndex()
		{
			return 258;
		}

		protected override int GetNextState(int input)
		{
			return start[input];
		}

		protected override Token CreateToken()
		{
			return new CategorizedToken(TokenLanguage.Css);
		}

		protected override void NextTokenAfterScan()
		{
			if (t.Type == 28 && t.Value == "url(")
			{
				ReadURIText();
				t.Value = new string(tval, 0, tlen);
				t.Type = 6;
			}
		}

		private void ReadURIText()
		{
			SkipIgnoredChars();
			if (ch == '"')
			{
				AddCh();
				while (ch != '\uffff')
				{
					if (ch == '"')
					{
						AddCh();
						break;
					}
					AddCh();
				}
			}
			else if (ch == '\'')
			{
				AddCh();
				while (ch != '\uffff')
				{
					if (ch == '\'')
					{
						AddCh();
						break;
					}
					AddCh();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num = 1;
				if (ch == ')')
				{
					AddCh();
					return;
				}
				while (ch != '\uffff')
				{
					AddCh();
					if (ch == '(')
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (ch == ')')
					{
						num--;
					}
					if (num == 0)
					{
						AddCh();
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			SkipIgnoredChars();
			if (ch == ')')
			{
				AddCh();
			}
		}
	}
	public class CssTokensCategoryHelper : ITokenCategoryHelper
	{
		public TokenCategory GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			return TokenCategory.Text;
		}

		public TokenCollection GetTokens(string code)
		{
			if (code == null || code.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
				CssParser cssParser = new CssParser();
				cssParser.SetTokensCategory = true;
				cssParser.Parse(reader);
				return cssParser.SavedTokens;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public string GetTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (token is CategorizedToken categorizedToken)
			{
				return categorizedToken.GetTokenCategory();
			}
			return "Text";
		}

		public string GetTokenCategory(Token token, ParserVersion version)
		{
			return GetTokenCategory(token);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.CodeParser.CSharp
{
	public sealed class CodeGenHelper
	{
		private struct AccessSpecifierInfo : IComparable<AccessSpecifierInfo>
		{
			public SourcePoint Point;

			public FormattingTokenType KeyWord;

			private int _Index;

			public AccessSpecifierInfo(SourceRange range, FormattingTokenType keyWord, int index)
			{
				Point = range.Start;
				KeyWord = keyWord;
				_Index = index;
			}

			public int CompareTo(AccessSpecifierInfo other)
			{
				int num = Point.CompareTo(other.Point);
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return _Index.CompareTo(other._Index);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private const string STR_Public = "public";

		private const string STR_Private = "private";

		private const string STR_Protected = "protected";

		private const string STR_Internal = "internal";

		private const string STR_ProtectedInternal = "protected internal";

		private CodeGenHelper()
		{
		}

		private static bool HasTypeParameterConstraints(TypeParameterCollection typeParams)
		{
			if (typeParams == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = typeParams.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				TypeParameter typeParameter = typeParams[i];
				if (typeParameter != null && HasTypeParameterConstraints(typeParameter))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void GenerateAccessSpecifiers(LanguageElementCodeGenBase leGen)
		{
			if (!(leGen.Context is AccessSpecifiedElement { AccessSpecifiers: { } accessSpecifiers }))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<AccessSpecifierInfo> list = new List<AccessSpecifierInfo>();
			LanguageElement context = leGen.Context;
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsAbstract)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.AbstractRange, FormattingTokenType.Abstract, 1));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsExtern)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.ExternRange, FormattingTokenType.Extern, 2));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsNew)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.NewRange, FormattingTokenType.New, 3));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsUnsafe)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.UnsafeRange, FormattingTokenType.Unsafe, 4));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsStatic)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.StaticRange, FormattingTokenType.Static, 5));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsReadOnly && (context == null || context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Property))
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.ReadOnlyRange, FormattingTokenType.ReadOnly, 6));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsSealed)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.SealedRange, FormattingTokenType.Sealed, 7));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsOverride)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.OverrideRange, FormattingTokenType.Override, 8));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsVirtual)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.VirtualRange, FormattingTokenType.Virtual, 9));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsVolatile)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.VolatileRange, FormattingTokenType.Volatile, 10));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsPartial)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.PartialRange, FormattingTokenType.Partial, 11));
			}
			if (accessSpecifiers.IsAsynchronous)
			{
				list.Add(new AccessSpecifierInfo(accessSpecifiers.AsynchronousRange, FormattingTokenType.Async, 12));
			}
			list.Sort();
			foreach (AccessSpecifierInfo item in list)
			{
				leGen.Write(item.KeyWord);
			}
		}

		public static void GenerateVisibility(LanguageElementCodeGenBase leGen)
		{
			if (leGen.Context is AccessSpecifiedElement accessSpecifiedElement)
			{
				GenerateVisibility(leGen, accessSpecifiedElement.Visibility);
			}
		}

		public static void GenerateVisibility(LanguageElementCodeGenBase leGen, MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			if (!(leGen.Context is AccessSpecifiedElement { IsDefaultVisibility: not false }))
			{
				switch (visibility)
				{
				case MemberVisibility.Public:
					leGen.Write(FormattingTokenType.Public);
					break;
				case MemberVisibility.Private:
					leGen.Write(FormattingTokenType.Private);
					break;
				case MemberVisibility.Protected:
					leGen.Write(FormattingTokenType.Protected);
					break;
				case MemberVisibility.Internal:
					leGen.Write(FormattingTokenType.Internal);
					break;
				case MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal:
					leGen.Write(FormattingTokenType.Protected);
					leGen.Write(FormattingTokenType.Internal);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool HasTypeParameterConstraints(GenericModifier modifier)
		{
			if (modifier == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return HasTypeParameterConstraints(modifier.TypeParameters);
		}

		public static bool HasTypeParameterConstraints(TypeParameter param)
		{
			if (param == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (param.Constraints != null)
			{
				return param.Constraints.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void GenerateExpressionListForMethodCall(ExpressionCollection expressions, string delimiter, CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			if (expressions == null || expressions.Count == 0 || codeGen == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < expressions.Count; i++)
			{
				Expression expression = expressions[i];
				if (expression != null)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(delimiter) && i != 0)
					{
						codeGen.Code.Write(delimiter);
					}
					codeGen.GenerateElement(expression);
				}
			}
		}

		public static string GetVisibility(MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			return visibility switch
			{
				MemberVisibility.Public => "public", 
				MemberVisibility.Private => "private", 
				MemberVisibility.Protected => "protected", 
				MemberVisibility.Internal => "internal", 
				MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal => "protected internal", 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class CSharpCodeGen : CodeGen
	{
		private LanguageElement _FirstElement;

		internal override FormattingTable FormattingTable => CSharpFormattingTable.Instance;

		public bool ContextIsFirstElement => base.Context == _FirstElement;

		public CSharpCodeGen()
			: this(new CodeGenOptions(ParserLanguageID.CSharp))
		{
		}

		public CSharpCodeGen(CodeGenOptions options)
			: base(options)
		{
		}

		private void AddCharOperatorsToFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType, FormattingElements result)
		{
			if (result == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Equal:
			{
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.NamespaceReference)
				{
					if (Options.Spacing.AroundEqualsInNamespaceAliasDeclaration)
					{
						result.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
					break;
				}
				LanguageElement parent = base.Context.Parent;
				if ((parent == null || parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression) && Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators)
				{
					result.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			case FormattingTokenType.BackSlashEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThanGreatThanEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.AmpersandEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.SlashEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.EqualEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThenEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThanEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanLessThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.MinusEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.PercentEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.ExclamationEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBarEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.PlusEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.AsteriskEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.CaretEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.QuestionQuestion:
			case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBarVerticalBar:
			case FormattingTokenType.AmpersandAmpersand:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThanEqual:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreatThanGreatThan:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundTwoCharOperators && (base.Context is BinaryOperatorExpression || base.Context is Assignment))
				{
					result.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Ampersand:
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
			case FormattingTokenType.Minus:
			case FormattingTokenType.Plus:
			case FormattingTokenType.Asterisk:
			case FormattingTokenType.VerticalBar:
			case FormattingTokenType.Caret:
			case FormattingTokenType.Slash:
			case FormattingTokenType.Percent:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators && base.Context is BinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					result.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
				if (base.Context is BinaryOperatorExpression)
				{
					result.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void CSharpContextPoped(LanguageElement oldContext)
		{
			if (oldContext != null && !oldContext.IsRemoved && (base.StatementGen == null || !base.StatementGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.TypeDeclarationGen == null || !base.TypeDeclarationGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.MemberGen == null || !base.MemberGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.NamespaceReferenceGen == null || !base.NamespaceReferenceGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.NamespaceGen == null || !base.NamespaceGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.ExpressionGen == null || !base.ExpressionGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.SupportElementGen == null || !base.SupportElementGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && (base.XmlGen == null || !base.XmlGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext)) && base.DirectiveGen != null)
			{
				base.DirectiveGen.GenerateElementTail(oldContext);
			}
		}

			return null;
