		protected override void ContextPushed()
		{
			Alignment(base.Context, pushed: true);
		}

		protected override bool NeedGenerateSideComment(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!base.SaveFormat)
			{
				return !base.GenCommentsFromToken;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void ContextPoped(LanguageElement oldContext)
		{
			CSharpContextPoped(oldContext);
			Alignment(oldContext, pushed: false);
			if (oldContext == base.Context)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (oldContext is ParentingStatement parentingStatement && !TokenCStatementCodeGenBase.NeedToAddBraces(parentingStatement, Options) && parentingStatement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Case)
			{
				if (parentingStatement.ElementType == LanguageElementType.UsingStatement && parentingStatement.NodeCount > 0)
				{
					foreach (LanguageElement node in parentingStatement.Nodes)
					{
						if (node.ElementType == LanguageElementType.UsingStatement)
						{
							if (Options.Indention.IndentNestedUsingStatements)
							{
								AddDecreaseIndent();
							}
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				if (Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents && parentingStatement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Do)
				{
					If obj = parentingStatement.PreviousCodeSibling as If;
					bool flag = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceElseStatementOnNewLine && !(parentingStatement.PreviousSibling is SupportElement);
					bool flag2 = obj != null && !obj.HasBlock;
					bool flag3 = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && obj != null && obj.NodeCount == 1 && parentingStatement.NodeCount == 1;
					if (parentingStatement.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Else || ((!(parentingStatement.FirstChild is If) || Options.LineBreaks.PlaceIfStatementFollowedByElseOnNewLine) && (flag || flag2 || DecreaseIndentInElseStatement(parentingStatement as Else)) && !flag3))
					{
						AddDecreaseIndent();
					}
				}
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = oldContext.ElementType;
			if (elementType == LanguageElementType.Case && Options.Indention.CaseStatementContents)
			{
				AddDecreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		private bool DecreaseIndentInElseStatement(Else elseSt)
		{
			if (elseSt == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (elseSt.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ElseIf)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TokenCStatementCodeGenBase.NeedToAddBraces(elseSt, Options))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine && base.Context.NodeCount == 1) || (base.Context.NextNode is If && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceIfStatementFollowedByElseOnNewLine))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
		}

		protected internal override void CalculateIndent(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.SourceFile)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (LanguageElement parent = element.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
			{
				switch (parent.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.Case:
					if (Options.Indention.CaseStatementContents)
					{
						base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Switch:
					if (Options.Indention.CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement)
					{
						base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
				case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
				case LanguageElementType.ObjectCollectionInitializer:
					if ((Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializers || Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializer) && Options.Indention.ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents)
					{
						base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression:
				case LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression:
					if (Options.Indention.AnonymousMethodContents)
					{
						base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					}
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.Else:
				{
					LanguageElement firstChild = parent.FirstChild;
					if ((firstChild == null || firstChild.ElementType != LanguageElementType.If || Options.LineBreaks.PlaceIfStatementFollowedByElseOnNewLine) && Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents && parent.NodeCount > 0)
					{
						base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					if (Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents && parent is IHasBlock && parent.NodeCount > 0)
					{
						base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ResetIndent()
		{
			base.Code.IndentLevel = 0;
		}

		public override void GenerateMemberVisibilitySpecifier(MemberVisibilitySpecifier specifier)
		{
			CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(base.MemberGen, specifier.MemberVisibility);
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (_FirstElement == null)
			{
				_FirstElement = element;
			}
			base.GenerateElement(element);
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeComma)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Dot:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeDot)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				CurlyBraceHelper.AddTokensBeforeOpen(formattingElements, this);
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose:
				CurlyBraceHelper.AddTokensBeforeClose(formattingElements, this);
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Semicolon:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeSemicolon && base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.For)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
			{
				LanguageElementType elementType = base.Context.ElementType;
				if (elementType != LanguageElementType.MethodCall && elementType != LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInInvocation)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				}
				else if (((IHasArguments)base.Context).ArgumentsCount > 0)
				{
					if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodCallWithArguments)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodCallWithoutArguments)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
			{
				LanguageElementType elementType2 = base.Context.ElementType;
				if (elementType2 == LanguageElementType.MethodCall || elementType2 == LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression)
				{
					if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeCloseBraceInInvocation)
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
					else if (Options.Spacing.WithinArgumentsListParentheses && ((IHasArguments)base.Context).ArgumentsCount > 0)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketClose:
				if (base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.AttributeSection && Options.Spacing.WithinSquareBrackets)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Ident:
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstMultiVariableDeclaration && base.Context is Variable { PreviousVariable: null, NextVariable: not null })
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			AddCharOperatorsToFormattingElements(tokenType, formattingElements);
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.TypeReferenceExpression)
				{
					TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = base.Context as TypeReferenceExpression;
					if (typeReferenceExpression.IsUnbound || typeReferenceExpression.IsArrayType)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (Options.Spacing.AfterComma && base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.EnumElement)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Dot:
				if (Options.Spacing.AfterDot)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen:
				CurlyBraceHelper.AddTokensAfterOpen(formattingElements, this);
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose:
				CurlyBraceHelper.AddTokensAfterClose(formattingElements, this);
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Semicolon:
				if (base.Context is PropertyAccessor && base.Context.Parent is Property property && ((Options.LineBreaks.PlaceAutoImplementedPropertyOnSingleLine && property.IsAutoImplemented) || (Options.LineBreaks.PlaceAbstractInterfaceMemberOnSingleLine && (property.IsAbstract || property.Parent is Interface))))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Internal:
			case FormattingTokenType.Private:
			case FormattingTokenType.Protected:
			case FormattingTokenType.Public:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
			{
				LanguageElementType elementType = base.Context.ElementType;
				if (elementType != LanguageElementType.MethodCall && elementType != LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (((IHasArguments)base.Context).ArgumentsCount > 0)
				{
					if (Options.Spacing.WithinArgumentsListParentheses)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.WithinEmptyArgumentsListParentheses)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				if ((base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.MethodCall || base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.MethodCallExpression) && Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInInvocation)
				{
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen:
				if (base.Context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.AttributeSection && Options.Spacing.WithinSquareBrackets)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			AddCharOperatorsToFormattingElements(tokenType, formattingElements);
			LanguageElementType elementType2 = base.Context.ElementType;
			if (elementType2 == LanguageElementType.Comment)
			{
				Comment comment = (Comment)base.Context;
				if (comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine && comment.Position != SupportElementPosition.Inside)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}
	public class CSharpDirectiveCodeGen : DirectiveCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSharpDirectiveCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Region && Options.BlankLines.InsideRegionDirectives) || (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.EndRegionDirective && Options.BlankLines.AroundRegionDirectives))
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLine(2);
				return true;
			}
			if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Region)
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.IfDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.ElifDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.DefineDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.UndefDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.LineDirective:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			int num = 0;
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.IfDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.ElseDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.ElifDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.EndIfDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.DefineDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.UndefDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.LineDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.ErrorDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.WarningDirective:
			case FormattingTokenType.PragmaDirective:
				num = 1;
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.RegionDirective:
				num = ((!Options.BlankLines.AroundRegionDirectives) ? 1 : 2);
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.EndRegionDirective:
				num = ((!Options.BlankLines.InsideRegionDirectives) ? 1 : 2);
				break;
			}
			bool flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Code.LastLine);
			switch (num)
			{
			case 1:
				if (!flag)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine(num);
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				if (flag)
				{
					num--;
					string[] array = base.Code.Code.Split('\n');
					if (array.Length > 1 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(array[array.Length - 2].Trim()))
					{
						num--;
					}
				}
				if (num > 0)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine(num);
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		protected override void GenerateDefineDirective(DefineDirective directive)
		{
			if (directive != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.DefineDirective);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateIfDirective(IfDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.IfDirective);
			Write(directive.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateElifDirective(ElifDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ElifDirective);
			Write(directive.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateElseDirective(ElseDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ElseDirective);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEndIfDirective(EndIfDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.EndIfDirective);
		}

		protected override void GenerateUndefDirective(UndefDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.UndefDirective);
			Write(directive.Symbol);
		}

		protected override void GenerateErrorDirective(ErrorDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ErrorDirective);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directive.Expression) && !base.SaveFormat)
			{
				CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.UserFormattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			Write(directive.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateWarningDirective(WarningDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.WarningDirective);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directive.Text) && !base.SaveFormat)
			{
				CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.UserFormattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			Write(directive.Text);
		}

		protected override void GeneratePragmaDirective(PragmaDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.PragmaDirective);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directive.Text) && !base.SaveFormat)
			{
				CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.UserFormattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			Write(directive.Text);
		}

		protected override void GenerateLineDirective(LineDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.LineDirective);
			if ((directive.Hidden || directive.Default || directive.LineNumber > 0) && !base.SaveFormat)
			{
				CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.UserFormattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			if (directive.Hidden)
			{
				Write("hidden");
				return;
			}
			if (directive.Default)
			{
				Write("default");
				return;
			}
			if (directive.LineNumber > 0)
			{
				Write(directive.LineNumber.ToString());
			}
			if (directive.FileName != null)
			{
				Write(" \"" + directive.FileName + "\"");
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateRegion(RegionDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.RegionDirective);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directive.Name) && !base.SaveFormat)
			{
				CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.UserFormattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEndRegion(EndRegionDirective directive)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.EndRegionDirective);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directive.Message) && !base.SaveFormat)
			{
				CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.UserFormattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			Write(directive.Message);
		}

		protected override void GenerateIfDefDirective(IfDefDirective directive)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateIfnDefDirective(IfnDefDirective directive)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateIncludeDirective(IncludeDirective directive)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateImportDirective(ImportDirective directive)
		{
		}
	}
	public class CSharpExpressionCodeGen : TokenCExpressionCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSharpExpressionCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Ident:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.AttributeVariableInitializer))
				{
					if (Options.Spacing.AfterColon)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				else if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ConditionalExpression) && Options.Spacing.AroundOneCharOperators)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Ampersand:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundUnsafeOperators)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeArgumentAngles && base.Context is ReferenceExpressionBase)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinCheckedUncheckedParentheses && (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.CheckedExpression) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.UncheckedExpression)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeofSizeofParentheses && (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.CheckedExpression) || ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.UncheckedExpression)))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.WithinDefaultParentheses && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.DefaultValueExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.As:
			case FormattingTokenType.Await:
			case FormattingTokenType.Equals:
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Is:
			case FormattingTokenType.OrderBy:
			case FormattingTokenType.Out:
			case FormattingTokenType.Ref:
			case FormattingTokenType.Stackalloc:
			case FormattingTokenType.By:
			case FormattingTokenType.From:
			case FormattingTokenType.Select:
			case FormattingTokenType.On:
			case FormattingTokenType.Where:
			case FormattingTokenType.Join:
			case FormattingTokenType.Into:
			case FormattingTokenType.Group:
			case FormattingTokenType.Let:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.EqualGreaterThen:
			{
				bool flag = base.Context.NodeCount > 0 && base.Context.Nodes[0] is Expression;
				bool flag2 = Options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousMethods && !flag;
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundLambdaExpressionOperator && !flag2)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Ident:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Question:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.TypeReferenceExpression) && Options.Spacing.BeforeNullableTypeOperator)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeArgumentAngles && base.Context is ReferenceExpressionBase)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeTypeArgumentAngles && base.Context is ReferenceExpressionBase)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.On:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeArrayRankBrackets)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.As:
			case FormattingTokenType.Equals:
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Is:
			case FormattingTokenType.By:
			case FormattingTokenType.Into:
			case FormattingTokenType.Ascending:
			case FormattingTokenType.Descending:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.AttributeVariableInitializer) && Options.Spacing.BeforeColon)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.EqualGreaterThen:
				if (Options.Spacing.AroundLambdaExpressionOperator)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		protected override void GenerateAddressOfExpression(AddressOfExpression expression)

			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ampersand);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);

		protected override void GenerateAttributeVariableInitializer(AttributeVariableInitializer expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			if (base.Context.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
		}

		protected override void GenerateMarkupExtensionExpression(MarkupExtensionExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			if (expression.Qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Qualifier);
			}
			base.Code.Write(" ");
			if (expression.ArgumentCount > 0)
			{
				GenerateExpressionList(expression.Arguments, " ");
			}
			if (expression.InitializerCount > 0)
			{
				if (expression.ArgumentCount > 0)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
				GenerateExpressionList(expression.Initializers);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateGenericTypeArguments(TypeReferenceExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.LessThan);
			GenerateExpressionList(arguments);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen);
		}

		private void GenerateJoinExpressionBase(JoinExpressionBase expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Join);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.InExpression);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.On);
				if (expression.EqualsExpressions != null && expression.EqualsExpressions.Count != 0)
				{
					GenerateExpressionList(expression.EqualsExpressions, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateArrayCreateExpression(ArrayCreateExpression expression)
		{
			if (!expression.IsStackAlloc)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.New);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Stackalloc);
			}
			TypeReferenceExpression baseType = expression.BaseType;
			bool flag = baseType?.IsArrayType ?? false;
			int num = -1;
			if (expression.Dimensions != null)
			{
				num = expression.Dimensions.Count;
			}
			bool flag2 = expression.Dimensions != null && expression.Dimensions.Count > 0;
			if (num > 0 && flag)
			{
				GenerateArrayCreateWithDimensionsAndBaseArrayType(expression, baseType);
			}
			else
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(baseType);
				if (!flag)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
					}
					GenerateExpressionList(expression.Dimensions);
					if (flag)
					{
						Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
				}
			}
			Expression initializer = expression.Initializer;
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(initializer);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateArrayCreateWithDimensionsAndBaseArrayType(ArrayCreateExpression expression, TypeReferenceExpression baseType)
		{
			if (baseType != null && expression != null)
			{
				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression = baseType.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression;
				TypeReferenceExpression typeReferenceExpression2 = null;
				while (typeReferenceExpression.BaseType != null && typeReferenceExpression.BaseType.IsArrayType)
				{
					typeReferenceExpression = typeReferenceExpression.BaseType;
				}
				typeReferenceExpression2 = typeReferenceExpression.BaseType;
				typeReferenceExpression.BaseType = null;
				typeReferenceExpression.Rank = typeReferenceExpression.Rank;
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(typeReferenceExpression2);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
				GenerateExpressionList(expression.Dimensions);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(typeReferenceExpression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateObjectCreationExpression(ObjectCreationExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.New);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.ObjectType);
				Expression objectInitializer = expression.ObjectInitializer;
				ExpressionCollection arguments = expression.Arguments;
				if ((arguments != null && arguments.Count != 0) || objectInitializer == null || !expression.ParensRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.Arguments, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
				}
				if (objectInitializer != null)
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(objectInitializer);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethodCallExpression(MethodCallExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Qualifier);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(expression.Arguments, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateArgumentDirection(ArgumentDirection direction)
		{
			switch (direction)
			{
			case ArgumentDirection.Out:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Out);
				break;
			case ArgumentDirection.Ref:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ref);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateArgumentDirectionExpression(ArgumentDirectionExpression expression)
		{
			GenerateArgumentDirection(expression.Direction);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
		}

		protected override void GenerateBaseReferenceExpression(BaseReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Base);
		}

		protected override void GenerateCheckedExpression(CheckedExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Checked);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateBooleanLiteral(bool value)
		{
			if (value)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.True);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.False);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsEscapedString(string value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value.StartsWith("@\""))
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (value[i])
				{
				case '\0':
				case '\t':
				case '\n':
				case '\r':
				case '\\':
				case '\u2028':
				case '\u2029':
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void GenerateStringLiteral(string value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value.Length == 0)
				{
					Write("\"\"");
					return;
				}
				string text = ReplaceEscapeChars(value);
				Write("\"" + text + "\"");
			}
		}

		protected override bool GenerateSpecificExpression(Expression expression)
		{
			switch (expression.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.LambdaFunctionExpression:
				GenerateLambdaExpression(expression as LambdaExpression);
				return true;
			case LanguageElementType.AwaitExpression:
				GenerateAwaitExpression(expression as AwaitExpression);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAwaitExpression(AwaitExpression awaitExpression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Await);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(awaitExpression.SourceExpression);
		}

		private string ReplaceEscapeChars(string value)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(ReplaceChar(value[i]));
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private string ReplaceChar(char c)
		{
			return c switch
			{
				'\0' => "\\0", 
				'\t' => "\\t", 
				'\r' => "\\r", 
				'\n' => "\\n", 
				'\u2028' => "\\u2028", 
				'\u2029' => "\\u2029", 
				'\\' => "\\\\", 
				_ => c.ToString(), 
			};
		}

		protected override void GenerateCharLiteral(char value)
		{
			if (value == '\0')
			{
				Write("'\\0'");
				return;
			}
			string text = ReplaceChar(value);
			Write("'" + text + "'");
		}

		protected override void GenerateNullLiteral()
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Null);
		}

		protected override void GenerateNumberLiteral(string name, object value, PrimitiveType type)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				Write(name);
				return;
			}
			string stringValue = GetStringValue(value);
			if (stringValue != null)
			{
				stringValue += CSharpPrimitiveTypeUtils.GetTypeSuffix(value, type);
				Write(stringValue);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeOfExpression(TypeOfExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.TypeOf);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TypeReference);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeReferenceExpression(TypeReferenceExpression expression)
		{
			base.GenerateTypeReferenceExpression(expression);
			if (expression.IsUnbound)
			{
				int typeArity = expression.TypeArity;
				Write(FormattingTokenType.LessThan);
				for (int i = 0; i < typeArity - 1; i++)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma, i);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen);
			}
			if (expression.IsNullable)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Question);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateUncheckedExpression(UncheckedExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Unchecked);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeOfIsExpression(TypeOfIsExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null && expression.Expression != null && expression.TypeReference != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Is);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.TypeReference);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateTypeCheck(TypeCheck expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Is);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
		}

		protected override void GenerateConditionalTypeCast(ConditionalTypeCast expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.As);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);

			Write(FormattingTokenType.Default);

			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateNullCoalescingExpression(NullCoalescingExpression expression)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.QuestionQuestion);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
		}

		protected override void GenerateQualifiedAliasExpression(QualifiedAliasExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression.IsGlobal)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Global);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ColonColon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateReferenceExpressionBase(ReferenceExpressionBase expression, string delimiter)
		{
			Expression qualifier = expression.Qualifier;
			if (qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(qualifier);
				if (qualifier.ElementType != LanguageElementType.QualifiedAliasExpression)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Dot);
				}
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (expression.IsGeneric)
			{
				GenerateGenericTypeArguments(expression.TypeArguments);
			}
		}

		protected override void GeneratePointerElementReference(PointerElementReference expression)
		{
			Expression qualifier = expression.Qualifier;
			if (qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(qualifier);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.MinusGreaterThen);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (expression.IsGeneric)
			{
				GenerateGenericTypeArguments(expression.TypeArguments);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateMemberInitializerExpression(MemberInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Value);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateObjectInitializerExpression(ObjectInitializerExpression expression)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(expression.Initializers, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateLambdaExpression(LambdaExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (expression.IsAsynchronous)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Async);
			}
			if (expression.ParameterCount > 0)
			{
				bool flag = !expression.ParamOpenRange.IsEmpty && !expression.ParamCloseRange.IsEmpty;
				if (expression.ParameterCount > 1 || flag || !(expression.Parameters[0] is LambdaImplicitlyTypedParam))
				{
					GenerateParameters(expression.Parameters);
				}
				else
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Parameters[0]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.EqualGreaterThen);
			if (expression.NodeCount > 0 && expression.Nodes[0] is Expression)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Nodes[0] as LanguageElement);
				return;
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(expression.Nodes);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateFromExpression(FromExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.From);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.InExpressions, FormattingTokenType.Comma, null);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateJoinExpression(JoinExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				GenerateJoinExpressionBase(expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateJoinIntoExpression(JoinIntoExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				GenerateJoinExpressionBase(expression);
				if (expression.IntoElements != null && expression.IntoElements.Count != 0)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Into);
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.IntoElements, FormattingTokenType.Comma, null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateEqualsExpression(EqualsExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null && expression.LeftSide != null && expression.RightSide != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.LeftSide);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equals);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.RightSide);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateQueryExpression(QueryExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				FormattingTokenType delimiter = ((!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapQueryExpression && !base.SaveFormat && !Options.General.KeepExistingWhiteSpace) ? FormattingTokenType.WhiteSpace : FormattingTokenType.None);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.DetailNodes, delimiter);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateLetExpression(LetExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Let);
				if (expression.Declarations != null && expression.Declarations.Count != 0)
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.Declarations, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateWhereExpression(WhereExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Where);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.WhereClause);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateOrderingExpression(OrderingExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Ordering);
				switch (expression.Order)
				{
				case OrderingType.Ascending:
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Ascending);
					break;
				default:
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Descending);
					break;
				case OrderingType.Default:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateOrderByExpression(OrderByExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.OrderBy);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.Orderings, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateSelectExpression(SelectExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Select);
				if (expression.ReturnedElements != null && expression.ReturnedElements.Count != 0)
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(expression.ReturnedElements, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateGroupByExpression(GroupByExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Group);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.GroupList, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.By);
				GenerateElementCollection(expression.ByList, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateIntoExpression(IntoExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Into);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.IntoTarget);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateInExpression(InExpression expression)
		{
			if (expression != null)
			{
				if (expression.QueryIdent != null)
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.QueryIdent);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.In);
				}
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression.Expression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateDistinctExpression(DistinctExpression expression)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateExpressionList(ExpressionCollectionBase expressions)
		{
			GenerateExpressionList(expressions, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is ConditionalExpression) || !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTernaryExpression)
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class CSharpMemberCodeGen : MemberCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSharpMemberCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		private bool CanGenerateMethodVisibility(Method method)
		{
			if (method == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (method.IsConstructor)
			{
				return !method.IsStatic;
			}
			if (method.IsDestructor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanGenerateVarType(Variable var)
		{
			if (var == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CodeGen.GetPrevContext() is UsingStatement { Initializers: not null } usingStatement)
			{
				return usingStatement.Initializers.IndexOf(var) < 1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string RemoveTags(string str)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(str))
			{
				return str;
			}
			str = str.Replace("«Caret»", "");
			str = str.Replace("«BlockAnchor»", "");
			return str;
		}

		private void GenerateArgumentDirection(ArgumentDirection ad)
		{
			switch (ad)
			{
			case ArgumentDirection.In:
				break;
			case ArgumentDirection.Out:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Out);
				break;
			case ArgumentDirection.Ref:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ref);
				break;
			case ArgumentDirection.ParamArray:
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Params);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void GenerateBaseVariable(Variable var)
		{
			if (var.PreviousVariable == null)
			{
				CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(this);
				if (var.IsConst)
				{
					CodeGenHelper.GenerateAccessSpecifiers(this);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Const);
				}
				else
				{
					CodeGenHelper.GenerateAccessSpecifiers(this);
				}
				if (var.IsFixedSizeBuffer)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Fixed);
				}
				if (var.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ImplicitVariable)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Var);
				}
				else if (CanGenerateVarType(var))
				{
					GenerateMemberType(var);
				}
				if (var.NextVariable != null)
				{
					bool needIncreaseAlignment = Options.WrappingAlignment.AlignWithFirstMultiVariableDeclarationItem && !Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstMultiVariableDeclaration;
					CodeGen.TokenGen.NeedIncreaseAlignment = needIncreaseAlignment;
				}
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
		}

		private void GenerateMemberType(Member member)
		{
			if (member == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TypeReferenceExpression elementType = ParserUtils.GetElementType(member);
			if (elementType != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(elementType);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(member.Name))
				{
					CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
				}
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(member.MemberType))
			{
				Write(member.MemberType);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(member.Name))
				{
					CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
				}
			}
			else if (member is BaseVariable)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Object);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Void);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateMethodName()
		{
			if (base.Context is Method { Name: var name } method)
			{
				string text = RemoveTags(name);
				if (!text.StartsWith("~") && method.MethodType == MethodTypeEnum.Destructor)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Tilde);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateOverloadOperatorSignature(Method method)
		{
			if (method.IsExplicitCast)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Explicit);
			}
			else if (method.IsImplicitCast)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Implicit);
			}
			else
			{
				GenerateMemberType(method);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Operator);
			if (method.IsExplicitCast || method.IsImplicitCast)
			{
				GenerateMemberType(method);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(CSharpOperatorHelper.GetOperatorToken(method.OverloadsOperator));
			}
		}

		private void GenerateMethodParameters(Method method)
		{
			if (method.IsGeneric)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(method.GenericModifier);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(method.Parameters, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			if (method.IsGeneric)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(method.GenericModifier);
			}
		}

		private void GenetateVarTail(Variable var)
		{
			if (!var.IsDetailNode)
			{
				if (var.NextVariable == null)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
				}
				else
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateInitializedVolatile(InitializedVolatile var)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateConstVolatile(ConstVolatile member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateVolatile(Volatile member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethodPrototype(MethodPrototype member)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethod(Method method)
		{
			if ((method.Parent == null || method.Parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Interface) && CanGenerateMethodVisibility(method))
			{
				CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(this);
			}
			CodeGenHelper.GenerateAccessSpecifiers(this);
			MethodTypeEnum methodType = method.MethodType;
			if (method.IsClassOperator)
			{
				GenerateOverloadOperatorSignature(method);
			}
			else
			{
				if (methodType == MethodTypeEnum.Function || methodType == MethodTypeEnum.Void)
				{
					GenerateMemberType(method);
				}
				GenerateMethodName();
			}
			GenerateMethodParameters(method);
			if (method.IsAbstract || (method.Parent != null && method.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Interface) || !method.GenerateCodeBlock || method.IsExtern)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
				return;
			}
			if (methodType == MethodTypeEnum.Constructor && method.HasInitializer)
			{
				bool codeBlockContents = CodeGen.Options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
				if (codeBlockContents)
				{
					base.Code.IncreaseIndent();
				}
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(method.Initializer);
				if (codeBlockContents)
				{
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(method.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None, false, LanguageElementType.ConstructorInitializer);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEvent(Event member)
		{
			if (member.Parent == null || member.Parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Interface)
			{
				CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(this);
				CodeGenHelper.GenerateAccessSpecifiers(this);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Event);
			GenerateMemberType(member);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (member.Initializer != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(member.Initializer);
			}
			if (member.Adder != null || member.Remover != null)
			{
				if (member.IsAbstract || (member.Parent != null && member.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Interface))
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
					return;
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(member.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateProperty(Property property)
		{
			if (property.Parent == null || property.Parent.ElementType != LanguageElementType.Interface)
			{
				CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(this);
				CodeGenHelper.GenerateAccessSpecifiers(this);
			}
			GenerateMemberType(property);
			if (property.IsIndexed)
			{
				if (property.ImplementsExpressions != null)
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(property.ImplementsExpressions, FormattingTokenType.Dot);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Dot);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.This);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(property.Parameters, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
			}
			else
			{
				ExpressionCollection implementsExpressions = property.ImplementsExpressions;
				if (implementsExpressions != null && implementsExpressions.Count > 0)
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(implementsExpressions, FormattingTokenType.Dot);
				}
				else
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				}
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
			if (property.IsAutoImplemented && !property.HasGetter)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Get);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
			GenerateElementCollection(property.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
			if (property.IsAutoImplemented && !property.HasSetter)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Set);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
		}

		protected override void GenerateDelegate(DelegateDefinition member)
		{
			CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(this);
			CodeGenHelper.GenerateAccessSpecifiers(this);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Delegate);
			GenerateMemberType(member);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (member.IsGeneric)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(member.GenericModifier);
			}
			GenerateParameters(member.Parameters);
			if (member.IsGeneric)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(member.GenericModifier);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateConst(Const var)
		{
			GenerateBaseVariable(var);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(var.Value);
			GenetateVarTail(var);
		}

		protected override void GenerateVariable(Variable var)
		{
			if (var != null)
			{
				GenerateBaseVariable(var);
				if (var.IsFixedSizeBuffer)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(var.FixedSize);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.BracketClose);
				}
				GenetateVarTail(var);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateInitializedVariable(InitializedVariable var)
		{
			if (var != null)
			{
				GenerateBaseVariable(var);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(var.Expression);
				GenetateVarTail(var);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateParameter(Param param)
		{
			GenerateArgumentDirection(param.Direction);
			GenerateMemberType(param);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (param.IsOptional)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(param.DefaultValueExpression);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateEnumElement(EnumElement element)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (element.ValueExpression != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(element.ValueExpression);
			}
			if (element.NextSibling == null && element.HasComma)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateImplicitVariable(ImplicitVariable member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				GenerateBaseVariable(member);
				Expression expression = member.Expression;
				if (expression != null)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(expression);
				}
				GenetateVarTail(member);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateExtensionMethodParam(ExtensionMethodParam member)
		{
			GenerateArgumentDirection(member.Direction);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.This);
			GenerateMemberType(member);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
		}

		protected override void GenerateLambdaImplicitlyTypedParam(LambdaImplicitlyTypedParam member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateQueryIdent(QueryIdent member)
		{
			if (member != null)
			{
				if (member.MemberTypeReference != null)
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(member.MemberTypeReference);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				if (member.Expression != null)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(member.Expression);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateMultiVars(Variable var)
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			while (var != null)
			{
				languageElementCollection.Add(var);
				var = var.NextVariable;
			}
			GenerateElementCollection(languageElementCollection, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
		}

		public override void GenerateGenericModifier(GenericModifier generic)
		{
			if (generic == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ElementWasGenerated(generic))
			{
				if (CodeGenHelper.HasTypeParameterConstraints(generic))
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(generic.TypeParameters, FormattingTokenType.None);
				}
				RemoveGeneratedElement(generic);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.LessThan);
				GenerateElementCollection(generic.TypeParameters, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen);
				AddGeneratedElement(generic);
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateTypeParameter(TypeParameter parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ElementWasGenerated(parameter))
			{
				if (CodeGenHelper.HasTypeParameterConstraints(parameter))
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Where, CodeGen.Contexts.Count - 3, 0, null);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon, CodeGen.Contexts.Count - 3, 0, null);
					GenerateElementCollection(parameter.Constraints, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
					RemoveGeneratedElement(parameter);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (parameter.Direction == TypeParameterDirection.In)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.In);
				}
				else if (parameter.Direction == TypeParameterDirection.Out)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Out);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				AddGeneratedElement(parameter);
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateTypeParameterConstraint(TypeParameterConstraint constraint)
		{
			if (constraint != null)
			{
				switch (constraint.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.ClassTypeParameterConstraint:
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Class);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.StructTypeParameterConstraint:
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Struct);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.NewTypeParameterConstraint:
					Write(FormattingTokenType.New);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
					Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.NamedTypeParameterConstraint:
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(((NamedTypeParameterConstraint)constraint).TypeReference);
					break;
				default:
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateTypeParameterCollection(TypeParameterCollection collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int count = collection.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(collection[i]);
				if (i < collection.Count - 1)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Comma);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		public override bool IsMemberGenElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is Member || element is GenericModifier || element is TypeParameter || element is TypeParameterConstraint)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (!(element is Member { IsDetailNode: false } member))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (member.Parent != null)
			{
				LanguageElementType elementType = member.Parent.ElementType;
				if ((elementType == LanguageElementType.Class || elementType == LanguageElementType.Interface || elementType == LanguageElementType.Struct) && member.NextSibling != null)
				{
					bool flag = (int)member.Range.LineCount > 1;
					bool flag2 = Options.BlankLines.AfterMultiLineMembers && flag;
					bool flag3 = Options.BlankLines.AfterSingleLineMembers && !flag;
					if (flag2 || flag3)
					{
						CodeGen.AddNewLine(2);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.EnumElement)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is Variable { NextVariable: not null })
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement nextSibling = element.NextSibling;
			if (nextSibling == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			return true;
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Ident:
				if (base.Context is QueryIdent { MemberTypeReference: not null })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Where:
				if (!(base.Context.Parent is GenericModifier { DetailNodeCount: not 0 } genericModifier))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (genericModifier.DetailNodes.IndexOf(base.Context) == 0)
				{
					if (!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstTypeParameterConstraint)
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				else if (!Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapTypeParameterConstraints)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.BracketOpen:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpenSquareBracket)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeComma)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
				if (Options.Spacing.BeforeTypeParameterAngles)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.GreaterThen:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeParameterAngles)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (base.Context is TypeParameter && Options.Spacing.BeforeTypeParameterConstraintColon)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Base:
			case FormattingTokenType.This:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.ConstructorInitializer) && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceConstructorInitializerOnSameLine)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
			{
				if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Method))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInDeclaration)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					IncreaseIndent();
					break;
				}
				bool flag2 = ((Method)base.Context).ParameterCount > 0;
				if ((Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodWithParameters && flag2) || (Options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningParenthesisOfAMethodWithoutParameters && !flag2))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
			{
				if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Method))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeCloseBraceInDeclaration)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					break;
				}
				bool flag = ((Method)base.Context).ParameterCount > 0;
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinMethodDeclarationParentheses && flag)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Abstract:
			case FormattingTokenType.Async:
			case FormattingTokenType.Delegate:
			case FormattingTokenType.Event:
			case FormattingTokenType.Explicit:
			case FormattingTokenType.Extern:
			case FormattingTokenType.Fixed:
			case FormattingTokenType.Implicit:
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Object:
			case FormattingTokenType.Operator:
			case FormattingTokenType.Out:
			case FormattingTokenType.Override:
			case FormattingTokenType.Params:
			case FormattingTokenType.ReadOnly:
			case FormattingTokenType.Ref:
			case FormattingTokenType.Sealed:
			case FormattingTokenType.Static:
			case FormattingTokenType.Unsafe:
			case FormattingTokenType.Var:
			case FormattingTokenType.Virtual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Void:
			case FormattingTokenType.Volatile:
			case FormattingTokenType.Partial:
			case FormattingTokenType.Where:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.LessThan:
				if (Options.Spacing.WithinTypeParameterAngles)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.New:
				if (!ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.NewTypeParameterConstraint))
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (base.Context is TypeParameter && Options.Spacing.AfterTypeParameterConstraintColon)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.This:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ExtensionMethodParam)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Method))
				{
					bool flag = ((Method)base.Context).ParameterCount > 0;
					if ((Options.Spacing.WithinMethodDeclarationParentheses && flag) || (Options.Spacing.WithinEmptyMethodDeclarationParentheses && !flag))
					{
						formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
					}
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.ParenClose:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Method) && Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeOpenBraceInDeclaration)
				{
					base.Code.DecreaseIndent();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Const:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}
	public class CSharpNamespaceGen : NamespaceGenBase
	{
		public CSharpNamespaceGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		protected override void GenerateNamespace(Namespace element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Namespace);
				string name = element.Name;
				string[] array = name.Split('.');
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident, array.Length - 1);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(element.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
				if (element.HasEndingSemicolon)
				{
					Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
				}
			}
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			if (tokenType == FormattingTokenType.Namespace)
			{
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}
	public class CSharpNamespaceReferenceGen : NamespaceReferenceGenBase
	{
		public CSharpNamespaceReferenceGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Extern:
			case FormattingTokenType.Using:
			case FormattingTokenType.Alias:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Semicolon:
				if (base.Context is NamespaceReference { NextSibling: not null } namespaceReference)
				{
					if (!Options.BlankLines.AfterImportedNamespacesSection || namespaceReference.NextSibling is NamespaceReference)
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine();
					}
					else
					{
						formattingElements.AddNewLine(2);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		protected override void GenerateExternAlias(ExternAlias element)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Extern);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Alias);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateNamespaceReference(NamespaceReference element)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Using);
			LanguageElement languageElement = element.FirstDetail;
			if (element.IsAlias)
			{
				if (element.AliasExpression != null)
				{
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(element.AliasExpression);
				}
				else
				{
					Write(element.AliasName);
				}
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Equal);
				if (element.DetailNodeCount > 1)
				{
					languageElement = element.DetailNodes[1] as LanguageElement;
				}
			}
			if (languageElement != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}
	}
	public class CSharpSnippetCodeGen : TokenCSnippetCodeGen
