	public class CSharpStatementCodeGen : TokenCStatementCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSharpStatementCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement statement)
		{
			if (!(statement is Statement { NextSibling: var nextSibling } statement2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (nextSibling == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (statement2.ElementType == LanguageElementType.If && (nextSibling.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Else || nextSibling.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ElseIf))
			{
				if (statement2.NodeCount < 2 && CodeGen.Options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine)
				{
					CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
					return true;
				}
				if (!CodeGen.Options.LineBreaks.PlaceElseStatementOnNewLine)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (statement2 is PropertyAccessor && statement2.Parent is Property property)
			{
				if (property.IsAbstract || property.IsAutoImplemented)
				{
					return true;
				}
				LanguageElement parent = property.Parent;
				if (parent != null && parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Interface)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (statement2 is Try)
			{
				if (nextSibling is Catch && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceCatchStatementOnNewLine)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (nextSibling is Finally && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceFinallyStatementOnNewLine)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (statement2 is Catch && nextSibling is Finally && !Options.LineBreaks.PlaceFinallyStatementOnNewLine)
			{
				return true;
			}
			CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
			return true;
		}

		private void GenerateEventAccessorStatement(EventAccessor statement, FormattingTokenType keyword)
		{
			if (!(statement.Parent is Event obj))
			{
				return;
			}
			Interface obj2 = statement.GetParentClassInterfaceOrStruct() as Interface;
			if (obj.IsAbstract || obj2 != null)
			{
				Write(keyword);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
				return;
			}
			Write(keyword);
			if (statement.GenerateCodeBlock)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
			if (statement.HasEndingSemicolon)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
		}

		private void GeneratePropertyAccessorStatement(PropertyAccessor statement, FormattingTokenType keyword)
		{
			Property property = statement.Parent as Property;
			Interface obj = statement.GetParentClassInterfaceOrStruct() as Interface;
			if (property == null || property.Visibility != statement.Visibility)
			{
				CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(this, statement.Visibility);
			}
			Write(keyword);
			if ((property != null && (property.IsAbstract || property.IsAutoImplemented)) || obj != null)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
				return;
			}
			if (statement.GenerateCodeBlock)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(statement.Nodes);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
			if (statement.HasEndingSemicolon)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateThrowStatement(Throw statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Throw);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateCheckedStatement(Checked statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Checked);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateUncheckedStatement(Unchecked statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Unchecked);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateFixedStatement(Fixed statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Fixed);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateLockStatement(Lock statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Lock);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.DetailNodes, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			GenerateBlockStatementContents(statement);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEventAddStatement(EventAdd statement)
		{
			GenerateEventAccessorStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.Add);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEventRemoveStatement(EventRemove statement)
		{
			GenerateEventAccessorStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.Remove);
		}

		protected override void GeneratePropertyAccessorGetStatement(Get statement)
		{
			GeneratePropertyAccessorStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.Get);
		}

		protected override void GeneratePropertyAccessorSetStatement(Set statement)
		{
			GeneratePropertyAccessorStatement(statement, FormattingTokenType.Set);
		}

		protected override void GenerateStatementStatement(Statement statement)
		{
			if (statement.Name == ";")
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
			else
			{
				base.GenerateStatementStatement(statement);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateWithStatement(With statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateEventRaiseStatement(EventRaise statement)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateRaiseEventStatement(RaiseEvent statement)
		{
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateYieldBreakStatement(YieldBreak statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Yield);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Break);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateYieldReturnStatement(YieldReturn statement)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Yield);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Return);
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Expression);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateConstructorInitializer(ConstructorInitializer initializer)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
			if (initializer.IsBase)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Base);
			}
			else
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.This);
			}
			GenerateParameters(initializer.Arguments);
		}

		protected override void GenerateMethodCallStatement(MethodCall statement)
		{
			if (statement.Qualifier != null)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(statement.Qualifier);
			}
			else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(statement.Name))
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenOpen);
			GenerateElementCollection(statement.Arguments, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.ParenClose);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Yield:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Throw:
				if (base.Context is Throw { Expression: not null })
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (base.Context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.ConstructorInitializer)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}
	public class CSharpSupportElementCodeGen : TokenSupportElementCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSharpSupportElementCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateCppAttribute(CppAttributeSection element)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		protected override bool HasSameLineRange(Comment com, SupportElementPosition possiblePosition)
		{
			if (com == null || com.Position != possiblePosition)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(com.TargetNode is CodeElement target))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return SupportElementCodeGenBase.HasSameLineRange(target, com);
		}

		protected override void GenerateElementComment(CodeElement codeElement, SupportElementPosition position)
		{
			if (codeElement == null || codeElement.Comments == null || codeElement.CommentCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Comment comment = null;
			CommentCollection comments = codeElement.Comments;
			int commentCount = codeElement.CommentCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < commentCount; i++)
			{
				comment = comments[i];
				if (!CodeGen.TokenArgsContainsElement(comment) && comment.Position == position && comment.TargetNode == codeElement && !CodeGen.IsSkipped(comment))
				{
					if (HasSameLineRange(comment, SupportElementPosition.After))
					{
						CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
					}
					CodeGen.GenerateElement(comment);
					if (HasSameLineRange(comment, SupportElementPosition.Before))
					{
						CodeGen.AddWSIfNeeded();
					}
					CodeGen.AddSkipped(comment);
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is Comment { CommentType: CommentType.SingleLine } && !CodeGen.GeneratingInSupportElement)
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class CSharpTypeDeclarationCodeGen : TypeDeclarationCodeGenBase
	{
		public CSharpTypeDeclarationCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		private FormattingTokenType GetDeclarationType(TypeDeclaration type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return FormattingTokenType.None;
			}
			return type.ElementType switch
			{
				LanguageElementType.Class => FormattingTokenType.Class, 
				LanguageElementType.Interface => FormattingTokenType.Interface, 
				LanguageElementType.Struct => FormattingTokenType.Struct, 
				LanguageElementType.Enum => FormattingTokenType.Enum, 
				_ => FormattingTokenType.None, 
			};
		}

		private void GenerateUnderlyingType(Enumeration enumeration)
		{
			string underlyingType = enumeration.UnderlyingType;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(underlyingType))
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
				Write(underlyingType);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateAncestorTypes(TypeDeclaration type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (type.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Enum)
			{
				GenerateUnderlyingType((Enumeration)type);
			}
			else if (type.PrimaryAncestorType != null || type.SecondaryAncestorTypes.Count != 0)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Colon);
				LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
				if (type.PrimaryAncestorType != null)
				{
					languageElementCollection.Add(type.PrimaryAncestorType);
				}
				languageElementCollection.AddRange(type.SecondaryAncestorTypes);
				GenerateElementCollection(languageElementCollection, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
			}
		}

		private void GenerateType(TypeDeclaration type)
		{
			GenerateType(type, FormattingTokenType.None);
		}

		private void GenerateType(TypeDeclaration type, FormattingTokenType delimiter)
		{
			if (type.Visibility == MemberVisibility.Illegal && type.IsDefaultVisibility)
			{
				MemberVisibility memberVisibility = ((type.Parent is TypeDeclaration) ? MemberVisibility.Private : MemberVisibility.Internal);
			}
			CodeGenHelper.GenerateVisibility(this);
			CodeGenHelper.GenerateAccessSpecifiers(this);
			Write(GetDeclarationType(type));
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			if (type.IsGeneric)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(type.GenericModifier);
			}
			GenerateAncestorTypes(type);
			if (type.IsGeneric)
			{
				CodeGen.GenerateElement(type.GenericModifier);
			}
			if (type.GenerateBlock)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceOpen);
				GenerateElementCollection(type.Nodes, delimiter);
				Write(FormattingTokenType.CurlyBraceClose);
			}
			if (type.HasEndingSemicolon)
			{
				Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateModuleDeclaration(Module type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateClassDeclaration(Class type)
		{
			GenerateType(type);
		}

		protected override void GenerateStructDeclaration(Struct type)
		{
			GenerateType(type);
		}

		protected override void GenerateInterfaceDeclaration(Interface type)
		{
			GenerateType(type);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEnumDeclaration(Enumeration type)
		{
			GenerateType(type, FormattingTokenType.Comma);
		}

		protected override void GenerateUnionDeclaration(Union type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateManagedClassDeclaration(ManagedClass type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateManagedStructDeclaration(ManagedStruct type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateInterfaceClassDeclaration(InterfaceClass type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateInterfaceStructDeclaration(InterfaceStruct type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateValueClassDeclaration(ValueClass type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateValueStructDeclaration(ValueStruct type)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateMembers(NodeList nodeList)
		{
			GenerateElementCollection(nodeList);
		}

		public override FormattingElements PrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.PrevFormattingElements(tokenType);
			if (tokenType == FormattingTokenType.Colon && base.Context is TypeDeclaration)
			{
				if (Options.WrappingAlignment.WrapBeforeColonForAncestorsList)
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				else if (Options.Spacing.BeforeColonForAncestorsListInTypeDeclaration)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		public override FormattingElements NextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType tokenType)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = base.NextFormattingElements(tokenType);
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case FormattingTokenType.Abstract:
			case FormattingTokenType.Class:
			case FormattingTokenType.Enum:
			case FormattingTokenType.In:
			case FormattingTokenType.Interface:
			case FormattingTokenType.New:
			case FormattingTokenType.Out:
			case FormattingTokenType.Override:
			case FormattingTokenType.ReadOnly:
			case FormattingTokenType.Sealed:
			case FormattingTokenType.Static:
			case FormattingTokenType.Struct:
			case FormattingTokenType.Unsafe:
			case FormattingTokenType.Virtual:
			case FormattingTokenType.Volatile:
			case FormattingTokenType.Partial:
				formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Colon:
				if (Options.Spacing.AfterColonForAncestorsListInTypeDeclaration)
				{
					formattingElements.AddWhiteSpace();
				}
				break;
			case FormattingTokenType.Comma:
				if (ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.Enum))
				{
					formattingElements.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}
	}
	public class CSharpXmlCodeGen : XmlCodeGenBase
	{
		private const string STR_Prefix = "///";

		private bool _LastXMLTextIsEmpty;

		public CSharpXmlCodeGen(CodeGen codeGen)
			: base(codeGen)
		{
		}

		protected override void GenerateXmlPrefix()
		{
			base.Code.Write("///");
		}

		public override void GenerateElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				switch (element.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.XmlDocComment:
					GenerateXmlDocComment(element as XmlDocComment);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.XmlDocAttribute:
					GenerateXmlDocAttribute(element as XmlAttribute);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.XmlDocText:
					GenerateXmlDocText(element as XmlText);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.XmlCharacterData:
					GenerateXmlCharacterData(element as XmlCharacterData);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.XmlDocElement:
					GenerateXmlDocElement(element as XmlElement);
					break;
				case LanguageElementType.XmlReference:
					GenerateXmlReference(element as XmlReference);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void GenerateXmlReference(XmlReference xmlReference)
		{
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Ampersand);
			Write(xmlReference.Name);
			Write(FormattingTokenType.Semicolon);
		}

		protected override void GenerateXmlDocComment(XmlDocComment xmlComment)
		{
			if (xmlComment != null && !CodeGen.IsSkipped(xmlComment))
			{
				if (base.SaveFormat)
				{
					CodeGen.Code.IncreaseAlignment();
				}
				if (xmlComment.NodeCount == 0)
				{
					CodeGen.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.Reset();
					base.Code.Write(xmlComment.Name, split: false);
					CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
				}
				else
				{
					GenerateElementCollection(xmlComment.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
				}
				if (base.SaveFormat)
				{
					CodeGen.Code.DecreaseAlignment();
				}
				CodeGen.AddSkipped(xmlComment);
			}
		}

		protected override void GenerateXmlDocElement(XmlElement xmlDocElement)
		{
			if (xmlDocElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CodeWritePrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			GenerateXmlElementOpenTag(xmlDocElement);
			if (xmlDocElement.HasCloseTag)
			{
				GenerateElementCollection(xmlDocElement.Nodes, FormattingTokenType.None);
				GenerateXmlElementCloseTag(xmlDocElement);
				CodeWriteNextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				if (base.SaveFormat && (!(xmlDocElement.Parent is XmlDocComment) || xmlDocElement.NextCodeSibling != null))
				{
					CodeGen.Code.WriteLine();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NeedGenerateStartPrefixForOpenTag(XmlElement xmlDocElement)
		{
			if (xmlDocElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (xmlDocElement.Range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			LanguageElement prevContext = CodeGen.GetPrevContext();
			LanguageElement previousSibling = xmlDocElement.PreviousSibling;
			if (previousSibling != null)
			{
				if (previousSibling.Range.IsEmpty || previousSibling.EndLine != xmlDocElement.StartLine || (_LastXMLTextIsEmpty && previousSibling is XmlText))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (prevContext == null || prevContext is XmlDocComment || prevContext.Range.IsEmpty || prevContext.StartLine < xmlDocElement.StartLine)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void GenerateXmlElementOpenTag(XmlElement xmlDocElement)
		{
			if (xmlDocElement != null)
			{
				if (NeedGenerateStartPrefixForOpenTag(xmlDocElement))
				{
					GenerateXmlPrefix();
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write("<");
				base.Code.Write(xmlDocElement.Name);
				if (xmlDocElement.XmlAttributes != null && xmlDocElement.XmlAttributes.Count > 0)
				{
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				GenerateElementCollection(xmlDocElement.XmlAttributes, FormattingTokenType.None);
				if (xmlDocElement.HasCloseTag)
				{
					base.Code.Write(">");
				}
				else
				{
					base.Code.Write("/>");
				}
			}
		}

		private bool NeedGenerateStartPrefixForCloseTag(XmlElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElement lastChild = element.LastChild;
			if (lastChild != null)
			{
				if (lastChild.Range.End.Line == element.Range.End.Line || lastChild.Range.IsEmpty || element.Range.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (lastChild is XmlText)
					{
						return _LastXMLTextIsEmpty;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void GenerateXmlElementCloseTag(XmlElement xmlDocElement)
		{
			if (xmlDocElement != null)
			{
				if (NeedGenerateStartPrefixForCloseTag(xmlDocElement))
				{
					GenerateXmlPrefix();
					base.Code.Write(" ");
				}
				base.Code.Write("<");
				base.Code.Write("/");
				base.Code.Write(xmlDocElement.Name);
				base.Code.Write(">");
			}
		}

		private void GenerateXmlDocAttribute(XmlAttribute element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				CodeWritePrevFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
				base.Code.Write(element.Name);
				base.Code.Write("=");
				GenerateQuote();
				base.Code.Write(element.Value);
				GenerateQuote();
				CodeWriteNextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
			}
		}

		private bool ContainsValuableText(XmlText xmlDocText)
		{
			if (xmlDocText == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = xmlDocText.Text;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			text = text.Trim();
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text);
		}

		private void GenerateXmlCharacterData(XmlCharacterData xmlCharacterData)
		{
			if (xmlCharacterData != null)
			{
				base.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.Reset();
				string str = " <![CDATA[\r\n" + xmlCharacterData.Name + "]]>";
				GenerateXmlPrefix();
				WriteXmlString(str, xmlCharacterData);
			}
		}

		private void WriteXmlString(string str, LanguageElement element)
		{
			string[] array = StringHelper.SplitLines(str, removeLastIfEmpty: false);
			_LastXMLTextIsEmpty = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					base.Code.Write(array[i]);
					continue;
				}
				string text = array[i].TrimStart();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || i != array.Length - 1)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
					GenerateXmlPrefix();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						base.Code.Write(" " + text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_LastXMLTextIsEmpty = true;
					LanguageElement parent = element.Parent;
					if (!(parent is XmlDocComment) || parent.LastChild != element)
					{
						base.Code.WriteLine();
					}
				}
			}
			CodeWriteNextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
		}

		protected override void GenerateXmlDocText(XmlText xmlDocText)
		{
			if (xmlDocText == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.TokenGen.TokenGenArgs.Reset();
			string[] array = StringHelper.SplitLines(xmlDocText.Text, removeLastIfEmpty: false);
			_LastXMLTextIsEmpty = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i == 0)
				{
					base.Code.Write(array[i]);
					continue;
				}
				string text = array[i].TrimStart();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || i != array.Length - 1)
				{
					base.Code.WriteLine();
					GenerateXmlPrefix();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						base.Code.Write(" " + text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_LastXMLTextIsEmpty = true;
					LanguageElement parent = xmlDocText.Parent;
					if (!(parent is XmlDocComment) || parent.LastChild != xmlDocText)
					{
						base.Code.WriteLine();
					}
				}
			}
			CodeWriteNextFormattingElements(FormattingTokenType.Ident);
		}

		internal override bool IsXmlGenElement(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = element.ElementType;
			if (elementType != LanguageElementType.XmlDocComment && elementType != LanguageElementType.XmlDocElement && elementType != LanguageElementType.XmlDocAttribute && elementType != LanguageElementType.XmlDocText && elementType != LanguageElementType.XmlReference)
			{
				return elementType == LanguageElementType.XmlCharacterData;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void GenerateCode(CodeWriter writer, LanguageElement languageElement, bool calculateIndent)
		{
			if (writer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("writer");
			}
			if (CodeGen == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("CodeGen is Null");
			}
			PushCodeWriter();
			SetCodeWriter(writer);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				CalculateIndent(languageElement);
			}
			CodeGen.GenerateElement(languageElement);
			if (calculateIndent)
			{
				ResetIndent();
			}
			PopCodeWriter();
		}

		public override bool GenerateElementTail(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || !IsXmlGenElement(element))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element.ElementType == LanguageElementType.XmlDocElement && base.Context != null && ContextMatch(LanguageElementType.XmlDocComment))
			{
				CodeGen.AddNewLineIfNeeded();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private void Parser()
		{
			while (IsExternAliasDirective())
			{
				ExternAliasDirective();
			}
			while (la.Type == 78)
			{
				UsingDirective();
			}
			while (IsGlobalAttrTarget())
			{
				GlobalAttributes();
			}
			while (StartOf(1))
			{
				NamespaceMemberDeclaration();
			}
		}

		private void ExternAliasDirective()
		{
			SourceRange empty = SourceRange.Empty;
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			string empty2 = string.Empty;
			Expect(30);
			Expect(1);

		}

		private void ModifierListCore(ref AccessSpecifiers accessSpecifiers, ref MemberVisibility visibility, ref bool wasProtectedInternal, ref bool wasInternalProtected)
		{
			while (StartOf(24))
			{
				switch (la.Type)
				{
				case 48:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsNew = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetNewRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 56:
					Get();
					visibility = MemberVisibility.Public;
					accessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 55:
					Get();
					if (visibility == MemberVisibility.Internal && !wasInternalProtected)
					{
						visibility = MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal;
						accessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(GetRange(accessSpecifiers.VisibilityRange, tToken.Range));
						wasInternalProtected = true;
					}
					else if ((visibility != MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal) | wasInternalProtected)
					{
						visibility = MemberVisibility.Protected;
						wasInternalProtected = false;
						accessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(tToken.Range);
					}
					break;
				case 43:
					Get();
					if (visibility == MemberVisibility.Protected && !wasProtectedInternal)
					{
						visibility = MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal;
						accessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(GetRange(accessSpecifiers.VisibilityRange, tToken.Range));
						wasProtectedInternal = true;
					}
					else if ((visibility != MemberVisibility.ProtectedInternal) | wasProtectedInternal)
					{
						visibility = MemberVisibility.Internal;
						accessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(tToken.Range);
					}
					break;
				case 54:
					Get();
					visibility = MemberVisibility.Private;
					accessSpecifiers.SetVisibilityRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 76:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsUnsafe = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetUnsafeRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 65:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsStatic = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetStaticRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 57:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsReadOnly = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetReadOnlyRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 81:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsVolatile = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetVolatileRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 79:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsVirtual = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetVirtualRange(tToken.Range);
					accessSpecifiers.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 61:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsSealed = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetSealedRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 52:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsOverride = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetOverrideRange(tToken.Range);
					accessSpecifiers.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 8:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsAbstract = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetAbstractRange(tToken.Range);
					accessSpecifiers.SetVirtualOverrideAbstractRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				case 30:
					Get();
					accessSpecifiers.IsExtern = true;
					accessSpecifiers.SetExternRange(tToken.Range);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResolvedType(out TypeReferenceExpression type)

		private void StatementExpression()
		{
			Expression expression = null;
			Statement statement = null;
			NestedMethod nestedMethod = base.Context as NestedMethod;
			Token token = tToken;
			Expression(out expression);
			Expect(118);
			if (expression != null)
			{
				statement = ((expression is AssignmentExpression) ? Assignment.FromAssignmentExpression(expression as AssignmentExpression) : ((!(expression is MethodCallExpression)) ? DevExpress.CodeParser.Statement.FromExpression(expression) : MethodCall.FromMethodCallExpression(expression as MethodCallExpression)));
				statement.SetRange(GetRange(expression, tToken));
			}
			else if (tToken.Type == 118)
			{
				statement = new Statement(tToken.Value);
				statement.SetRange(tToken.Range);
			}
			else
			{
				Get();
			}
			if (token == tToken)
			{
				Get();
			}
			if (statement != null)
			{
				if (nestedMethod != null)
				{
					nestedMethod.AddNode(statement);
				}
				else
				{
					AddNode(statement);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SwitchSection()
		{
			SwitchLabel();
			while (la.Type == 14 || (la.Type == 22 && scanner.Peek().Type == 90))
			{
				SwitchLabel();
			}
			Statement();
			while (la.Type != 0 && IsNoSwitchLabelOrRBrace())
			{
				Token token = la;
				Statement();
				if (token == la)
				{
					Get();
				}
			}
			if (base.Context != null && base.Context is Case)
			{
				base.Context.SetRange(GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
				CloseContext();
			}
		}

		private void ForInitializer()
		{
			Expression expression = null;
			For obj = base.Context as For;

			}
			else if (StartOf(17))
			{
				Expression(out expression);
				if (obj != null && expression != null)
				{
					obj.Initializers.Add(expression);
					obj.AddDetailNode(expression);
				}
				while (la.Type == 91)
				{
					Get();
					Expression(out expression);
					if (obj != null && expression != null)
					{
						obj.Initializers.Add(expression);
						obj.AddDetailNode(expression);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(207);
			}
		}

		private void ForIterator()

					obj.Incrementors.Add(expression);
					obj.AddDetailNode(expression);
				}
			}
		}

		private void TryCatchFinallyBlock()
		{
			Expect(71);
			Try obj = new Try();
			OpenContext(obj);
			obj.SetRange(tToken.Range);
			BlockCore(isMethodBlock: false);
			CloseContextAndSetRange(obj);
			while (la.Type == 15 || la.Type == 32)

			{
				expression.AddDetailNode(type);
				type = null;
			}
			if (expression != null)
			{
				expression.SetRange(GetRange(range, tToken));
			}
		}

		private void CheckedUncheckedExpression(out Expression expression)
		{
			expression = null;
			Expression expression2 = null;
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			if (la.Type == 17)
			{
				Get();
				Expect(102);
				Expression(out expression2);
				Expect(117);
				expression = new CheckedExpression(expression2);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 75)
			{
				Get();
				Expect(102);
				Expression(out expression2);
				Expect(117);
				expression = new UncheckedExpression(expression2);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(230);
			}
			if (expression2 != null && expression != null)
			{
				expression.AddDetailNode(expression2);
				expression2 = null;
			}
			if (expression != null)
			{
				expression.SetRange(GetRange(range, tToken));
			}
		}

		private void RefValueArguments(out ExpressionCollection arguments)
		{
			arguments = new ExpressionCollection();
			Expression expression = null;
			TypeReferenceExpression type = null;
			Expression(out expression);
			Expect(91);
			Type(out type, ignoreTypeCastChecks: true);
			if (expression != null)
			{
				arguments.Add(expression);
			}
			if (type != null)
			{
				arguments.Add(type);
			}
		}

		private void ObjectInitializer(out Expression expression)
		{
			expression = new ObjectInitializerExpression();
			expression.SetRange(la.Range);
			Expect(100);
			if (StartOf(21))
			{
				MemberInitializerList(expression as ObjectInitializerExpression);
			}
			Expect(115);
			expression.SetRange(GetRange(expression, tToken));
		}

		private void MemberInitializerList(ObjectInitializerExpression objectInitializer)
		{
			Expression expression = null;
			MemberInitializerExpression(out expression);
			if (expression != null && objectInitializer != null)
			{
				objectInitializer.AddDetailNode(expression);
				objectInitializer.Initializers.Add(expression);
			}
			while (StartOf(32))
			{
				if (la.Type == 91)
				{
					Get();
				}
				MemberInitializerExpression(out expression);
				if (expression != null && objectInitializer != null)
				{
					objectInitializer.AddDetailNode(expression);
					objectInitializer.Initializers.Add(expression);
				}
			}
		}

		private void MemberInitializerExpression(out Expression expression)
		{
			expression = null;
			if (IsMemberInit())
			{
				MemberInitializer(out expression);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 100)
			{
				ObjectInitializer(out expression);
			}
			else if (StartOf(17))
			{
				Expression(out expression);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(231);
			}
			if (expression == null)
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		private void MemberInitializer(out Expression result)
		{
			MemberInitializerExpression memberInitializerExpression = (MemberInitializerExpression)(result = new MemberInitializerExpression());
			Expression expression = null;
			memberInitializerExpression.SetRange(la.Range);
			memberInitializerExpression.Name = la.Value;
			memberInitializerExpression.NameRange = la.Range;
			Expect(1);
			Expect(87);
			InitializerValue(out expression);
			if (memberInitializerExpression != null)
			{
				memberInitializerExpression.SetRange(GetRange(memberInitializerExpression, tToken));
				if (expression != null)
				{
					memberInitializerExpression.Value = expression;
					memberInitializerExpression.AddDetailNode(expression);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializerValue(out Expression expression)
		{
			expression = null;
			if (StartOf(17))
			{
				Expression(out expression);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 100)
			{
				ObjectInitializer(out expression);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(232);
			}
		}

		private void TypeArgDirection(out TypeParameterDirection typeArgumentDirection)
		{
			typeArgumentDirection = TypeParameterDirection.None;
			if (la.Type == 40 || la.Type == 51)
			{
				if (la.Type == 40)
				{
					Get();
					typeArgumentDirection = TypeParameterDirection.In;
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
					typeArgumentDirection = TypeParameterDirection.Out;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Parse()
		{
			PreparePreprocessor();
			Comments.Clear();
			base.TextStrings.Clear();
			Regions.Clear();
			FirstGet();
			Parser();
			if (base.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				while (la != null && la.Type != 0)
				{
					Get();
				}
			}
			Expect(0);
			if (base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.SetRange(GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
			}
			CloseContext();
			BindComments();
		}

		{

			{
				base.LastFormattingParsingElement.FormattingType = type;
			}
		}

		private void CallAppropriateParseRule(LanguageElement context)
		{
			if (context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Method)
			{
				Method method = (Method)context;
				IsAsyncContext = method.IsAsynchronous;
			}
			try
			{
				_ParsingPostponedTokens = context.ParsingPostponedTokens;
				switch (context.ElementType)
				{
				case LanguageElementType.SourceFile:
					Parser();
					Expect(0);
					SetContextEndIfNeeded();
					return;
				case LanguageElementType.Namespace:
				case LanguageElementType.TemplateModifier:
				case LanguageElementType.ExternDeclaration:
					while (la.Type == 78)
					{
						UsingDirective();
					}
					NamespaceMemberDeclarations();
					ParseTypeEnd();
					return;
				case LanguageElementType.Method:
				case LanguageElementType.Do:
				case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
				case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
				case LanguageElementType.If:
				case LanguageElementType.Else:
				case LanguageElementType.Case:
				case LanguageElementType.Switch:
				case LanguageElementType.For:
				case LanguageElementType.ForEach:
				case LanguageElementType.While:
				case LanguageElementType.Try:
				case LanguageElementType.Catch:
				case LanguageElementType.Finally:
				case LanguageElementType.Lock:
				case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
				case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
				case LanguageElementType.EventRaise:
					StatementSeq();
					ParseMemberEnd(context.ElementType);
					return;
				case LanguageElementType.Event:
					EventAccessorDeclarationsSeq();
					ParseMemberEnd(context.ElementType);
					return;
				case LanguageElementType.Property:
					AccessorDeclarationsSeq();
					ParseMemberEnd(context.ElementType);
					return;
				case LanguageElementType.Class:
				case LanguageElementType.Interface:
				case LanguageElementType.Struct:
				case LanguageElementType.Union:
					NamespaceMemberDeclaration();
					ParseTypeEnd();
					return;
				case LanguageElementType.Enum:
					break;
				default:
					return;
				}
				while (la != null && la.Type == 91)
				{
					Get();
				}
				if (la.Type != 0)
				{
					EnumMembers();
				}
				ParseTypeEnd();
			}
			finally
			{
				_ParsingPostponedTokens = false;
			}
		}

		protected override LanguageElement DoParse(ParserContext parserContext, ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				base.SaveFormat = parserContext.SaveUserFormat;
				LanguageElement context = parserContext.Context;
				if (context == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				SetRootNode(context);
				if (context is SourceFile)
				{
					((SourceFile)context).SetDocument(parserContext.Document);
					((SourceFile)context).TextStrings = base.TextStrings;
					((SourceFile)context).ClearFriendAssemblyNames();
					base.TextStrings.Clear();
					Comments.Clear();
					Regions.Clear();
				}
				_Reader = reader;
				scanner = CreateScanner(reader, parserContext.ScannerExtension);
				PreparePreprocessor();
				FirstGet();
				CallAppropriateParseRule(context);
				if (parserContext != null && Comments != null)
				{
					parserContext.Comments.AddRange(Comments);
				}
				if (parserContext != null)
				{
					parserContext.ContextAfterParse = base.Context;
				}
				BindComments();
				CheckForErrors(base.RootNode);
				if (context is SourceFile)
				{
					base.LastParsingHasEOF = tToken != null && tToken.Type == 0;
				}
				else
				{
					base.LastParsingHasEOF = la != null && la.Type == 0;
				}
				AfterParsing();
				return base.RootNode;
			}
			finally
			{
				_Reader = null;
				parserContext.Errors = parserErrors.GetClonedErrorList();
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement Parse(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				_Reader = reader;
				scanner = new CSharpScanner(reader);
				if (base.RootNode == null)
				{
					OpenContext(GetSourceFile("SourceFile"));
				}
				Parse();
				CheckForErrors(base.RootNode);
				AfterParsing();
				return base.RootNode;
			}
			finally
			{
				_Reader = null;
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public Expression ParseExpression(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				_Reader = reader;
				scanner = CreateScanner(reader);
				if (base.RootNode == null)
				{
					OpenContext(GetSourceFile("SourceFile"));
				}
				Comments.Clear();
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				Regions.Clear();
				PreparePreprocessor();
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				Expression expression = null;
				VariableInitializer(out expression);
				AfterParsing(expression);
				ClearFormattingParsingElements();
				return expression;
			}
			finally
			{
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection ParseStatements(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			try
			{
				scanner = CreateScanner(reader);
				Comments.Clear();
				LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
				Method method = new Method("root");
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				Regions.Clear();
				PreparePreprocessor();
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				OpenContext(method);
				StatementSeq();
				for (int i = 0; i < method.NodeCount; i++)
				{
					languageElementCollection.Add(method.Nodes[i]);
				}
				AfterParsing(languageElementCollection);
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorExpression()
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			Expression expression = null;
			_RazorParsingMode = RazorParsingMode.Expression;
			Primary(out expression, UnaryOperatorType.None);
			if (expression != null)

				languageElementCollection.Add(expression);
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		private ISourceReader GetRazorReader()
		{
			ISourceReader sourceReader = scanner.SourceReader;
			TextReader stream = sourceReader.GetStream();
			string text = stream.ReadToEnd();
			int num = la.StartPosition - _FirstTokenStartPosition;
			return sourceReader.GetSubStream(num, text.Length - num, la.Line, la.Column);
		}

		private void SetHasEndingSemicolonIfNeeded(LanguageElement namespaceOrType)
		{
			switch (namespaceOrType.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Namespace:
				((Namespace)namespaceOrType).HasEndingSemicolon = true;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Class:
			case LanguageElementType.Enum:
			case LanguageElementType.Interface:
			case LanguageElementType.Struct:
				((TypeDeclaration)namespaceOrType).HasEndingSemicolon = true;
				break;
			}
		}

		protected void ParseRazorHtmlEmbedding(out LanguageElementCollection htmlParseResult)
		{
			HtmlParser htmlParser = new HtmlParser(isRazorParser: true, workAsXAMLParser: false, DotNetLanguageType.CSharp);
			bool setTokensCategory = base.SetTokensCategory;
			htmlParser.SetTokensCategory = setTokensCategory;
			ISourceReader razorReader = GetRazorReader();
			int scannerPositionDelta = -1;
			htmlParseResult = htmlParser.ParseSingleElement(razorReader, out scannerPositionDelta);
			SourceRange sourceRange = SourceRange.Empty;
			if (htmlParseResult != null && htmlParseResult.Count > 0 && base.Context != null)
			{
				base.Context.AddNodes(htmlParseResult);
				sourceRange = new SourceRange(htmlParseResult[0].Range.Start, htmlParseResult[htmlParseResult.Count - 1].Range.End);
			}
			if (base.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				foreach (CategorizedToken savedToken in htmlParser.SavedTokens)
				{
					if (sourceRange.Contains(savedToken.Range))
					{
						base.SavedTokens.Add(savedToken);
					}
				}
			}
			la.Next = null;
			scannerPositionDelta = la.StartPosition + scannerPositionDelta - (scanner.Position - 1);
			if (scannerPositionDelta < 0 && la != scanner.tToken)
			{
				la.Next = scanner.tToken;
			}
			scanner.SyncPosition(scannerPositionDelta);
		}

		private bool IsNamespaceReference(Token token)
		{
			if (token.Type != 78)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token2 = Peek();
			if (token2 != null)
			{
				return token2.Type != 102;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAwaitExpression()
		{
			bool flag = la.Type == 1 && la.Value == "await";
			if (IsAsyncContext && flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ResetPeek();
				Token token = Peek();
				if (token.Type == 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsAsyncModifier()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1 || la.Value != "async")
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token pt = Peek();
			switch (pt.Type)
			{
			case 8:
			case 30:
			case 43:
			case 48:
			case 52:
			case 54:
			case 55:
			case 56:
			case 57:
			case 61:
			case 65:
			case 76:
			case 79:
			case 80:
			case 81:
				return true;
			case 1:
				if (IsPartialModifier(pt))
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (!IsType(ref pt))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pt.Type == 102)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsAsyncDelegate()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1 || la.Value != "async")
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token != null)
			{
				return token.Type == 23;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorCode(ISourceReader reader, ref int scannerPositionDelta)
		{
			try
			{
				_ParsingRazor = true;
				scanner = CreateScanner(reader);
				int position = scanner.Position;
				int num = position;
				Comments.Clear();
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				Regions.Clear();
				PreparePreprocessor();
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				_FirstTokenStartPosition = la.StartPosition;
				LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = null;
				languageElementCollection = (IsNamespaceReference(la) ? ParseNamespaceReference() : ((!IsValidRazorStatementStart(la)) ? ParseRazorExpression() : ParseRazorStatement()));
				num = tToken.EndPosition + 1;
				scannerPositionDelta += num - position;
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				_ParsingRazor = false;
				_RazorParsingMode = RazorParsingMode.None;
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public LanguageElement ParseRazorHelper(ISourceReader reader, out int scannerPositionDelta)
		{
			try
			{
				_ParsingRazor = true;
				_RazorParsingMode = RazorParsingMode.Helper;
				scanner = CreateScanner(reader);
				int position = scanner.Position;
				int num = position;
				Comments.Clear();
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				Regions.Clear();
				PreparePreprocessor();
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				SourceRange range = la.Range;
				_FirstTokenStartPosition = la.StartPosition;
				LanguageElement languageElement = ParseRazorHelper();
				languageElement?.SetRange(GetRange(range, languageElement));
				num = tToken.EndPosition + 1;
				scannerPositionDelta = num - position;
				return languageElement;
			}
			finally
			{
				_ParsingRazor = false;
				_RazorParsingMode = RazorParsingMode.None;
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private LanguageElement ParseRazorHelper()
		{
			ElementReferenceExpression refExpr = null;
			TypeReferenceExpression typeRef = new TypeReferenceExpression("string");
			Class obj = new Class();
			OpenContext(obj);
			MemberName(out refExpr);
			MethodDeclaration(typeRef, refExpr, null, MemberVisibility.Public, null);
			if (obj != null && obj.NodeCount > 0)
			{
				return obj.Nodes[0] as LanguageElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorFunctions(ISourceReader reader, out int scannerPositionDelta)
		{
			scannerPositionDelta = 0;
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = null;
			try
			{
				_ParsingRazor = true;
				_RazorParsingMode = RazorParsingMode.Functions;
				scanner = CreateScanner(reader);
				int position = scanner.Position;
				int num = position;
				Comments.Clear();
				base.TextStrings.Clear();
				Regions.Clear();
				PreparePreprocessor();
				la = new Token();
				la.Value = "";
				Get();
				SourceRange range = la.Range;
				_FirstTokenStartPosition = la.StartPosition;
				languageElementCollection = ParseRazorFunctions();
				num = tToken.EndPosition + 1;
				scannerPositionDelta = num - position;
				return languageElementCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				_ParsingRazor = false;
				_RazorParsingMode = RazorParsingMode.None;
				CleanUpParser();
				if (reader != null)
				{
					reader.Dispose();
					reader = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorFunctions()
		{
			LanguageElementCollection languageElementCollection = new LanguageElementCollection();
			Class obj = new Class();
			OpenContext(obj);
			ClassBody(obj);
			for (int i = 0; i < obj.NodeCount; i++)
			{
				languageElementCollection.Add(obj.Nodes[i] as LanguageElement);
			}
			if (base.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				SourceRange blockRange = obj.BlockRange;
				int num = base.SavedTokens.Count - 1;
				while (num > -1 && !blockRange.Contains(base.SavedTokens[num].Range))
				{
					base.SavedTokens.RemoveAt(num);
					num--;
				}
				if (base.SavedTokens.Count > 0)
				{
					CategorizedToken categorizedToken = base.SavedTokens[0] as CategorizedToken;
					if (categorizedToken.Type == 100)
					{
						categorizedToken.Category = TokenCategory.HtmlServerSideScript;
					}
					categorizedToken = base.SavedTokens[base.SavedTokens.Count - 1] as CategorizedToken;
					if (categorizedToken.Type == 115)
					{
						categorizedToken.Category = TokenCategory.HtmlServerSideScript;
					}
				}
			}
			return languageElementCollection;
		}

		protected bool IsRazorInlineExpression()
		{
			if (!_ParsingRazor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (la.Type != 89)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token == null || token.Type != 104)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsRazorHtmlCode()
		{
			if (!_ParsingRazor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (la.Type == 104)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (la.Type == 89)
			{
				ResetPeek();
				Token token = Peek();
				if (token != null && token.Type != 104)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (la.Type == 88)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (la.Type == 1 && la.Value.StartsWith("@"))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected LanguageElementCollection ParseRazorStatement()
		{
			LanguageElementCollection result = null;
			Block block = new Block();
			OpenContext(block);
			_RazorParsingMode = RazorParsingMode.Statement;
			Statement();
			if (block.NodeCount <= 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			int nodeCount = block.NodeCount;
			result = new LanguageElementCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (block.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement value)
				{
					result.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected LanguageElementCollection ParseNamespaceReference()
		{
			LanguageElementCollection result = null;
			SourceFile sourceFile = new SourceFile();
			OpenContext(sourceFile);
			UsingDirective();
			if (sourceFile.NodeCount <= 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			int nodeCount = sourceFile.NodeCount;
			result = new LanguageElementCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (sourceFile.Nodes[i] is LanguageElement value)
				{
					result.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool IsValidRazorStatementStart(Token token)
		{
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 24:
			case 26:
			case 35:
			case 36:
			case 38:
			case 67:
			case 78:
			case 82:
			case 100:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected Token CreatePostponedToken(Token left, Token right)
		{
			left.StartPosition += 1;
			left.Column += 1;
			left.Line = left.Line;
			left.EndPosition = right.EndPosition - 1;
			left.EndColumn = right.EndColumn - 1;
			left.EndLine = right.EndLine;
			return left;
		}

		protected void CorrectFormattingTokenType(Token token)
		{
			SetKeywordTokenCategory(token);
			if (base.LastParsingElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			FormattingTokenType type = FormattingTokenType.None;
			if (token.Type == 1)
			{
				switch (token.Value)
				{
				case "var":
					type = FormattingTokenType.Var;
					break;
				case "alias":
					type = FormattingTokenType.Alias;
					break;
				case "partial":
					type = FormattingTokenType.Partial;
					break;
				case "async":
					type = FormattingTokenType.Async;
					break;
				case "await":
					type = FormattingTokenType.Await;
					break;
				}
			}
			base.LastParsingElement = ReplaceOrAddFormattingParsingElement(token as FormattingToken, type);
		}

		private void ParseMemberEnd(LanguageElementType elementType)
		{
			LanguageElement context = base.Context;
			if (elementType == LanguageElementType.Method || elementType == LanguageElementType.Property || elementType == LanguageElementType.Event)
			{
				ParseMethodEnd();
			}
			if (context != base.Context)
			{
				CallAppropriateParseRule(base.Context);
			}
		}

		private void ParseMethodEnd()
		{
			if (la != null && la.Type == 115 && base.Context != null)
			{
				Get();
				ReadBlockEnd(tToken.Range);
				base.Context.SetRange(GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
				CloseContext();
			}
		}

		protected void SkipMethodBody()
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (la.Type != 0)
			{
				if (la.Type == 100)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (la.Type == 115)
				{
					if (num == 0)
					{
						break;
					}
					num--;
				}
				Get();
			}
		}

		protected void SkipTo(int tokenType)
		{
			while (la != null && la.Type != 0 && tokenType != la.Type)
			{
				Get();
			}
		}

		protected bool IsAccessorDeclaration()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type != 1 || (!(la.Value == "get") && !(la.Value == "set")))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token.Type == 118 || token.Type == 100)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override TokenCategory GetTokenCategory(CategorizedToken token)
		{
			return CSharpTokensHelper.GetUncategorizedTokenCategory(token);
		}

		protected JoinExpressionBase ConvertToJoinIntoExpression(JoinExpressionBase joinBase, QueryIdent intoName)
		{
			if (joinBase == null || intoName == null)
			{
				return joinBase;
			}
			JoinIntoExpression joinIntoExpression = new JoinIntoExpression();
			joinIntoExpression.SetRange(joinBase.Range);
			joinIntoExpression.SetInExpression(joinBase.InExpression);
			for (int i = 0; i < joinBase.EqualsExpressions.Count; i++)
			{
				joinIntoExpression.AddEqualsExpression(joinBase.EqualsExpressions[i] as EqualsExpression);
			}
			joinIntoExpression.AddIntoElement(intoName);
			return joinIntoExpression;
		}

		protected QueryIdent CreateQueryIdent(Token nameToken, SourceRange operatorRange, Expression initializer)
		{
			if (nameToken == null || initializer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			QueryIdent queryIdent = new QueryIdent(nameToken.Value);
			queryIdent.NameRange = nameToken.Range;
			queryIdent.OperatorRange = operatorRange;
			queryIdent.Expression = initializer;
			queryIdent.AddDetailNode(initializer);
			queryIdent.SetRange(GetRange(nameToken, initializer));
			return queryIdent;
		}

		protected override void CleanUpParser()
		{
			_UnclosedMemberContext = null;
			_StatementNestingLevel = 0;
			base.CleanUpParser();
			if (Comments != null)
			{
				Comments.Clear();
			}
			if (_Preprocessor != null)
			{
				_Preprocessor.CleanUp();
			}
			_ActiveSqlExpression = null;
		}

		private bool TokenIsComment(int tokenType)
		{
			if (tokenType != 124 && tokenType != 149 && tokenType != 125 && tokenType != 150)
			{
				return tokenType == 126;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private SourceFile GetFileNode()
		{
			if (base.Context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SourceFile sourceFile = null;
			if (base.Context is SourceFile)
			{
				return base.Context as SourceFile;
			}
			return base.Context.FileNode;
		}

		private SourceRange CalculateRegionNameRange(int startLine, int tokenOffset, string regionName, string tokenValue)
		{
			int num = tokenValue.IndexOf(regionName) + tokenOffset;
			string text = (base.SaveFormat ? regionName : regionName.Trim());
			return new SourceRange(startLine, num, startLine, text.Length + num);
		}

		private bool TokenIsSupportElement(int tokenType)
		{
			if (tokenType != 137 && tokenType != 138 && tokenType != 139 && tokenType != 140 && tokenType != 141 && tokenType != 142 && tokenType != 143 && tokenType != 144 && tokenType != 145 && tokenType != 146 && tokenType != 147)
			{
				return tokenType == 148;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsConditionalExpressionCore()
		{
			Token pt = Peek();
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			int type = pt.Type;
			if (type == 97 || type == 91)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (pt.Type != 0 && pt.Type != 118)
			{
				switch (pt.Type)
				{
				case 48:
					pt = Peek();
					IsType(ref pt);
					continue;
				case 101:
					num3++;
					break;
				case 116:
					num3--;
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case 1:
					if (string.Compare("where", pt.Value, StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case 114:
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case 87:
					return false;
				case 100:
					if (num == 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					num4++;
					break;
				case 115:
					num4--;
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				case 90:
					return true;
				case 102:
					num2++;
					break;
				case 117:
					num2--;
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					break;
				}
				num = pt.Type;
				pt = Peek();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsConditionalExpressionStart()
		{
			if (la == null || la.Type != 114)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			return IsConditionalExpressionCore();
		}

		public override SourceFile GetSourceFile(string fileName)
		{
			return new CSharpSourceFile(fileName);
		}

		private FormattingElements CutElementsFromEOL(FormattingElements elements)
		{
			if (elements == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FormattingElements formattingElements = new FormattingElements();
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < elements.Count && !(elements[i] is FormattingElement { Type: FormattingElementType.EOL }); i++)
			{
			}
			while (i < elements.Count)
			{
				formattingElements.Add(elements[i]);
				elements.RemoveAt(i);
			}
			return formattingElements;
		}

		private string ProcessDirective(PreprocessorDirective directive, FormattingToken formattingToken, SourceFile sourceFile, bool canHaveComment, out FormattingElements elementsAfter)
		{
			elementsAfter = null;
			AddFormattingElements(formattingToken);
			formattingToken.WasChecked = true;
			int line = formattingToken.Line;
			int column = formattingToken.Column;
			string text = "";
			bool saveFormat = scanner.SaveFormat;
			if (!saveFormat)
			{
				scanner.GetFormatingTokenElement();
			}
			scanner.SaveFormat = true;
			FormattingElements formattingElements = formattingToken.FormattingElements;
			if (scanner.EndLineValue > formattingToken.EndLine)
			{
				elementsAfter = CutElementsFromEOL(formattingElements);
			}
			while (formattingToken != null && scanner.EndLineValue <= formattingToken.EndLine)
			{
				Token token = scanner.Scan();
				if (token.Type == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(token);
				text += token.Value;
				formattingToken = token as FormattingToken;
				if (formattingToken == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				formattingToken.WasChecked = true;
				formattingElements = (elementsAfter = formattingToken.FormattingElements);
				if (scanner.EndLineValue > formattingToken.EndLine)
				{
					if (canHaveComment)
					{
						break;
					}
					elementsAfter = CutElementsFromEOL(formattingElements);
				}
				if (canHaveComment && scanner.CurrentChar == '/')
				{
					break;
				}
				text += _Preprocessor.GetFEText(formattingElements);
			}
			scanner.SaveFormat = saveFormat;
			directive.SetRange(line, column, line, formattingToken.EndColumn + ((formattingElements != null && elementsAfter != formattingElements) ? formattingElements.Count : 0));
			sourceFile?.AddDirective(directive);
			return text;
		}

		private PreprocessorDirective ProcessSupportElement(FormattingToken token, out FormattingElements elementsAfter)
		{
			elementsAfter = null;
			if (token == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SourceFile fileNode = GetFileNode();
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 143:
			{
				LineDirective lineDirective = new LineDirective();
				string text = ProcessDirective(lineDirective, token, fileNode, canHaveComment: true, out elementsAfter);
				SetLineProperties(lineDirective, text);
				return lineDirective;
			}
			case 148:
			{
				PragmaDirective pragmaDirective = new PragmaDirective();
				pragmaDirective.Text = ProcessDirective(pragmaDirective, token, fileNode, canHaveComment: true, out elementsAfter);
				return pragmaDirective;
			}
			case 144:
			{
				ErrorDirective errorDirective = new ErrorDirective();
				errorDirective.Expression = ProcessDirective(errorDirective, token, fileNode, canHaveComment: false, out elementsAfter);
				return errorDirective;
			}
			case 145:
			{
				WarningDirective warningDirective = new WarningDirective();
				warningDirective.Text = ProcessDirective(warningDirective, token, fileNode, canHaveComment: false, out elementsAfter);
				return warningDirective;
			}
			case 146:
			{
				RegionDirective regionDirective = new RegionDirective();
				regionDirective.Name = ProcessDirective(regionDirective, token, fileNode, canHaveComment: false, out elementsAfter);
				regionDirective.NameRange = new SourceRange(token.Line, regionDirective.EndOffset - regionDirective.Name.Length, token.Line, regionDirective.EndOffset);
				return regionDirective;
			}
			case 147:
			{
				EndRegionDirective endRegionDirective = new EndRegionDirective();
				endRegionDirective.Message = ProcessDirective(endRegionDirective, token, fileNode, canHaveComment: false, out elementsAfter);
				return endRegionDirective;
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected void PreparePreprocessor()
		{
			if (base.RootNode != null && scanner != null)
			{
				SourceFile sourceFile = base.RootNode as SourceFile;
				if (sourceFile == null)
				{
					sourceFile = base.RootNode.GetSourceFile();
				}
				if (sourceFile == null)
				{
					sourceFile = GetSourceFile(string.Empty);
				}
				_Preprocessor = new CSharpPreprocessor(scanner as CSharpScanner, this, sourceFile);
			}
		}

		private bool IsDirectiveForPreprocessing(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int type = token.Type;
			if (137 != type && 138 != type && 139 != type && 140 != type && 141 != type)
			{
				return 142 == type;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetLineProperties(LineDirective line, string text)
		{
			string text2 = text.Trim();
			if (!(text2 == "default"))
			{
				if (text2 == "hidden")
				{
					line.Hidden = true;
					return;
				}
				int lineNumber = 0;
				string fileName = null;
				GetLineInfo(text2, out lineNumber, out fileName);
				line.LineNumber = lineNumber;
				line.FileName = fileName;
			}
			else
			{
				line.Default = true;
			}
		}

		private void GetLineInfo(string lineIndicatorStr, out int lineNumber, out string fileName)
		{
			lineNumber = 0;
			fileName = null;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineIndicatorStr))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int length = lineIndicatorStr.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < length && char.IsDigit(lineIndicatorStr[i]); i++)
			{
				num = i;
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			string s = lineIndicatorStr.Substring(0, ++num);
			int.TryParse(s, out lineNumber);
			if (num != length)
			{
				string text = lineIndicatorStr.Substring(num).Trim().Trim('"');
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					fileName = text;
				}
			}
		}

		private SourceFile GetSourceFileFromContext()
		{
			if (base.Context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.Context is SourceFile)
			{
				return base.Context as SourceFile;
			}
			return base.Context.FileNode;
		}

		protected void AddTextString(Token stringToken)
		{
			if (!ShouldWorkAsExpressionParser)
			{
				int num = stringToken.Range.Start.Offset + 1;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				if (stringToken.Value[0] == '@')
				{
					num++;
					empty = stringToken.Value.Substring(2, stringToken.Value.Length - 3);
				}
				else
				{
					empty = stringToken.Value.Substring(1, stringToken.Value.Length - 2);
				}
				TextString textString = new TextString(empty, isVerbatim: false);
				SourceFile parent = null;
				if (base.Context != null)
				{
					parent = base.Context.FileNode;
				}
				textString.SetParent(parent);
				textString.SetRange(new SourceRange(stringToken.Range.Start.Line, num, stringToken.Range.End.Line, stringToken.Range.End.Offset - 1));
				base.TextStrings.Add(textString);
			}
		}

		private bool TokenIsAspToken(int type)
		{
			if (type != 154 && type != 153)
			{
				return type == 155;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetDocumentText(SourceRange range)
		{
			if (range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			IDocument document = base.Document;
			if (document == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return document.GetText(range.Start.Line, range.Start.Offset, range.End.Line, range.End.Offset);
		}

		private void CloseNestedMethodContext(Token token)
		{
			if (base.Context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			LanguageElement languageElement = base.Context as NestedMethod;
			if (languageElement == null)
			{
				languageElement = base.Context.GetParent(LanguageElementType.NestedMethod) as NestedMethod;
			}
			if (languageElement == null || languageElement.Parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			while (base.Context != languageElement.Parent && base.Context != null)
			{
				if (base.Context != languageElement)
				{
					base.Context.SetRange(GetRange(base.Context, tToken));
				}
				else
				{
					base.Context.SetRange(GetRange(base.Context, token));
				}
				CloseContext();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessAspToken(Token token)
		{
			if (token != null)
			{
				switch (token.Type)
				{
				case 153:
				{
					NestedMethod nestedMethod = new NestedMethod();
					nestedMethod.SetRange(token.Range);
					OpenContext(nestedMethod);
					break;
				}
				case 154:
					CloseNestedMethodContext(token);
					break;
				case 155:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private Token TokenStep(bool isPeek)
		{
			if (isPeek)
			{
				return Peek();
			}
			base.Get();
			return la;
		}

		private Token PreprocessToken(bool isPeek, Token startToken, FormattingParsingElement lastElement)
		{
			if (startToken == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (_Preprocessor == null)
			{
				PreparePreprocessor();
			}
			if (_Preprocessor == null)
			{
				return TokenStep(isPeek);
			}
			_Preprocessor.ActiveParsingElement = lastElement;
			return _Preprocessor.Preprocess(startToken);
		}

		protected override void Get()
		{
			_PreviousTokenWasComment = false;
			base.Get();
			Token token = tToken;
			int type = la.Type;
			while (TokenIsComment(type) || TokenIsSupportElement(type) || type == 6 || TokenIsAspToken(type))
			{
				if (IsDirectiveForPreprocessing(la))
				{
					la = PreprocessToken(isPeek: false, la, base.LastParsingElement);
				}
				else
				{
					FormattingToken formattingToken = la as FormattingToken;
					if (TokenIsComment(type))
					{
						AddCommentNode(la, base.LastParsingElement);
						_PreviousTokenWasComment = true;
					}
					else if (TokenIsSupportElement(type))
					{
						FormattingElements elementsAfter;
						PreprocessorDirective formattingElement = ProcessSupportElement(formattingToken, out elementsAfter);
						AddToParsingElement(base.LastParsingElement, formattingElement);
						AddToParsingElement(base.LastParsingElement, elementsAfter);
					}
					else if (TokenIsAspToken(type))
					{
						ProcessAspToken(la);
					}
					if (formattingToken != null)
					{
						formattingToken.WasChecked = true;
					}
					base.Get();
				}
				type = la.Type;
			}
			if (tToken.Type != 126)
			{
				tToken = token;
			}
			if (la.Type == 5)
			{
				AddTextString(la);
			}
		}

		protected new Token Peek()
		{
			_PreviousTokenWasComment = false;
			Token pt = scanner.GetPt();
			base.LastParsingElement = AddFormattingElements(pt as FormattingToken);
			Token tokens = scanner.GetTokens();
			Token token = scanner.Peek();
			int type = token.Type;
			SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(token);
			FormattingParsingElement lastFormattingParsingElement = base.LastFormattingParsingElement;
			while (TokenIsComment(type) || TokenIsSupportElement(type) || type == 6)
			{
				if (type == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (IsDirectiveForPreprocessing(token))
				{
					scanner.SetTokens(token);
					token = PreprocessToken(isPeek: true, token, lastFormattingParsingElement);
					SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(token);
				}
				else
				{
					if (type == 6)
					{
						tokens = scanner.GetTokens();
						pt = scanner.GetPt();
						token = scanner.Peek();
						if (token != null)
						{
							type = token.Type;
						}
						continue;
					}
					FormattingToken formattingToken = token as FormattingToken;
					if (TokenIsComment(type))
					{
						AddCommentNode(token, lastFormattingParsingElement);
						_PreviousTokenWasComment = true;
					}
					else if (TokenIsSupportElement(type))
					{
						scanner.SetTokens(formattingToken);
						FormattingElements elementsAfter;
						PreprocessorDirective formattingElement = ProcessSupportElement(formattingToken, out elementsAfter);
						AddToParsingElement(lastFormattingParsingElement, formattingElement);
						AddToParsingElement(lastFormattingParsingElement, elementsAfter);
					}
					if (formattingToken != null)
					{
						formattingToken.WasChecked = true;
					}
					token = scanner.Peek();
					SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(token);
				}
				scanner.SetTokens(tokens);
				scanner.SetOnPeek(pt, token);
				type = token.Type;
			}
			return token;
		}

		private bool IsSingleLineXmlComment(Comment comment)
		{
			if (comment is XmlDocComment)
			{
				return comment.CommentType == CommentType.SingleLine;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void AddCommentNode(Token lCommentToken, FormattingParsingElement lastElement)
		{
			CommentType commentType = ((lCommentToken.Type != 124 && lCommentToken.Type != 149) ? CommentType.MultiLine : CommentType.SingleLine);
			string text = lCommentToken.Value;
			bool flag = text.StartsWith("/*") || text.StartsWith("/**");
			int num = 2;
			Comment comment;
			if (lCommentToken.Type == 149 || lCommentToken.Type == 150)
			{
				comment = new XmlDocComment();
				num = 3;
			}
			else
			{
				comment = new Comment();
			}
			comment.SetCommentType(commentType);
			comment.SetTextStartOffset(num);
			if (!(comment is XmlDocComment))
			{
				text = ((text.Length <= num) ? "" : text.Substring(num));
			}
			if (_PreviousTokenWasComment && IsSingleLineXmlComment(comment) && Comments[Comments.Count - 1] is XmlDocComment xmlDocComment && IsSingleLineXmlComment(xmlDocComment) && ShouldConcatComments(xmlDocComment.Range, lCommentToken.Range))
			{
				xmlDocComment.InternalName += "\r\n";
				int num2 = lCommentToken.Range.Start.Offset - 1;
				int num3 = lCommentToken.Range.Start.Line - xmlDocComment.Range.End.Line - 1;
				string text2 = string.Empty;
				if (num3 > 0)
				{
					text2 = new string('\n', num3);
				}
				string text3 = string.Empty;
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					text3 = new string(' ', num2);
				}
				xmlDocComment.InternalName = xmlDocComment.InternalName + text2 + text3 + text;
				xmlDocComment.SetRange(GetRange(xmlDocComment, lCommentToken));
				return;
			}
			int num4 = text.LastIndexOf("*/");
			if (lCommentToken.Type == 126)
			{
				num4 = text.LastIndexOf("*@");
				tToken = lCommentToken.Clone();
			}
			bool flag2 = num4 >= 0;
			if (commentType == CommentType.MultiLine && flag2 && !(comment is XmlDocComment))
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, num4);
			}
			if (flag && !flag2)
			{
				comment.IsUnfinished = true;
			}
			comment.SetRange(lCommentToken.Range);
			comment.StartPos = lCommentToken.StartPosition;
			comment.EndPos = lCommentToken.EndPosition;
			comment.InternalName = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(text);
			Comments.Add(comment);
			if (lCommentToken is FormattingToken { WasChecked: false })
			{
				AddToParsingElement(lastElement, comment);
				AddToParsingElement(lastElement, ((FormattingToken)lCommentToken).FormattingElements);
			}
			if (_ParsingRazor)
			{
				AddNode(comment);
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldConcatComments(SourceRange previousCommentRange, SourceRange newCommentRange)
		{
			int line = previousCommentRange.End.Line;
			int line2 = newCommentRange.Start.Line;
			return line2 - line < 2;
		}

		{
			if (symbols == null)

				return;

			{
				symbols[i] = symbols[i].Trim();

				{
					ccs.Add(symbols[i]);
				}
			}
		}

					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.ReadOnlyRange, element.Range));

				if (!accessSpecifiers.RegisterRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.RegisterRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.SealedRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.SealedRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.StaticRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.StaticRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.TypeDefRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.TypeDefRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.UnsafeRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.UnsafeRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.VirtualOverrideAbstractRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.VirtualOverrideAbstractRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.VisibilityRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.VisibilityRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.VolatileRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.VolatileRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.WithEventsRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.WithEventsRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.WriteOnlyRange.IsEmpty)
				{
					element.SetRange(SourceRange.Union(accessSpecifiers.WriteOnlyRange, element.Range));
				}
				if (!accessSpecifiers.ExternRange.IsEmpty)
				{

			}
		}

		protected void SetContextEndIfNeeded()
		{
			if (base.Context == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourcePoint end = tToken.Range.End;
			SourcePoint end2 = base.Context.Range.End;
			if (end > end2)
			{
				SetContextEnd(end);
				return;
			}
			for (int num = base.Context.NodeCount - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (base.Context.Nodes[num] is LanguageElement languageElement)
				{
					SourcePoint end3 = languageElement.Range.End;
					if (end3 > end)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (end > end2)
			{
				SetContextEnd(end);
			}
		}

		protected void SetIndexRanges(Property target, SourceRange indexOpenRange, SourceRange indexCloseRange)
		{
			if (target != null)
			{
				target.IndexOpenRange = indexOpenRange;
				target.IndexCloseRange = indexCloseRange;
			}
		}

		protected void SetParameters(MemberWithParameters target, LanguageElementCollection parameters)
		{
			if (parameters != null && target != null)
			{
				target.SetParameters(parameters);
				for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Count; i++)
				{
					target.AddDetailNode(parameters[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		protected Event CreateEvent(TypeReferenceExpression type, ElementReferenceExpression name)
		{
			Event obj = CreateEvent(type, GlobalStringStorage.Intern(name.ToString()), name.NameRange);
			if (obj.Name.IndexOf(".") != -1)
			{
				obj.AddImplementsExpression(name);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected Event CreateEvent(TypeReferenceExpression type, string name, SourceRange nameRange)
		{
			if (type == null || name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Event obj = new Event(name);
			obj.NameRange = nameRange;
			obj.MemberType = GlobalStringStorage.Intern(type.ToString());
			obj.MemberTypeReference = type;
			obj.TypeRange = type.Range;
			obj.AddDetailNode(type);
			if (obj.Name.IndexOf(".") != -1)
			{
				obj.IsExplicitInterfaceMember = true;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected Property CreateIndexer(TypeReferenceExpression type, string name, SourceRange nameRange)
		{
			if (type == null || name.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;

			{
				property.IsExplicitInterfaceMember = true;
			}

		protected Property CreateProperty(TypeReferenceExpression type, ElementReferenceExpression name)
		{
			if (type == null || name == null)
			{
				return null;

			Property property = new Property(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(type.ToString()), GlobalStringStorage.Intern(name.ToString()));
			property.NameRange = name.NameRange;

				property.AddImplementsExpression(name);

		protected Method CreateMethod(TypeReferenceExpression type, ElementReferenceExpression name)
		{
			if (type == null || name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Method method = new Method(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(type.ToString()), GlobalStringStorage.Intern(name.ToString()));
			method.NameRange = name.NameRange;
			method.MemberTypeReference = type;
			method.TypeRange = type.Range;
			method.AddDetailNode(type);
			if (method.Name.IndexOf(".") != -1)
			{
				method.IsExplicitInterfaceMember = true;
				method.AddImplementsExpression(name);
			}
			if (type.ToString() == "void")
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Void;
			}
			else
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Function;
			}
			return method;
		}

		protected Method CreateCastOperator(TypeReferenceExpression type, bool isExplicit)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			empty = ((!isExplicit) ? "op_Implicit" : "op_Explicit");
			Method method = new Method(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(type.ToString()), empty);
			method.IsClassOperator = true;
			method.NameRange = type.NameRange;
			method.MemberTypeReference = type;
			method.TypeRange = type.Range;
			method.AddDetailNode(type);
			if (type.ToString() == "void")
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Void;
			}
			else
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Function;
			}
			method.IsImplicitCast = !isExplicit;
			method.IsExplicitCast = isExplicit;
			return method;
		}

		protected Method CreateConstructor(string name, SourceRange nameRange)

			Method method = new Method(name);
			method.NameRange = nameRange;
			method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Constructor;
			return method;
		}

			method.NameRange = nameRange;
			method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Destructor;
			return method;
		}

		protected EnumElement CreateEnumElement(string name, Expression expression, SourceRange nameRange, SourceRange startRange, SourceRange endRange)
		{

			enumElement.SetRange(GetRange(startRange, endRange));
