		protected Method CreateClassOperator(string name, SourceRange nameRange, TypeReferenceExpression typeRef, OperatorType operatorType)
		{
			if (typeRef == null || name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Method method = new Method(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(typeRef.ToString()), name);
			method.NameRange = nameRange;
			method.MemberTypeReference = typeRef;
			method.TypeRange = typeRef.Range;
			method.AddDetailNode(typeRef);
			method.IsClassOperator = true;
			method.OverloadsOperator = operatorType;
			if (typeRef.ToString() != "void")
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Function;
			}
			else
			{
				method.MethodType = MethodTypeEnum.Void;
			}
			return method;
		}

		protected bool IsConstructor()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			if (Peek().Type != 102)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SetBinaryOperationFields(BinaryOperatorExpression expression, Token operatorToken, Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart)
		{
			expression.OperatorText = operatorToken.Value;
			expression.SetOperatorRange(operatorToken.Range);
			SourceRange range = operatorToken.Range;
			if (rightPart != null)
			{
				range = rightPart.Range;
			}
			expression.SetRange(GetRange(leftPart, range));
		}

		protected TypeCheck GetTypeCheck(Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart, Token operatorToken)
		{
			if (leftPart == null || rightPart == null || operatorToken == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TypeCheck typeCheck = new TypeCheck(leftPart, rightPart);
			SetBinaryOperationFields(typeCheck, operatorToken, leftPart, rightPart);
			return typeCheck;
		}

		protected ConditionalTypeCast GetConditionalTypeCast(Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart, Token operatorToken)

			if (leftPart == null || rightPart == null || operatorToken == null)
			{
				return null;

			ConditionalTypeCast conditionalTypeCast = new ConditionalTypeCast(leftPart, rightPart);
			SetBinaryOperationFields(conditionalTypeCast, operatorToken, leftPart, rightPart);
			return conditionalTypeCast;
		}

		protected BinaryOperatorExpression GetBinaryOperatorExpression(Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart, BinaryOperatorType operatorType, Token operatorToken)
		{
			if (leftPart == null || rightPart == null || operatorToken == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BinaryOperatorExpression binaryOperatorExpression = new BinaryOperatorExpression(leftPart, operatorType, rightPart);
			SetBinaryOperationFields(binaryOperatorExpression, operatorToken, leftPart, rightPart);
			return binaryOperatorExpression;
		}

		protected RelationalOperation GetRelationalOperation(Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart, RelationalOperator operatorType, Token operatorToken)

		protected AssignmentExpression GetAssignmentExpression(Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart, AssignmentOperatorType assignmentOperator, Token operatorToken)
		{
			if (operatorToken == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AssignmentExpression assignmentExpression = new AssignmentExpression();
			if (leftPart != null)
			{
				assignmentExpression.LeftSide = leftPart;
			}
			if (rightPart != null)
			{
				assignmentExpression.RightSide = rightPart;
			}
			assignmentExpression.AssignmentOperator = assignmentOperator;
			SetBinaryOperationFields(assignmentExpression, operatorToken, leftPart, rightPart);
			return assignmentExpression;
		}

		protected LogicalOperation GetLogicalOperation(Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart, LogicalOperator operatorType, Token operatorToken)

		protected NullCoalescingExpression GetNullCoalescingExpression(Expression leftPart, Expression rightPart, Token operatorToken)

			{
				return null;
			}
			NullCoalescingExpression nullCoalescingExpression = new NullCoalescingExpression(leftPart, rightPart);
			SetBinaryOperationFields(nullCoalescingExpression, operatorToken, leftPart, rightPart);
			return nullCoalescingExpression;
		}

		protected MethodReferenceExpression ToMethodReference(ElementReferenceExpression source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MethodReferenceExpression methodReferenceExpression = null;
			if (source is PointerElementReference)
			{
				methodReferenceExpression = new PointerMethodReference(source, source.Name, source.NameRange);
				methodReferenceExpression.AddNode(source.Qualifier);
			}
			else if (source.Qualifier == null)
			{
				methodReferenceExpression = new MethodReferenceExpression(source.Name, source.NameRange);
			}
			else
			{
				methodReferenceExpression = new MethodReferenceExpression(source.Qualifier, source.Name, source.NameRange);
				methodReferenceExpression.AddNode(source.Qualifier);
			}
			CopyFieldValuesFromElementReference(methodReferenceExpression, source);
			return methodReferenceExpression;
		}

		protected void CopyFieldValuesFromElementReference(ReferenceExpressionBase target, ReferenceExpressionBase source)
		{
			if (target != null && source != null)
			{
				if (source.TypeArguments != null && source.TypeArguments.Count > 0)
				{
					target.TypeArguments = source.TypeArguments;
				}
				CopyFieldValuesFromExpression(target, source);
				if (source.Qualifier != null)
				{
					target.Qualifier = source.Qualifier;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void CopyFieldValuesFromExpression(Expression target, Expression source)
		{
			if (target == null || source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			target.SetRange(source.Range);
			target.NameRange = source.NameRange;
			if (source.DetailNodeCount <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < source.DetailNodeCount; i++)
			{
				if (!target.DetailNodes.Contains(source.DetailNodes[i]))
				{
					target.AddDetailNode(source.DetailNodes[i] as LanguageElement);
				}
			}
		}

		protected Param CreateParameter(Token nameToken, TypeReferenceExpression typeRef, ArgumentDirection direction, SourceRange paramRange)
		{
			Param param = null;
			if (nameToken == null)
			{
				return param;
			}
			if (direction == ArgumentDirection.ArgList)
			{
				param = new Param(nameToken.Value);
				SetParameterValues(param, nameToken, null, direction, paramRange);
			}
			if (typeRef == null)
			{
				return param;
			}
			param = new Param(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(typeRef.ToString()), nameToken.Value);
			SetParameterValues(param, nameToken, typeRef, direction, paramRange);
			return param;
		}

		protected Param CreateExtensionMethodParameter(Token nameToken, TypeReferenceExpression typeRef, ArgumentDirection direction, SourceRange paramRange)
		{
			Param result = null;
			if (nameToken == null || typeRef == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			result = new ExtensionMethodParam(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(typeRef.ToString()), nameToken.Value);
			SetParameterValues(result, nameToken, typeRef, direction, paramRange);
			return result;
		}

		protected bool IsMemberInit()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			return Peek().Type == 87;
		}

		protected void InitializeTypeDeclaration(TypeDeclaration typeDecl, SourceRange startRange, AccessSpecifiers accessSpecifiers, MemberVisibility visibility)
		{
			if (typeDecl != null)
			{
				typeDecl.SetRange(startRange);
				SetAccessSpecifiers(typeDecl, accessSpecifiers, visibility);
			}
		}

		protected bool IsSqlExpression()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1 || la.Value != "from")
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token.Type != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			token = Peek();
			if (token.Type == 118 || token.Type == 87 || token.Type == 91)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool SkipLambdaParamList(ref Token currentToken)
		{
			int type = currentToken.Type;
			int num = 1;
			while (type != 0 && type != 118 && type != 87)
			{
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (type == 102)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (type == 117)
				{
					num--;
				}
				currentToken = Peek();
				if (currentToken == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				type = currentToken.Type;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsYieldStatement()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1 || la.Value != "yield")
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			int type = Peek().Type;
			if (type != 59)
			{
				return type == 12;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsPartialModifier(Token token)
		{
			return token.Value == "partial";
		}

		private bool IsLambda()
		{
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = la;
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (token.Type == 1 && token.Value == "async")
			{
				token = Peek();
			}
			if (token.Type != 102)
			{
				return IsLambdaWithImplicitParams();
			}
			token = Peek();
			if (!SkipLambdaParamList(ref token))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return token.Type == 136;
		}

		private bool IsAssignOperatorToken(int token)
		{
			if (token == 87)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return assgnOps[token];
		}

		private bool IsLambdaWithImplicitParams()
		{
			int type = la.Type;
			while (type != 0 && type != 118 && type != 90 && type != 102 && type != 117 && type != 101 && type != 116 && type != 91 && type != 48 && type != 5 && !IsAssignOperatorToken(type))
			{
				if (type == 136)
				{
					return true;
				}
				type = Peek().Type;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsImplicitLambdaParameter()
		{
			if (la.Type != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ResetPeek();
			int type = Peek().Type;
			if (type == 91 || type == 136 || type == 117)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetParameterValues(Param parameter, Token nameToken, TypeReferenceExpression typeRef, ArgumentDirection direction, SourceRange paramRange)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				parameter.Direction = direction;
				parameter.NameRange = nameToken.Range;
				if (typeRef != null)
				{
					parameter.MemberTypeReference = typeRef;
					parameter.SetFullTypeName(GetFullType(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(typeRef.ToString())));
					parameter.TypeRange = typeRef.Range;
					parameter.AddDetailNode(typeRef);
				}
				parameter.SetRange(paramRange);
			}
		}

		private string GetFullType(string shortName)
		{
			if (shortName == null || shortName.Length == 0)
			{
				return shortName;
			}
			if (_PrimitiveToFullTypes.ContainsKey(shortName))
			{
				return (string)_PrimitiveToFullTypes[shortName];
			}
			return shortName;
		}

		protected void AttachToQualifiedElementReference(Expression source, QualifiedElementReference elRef)
		{
			if (source != null && elRef != null)
			{
				elRef.SetRange(GetRange(source, elRef));
				Expression qualifier = elRef.Qualifier;
				ReferenceExpressionBase referenceExpressionBase = elRef;
				ReferenceExpressionBase referenceExpressionBase2 = qualifier as ReferenceExpressionBase;
				while (referenceExpressionBase2 != null && referenceExpressionBase2.Qualifier != null)
				{
					referenceExpressionBase2.SetRange(GetRange(source, referenceExpressionBase2));
					referenceExpressionBase = referenceExpressionBase2;
					qualifier = referenceExpressionBase2.Qualifier;
					referenceExpressionBase2 = referenceExpressionBase2.Qualifier as ReferenceExpressionBase;
				}
				QualifiedElementReference qualifiedElementReference = new QualifiedElementReference(source, qualifier.Name, qualifier.NameRange);
				qualifiedElementReference.AddNode(source);
				CopyFieldValuesFromElementReference(qualifiedElementReference, qualifier as ElementReferenceExpression);
				qualifiedElementReference.SetRange(GetRange(source, qualifiedElementReference));
				if (referenceExpressionBase != null)
				{
					referenceExpressionBase.Qualifier = qualifiedElementReference;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void AttachToPointerElementReference(Expression source, QualifiedElementReference elRef)
		{
			if (source != null && elRef != null)
			{
				elRef.SetRange(GetRange(source, elRef));
				Expression qualifier = elRef.Qualifier;
				ReferenceExpressionBase referenceExpressionBase = elRef;
				while (qualifier is ReferenceExpressionBase && (qualifier as ReferenceExpressionBase).Qualifier != null)
				{
					qualifier.SetRange(GetRange(source, qualifier));
					referenceExpressionBase = qualifier as ReferenceExpressionBase;
					qualifier = referenceExpressionBase.Qualifier;
				}
				QualifiedElementReference qualifiedElementReference = new PointerElementReference(source, qualifier.Name, qualifier.NameRange);
				qualifiedElementReference.AddNode(source);
				CopyFieldValuesFromElementReference(qualifiedElementReference, qualifier as ElementReferenceExpression);
				qualifiedElementReference.SetRange(GetRange(source, qualifiedElementReference));
				referenceExpressionBase.Qualifier = qualifiedElementReference;
			}
		}

		protected Const CreateConstant(string constName, TypeReferenceExpression typeRef, Expression constValue, SourceRange nameRange, SourceRange startRange, bool shouldAddTypeRef, SourceRange operatorRange)
		{
			Const obj = null;
			if (typeRef != null && constName != null)
			{
				obj = new Const(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(typeRef.ToString()), constName);
				SetVariableProperties(obj, typeRef, nameRange, shouldAddTypeRef, operatorRange);
				if (constValue != null)
				{
					obj.Expression = constValue;
					obj.SetRange(GetRange(startRange, constValue));
				}
				else
				{
					obj.SetRange(GetRange(startRange, tToken));
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private void SetVariableProperties(Variable variable, TypeReferenceExpression typeRef, SourceRange nameRange, bool shouldAddTypeRef, SourceRange operatorRange)
		{
			if (variable != null)
			{
				variable.NameRange = nameRange;
				variable.MemberTypeReference = typeRef;
				variable.TypeRange = typeRef.Range;
				variable.OperatorRange = operatorRange;
				if (shouldAddTypeRef)
				{
					variable.AddDetailNode(typeRef);
				}
				else
				{
					typeRef.SetParent(variable);
				}
			}
		}

		protected Variable CreateVariable(string name, TypeReferenceExpression typeRef, Expression initializer, SourceRange nameRange, SourceRange startRange, bool shouldAddTypeRef, SourceRange operatorRange)
		{
			if (typeRef == null || name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!shouldAddTypeRef)
			{
				typeRef = typeRef.Clone() as TypeReferenceExpression;
				typeRef.Comments.Clear();
			}
			Variable variable = null;
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				InitializedVariable initializedVariable = new InitializedVariable(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(typeRef.ToString()), name);
				SetVariableProperties(initializedVariable, typeRef, nameRange, shouldAddTypeRef, operatorRange);
				initializedVariable.Expression = initializer;
				initializedVariable.SetRange(GetRange(startRange, initializer));
				return initializedVariable;
			}
			variable = new Variable(GlobalStringStorage.Intern(typeRef.ToString()), name);
			SetVariableProperties(variable, typeRef, nameRange, shouldAddTypeRef, operatorRange);
			variable.SetRange(GetRange(startRange, nameRange));
			return variable;
		}

		protected ImplicitVariable CreateImplicitVariable(string name, Expression initializer, SourceRange nameRange, SourceRange startRange, bool shouldAddTypeRef, SourceRange operatorRange, SourceRange varKeywordRange)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ImplicitVariable implicitVariable = new ImplicitVariable(name, initializer);
			implicitVariable.NameRange = nameRange;
			implicitVariable.OperatorRange = operatorRange;
			if (initializer != null)
			{
				implicitVariable.AddDetailNode(initializer);
				implicitVariable.SetRange(GetRange(startRange, initializer));
			}
			else
			{
				implicitVariable.SetRange(GeneratedParserBase.GetRange(startRange, nameRange.End));
			}
			implicitVariable.TypeRange = varKeywordRange;
			return implicitVariable;
		}

		protected ImplicitVariable CreateImplicitVariable(string name, SourceRange nameRange, SourceRange startRange, bool shouldAddTypeRef)
		{
			if (name == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ImplicitVariable implicitVariable = new ImplicitVariable(name);
			implicitVariable.NameRange = nameRange;
			return implicitVariable;
		}

		protected TypeParameter GetTypeParameter(GenericModifier modifier, string paramName)
		{
			if (modifier == null || modifier.TypeParameters == null || modifier.TypeParameters.Count == 0 || paramName == null || paramName.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < modifier.TypeParameters.Count; i++)
			{
				if (modifier.TypeParameters[i].Name == paramName)
				{
					return modifier.TypeParameters[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void SetTypeArguments(ReferenceExpressionBase expression, TypeReferenceExpressionCollection typeRefColl)
		{
			if (expression != null && typeRefColl != null && typeRefColl.Count != 0)
			{
				expression.TypeArguments = typeRefColl;
			}
		}

		protected int EndOf(string symbol, int start, bool whitespaces)
		{
			while (start < symbol.Length && (char.IsWhiteSpace(symbol[start]) ^ !whitespaces))
			{
				start++;
			}
			return start;
		}

		protected string RemPPDirective(string symbol)
		{
			int start = 1;
			start = EndOf(symbol, start, whitespaces: true);
			start = EndOf(symbol, start, whitespaces: false);
			start = EndOf(symbol, start, whitespaces: true);
			int num = EndOf(symbol, start, whitespaces: false);
			return symbol.Substring(start, num - start);
		}

		protected void AddCCS(string symbol)
		{
			symbol = RemPPDirective(symbol);
			if (!ccs.Contains(symbol))
			{
				ccs.Add(symbol);
			}
		}

		protected void RemCCS(string symbol)
		{
			ccs.Remove(RemPPDirective(symbol));
		}

		protected bool IsCCS(string symbol)
		{
			return ccs.Contains(RemPPDirective(symbol));
		}

		private void ParseTypeEnd()
		{
			if (la != null && la.Type == 115)
			{
				LanguageElement context = base.Context;
				NamespaceMemberDeclarationEnd(base.Context, addToList: false);
				if (context != base.Context)
				{
					CallAppropriateParseRule(base.Context);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetUnclosedMemberContext()
		{
			_UnclosedMemberContext = base.Context;
			if (_UnclosedMemberContext is Member member)
			{
				member.Unclosed = true;
			}
		}

		private void CloseMemberContextIfNeeded(LanguageElement newContext)
		{
			if (_UnclosedMemberContext != null && base.Context == _UnclosedMemberContext && (newContext is Method || newContext is Property))
			{
				_UnclosedMemberContext = null;
				CloseContext();
			}
		}

		protected override void OpenContext(LanguageElement newContext)
		{
			CloseMemberContextIfNeeded(newContext);
			base.OpenContext(newContext);
		}

		private void CloseMemberContext(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null || token.Type == 115)
			{
				CloseContext();
			}
			else
			{
				SetUnclosedMemberContext();
			}
		}

		private string GetAccessorName(string prefix)
		{
			if (base.Context is Member { ImplementsCount: >0 } member)
			{
				string empty = string.Empty;
				if (member.ImplementsExpressions[0] is QualifiedElementReference { Qualifier: not null } qualifiedElementReference)
				{
					return qualifiedElementReference.Qualifier.ToString() + "." + prefix + member.GetNameWithoutImplementsQualifier();
				}
			}
			return prefix + base.Context.Name;
		}

		private static BitArray NewSet(params int[] values)
		{
			BitArray bitArray = new BitArray(160);
			foreach (int index in values)
			{
				bitArray[index] = true;
			}
			return bitArray;
		}

		protected bool IsAssignment()
		{
			if (la.Type == 1)
			{
				return Peek().Type == 87;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool NotFinalComma()
		{
			int type = Peek().Type;
			if (la.Type == 91 && type != 115)
			{
				return type != 116;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsQualident(ref Token pt, out string qualident)
		{
			qualident = "";
			if (pt.Type == 1)
			{
				qualident = pt.Value;
				pt = Peek();
				while (pt.Type == 94)
				{
					pt = Peek();
					if (pt.Type != 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					qualident = qualident + "." + pt.Value;
					pt = Peek();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsGeneric()
		{
			if (_ParsingRazor && _RazorParsingMode == RazorParsingMode.Expression)
			{
				return false;
			}
			scanner.ResetPeek();
			Token pt = la;
			if (!IsTypeArgumentList(ref pt))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsTypeArgumentList(ref Token pt)
		{
			if (pt.Type == 104)
			{
				pt = Peek();
				while (true)
				{
					if (!IsType(ref pt))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (pt.Type == 97)
					{
						pt = Peek();
						return true;
					}
					if (pt.Type != 91)
					{
						break;
					}
					pt = Peek();
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Token MoveToQuestionToken(Token questionToken)
		{
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			while (token != null && questionToken != null && token != questionToken)
			{
				token = Peek();
			}
			return Peek();
		}

		protected void CloseContextAndSetRange(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element != null && base.Context == element)
			{
				CloseContext();
				element.SetRange(GetRange(element, tToken));
			}
		}

		private bool SkipQualifier(ref Token pt)
		{
			if (pt.Type == 95 || pt.Type == 94)
			{
				pt = Peek();
				if (!IsQualident(ref pt, out var _))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsType(ref Token pt)
		{
			if (typeKW[pt.Type])
			{
				pt = Peek();
			}
			else if (pt.Type == 80)
			{
				pt = Peek();
				if (pt.Type != 120)
				{
					return false;
				}
				pt = Peek();
			}
			else
			{
				if (pt.Type != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				pt = Peek();
			}
			if (pt.Type == 104 && !IsTypeArgumentList(ref pt))
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (pt.Type == 95 || pt.Type == 94)
			{
				if (!SkipQualifier(ref pt))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (pt.Type == 104 && !IsTypeArgumentList(ref pt))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (pt.Type == 114)
			{
				Token token = pt;
				if (IsConditionalExpressionCore())
				{
					return false;
				}
				pt = MoveToQuestionToken(pt);
			}
			return SkipPointerOrDims(ref pt);
		}

		protected bool IsLocalVarDecl()
		{
			Token pt = la;
			bool flag = la.Match(1) && la.Value == "await";
			if (IsAsyncContext && flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ResetPeek();
				if (Peek().Match(1))
				{
					return Peek().Match(118);
				}
			}
			if (IsSqlExpression())
			{
				return false;
			}
			scanner.ResetPeek();
			if (IsType(ref pt))
			{
				if (pt.Type != 1 && pt.Type != 94)
				{
					return pt.Type == 101;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsDims()
		{
			int type = Peek().Type;
			if (la.Type == 101)
			{
				if (type != 91)
				{
					return type == 116;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsLBRACK()
		{
			int type = Peek().Type;
			return la.Type == 101;
		}

		protected bool IsPointerOrDims()
		{
			if (la.Type != 120)
			{
				return IsDims();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool SkipPointerOrDims(ref Token pt)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				if (pt.Type == 101)
				{
					do
					{
						pt = Peek();
					}
					while (pt.Type == 91);
					if (pt.Type != 116)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (pt.Type != 120)
				{
					break;
				}
				pt = Peek();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsAttrTargSpec()
		{
			if (la.Type == 1 || keyword[la.Type])
			{
				return Peek().Type == 90;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsFieldDecl()
		{
			int type = Peek().Type;
			if (la.Type == 1)
			{
				if (type != 91 && type != 87)
				{
					return type == 118;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsTypeCast()
		{
			if (la.Type != 102)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsSimpleTypeCast())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return GuessTypeCast();
		}

		protected bool IsSimpleTypeCast()
		{
			scanner.ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			Token token2 = Peek();
			if (typeKW[token.Type])
			{
				if (token2.Type != 117 && token2.Type != 120)
				{
					if (token2.Type == 114)
					{
						return Peek().Type == 117;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool GuessTypeCast()
		{
			scanner.ResetPeek();
			Token pt = Peek();
			if (!IsType(ref pt))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pt.Type != 117)
			{
				return false;
			}
			pt = Peek();
			if (_ActiveSqlExpression != null && pt.Type == 1 && IsSqlKeyword(pt.Value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsAdressOfOperation(pt.Type))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return castFollower[pt.Type];
		}

		private bool IsAdressOfOperation(int tokenType)
		{
			if (tokenType != 85)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsUnsafeContext())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsImplicitVariable()
		{
			if (WorkAsCSharp30Parser)
			{
				return string.Compare(la.Value, "var") == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsUnsafeContext()
		{
			if (!IsUnsafeMethod())
			{
				return IsUnsafeStatement();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsUnsafeMethod()
		{
			AccessSpecifiedElement accessSpecifiedElement = base.Context as AccessSpecifiedElement;
			if (accessSpecifiedElement == null)
			{
				accessSpecifiedElement = base.Context.GetParentMethodOrAccessor() as AccessSpecifiedElement;
			}
			return accessSpecifiedElement?.IsUnsafe ?? false;
		}

		private bool IsUnsafeStatement()
		{
			UnsafeStatement unsafeStatement = base.Context as UnsafeStatement;
			if (unsafeStatement == null)
			{
				unsafeStatement = base.Context.GetParent(LanguageElementType.UnsafeStatement) as UnsafeStatement;
			}
			if (unsafeStatement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool IsGlobalAttrTarget()
		{
			Token token = Peek();
			if (la.Type == 101 && token.Type == 1)
			{
				if (!"assembly".Equals(token.Value))
				{
					return "module".Equals(token.Value);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsExternAliasDirective()
		{
			if (la.Type == 30)
			{
				return "alias".Equals(Peek().Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsLtNoWs()
		{
			return la.Type == 104;
		}

		protected bool IsNoSwitchLabelOrRBrace()
		{
			if (la.Type == 14 || la.Type == 22 || la.Type == 115)
			{
				if (la.Type == 22)
				{
					return Peek().Type != 90;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsSqlKeyword(string name)
		{
			switch (name)
			{
			default:
				return name == "into";
			case "select":
			case "from":
			case "join":
			case "on":
			case "where":
			case "let":
			case "orderby":
			case "ascending":
			case "descending":
			case "group":
			case "by":
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected bool QueryIdentHasType()
		{
			ResetPeek();
			Token token = Peek();
			if (token.Type != 40)
			{
				return !IsSqlKeyword(token.Value);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsPartOfMemberName()
		{
			scanner.ResetPeek();
			Token pt = la;
			if (!IsTypeArgumentList(ref pt))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return pt.Type != 102;
		}

		public override ExpressionParserBase CreateExpressionParser()
		{
			return new CSharp30ExpressionParser(this);
		}

		public override bool SupportsFileExtension(string ext)
		{
			return ext.ToLower() == ".cs";
		}

		public override IExpressionInverter CreateExpressionInverter()
		{
			return new CSharpExpressionInverter();
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(LanguageElement a, LanguageElement b)
		{
			if (a != null && b != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.InternalRange.Start, b.InternalRange.End);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(LanguageElement a, SourceRange b)
		{
			if (a != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.InternalRange.Start, b.End);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(LanguageElement a, Token b)
		{
			if (a != null && b != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.InternalRange.Start, b.Range.End);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(Token a, Token b)
		{
			if (a != null && b != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.Line, a.Column, b.EndLine, b.EndColumn);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(Token a, SourceRange b)
		{
			if (a != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.Line, a.Column, b.End.Line, b.End.Offset);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(Token a, LanguageElement b)
		{
			if (a != null && b != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.Line, a.Column, b.InternalRange.End.Line, b.InternalRange.End.Offset);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(SourceRange a, SourceRange b)
		{
			return new SourceRange(a.Start, b.End);
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(SourceRange a, Token b)
		{
			if (b != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.Start.Line, a.Start.Offset, b.EndLine, b.EndColumn);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public static SourceRange GetRange(SourceRange a, LanguageElement b)
		{
			if (b != null)
			{
				return new SourceRange(a.Start, b.InternalRange.End);
			}
			return SourceRange.Empty;
		}

		public override bool IsQueryExpressionStart(string lineText)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(lineText))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] array = lineText.Split(' ', '\t');
			int num = array.Length;
			if (num > 2)
			{
				string text = array[num - 2];
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return string.Compare(text, "from", StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsIdent(Token token)
		{
			return token.Type == 1;
		}

		private void FirstGet()
		{
			la = new FormattingToken(TokenLanguage.CSharp);
			la.Value = "";
			string text = scanner.FirstSkip();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				((FormattingToken)la).FormattingElements.AddSourceFileStartText(text);
			}
			Get();
		}
	}

	public enum RazorParsingMode
	{
		None,
		Statement,
		Expression,
		Helper,
		Functions

	public class CSharp30ExpressionParser : ExpressionParserBase
	{
		public CSharp30ExpressionParser(ParserBase parser)
			: base(parser)
		{
		}

		private CSharp30Parser GetParser()
		{
			CSharp30Parser cSharp30Parser = base.Parser as CSharp30Parser;
			if (cSharp30Parser == null)
			{
				cSharp30Parser = new CSharp30Parser();
			}
			return cSharp30Parser;
		}

		private void UseLikeExpressionParser(Action<CSharp30Parser> action)
		{
			bool shouldWorkAsExpressionParser = false;
			CSharp30Parser parser = GetParser();
			if (parser != null)
			{
				shouldWorkAsExpressionParser = parser.ShouldWorkAsExpressionParser;
				parser.ShouldWorkAsExpressionParser = true;
			}
			try
			{
				action?.Invoke(parser);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (parser != null)
				{
					parser.ShouldWorkAsExpressionParser = shouldWorkAsExpressionParser;
				}
			}
		}

		public override Expression Parse(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			Expression result = null;
			UseLikeExpressionParser(delegate(CSharp30Parser parser)
			{
				result = parser.ParseExpression(reader);
			});
			return result;
		}

		public override TypeReferenceExpression ParseTypeReferenceExpression(ISourceReader reader)
		{
			TypeReferenceExpression result = null;
			UseLikeExpressionParser(delegate(CSharp30Parser parser)
			{
				result = parser.ParseTypeReferenceExpression(reader);
			});
			return result;
		}
	}

	public abstract class CSharpScannerBase : GeneratedScannerBase
	{
		private ScannerExtension _ScannerExtension;

		private bool _InPreprocess;

		protected ScannerExtension ScannerExtension
		{
			get
			{
				return _ScannerExtension;
			}
			set
			{
				_ScannerExtension = value;
			}
		}

		public bool InPreprocess
		{
			get
			{
				return _InPreprocess;
			}
			set
			{
				_InPreprocess = value;
			}
		}

		protected override Token CreateToken()
		{
			return new FormattingToken(TokenLanguage.CSharp);
		}

		protected override bool NextTokenStart()
		{
			return base.NextTokenStart();
		}

		private void ChangeTokenType(Token token)
		{
			if (token != null)
			{
				switch (token.Type)
				{
				case 175:
					token.Type = 153;
					break;
				case 176:
					token.Type = 154;
					break;
				case 177:
					token.Type = 155;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckForInvalidComments(ref Token token)
		{
			string value = token.Value;
			if (value != null && value.Length != 0 && !value.StartsWith("/"))
			{
				int num = value.IndexOf(".");
				if (num > 0)
				{
					string text = value.Substring(0, num);
					int tokenType = (text.StartsWith("@") ? 5 : 2);
					Token token2 = new CategorizedToken(token.Line, token.Column, token.EndLine, token.EndColumn - 1, tokenType, text);
					token2.StartPosition = token.StartPosition;
					token2.EndPosition = token.EndPosition - 1;
					Token token3 = new CategorizedToken(token.EndLine, token.EndColumn - 1, token.EndLine, token.EndColumn, 94, ".");
					token3.StartPosition = token.EndPosition - 1;
					token3.EndPosition = token.EndPosition;
					token2.Next = token3;
					token = token2;
				}
			}
		}

		private TokenCollection GetExtensionTokens(Token scannerToken)
		{
			TokenCollection tokenCollection = new TokenCollection();
			if (scannerToken == null)
			{
				return tokenCollection;
			}
			if (scannerToken.Type == 0)
			{
				return _ScannerExtension.GetTailTokens();
			}
			Token token = null;
			for (token = _ScannerExtension.Scan(scannerToken.Range.Start); token != null; token = _ScannerExtension.Scan(scannerToken.Range.Start))
			{
				tokenCollection.Insert(0, token);
			}
			return tokenCollection;
		}

		private void InsertExtensionTokens(ref Token start, TokenCollection extensionTokens)
		{
			Token token = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < extensionTokens.Count; i++)
			{
				token = extensionTokens[i];
				token.Next = start;
				start = token;
			}
		}

		public override Token Scan()
		{
			if (_ScannerExtension == null)
			{
				return base.Scan();
			}
			Token scannerToken = base.Scan();
			InsertExtensionTokens(ref tokens, GetExtensionTokens(scannerToken));
			pt = tokens;
			ChangeTokenType(tokens);
			return tokens;
		}

		public override Token Peek()
		{
			if (_ScannerExtension == null)
			{
				return base.Peek();
			}
			Token token = base.Peek();
			Token next = tokens;
			while (next != null && next.Next != token)
			{
				next = next.Next;
			}
			if (next == null)
			{
				return token;
			}
			InsertExtensionTokens(ref pt, GetExtensionTokens(token));
			next.Next = pt;
			ChangeTokenType(pt);
			return pt;
		}

		protected override void NextTokenEnd()
		{
			if (t == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (t.Type)
			{
			case 149:
				CheckForInvalidComments(ref t);
				break;
			case 124:
				if (t.Value.StartsWith("///") && !t.Value.StartsWith("////"))
				{
					t.Type = 149;
				}
				break;
			case 125:
				if (t.Value.StartsWith("/**") && !t.Value.StartsWith("/***"))
				{
					t.Type = 150;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void SkipIgnoredChars()
		{
			while (ch != '\uffff' && ch < 'ÿ' && ignore[ch] && (!InPreprocess || (ch != '\r' && ch != '\n')))
			{
				NextCh();
			}
		}

		protected override void SetInPreprocess()
		{
			if (t.Value == "#else")
			{
				InPreprocess = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void ResetInPreprocess()
		{
			if (t.Value == "#else")
			{
				InPreprocess = false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsNextChar(char c)
		{
			SkipWs();
			return ch == c;
		}

		public bool IsEof()
		{
			return IsNextChar('\uffff');
		}

		public string SkipToEOL()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			while (!IsLineTerminator(stringBuilder) && !IsEof(stringBuilder))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(ch);
				NextCh();
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void SkipWs()
		{
			while (ch == ' ' || ch == '\t')
			{
				NextCh();
			}
		}

		private bool IsLineTerminator(StringBuilder sb)
		{
			if (ch == '\r')
			{
				sb.Append(ch);
				NextCh();
				if (ch == '\n')
				{
					sb.Append(ch);
					NextCh();
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (ch == '\n')
			{
				sb.Append(ch);
				NextCh();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsEOLChar(char ch)
		{
			if (!InPreprocess)
			{
				return ch == '\n';
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsCRChar(char ch)
		{
			if (!InPreprocess)
			{
				return ch == '\r';
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override FormattingElements GetNextFormattingTokenElements()
		{
			bool inPreprocess = InPreprocess;
			if (t.Type == 7)
			{
				InPreprocess = false;
			}
			try
			{
				return base.GetNextFormattingTokenElements();
			}
			finally
			{
				InPreprocess = inPreprocess;
			}
		}
	}
	public class CSharpExpressionInverter : ExpressionInverterBase
	{
		protected override Expression InvertIsExpression(Is expression)
		{
			return ExpressionInverterBase.DefaultInvert(expression);
		}

		protected override Expression InvertIsNotExpression(IsNot expression)
		{
			return ExpressionInverterBase.DefaultInvert(expression);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class CSharpLanguageUtils : LanguageUtils
	{
		private class CSharpTokenizer : Tokenizer
		{
			public override IList<CategorizedToken> GetTokens(string code, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType codeEmbeddingDefaultLanguage)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
				{
					return null;
				}
				ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
				CSharp30Parser cSharp30Parser = new CSharp30Parser();
				cSharp30Parser.WorkAsCSharp30Parser = true;
				cSharp30Parser.SetTokensCategory = true;
				cSharp30Parser.Parse(reader);
				TokenCollection savedTokens = cSharp30Parser.SavedTokens;
				int count = savedTokens.Count;
				List<CategorizedToken> list = new List<CategorizedToken>();
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					CategorizedToken item = (CategorizedToken)savedTokens[i];
					list.Add(item);
				}
				return list.AsReadOnly();
			}
		}

		public override Tokenizer CreateTokenizer()
		{
			return new CSharpTokenizer();
		}

		public override ParserBase CreateParser(ParserVersion version, EmbededLanguageKind languageKind, DotNetLanguageType embededLanguage)
		{
			CSharp30Parser cSharp30Parser = new CSharp30Parser();
			if (version > ParserVersion.VS2005)
			{
				cSharp30Parser.WorkAsCSharp30Parser = true;
			}
			return cSharp30Parser;
		}

		public override CodeGen CreateCodeGen()
		{
			return new CSharpCodeGen();
		}

		public override ElementBuilder CreateElementBuilder()
		{
			return new ElementBuilder();
		}
	}
	public sealed class CSharpOperatorHelper
	{
		private static OperatorType GetUnaryOperatorType(string name)
		{
			return name switch
			{
				"--" => OperatorType.Decrement, 
				"++" => OperatorType.Increment, 
				"-" => OperatorType.UnaryNegation, 
				"+" => OperatorType.UnaryPlus, 
				"!" => OperatorType.LogicalNot, 
				"true" => OperatorType.True, 
				"false" => OperatorType.False, 
				"&" => OperatorType.AddressOf, 
				"~" => OperatorType.OnesComplement, 
				"*" => OperatorType.PointerDereference, 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		private static OperatorType GetBinaryOperatorType(string name)
		{
			return name switch
			{
				"+" => OperatorType.Addition, 
				"-" => OperatorType.Subtraction, 
				"*" => OperatorType.Multiply, 
				"/" => OperatorType.Division, 
				"%" => OperatorType.Modulus, 
				"^" => OperatorType.ExclusiveOr, 
				"&" => OperatorType.BitwiseAnd, 
				"|" => OperatorType.BitwiseOr, 
				"&&" => OperatorType.LogicalAnd, 
				"||" => OperatorType.LogicalOr, 
				"=" => OperatorType.Assign, 
				"<<" => OperatorType.LeftShift, 
				">>" => OperatorType.RightShift, 
				"==" => OperatorType.Equality, 
				">" => OperatorType.GreaterThan, 
				"<" => OperatorType.LessThan, 
				"!=" => OperatorType.Inequality, 
				">=" => OperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual, 
				"<=" => OperatorType.LessThanOrEqual, 
				"->" => OperatorType.MemberSelection, 
				">>=" => OperatorType.RightShiftAssignment, 
				"*=" => OperatorType.MultiplicationAssignment, 
				"->*" => OperatorType.PointerToMemberSelection, 
				"-=" => OperatorType.SubtractionAssignment, 
				"^=" => OperatorType.ExclusiveOrAssignment, 
				"<<=" => OperatorType.LeftShiftAssignment, 
				"%=" => OperatorType.ModulusAssignment, 
				"+=" => OperatorType.AdditionAssignment, 
				"&=" => OperatorType.BitwiseAndAssignment, 
				"|=" => OperatorType.BitwiseOrAssignment, 
				"," => OperatorType.Comma, 
				"/=" => OperatorType.DivisionAssignment, 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		private static OperatorType GetUnaryOperatorTypeByMethodName(string methodName)
		{
			return methodName switch
			{
				"op_Decrement" => OperatorType.Decrement, 
				"op_Increment" => OperatorType.Increment, 
				"op_UnaryNegation" => OperatorType.UnaryNegation, 
				"op_UnaryPlus" => OperatorType.UnaryPlus, 
				"op_LogicalNot" => OperatorType.LogicalNot, 
				"op_True" => OperatorType.True, 
				"op_False" => OperatorType.False, 
				"op_AddressOf" => OperatorType.AddressOf, 
				"op_OnesComplement" => OperatorType.OnesComplement, 
				"op_PointerDereference" => OperatorType.PointerDereference, 
				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};
		}

		private static OperatorType GetBinaryOperatorTypeByMethodName(string methodName)
		{
			return methodName switch
			{
				"op_Addition" => OperatorType.Addition, 
				"op_Subtraction" => OperatorType.Subtraction, 
				"op_Multiply" => OperatorType.Multiply, 
				"op_Division" => OperatorType.Division, 
				"op_Modulus" => OperatorType.Modulus, 
				"op_ExclusiveOr" => OperatorType.ExclusiveOr, 
				"op_BitwiseAnd" => OperatorType.BitwiseAnd, 
				"op_BitwiseOr" => OperatorType.BitwiseOr, 
				"op_LogicalAnd" => OperatorType.LogicalAnd, 
				"op_LogicalOr" => OperatorType.LogicalOr, 
				"op_Assign" => OperatorType.Assign, 
				"op_LeftShift" => OperatorType.LeftShift, 
				"op_RightShift" => OperatorType.RightShift,

		}

		public static OperatorType GetOperatorTypeByMethodName(string methodName)
		{
			OperatorType unaryOperatorTypeByMethodName = GetUnaryOperatorTypeByMethodName(methodName);
			if (unaryOperatorTypeByMethodName != OperatorType.None)
			{
				return unaryOperatorTypeByMethodName;
			}
			return GetBinaryOperatorTypeByMethodName(methodName);
		}

				_ => OperatorType.None, 
			};

			};

				_ => FormattingTokenType.None, 
			};
		}

		public static BinaryOperatorExpression GetBinaryOperator(Expression left, OperatorType type, Expression right)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case OperatorType.Addition:
			case OperatorType.Subtraction:
			case OperatorType.Multiply:
			case OperatorType.Division:
			case OperatorType.Modulus:
				return new BinaryOperatorExpression(left, GetBinaryOperatorText(type), right);
			case OperatorType.ExclusiveOr:
				return new LogicalOperation(left, LogicalOperator.ExclusiveOr, right);
			case OperatorType.BitwiseAnd:
				return new LogicalOperation(left, LogicalOperator.And, right);
			case OperatorType.BitwiseOr:
				return new LogicalOperation(left, LogicalOperator.Or, right);
			case OperatorType.LogicalAnd:
				return new LogicalOperation(left, LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitAnd, right);
			case OperatorType.LogicalOr:
				return new LogicalOperation(left, LogicalOperator.ShortCircuitOr, right);
			case OperatorType.Assign:
				return new AssignmentExpression(left, GetBinaryOperatorText(type), right);
			case OperatorType.LeftShift:
			case OperatorType.RightShift:
				return new BinaryOperatorExpression(left, GetBinaryOperatorText(type), right);
			case OperatorType.Equality:
				return new RelationalOperation(left, RelationalOperator.Equality, right);
			case OperatorType.GreaterThan:
				return new RelationalOperation(left, RelationalOperator.GreaterThan, right);
			case OperatorType.LessThan:
				return new RelationalOperation(left, RelationalOperator.LessThan, right);
			case OperatorType.Inequality:
				return new RelationalOperation(left, RelationalOperator.Inequality, right);
			case OperatorType.GreaterThanOrEqual:
				return new RelationalOperation(left, RelationalOperator.GreaterOrEqual, right);
			case OperatorType.LessThanOrEqual:
				return new RelationalOperation(left, RelationalOperator.LessOrEqual, right);
			case OperatorType.PointerToMemberSelection:
				return null;
			case OperatorType.MemberSelection:
				return null;
			case OperatorType.RightShiftAssignment:
			case OperatorType.MultiplicationAssignment:
			case OperatorType.SubtractionAssignment:
			case OperatorType.ExclusiveOrAssignment:
			case OperatorType.LeftShiftAssignment:
			case OperatorType.ModulusAssignment:
			case OperatorType.AdditionAssignment:
			case OperatorType.BitwiseAndAssignment:
			case OperatorType.BitwiseOrAssignment:
			case OperatorType.DivisionAssignment:
				return new AssignmentExpression(left, GetBinaryOperatorText(type), right);
			case OperatorType.Comma:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class CSharpPrimitiveTypeUtils
	{
		private const string STR_0X = "0X";

		private const string STR_0x = "0x";

		private const string STR_L = "L";

		private const string STR_U = "u";

		private const string STR_Lu = "lu";

		private const string STR_Ul = "ul";

		private const string STR_F = "f";

		private const string STR_D = "d";

		private const string STR_M = "m";

		private CSharpPrimitiveTypeUtils()
		{
		}

		private static bool IsHexLiteral(string value)
		{
			if (!value.StartsWith("0x"))
			{
				return value.StartsWith("0X");
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ConvertToDecimal(string value, out decimal result)
		{
			result = -1m;
			try
			{
				decimal num;
				if (IsHexLiteral(value))
				{
					num = Convert.ToUInt64(value.Substring(2), 16);
					result = num;
					return true;
				}
				num = Convert.ToDecimal(value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.NumberFormat);
				result = num;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static PrimitiveType GetIntegerTypeFromValue(string value)
		{
			if (!ConvertToDecimal(value, out var result))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			return PrimitiveTypeUtils.GetPrimitiveType(result);
		}

		private static string GetIntegerLiteralSuffix(string value)
		{
			string str = value.ToLower();
			if (EndsWith(str, "ul"))
			{
				return "ul";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "lu"))
			{
				return "lu";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "u"))
			{
				return "u";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "L"))
			{
				return "L";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static string GetFloatingPointLiteralSuffix(string value)
		{
			string str = value.ToLower();
			if (EndsWith(str, "f"))
			{
				return "f";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "d"))
			{
				return "d";
			}
			if (EndsWith(str, "m"))
			{
				return "m";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static bool GetIntegerLiteralValue(string value, out decimal intValue)
		{
			intValue = -1m;
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string integerLiteralSuffix = GetIntegerLiteralSuffix(value);
			decimal result;
			if (integerLiteralSuffix != null && integerLiteralSuffix.Length > 0)
			{
				string value2 = value.Substring(0, value.Length - integerLiteralSuffix.Length);
				if (!ConvertToDecimal(value2, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
				intValue = result;
				return true;
			}
			if (!ConvertToDecimal(value, out result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			intValue = result;
			return true;
		}

		private static bool GetFloatingPointLiteralValue(string value, out decimal realValue)
		{
			realValue = -1m;
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string floatingPointLiteralSuffix = GetFloatingPointLiteralSuffix(value);
			decimal result;
			if (floatingPointLiteralSuffix != null && floatingPointLiteralSuffix.Length > 0)
			{
				string value2 = value.Substring(0, value.Length - floatingPointLiteralSuffix.Length);
				if (!ConvertToDecimal(value2, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
				realValue = result;
				return true;
			}
			if (!ConvertToDecimal(value, out result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			realValue = result;
			return true;
		}

		private static PrimitiveType NarrowIntegerLiteralType(string value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			if (!GetIntegerLiteralValue(value, out var intValue))
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			string integerLiteralSuffix = GetIntegerLiteralSuffix(value);
			if (integerLiteralSuffix != null && integerLiteralSuffix.Length > 0)
			{
				return NarrowIntegerLiteralType(integerLiteralSuffix, intValue);
			}
			PrimitiveType integerTypeFromValue = GetIntegerTypeFromValue(value);
			switch (integerTypeFromValue)
			{
			case PrimitiveType.Byte:
			case PrimitiveType.SByte:
			case PrimitiveType.Int16:
			case PrimitiveType.Int32:
			case PrimitiveType.UInt16:
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			case PrimitiveType.UInt32:
			case PrimitiveType.UInt64:
				return integerTypeFromValue;
			default:
				return PrimitiveType.Int64;
			}
		}

		private static PrimitiveType NarrowIntegerLiteralType(string suffix, decimal intValue)
		{
			if (suffix == null && suffix.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			switch (suffix)
			{
			case "ul":
			case "lu":
				return PrimitiveType.UInt64;
			case "u":
				if (PrimitiveTypeUtils.IsUInt(intValue))
				{
					return PrimitiveType.UInt32;
				}
				if (PrimitiveTypeUtils.IsULong(intValue))
				{
					return PrimitiveType.UInt64;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (suffix == "L")
			{
				if (PrimitiveTypeUtils.IsLong(intValue))
				{
					return PrimitiveType.Int64;
				}
				if (PrimitiveTypeUtils.IsULong(intValue))
				{
					return PrimitiveType.UInt64;
				}
			}
			return PrimitiveType.Int32;
		}

		private static bool EndsWith(string str, string strEnd)
		{
			if (str == null || strEnd == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return str.EndsWith(strEnd, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase);
		}

		private static PrimitiveType NarrowFloatingPointLiteralType(string value)
		{
			string floatingPointLiteralSuffix = GetFloatingPointLiteralSuffix(value);
			if (floatingPointLiteralSuffix == null || floatingPointLiteralSuffix.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Double;
			}
			return floatingPointLiteralSuffix switch
			{
				"f" => PrimitiveType.Single, 
				"d" => PrimitiveType.Double, 
				"m" => PrimitiveType.Decimal, 
				_ => PrimitiveType.Double, 
			};
		}

		private static string RemoveQuotes(string s)
		{
			if (s == null || s.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (s == "@\"\"")
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (s == "\"\"")
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = 1;
			if (s.StartsWith("@\""))
			{
				num = 2;
			}
			int length = s.Length - num - 1;
			s = s.Substring(num, length);
			return ReplaceEscapes(s);
		}

		private static string RemoveCharQuotes(string s)
		{
			if (s == null || s.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (s == "''")
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			int num = 1;
			int length = s.Length - num - 1;
			s = s.Substring(num, length);
			return ReplaceEscapes(s);
		}

		private static int GetEscapeSequenceIndex(string s, int startIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex == -1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			string[] array = new string[13]
			{
				"\\\\'", "\\\\\\\"", "\\\\r", "\\\\n", "\\\\a", "\\\\0", "\\\\b", "\\\\f", "\\\\t", "\\\\v",
				"\\\\U", "\\\\x", "\\\\u"
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				int num = s.IndexOf(array[i], startIndex);
				if (num != -1)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private static string ReplaceEscapes(string s)
		{
			if (s == null || s.Length == 0)
			{
				return s;
			}
			if (s.StartsWith("@"))
			{
				return s;
			}
			int num = s.IndexOf("\\\\");
			int escapeSequenceIndex = GetEscapeSequenceIndex(s, num);
			while (num >= 0)
			{
				if (num == escapeSequenceIndex)
				{
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					s = s.Remove(num, 2);
					s = s.Insert(num, "\\");
				}
				num = s.IndexOf("\\\\", num);
				escapeSequenceIndex = GetEscapeSequenceIndex(s, num);
				if (num >= s.Length)
				{
					return s;
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s))
				{
					return s;
				}
			}
			return s;
		}

		public static PrimitiveType ToPrimitiveType(Token token)
		{
			return ToPrimitiveType(token, UnaryOperatorType.None);
		}

		public static PrimitiveType ToPrimitiveType(Token token, UnaryOperatorType typeOperator)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
			return ToPrimitiveType(token.Type, token.EscapedValue, typeOperator);
		}

		public static PrimitiveType ToPrimitiveType(int tokenType, string value)
		{
			return ToPrimitiveType(tokenType, value, UnaryOperatorType.None);
		}

		public static PrimitiveType ToPrimitiveType(int tokenType, string value, UnaryOperatorType typeOperator)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Void;
			}
			if (typeOperator == UnaryOperatorType.UnaryNegation)
			{
				value = "-" + value;
			}
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case 31:
			case 70:
				return PrimitiveType.Boolean;
			case 49:
				return PrimitiveType.Void;
			case 5:
				return PrimitiveType.String;
			case 4:
				return PrimitiveType.Char;
			case 2:
				return NarrowIntegerLiteralType(value);
			case 3:
				return NarrowFloatingPointLiteralType(value);
			default:
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
		}

		public static object ToPrimitiveValue(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ToPrimitiveValue(token.Type, token.EscapedValue);
		}

		public static object ToPrimitiveValue(int tokenType, string value)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return PrimitiveType.Void;
			}
			switch (tokenType)
			{
			case 70:
				return true;
			case 31:
				return false;
			case 49:
				return null;
			case 5:
				return RemoveQuotes(value);
			case 4:
			{
				string text = RemoveCharQuotes(value);
				if (text.Length == 1)
				{
					return Convert.ToChar(text);
				}
				return text;
			}
			case 2:
			{
				if (!GetIntegerLiteralValue(value, out var intValue))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return intValue;
			}
			case 3:
			{
				if (!GetFloatingPointLiteralValue(value, out var realValue))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return realValue;
			}
			default:
				return PrimitiveType.Int32;
			}
		}

		public static string GetTypeSuffix(object value, PrimitiveType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				PrimitiveType.SByte => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.Byte => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.Int32 => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.Int16 => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.UInt32 => "u", 
				PrimitiveType.UInt16 => string.Empty, 
				PrimitiveType.UInt64 => "ul", 
				PrimitiveType.Int64 => "L", 
				PrimitiveType.Single => "f", 
				PrimitiveType.Double => "d", 
				PrimitiveType.Decimal => "m", 
				_ => GetTypeSuffix(value), 
			};
		}

		private static string GetTypeSuffix(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is sbyte)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is byte)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is short)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is int)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is uint)
			{
				return "u";
			}
			if (value is ushort)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (value is ulong)
			{
				return "ul";
			}
			if (value is long)
			{
				return "L";
			}
			if (value is float)
			{
				return "f";
			}
			if (value is double)
			{
				return "d";
			}
			if (value is decimal)
			{
				return "m";
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	public sealed class CSharpPunctuators
	{
		private static Hashtable _Punctuators;

		public static ICollection TokenTypes => _Punctuators.Keys;

		private CSharpPunctuators()
		{
		}

		static CSharpPunctuators()
		{
			lock (typeof(CSharpPunctuators))

				_Punctuators.Add(151, ">>");

				_Punctuators.Add(152, ">>=");
				_Punctuators.Add(135, "->");
			}
		}

		public static string GetPunctuator(int token)
		{
			string result = "";
			if (_Punctuators.ContainsKey(token))
			{
				result = (string)_Punctuators[token];
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool IsPunctuator(int token)
		{
			return _Punctuators.ContainsKey(token);
		}

	public abstract class CSharpTokensBase : LanguageTokensBase
	{
		private Hashtable _Keywords;

		private Hashtable _Punctuators;

		private Hashtable _Directives;

		private string[] tokens;

		private Hashtable _PrimitiveToFullTypes;

		private Hashtable _FullToPrimitiveTypes;

		public CSharpTokensBase()
		{
			tokens = new string[200];
			PopulateTokenTable();
		}

		private void AddToken(int token, string name)
		{
			tokens[token] = name;
		}

		private void PopulateTokenTable()
		{
			LoadKeyWords();
			LoadPunctuators();
			LoadDirectives();
			LoadTypeConversionTables();
		}

		private void LoadKeyWords()
		{
			_Keywords = new Hashtable();
			StringCollection stringCollection = CreateKeywords();
			StringEnumerator enumerator = stringCollection.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					string current = enumerator.Current;
					int tokenType = GetTokenType(current);
					AddToken(tokenType, current);
					_Keywords[current] = tokenType;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetTokenType(string code)
		{
			TokenCollection tokenCollection = CSharpTokensHelper.GetTokens(code);
			if (tokenCollection == null || tokenCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Token token = tokenCollection[0];
			return token.Type;
		}

		private void LoadPunctuator(int type)
		{
			string punctuator = CSharpPunctuators.GetPunctuator(type);
			AddToken(type, punctuator);
			if (punctuator != null)
			{
				_Punctuators[punctuator] = type;
			}
		}

		private void LoadPunctuators()
		{
			_Punctuators = new Hashtable();
			IEnumerator enumerator = CSharpPunctuators.TokenTypes.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				LoadPunctuator((int)enumerator.Current);
			}
		}

		private void AddDirective(string name, int token)
		{
			_Directives[name] = token;
			AddToken(token, name);
		}

		private void LoadDirectives()
		{
			_Directives = new Hashtable();
			AddDirective("#region", 146);
			AddDirective("#endregion", 147);
			AddDirective("#if", 139);
			AddDirective("#else", 141);
			AddDirective("#elif", 140);
			AddDirective("#endif", 142);
			AddDirective("#define", 137);
			AddDirective("#undef", 138);
			AddDirective("#warning", 145);
			AddDirective("#error", 144);
			AddDirective("#line", 143);
			AddDirective("#pragma", 148);
		}

		private void LoadTypeConversionTables()
		{
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes = new Hashtable();
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["bool"] = "System.Boolean";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["byte"] = "System.Byte";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["sbyte"] = "System.SByte";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["char"] = "System.Char";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["decimal"] = "System.Decimal";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["double"] = "System.Double";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["float"] = "System.Single";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["int"] = "System.Int32";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["uint"] = "System.UInt32";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["long"] = "System.Int64";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["ulong"] = "System.UInt64";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["object"] = "System.Object";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["short"] = "System.Int16";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["ushort"] = "System.UInt16";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["string"] = "System.String";
			_PrimitiveToFullTypes["void"] = "System.Void";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes = new Hashtable();
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Boolean"] = "bool";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Byte"] = "byte";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.SByte"] = "sbyte";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Char"] = "char";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Decimal"] = "decimal";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Double"] = "double";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Single"] = "float";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Int32"] = "int";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.UInt32"] = "uint";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Int64"] = "long";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.UInt64"] = "ulong";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Object"] = "object";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Int16"] = "short";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.UInt16"] = "ushort";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.String"] = "string";
			_FullToPrimitiveTypes["System.Void"] = "void";
		}

		public bool IsUnaryOperator(Token token)
		{
			switch (token.Type)
			{
			case 92:
			case 99:
			case 106:
			case 110:
			case 112:
			case 119:
			case 120:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsHexDigit(char ch)
		{
			if (char.IsDigit(ch))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (char.IsLetter(ch))
			{
				switch (char.ToUpper(ch))
				{
				case 'A':
				case 'B':
				case 'C':
				case 'D':
				case 'E':
				case 'F':
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsRealTypeSuffix(char ch)
		{
			char c = char.ToLower(ch);
			if (c == 'd' || c == 'f' || c == 'm')
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsIdentifier(int tokenType)
		{
			return tokenType == 1;
		}

		public override bool IsIdentifier(string word)
		{
			return IsIdentifier(shortToToken(word));
		}

		public bool IsIdentifier(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsIdentifier(token.Type);
		}

		public override bool IsKeyword(string word)
		{
			return _Keywords.Contains(word);
		}

		public bool IsPunctuator(string s)
		{
			return _Punctuators.Contains(s);
		}

		public bool IsPunctuator(char ch)
		{
			return IsPunctuator(ch.ToString());
		}

		public bool IsPunctuator(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsPunctuator(token.EscapedValue);
		}

		public override bool IsDirective(int type)
		{
			return _Directives.ContainsValue(type);
		}

		public override bool IsComment(int type)
		{
			if (type != 124)
			{
				return type == 125;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsXmlDocComment(int type)
		{
			if (type != 149)
			{
				return type == 150;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsNumber(int type)
		{
			if (type != 2)
			{
				return type == 3;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsStringLiteral(int type)
		{
			return 5 == type;
		}

		private int shortToToken(string word)
		{
			if (_Punctuators.Contains(word))
			{
				return (int)_Punctuators[word];
			}
			if (_Keywords.Contains(word))
			{
				return (int)_Keywords[word];
			}
			if (_Directives.Contains(word))
			{
				return (int)_Directives[word];
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public override int ToTokenType(string token)
		{
			return shortToToken(token);
		}

		public int GetKeywordToken(string word)
		{
			object obj = _Keywords[word];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return (int)obj;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public int GetDirectiveToken(string word)
		{
			object obj = _Directives[word];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return (int)obj;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public int ToTokenType(Token token)
		{
			return ToTokenType(token.EscapedValue);
		}

		public override bool IsStandardType(string word)
		{
			if (word != "string" && word != "object")
			{
				return IsStandardType(shortToToken(word));
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsStandardType(int word)
		{
			if (word != 11 && word != 13 && word != 16 && word != 21 && word != 25 && word != 34 && word != 41 && word != 46 && word != 60 && word != 62 && word != 73 && word != 74 && word != 77)
			{
				return word == 80;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsBooleanLiteral(int tokenType)
		{
			if (tokenType != 70)
			{
				return tokenType == 31;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool IsBooleanLiteral(string word)
		{
			int tokenType = shortToToken(word);
			return IsBooleanLiteral(tokenType);
		}

		public bool IsNullLiteral(int tokenType)
		{
			return tokenType == 49;
		}

		public bool IsNullLiteral(string word)
		{
			int tokenType = shortToToken(word);
			return IsNullLiteral(tokenType);
		}

		public string GetFullTypeName(string simpleName)
		{
			if (simpleName == null || simpleName.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (_PrimitiveToFullTypes.ContainsKey(simpleName))
			{
				return string.Intern((string)_PrimitiveToFullTypes[simpleName]);
			}
			return simpleName;
		}

		public string GetSimpleTypeName(string fullName)
		{
			if (fullName == null || fullName.Length == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (_FullToPrimitiveTypes.ContainsKey(fullName))
			{
				return string.Intern((string)_FullToPrimitiveTypes[fullName]);
			}
			return fullName;
		}

		public string GetTokenString(int tokenType)
		{
			if (tokenType < 0 || tokenType > tokens.Length)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return tokens[tokenType];
		}
	}

		}

		public CSharpSourceFile(string fileName)
			: base(fileName)
		{
		}

		public override MemberVisibility GetDefaultVisibility()
		{
			return MemberVisibility.Internal;
		}

		public override BaseElement Clone(ElementCloneOptions options)
		{
			CSharpSourceFile cSharpSourceFile = new CSharpSourceFile();
			cSharpSourceFile.CloneDataFrom(this, options);
			return cSharpSourceFile;
		}

		public override int GetImageIndex()
		{
			return 76;
		}
	}

		public TokenCollection GetTokens(string code)

		}

		}
	}

			case 85:

				return TokenCategory.Operator;
			case 137:

				return TokenCategory.PreprocessorKeyword;
			case 4:

				return TokenCategory.String;
			case 2:
			case 3:
				return TokenCategory.Number;
			case 124:
			case 125:
				return TokenCategory.Comment;
			case 149:
			case 150:
				return TokenCategory.XmlComment;
			case 1:
				if (token.Value == "string" || token.Value == "object")
				{
					return TokenCategory.Keyword;
				}
				return TokenCategory.Identifier;
			case 0:
			case 7:
				return TokenCategory.Unknown;
			default:
				return TokenCategory.Text;
			}
		}

		public static TokenCollection GetTokens(string code)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(code))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ISourceReader reader = new SourceStringReader(code, 1, 1);
			CSharp30Parser cSharp30Parser = new CSharp30Parser();
			cSharp30Parser.SetTokensCategory = true;
			cSharp30Parser.Parse(reader);
			return cSharp30Parser.SavedTokens;
		}

		public static string GetTokenCategory(Token token, ParserVersion version)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return "Text";
			}
			string tokenCategory = GetTokenCategory(token);
			if (version >= ParserVersion.VS2010 && string.Compare(token.Value, "dynamic", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return "Keyword";
			}
			if (version >= ParserVersion.VS2008 && string.Compare(token.Value, "var", StringComparison.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return "Keyword";
			}
			return tokenCategory;
		}

		public static string GetTokenCategory(Token token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return "Text";
			}
			if (token is CategorizedToken)
			{
				switch ((token as CategorizedToken).Category)
				{
				case TokenCategory.Keyword:
					return "Keyword";
				case TokenCategory.Identifier:
					return "Identifier";
				case TokenCategory.Number:
					return "Number";
				case TokenCategory.Operator:
					return "Operator";
				case TokenCategory.PreprocessorKeyword:
					return "Preprocessor Keyword";
				case TokenCategory.String:
					return "String";
				case TokenCategory.Comment:
					return "Comment";
				case TokenCategory.XmlComment:
				{
					string xMLTagName = StructuralParserServicesHolder.GetXMLTagName();
					if (xMLTagName != null)
					{
						return xMLTagName;
					}
					return "XML Doc Tag";
				}
				default:
					return "Text";
				}
			}
			return "Text";
		}
	}

		public const int Using = 108;
	}

	public class CSharpPreprocessor : PreprocessorBase
	{
		public CSharpPreprocessor(CSharpScanner scanner, SourceFile rootNode)
			: base(scanner, rootNode)
		{
			errors = new PreprocessorErrors();
			set = CreateSetArray();
			maxTokens = 156;
		}

		public CSharpPreprocessor(CSharpScanner scanner, FormattingParserBase parser, SourceFile rootNode)
			: this(scanner, rootNode)
		{
			base.Parser = parser;
			if (base.Parser != null && base.Parser.SetTokensCategory)
			{
				base.PreprocessMode = PreprocessMode.None;
			}
		}

		protected override void Get()
		{
			while (true)
			{
				ProcessFormattingToken();
				tToken = la;
				la = base.Scanner.Scan();
				if (la.Type <= 156)
				{
					break;
				}
				la = tToken;
			}
			errDist++;
			tToken.Next = la;
			AddTokenToCategoryCollectionIfNeeded();
		}

		private void PreprocessorRoot()
		{
			if (la.Type == 137 || la.Type == 138)
			{
				PpDeclaration();
			}
			else if (StartOf(1))
			{
				PpConditional();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(157);
			}
		}

		private void PpDeclaration()
		{
			PreprocessorDirective directive = null;
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			if (la.Type == 137)
			{
				Get();
				IdnetifierOrKeyword();
				string value = tToken.Value;
				DefineMacro(value);
				DefineDirective defineDirective = new DefineDirective();
				defineDirective.Expression = value;
				defineDirective.Name = value;
				directive = defineDirective;
			}
			else if (la.Type == 138)
			{
				Get();
				IdnetifierOrKeyword();
				string value2 = tToken.Value;
				UndefMacro(value2);
				UndefDirective undefDirective = new UndefDirective();
				undefDirective.Symbol = value2;
				directive = undefDirective;
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(158);
			}
			SetDirectiveRange(directive, range);
			AddPreprocessorDirective(directive);
		}

		private void PpConditional()
		{
			if (la.Type == 139)
			{
				PpIfSection();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 140)
			{
				PpElIfSection();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 141)
			{
				PpElseSection();
			}
			else if (la.Type == 142)
			{
				PpEndIf();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(159);
			}
		}

		private void IdnetifierOrKeyword()
		{
			if (la.Type == 1)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else if (StartOf(2))
			{
				Keyword();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(160);
			}
		}

		private void PpIfSection()
		{
			bool result = false;
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			TurnOnScannerPreprocessMode();
			bool saveFormat = base.Parser.SaveFormat;
			base.Parser.SaveFormat = true;
			Expect(139);
			Token startToken = la;
			PpExpression(out result);
			base.Parser.SaveFormat = saveFormat;
			IfDirective ifDirective = new IfDirective();
			ifDirective.Expression = GetDirectiveExpression(startToken, tToken);
			ifDirective.ExpressionValue = result;
			SetDirectiveRange(ifDirective, range);
			AddPreprocessorDirective(ifDirective);
			CoditionDirectiveTail(WillSkipInIf(result));
			ProcessIFDirectiveCondition(result);
		}

		private void PpElIfSection()
		{
			bool result = false;
			SourceRange range = la.Range;
			TurnOnScannerPreprocessMode();
			bool saveFormat = base.Parser.SaveFormat;
			base.Parser.SaveFormat = true;
			Expect(140);
			Token startToken = la;
			PpExpression(out result);
			base.Parser.SaveFormat = saveFormat;
			ElifDirective elifDirective = new ElifDirective();
			elifDirective.Expression = GetDirectiveExpression(startToken, tToken);
			elifDirective.ExpressionValue = result;
			SetDirectiveRange(elifDirective, range);
			AddPreprocessorDirective(elifDirective);
			CoditionDirectiveTail(WillSkip(result));
			ProcessDirectiveCondition(result);
		}

		private void PpElseSection()
		{
			TurnOnScannerPreprocessMode();
			Expect(141);
			ElseDirective elseDirective = new ElseDirective();
			elseDirective.IsSatisfied = !base.ConditionWasTrue;
			SetDirectiveRange(elseDirective, tToken.Range);
			bool willSkip = WillSkip(result: true);
			AddPreprocessorDirective(elseDirective);
			CoditionDirectiveTail(willSkip);
			ProcessDirectiveCondition(condition: true);
		}

		private void PpEndIf()
		{
			Expect(142);
			EndIfDirective directive = new EndIfDirective();
			SetDirectiveRange(directive, tToken.Range);
			AddPreprocessorDirective(directive);
			ProcessNonNewLineToken(tToken as FormattingToken);
			ProcessEndIf();
		}

		private void PpExpression(out bool result)
		{
			result = false;
			base.AddFormattingTokens = false;
			PpOrExpression(out result);
			base.AddFormattingTokens = true;
		}

		private void CoditionDirectiveTail(bool willSkip)
		{
			ProcessSingleLineComment(la as FormattingToken);
			TurnOffScannerPreprocessMode();
			if (la.Type == 7)
			{
				AddLineTerminatorToFormattingTokens();
			}
			if (!willSkip)
			{
				ProcessLineTerminator(la as FormattingToken);
				Expect(7);
			}
		}

		private void PpOrExpression(out bool result)
		{
			result = false;
			bool result2 = false;
			PpAndExpression(out result);
			while (la.Type == 128)
			{
				Get();
				PpAndExpression(out result2);
				result |= result2;
			}
		}

		private void PpAndExpression(out bool result)
		{
			result = false;
			bool result2 = true;
			PpEqualityExpression(out result);
			while (la.Type == 129)
			{
				Get();
				PpEqualityExpression(out result2);
				result &= result2;
			}
		}

		private void PpEqualityExpression(out bool result)
		{
			result = false;
			bool result2 = false;
			bool flag = false;
			PpUnaryExpression(out result);
			while (la.Type == 96 || la.Type == 109)
			{
				if (la.Type == 96)
				{
					Get();
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					Get();
					flag = false;
				}
				PpUnaryExpression(out result2);
				if (flag)
				{
					result = result == result2;
				}
				else
				{
					result = result != result2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void PpUnaryExpression(out bool result)
		{
			result = false;
			if (StartOf(3))
			{
				PpPrimaryExpression(out result);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 110)
			{
				Get();
				PpUnaryExpression(out result);
				result = !result;
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(161);
			}
		}

		private void PpPrimaryExpression(out bool result)
		{
			result = false;
			if (la.Type == 70)
			{
				Get();
				result = true;
			}
			else if (la.Type == 31)
			{
				Get();
				result = false;
			}
			else if (StartOf(4))
			{
				IdnetifierOrKeyword();
				result = IsDefineMacro(tToken.Value);
			}
			else if (la.Type == 102)
			{
				ExprInParens(out result);
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(162);
			}
		}

	public class PreprocessorErrors : ParserErrorsBase
	{
		protected override string GetSyntaxErrorText(int n)
		{
			return n switch
			{
				0 => "EOF expected", 
				1 => "IDENT expected", 
				2 => "INTCON expected", 
				3 => "REALCON expected", 
				4 => "CHARCON expected", 
				5 => "STRINGCON expected", 
				6 => "SHARPCOCODIRECTIVE expected", 
				7 => "LINETERMINATOR expected", 
				8 => "ABSTRACT expected", 
				9 => "AS expected", 
				10 => "BASE expected", 
				11 => "BOOL expected", 
				12 => "BREAK expected", 
				13 => "BYTE expected", 
				14 => "CASE expected", 
				15 => "CATCH expected", 
				16 => "CHAR expected", 
				17 => "CHECKED expected", 
				18 => "CLASS expected", 
				19 => "CONST expected", 
				20 => "CONTINUE expected", 
				21 => "DECIMAL expected", 
				22 => "DEFAULT expected", 
				23 => "DELEGATE expected", 
				24 => "DO expected", 
				25 => "DOUBLE expected", 
				26 => "ELSE expected", 
				27 => "ENUM expected", 
				28 => "EVENT expected", 
				29 => "EXPLICIT expected", 
				30 => "EXTERN expected", 
				31 => "FALSE expected", 
				32 => "FINALLY expected", 
				33 => "FIXED expected", 
				34 => "FLOAT expected", 
				35 => "FOR expected", 
				36 => "FOREACH expected", 
				37 => "GOTO expected", 
				38 => "IFCLAUSE expected", 
				39 => "IMPLICIT expected", 
				40 => "IN expected", 
				41 => "INT expected", 
				42 => "INTERFACE expected", 
				43 => "INTERNAL expected", 
				44 => "IS expected", 
				45 => "LOCK expected", 
				46 => "LONG expected", 
				47 => "NAMESPACE expected", 
				48 => "NEW expected",
