	public enum PreprocessMode
	{
		None,
		SimplePreprocessing,
		SmartPreprocessing
	}
	public abstract class PreprocessorBase
	{
		private Stack _IfConditions;

		private FormattingParserBase _Parser;

		private const int minErrDist = 2;

		protected const bool T = true;

		protected const bool x = false;

		protected int errDist = 2;

		protected Token tToken;

		protected Token la;

		protected ParserErrorsBase errors;

		protected bool[,] set;

		protected int maxTokens;

		private SourceFile _SourceFile;

		private bool _AddFormattingTokens = true;

		private CSharpScanner _Scanner;

		private Dictionary<string, string> _Defines;

		private Dictionary<string, object> _OnlyThisFileDefines;

		private PreprocessMode _PreprocessMode = PreprocessMode.SimplePreprocessing;

		public FormattingParsingElement ActiveParsingElement;

		private List<object> _PreprocessorTokens;

		public bool AddFormattingTokens
		{
			get
			{
				return _AddFormattingTokens;
			}
			set
			{
				_AddFormattingTokens = value;
			}
		}

		protected FormattingParserBase Parser
		{
			get
			{
				return _Parser;
			}
			set
			{
				_Parser = value;
			}
		}

		protected CSharpScanner Scanner
		{
			get
			{
				return _Scanner;
			}
			set
			{
				_Scanner = value;
			}
		}

		protected PreprocessMode PreprocessMode
		{
			get
			{
				return _PreprocessMode;
			}
			set
			{
				_PreprocessMode = value;
			}
		}

		protected List<object> PreprocessorTokens
		{
			get
			{
				if (_PreprocessorTokens == null)
				{
					_PreprocessorTokens = new List<object>();
				}
				return _PreprocessorTokens;
			}
		}

		protected SourceFile SourceFile
		{
			get
			{
				return _SourceFile;
			}
			set
			{
				_SourceFile = value;
			}
		}

		protected Stack IfConditions => _IfConditions;

		public bool ConditionWasTrue
		{
			get
			{
				if (_IfConditions.Count > 0)
				{
					return (bool)_IfConditions.Peek();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void StartRule();

		protected abstract bool[,] CreateSetArray();

		protected abstract void Get();

		public PreprocessorBase(CSharpScanner scanner, SourceFile rootNode)
		{
			_IfConditions = new Stack();
			_Defines = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			_OnlyThisFileDefines = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			_Scanner = scanner;
			_SourceFile = rootNode;
			AddProjectDefines(rootNode);
		}

		private void AddDefineCall(string name)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) && !_OnlyThisFileDefines.ContainsKey(name) && _SourceFile != null)
			{
				string name2 = _SourceFile.Name;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
				{
					_SourceFile.AddInvalidateMacro(name);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddProjectDefines(SourceFile sourceFile)
		{
			if (sourceFile == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IProjectElement project = sourceFile.Project;
			if (project == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] defines = project.Defines;
			if (defines != null && defines.Length != 0)
			{
				string[] array = defines;
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					_Defines.Add(text, text);
				}
			}
		}

		protected string GetDirectiveExpression(Token startToken, Token endToken)
		{
			if (startToken == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			Token token = startToken;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(startToken.Value);
			while (token != endToken && token != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(GetFEText(((FormattingToken)token).FormattingElements));
				token = token.Next;
				if (token != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(token.Value);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected void ProcessFormattingToken()
		{
			int type = la.Type;
			if (AddFormattingTokens && type != 7 && type != 141 && type != 142 && type != 147 && type != 1)
			{
				Parser.AddFormattingElements(la as FormattingToken);
			}
		}

		protected bool ProcessLineTerminator(FormattingToken token)
		{
			if (token == null || token.Type != 7)
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddToActiveParsingElement(token.FormattingElements);
			return true;
		}

		protected void AddLineTerminatorToFormattingTokens()
		{
			AddToActiveParsingElement(new FormattingElement(FormattingElementType.EOL));
		}

		protected void ProcessSingleLineComment(FormattingToken token)
		{
			if (token != null && token.Type == 124)
			{
				Parser.AddCommentNode(token, ActiveParsingElement);
				Get();
			}
		}

		private void AddToActiveParsingElement(IFormattingElement element)
		{
			Parser.AddToParsingElement(ActiveParsingElement, element);
		}

		private void AddToActiveParsingElement(FormattingElements elements)
		{
			Parser.AddToParsingElement(ActiveParsingElement, elements);
		}

		private string GetTokenValue(FormattingToken token)
		{
			if (token == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(token.Value);
			stringBuilder.Append(GetFEText(token.FormattingElements));
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal string GetFEText(FormattingElements fes)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (fes == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			foreach (IFormattingElement fe in fes)
			{
				if (fe is FormattingElement formattingElement)
				{
					if (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.WS)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(' ');
					}
					else if (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.Tab)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append('\t');
					}
					else if (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected void DefineMacro(string name)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				if (!_OnlyThisFileDefines.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					_OnlyThisFileDefines.Add(name, null);
				}
				if (!_Defines.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					_Defines.Add(name, name);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void AddTokenToCategoryCollectionIfNeeded()
		{
			if (_Parser != null)
			{
				_Parser.SaveCategorizedTokenIfNeeded(la);
			}
		}

		protected void UndefMacro(string name)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				AddDefineCall(name);
				if (_Defines.ContainsKey(name))
				{
					_Defines.Remove(name);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void Expect(int n)
		{
			if (la.Type == n)
			{
				Get();
			}
			else
			{
				SynErr(n);
			}
		}

		protected void SynErr(int n)
		{
			if (errDist >= 2)
			{
				errors.SynErr(la.Line, la.Column, n);
			}
			errDist = 0;
		}

		protected bool StartOf(int s)
		{
			return set[s, la.Type];
		}

		public Token Preprocess(Token laToken)
		{
			PreprocessorTokens.Clear();
			la = laToken;
			StartRule();
			return la;
		}

		private bool IsEOF(StringBuilder bufferString)
		{
			return _Scanner.IsEof(bufferString);
		}

		private bool IsNextChar(char ch, StringBuilder bufferString)
		{
			return _Scanner.IsNextChar(ch, bufferString);
		}

		private FormattingElements CutPPFormElements(FormattingToken token)
		{
			FormattingElements formattingElements = token.FormattingElements;
			FormattingElements result = new FormattingElements();
			if (formattingElements == null || formattingElements.Count == 0)
			{
				return result;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < formattingElements.Count; i++)
			{
				FormattingElement formattingElement = formattingElements[i] as FormattingElement;
				if (formattingElement.Type == FormattingElementType.EOL)
				{
					result = formattingElements.GetElements(i + 1, formattingElements.Count - (i + 1));
					formattingElements.RemoveRange(i, formattingElements.Count - i);
					return result;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected void ProcessNonNewLineToken(FormattingToken t)
		{
			if (t == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string value = t.Value;
			if (!value.StartsWith("#"))
			{
				return;
			}
			value = value.Remove(0, 1);
			value = value.TrimStart();
			while (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				char c = value[0];
				if (!char.IsLetter(c))
				{
					break;
				}
				value = value.Remove(0, 1);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				AddToActiveParsingElement(new InsignificantDirectiveText(value));
			}
		}

		private void IfWaitEndIf()
		{
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = la.Type != 7;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			try
			{
				if (la.Type != 7)
				{
					FormattingElements formattingElements = null;
					formattingElements = CutPPFormElements(tToken as FormattingToken);
					stringBuilder.Append(GetFEText(formattingElements));
					if (la.Type == 141 || la.Type == 140 || la.Type == 142)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (la.Type == 139)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("#if ");
						AddTokenToCategoryCollectionIfNeeded();
						num++;
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(GetTokenValue(la as FormattingToken));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(GetFEText(((FormattingToken)la).FormattingElements));
				}
				while (true)
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
					if (IsEOF(stringBuilder2))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(stringBuilder2.ToString());
						break;
					}
					if (IsNextChar('#', stringBuilder2))
					{
						tToken = la;
						bool saveFormat = _Scanner.SaveFormat;
						_Scanner.SaveFormat = true;
						la = _Scanner.Scan();
						_Scanner.SaveFormat = saveFormat;
						AddTokenToCategoryCollectionIfNeeded();
						if (la.Type == 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (la.Type == 139)
						{
							num++;
						}
						if ((la.Type == 141 || la.Type == 140) && num == 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (la.Type == 142)
						{
							if (num == 0)
							{
								break;
							}
							num--;
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(stringBuilder2.ToString());
						stringBuilder.Append(GetTokenValue(la as FormattingToken));
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(stringBuilder2.ToString());
						stringBuilder.Append(SkipToEOL());
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				AddToActiveParsingElement(new DeadCode(stringBuilder.ToString()));
			}
		}

		protected void SkipToEolIfNeeded()
		{
			if (la.Type != 7 && la.Type != 0)
			{
				string text = SkipToEOL();
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessIFDirectiveCondition(bool condition)
		{
			if (_PreprocessMode != PreprocessMode.None)
			{
				IfConditions.Push(condition);
				if (!condition)
				{
					IfWaitEndIf();
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool WillSkipInIf(bool result)
		{
			if (_PreprocessMode == PreprocessMode.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !result;
		}

		protected bool WillSkip(bool result)
		{
			if (_PreprocessMode == PreprocessMode.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ConditionWasTrue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (result)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ProcessDirectiveConditionCore(bool condition)
		{
			if (condition)
			{
				if (IfConditions.Count > 0)
				{
					IfConditions.Pop();
				}
				IfConditions.Push(true);
			}
			else
			{
				IfWaitEndIf();
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessDirectiveCondition(bool condition)
		{
			if (_PreprocessMode != PreprocessMode.None)
			{
				if (ConditionWasTrue)
				{
					IfWaitEndIf();
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessDirectiveConditionCore(condition);
				}
			}
		}

		protected string GetNextToken()
		{
			if (la == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string value = la.Value;
			Get();
			return value;
		}

		protected bool IsDefineMacro(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddDefineCall(name);
			return _Defines.ContainsKey(name);
		}

		protected void AddPreprocessorDirective(PreprocessorDirective directive)
		{
			if (directive == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SourceFile sourceFile = SourceFile;
			if (sourceFile == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Parser != null && Parser.SaveFormat)
			{
				AddToActiveParsingElement(directive);
				if (tToken is FormattingToken formattingToken)
				{
					AddToActiveParsingElement(formattingToken.FormattingElements);
				}
			}
			sourceFile.AddSimpleDirective(directive, inEach: false);
			sourceFile.CompilerDirectiveRootNode?.AddNode(directive);
		}

		protected void SetDirectiveRange(LanguageElement directive, SourceRange range)
		{
			range = SourceRangeUtils.GetRange(range, tToken.Range);
			directive.SetRange(range);
		}

		protected void TurnOnScannerPreprocessMode()
		{
			_Scanner.InPreprocess = true;
		}

		protected void TurnOffScannerPreprocessMode()
		{
			_Scanner.InPreprocess = false;
		}

		protected string SkipToEOL()
		{
			return _Scanner.SkipToEOL();
		}

		public void CleanUp()
		{
			_Defines.Clear();
			_IfConditions.Clear();
			_SourceFile = null;
			_Scanner = null;
			tToken = null;
			la = null;
			errors = null;
			set = null;
		}

		private void ProcessNonEndLineToken(FormattingToken t)
		{
			if (t != null)
			{
				string value = t.Value;
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessEndIf()
		{
			if (IfConditions.Count > 0)
			{
				IfConditions.Pop();
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class BaseFormattingRule
	{
		private object _Value;

		private FormattingRuleCollection _ParentCollection;

		protected const ParserLanguageID CSharpAndBasic = ParserLanguageID.CSharp | ParserLanguageID.Basic;

		public abstract FormattingCategory Category { get; }

		public abstract string Name { get; }

		public abstract string SubCategory { get; }

		public virtual ParserLanguageID SupportedLanguage => ParserLanguageID.None;

		public bool Enabled => GetValue<bool>();

		public bool BoolValue => Enabled;

		public int IntValue => Convert.ToInt32(Value);

		public string StringValue => GetValue<string>();

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (_Value == null)
				{
					return DefaultValue;
				}
				return _Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(_Value, value))
				{
					object value2 = _Value;
					_Value = value;
					ValueChanged(value2);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual object DefaultValue => null;

		public int DefaultIntValue => Convert.ToInt32(DefaultValue);

		public virtual FormattingOption EditOption => FormattingOption.Boolean;

		public FormattingRuleCollection ParentCollection
		{
			get
			{
				return _ParentCollection;
			}
			internal set
			{
				_ParentCollection = value;
			}
		}

		private T GetValue<T>()
		{
			return GetValue<T>(Value);
		}

		private T GetDefaultValue<T>()
		{
			return GetValue<T>(DefaultValue);
		}

		private T GetValue<T>(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is T)
			{
				return (T)obj;
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		protected virtual void ValueChanged(object oldValue)
		{
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual object GetDefaultValue(LanguageElement element)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsLanguageSupport(ParserLanguageID languageID)
		{
			return (SupportedLanguage & languageID) != 0;
		}
	}
	public class BlankLinesFormattingOptions : FormattingOptions
	{
		private bool _AfterFileOptionsSection;

		private bool _AfterImportedNamespacesSection;

		private bool _AfterNamespaces;

		private bool _AfterTypeDeclarations;

		private bool _AfterSingleLineMembers;

		private bool _AfterMultiLineMembers;

		private bool _AroundRegionDirectives;

		private bool _InsideRegionDirectives;

		private bool _AfterGlobalAttributes;

		private bool _BetweenDifferentImportedNamespacesGroups;

		private bool _AfterProcessingInstructions;

		private bool _MaximumBlankLinesBetweenTags;

		public bool AfterFileOptionsSection => _AfterFileOptionsSection;

		public bool AfterImportedNamespacesSection => _AfterImportedNamespacesSection;

		public bool AfterNamespaces => _AfterNamespaces;

		public bool AfterTypeDeclarations => _AfterTypeDeclarations;

		public bool AfterSingleLineMembers => _AfterSingleLineMembers;

		public bool AfterMultiLineMembers => _AfterMultiLineMembers;

		public bool AroundRegionDirectives => _AroundRegionDirectives;

		public bool InsideRegionDirectives => _InsideRegionDirectives;

		public bool AfterGlobalAttributes => _AfterGlobalAttributes;

		public bool BetweenDifferentImportedNamespacesGroups => _BetweenDifferentImportedNamespacesGroups;

		public bool AfterProcessingInstructions => _AfterProcessingInstructions;

		public bool MaximumBlankLinesBetweenTags => _MaximumBlankLinesBetweenTags;

		public override void Load(FormattingRuleCollection rules)
		{
			_AfterFileOptionsSection = GetOptionByName("After file options section", rules);
			_AfterImportedNamespacesSection = GetOptionByName("After imported namespaces section", rules);
			_AfterNamespaces = GetOptionByName("After namespaces", rules);
			_AfterTypeDeclarations = GetOptionByName("After type declarations", rules);
			_AfterSingleLineMembers = GetOptionByName("After single line members", rules);
			_AfterMultiLineMembers = GetOptionByName("After multi line members", rules);
			_AroundRegionDirectives = GetOptionByName("Around region directives", rules);

	public abstract class FormattingOptions
	{
		protected bool GetOptionByName(string name, FormattingRuleCollection rules)
		{
			return rules[name]?.Enabled ?? false;
		}

		public abstract void Load(FormattingRuleCollection rules);

		public abstract void LoadDefault(ParserLanguageID language);
	}
	public class FormattingRuleCollection : IEnumerable<BaseFormattingRule>, IEnumerable, IComparer<BaseFormattingRule>
	{
		private Dictionary<string, BaseFormattingRule> _Rules = new Dictionary<string, BaseFormattingRule>();

		public BaseFormattingRule this[string name] => Find(name);

		public int Count => _Rules.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => false;

		private void Sort()
		{
			List<BaseFormattingRule> list = new List<BaseFormattingRule>(_Rules.Values);
			list.Sort(this);
			_Rules.Clear();
			foreach (BaseFormattingRule item in list)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void Add(BaseFormattingRule rule)
		{
			if (rule.Name != null)
			{
				rule.ParentCollection = this;
				_Rules[rule.Name] = rule;
			}
		}

		public void Add(BaseFormattingRule rule, object value)
		{
			if (rule != null)
			{
				rule.Value = value;
				Add(rule);
			}
		}

		public bool Enabled(string name)
		{
			return Find(name)?.Enabled ?? false;
		}

		public object GetDefaultValue(string name)
		{
			return Find(name)?.DefaultValue;
		}

		public BaseFormattingRule Find(string name)
		{
			BaseFormattingRule value = null;
			if (_Rules.TryGetValue(name, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static FormattingRuleCollection GetRulesByLanguage(ParserLanguageID languageId)
		{
			FormattingRuleCollection formattingRuleCollection = new FormattingRuleCollection();
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BaseFormattingRule);
			Assembly executingAssembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
			Type[] types = executingAssembly.GetTypes();
			foreach (Type type in types)
			{
				if (type.IsAbstract || !typeFromHandle.IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					BaseFormattingRule baseFormattingRule = (BaseFormattingRule)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
					if (baseFormattingRule.IsLanguageSupport(languageId))
					{
						formattingRuleCollection.Add(baseFormattingRule);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			formattingRuleCollection.Sort();
			return formattingRuleCollection;
		}

		IEnumerator<BaseFormattingRule> IEnumerable<BaseFormattingRule>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _Rules.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return _Rules.Values.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public int Compare(BaseFormattingRule x, BaseFormattingRule y)
		{
			int num = string.Compare(x.Category.ToString(), y.Category.ToString());
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			string text = x.SubCategory.Split('\\')[0];
			string text2 = y.SubCategory.Split('\\')[0];
			if (text == "General" && text != text2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (text2 == "General" && text != text2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (text == "Other" && text != text2)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (text2 == "Other" && text != text2)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			num = string.Compare(x.SubCategory, y.SubCategory);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return string.Compare(x.Name, y.Name);
		}
	}
	internal class AfterImportedNamespaceSection : BlankLinesBaseRule
	{
		public override string Name => "After imported namespaces section";

		public override object DefaultValue => true;

		public override object GetDefaultValue(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null || !(element is NamespaceReference))
			{
				return null;
			}
			LanguageElement nextCodeSibling = element.NextCodeSibling;
			if (nextCodeSibling == null || nextCodeSibling is NamespaceReference)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.GetDefaultValue(element);
		}
	}

	internal class IndentArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents : IndentationBaseRule
	{
		public override string Name => "Indent array, object and collection initializer contents";

		public override object DefaultValue => false;

		protected override void ValueChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (!base.BoolValue || base.ParentCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BaseFormattingRule baseFormattingRule = base.ParentCollection["Wrap array, object and collection initializers"];
			BaseFormattingRule baseFormattingRule2 = base.ParentCollection["Wrap first array, object and collection initializer"];
			if ((baseFormattingRule == null || !baseFormattingRule.BoolValue) && (baseFormattingRule2 == null || !baseFormattingRule2.BoolValue))
			{
				if (baseFormattingRule != null)
				{
					baseFormattingRule.Value = true;
				}
				else if (baseFormattingRule2 != null)
				{
					baseFormattingRule2.Value = true;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal abstract class WrapBase : WrappingAlignmentBaseRule
	{
		private string _AlignRuleName;

		private string _WrapRuleName;

		public WrapBase(string alignRuleName, string wrapRuleName)
		{
			_AlignRuleName = alignRuleName;
			_WrapRuleName = wrapRuleName;
		}

		protected override void ValueChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (base.Enabled || base.ParentCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_WrapRuleName))
			{
				BaseFormattingRule baseFormattingRule = base.ParentCollection[_WrapRuleName];
				if (baseFormattingRule != null && baseFormattingRule.Enabled)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_AlignRuleName))
			{
				BaseFormattingRule baseFormattingRule2 = base.ParentCollection[_AlignRuleName];
				if (baseFormattingRule2 != null)
				{
					baseFormattingRule2.Value = false;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class AlignBase : WrappingAlignmentBaseRule
	{
		private string _WrapRuleName;

		private string _WrapFirstRuleName;

		public AlignBase(string wrapRuleName, string wrapFirstRuleName)
		{
			_WrapFirstRuleName = wrapFirstRuleName;
			_WrapRuleName = wrapRuleName;
		}

		protected override void ValueChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (!base.Enabled || base.ParentCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BaseFormattingRule baseFormattingRule = null;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_WrapFirstRuleName))
			{
				baseFormattingRule = base.ParentCollection[_WrapFirstRuleName];
				if (baseFormattingRule != null && baseFormattingRule.Enabled)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_WrapRuleName))
			{
				BaseFormattingRule baseFormattingRule2 = base.ParentCollection[_WrapRuleName];
				if (baseFormattingRule2 != null)
				{
					if (!baseFormattingRule2.Enabled)
					{
						baseFormattingRule2.Value = true;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (baseFormattingRule != null)
			{
				baseFormattingRule.Value = true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class WrappingAlignmentBaseRule : BaseFormattingRule
	{
		public override FormattingCategory Category => FormattingCategory.WrappingAndAlignment;

		public override string SubCategory => "General";

		public override ParserLanguageID SupportedLanguage => ParserLanguageID.CSharp | ParserLanguageID.Basic;

		public override object DefaultValue => false;
	}
	public class GeneralFormattingOptions : FormattingOptions
	{
		private bool _AdjustCodeStyleOnAutoformat;

		private bool _KeepExistingLineBreaks;

		private bool _KeepExistingWhiteSpace;

		private bool _KeepExpressionsIndent;

		public bool AdjustCodeStyleOnAutoformat => _AdjustCodeStyleOnAutoformat;

		public bool KeepExistingLineBreaks => _KeepExistingLineBreaks;

		public bool KeepExistingWhiteSpace => _KeepExistingWhiteSpace;

		public bool KeepExpressionsIndent => _KeepExpressionsIndent;

		public override void Load(FormattingRuleCollection rules)
		{
			_AdjustCodeStyleOnAutoformat = GetOptionByName("Adjust code style on autoformat", rules);
			_KeepExistingLineBreaks = GetOptionByName("Keep existing line breaks", rules);
			_KeepExistingWhiteSpace = GetOptionByName("Keep existing white space", rules);
			_KeepExpressionsIndent = GetOptionByName("Keep expressions indent", rules);
		}

		public override void LoadDefault(ParserLanguageID language)
		{
		}
	}
	public class IndentionFormattingOptions : FormattingOptions
	{
		private bool _OpenAndCloseBraces;

		private bool _CodeBlockContents;

		private bool _AnonymousMethodContents;

		private bool _ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents;

		private bool _CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement;

		private bool _CaseStatementContents;

		private bool _IndentLabels;

		private bool _IndentComment;

		private bool _IndentNestedUsingStatements;

		public bool OpenAndCloseBraces => _OpenAndCloseBraces;

		public bool CodeBlockContents => _CodeBlockContents;

		public bool AnonymousMethodContents => _AnonymousMethodContents;

		public bool ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents => _ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents;

		public bool CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement => _CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement;

		public bool CaseStatementContents => _CaseStatementContents;

		public bool IndentLabels => _IndentLabels;

		public bool IndentComment => _IndentComment;

		public bool IndentNestedUsingStatements => _IndentNestedUsingStatements;

		public override void Load(FormattingRuleCollection rules)
		{
			_OpenAndCloseBraces = GetOptionByName("Indent open and close braces", rules);
			_CodeBlockContents = GetOptionByName("Indent code block contents", rules);
			_AnonymousMethodContents = GetOptionByName("Indent anonymous method contents", rules);
			_ArrayObjectAndCollectionInitializerContents = GetOptionByName("Indent array, object and collection initializer contents", rules);
			_CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement = GetOptionByName("Indent case statement from switch statement", rules);
			_CaseStatementContents = GetOptionByName("Indent case statement contents", rules);
			_IndentLabels = GetOptionByName("Indent labels", rules);
			_IndentComment = GetOptionByName("Indent comments", rules);
			_IndentNestedUsingStatements = GetOptionByName("Indent nested 'using' statements", rules);
		}

		public override void LoadDefault(ParserLanguageID language)
		{
			_AnonymousMethodContents = true;
			_CodeBlockContents = true;
			_CaseStatementContents = true;
			_CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement = true;
			_IndentNestedUsingStatements = true;
			_IndentComment = true;
		}
	}
	public interface IFormattingService
	{
		FormattingRuleCollection this[ParserLanguageID languageId] { get; }

		FormattingRuleCollection GetRules(ParserLanguageID languageId);

		void SetDefaults(ParserLanguageID languageId);

		bool Enabled(ParserLanguageID languageId, string optionName);

		int GetIntValue(ParserLanguageID languageId, string optionName);

		string GetStringValue(ParserLanguageID languageId, string optionName);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void Save(ParserLanguageID languageId);

		bool Format(SourceFile file, SourceRange range);

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void FormatRange(SourceFile file, SourceRange range);

		IRuleChanger GetRuleChanger(ParserLanguageID language);
	}

	internal static class CurlyBraceHelper
	{
		private static int GetNodeCount(LanguageElement element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return GetNodeCount(element.Nodes);
		}

		private static int GetNodeCount(NodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null || nodes.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (LanguageElement node in nodes)
			{
				if (!(node is SupportElement))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static bool IsSimpleElement(LanguageElement element, CodeGenOptions options)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (element.NodeCount == 0 && element.DetailNodeCount == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (element.NodeCount > 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element.NodeCount > 0)
			{
				foreach (LanguageElement node in element.Nodes)
				{
					if (!IsSimpleElement(node, options))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (element.DetailNodeCount > 0)
			{
				foreach (LanguageElement detailNode in element.DetailNodes)
				{
					if (!IsSimpleElement(detailNode, options))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			LanguageElementType elementType = element.ElementType;
			if (elementType == LanguageElementType.Else || (uint)(elementType - 49) <= 2u || (uint)(elementType - 57) <= 1u)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is ArrayInitializerExpression)
			{
				ArrayInitializerExpression arrayInitializerExpression = (ArrayInitializerExpression)element;
				if (arrayInitializerExpression.Initializers.Count > 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (element is Method && ((Method)element).Parameters.Count > 0 && (options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstFormalParameter || options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFormalParameters))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is MethodCall && ((MethodCall)element).ArgumentsCount > 0 && (options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument || options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is MethodCallExpression && ((MethodCallExpression)element).ArgumentsCount > 0 && (options.WrappingAlignment.WrapFirstInvocationArgument || options.WrappingAlignment.WrapInvocationArguments))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is LambdaExpression && !options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine && (options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForLambdaExpressions || options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForLambdaExpressions))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is AnonymousMethodExpression && !options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine && (options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousMethods || options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousMethods))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is If && !options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleEmbeddedStatementOnSingleLine)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (element is Switch)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static void AddTokensBeforeOpen(FormattingElements tokens, CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			CodeGenOptions options = codeGen.Options;
			LanguageElement context = codeGen.Context;
			bool flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForCodeBlocks && context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression;
			bool flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpenCurlyBraceOnTheSameLine && context.ElementType != LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression;
			switch (context.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Property:
			{
				Property property = (Property)context;
				bool flag4 = property.Parent != null && property.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Interface;
				bool flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				if (flag4 || property.IsAbstract)
				{
					flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceAbstractInterfaceMemberOnSingleLine;
				}
				else if (property.IsAutoImplemented)
				{
					flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceAutoImplementedPropertyOnSingleLine;
				}
				flag = !flag3 && options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForProperties;
				flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningBraceInProperty;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
			{
				bool flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAccessorOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag = !flag3 && flag;
				flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningBraceInAccessor;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Method:
			{
				bool flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForMethods && !flag3;
				flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpenCurlyBraceOnTheSameLine;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Namespace:
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForNamespaces;
				flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpenCurlyBraceOnTheSameLine;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
			{
				bool flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAccessorOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningBraceInAccessor;
				flag = !flag3 && flag;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Class:
			case LanguageElementType.Enum:
			case LanguageElementType.Interface:
			case LanguageElementType.Struct:
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForTypeDeclarations;
				flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpenCurlyBraceOnTheSameLine;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Block:
			{
				LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
				if (parent != null && parent.NodeCount == 1 && parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Case)
				{
					flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForBlocksUnderCaseStatement;
				}
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Event:
			{
				bool flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag2 = options.Spacing.BeforeOpeningBraceInProperty;
				flag = !flag3 && options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForProperties;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression:
			{
				bool flag3 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				bool flag5 = context.NodeCount > 0 && context.Nodes[0] is Expression;
				bool flag6 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForLambdaExpressions && !flag5;
				flag2 = !options.Spacing.AroundLambdaExpressionOperator && flag2;
				flag = !flag3 && flag6;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression:
				flag = (!options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine || !IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options)) && options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousMethods;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
				flag = ((!(context.Parent is ObjectCreationExpression { ObjectType: null })) ? options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers : options.LineBreaks.PlaceOpenBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousTypes);
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				tokens.AddNewLine();
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			if (options.Indention.OpenAndCloseBraces)
			{
				tokens.AddIncreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		public static void AddTokensAfterOpen(FormattingElements tokens, CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			CodeGenOptions options = codeGen.Options;
			LanguageElement context = codeGen.Context;
			if (context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (options.Indention.OpenAndCloseBraces)
			{
				tokens.AddDecreaseIndent();
			}
			int nodeCount = GetNodeCount(context);
			bool flag2 = !options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine || !IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
			bool flag3 = options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			switch (context.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Property:
			{
				Property property = (Property)context;
				bool flag5 = property.Parent != null && property.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Interface;
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				if (flag5 || property.IsAbstract)
				{
					flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceAbstractInterfaceMemberOnSingleLine;
				}
				else if (property.IsAutoImplemented)
				{
					flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceAutoImplementedPropertyOnSingleLine;
				}
				flag = flag4 && options.Spacing.WithinBracesInPropertyDeclaration && nodeCount > 0;
				flag2 = !flag4;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
			case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAccessorOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag = options.Spacing.WithinSingleLineAccessor && flag4;
				flag2 = !flag4;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Method:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag = options.Spacing.WithinSingleLineMethod && flag4;
				flag2 = !flag4 && nodeCount > 0;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Namespace:
				flag2 = nodeCount > 0;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Event:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag2 = !flag4;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag = options.Spacing.WithinSingleLineAnonymousMethod && flag4;
				flag3 = options.Indention.AnonymousMethodContents;
				flag2 = !flag4;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
				flag = options.Spacing.WithinArrayInitializerBraces;
				flag2 = false;
				flag3 = false;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Switch:
				flag3 = options.Indention.CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Class:
			case LanguageElementType.Enum:
			case LanguageElementType.Interface:
			case LanguageElementType.Struct:
				flag2 = nodeCount > 0;
				break;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				tokens.AddNewLine();
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				tokens.AddIncreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		public static void AddTokensBeforeClose(FormattingElements tokens, CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			LanguageElement context = codeGen.Context;
			if (context.ElementType == LanguageElementType.MarkupExtensionExpression)
			{
				return;
			}
			CodeGenOptions options = codeGen.Options;
			int nodeCount = GetNodeCount(context);
			bool flag = (!options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine || !IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options)) && options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForCodeBlocks && nodeCount > 0;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = options.Indention.CodeBlockContents;
			switch (context.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Property:
			{
				Property property = (Property)context;
				bool flag5 = property.Parent != null && property.Parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Interface;
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				if (flag5 || property.IsAbstract)
				{
					flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceAbstractInterfaceMemberOnSingleLine;
				}
				else if (property.IsAutoImplemented)
				{
					flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceAutoImplementedPropertyOnSingleLine;
				}
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForProperties && !flag4 && nodeCount > 0;
				flag2 = options.Spacing.WithinBracesInPropertyDeclaration && !property.IsAutoImplemented && !property.IsAbstract && nodeCount > 0;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
			case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAccessorOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag = !flag4 && options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForCodeBlocks && nodeCount > 0;
				flag2 = options.Spacing.WithinSingleLineAccessor && flag4;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Method:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleMemberOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag2 = options.Spacing.WithinSingleLineMethod && flag4;
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForMethods && !flag4;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Namespace:
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForNamespaces;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Class:
			case LanguageElementType.Enum:
			case LanguageElementType.Interface:
			case LanguageElementType.Struct:
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForTypeDeclarations;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Block:
			{
				LanguageElement parent = context.Parent;
				if (parent != null && parent.NodeCount == 1 && parent.ElementType == LanguageElementType.Case)
				{
					flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForBlocksUnderCaseStatement && nodeCount > 0;
				}
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.Event:
				flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForProperties;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.LambdaExpression:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag3 = options.Indention.AnonymousMethodContents;
				flag = !flag4 && options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForLambdaExpressions && nodeCount > 0;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.AnonymousMethodExpression:
			{
				bool flag4 = options.LineBreaks.PlaceSimpleAnonymousMethodOnSingleLine && IsSimpleElement(context, codeGen.Options);
				flag = !flag4 && options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousMethods && nodeCount > 0;
				flag2 = flag4 && options.Spacing.WithinSingleLineAnonymousMethod && nodeCount < 2;
				flag3 = options.Indention.AnonymousMethodContents;
				break;
			}
			case LanguageElementType.ArrayInitializerExpression:
			case LanguageElementType.ObjectInitializerExpression:
				if (context.Parent is ObjectCreationExpression { ObjectType: null })
				{
					flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForAnonymousTypes;
				}
				else
				{
					int nodeCount2 = GetNodeCount(context.DetailNodes);
					flag = options.LineBreaks.PlaceCloseBraceOnNewLineForArrayObjectAndCollInitializers && nodeCount2 > 0;
				}
				flag2 = options.Spacing.WithinArrayInitializerBraces;
				flag3 = false;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Switch:
				flag3 = options.Indention.CaseStatementFromSwitchStatement;
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				tokens.AddNewLine();
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				tokens.AddWhiteSpace();
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				tokens.AddDecreaseIndent();
			}
			if (options.Indention.OpenAndCloseBraces)
			{
				tokens.AddIncreaseIndent();
			}
		}

		public static void AddTokensAfterClose(FormattingElements tokens, CodeGen codeGen)
		{
			if (codeGen.Options.Indention.OpenAndCloseBraces)
			{
				tokens.AddDecreaseIndent();
			}
			LanguageElement context = codeGen.Context;
			CodeGenOptions options = codeGen.Options;
			bool flag = false;
			switch (context.ElementType)
			{
			case LanguageElementType.Namespace:
				flag = options.BlankLines.AfterNamespaces && context.NextCodeSibling != null;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.Class:
			case LanguageElementType.Enum:
			case LanguageElementType.Interface:
			case LanguageElementType.Struct:
				flag = options.BlankLines.AfterTypeDeclarations && context.NextSibling != null;
				break;
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorGet:
			case LanguageElementType.PropertyAccessorSet:
			case LanguageElementType.EventAdd:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRemove:
			case LanguageElementType.EventRaise:
				if (context.NextCodeSibling != null)
				{
					tokens.AddNewLine();
				}
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				tokens.AddNewLine();
			}
		}
	}
}
